d:
**1.** father of an individual
**2.** of God as father of his people
**3.** head or founder of a household, group, family, or clan
**4.** ancestor
		**a.** grandfather, forefathers — of person
		**b.** of people
**5.** originator or patron of a class, profession, or art
**6.** of producer, generator (fig.)
**7.** of benevolence and protection (fig.)
**8.** term of respect and honour
**9.** ruler or chief (spec.)
s: A primitive word; *father* in a literal and immediate, or figurative and remote application: - chief, (fore-) father (\[-less\]), X patrimony, principal. Compare names in “Abi-”

d: **1.** father
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1](H1): - father.

d: **1.** freshness, fresh green, green shoots, or greenery
s: From the same as [H24](H24); a *green* plant: - greenness, fruit.

d: **1.** fruit, fresh, young, greening
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3](H3): - fruit.

d:
Abagtha = "God-given"
**1.** one of the seven eunuchs in the Persian court of Ahasuerus
s: Of foreign origin; *Abagtha*, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Abagtha.

d:
**1.** perish, vanish, go astray, be destroyed
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** perish, die, be exterminated
				**2.** perish, vanish (fig.)
				**3.** be lost, strayed
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to destroy, kill, cause to perish, to give up (as lost), exterminate
				**2.** to blot out, do away with, cause to vanish, (fig.)
				**3.** cause to stray, lose
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to destroy, put to death
						**a.** of divine judgment
				**2.** object name of kings (fig.)
s: A primitive root; properly to *wander* away, that is *lose* oneself; by implication to *perish* (causatively, *destroy*): - break, destroy (-uction), + not escape, fail, lose, (cause to, make) perish, spend, X and surely, take, be undone, X utterly, be void of, have no way to flee.

d:
**1.** to perish, vanish
		**a.** (P'al) shall perish
		**b.** (Aphel) destroy
		**c.** (Hophal) be destroyed
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6](H6): - destroy, perish.

d: **1.** destruction
s: Active participle of [H6](H6); (concretely) *wretched* or (abstractly) *destruction: -* perish.

d: **1.** a lost thing, something lost
s: From [H6](H6); concretely something *lost*; abstractly *destruction*, that is Hades: - lost. Compare [H10](H10).

d: **1.** a lost thing, something lost, a perishing
s: The same as [H9](H9), miswritten for [H11](H11); a *perishing: -* destruction.
o: the same as [H9](H9), incorrectly written for [H11](H11)

d: **1.** place of destruction, destruction, ruin, Abaddon
s: Intensively from [H6](H6); abstractly a *perishing*; concretely Hades: - destruction.

d: **1.** destruction
s: From [H6](H6); a *perishing: -* destruction.

d: **1.** destruction
s: From [H6](H6); a *perishing: -* destruction.

d:
**1.** to be willing, consent
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be willing
				**2.** to consent, yield to, accept
				**3.** to desire
s: A primitive root; to *breathe* after, that is (figuratively) to *be* *acquiescent: -* consent, rest content, will, be willing.

d: **1.** entreat, longing, desire
s: From [H14](H14); *longing: -* desire.

d:
**1.** reed, papyrus
++++
Probably ships made of reeds or papyrus were the clipper sailing ships of those days because of their speed.
s: From [H14](H14) (in the sense of *bending* towards); the *papyrus: -* swift.
o: from [H14](H14) (in the sense of bending toward)

d: **1.** Oh!, Woe!, (exclamation of pain — indicates desire or uneasiness)
s: From [H14](H14) (in the sense of *desiring*); *want: -* sorrow.

d: **1.** crib, manger, feeding trough
s: From [H75](H75); a *manger* or *stall: -* crib.

d: **1.** slaughter, flesh, meat, slaughtered meat
s: From an unused root (apparently meaning to *turn*); *brandishing* of a sword: - point.
o: from an unused root (apparently meaning to turn)

d: **1.** watermelon, Egyptian fruit
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *melon* (only plural): - melon.

d:
Abi = "my father"
**1.** mother of Hezekiah (cf H029)
s: From [H1](H1); *fatherly*; *Abi*, Hezekiah’s mother: - Abi.

d:
Abiel = "El (God) is (my) father"
**1.** Saul's grandfather
s: From [H1](H1) and [H410](H410); *father* (that is *possessor*) *of* *God*; *Abiel*, the name of two Israelites: - Abiel.

d:
Abiasaph = "my father has gathered"
**1.** son (descendant) of Korah
s: From [H1](H1) and [H622](H622); *father* *of* *gathering* (that is *gatherer*); *Abiasaph*, an Israelite: - Abiasaph.

d:
**1.** fresh, young barley ears, barley
**2.** month of ear-forming, of greening of crop, of growing green Abib, month of exodus and passover (March or April)
s: From an unused root (meaning to *be* *tender*); *green*, that is a young *ear* of grain; hence the name of the month *Abib* or Nisan: - Abib, ear, green ears of corn.
o: from an unused root (meaning to be tender)

d:
Abi Gibon = "father of Gibeon"
**1.** site of great Bamah, location of the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place
s: From [H1](H1) and [H1391](H1391); *father* (that is *founder*) *of* *Gibon*; *Abi-Gibon*, perhaps an Israelite: - father of Gibeon.

d:
Abigail = "my father is joy"
**1.** wife of Nabal, then of David
**2.** sister of David
s: From [H1](H1) and [H1524](H1524); *father* (that is *source*) *of* *joy*; *Abigail* or *Abigal*, the name of two Israelitesses: - Abigal.

d:
Abidan = "my father is judge"
**1.** a prince (ruler) of Benjamin
s: From [H1](H1) and [H1777](H1777); *father* *of* *judgment* (that is *judge*); *Abidan*, an Israelite: - Abidan.

d:
Abida or Abidah = "my father knows"
**1.** fourth son of Midian and grandson of Abraham by his wife Keturah (after Sarah died)
s: From [H1](H1) and [H3045](H3045); *father* *of* *knowledge* (that is *knowing*); *Abida*, a son of Abraham by Keturah: - Abida, Abidah.

d:
Abia or Abiah or Abijah = "Jehovah is (my) father"
**1.** king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam
**2.** second son of Samuel
**3.** son of Jeroboam the first, king of Israel
**4.** son of Becher, a Benjamite
**5.** head of a priestly house (one of the 24 Levite groups)
**6.** head of a priestly house (after the exile)
**7.** wife of Hezron
**8.** mother of Hezekiah (cf H021)
s: From [H1](H1) and [H3050](H3050); *father* (that is *worshipper*) *of* *Jah*; *Abijah*, the name of several Israelite men and two Israelitesses: - Abiah, Abijah.

d:
Abihu = "he is (my) father"
**1.** a son of Aaron destroyed for sacrificing strange fire to God
s: From [H1](H1) and [H1931](H1931); *father* (that is *worshipper*) of *Him* (that is *God*); *Abihu*, a son of Aaron: - Abihu.

d:
Abihud = "my father is majesty"
**1.** son of Bela, a Benjamite
s: From [H1](H1) and [H1935](H1935); *father* (that is, *possessor*) *of* *renown*; *Abihud*, the name of two Israelites: - Abihud.

d:
Abihail = "my father is might"
**1.** a Levite in Moses's time
**2.** a Gadite
**3.** father of Esther
**4.** wife of Abishur
**5.** wife of Rehoboam
s: (More correct in its second form); from [H1](H1) and [H2428](H2428); *father* (that is, *possessor*) *of* *might*; *Abihail* or *Abichail*, the name of three Israelites and two Israelitesses: - Abihail.

d:
Abiezrite = "my father is help"
**1.** one of the family of Abiezer, a descendant of Joseph's son, Manasseh
s: From [H44](H44) with the article inserted; *father* *of* *the* *Ezrite*; and *Abiezrite* or descendant of Abiezer: - Abiezrite.

d:
**1.** in want, needy, chiefly poor, needy person
**2.** subject to oppression and abuse
**3.** needing help, deliverance from trouble, especially as delivered by God
**4.** general reference to lowest class
s: From [H14](H14), in the sense of *want* (especially in feeling); *destitute: -* beggar, needy, poor (man).
o: from [H14](H14), in the sense of want (especially in feeling)

d: **1.** caper-berry-of stimulating desire
s: From [H14](H14); provocative of *desire*; the *caper* berry (from its *stimulative* taste): - desire.

d:
Abitub = "my father is good(ness)"
**1.** son of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
s: From [H1](H1) and [H2898](H2898); *father* *of* *goodness* (that is, *good*); *Abitub*, an Israelite: - Abitub.

d:
Abital = "my father is (the) dew"
**1.** a wife of David
s: From [H1](H1) and [H2919](H2919); *father* *of* *dew* (that is, *fresh*); *Abital*, a wife of King David: - Abital.

d:
Abijam = "my father is the sea" or "Yah(u) is (my) father"
**1.** king of Judah, son and successor of Rehoboam
s: From [H1](H1) and [H3220](H3220); *father* *of* (the) *sea* (that is, *seaman*); *Abijam* (or Abijah), a king of Judah: - Abijam.

d:
Abimael = "my father is El (God)"
**1.** son of Joktan, descendant of Shem
s: From [H1](H1) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word; *father* *of* *Mael* (apparently some Arab tribe); *Abimael*, a son of Joktan: - Abimael.
o: from [H1](H1) and an elsewhere unused (probably foreign) word

d:
Abimelech = "Melek is father" or "my father is king"
**1.** king of Gerar in Abraham's time
**2.** king of Gath in David's time; maybe title of Philistine kings
**3.** son of Gideon by a concubine
**4.** priest, son of Abiathar
s: From [H1](H1) and [H4428](H4428); *father* *of* (the) *king*; *Abimelek*, the name of two Philistine kings and of two Israelites: - Abimelech.

d:
Abinadab = "my father is noble" or "my father is willing"
**1.** a man of Gibeah who sheltered the ark
**2.** second son of Jesse, David's older brother
**3.** a son of Saul, slain with him by the Philistines
s: From [H1](H1) and [H5068](H5068); *father* *of* *generosity* (that is, *liberal*); *Abinadab*, the name of four Israelites: - Abinadab.

d:
Abinoam = "my father is delight"
**1.** father of Barak, descendant of Naphtali
s: From [H1](H1) and [H5278](H5278); *father* *of* *pleasantness* (that is, *gracious*); *Abinoam*, an Israelite: - Abinoam.

d:
Ebiasaph = "my father has gathered"
**1.** a son or descendant of Korah
s: Construction from [H23](H23); *Ebjasaph*, an Israelite: - Ebiasaph.

d:
Abiezer = "my father is help"
**1.** a Manassite, called "son" of Gilead, also son of Gilead's sister
**2.** a Benjamite, warrior of David
s: From [H1](H1) and [H5829](H5829); *father* *of* *help* (that is, *helpful*); *Abiezer*, the name of two Israelites: - Abiezer.

d:
Abialbon = "El (God) is my father"
**1.** one of David's mighty men (hero)
s: From [H1](H1) and an unused root of uncertain derivation; probably *father* *of* *strength* (that is, *valiant*); *Abialbon*, an Israelite: - Abialbon.
o: from [H1](H1) and an unused root of uncertain derivation

d:
**1.** strong, mighty-used only to describe God
**2.** the Strong-old name for God (poetic)
s: From [H82](H82); *mighty* (spoken of God): - mighty (one).

d:
**1.** mighty, valiant
		**a.** of men
		**b.** of angels
		**c.** of animals
		**d.** (metaph)
				**1.** of enemies
				**2.** of princes
				**3.** of sacrificial objects
		**e.** obstinate (fig.)
s: For [H46](H46): - angel, bull, chiefest, mighty (one), stout \[-hearted\], strong (one), valiant.

d:
Abiram = "my father is exalted" or "(the) Exalted One is (my) father"
**1.** a Reubenite, son of Eliab in exodus
**2.** son of Hiel the Bethelite who worked to rebuild Jericho
s: From [H1](H1) and [H7311](H7311); *father* *of* *height* (that is, *lofty*); *Abiram*, the name of two Israelites: - Abiram.

d:
Abishag = "my father is a wanderer"
**1.** David's beautiful young nurse
s: From [H1](H1) and [H7686](H7686); *father* *of* *error* (that is, *blundering*); *Abishag*, a concubine of David: - Abishag.

d:
Abishua = "my father is rescue (safety), or is opulence"
**1.** son of Phinehas, grandson of Aaron
s: From [H1](H1) and [H7171](H7171); *father* *of* *plenty* (that is, *prosperous*); *Abishua*, the name of two Israelites: - Abishua.

d:
Abishur = "my father is a wall"
**1.** son of Shammai, descendant of Judah
s: From [H1](H1) and [H7791](H7791); *father* *of* (the) *wall* (that is, perhaps *mason*), *Abishur*, an Israelites: - Abishur.

d:
Abishai = "my father is Jesse" or "my father is a gift"
**1.** grandson of Jesse, nephew of David via his sister Zeruiah, brother of Joab
s: From [H1](H1) and [H7862](H7862); *father* *of* *a* *gift* (that is, probably *generous*); *Abishai*, an Israelite: - Abishai.

d:
Absalom or Abishalom = "my father is peace"
**1.** father-in-law of Rehoboam
**2.** third son of David, killer of first-born son Amnon, also leader of revolt against his father-David
s: From [H1](H1) and [H7965](H7965); *father* *of* *peace* (that is, *friendly*); *Abshalom*, a son of David; also (the fuller form) a later Israelite: - Abishalom, Absalom.

d:
Abiathar = "my father is great"
**1.** priest, son of Ahitub (Ahimelech), faithful to David, but later rebelled with Adonijah
s: Contracted from [H1](H1) and [H3498](H3498); *father* *of* *abundance* (that is, *liberal*); *Ebjathar*, an Israelite: - Abiathar.

d:
**1.** to roll, turn
		**a.** (Hithpael) to roll, roll up, billow
s: A primitive root; probably to *coil* upward: - mount up.

d:
**1.** to mourn, lament
		**a.** (Qal) to mourn, lament
				**1.** of humans
				**2.** of inanimate objects (fig.)
						**a.** of gates
						**b.** of land
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to mourn, cause to mourn (fig.)
		**c.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to mourn
				**2.** play the mourner
s: A primitive root; to *bewail: -* lament, mourn.

d:
**1.** mourning
		**a.** for the dead
		**b.** because of calamity
		**c.** of rites of mourning
**2.** mourner (subst.)
		**a.** for the dead
		**b.** for calamity
s: From [H56](H56); *lamenting: -* mourn (er, -ing).

d: **1.** meadow (from verb-to grow green, to withstand)
s: From an unused root (meaning to *be* *grassy*); a *meadow*: - plain. Compare also the proper names beginning with Abel-.
o: from an unused root (meaning to be grassy)

d:
**1.** city in northern Israel near Bethmaachah
**2.** the place where the ark rested in the field of Joshua at Bethshemesh
s: From [H58](H58); a *meadow*; *Abel*, the name of two places in Palestine: - Abel.

d:
**1.** mourning
		**a.** for the dead
		**b.** for rites of mourning (metaph)
		**c.** mourning garb
		**d.** period of mourning
s: From [H56](H56); *lamentation: -* mourning.

d:
**1.** truly, verily, surely
**2.** but, however, howbeit
**3.** contrariwise, nay rather (neg.)
s: Apparently from [H56](H56) through the idea of *negation*; *nay*, that is, *truly* or *yet: -* but, indeed, nevertheless, verily.
o: apparently from [H56](H56) through the idea of negation

d:
Abel Beth Maachah = "meadow of the house of Maachah"
**1.** city in northern Israel near Beth Maachah
s: From [H58](H58) and [H1004](H1004) and [H4601](H4601); *meadow* *of* *Beth-Maakah*; *Abel* *of* *Beth-Maakah*, a place in Palestine: - Abel-beth-maachah, Abel of Beth-maachah.

d:
Abel Shittim = "meadow of acacias"
**1.** place in lowlands of Moab
s: From [H58](H58) and the plural of [H7848](H7848), with the article inserted; *meadow* *of* *the* *acacias*; *Abel* *hash-Shittim*, a place in Palestine: - Abel-shittim.
o: from [H58](H58) and the plural of [H7848](H7848), with the article inserted

d:
Abel Keramim = "meadow of the vineyards"
**1.** a place in Ammon
s: From [H58](H58) and the plural of [H3754](H3754); *meadow* *of* *vineyards*; *Abel-Keramim*, a place in Palestine: - plain of the vineyards.

d:
Abel Meholah = "meadow of dancing"
**1.** a city of Issachar, birthplace of Elisha
s: From [H58](H58) and [H4246](H4246); *meadow* *of* *dancing*; *Abel-Mecholah*, a place in Palestine: - Abel-meholah.

d:
Abel Maim = "meadow of waters"
**1.** a city in northern Israel (perhaps Abel Beth Maachah)
s: From [H58](H58) and [H4325](H4325); *meadow* *of* *water*; *Abel-Majim*, a place in Palestine: - Abel-maim.

d:
Abel Mizraim = "meadow of Egypt"
**1.** a place east of the Jordan (perhaps "as fertile as Egypt")
s: From [H58](H58) and [H4714](H4714); *meadow* *of* *Egypt*; *Abel-Mitsrajim*, a place in Palestine: - Abel-mizraim.

d:
**1.** stone (large or small)
		**a.** common stone (in natural state)
		**b.** stone, as material
				**1.** of tablets
				**2.** marble, hewn stones
		**c.** precious stones, stones of fire
		**d.** stones containing metal (ore), tool for work or weapon
		**e.** weight
		**f.** plummet (stones of destruction) also made of metal
		**g.** stonelike objects, eg hailstones, stony heart, ice
		**h.** sacred object, as memorial Samuel set up to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines
		**i.** (simile)
				**1.** sinking in water, motionlessness
				**2.** strength, firmness, solidity
				**3.** commonness
		**j.** (metaph)
				**1.** petrified with terror
				**2.** perverse, hard heart
s: From the root of [H1129](H1129) through the meaning, to *build*; *a* *stone: -* + carbuncle, + mason, + plummet, \[chalk-, hail-, bead-, sling-\] stone (-ny), (divers) weight (-s).
o: from the root of [H1129](H1129) through the meaning to build

d:
**1.** stone
		**a.** a (the) stone
		**b.** stone, material of idols and buildings
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H68](H68): - stone.

d:
**1.** wheel, disc
		**a.** potter's wheel
		**b.** bearing-stool, midwife's stool
s: From the same as [H68](H68); *a* *pair* *of* *stones* (only dual); a potter’s *wheel* or a midwife’s *stool* (consisting alike of two horizontal disks with a support between): - wheel, stool.

d: **1.** river Abana, Syrian river flowing through Damascus
s: Perhaps feminine of [H68](H68); *stony*; *Abanah*, a river near Damascus: - Abana. Compare [H549](H549).

d:
Ebenezer = "stone of help"
**1.** memorial stone erected by Samuel to mark where God helped Israel to defeat the Philistines-north of Jerusalem
s: From [H68](H68) and [H5828](H5828) with the article inserted; *stone* *of* *the* *help*; *Eben* *ha-Ezer*, a place in Palestine: - Ebenezer.
o: from [H68](H68) and [H5828](H5828) with the article inserted

d:
**1.** girdle, sash, waistband
		**a.** of high priest
		**b.** of other priests
		**c.** of high official
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *belt: -* girdle.

d:
Abner = "my father is a lamp"
**1.** Saul's cousin and army captain, treacherously slain by Joab
s: From [H1](H1) and [H5216](H5216); *father* *of* *light* (that is, *enlightening*); *Abner*, an Israelite: - Abner.

d:
**1.** to feed, fatten
		**a.** (Qal) fattened (passive participle)
s: A primitive root; to *fodder: -* fatted, stalled.

d: **1.** blisters, boils (from root, to swell up)
s: (By reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to *belch* forth); an inflammatory *pustule* (as *eruption*): - blains.
o: (by reduplication) from an unused root (meaning to belch forth)

d:
Abez = "I will make white (or miry)"
**1.** a city in Issachar
s: From an unused root, probably means to *gleam*; *conspicuous*; *Ebets*, a place in Palestine: - Abez.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to gleam

d:
Ibzan, "their whiteness (literally their tin — as white"
**1.** a Bethlehemite judge in time of the judges
s: From the same as [H76](H76); *splendid*; *Ibtsan*, an Israelite: - Ibzan.

d: **1.** (Niphal) to wrestle, grapple (get dusty), bedust
s: A primitive root; probably to *float* away (as vapor), but used only as denominative from [H80](H80); to *bedust*, that is, *grapple: -* wrestle.
o: a primitive root, probably to float away (as vapour), but used only as denominative from [H80](H80)

d:
**1.** dust
		**a.** on ground
		**b.** clouds (fig.)
s: From root of [H79](H79); light *particles* (as *volatile*): - (small) dust, powder.

d: **1.** aromatic powders, powder
s: Feminine of [H80](H80): - powder.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to fly (to move wings)
s: A primitive root; to *soar: -* fly.

d:
**1.** pinion, wing
		**a.** of bird (dove, eagle)
		**b.** of Babylonian king (fig.)
s: From [H82](H82); a *pinion: -* \[long-\] wing (-ed).

d:
**1.** pinion, wing
		**a.** of bird (ostrich, eagle, dove)
		**b.** of God (metaph)
s: Feminine of [H83](H83): - feather, wing.

d:
Abraham = "father of a multitude" or "chief of multitude"
**1.** friend of God and founder of Hebrew nation via God's elective covenant
s: Contracted from [H1](H1) and an unused root (probably meaning to *be* *populous*); *father* *of* *a* *multitude*; *Abraham*, the later name of Abram: - Abraham.
o: contracted from [H1](H1) and an unused root (probably meaning to be populous)

d:
**1.** (meaning dubious) -a shout made to announce Joseph's chariot
		**a.** command
		**b.** bow
s: Probably an Egyptian word meaning *kneel: -* bow the knee.
o: probably an Egyptian word meaning kneel

d:
Abram = "exalted father"
**1.** original name of Abraham
s: Contracted from [H48](H48); *high* *father*; *Abram*, the original name of Abraham: - Abram.

d:
Oboth = "waterskins"
**1.** undetermined site of an Israelite camp in the wilderness (perhaps at east boundary of Moab)
s: Plural of [H178](H178); water *skins*; *oboth*, a place in the Desert: - Oboth.

d:
Agee = "I shall increase"
**1.** father of a warrior of David
s: Of uncertain derivation (compare [H90](H90)); *Age*, an Israelite: - Agee.

d:
Agag = "I will overtop"
**1.** king of Amalek, spared by Saul but slain by Samuel
s: Of uncertain derivation (compare [H89](H89)); *flame*; *Agag*, a title of Amalekitish kings: - Agag.

d:
Agagite = "I will overtop"
**1.** said of Haman, Haman the Agagite
s: Patrial or patronymic from [H90](H90); an *Agagite* or descendant (subject) of Agag: - Agagite.

d:
**1.** band, binding
		**a.** cords, bands, thongs (metaphorical of slavery)

d:
Uzai = "I shall have my sprinklings"
**1.** a Judean, one of the repairers of Jerusalem's walls
s: Perhaps by permutation for [H5813](H5813), *strong*; *Uzai*, an Israelite: - Uzai.

d:
Uzal = "I shall be flooded"
**1.** sixth son Joktan
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Uzal*, a son of Joktan: - Uzal.

d:
**1.** woe! alas! oh!
		**a.** passionate cry of grief or despair
s: Probably from [H183](H183) (in the sense of *crying* out after); *lamentation*; also interjectionally, *Oh*!: - alas, woe.
o: probably from [H183](H183) (in the sense of crying out after)

d:
Evi = "my desire"
**1.** one of five chiefs of Midian
s: Probably from [H183](H183); *desirous*; *Evi*, a Midianitish chief: - Evi.
Feminine of [H188](H188): - woe.

d:
**1.** be foolish, foolish
		**a.** (subst)
				**1.** of one who despises wisdom
				**2.** of one who mocks when guilty
				**3.** of one who is quarrelsome
				**4.** of one who is licentious
s: From an unused root (meaning to be *perverse*); (figuratively) *silly: -* fool (-ish) (man).
o: from an unused root (meaning to be perverse)

d:
Evil Merodach = "man of Merodach"
**1.** son and successor of Nebuchadnezzar, king of Neo-Babylonian empire, 562-560 BC
s: Of Chaldee derivation and probably meaning *soldier* *of* *Merodak*; *Evil-Merodak*, a Babylonian king: - Evil-merodach.
o: of Aramaic derivation and probably meaning soldier of merodach

d:
**1.** prominence
		**a.** body, belly (contemptuous)
		**b.** nobles, wealthy men
s: From an unused root meaning to *twist*, that is, (by implication) *be* *strong*; the *body* (as being *rolled* together) also *powerful: -* mighty, strength.
o: from an unused root meaning to twist, i.e. (by implication) be strong

d:
**1.** perhaps, peradventure
**2.** if peradventure
**3.** unless
**4.** suppose
s: From [H176](H176); *if* *not*; hence *perhaps: -* if so be, may be, peradventure, unless.

d:
Ulai = "my leaders (mighties)"
**1.** river of Elam
s: Of Persian derivation; the *Ulai* (or Eulaeus), a river of Persia: - Ulai.

d: **1.** foolish
s: From [H191](H191); *silly*, *foolish*; hence (morally) *impious: -* foolish.

d:
**1.** porch
		**a.** in Solomon's temple
		**b.** in Solomon's palace
		**c.** in temple of Ezekiel's vision
s: From [H481](H481) (in the sense of *tying*); a *vestibule* (as *bound* to the building): - porch.

d:
Ulam = "their leader: vestibule"
**1.** a Manassite
**2.** a Benjamite of Saul's family
s: Apparently from [H481](H481) (in the sense of *dumbness*); *solitary*; *Ulam*, the name of two Israelites: - Ulam.
o: apparently from [H481](H481) (in the sense of dumbness)

d:
**1.** but, but indeed (a strong adversative)
**2.** however, nevertheless
s: Apparently a variation of [H194](H194); *however* or *on* *the* *contrary: -* as for, but, howbeit, in very deed, surely, truly, wherefore.

d: **1.** foolishness, folly
s: From the same as [H191](H191); *silliness: -* folly, foolishly (-ness).

d:
Omar = "speaker" or "eloquent"
**1.** grandson of Esau
s: From [H559](H559); *talkative*; *Omar*, a grandson of Esau: - Omar.

d:
**1.** vigour, generative power
**2.** wealth
**3.** physical strength (of men and behemoth)
s: Probably from the same as [H205](H205) (in the sense of *effort*, but successful); *ability*, *power*, (figuratively) *wealth: -* force, goods, might, strength, substance.
o: probably from the same as [H205](H205) (in the sense of effort, but successful)

d:
On = "wealth" or "vigour"
**1.** a chief of the tribe of Reuben
s: The same as [H202](H202); *On*, an Israelite: - On.

d:
On = "strength or vigour"
**1.** city in lower Egypt, bordering land of Goshen, centre of sun-worship, residence of Potipherah (priest of On and father-in-law of Joseph)
s: Of Egyptian derivation; *On*, a city of Egypt: - On.

d:
**1.** trouble, wickedness, sorrow
		**a.** trouble, sorrow
		**b.** idolatry
		**c.** trouble of iniquity, wickedness
s: From an unused root perhaps meaning properly to *pant* (hence to *exert* oneself, usually in vain; to *come* *to* *naught*); strictly *nothingness*; also *trouble*, *vanity*, *wickedness*; specifically an *idol*: - affliction, evil, false, idol, iniquity, mischief, mourners (-ing), naught, sorrow, unjust, unrighteous, vain, vanity, wicked (-ness.) Compare [H369](H369).
o: from an unused root perhaps meaning properly, to pant (hence, to exert oneself, usually in vain

d:
Aven = "vanity"
**1.** a name used contemptuously for the following places of idolatrous worship
		**a.** a city in Egypt, possibly On (Eze 30:17)
		**b.** Bethel with its calf worship (Ho 10:8)
		**c.** A town or region in Syria (Am 1:5)
s: The same as [H205](H205); *idolatry*; *Aven*, the contemptuous synonym of three places, one in Coele Syria, one in Egypt (On), and one in Palestine (Bethel): - Aven. See also [H204](H204), [H1007](H1007).

d:
Ono = "vigorous"
**1.** city in Benjamin
**2.** a valley (of craftsman)
s: From [H202](H202); *strong*; *Ono*, a place in Palestine: - Ono.

d:
Onam = "vigorous"
**1.** a Horite chief, grandson of Seir
**2.** son Jerahmeel, a chief of Judah
s: A variation of [H209](H209); *strong*; *Onam*, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Onam.

d:
Onan = "strong"
**1.** second son of Judah, slain by God for not fulfilling the levitical requirement to beget a child with the wife of a dead, childless brother
s: A variation of [H207](H207); *strong*; *Onan*, a son of Judah: - Onan.

d:
Uphaz = "desire of fine gold"
**1.** a place famous for its gold (site unknown)
s: Perhaps a corruption of [H211](H211); *Uphaz*, a famous gold region: - Uphaz.

d:
Ophir = "reducing to ashes"
**1.** eleventh son of Joktan
**2.** a land or city in southern Arabia in Solomon's trade route where gold evidently was traded for goods
**3.** characteristic of fine gold
**4.** fine gold
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Ophir*, the name of a son of Joktan, and of a gold region in the East: - Ophir.

d:
**1.** wheel
		**a.** chariot wheel
		**b.** wheel in Ezekiel's vision
		**c.** wheels of the ten bases beneath the lavers in Solomon's temple
s: From an unused root meaning to *revolve*; a *wheel: -* wheel.
o: from an unused root meaning to revolve

d:
**1.** to press, be pressed, make haste, urge, be narrow
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to press, hasten
				**2.** to be pressed, confined, narrow
				**3.** to hasten, make haste
				**4.** be narrow
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to urge, insist
				**2.** to hasten
s: A primitive root; to *press*; (by implication) to *be* *close*, *hurry*, *withdraw: -* (make) haste (-n, -y), labor, be narrow.

d:
**1.** treasure, storehouse
		**a.** treasure (gold, silver, etc)
		**b.** store, supplies of food or drink
		**c.** treasure-house, treasury
				**1.** treasure-house
				**2.** storehouse, magazine
				**3.** treasury
				**4.** magazine of weapons (fig. of God's armoury)
				**5.** storehouses (of God for rain, snow, hail, wind, sea)
s: From [H686](H686); a *depository: -* armory, cellar, garner, store(-house), treasure (-house) (-y).

d:
**1.** to be or become light, shine
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to become light (day)
				**2.** to shine (of the sun)
				**3.** to become bright
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be illuminated
				**2.** to become lighted up
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to give light, shine (of sun, moon, and stars)
				**2.** to illumine, light up, cause to shine, shine
				**3.** to kindle, light (candle, wood)
				**4.** lighten (of the eyes, his law, etc)
				**5.** to make shine (of the face)
s: A primitive root; *to* *be* (causatively *make*) *luminous* (literally and metaphorically): - X break of day, glorious, kindle, (be, en-, give, show) light (-en, -ened), set on fire, shine.

d:
**1.** light
		**a.** light of day
		**b.** light of heavenly luminaries (moon, sun, stars)
		**c.** day-break, dawn, morning light
		**d.** daylight
		**e.** lightning
		**f.** light of lamp
		**g.** light of life
		**h.** light of prosperity
		**i.** light of instruction
		**j.** light of face (fig.)
		**k.** Jehovah as Israel's light
s: From [H215](H215); *illumination* or (concretely) *luminary* (in every sense, including *lightning*, *happiness*, etc.): - bright, clear, + day, light (-ning), morning, sun.

d: **1.** flame, light of fire
s: From [H215](H215); *flame*, hence (in the plural) the *East* (as being the region of light): - fire, light. See also [H224](H224).

d:
Ur = "flame"
**1.** city in southern Babylonia, city of the Chaldeans, centre of moon worship, home of Abraham's father, Terah, and departure point for the Abraham's migration to Mesopotamia and Canaan
s: The same as [H217](H217); *Ur*, a place in Chaldaea; also an Israelite: - Ur.

d:
**1.** light
**2.** light of joy and happiness (fig.)
s: Feminine of [H216](H216); *luminousness*, that is, (figuratively) *prosperity*; also a plant (as being *bright*): - herb light.

d: **1.** manger, stall, crib
s: By transposition for [H723](H723); a *stall: -* cote.

d:
Uri = "fiery"
**1.** a prince of Judah, a son of Hur who was used by God to prepare the tabernacle
**2.** an officer (or the father of an officer) of Solomon in Gilead
**3.** a porter or gatekeeper in time of Ezra who took a foreign woman as wife
s: From [H217](H217); *fiery*; *Uri*, the name of three Israelites: - Uri.

d:
Uriel = "God (El) is my light"
**1.** chief of the Levitical line of Kohath in David's time
**2.** maternal grandfather of Abijah
s: From [H217](H217) and [H410](H410); *flame* *of* *God*; *Uriel*, the name of two Israelites: - Uriel.

d:
Uriah or Urijah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) is my light (flame)"
**1.** Hittite husband of Bathsheba
**2.** a priest who built king Ahaz' heathen altar
**3.** a priest who rebuilt Jerusalem's wall
**4.** a prophet slain by Jehoiakim
s: From [H217](H217) and [H3050](H3050); *flame* *of* *Jah*; *Urijah*, the name of one Hittite and five Israelites: - Uriah, Urijah.

d:
Urim = "lights"
**1.** stones kept in a pouch on the high-priest's breastplate, used in determining God's decision in certain questions and issues
s: Plural of [H217](H217); *lights*; *Urim*, the oracular brilliancy of the figures in the high priest’s breastplate: - Urim.

d: **1.** (Niphal) to consent, agree
s: A primitive root; properly to *come*, that is, (impliedly) to *assent: -* consent.

d:
**1.** sign, signal
		**a.** a distinguishing mark
		**b.** banner
		**c.** remembrance
		**d.** miraculous sign
		**e.** omen
		**f.** warning
**2.** token, ensign, standard, miracle, proof
s: Probably from [H225](H225) (in the sense of *appearing*); a *signal* (literally or figuratively), as a *flag*, *beacon*, *monument*, *omen*, *prodigy*, *evidence*, etc.: - mark, miracle, (en-) sign, token.
o: probably from [H225](H225) (in the sense of appearing)

d:
**1.** then, at that time
		**a.** temporal expressions
				**1.** then (past)
				**2.** then, if...then (future)
				**3.** earlier
		**b.** logical expressions
				**1.** in that case
				**2.** that (being so)
s: A demonstrative adverb; *at* *that* *time* or *place*; also as a conjugation, *therefore: -* beginning, for, from, hitherto, now, of old, once, since, then, at which time, yet.

d: **1.** (P'al) make hot, heat
s: (Chaldee); to *kindle*; (by implication) to *heat: -* heat, hot.

d:
Ezbai = "my humblings"
**1.** father of one of David's mighty men
s: Probably from [H231](H231); *hyssop* *like*; *Ezbai*, an Israelite: - Ezbai.

d: **1.** (P'al) to be gone
s: (Chaldee); of uncertain derivation; *firm: -* be gone.

d: **1.** hyssop, a plant used for medicinal and religious purposes
s: Probably of foreign derivation; *hyssop: -* hyssop.

d:
**1.** waist-cloth, the innermost piece of clothing
		**a.** of God's power over kings (fig.)
		**b.** of faithfulness (metaph)
**2.** waistband
s: From [H246](H246); something *girt*; a *belt*, also a *band: -* girdle.

d: **1.** then, in that case
s: Probably from [H227](H227); *at* *that* *time: -* then.

d: **1.** memorial-offering, the portion of the meal (food) offering which is burned
s: From [H2142](H2142); a *reminder*; specifically *remembrance* *offering: -* memorial.

d:
**1.** to go, to go away, to go about
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to go away
				**2.** to go about
				**3.** to be used up, be exhausted, be gone, evaporated
		**b.** (Pual) to go to and fro
s: A primitive root; to *go* *away*, hence to *disappear: -* fail, gad about, go to and fro \[but in Eze 27:19 the word is rendered by many “from Uzal,” by others “yarn”\], be gone (spent).

d:
**1.** to go, to go off
		**a.** (P'al) to go, go off
s: (Chaldee); the same as [H235](H235); to *depart: -* go (up).

d:
Ezel = "departure"
**1.** a memorial stone between Ramah and Nob; scene of final farewell between David and Jonathan
s: From [H235](H235); *departure*; *ezel*, a memorial stone in Palestine: - Ezel.

d:
**1.** to hear, listen
		**a.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to hear, listen, give ear
				**2.** to be obedient, harken
				**3.** to hear or listen to prayers (of God)
s: A primitive root; probably to *expand*; but used only as a denominative from [H241](H241); to *broaden* *out* *the* *ear* (with the hand), that is, (by implication) to *listen: -* give (perceive by the) ear, hear (-ken). See [H239](H239).

d: **1.** (Piel) weigh, test, prove, consider
s: A primitive root (rather identical with [H238](H238) through the idea of *scales* as if two ears); to *weigh*, that is, (figuratively) *ponder: -* give good heed.
o: a primitive root \[rather identical with [H238](H238) through the idea of scales as if two ears\]

d: **1.** tools, implements, weapons
s: From [H238](H238); a *spade* or *paddle* (as having a *broad* end): - weapon.

d:
**1.** ear, as part of the body
**2.** ear, as organ of hearing
**3.** (subjective) to uncover the ear to reveal; the receiver of divine revelation
s: From [H238](H238); *broadness*, that is, (concretely) the *ear* (from its form in man): - + advertise, audience, + displease, ear, hearing, + show.

d:
Uzzen Sherah = "portion of Sherah"
**1.** city built by Sherah, Ephraim's daughter
s: From [H238](H238) and [H7609](H7609); *plat* *of* *Sheerah* (that is, settled by him); *Uzzen* *Sheerah*, a place in Palestine: - Uzzen-sherah.

d:
Aznoth Tabor = "peaks of Tabor"
**1.** a pair of hills on Naphtali's border
s: From [H238](H238) and [H8396](H8396); *flats* (that is, *tops*) *of* *Tabor* (that is, situated on it); *aznoth* *Tabor*, a place in Palestine: - Aznoth-tabor.

d:
Ozni or Oznite = "my ear (hearing)"
**1.** son of Gad
**2.** pertaining to Ozni and his descendants
s: From [H241](H241); *having* (quick) *ears*; *Ozni*, an Israelite; also an *Oznite* (collectively), his descendants: - Ozni, Oznites.

d:
Azaniah = "Jehovah (Yahweh) hears"
**1.** the father of Jeshua, a Levite
s: From [H238](H238) and [H3050](H3050); *heard* *by* *Jah*; *Azanjah*, an Israelite: - Azaniah.

d: **1.** chains, manacles
s: A variation for [H2131](H2131); *manacles: -* chains.

d:
**1.** gird, encompass, equip, clothe
		**a.** (Qal) to gird, gird on (metaphorical of strength)
		**b.** (Niphal) be girded
		**c.** (Piel) hold close, clasp
		**d.** (Hiphpael) gird oneself (for war)
s: A primitive root; to *belt: -* bind (compass) about, gird (up, with).
A variation for [H2220](H2220); the *arm: -* arm.

d:
**1.** a native (one rising from the soil)
		**a.** of man, native Israelites
		**b.** of tree, native (to Israel)
s: From [H2224](H2224) (in the sense of *springing* *up*); a spontaneous *growth*, that is, *native* (tree or persons): - bay tree, (home-) born (in the land), of the (one’s own) country (nation).
o: from [H2224](H2224) (in the sense of springing up)

d:
Ezraite = "a native (as arising out of the soil)"
**1.** Ezrahite, of the family of Zerach
s: Patronymic from [H2246](H2246); an *Ezrachite* or descendants of Zerach: - Ezrahite.

d:
**1.** brother
		**a.** brother of same parents
		**b.** half-brother (same father)
		**c.** relative, kinship, same tribe
		**d.** each to the other (reciprocal relationship)
		**e.** (fig.) of resemblance
s: A primitive word; a *brother* (used in the widest sense of literal relationship and metaphorical affinity or resemblance (like [H1](H1))): - another, brother (-ly), kindred, like, other. Compare also the proper names beginning with “Ah-” or “Ahi-”.

d: **1.** brother
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H251](H251): - brother.

d: **1.** ah!, alas!, woe!
s: A variation for [H162](H162); *Oh*! (expressive of grief or surprise): - ah, alas.

d: **1.** fire-pot, brazier
s: Of uncertain derivation; a fire *pot* or chafing dish: - hearth.

d:
**1.** howling animal
		**a.** jackal
		**b.** hyena
s: Probably from [H253](H253); a *howler* or lonesome wild animal: - doleful creature.

d:
Ahab = "father's brother"
**1.** king of Israel, son of Omri, husband of Jezebel
**2.** false prophet executed by Nebuchadrezzar, time of Jeremiah
s: The second form used once (by contraction) in Jer 29:22; from [H251](H251) and [H1](H1); *brother* (that is, *friend*) of (his) *father*; *Achab*, the name of a king of Israel and of a prophet at Babylon: - Ahab.

d:
Ahban = "brother of an understanding (intelligent) one"
**1.** son of Abishur of Judah
s: From [H251](H251) and [H995](H995); *brother* (that is, *possessor*) of *understanding*; *Achban*, an Israelite: - Ahban.

d: **1.** (Hithpael) to go one way or another, to be sharp
s: Perhaps a primitive root; to *unify*, that is, (figuratively) *collect* (one’s thoughts): - go one way or other.

d:
**1.** one (number)
		**a.** one (number)
		**b.** each, every
		**c.** a certain
		**d.** an (indefinite article)
		**e.** only, once, once for all
		**f.** one...another, the one...the other, one after another, one by one
		**g.** first
		**h.** eleven (in combination), eleventh (ordinal)
s: A numeral from [H258](H258); properly *united*, that is, *one*; or (as an ordinal) *first: -* a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any (-thing), apiece, a certain \[dai-\] ly, each (one), + eleven, every, few, first, + highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together.

d: **1.** reeds, marsh plants, rushes
s: Of uncertain (perhaps Egyptian) derivation; a *bulrush* or any marshy grass (particularly that along the Nile): - flag, meadow.

d:
Ehud = "united"
**1.** great grandson of Benjamin
s: From [H258](H258); *united*; *Echud*, the name of three Israelites: - Ehud.

d: **1.** declaration
s: From [H2331](H2331) (in the sense of [H2324](H2324)); an *utterance: -* declaration.

d: **1.** declaration, a declaring
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H262](H262); *solution* (of riddles): - showing.

d: **1.** fraternity, brotherhood
s: From [H251](H251); *fraternity: -* brotherhood.

d:
Ahoah = "brother of rest"
**1.** a grandson of Benjamin
s: By reduplication from [H251](H251); *brotherly*; *Achoach*, an Israelite: - Ahoah.

d:
Ahohite = "brother of rest"
**1.** one of the clan of Ahoah
s: Patronymic from [H264](H264); an *Achochite* or descendants of Achoach: - Ahohite.

d:
Ahumai = "a water reed: brother of waters"
**1.** grandson of Shobal, descendant of Judah
s: Perhaps from [H251](H251) and [H4325](H4325); *brother* (that is, *neighbour*) *of* *water*; *Achumai*, an Israelite: - Ahumai.

d:
**1.** the back side, the rear
		**a.** backwards
		**b.** hereafter (of time)
		**c.** behind
s: From [H299](H299); the *hinder* part; hence (adverbially) *behind*, *backward*; also (as facing north) the *West: -* after (-ward), back (part, -side, -ward), hereafter, (be-) hind (-er part), time to come, without.

d:
**1.** sister
		**a.** sister (same parents)
		**b.** half-sister (same father)
		**c.** relative
				**1.** (metaph) of Israel's and Judah's relationship
		**d.** beloved
				**1.** bride
		**e.** (fig.) of intimate connection
		**f.** another
s: Irregular feminine of [H251](H251); a *sister* (used very widely (like [H250](H250)), literally and figuratively): - (an-) other, sister, together.

d:
**1.** grasp, take hold, seize, take possession
		**a.** (Qal) to grasp, take hold of
		**b.** (Niphal) to be caught, grasped, be settled
		**c.** (Piel) to enclose, overlay
		**d.** (Hophal) fastened
s: A primitive root; to *seize* (often with the accessory idea of holding in possession): -  + be affrighted, bar, (catch, lay, take) hold (back), come upon, fasten, handle, portion, (get, have or take) possess (-ion).

d:
Ahaz = "he has grasped"
**1.** king of Judah, son Jotham, father of Hezekiah
**2.** a Benjamite, son of Micah, and great grandson of Jonathan
s: From [H270](H270); *possessor*; *Achaz*, the name of a Jewish king and of an Israelite: - Ahaz.

d:
**1.** possession, property
		**a.** land
		**b.** possession by inheritance
s: Feminine passive participle of [H270](H270); something *seized*, that is, a *possession* (especially of land): - possession.

d:
Ahasai = "my holder, protector"
**1.** a post-exilic priest, in Jerusalem
s: From [H270](H270); *seizer*; *Achzai*, an Israelite: - Ahasai.

d:
Ahaziah = "Jehovah (Yahu) holds (possesses)"
**1.** ruler of Israel, son of Ahab
**2.** ruler of Judah, son of Jehoram (Joram)
s: From [H270](H270) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *seized*; *Achazjah*, the name of a Jewish and an Israelitish king: - Ahaziah.

d:
Ahuzam = "possessor"
**1.** a descendant of Judah through Caleb
s: From [H270](H270); *seizure*; *Achuzzam*, an Israelite: - Ahuzam.

d:
Ahuzzath = "possession"
**1.** friend of Abimelech
s: A variation of [H272](H272); *possession*; *Achuzzath*, a Philistine: - Ahuzzath.

d:
Ahi = "my brother"
**1.** a head of the families of Gad
**2.** an Asherite
s: From [H251](H251); *brotherly*; *Achi*, the name of two Israelites: - Ahi.

d:
Ehi = "my brother"
**1.** son of Benjamin
s: Probably the same as [H277](H277); *Echi*, an Israelite: - Ehi.

d:
Ahiam = "mother's brother"
**1.** one of David's warriors (heroes)
s: From [H251](H251) and [H517](H517); *brother* *of* the *mother* (that is, *uncle*); *Achiam*, an Israelite: - Ahiam.

d: **1.** puzzle, riddle
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2420](H2420), an *enigma: -* hard sentence.

d:
Ahiah or Ahijah = "brother of Jehovah (Yahu)"
**1.** grandson of Phinehas
**2.** scribe of Solomon
**3.** a prophet who predicted the revolt of the Northern tribes
**4.** father of Baasha, who usurped the Northern throne
**5.** grandson of Hezron (or mother of 1-4 above)
**6.** a Benjamite, son of Ehud
**7.** one of David's heroes
**8.** a Levite during David's time
**9.** a chief man under Nehemiah
s: From [H251](H251) and [H3050](H3050); *brother* (that is, *worshipper*) *of* *Jah*; *Achijah*, the name of nine Israelites: - Ahiah, Ahijah.

d:
Ahihud = "brother of majesty"
**1.** a prince of Asher
s: From [H251](H251) and [H1935](H1935); *brother* (that is, *possessor*) *of* *renown*; *Achihud*, an Israelite: - Ahihud.

d:
Ahio = "brotherly" or "fraternal"
**1.** son of Abinadab who sheltered the ark
**2.** a Benjamite
**3.** another Benjamite of Saul's ancestry
s: Prolonged from [H251](H251); *brotherly*; *Achio*, the name of three Israelites: - Ahio.

d:
Ahihud = "brother of mystery"
**1.** a Benjamite, son of Ehud
s: From [H251](H251) and [H2330](H2330); *brother* *of* *a* *riddle* (that is, *mysterious*); *Achichud*, an Israelite: - Ahihud.

d:
Ahitub = "my brother is good (goodness)"
**1.** a grandson of Eli
**2.** the father of Zadok the priest
s: From [H251](H251) and [H2898](H2898); *brother* *of* *goodness*; *Achitub*, the name of several priests: - Ahitub.

d:
Ahilud = "child's brother"
**1.** father of Jehoshaphat, David's recorder
**2.** father of Baana, an officer of Solomon
s: From [H251](H251) and [H3205](H3205); *brother* *of* one *born*; *Achilud*, an Israelite: - Ahilud.

d:
Ahimoth = "brother of death" or "my brother is death"
**1.** a son of Elkanah, a Levite
s: From [H251](H251) and [H4191](H4191); *brother* *of* *death*; *Achimoth*, an Israelite: - Ahimoth.

d:
Ahimelech = "my brother is king" or "brother of Melek"
**1.** a priest murdered by Doeg at Saul's command, for supposedly assisting David
**2.** a Hittite warrior under David
s: From [H251](H251) and [H4428](H4428); *brother* *of* (the) *king*; *Achimelek*, the name of an Israelite and of a Hittite: - Ahimelech.

d:
Ahiman = "my brother is a gift"
**1.** a son of Anak
**2.** a Levite servant in the temple
s: From [H251](H251) and [H4480](H4480); *brother* *of* *a* *portion* (that is, *gift*); *Achiman*, the name of an Anakite and of an Israelite: - Ahiman.

d:
Ahimaaz = "my brother is anger (wrath)"
**1.** father-in-law of Saul
**2.** Zadok's son who aided David during Absalom's rebellion
**3.** a supply officer of Solomon
s: From [H251](H251) and the equivalent of [H4619](H4619); *brother* *of* *anger*; *Achimaats*, the name of three Israelites: - Ahimaaz.

d:
Ahian = "brotherly" or "fraternal"
**1.** son of Shemida of Manasseh
s: From [H251](H251); *brotherly*; *Achjan*, an Israelite: - Ahian.

d:
Ahinadab = "my brother is liberal, or, noble"
**1.** a supply officer of Solomon
s: From [H251](H251) and [H5068](H5068); *brother* *of* *liberality*; *Achinadab*, an Israelite: - Ahinadab.

d:
Ahinoam = "my brother is delight"
**1.** wife of Saul, daughter of Ahimaaz
**2.** wife of David, mother of Amnon, a Jezreelitess
s: From [H251](H251) and [H5278](H5278); *brother* *of* *pleasantness*; *Achinoam*, the name of two Israelitesses: - Ahinoam.

d:
Ahisamach = "my brother is support (has supported)"
**1.** a Danite, father of Aholiab, a workman on the tabernacle
s: From [H251](H251) and [H5564](H5564); *brother* *of* *support*; *Achisamak*, an Israelite: - Ahisamach.

d:
Ahiezer = "my brother is help"
**1.** a Danite chief who assisted Moses
**2.** a Danite chief, one of David's heroes
s: From [H251](H251) and [H5828](H5828); *brother* *of* *help*; *Achiezer*, the name of two Israelites: - Ahiezer.

d:
Ahikam = "my brother has risen (arisen)"
**1.** son of Shaphan, an officer in Josiah's reign
**2.** protector of Jeremiah
**3.** father of Gedaliah
s: From [H251](H251) and [H6965](H6965); *brother* *of* *rising* (that is, *high*); *Achikam*, an Israelite: - Ahikam.

d:
Ahiram = "my brother is exalted" or "brother or (the) lofty"
**1.** a Benjamite, son of Benjamin
s: From [H251](H251) and [H7311](H7311); *brother* *of* *height* (that is, *high*); *Achiram*, an Israelite: - Ahiram.

d:
Ahiramite = "brother of mother"
**1.** one of the clan of Ahiram
s: Patronymic from [H297](H297); an *Achiramite* or descendants (collectively) of Achiram: - Ahiramites.

d:
Ahira = "my brother is evil"
**1.** a chief of Naphtali
s: From [H251](H251) and [H7451](H7451); *brother* *of* *wrong*; *Achira*, an Israelite: - Ahira.

d:
Ahishahar = "my brother is dawn" or "brother of the dawn"
**1.** a Benjamite
s: From [H251](H251) and [H7837](H7837); *brother* *of* (the) *dawn*; *Achishachar*, an Israelite: - Ahishar.

d:
Ahishar = "my brother sang"
**1.** chief steward for Solomon
s: From [H251](H251) and [H7891](H7891); *brother* *of* (the) *singer*; *Achishar*, an Israelite: - Ahishar.

d:
Ahithophel = "my brother is foolish (folly)"
**1.** a counsellor of David, grandfather of Bathsheba (cf 2Sa 11:3, 23:34), who joined Absalom in revolt against David, and committed suicide when Absalom did not heed his counsel
s: From [H251](H251) and [H8602](H8602); *brother* *of* *folly*; *Achithophel*, an Israelite: - Ahithophel.

d:
Ahlab = "fertile place"
**1.** a town allotted to Asher, site presently unknown
s: From the same root as [H2459](H2459); *fatness* (that is, *fertile*); *Achlab*, a place in Palestine: - Ahlab.

d:
Ahlai = "O! would that!"
**1.** daughter of Sheshan
**2.** father of one of David's heroes (mighty men, warriors)
s: The same as [H305](H305); *wishful*; *Achlai*, the name of an Israelitess and of an Israelite: - Ahlai.

d: **1.** Oh that...!; oh would that!; ah that!
s: Probably from [H253](H253) and a variation of [H3863](H3863); *would* *that*!: - O that, would God.
o: probably from [H253](H253) and a variation of [H3863](H3863)

d: **1.** amethyst, a gem in the third row on the ephod, breastplate of judgment worn by the high priest. Transliteration of the Septuagint word. Identification is not certain but is a purple stone perhaps a corundum or red or brown jasper.
s: Perhaps from [H2492](H2492) (and thus *dream* *stone*); a gem, probably the *amethyst: -* amethyst.

d:
Achmetha = "Ecbatana"
**1.** capital of Media, captured by Cyrus in 550 BC and then summer residence of Persian kings
s: Of Persian derivation; *Achmetha* (that is, *Ecbatana*), the summer capital of Persia: - Achmetha.

d:
Ahasbai = "brother of my encompassers"
**1.** father of Eliphelet, one of David's heroes
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Achasbai*, an Israelite: - Ahasbai.

d:
**1.** to delay, hesitate, tarry, defer, remain behind
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to delay, tarry (intensive)
				**2.** to cause one to delay, hinder, keep back
		**b.** (Piel) to delay, wait, stay behind (but not in hope)
s: A primitive root; to *loiter* (that is, *be* *behind*); by implication to *procrastinate: -* continue, defer, delay, hinder, be late (slack), stay (there), tarry (longer).

d:
**1.** after the following part, behind (of place), hinder, afterwards (of time)
		**a.** as an adverb
				**1.** behind (of place)
				**2.** afterwards (of time)
		**b.** as a preposition
				**1.** behind, after (of place)
				**2.** after (of time)
				**3.** besides
		**c.** as a conjunction
		**c.** after that
		**d.** as a substantive
				**1.** hinder part
		**e.** with other prepositions
				**1.** from behind
				**2.** from following after
s: From [H309](H309); properly the *hind* part; generally used as an adverb or conjugation, *after* (in various senses): - after (that, -ward), again, at, away from, back (from, -side), behind, beside, by, follow (after, -ing), forasmuch, from, hereafter, hinder end, + out (over) live, + persecute, posterity, pursuing, remnant, seeing, since, thence \[-forth\], when, with.

d: **1.** after
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H310](H310); *after: -* \[here-\] after.

d:
**1.** another, other, following
		**a.** following, further
		**b.** other, different
s: From [H309](H309); properly *hinder*; generally *next*, *other*, etc.: - (an-) other (man), following, next, strange.

d:
Aher = "following"
**1.** a Benjamite
s: The same as [H312](H312); *Acher*, an Israelite: - Aher.

d:
**1.** behind, following, subsequent, western
		**a.** behind, hindermost, western (of location)
		**b.** later, subsequent, latter, last (of time)
s: From [H309](H309); *hinder*; generally *late* or *last*; specifically (as facing the east) *western: -* after (-ward), to come, following, hind (-er, -ermost, -most), last, latter, rereward, ut(ter)most.

d:
Aharah = "a following brother"
**1.** a son of Benjamin
s: From [H310](H310) and [H251](H251); *after* (his) *brother*; *Achrach*, an Israelite: - Aharah.

d:
Aharhel = "a following host"
**1.** a descendant of Judah through Caleb
s: From [H310](H310) and [H2426](H2426); *behind* (the) *intrenchment* (that is, *safe*); *Acharchel*, an Israelite: - Aharhel.

d: **1.** other, another
s: (Chaldee); from [H311](H311); *other: -* (an-) other.

d:
**1.** end, outcome
		**a.** hid part (of cows)
		**b.** end (of time)
		**c.** remnant, descendants
s: (Chaldee); from [H317](H317); *last: -* at last.

d:
**1.** after part, end
		**a.** end, issue, event
		**b.** latter time (prophetic for future time)
		**c.** posterity
		**d.** last, hindermost
s: From [H310](H310); the *last* or *end*, hence the *future*; also *posterity: -* (last, latter) end (time), hinder (utter) -most, length, posterity, remnant, residue, reward.

d: **1.** end, latter
s: (Chaldee); from [H311](H311); the same as [H319](H319); *later: -* latter.

d: **1.** other, another
s: (Chaldee); from [H311](H311); the same as [H317](H317); *other: -* (an-) other.

d: **1.** backwards, back part, the rear
s: Prolonged from [H268](H268); *backwards: -* back(-ward, again).

d: **1.** satrap, a governor of a Persian province
s: Of Persian derivation; a *satrap* or governor of a main province (of Persia): - lieutenant.

d: **1.** satrap, a governor of a Persian province
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H323](H323): - prince.

d:
Ahasuerus = "I will be silent and poor"
**1.** title of the king of Persia, probably Xerxes
s: Of Persian origin; *Achashverosh* (that is, Ahasuerus or Artaxerxes, but in this case Xerxes), the title (rather than name) of a Persian king: - Ahasuerus.

d:
Haahashtari = "I will diligently observe the searching"
**1.** a descendant of Ashur of Judah
s: Probably of Persian derivation; an *achastarite* (that is, courier); the designation (rather than name) of an Israelite: - Haakashtari \[includ. the article.\]

d: **1.** royal (steeds)
s: Of Persian origin; a *mule*: - camel.

d:
**1.** gentleness, softness
		**a.** gently
		**b.** flowing
		**c.** softly
		**d.** enchanter, necromancer (substantive)
s: From an unused root perhaps meaning to *move* *softly*; (as a noun) a *necromancer* (from their soft incantations), (as an adverb) *gently: -* charmer, gently, secret, softly.
o: from an unused root perhaps meaning to move softly

d:
**1.** bramble, thorn, buckthorn
**2.** the threshing Atad, meaning thorn, also called Abelmizraim and afterwards called Bethhogla was located on the west of Jordan between the Jordan and Jericho
s: From an unused root probably meaning to *pierce* or *make* *fast*; a *thorn* tree (especially the *buckthorn*): - Atad, bramble, thorn.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to pierce or make fast

d: **1.** linen, yarn, thread
s: From an unused root (probably meaning to *bind*); properly twisted (*yarn*), that is, tapestry: - fine linen.
o: from an unused root (probably meaning to bind)

d:
**1.** to shut, shut up, close
		**a.** (Qal) to shut, stop (of lips)
		**b.** (Hiphil) of the wicked stopping their ears (fig.)
s: A primitive root; to *close* (the lips or ears); by analogy to *contract* (a window by bevelled jambs): - narrow, shut, stop.

d:
**1.** (Qal) shut
		**a.** to shut up, close, bind
		**b.** close one's mouth
s: A primitive root; to *close* up: - shut.

d:
Ater = "binder"
**1.** an exiled descendant of Hezekiah
**2.** an exiled Levite porter (perhaps same as 1)
**3.** a chief Israelite who sealed Nehemiah's covenant
s: From [H332](H332); *maimed*; *Ater*, the name of three Israelites: - Ater.

d: **1.** bound, impeded (on the right, ie, left-handed), shut, shut up
s: From [H332](H332); *shut* up, the is, *impeded* (as to the use of the right hand): -  + left-handed.

d:
**1.** where?, whence?
**2.** which?, how? (in prefix with other adverb)
s: Perhaps from [H370](H370); *where*? hence *how?*: - how, what, whence, where, whether, which (way).
Probably identical with [H335](H335) (through the idea of a *query*); *not*. (Job 22:30): - island (Job [H22](H22) : [H30](H30)).
o: probably identical with [H335](H335) (through the idea of a query)

d: **1.** alas!, woe!
s: Shortened from [H188](H188); *alas!*: - woe.

d: **1.** howling beast, jackal
s: Probably identical with [H337](H337) (through the idea of a *doleful* sound); a *howler* (used only in the plural), that is, any solitary wild creature: - wild beast of the islands.
o: probably identical with [H337](H337) (through the idea of a doleful sound)

d: **1.** coast, island, shore, region
s: From [H183](H183); properly a *habitable* spot (as *desirable*); dry *land*, a *coast*, an *island: -* country, isle, island.

d:
**1.** to be hostile to, to be an enemy to
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be hostile to
				**2.** to treat as an enemy
s: A primitive root; to *hate* (as one of an opposite tribe or party); hence to be *hostile: -* be an enemy.

d:
**1.** (Qal) enemy
		**a.** personal
		**b.** national
s: Active participle of [H340](H340); *hating*; an *adversary: -* enemy, foe.

d: **1.** enmity, hatred
s: From [H340](H340); *hostility: -* enmity, hatred.

d:
**1.** distress, burden, calamity
		**a.** burden (of the righteous)
		**b.** calamity (of nation)
		**c.** disaster (of wicked)
		**d.** day of calamity
s: From the same as [H181](H181) (in the sense of *bending* down); *oppression*; by implication *misfortune*, *ruin: -* calamity, destruction.
o: from the same as [H181](H181) (in the sense of bending down)

d: **1.** hawk, falcon, kite
s: Perhaps from [H337](H337); the *screamer*, that is, a *hawk: -* kite, vulture.

d:
Aiah or Ajah = "falcon"
**1.** a Horite, son of Zibeon
**2.** father of Rizpah, Saul's concubine
s: The same as [H344](H344); *Ajah*, the name of two Israelites: - Aiah, Ajah.

d:
**1.** where?
		**a.** of persons, things
		**b.** rhetorical
s: Prolonged from [H335](H335); *where?*: - where.

d:
Job = "hated"
**1.** a patriarch, the subject of the book of Job
s: From [H340](H340); *hated* (that is, *persecuted*); *Ijob*, the patriarch famous for his patience: - Job.

d:
Jezebel = "Baal exalts" or "Baal is husband to" or "unchaste"
**1.** queen of Israel, wife of Ahab, daughter of Ethbaal
s: From [H336](H336) and [H2083](H2083); *chaste*, *Izebel*, the wife of king Ahab: - Jezebel.

d:
interrog adv
**1.** how?
interj
**2.** how! (in lamentation)
**3.** expression of satisfaction
s: Prolonged from [H335](H335); *how*? or *how*!; also *where: -* how, what.

d:
Ichabod = "no glory"
**1.** a son of Phinehas, so named because of the capture of the Ark by the Philistines
s: From [H336](H336) and [H3519](H3519); (there is) *no* *glory*, that is, *inglorious*; *Ikabod*, a son of Phineas: - I-chabod.

d: **1.** where!
s: Probably a variation for [H349](H349), but not as an interrogative; *where: -* where.
o: probably a variation for [H349](H349), but not as an interrogative

d:
**1.** ram
		**a.** ram (as food)
		**b.** ram (as sacrifice)
		**c.** ram (skin dyed red, for tabernacle)
**2.** pillar, door post, jambs, pilaster
**3.** strong man, leader, chief
**4.** mighty tree, terebinth
s: From the same as [H193](H193); properly *strength*; hence anything *strong*; specifically a *chief* (politically); also a *ram* (from his strength); a *pilaster* (as a strong support); an *oak* or other strong tree: - mighty (man), lintel, oak, post, ram, tree.

d:
**1.** strength
**2.** help
s: A variation of [H352](H352); *strength: -* strength.

d: **1.** stag, deer, hart
s: An intensive form of [H352](H352) (in the sense of *ram*); a *stag* or male deer: - hart.
o: an intensive form of [H352](H352) (in the sense of ram)

d: **1.** doe, deer, hind
s: Feminine of [H354](H354); a *doe* or female deer: - hind.

d:
Elon = "terebinth, mighty"
**1.** Hittite, father-in-law of Esau
**2.** second son of Zebulun
**3.** Zebulonite judge of Israel
**4.** town in Dan
s: From [H352](H352); *oakgrove*; *Elon*, the name of a place in Palestine, and also of one Hittite, two Israelite: - Elon.

d:
Ajalon or Aijalon = "field of deer"
**1.** Levitical city in Dan, 14 miles or 25 km NW of Jerusalem, later ruled by the Amorites, then the Benjamites of Judah, then by the Philistines
**2.** a city of Zebulun, site unknown
s: From [H354](H354); *deerfield*; *Ajalon*, the name of five places in Palestine: - Aijalon, Ajalon.

d:
Elon Beth-hanan = "oak of the house of grace"
**1.** a city of Dan
s: From [H356](H356), [H1004](H1004), and [H2603](H2603); *oakgrove* *of* (the) *house* *of* *favor*; *Elon* *of* *Bethchanan*, a place in Palestine: - Elon-beth-hanan.

d:
Elath or Eloth = "grove of lofty trees"
**1.** a port on the north-east arm of the Red Sea
s: From [H352](H352); *trees* or a *grove* (that is, palms); *Eloth* or *Elath*, a place on the Red Sea: - Elath, Eloth.

d: **1.** strength, my help
s: Feminine of [H353](H353); *power*; by implication *protection: -* strength.

d: **1.** porch, vestibule, portico
s: Probably from [H352](H352); a *pillar* *space* (or colonnade), that is, a *pale* (or portico): - arch.

d:
Elim = "palms"
**1.** second encampment of the Israelites after the Exodus
s: Plural of [H352](H352); palm *trees*; *Elim*, a place in the Desert: - Elim.

d: **1.** tree
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H356](H356); a *tree: -* tree.

d:
El-paran = "palm of Paran"
**1.** town and harbour at tip of Gulf of Aqaba on the Red Sea
s: From [H352](H352) and [H6290](H6290); *oak* *of* *Paran*; *El* *Paran*, a portion of the district of Paran: - El-paran.

d:
**1.** doe, deer, hind
**2.** "Aijeleth Shahar" is part of the title of Ps 22:1 and probably describes to the musician the melody to which the psalm was to be played
s: The same as [H355](H355); a *doe: -* hind, Aijeleth.

d: **1.** terrible, dreadful
s: From an unused root (meaning to *frighten*); *frightful: -* terrible.
o: from an unused root (meaning to frighten)

d: **1.** terror, dread
s: From the same as [H366](H366); *fright*; concretely an *idol* (as a bugbear): - dread. fear, horror, idol, terrible, terror.

d:
Emims = "terrors"
**1.** ancient inhabitants of Moab
s: Plural of [H367](H367); *terrors*; *Emim*, an early Canaanitish (or Moabitish) tribe: - Emims.

d:
**1.** nothing, not, nought n
		**a.** nothing, nought neg
		**b.** not
		**c.** to have not (of possession) adv
		**d.** without w/prep
		**e.** for lack of
s: As if from a primitive root meaning to *be* *nothing* or *not* *exist*; a *non-entity*; generally used as a negative particle: - else, except, fail \[father-\] less, be gone, in \[-curable\], neither, never, no (where), none, nor (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un \[-searchable\], well-nigh, without, Compare [H370](H370).
o: as if from a primitive root meaning to be nothing or not exist

d: **1.** where?, whence?
s: Probably identical with [H369](H369) in the sense of *query* (compare [H336](H336)); *where*? (only in connection with prepositional prefix, *whence*): - whence, where.
o: probably identical with [H369](H369) in the sense of query (compare [H336](H336))

d: **1.** Is there not?, Have you not?
s: Apparently a shortened form of [H369](H369); but (like [H370](H370)) interrogitive; is it *not?*: - not

d:
Jeezer = "no help"
**1.** a descendant of Manasseh
s: From [H336](H336) and [H5828](H5828); *helpless*; *Iezer*, an Israelite: - Jeezer.

d:
Jeezerite = "no help"
**1.** one of the tribe of Jeezer
s: Patronymic from [H372](H372); an *Iezrite* or descendant of Iezer: - Jezerite.

d:
**1.** ephah
		**a.** a dry measure of quantity, equal to 3 seahs, 10 omers; the same as the liquid measure bath; (about 9 imperial gallons (40 l), rabbinical writings give sizes of one-half this amount)
		**b.** the receptacle for measuring or holding that amount
s: Of Egyptian derivation; an *ephah* or measure for grain; hence a *measure* in general: - ephah, (divers) measure (-s).

d:
**1.** where?
**2.** what kind?
s: From [H335](H335) and [H6311](H6311); *what* *place*?; also (of time) *when*?; or (of means) *how?*: - what manner, where.

d:
**1.** man
		**a.** man, male (in contrast to woman, female)
		**b.** husband
		**c.** human being, person (in contrast to God)
		**d.** servant
		**e.** mankind
		**f.** champion
		**g.** great man
**2.** whosoever
**3.** each (adjective)
s: Contracted for [H582](H582) (or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to *be* *extant*); a *man* as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation.) : - also, another, any (man), a certain, + champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, \[foot-, husband-\] man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man \[-kind\], + none, one, people, person, + steward, what (man) soever, whoso (-ever), worthy. Compare [H802](H802).
o: contracted for [H582](H582) \[or perhaps rather from an unused root meaning to be extant\]

d: **1.** (Hithpalel) to be a man, show masculinity, champion, great man
s: Denominative from [H376](H376); to *be* *a* *man*, that is, act in a manly way: - show (one) self a man.

d:
Ishbosheth = "man of shame"
**1.** surviving son of Saul, king of Israel for 7 years while David was king over Judah; succeeded by David who united the kingdom
s: From [H376](H376) and [H1322](H1322); *man* *of* *shame*; *IshBosheth*, a son of King Saul: - Ish-bosheth.

d:
Ishod = "man of majesty"
**1.** a Manassite from east of the Jordan
s: From [H376](H376) and [H1935](H1935); *man* *of* *renown*; *Ishod*, an Israelite: - Ishod.

d:
**1.** pupil of the eye
**2.** middle of the night (that is the deepest blackness)
s: Diminutive from [H376](H376); the *little* *man* of the eye; the *pupil* or *ball*; hence the *middle* (of night): - apple \[of the eye\], black, obscure.

d: **1.** a mighty man, valiant man
s: From [H376](H376) and [H2428](H2428); *man* *of* *might*; (The second form is by defective transcription used in 2Sa 23:20); as if from [H376](H376) and [H2416](H2416); *living* *man*; *Ishchail* (or *Ishchai*), an Israelite: - a valiant man.

d:
Ishtob = "man of Tob"
**1.** a region beyond Jordan, north or northeast of Gilead
s: From [H376](H376) and [H2897](H2897); *man* *of* *Tob*; *Ish-Tob*, a place in Palestine: - Ish-tob.

d:
**1.** there is, there are
**2.** particle denoting existence
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3426](H3426); properly *entity*; used only as a particle of affirmation, there *is: -* art thou, can, do ye, have it be, there is (are), X we will not.

d:
Ithiel = "God is with me"
**1.** the disciple to whom Agur gave proverbs
**2.** a Benjamite in Nehemiah's time
s: Perhaps from [H837](H837) and [H410](H410); *God* *has* *arrived*; *Ithiel*, the name of an Israelite, also of a symbolic person: - Ithiel.

d:
Ithamar = "coast of palms"
**1.** fourth and youngest son of Aaron
s: From [H339](H339) and [H8558](H8558); *coast* *of* the *palm* tree; *Ithamar*, a son of Aaron: - Ithamar.

d:
**1.** perpetual, constant, perennial, ever-flowing
		**a.** ever-flowing (of a stream)
		**b.** permanence, permanent, enduring (fig.)
s: From an unused root (meaning to *continue*); *permanence*; hence (concretely) *permanent*; specifically a *chieftain: -* hard, mighty, rough, strength, strong.
o: from an unused root (meaning to continue)

d:
Ethan = "enduring"
**1.** an Ezrahite known for his wisdom
**2.** a grandson of Judah, father of Azariah
**3.** a Kohathite descendant of Levi
**4.** a Merarite son of Kushaiah, descendant of Levi
s: The same as [H386](H386); *permanent*; *Ethan*, the name of four Israelites: - Ethan.

d:
Ethanim = "enduring"
**1.** seventh Jewish month, corresponding to modern Oct. to Nov.; so named because permanent streams still flowed
s: Plural of [H386](H386); always with the article; the *permanent* brooks; *Ethanim*, the name of a month: - Ethanim.

d:
**1.** indeed, surely (emphatic)
**2.** howbeit, only, but, yet (restrictive)
s: Akin to [H403](H403); a particle of affirmation, *surely*; hence (by limitation) *only: -* also, in any wise, at least, but, certainly, even, howbeit, nevertheless, notwithstanding, only, save, surely of a surety, truly, verily, + wherefore, yet (but).

d:
Accad = "subtle"
**1.** a city in north Babylonia, also the district around it
s: From an unused root probably meaning to *strengthen*; a *fortress*; *Accad*, a place in Babylon: - Accad.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to strengthen

d: **1.** deceitful, treacherous, deception, lie, deceptive, disappointing
s: From [H3576](H3576); *falsehood*; by implication *treachery: -* liar, lie.

d:
Achzib = "deceit"
**1.** a town in the lowland of west Judah
**2.** a town in Asher by the Sea of Galilee
s: From [H391](H391); *deceitful* (in the sense of a winter torrent which *fails* in summer); *Akzib*, the name of two places in Palestine: - Achzib.

d: **1.** cruel, fierce
s: From an unused root (apparently meaning to *act* *harshly*); *violent*; by implication *deadly*; also (in a good sense) *brave: -* cruel, fierce.
o: from an unused root (apparently meaning to act harshly)

d: **1.** cruel
s: From [H393](H393); *terrible: -* cruel (one).

d: **1.** cruelty, fierceness, cruel
s: From [H394](H394); *fierceness: -* cruel.

d: **1.** food, a meal, an eating, meat
s: Feminine from [H398](H398); something *eatable*, that is, *food: -* meat.

d:
Achish = "I will blacken (or terrify)" or "only a man"
**1.** Philistine king of Gath
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Akish*, a Philistine king: - Achish.

d:
**1.** to eat, devour, burn up, feed
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to eat (human subject)
				**2.** to eat, devour (of beasts and birds)
				**3.** to devour, consume (of fire)
				**4.** to devour, slay (of sword)
				**5.** to devour, consume, destroy (inanimate subjects - ie, pestilence, drought)
				**6.** to devour (of oppression)
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be eaten (by men)
				**2.** to be devoured, consumed (of fire)
				**3.** to be wasted, destroyed (of flesh)
		**c.** (Pual)
				**1.** to cause to eat, feed with
				**2.** to cause to devour
		**d.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to feed
				**2.** to cause to eat
		**e.** (Piel)
				**1.** consume
s: A primitive root; to *eat* (literally or figuratively): - X at all, burn up, consume, devour (-er, up), dine, eat (-er, up), feed (with), food, X freely, X in . . . wise (-deed, plenty), (lay) meat, X quite.

d:
**1.** to eat, devour
		**a.** (P'al)
				**1.** to eat (of beasts)
				**2.** to devour
				**3.** eat their pieces (in a phrase, that is, slander them)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H398](H398): - + accuse, devour, eat.

d:
**1.** food
		**a.** cereal
		**b.** meat
**2.** food supply
**3.** meal, dinner
s: From [H398](H398); *food: -* eating, food, meal \[-time\], meat, prey, victuals.

d:
Ucal = "devoured"
**1.** student or disciple of Agur
s: Apparently from [H398](H398); *devoured*; *Ucal*, a fancy name: - Ucal.

d:
**1.** food
		**a.** food, eating
		**b.** object of devouring, consuming
				**1.** by wild beasts (figurative)
				**2.** in fire
				**3.** of judgment (figurative)
s: Feminine of [H401](H401); *food: -* consume, devour, eat, food, meat.

d:
**1.** surely, truly, indeed
		**a.** truly, indeed (strong assertive force)
		**b.** but indeed, but in fact (emphasizing a contrast)
s: From [H3559](H3559) (compare [H3651](H3651)); *firmly*; figuratively *surely*; also (adversely) *but: -* but, certainly, nevertheless, surely, truly, verily.

d:
**1.** press, urge, bend
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to crave
s: A primitive root; apparent meaning to *curve* (as with a burden); to *urge: -* crave.

d: **1.** pressure, urgency, burden
s: From [H404](H404); a *load*; by implication a *stroke* (others *dignity*): - hand.

d:
**1.** plowman, husbandman, farmer
		**a.** working the land, yet not owning any of it
s: From an unused root meaning to *dig*; a *farmer: -* husbandman, ploughman.
o: from an unused root meaning to dig

d:
Achshaph = "I shall be bewitched"
**1.** city in north Canaan at foot of Mt Carmel
s: From [H3784](H3784); *fascination*; *Acshaph*, a place in Palestine: - Achshaph.

d:
**1.** not, no, nor, neither, nothing (as wish or preference)
		**a.** do not, let not (with a verb)
		**b.** let there not be (with a verb understood)
		**c.** not, no (with substantive)
		**d.** nothing (as substantive)
s: A negative particle (akin to [H3808](H3808)); *not* (the qualified negation, used as a deprecative); once (Job 24:25) as a noun, *nothing: -* nay, neither, + never, no, nor, not, nothing \[worth\], rather than.

d: **1.** no, not
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H408](H408): - not.

d:
**1.** god, god-like one, mighty one
		**a.** mighty men, men of rank, mighty heroes
		**b.** angels
		**c.** god, false god, (demons, imaginations)
		**d.** God, the one true God, Jehovah
**2.** mighty things in nature
**3.** strength, power
s: Shortened from [H352](H352); *strength*; as adjective *mighty*; especially the *Almighty* (but used also of any *deity*): - God (god), X goodly, X great, idol, might (-y one), power, strong. Compare names in “-el.”

d: **1.** these, those
s: A demonstrative particle (but only in a plural sense) *these* or *those*: - these, those, Compare [H428](H428).
o: a demonstrative particle (only in a plural sense)

d: **1.** these
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H411](H411): - these.

d:
**1.** to, toward, unto (of motion)
**2.** into (limit is actually entered)
		**a.** in among
**3.** toward (of direction, not necessarily physical motion)
**4.** against (motion or direction of a hostile character)
**5.** in addition to, to
**6.** concerning, in regard to, in reference to, on account of
**7.** according to (rule or standard)
**8.** at, by, against (of one's presence)
**9.** in between, in within, to within, unto (idea of motion to)
s: (Used only in the shortened constructive form (the second form)); a primitive particle, properly denoting motion *towards*, but occasionally used of a quiescent position, that is, *near*, *with* or *among*; often in general, *to: -* about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because (-fore, -side), both . . . and, by, concerning, for, from, X hath, in (-to), near, (out) of, over, through,to (-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).

d:
Elah = "oak"
**1.** father of one of Solomon's deputies
s: A variation of [H424](H424); *oak*; *Ela*, an Israelite: - Elah.

d:
El-elohe-Israel = "the mighty God of Israel"
**1.** name given to an altar, a location, by Jacob
s: From [H410](H410) and [H430](H430) and [H3478](H3478); the *mighty* *God* *of* *Jisrael*; *El* *Elohi* *Jisrael*, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - El-elohe-israel.

d:
El Bethel = "The God of the House of God"
**1.** the place where God revealed Himself to Jacob
s: From [H410](H410) and [H1008](H1008); the *God* *of* *Bethel*; *El-Bethel*, the title given to a consecrated spot by Jacob: - El-beth-el.

d: **1.** hail (lit. -pearls of God)
s: From [H410](H410) and [H1378](H1378); *hail* (as if a *great* *pearl*): - great hail \[-stones\].

d: **1.** a tree (from Lebanon), algum trees
s: By transposition for [H484](H484); sticks of *algum* wood: - algum \[trees\].

d:
Eldad = "God has loved"
**1.** one of the two elders who prophesied in the Israelite camp
s: From [H410](H410) and [H1780](H1780); *God* *has* *loved*; *Eldad*, an Israelite: - Eldad.

d:
Eldaah = "God has known"
**1.** a son or descendant of Midian
s: From [H410](H410) and [H3045](H3045); *God* *of* *knowledge*; *Eldaah*, a son of Midian: - Eldaah.

d: **1.** (Qal) to lament, wail
s: A primitive root (rather identical with [H422](H422) through the idea of *invocation*); to *bewail: -* lament.
o: a primitive root \[rather identical with [H422](H422) through the idea of invocation\]

d:
**1.** to swear, curse
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to swear, take an oath (before God)
				**2.** to curse
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to put under oath, adjure
				**2.** to put under a curse
s: A primitive root; properly to *adjure*, that is, (usually in a bad sense) *imprecate: -* adjure, curse, swear.

d:
**1.** oath
**2.** oath of covenant
**3.** curse
		**a.** from God
		**b.** from men
**4.** execration
s: From [H422](H422); an *imprecation: -* curse, cursing, execration, oath, swearing.

d:
**1.** terebinth, terebinth tree
**2.** valley where David killed Goliath
s: Feminine of [H352](H352); an *oak* or other strong tree: - elm, oak, teil tree

d:
Elah = "An oak"
**1.** an Edomite chief
**2.** a king of Israel for two years, son of Baasha
**3.** the father of king Hoshea of Israel
**4.** a son of Caleb
**5.** son of Uzzi
s: The same as [H424](H424); *Elah*, the name of an Edomite, or four Israelites, and also of a place in Palestine: - Elah.

d:
**1.** god, God
		**a.** god, heathen deity
		**b.** God (of Israel)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H433](H433); *God: -* God, god.

d:
**1.** oak
**2.** terebinth
s: A variation of [H424](H424): - oak.

d:
**1.** these
		**a.** used before antecedent
		**b.** used following antecedent
s: Prolonged from [H411](H411); *these* or *those: -* an- (the) other; one sort, so, some, such, them, these (same), they, this, those, thus, which, who (-m).

d: **1.** these
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H428](H428): - these.

d:
**1.** (plural)
		**a.** rulers, judges
		**b.** divine ones
		**c.** angels
		**d.** gods
**2.** (plural intensive-singular meaning)
		**a.** god, goddess
		**b.** godlike one
		**c.** works or special possessions of God
		**d.** the (true) God
		**e.** God
s: Plural of [H433](H433); *gods* in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme *God*; occasionally applied by way of deference to *magistrates*; and sometimes as a superlative: - angels, X exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), X (very) great, judges, X mighty.

d: **1.** behold!, lo!
s: (Chaldee); probably prolonged from [H412](H412); *lo!*: - behold.

d: **1.** if, though (contrary to fact)
s: Probably from [H408](H408); *nay*, that is, (softened) *if: -* but if, yea though.

d:
**1.** God
**2.** false god
s: (The second form is rare); probably prolonged (emphatically) from [H410](H410); a *deity* or the *deity*: - God, god. See [H430](H430).

d:
**1.** worthless, something worthless, ineffective
**2.** worthless gods, idols
s: For [H457](H457); good for *nothing: -* thing of nought.

d:
Elul = "nothingness"
**1.** sixth Jewish month corresponding to modern Aug. or Sep.
s: Probably of foreign derivation; *Elul*, the sixth Jewish month: - Elul.

d:
**1.** tree, great tree, terebinth
**2.** plain
s: Prolonged from [H352](H352); an *oak* or other strong tree: - plain. See also [H356](H356).

d: **1.** oak, great tree
s: A variation of [H436](H436): - oak.

d:
Allon = "great tree" or "oak"
**1.** city in Naphtali
**2.** a Simeonite
s: The same as [H437](H437); *Allon*, an Israelite, also a place in Palestine: - Allon.

d:
Allon Bachuth = "oak of weeping"
**1.** site of Deborah's (Rebekah's nurse) grave near Bethel
s: From [H437](H437) and a variation of [H1068](H1068); *oak* *of* *weeping*; *Allon-Bakuth*, a monumental tree: - Allon-bachuth.

d:
Elonite = "might" or "terebinth: a plain"
**1.** one of the clan of Elon
s: Patronymic from [H438](H438); an *Elonite* or descendant (collectively) of Elon: - Elonites.

d:
**1.** tame, docile
**2.** friend, intimate
**3.** chief
s: From [H502](H502); *familiar*; a *friend*, also *gentle*; hence a *bullock* (as being tame; applied, although masculine, to a *cow*); and so a *chieftain* (as notable like neat cattle): - captain, duke, (chief) friend, governor, guide, ox.

d:
Alush = "I will knead (bread)"
**1.** a wilderness encampment following the Exodus
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Alush*, a place in the Desert: - Alush.

d:
Elzabad = "God has given"
**1.** a Gadite warrior who aided David
**2.** a Korhite Levite
s: From [H410](H410) and [H2064](H2064); *God* *has* *bestowed*; *Elzabad*, the name of two Israelites: - Elzabad.
