d: **1.** (Niphal) to be corrupt morally, tainted
s: A primitive root; to *muddle*, that is, (figuratively and intransitively) to *turn* (morally) *corrupt: -* become filthy.

d:
Elhanan = "God has been gracious"
**1.** Jair's son who fought the Gittites
**2.** Dodo's son who was a chief of David
s: From [H410](H410) and [H2603](H2603); *God* (is) *gracious*; *Elchanan*, an Israelite: - Elkanan.

d:
Eliab = "my God is father" or "God is father"
**1.** son of Helon, leader of Zebulun in the wilderness
**2.** a Reubenite chief, father of Dathan and Abiram
**3.** David's oldest brother
**4.** a Levite musician
**5.** a Gadite warrior for David
**6.** a Kohathite
s: From [H410](H410) and [H1](H1); *God* *of* (his) *father*; *Eliab*, the name of six Israelites: - Eliab.

d:
Eliel = "my God is God" or "El is God"
**1.** an ancestor of Samuel
**2.** chief in David's army (might be two or three different men)
**3.** a Levite with David in moving the ark
**4.** a chief of Manasseh
**5.** two chiefs of Benjamin
**6.** a chief Kohathite
**7.** a Levite
s: From [H410](H410) repeated; *God* *of* (his) *God*; *Eliel*, the name of nine Israelites: - Eliel.

d:
Eliathah = "God has come"
**1.** a Hemanite musician in David's court
s: From [H410](H410) and [H225](H225); *God* *of* (his) *consent*; *Eliathah*, an Israelite: - Eliathah.

d:
Elidad = "my God has loved"
**1.** a Benjamite chief who helped apportion his tribe's allotment to the Promised Land
s: From the same as [H419](H419); *God* *of* (his) *love*; *Elidad*, an Israelite: - Elidad.

d:
Eliadah or Eliada = "God knows"
**1.** a son of David
**2.** a Benjamite warrior chief
**3.** an Aramean, the father of an enemy of Solomon
s: From [H410](H410) and [H3045](H3045); *God* (is) *knowing*; *Eljada*, the name of two Israelites and of an Aramaean: - Eliada.

d: **1.** tail, fat-tail (of sheep-an Eastern delicacy)
s: From [H422](H422) (in the original sense of *strength*); the *stout* part, that is, the fat *tail* of the Oriental sheep: - rump.
o: from [H422](H422) (in the original sense of strength)

d:
Elijah or Eliah = "my God is Jehovah" or "Yah(u) is God"
**1.** the great prophet of the reign of Ahab
**2.** Benjamite son of Jeroham
**3.** a son of Elam with foreign wife during exile
**4.** a son of Harim, and priest, with foreign wife during exile
s: From [H410](H410) and [H3050](H3050); *God* *of* *Jehovah*; *Elijah*, the name of the famous prophet and of two other Israelites: - Elijah, Eliah.

d:
Elihu = "He is my God"
**1.** the younger man who rebuked Job and his three friends
**2.** an Ephraimite, Samuel's great grandfather
**3.** a Manassite warrior chief for David
**4.** son of Shemaiah and Korhite gatekeeper
**5.** David's brother
s: From [H410](H410) and [H1931](H1931); *God* *of* *him*; *Elihu*, the name of one of Job’s friends, and of three Israelites: - Elihu.

d:
Elioenai or Elihoenai = "unto Jehovah are my eyes"
**1.** a Korahite temple doorkeeper, son of Meshelemiah
**2.** two men with foreign wife during the exile; one a priest
**3.** a son of Neariah
**4.** a Simeonite
**5.** a Benjamite, son of Becher
s: From [H413](H413) and [H3068](H3068) and [H5869](H5869); *towards* *Jehovah* (are) *my* *eyes*; *Eljehoenai* or *Eljoenai*, the name of seven Israelites: - Elihoenai, Elionai.

d:
Eliahba = "God hides"
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H410](H410) and [H2244](H2244); *God* *will* *hide*; *Eljachba*, an Israelite: - Eliahbah.

d:
Elihoreph = "God of winter (harvest-time)"
**1.** a scribe in Solomon's court
s: From [H410](H410) and [H2779](H2779); *God* *of* *autumn*; *Elichoreph*, an Israelite: - Elihoreph.

d:
**1.** of nought, good for nothing, worthless
		**a.** of physicians, a shepherd, a divination
		**b.** of false gods
s: Apparently from [H408](H408); good for *nothing*, by analogy *vain* or *vanity*; specifically an *idol: -* idol, no value, thing of nought.

d:
Elimelech = "my God is king"
**1.** Naomi's husband
s: From [H410](H410) and [H4428](H4428); *God* *of* (the) *king*; *Elimelek*, an Israelite: - Elimelech.

d: **1.** these, those
s: (Chaldee); prolonged from [H412](H412); *these: -* the, these.

d:
Eliasaph = "God has added"
**1.** a Gadite chief in the wilderness census
**2.** a head of the Gershonites
s: From [H410](H410) and [H3254](H3254); *God* (is) *gatherer*; *Eljasaph*, the name of two Israelites: - Eliasaph.

d:
Eliezer = "God is help"
**1.** Abraham's Damascene servant
**2.** a son of Moses
**3.** a Benjamite
**4.** a priest who helped move the ark
**5.** a Reubenite
**6.** a prophet who spoke to Jehoshaphat
**7.** a Levite chief
**8.** son of Harim
**9.** priest with foreign wife
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5828](H5828); *God* *of* *help*; *Eliezer*, the name of a Damascene and of ten Israelites: - Eliezer.

d:
Elienai = "unto God are my eyes"
**1.** a Benjamite
s: Probably contracted for [H454](H454); *Elienai*, an Israelite: - Elienai.

d:
Eliam = "God of the people" or "God is kinsman"
**1.** Bathsheba's father
**2.** a Gilonite warrior of David
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5971](H5971); *God* *of* (the) *people*; *Eliam*, an Israelite: - Eliam.

d:
Eliphaz = "my God is (fine) gold"
**1.** Esau's son, father of Teman
**2.** the Temanite friend of Job
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6337](H6337); *God* *of* *gold*; *Eliphaz*, the name of one of Job’s friends, and of a son of Esau: - Eliphaz.

d:
Eliphal = "my God is supplication"
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6419](H6419); *God* *of* *judgment*; *Eliphal*, an Israelite: - Eliphal.

d:
Elipheleh = "my God sets him apart" or "my God distinguishes him"
**1.** a Levite gatekeeper and musician for David
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6395](H6395); *God* *of* *his* *distinction*; *Eliphelehu*, an Israelite: - Elipheleh.

d:
Elpalet or Eliphalet or Eliphelet = "God is deliverance"
**1.** David's youngest son
**2.** one of David's mighty warriors
**3.** a Benjamite descendant of Jonathan
**4.** a leader of the clan of Adonikam
**5.** one of the line of Hashum
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6405](H6405); *God* *of* *deliverance*; *Eliphelet* or *Elpelet*, the name of six Israelites: - Eliphalet, Eliphelet, Elpalet.

d:
Elizur = "my God is a rock" or "Rock is God"
**1.** a chief of Reuben in the wilderness
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6697](H6697); *God* *of* (the) *rock*; *Elitsur*, an Israelite: - Elizur.

d:
Elizaphan or Elzaphan = "my God has protected"
**1.** a Kohathite chief in the wilderness
**2.** a Zebulunite chief
**3.** Uzziel's son, Mishael's brother in time of Moses
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6845](H6845); *God* *of* *treasure*; *Elitsaphan* or *Eltsaphan*, an Israelite: - Elizaphan, Elzaphan.

d:
Elika = "my God rejects"
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6958](H6958); *God* *of* *rejection*; *Elika*, an Israelite: - Elika.

d:
Eliakim = "God raises" or "God sets up"
**1.** the son of Hilkiah, master of Hezekiah's household
**2.** Josiah's son, enthroned by Pharaoh
**3.** a priest who assisted Nehemiah
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6965](H6965); *God* *of* *raising*; *Eljakim*, the name of four Israelites: - Eliakim.

d:
Elisheba = "my God has sworn" or "God is an oath"
**1.** Aaron's wife
s: From [H410](H410) and [H7651](H7651) (in the sense of [H7650](H7650)); *God* *of* (the) *oath*; *Elisheba*, the wife of Aaron: - Elisheba.

d:
Elishah = "God of the coming (one)"
**1.** descendant of Noah, son of Javan; perhaps ancestor of the Aeolians
s: Probably of foreign derivation; *Elishah*, a son of Javan: - Elishah.

d:
Elishua = "my God is wealth" or "God is salvation"
**1.** a son of David
s: From [H410](H410) and [H7769](H7769); *God* *of* *supplication* (or *of* *riches*); *Elishua*, a son of King David: - Elishua.

d:
Eliashib = "God restores"
**1.** a priest in David's reign
**2.** a descendant of David
**3.** a high priest in Nehemiah's time
**4.** a temple singer with foreign wife
**5.** one of the line of Zattu
**6.** one of the line of Bani
s: From [H410](H410) and [H7725](H7725); *God* *will* *restore*; *Eljashib*, the name of six Israelites: - Eliashib.

d:
Elishama = "my God has heard"
**1.** an Ephraimite chief in the wilderness
**2.** a son of David
**3.** Jehoiakim's secretary
**4.** a priest who taught the law
**5.** a man of Judah
s: From [H410](H410) and [H8085](H8085); *God* *of* *hearing*; *Elishama*, the name of seven Israelites: - Elishama.

d:
Elisha = "God is salvation"
**1.** the great prophet who succeeded Elijah
s: Contracted for [H474](H474); *Elisha*, the famous prophet: - Elisha.

d:
Elishaphat = "my God has judged"
**1.** a captain for the high priest Jehoiada
s: From [H410](H410) and [H8199](H8199); *God* *of* *judgment*; *Elishaphat*, an Israelite: - Elishaphat.

d: **1.** these, those
s: (Chaldee); prolonged from [H412](H412); *these: -* these, those.

d: **1.** woe! alas!
s: By reduplication from [H421](H421); *alas!*: - woe.

d:
**1.** to bind
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be dumb
				**2.** to be bound
		**b.** (Piel) binding (part.)
s: A primitive root; to *tie* fast; hence (of the mouth) to be *tongue* *tied: -* bind, be dumb, put to silence.

d: **1.** in silence, silent
s: From [H481](H481); *silence* (that is, mute justice): - congregation. Compare [H3128](H3128).

d: **1.** mute, silent, dumb, unable to speak
s: From [H481](H481); *speechless: -* dumb (man).

d: **1.** a tree from Lebanon, almug trees (sandalwood?), almug wood
s: Probably of foreign derivation (used thus only in the plural); *almug* (that is, probably sandalwood) sticks: - almug trees. Compare [H418](H418).
o: probably of foreign derivation (used only in the plural)

d:
**1.** sheaf (as something bound)
		**a.** of Israel returning from exile (fig.)
s: Second form is masculine form; passive participle of [H481](H481); something *bound*; a *sheaf: -* sheaf.

d:
Almodad = "not measured"
**1.** a descendant of Shem
s: Probably of foreign derivation; *Almodad*, a son of Joktan: - Almodad.

d:
Alammelech = "oak of the king"
**1.** a town or site in Asher
s: From [H427](H427) and [H4428](H4428); *oak* *of* (the) *king*; *Allammelek*, a place in Palestine: - Alammelech.

d: **1.** widowed, forsaken, forsaken as a widow
s: Prolonged from [H481](H481) in the sense of *bereavement*; discarded (as a divorced person): - forsaken.
o: prolonged from [H481](H481) in the sense of bereavement

d: **1.** widowhood
s: From [H481](H481) as in [H488](H488); *bereavement: -* widowhood.

d: **1.** widow
s: Feminine of [H488](H488); a *widow*; also a desolate *place: -* desolate house (palace), widow.

d: **1.** widowhood
s: Feminine of [H488](H488); concretely a *widow*; abstractly *widowhood*: - widow, widowhood.

d: **1.** someone, a certain one
s: From [H489](H489) in the sense of *concealment*; *some* one (that is, *so* *and* *so*, without giving the name of the person or place): - one, and such.
o: from [H489](H489) in the sense of concealment

d:
Elnaam = "God is delight" or "God is pleasantness"
**1.** the father of two of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5276](H5276); *God* (is his) *delight*; *Elnaam*, an Israelite: - Elnaam.

d:
Elnathan = "God has given"
**1.** king Jehoiachin's maternal grandfather
**2.** three chief men in Ezra's time
**3.** son of Achbor, a military commander under Jehoiakim
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5414](H5414); *God* (is the) *giver*; *Elnathan*, the name of four Israelites: - Elnathan.

d:
Ellasar = "God is chastener"
**1.** a town in Babylonia, c. 28 miles (50 km) E of Ur
s: Probably of foreign derivation; *Ellasar*, an early country of Asia: - Ellasar.

d:
Elead = "God has testified"
**1.** a descendant of Ephraim
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5749](H5749); *God* *has* *testified*; *Elad*, an Israelite: - Elead.

d:
Eladah = "God has adorned"
**1.** a descendant of Ephraim
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5710](H5710); *God* *has* *decked*; *Eladah*, an Israelite: - Eladah.

d:
Eluzai = "God is my strength"
**1.** a Benjamite warrior who joined David
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5756](H5756) (in the sense of [H5797](H5797)); *God* (is) *defensive*; *Eluzai*, an Israelite: - Eluzai.

d:
Eleazar = "God has helped"
**1.** the high priest son of Aaron
**2.** Abinadab's son who cared for the ark
**3.** the priest who rebuilt and dedicated the restored walls of Jerusalem in time of Ezra
**4.** one of David's mighty warriors
**5.** a Levite
**6.** one of the line of Parosh
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5826](H5826); *God* (is) *helper*; *Elazar*, the name of seven Israelites: - Eleazar.

d:
Elealeh = "God is ascending"
**1.** a Reubenite village near Heshbon (in ruins)
s: From [H410](H410) and [H5927](H5927); *God* (is) *going* *up*; *Elale* or *Elaleh*, a place east of the Jordan: - Elealeh.

d:
Elasah or Eleasah = "God has made"
**1.** a descendant of Judah, son of Helez
**2.** a priest of Pashur's line with a foreign wife during Ezra's time
**3.** Shaphan's son, Zedekiah's servant
**4.** a descendant of Benjamin, son of Rapha, father of Azel
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6213](H6213); *God* *has* *made*; *Elasah*, the name of four Israelites: - Elasah, Eleasah.

d:
**1.** to learn
		**a.** (Qal) to learn
		**b.** (Piel) to teach
s: A primitive root, to *associate* with; hence to *learn* (and causatively to *teach*): - learn, teach, utter.
o: a primitive root, to associate with

d:
v
**1.** (CLBL) to make thousand-fold, bring forth thousands
**2.** (TWOT) (Hiphil) producing thousands
n m
**3.** (BDB) chief, chiliarch
s: Denominative from [H505](H505); causatively to *make* *a* *thousandfold: -* bring forth thousands.

d:
**1.** cattle, oxen
		**a.** in farming
		**b.** as a possession
s: From [H502](H502); a *family*; also (from the sense of *yoking* or *taming*) an *ox* or *cow: -* family, kine, oxen.

d:
**1.** a thousand
		**a.** as numeral
**2.** a thousand, company
		**a.** as a company of men under one leader, troops
s: Properly the same as [H504](H504); hence (an ox’s head being the first letter of the alphabet, and this eventually used as a numeral) a *thousand: -* thousand.

d: **1.** a thousand, 1000
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H505](H505): - thousand.

d:
Eleph = "thousand"
**1.** a city in the territory of Benjamin
s: The same as [H505](H505); *Eleph*, a place in Palestine: - Eleph.

d:
Elpaal = "God is maker"
**1.** a Benjamite
s: From [H410](H410) and [H6466](H6466); *God* (is) *act*; *Elpaal*, an Israelite: - Elpaal.

d: **1.** (Piel) to urge
s: A primitive root; to *press: -* urge.

d:
**1.** (TWOT) (neg adv) no, not, nor, neither
**2.** (BDB) band of soldiers
**3.** (CLBL) no rebellion, no uprising (lit.)
s: Probably from [H408](H408) and [H6965](H6965); a *non-rising* (that is, *resistlessness*): - no rising up.

d:
Elkanah = "God has possessed" or "God has created"
**1.** Samuel's father
**2.** a ruler in Jerusalem in the time of king Ahaz
**3.** one of David's mighty warriors
**4.** son of Korah
**5.** several Levites
s: From [H410](H410) and [H7069](H7069); *God* *has* *obtained*; *Elkanah*, the name of seven Israelites: - Elkanah.

d:
Elkoshite = "God the ensnarer"
**1.** a native and/or descendant of Elkosh (location unknown)
s: Patrial from a name of uncertain derivation; an *Elkoshite* or native of Elkosh: - Elkoshite.
o: patrial from a name of uncertain derivation

d:
Eltolad = "God's generations"
**1.** a city in southern Judah
s: Probably from [H410](H410) and a masculine form of [H8435](H8435) (compare [H8434](H8434)); *God* (is) *generator*; *Eltolad*, a place in Palestine: - Eltolad.
o: probably from [H410](H410) and a masculine form of [H8435](H8435) \[compare [H8434](H8434)\]

d:
Eltekeh = "let God spue thee out"
**1.** Levitical city in the tribe of Dan, between Ekron and Timna
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Eltekeh* or *Elteke*, a place in Palestine: - Eltekeh.

d:
Eltekon = "God is straight"
**1.** a city in the territory of Judah north of Hebron
s: From [H410](H410) and [H8626](H8626); *God* (is) *straight*; *Eltekon*, a place in Palestine: - Eltekon.

d:
Al-taschith = "do not destroy"
**1.** (Hiphil) a command to the chief musician, or perhaps the title of a melody used for several Psalms
s: From [H408](H408) and [H7843](H7843); *Thou* *must* *not* *destroy*; probably the opening words of a popular song: - Al-taschith.

d:
**1.** mother
		**a.** of humans
		**b.** of Deborah's relationship to the people (fig.)
		**c.** of animals
**2.** point of departure or division
s: A primitive word; a *mother* (as the *bond* of the family); in a wide sense (both literally and figuratively); (like [H1](H1)): - dam, mother, X parting.

d:
**1.** if
		**a.** conditional clauses
				**1.** of possible situations
				**2.** of impossible situations
		**b.** oath contexts
				**1.** no, not
		**c.** if...if, whether...or, whether...or...or
		**d.** when, whenever
		**e.** since
		**f.** interrogative particle
		**g.** but rather
s: A primitive particle; used very widely as demonstrative, *lo*!; interrogitive, *whether*?; or conditional, *if*, *although*; also *Oh* *that*!, *when*; hence as a negative, *not: -* (and, can-, doubtless, if, that) (not), + but, either, + except, + more (-over if, than), neither, nevertheless, nor, oh that, or, + save (only, -ing), seeing, since, sith, + surely (no more, none, not), though, + of a truth, + unless, + verily, when, whereas, whether, while, + yet.

d:
**1.** maid-servant, female slave, maid, handmaid, concubine
		**a.** of humility (fig.)
s: Apparently a primitive word; a *maidservant* or female slave: - (hand-) bondmaid (-woman,) maid (-servant).

d: **1.** cubit-a measure of distance (the forearm), roughly 18 in (. 5m). There are several cubits used in the OT, the cubit of a man or common cubit (De 3:11), the legal cubit or cubit of the sanctuary (Eze 40:5) plus others. See a Bible Dictionary for a complete treatment.
s: Prolonged from [H517](H517); properly a *mother* (that is, *unit*) of measure, or the *forearm* (below the elbow), that is, a *cubit*; also a door *base* (as a *bond* of the entrance): - cubit, + hundred \[by exchange for [H3967](H3967)\], measure, post.

d: **1.** cubit-a measure of distance (the forearm), roughly 18 in (. 5 m)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H520](H520): - cubit.

d:
Ammah = "a cubit"
**1.** a hill near Gibeon
s: The same as [H520](H520); *Ammah*, a hill in Palestine: - Ammah.

d: **1.** people, tribe, nation
s: From the same as [H517](H517); a *collection*, that is, community of persons: - nation, people.

d: **1.** people, tribe, nation
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H523](H523): - nation.

d: **1.** artificer, architect, master workman, skilled workman
s: From [H539](H539), probably in the sense of *training*; *skilled*, that is, an architect (like [H542](H542)): - one brought up.
o: from [H539](H539), probably in the sense of training

d:
Amon = "skilled workman" or "master workman"
**1.** a king of Judah, son of Manasseh
**2.** a governor of Samaria
**3.** a descendant of a servant of Solomon
s: The same as [H525](H525); *Amon*, the name of three Israelites: - Amon.

d:
**1.** artificer, architect, master workman
**2.** (CLBL) throng, multitude
s: A variation for [H1995](H1995); a *throng* of people: - multitude.

d:
Amon or Amun = "to nourish: to be faithful"
**1.** an Egyptian god, originally the local god of Thebes, later head of the Egyptian pantheon
s: Of Egyptian derivation; *Amon* (that is, Ammon or Amn), a deity of Egypt (used only as an adjunct of [H4996](H4996)): - multitude, populous.

d:
**1.** faithfulness, trusting
		**a.** faithful, trusty (as adj.)
s: From [H539](H539); *established*, that is, (figuratively) *trusty*; also (abstractly) *trustworthiness: -* faith (-ful), truth.

d: **1.** firmness, fidelity, steadfastness, steadiness
s: Feminine of [H529](H529); literally *firmness*; figuratively *security*; moral *fidelity: -* faith (-ful, -ly, -ness, \[man\]), set office, stability, steady, truly, truth, verily.

d:
Amoz = "strong"
**1.** father of Isaiah
s: From [H553](H553); *strong*; *Amots*, an Israelite: - Amoz.

d:
Ami = "bond-servant"
**1.** a descendant of Amon, Solomon's servant
s: An abbreviated for [H526](H526); *Ami*, an Israelite: - Ami.

d: **1.** strong, mighty
s: From [H553](H553); *strong* or (abstractly) *strength: -* courageous, mighty, strong (one).

d:
**1.** top, summit
		**a.** of tree
		**b.** of mountain
s: Apparently from [H559](H559) (in the sense of *self* *exaltation*); a *summit* (of a tree or mountain): - bough, branch.

d:
**1.** to be weak, to droop, to languish, to be exhausted
		**a.** (Qal) pass participle (of the heart)
				**1.** to be weak
				**2.** to droop
		**b.** (Pulal)
				**1.** to be or grow feeble
				**2.** to languish
s: A primitive root; to *droop*; by implication to *be* *sick*, to *mourn: -* languish, be weak, wax feeble.

d: **1.** weak, feeble
s: From [H535](H535); *sick: -* weak.

d: **1.** weak, feeble
s: From [H535](H535); *languid: -* feeble.

d:
Amam = "their mother"
**1.** a city in southern Judah
s: From [H517](H517); *gathering* spot; *Amam*, a place in Palestine: - Amam.

d:
**1.** to support, confirm, be faithful
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to support, confirm, be faithful, uphold, nourish
						**a.** foster-father (subst.)
						**b.** foster-mother, nurse
						**c.** pillars, supporters of the door
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be established, be faithful, be carried, make firm
						**a.** to be carried by a nurse
						**b.** made firm, sure, lasting
						**c.** confirmed, established, sure
						**d.** verified, confirmed
						**e.** reliable, faithful, trusty
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to stand firm, to trust, to be certain, to believe in
						**a.** stand firm
						**b.** trust, believe
s: A primitive root; properly to *build* *up* or *support*; to *foster* as a parent or nurse; figuratively to *render* (or *be*) *firm* or faithful, to *trust* or believe, to be *permanent* or quiet; morally to *be* *true* or certain; once (in Isa 30:21; by interchange for [H541](H541)) to *go* *to* *the* *right* *hand: -* hence assurance, believe, bring up, establish, + fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.

d:
**1.** to confirm, support
		**a.** (Aphel)
				**1.** to believe in
				**2.** to trust
				**3.** trustworthy (pass participle)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H539](H539): - believe, faithful, sure.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to take the right hand, to turn right, choose to the right, go to the right, use the right hand
s: Denominative from [H3225](H3225); to take the *right* *hand* road: - turn to the right. See [H539](H539).

d: **1.** master-workman, artist, steady-handed one, artisan
s: From [H539](H539) (in the sense of *training*); an *expert: -* cunning workman.

d: **1.** verily, truly, amen, so be it
s: From [H539](H539); *sure*; abstractly *faithfulness*; adverbially *truly: -* Amen, so be it, truth.

d: **1.** faithfulness
s: From [H539](H539); *verity: -* truth.

d: **1.** bringing up, nourishment, rearing, training, providing for (as a parent)
s: Feminine of [H544](H544) (in the specific sense of *training*); *tutelage: -* brought up.
o: from [H544](H544) (in the specific sense of training)

d: **1.** verily, truly, indeed
s: Feminine of [H544](H544) (in its usual sense); adverbially *surely: -* indeed.
o: feminine form of [H544](H544) (in its usual sense)

d:
**1.** pillar, supporters of the door
**2.** confirm, support, uphold
s: Feminine active participle of [H544](H544) (in the original sense of *supporting*); a *column: -* pillar.
o: active participle of [H544](H544) (in the original sense of supporting)

d:
**1.** faith, support, sure, certain
		**a.** of a covenant
		**b.** of financial support
s: Feminine of [H543](H543); something *fixed*, that is, a *covenant*, an *allowance: -* certain portion, sure.

d:
Amana = "support"
**1.** a river flowing into the plain of Damascus from Antilebanon
**2.** mountainous area of the river's origin
s: The same as [H548](H548); *Amanah*, a mountain near Damascus: - Amana.

d:
Amnon = "faithful"
**1.** oldest son of David, rapist of Tamar, slain by Absalom
**2.** a son of Shimon (of Caleb's clan)
s: From [H539](H539); *faithful*; *Amnon* (or Aminon), a son of David: - Amnon.

d: **1.** verily, truly, surely
s: Adverb from [H544](H544); *verily: -* indeed, no doubt, surely, (it is, of a) true (-ly, -th).

d: **1.** verily, truly, indeed
s: An orthographical variation of [H551](H551): - in (very) deed; of a surety.

d:
**1.** to be strong, alert, courageous, brave, stout, bold, solid, hard
		**a.** (Qal) to be strong, brave, bold
		**b.** (Piel) to strengthen, secure (for oneself), harden (heart), make firm, make obstinate, assure
		**c.** (Hithpael) to be determined, to make oneself alert, strengthen oneself, confirm oneself, persist in, prove superior to
		**d.** (Hiphil) to exhibit strength, be strong, feel strong
s: A primitive root; to *be* *alert*, physically (on foot) or mentally (in courage): - confirm, be courageous (of good courage, stedfastly minded, strong, stronger), establish, fortify, harden, increase, prevail, strengthen (self), make strong (obstinate, speed).

d:
**1.** strong
**2.** bay, dappled, piebald (of colour)
s: Probably from [H553](H553); of a *strong* color, that is, *red* (others *fleet*): - bay.

d: **1.** strength
s: From [H553](H553); *strength: -* stronger.

d: **1.** strength
s: From [H553](H553); *force: -* strength.

d:
Amzi = "my strength"
**1.** a Levite
**2.** the ancestor of a returned exile in the priestly line
s: From [H553](H553); *strong*; *Amtsi*, an Israelite: - Amzi.

d:
Amaziah = "Jehovah is mighty"
**1.** a king of Judah, son Joash, father of Azariah
**2.** a priest of Bethel under Jeroboam II
**3.** father of Joshah, of the tribe of Simeon
**4.** a Levite tabernacle singer in David's day
s: From [H553](H553) and [H3050](H3050); *strength* *of* *Jah*; *Amatsjah*, the name of four Israelites: - Amaziah.

d:
**1.** to say, speak, utter
		**a.** (Qal) to say, to answer, to say in one's heart, to think, to command, to promise, to intend
		**b.** (Niphal) to be told, to be said, to be called
		**c.** (Hithpael) to boast, to act proudly
		**d.** (Hiphil) to avow, to avouch
s: A primitive root; to *say* (used with great latitude): - answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, + (at the, give) command (ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, X desire, determine, X expressly, X indeed, X intend, name, X plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), X still, X suppose, talk, tell, term, X that is, X think, use \[speech\], utter, X verily, X yet.

d: **1.** (P'al) to say, to speak, to command, to tell, to relate
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H559](H559): - command, declare, say, speak, tell.

d: **1.** utterance, speech, word, saying, promise, command
s: From [H559](H559); something *said: -* answer, X appointed unto him, saying, speech, word.

d: **1.** utterance, speech, word, saying, promise, command
s: The same as [H561](H561): - promise, speech, thing, word.

d: **1.** lamb
s: (Chaldee); perhaps from [H560](H560) (in the sense of *bringing* *forth*); a *lamb: -* lamb.
o: perhaps from [H560](H560) (in the sense of bringing forth)

d:

**1.** first-fruits
		**a.** the first of the crops and fruit that ripened, was gathered, and offered to God according to the ritual of Pentecost
		**b.** the bread made of the new grain offered at Pentecost
		**c.** the day of the first-fruits (Pentecost)
s: From [H1069](H1069); the *first* *fruits* of the crop: - first fruit (-ripe \[figuratively), hasty fruit.

d: **1.** birthright, primogeniture, right of the first-born
s: Feminine of [H1060](H1060); the *firstling* of man or beast; abstractly *primogeniture: -* birthright, firstborn (-ling).

d:
**1.** first-ripe fig, early fig
**2.** (TWOT) firstfruits
s: Feminine of [H1061](H1061); the *early* fig: - firstripe (fruit).

d:
Bechorath = "first-born"
**1.** a Benjamite ancestor of Saul
s: Feminine of [H1062](H1062); *primogeniture*; *Bekorath*, an Israelite: - Bechorath.

d: **1.** a weeping, weeping
s: From [H1058](H1058); a *weeping*; by analogy, a *dripping: -* overflowing, X sore, (continual) weeping, wept.

d:
Bochim = "weeping"
**1.** a place near Gilgal (or Bethel), where sons of Israel wept
s: Plural active participle of [H1058](H1058); (with the article) the *weepers*; *Bokim*, a place in Palestine: - Bochim.

d:
**1.** firstborn daughter, firstborn (of women)
		**a.** always used of women
s: Feminine from [H1069](H1069); the *eldest* daughter: - firstborn.

d: **1.** weeping
s: From [H1058](H1058); a *weeping: -* mourning.

d:
**1.** to be born first
		**a.** (Piel)
				**1.** to bear early, new fruit
				**2.** to give the right of the firstborn
						**a.** to make as firstborn
						**b.** to constitute as firstborn
		**b.** (Pual)
				**1.** to be born a firstling
				**2.** to be made a firstling
		**c.** (Hiphil) one bearing her first child
s: A primitive root; properly to *burst* the womb, that is, (causatively) *bear* or *make* *early* *fruit* (of woman or tree); also (as denominatively from [H1061](H1061)) to *give* *the* *birthright: -* make firstborn, be firstling, bring forth first child (new fruit).

d: **1.** young camel, dromedary
s: From [H1069](H1069) (in the sense of *youth*); a young *camel: -* dromedary.

d:
Becher = "young camel"
**1.** a son of Ephraim
**2.** a son of Benjamin
s: The same as [H1070](H1070); *Beker*, the name of two Israelites: - Becher.

d: **1.** a young female camel, young camel, dromedary
s: Feminine of [H1070](H1070); a young *she* *camel: -* dromedary.

d:
**1.** first ripe fig, early fig
**2.** (TWOT) firstfruits
s: By orthographical variation for [H1063](H1063); a *first* *ripe* fig: - first-ripe.

d:
Bocheru = "firstborn"
**1.** a Benjamite
s: From [H1069](H1069); *first* *born*; *Bokeru*, an Israelite: - Bocheru.

d:
Bichri = "youthful"
n pr m
**1.** a Benjamite, father of Sheba
adj
**2.** (BDB) the Bichrites
s: From [H1069](H1069); *youthful*; *Bikri*, an Israelite: - Bichri.

d:
Bachrites = "a dromedary: first-born"
**1.** one of the family of Becher
s: Patronymic from [H1071](H1071); a *Bakrite* (collectively) or descendant of Beker: - Bachrites.

d: **1.** not, hardly, else
s: From [H1086](H1086); properly a *failure*; by implication *nothing*; usually (adverbially) *not* at all; also *lest: -* lest, neither, no, none (that . . . ), not (any), nothing.

d:
Bel = "lord"
**1.** a chief Babylonian deity
s: By contraction for [H1168](H1168); *Bel*, the Baal of the Babylonians: - Bel.

d: **1.** mind, heart
s: (Chaldee); from [H1080](H1080); properly *anxiety*, that is, (by implication) the *heart* (as its seat): - heart.

d:
**1.** (Pael) to wear away, wear out
		**a.** to harass constantly (fig.)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1086](H1086) (but used only in a mental sense); to *afflict: -* wear out.
o: corresponding to [H1086](H1086) (used only in a mental sense)

d:
Baladan = "Bel (is his) lord)"
**1.** the father of Merodach-baladan to whom Hezekiah revealed the riches of his treasures
s: From [H1078](H1078) and [H113](H113) (contracted); *Bel* (is his) *lord*; *Baladan*, the name of a Babylonian prince: - Baladan.

d:
**1.** to gleam, smile
		**a.** (Hiphil) only
				**1.** to show a smile, look pleasant
				**2.** to cause to burst
s: A primitive root; to *break* *off* or *loose* (in a favorable or unfavorable sense), that is, *desist* (from grief) or *invade* (with destruction): - comfort, (recover) strength(-en).

d:
Bilgah = "cheerfulness"
**1.** a priest of the 15th course, in David's time
**2.** a priest accompanying Zerubbabel
s: From [H1082](H1082); *desistance*; *Bilgah*, the name of two Israelites: - Bilgah.

d:
Bilgai = "my cheerfulness"
**1.** a priest who covenanted with Nehemiah
s: From [H1082](H1082); *desistant*; *Bilgai*, an Israelite: - Bilgai.

d:
Bildad = "confusing (by mingling) love"
**1.** the second friend of Job
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Bildad*, one of Job’s friends: - Bildad.

d:
**1.** to wear out, become old
		**a.** (Qal) to wear out
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to wear out
				**2.** to wear out by use, use up completely
				**3.** to enjoy, use to the full
s: A primitive root; to *fail*; by implication to *wear* *out*, *decay* (causatively *consume*, *spend*): - consume, enjoy long, become (make, wax) old, spend, waste.

d: **1.** worn out, old
s: From [H1086](H1086); *worn* *out: -* old.

d:
Balah = "waxed old"
**1.** a place in Simeon
s: Feminine of [H1087](H1087); *failure*; *Balah*, a place in Palestine: - Balah.

d: **1.** (Piel) to trouble
s: A primitive root (rather by transposition for [H926](H926)); to *palpitate*; hence (causatively) to *terrify: -* trouble.
o: a primitive root \[rather by transposition for [H926](H926)\]

d:
Bilhah = "troubled"
n pr f
**1.** Rachel's handmaid whom she gave to Jacob as a concubine, mother to two of Jacob's children, Dan and Naphtali
n prloc
**2.** a city in Simeon
s: From [H1089](H1089); *timid*; *Bilhah*, the name of one of Jacob’s concubines; also of a place in Palestine: - Bilhah.

d: **1.** terror, destruction, calamity, dreadful event
s: From [H1089](H1089); *alarm*; hence *destruction: -* terror, trouble.

d:
Bilhan = "their decrepitude"
**1.** a descendant of Esau
**2.** a Benjamite
s: From [H1089](H1089); *timid*; *Bilhan*, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Bilhan.

d: **1.** tribute
s: (Chaldee); from a root coresponding to [H1086](H1086); *excise* (on articles consumed): - tribute.

d: **1.** worn out things, rags
s: From [H1086](H1086); (only in plural construction) *rags: -* old.

d:
Belteshazzar = "lord of the straitened's treasure"
**1.** the 4th of the greater prophets, taken as hostage in the first deportation to Babylon; because of the gift of God of the interpretation of dreams, he became the 2nd in command of the Babylon empire and lasted through the end of the Babylonian empire and into the Persian empire. His prophecies are the key to the understanding of end time events. Noted for his purity and holiness by contemporary prophet, Ezekiel
		**a.** also, 'Daniel' ( H01840 or H01841)
s: Of foreign derivation; *Belteshatstsar*, the Babylonian name of Daniel: - Belteshazzar.

d:
Belteshazzar = "lord of the straitened's treasure"
**1.** the 4th of the greater prophets, taken as hostage in the first deportation to Babylon; because of the gift of God of the interpretation of dreams, he became the 2nd in command of the Babylon empire and lasted through the end of the Babylonian empire and into the Persian empire. His prophecies are the key to the understanding of end time events. Noted for his purity and holiness by contemporary prophet, Ezekiel
		**a.** also, 'Daniel' ( H01840 or H01841)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1095](H1095): - Belteshazzar.

d:
subst
**1.** wearing out
adv of negation
**2.** without, no, not
s: From [H1086](H1086); properly *failure*, that is, *nothing* or *destruction*; usually (with preposition) *without*, *not* *yet*, *because* *not*, *as* *long* *as*, etc.: - corruption, ig\[norantly\], for lack of, where no . . . is, so that no, none, not, un\[awares\], without.

d: **1.** fodder
s: From [H1101](H1101); *mixed*, that is, (specifically) *feed* (for cattle): - corn, fodder, provender.

d: **1.** nothingness
s: From [H1097](H1097) and [H4100](H4100); (as indefinite) *nothing* *whatever: -* nothing.

d:
**1.** worthlessness
		**a.** worthless, good for nothing, unprofitable, base fellow
		**b.** wicked
		**c.** ruin, destruction (construct)
s: From [H1097](H1097) and [H3276](H3276); *without* *profit*, *worthlessness*; by extension *destruction*, *wickedness* (often in connection with [H376](H376), [H802](H802), [H1121](H1121), etc.): - Belial, evil, naughty, ungodly (men), wicked.

d:
**1.** to mix, mingle, confuse, confound
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to mingle, confuse
				**2.** to mix
				**3.** to give provender, feed (animals)
		**b.** (Hithpoel) to mix oneself (among others)
		**c.** (Hiphil) to fade away
s: A primitive root; to *overflow* (specifically with oil); by implication to *mix*; also (denominative from [H1098](H1098)) to *fodder: -* anoint, confound, X fade, mingle, mix (self), give provender, temper.

d: **1.** (Qal) to curb, hold in, restrain
s: A primitive root; to *muzzle: -* be held in.

d: **1.** (Qal) to gather figs, tend sycamore trees
s: A primitive root; to *pinch* sycamore figs (a process necessary to ripen them): - gatherer.

d:
**1.** to swallow down, swallow up, engulf, eat up
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to swallow down
				**2.** to swallow up, engulf
		**b.** (Niphal) to be swallowed up
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to swallow
				**2.** to swallow up, engulf
				**3.** squandering (fig.)
		**d.** (Pual) to be swallowed up
		**e.** (Hithpael) to be ended
s: A primitive root; to *make* *away* *with* (specifically by *swallowing*); generally to *destroy: -* cover, destroy, devour, eat up, be at end, spend up, swallow down (up).

d:
**1.** a swallowing, devouring (fig. for ruin)
**2.** a thing swallowed
s: From [H1104](H1104); a *gulp*; figuratively *destruction: -* devouring, that which he hath swallowed up.

d:
Bela = "destruction"
n pr m
**1.** a king of Edom
**2.** first son of Benjamin
**3.** a son of Ahaz, a Reubenite
n pr loc
**4.** one of the five cities of the plain which was spared at the intercession of Lot, and received the name of Zoar
s: The same as [H1105](H1105); *Bela*, the name of a place, also of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Bela.

d: **1.** apart from, except, without, besides
s: Constructive plural from [H1077](H1077) and [H5703](H5703); *not* *till*, that is, (as preposition or adverb) *except*, *without*, *besides: -* beside, not (in), save, without.

d:
Belaites = "swallowing"
**1.** descendants of Bela
s: Patronymic from [H1106](H1106); a *Belaite* (collectively) or descendant of Bela: - Belaites.

d:
Balaam = "not of the people"
n pr m
**1.** the son of Beor, a man endowed with the gift of prophecy
n pr loc
**2.** a town in Manasseh
s: Probably from [H1077](H1077) and [H5971](H5971); *not* (of the) *people*, that is, *foreigner*; *Bilam*, a Mesopotamian prophet; also a place in Palestine: - Balaam, Bileam.

d:
**1.** to waste, lay waste, devastate
		**a.** (Poel) to make waste
		**b.** (Pual) devastated (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *annihilate: -* (make) waste.

d:
Balak = "devastator"
**1.** a king of Moab who hired Balaam to curse Israel
s: From [H1110](H1110); *waster*; *Balak*, a Moabitish king: - Balak.

d:
Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king"
**1.** king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall
s: Of foreign origin (compare [H1095](H1095)); *Belshatstsar*, a Babylonian king: - Belshazzar.

d:
Belshazzar = "Bel protect the king"
**1.** king of Babylon at the time of its fall; he to whom Daniel interpreted the writing on the wall
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1112](H1112): - Belshazzar.

d:
Bilshan = "in slander"
**1.** an exile who returned with Zerubbabel
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Bilshan*, an Israelite: - Bilshan.

d:
subst
**1.** not, except
adv
**2.** not
**3.** except (after preceding negation)
conj
**4.** except (after an implied or expressed negation)
with prep
**5.** so as not, in order not
**6.** an account of not, because...not
**7.** until not
s: Constructive feminine of [H1086](H1086) (equivalent to [H1097](H1097)); properly a *failure* *of*, that is, (used only as a negative particle, usually with prepositional prefix) *not*, *except*, *without*, *unless*, *besides*, *because* *not*, *until*, etc.: - because un\[satiable\], beside, but, + continual, except, from, lest, neither, no more, none, not, nothing, save, that no, without.

d:
**1.** high place, ridge, height, bamah (technical name for cultic platform)
		**a.** high place, mountain
		**b.** high places, battlefields
		**c.** high places (as places of worship)
		**d.** funeral mound?
s: From an unused root (meaning to *be* *high*); an *elevation: -* height, high place, wave.
o: from an unused root (meaning to be high)

d:
Bamah = "high place"
**1.** a place in Palestine (of places of idolatrous worship)
s: The same as [H1116](H1116); *Bamah*, a place in Palestine: - Bamah. See also [H1120](H1120).

d:
Bimhal = "in circumcision: in weakness (by mixture)"
**1.** a descendant of Asher
s: Probably from [H4107](H4107) with prepositional prefix; *with* *pruning*; *Bimhal*, an Israelite: - Bimhal.

d: **1.** in, at, by
s: Prolonged for prepositional prefix; *in*, *with*, *by*, etc.: - for, in, into, through.

d:
Bamoth = "high places" or "great high place"
**1.** a town on the river Arnon in Moab
s: Plural of [H1116](H1116); *heights*; the second form is a more complete form of the first form; from the same and [H1168](H1168); *heights* *of* *Baal*; *Bamoth* or *Bamoth* *Baal*, a place East of the Jordan: - Bamoth, Bamoth-baal.

d:
**1.** son, grandson, child, member of a group
		**a.** son, male child
		**b.** grandson
		**c.** children (pl. - male and female)
		**d.** youth, young men (pl.)
		**e.** young (of animals)
		**f.** sons (as characterisation, i.e. sons of injustice [for un- righteous men] or sons of God [for angels]
		**g.** people (of a nation) (pl.)
		**h.** of lifeless things, i.e. sparks, stars, arrows (fig.)
		**i.** a member of a guild, order, class
s: From [H1129](H1129); a *son* (as a *builder* of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including *grandson*, *subject*, *nation*, *quality* or *condition*, etc., (like [H1](H1), [H251](H251), etc.): -  + afflicted, age, \[Ahoh-\] \[Ammon-\] \[Hachmon-\] \[Lev-\]ite, \[anoint-\]ed one, appointed to, (+) arrow, \[Assyr-\] \[Babylon-\] \[Egypt-\] \[Grec-\]ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, + (young) bullock, + (young) calf, X came up in, child, colt, X common, X corn, daughter, X of first, + firstborn, foal, + very fruitful, + postage, X in, + kid, + lamb, (+) man, meet, + mighty, + nephew, old, (+) people, + rebel, + robber, X servant born, X soldier, son, + spark, + steward, + stranger, X surely, them of, + tumultuous one, + valiant\[-est\], whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.

d:
Ben = "son"
**1.** a Levite, one of the porters appointed by David for the ark
s: The same as [H1121](H1121); *Ben*, an Israelite: - Ben.

d: **1.** son, child
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1121](H1121): - child, son, young.

d:
**1.** to build
		**a.** (P'al) to build
		**b.** (Ithp'il) to be built
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1129](H1129); to *build: -* build, make.

d:
Ben-Abinadab = "son of Abinadab"
**1.** an officer of Solomon
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H40](H40); (the) *son* *of* *Abinadab*; *Ben* *Abinadab*, an Israelite: - the son of Abinadab.

d:
Ben-oni = "son of my sorrow"
**1.** the name given to Benjamin by Rachel
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H205](H205); *son* *of* *my* *sorrow*; *Ben* *Oni*, the original name of Benjamin: - Ben-oni.

d:
Ben-geber = "the son of Geber" or "the son of a man"
**1.** an officer of Solomon
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H1397](H1397); *son* *of* (the) *hero*; *Ben* *Geber*, an Israelite: - the son of Geber.

d:
Ben-dekar = "son of stabbing" or "son of Dekar"
**1.** an officer of Solomon
s: From [H1121](H1121) and a derivative of [H1856](H1856); *son* *of* *piercing* (or *of* *a* *lance*); *Ben* *Deker*, an Israelite: - the son of Dekar.

d:
**1.** to build, rebuild, establish, cause to continue
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to build, rebuild
				**2.** to build a house (ie, establish a family)
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be built
				**2.** to be rebuilt
				**3.** established (of restored exiles) (fig.)
				**4.** established (made permanent)
				**5.** to be built up (of childless wife becoming the mother of a family through the children of a concubine)
s: A primitive root; to *build* (literally and figuratively): - (begin to) build (-er), obtain children, make, repair, set (up), X surely.

d:
Ben-hadad = "son of [the false god] Hadad"
**1.** the king of Syria, contemporary with Asa of Judah
**2.** the son of Hazael, also king of Syria
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H1908](H1908); *son* *of* *Hadad*; *Ben* *Hadad*, the name of several Syrian kings: - Ben-hadad.

d:
Binnui = "built up"
**1.** an exile returnee with Zerubbabel, son of Henadad, who assisted at the reparation of the wall of Jerusalem, under Nehemiah
**2.** a Levite in time of Ezra, father of Noadiah
**3.** another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife
**4.** still another Levite in time of Ezra, who took a foreign wife
s: From [H1129](H1129); *built* up; *Binnui*, an Israelite: - Binnui.

d:
Ben-zoheth = "son of Zoheth"
**1.** one of the tribe of Judah
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H2105](H2105); *son* *of* *Zocheth*; *Ben* *Zocheth*, an Israelite: - Ben-zoketh.

d:
Ben-hur = "son of whiteness" or "son of Chur"
**1.** a man who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H2354](H2354); *son* *of* *Chur*; *Ben* *Chur*, an Israelite: - the son of Hur.

d:
Ben-hail = "son of strength" or "son (man) of might"
**1.** a ruler (prince) under Jehoshaphat
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H2428](H2428); *son* *of* *might*; *Ben* *Chail*, an Israelite: - Ben-hail.

d:
Ben-hanan = "son of favour"
**1.** one of the tribe of Judah
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H2605](H2605); *son* *of* *Chanan*; *Ben* *Chanan*, an Israelite: - Ben-hanan.

d:
Ben-hesed = "son of mercy"
**1.** an officer of Solomon
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H2617](H2617); *son* *of* *kindness*; *Ben* *Chesed*, an Israelite: - the son of Hesed.

d:
Bani = "built"
**1.** a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors
**2.** a Levite of the line of Merari, and forefather to Ethan
**3.** a man of Judah of the line of Pharez
**4.** "children of Bani" returned from captivity with Zerubbabel
**5.** one or up to three Levites in Nehemiah's time
s: From [H1129](H1129); *built*; *Bani*, the name of five Israelites: - Bani.

d:
Bunni = "built"
**1.** a Levite in the time of Nehemiah
**2.** another Levite of earlier date
s: From [H1129](H1129); *built*; *Bunni* or *Buni*, an Israelite: - Bunni.

d:
Bene-barak = "sons of lightning"
**1.** a city in Dan
s: From the plural construction of [H1121](H1121) and [H1300](H1300); *sons* *of* *lightning*, *Beneberak*, a place in Palestine: - Bene-barak.
o: from the plural construction of [H1121](H1121) and [H1300](H1300)

d: **1.** structure, building
s: Feminine of [H1129](H1129); a *structure: -* building.

d:
Benaiah = "Jehovah has built" or "Yahweh has built up"
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors, son of Jehoiada the chief priest, a Levite, set by David over his bodyguard, later having remained faithful to Solomon during Adonijah's attempt on the crown, was raised into the place of Joab as commander-in-chief of the army
**2.** the Pirathonite, an Ephraimite, one of David's thirty mighty warriors, and the captain of the eleventh monthly course
**3.** a Simeonite, a prince of the families of Simeon
**4.** a Levite in the time of David who played with a psaltery on Alamoth
**5.** a priest in the time of David, appointed to blow the trumpet before the ark
**6.** a Levite of the sons of Asaph
**7.** a Levite in the time of Hezekiah
**8.** Four Israelites in the time of Ezra who had taken strange wives
**9.** the father of Pelatiah
s: From [H1129](H1129) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *built*; *Benajah*, the name of twelve Israelites: - Benaiah.

d:
Bene-jaakan = "sons of twisting"
**1.** an Israelite place of encampment in the wilderness (same as H0885)
s: From the plural of [H1121](H1121) and [H3292](H3292); *sons* *of* *Yaakan*, *Bene* *Jaakan*, a place in the Desert: - Bene-jaakan.

d:
**1.** between, space between two armies
		**a.** man of the space between armies, i.e. champion (of Goliath) (meton)
s: Dual of [H996](H996); a *double* *interval*, that is, the space between two armies: -  + champion.

d:
Benjamin = "son of the right hand"
**1.** Jacob's and Rachel's youngest son, Joseph's full brother
**2.** son of Bilhan, great-grandson of Benjamin
**3.** a Benjamite, one of the sons of Harim, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
**4.** the tribe descended from Benjamin, the son of Jacob
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H3225](H3225); *son* *of* (the) *right* *hand*; *Binjamin*, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory: - Benjamin.

d:
Benjamite = "a son of the right hand"
**1.** one of the tribe of Benjamin
s: Multiple forms. Sometimes (with the article inserted); with [H376](H376) inserted (1Sa 9:1); *son* *of* *a* *man* *of* *Jemini*; or shorter (1Sa 9:4; Est 2:5); *a* *man* *of* *Jemini*; or (1Sa 20:1); more simply: *a* *Jeminite*; (plural patronymic from [H1144](H1144); a *Benjaminite*, or descendant of Benjamin: - Benjamite, of Benjamin.
o: sometimes (with article inserted) Ben-ha-y@miniy ben-hah-yem-ee-nee’with [H376](H376) inserted ([H1](H1)>1) Sa [H9](H9):1) Ben-’iysh Y@miyniy ben-eesh’ yem-ee-nee’

d: **1.** structure, building
s: From [H1129](H1129); an *edifice: -* building.

d: **1.** a building, structure
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1146](H1146): - building.

d:
Beninu = "our son"
**1.** a returning Levite exile who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: Probably from [H1121](H1121) with pronominal suffix; *our* *son*; *Beninu*, an Israelite: - Beninu.

d: **1.** (P'al) to be angry
s: (Chaldee); of uncertain affinity; to *be* *enraged: -* be angry.

d:
Binea or Bineah = fountain
**1.** a descendant of Jonathan
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Bina* or *Binah*, an Israelite: - Binea, Bineah.

d:
Ben-ami = "son of my people"
**1.** son of Lot, born to his second daughter, progenitor of the Ammonites
s: From [H1121](H1121) and [H5971](H5971) with pronominal suffix; *son* *of* *my* *people*; *Ben* *Ammi*, a son of Lot: - Ben-ammi.

d:
Besodeiah = "with the counsel of Jehovah" or "in the secret of the Lord"
**1.** father of one of the repairers of the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
s: From [H5475](H5475) and [H3050](H3050) with prepositional prefix; *in* (the) *counsel* *of* *Jehovah*; *Besodejah*, an Israelite: - Besodeiah.

d:
Besai = "my treading"
**1.** a temple slave (or group of slaves) who returned with Zerubbabel
s: From [H947](H947); *domineering*; *Besai*, one of the Nethinim: - Besai.

d: **1.** unripe or sour grapes
s: From an unused root meaning to *be* *sour*; an *immature* grape: - unripe grape.
o: from an unused root meaning to be sour

d: **1.** unripe grapes, sour grapes
s: From the same as [H1154](H1154): - sour grape.

d:
**1.** to ask, seek, request, desire, pray, make petition
		**a.** (P'al)
				**1.** to ask, request
				**2.** to seek (for favour)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1158](H1158); to *seek* or *ask: -* ask, desire, make \[petition\], pray, request, seek.

d:
**1.** behind, through, round about, on behalf of, away from, about
		**a.** through (of action)
		**b.** behind (with verbs of shutting)
		**c.** about (with verbs of fencing)
		**d.** on behalf of (metaph. especially with Hithpael)
s: From [H5704](H5704) with prepositional prefix; *in* *up* *to* or *over* *against*; generally *at*, *beside*, *among*, *behind*, *for*, etc.: - about, at, by (means of), for, over, through, up (-on), within.

d:
**1.** to seek out, swell, cause to swell, boil up, enquire
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to seek, enquire
				**2.** to cause to boil up
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be searched out
				**2.** to be swelling, bulging, swelling out
s: A primitive root; to *gush* over, that is, to *swell*; (figuratively) to *desire* earnestly; by implication to *ask: -* cause, inquire, seek up, swell out, boil.

d:
**1.** petition, request
**2.** prayer (always in Jewish liturgy)
s: (Chaldee); from [H1156](H1156); a *request: -* petition.

d:
Beor = "burning"
**1.** father of Balaam
**2.** father of Bela, king of Edom
s: From [H1197](H1197) (in the sense of *burning*); a *lamp*; *Beor*, the name of the father of an Edomitish king; also of that of Balaam: - Beor.

d: **1.** terrors, alarms (occasioned by God)
s: Masculine plural from [H1204](H1204); *alarms: -* terrors.

d:
Boaz = "fleetness"
**1.** ancestor of David, kinsman-redeemer to Ruth, daughter-in-law of Naomi
**2.** name of the left of two brazen pillars, 18 cubits high, erected in the porch of Solomon's temple
s: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; *Boaz*, the ancestor of David; also the name of a pillar in front of the temple: - Boaz.
o: from an unused root of uncertain meaning

d:
**1.** to kick, kick at
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to kick
				**2.** to kick at
				**3.** to desire (fig.)
s: A primitive root; to *trample* down, that is, (figuratively) *despise: -* kick.

d: **1.** ruin, heap of ruins
s: From [H1158](H1158); a *prayer: -* grave.

d: **1.** beasts, cattle
s: From [H1197](H1197) (in the sense of *eating*): cattle: - beast, cattle.

d:
**1.** to marry, rule over, possess, own
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to marry, be lord (husband) over
				**2.** to rule over
		**b.** (Niphal) to be married
s: A primitive root; to *be* *master*; hence (as denominative from [H1167](H1167)) to *marry: -* Beulah have dominion (over), be husband, marry (-ried, X wife).

d:
**1.** owner, husband, lord
		**a.** owner
		**b.** a husband
		**c.** citizens, inhabitants
		**d.** rulers, lords
		**e.** (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams)
		**f.** lord (used of foreign gods)
s: From [H1166](H1166); a *master*; hence a *husband*, or (figuratively) *owner* (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense: -  + archer, + babbler, + bird, captain, chief man, + confederate, + have to do, + dreamer, those to whom it is due, + furious, those that are given to it, great, + hairy, he that hath it, have, + horseman, husband, lord, man, + married, master, person, + sworn, they of.

d:
Baal = "lord"
n pr m
**1.** supreme male divinity of the Phoenicians or Canaanites
**2.** a Reubenite
**3.** the son of Jehiel and grandfather of Saul
n pr loc
**4.** a town of Simeon, probably identical to Baalath-beer
s: The same as [H1167](H1167); *Baal*, a Phoenician deity: - Baal, \[plural\] Baalim.

d: **1.** owner, lord
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1167](H1167): -  + chancellor.

d:
Baal-berith = "lord of the covenant"
**1.** a god of the Philistines
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H1285](H1285); *Baal* *of* (the) *covenant*; *Baal* *Berith*, a special deity of the Shechemites: - Baal-berith.

d:
Baal-gad = "lord of fortune"
**1.** a city noted for Baal-worship, located at the most northern or northwestern point to which Joshua's victories extended
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H1409](H1409); *Baal* *of* *Fortune*; *Baal* *Gad*, a place in Syria: - Baal-gad.

d:
**1.** mistress, female owner
**2.** sorceress, necromancer (noun of relationship)
s: Feminine of [H1167](H1167); a *mistress: -* that hath, mistress.

d:
Baalah = "mistress"
**1.** another name for Kirjath-jearim or Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab
**2.** a town in the south of Judah, also called Balah and Bilhah
s: The same as [H1172](H1172); *Baalah*, the name of three places in Palestine: - Baalah.

d:
Baal-hamon = "lord (possessor) of abundance"
**1.** the site of Solomon's vineyard
s: From [H1167](H1167) and [H1995](H1995); *possessor* *of* *a* *multitude*; *Baal* *Hamon*, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hamon.

d:
Baalath or Bealoth = "mistresses"
**1.** a town in south Judah
s: Plural of [H1172](H1172); *mistresses*; *Bealoth*, a place in Palestine: - Bealoth, in Aloth \[by mistake for a plural from [H5927](H5927) with preposition prefix\].

d:
Baal-zebub = "lord of the fly"
**1.** a Philistine deity worshipped at Ekron
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H2070](H2070); *Baal* *of* (the) *Fly*; *Baal* *Zebub*, a special deity of the Ekronites: - Baal-zebub.

d:
Baal-hanan = "Baal is gracious"
**1.** an early king of Edom
**2.** one of David's officers, a Gederite, who had the superintendence of his olive and sycamore plantations
s: From [H1167](H1167) and [H2608](H2608); *possessor* *of* *grace*; *Baal* *Chanan*, the name of an Edomite, also of an Israelite: - Baal-hanan.

d:
Baal-hazor = "lord of the village"
**1.** a town on the border between Ephraim and Benjamin, apparent location of a sheep farm of Absalom and location of Amnon's murder
s: From [H1167](H1167) and a modification of [H2691](H2691); *possessor* *of* *a* *village*; *Baal* *Chatsor*, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hazor.

d:
Baal-hermon or Baal-chermon = "lord of destruction"
**1.** a city near or on Mount Hermon, named as a seat of Baal worship
s: From [H1167](H1167) and [H2768](H2768); *possessor* *of* *Hermon*; *Baal* *Chermon*, a place in Palestine: - Baal-hermon.

d:
Baali = "my lord"
**1.** a deity in the northern kingdom, variation of the name 'Baal'
s: From [H1167](H1167) with pronominal suffix; *my* *master*; *Baali*, a symbolical name of Jehovah: - Baali.

d:
Baale-bamoth = "the lords of the high places"
**1.** the people of Arnon, east of Jordan
s: From the plural of [H1168](H1168) and the plural of [H1116](H1116); *Baals* *of* (the) *heights*; *Baale* *Bamoth*, a place East of the Jordan: - lords of the high places.
o: from the pl. of [H1168](H1168) and the pl. of [H1116](H1116)

d:
Beeliada = "the lord knows"
**1.** a son of David, born in Jerusalem, elsewhere named 'Eliada'
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H3045](H3045); *Baal* *has* *known*; *Beeljada*, an Israelite: - Beeliada.

d:
Bealiah = "Jehovah is master"
**1.** a Benjamite who went over to David at Ziklag and was one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H1167](H1167) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* (is) *master*; *Bealjah*, an Israelite: - Bealiah.

d:
Baale-Judah = "the lords of Judah"
**1.** a place in Judah named for the Baalim, also known as Kirjath-jearim, Kirjath-baal; modern Kuriet el Enab
s: From the plural of [H1167](H1167) and [H3063](H3063); *masters* *of* *Judah*; *Baale* *Jehudah*, a place in Palestine: - Baale of Judah.

d:
Baalis = "lord of the banner: in causing the joy"
**1.** king of the Ammonites at the time of the destruction of Jerusalem by Nebuchadnezzar
s: Probably from a derivative of [H5965](H5965) with prepositional prefix; *in* *exultation*; *Baalis*, an Ammonitish king: - Baalis.
o: probably from a derivative of [H5965](H5965) with prepositional prefix

d:
Baal-meon = "lord of the habitation"
**1.** a town in Reuben, mentioned in connection with Nebo, and in the time of Ezekiel, Moabite
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H4583](H4583); *Baal* *of* (the) *habitation* (of) (compare [H1010](H1010)); *Baal* *Meon*, a place East of the Jordan: - Baal-meon.

d:
Baal-peor = "lord of the gap"
**1.** the deity worshipped at Peor with probable licentious rites
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H6465](H6465); *Baal* *of* *Peor*; *Baal* *Peor*, a Moabitish deity: - Baal-peor.

d:
Baal-perazim = "lord of the breaks"
**1.** the site of a victory of David over the Philistines, and of a great destruction of their images; also called 'Mount Perazim'
s: From [H1167](H1167) and the plural of [H6556](H6556); *possessor* *of* *breaches*; *Baal* *peratsim*, a place in Palestine: - Baal-perazim.

d:
Baal Tsphon or Baal-zephon = "lord of the north"
**1.** a place in Egypt near the Red Sea where Pharaoh and his army were destroyed during the Exodus
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H6828](H6828) (in the sense of *cold*) (according to others as Egyptian form of *Typhon*, the destroyer); *Baal* *of* *winter*; *Baal* *Tsephon*, a place in Egypt: - Baal-zephon.

d:
Baal-shalisha = "thrice-great lord"
**1.** a place in Ephraim near Gilgal
s: From [H1168](H1168) and [H8031](H8031); *Baal* *of* *Shalishah*; *Baal* *Shalishah*, a place in Palestine: - Baal-shalisha.

d:
Baalath = "mistress"
**1.** a town in Dan
s: A modification of [H1172](H1172); *mistresship*; *Baalath*, a place in Palestine: - Baalath.

d:
Baalath-beer = "mistress of the well"
**1.** a town in the south part of Judah, given to Simeon, which also bore the name of 'Ramath-negeb'
s: From [H1172](H1172) and [H875](H875); *mistress* *of* *a* *well*; *Baalath* *Beer*, a place in Palestine: - Baalath-beer.

d:
Baal-tamar = "lord of the palms"
**1.** a place near Gibeah in Benjamin
s: From [H1167](H1167) and [H8558](H8558); *possessor* *of* (the) *palm* *tree*; *Baal* *Tamar*, a place in Palestine: - Baal-tamar.

d:
Beon = "in the dwelling: indwelling"
**1.** a place or city in Reuben
s: Probably a contraction of [H1010](H1010); *Beon*, a place East of the Jordan: - Beon.

d:
Baana or Baanah = "in the affliction"
**1.** the son of Ahilud, Solomon's commissariat officer in Jezreel and the north of the Jordan valley
**2.** another of Solomon's officers
**3.** father of Zadok who assisted in rebuilding the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah
s: The same as [H1196](H1196); *Baana*, the name of four Israelites: - Baana, Baanah.

d:
Baana or Baanah = "in affliction"
**1.** a Benjamite, son Rimmon, who with his brother Rechab murdered Ish-bosheth. For this, killed by David, mutilated bodies hung up over the pool at Hebron
**2.** a Netophathite, father of Heleb or Heled, one of David's mighty warriors
**3.** the head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
**4.** a chief of the people
s: From a derivative of [H6031](H6031) with prepositional prefix; *in* *affliction: -* Baanah, the name of four Isr: - Baanah.
o: from a derivative of [H6031](H6031) with prepositional prefix

d:
**1.** to burn, consume, kindle, be kindled
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to begin to burn, be kindled, start burning
				**2.** to burn, be burning
				**3.** to burn, consume
				**4.** Jehovah's wrath, human wrath (fig.)
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to kindle, burn
				**2.** to consume, remove (of guilt) (fig.)
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to kindle
				**2.** to burn up
				**3.** to consume (destroy)
		**d.** (Pual) to burn

**2.** to be stupid, brutish, barbarous
		**a.** (Qal) to be stupid, dull-hearted, unreceptive
		**b.** (Niphal) to be stupid, dull-hearted
		**c.** (Piel) to feed, graze
		**d.** (Hiphil) to cause to be grazed over
s: A primitive root; to *kindle*, that is, *consume* (by fire or by eating); also (as denominative from [H1198](H1198)) to *be* (*become*) *brutish: -* be brutish, bring (put, take) away, burn, (cause to) eat (up), feed, heat, kindle, set (\[on fire\]), waste.

d: **1.** brutishness, stupidity, brutish (person)
s: From [H1197](H1197); properly *food* (as *consumed*); that is, (be extension) of cattle *brutishness*; (concretely) *stupid: -* brutish (person), foolish.

d:
Baara = "brutish"
**1.** one of the wives of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
s: From [H1198](H1198); *brutish*; *Baara*, an Israelitish woman: - Baara.

d: **1.** burning, fire
s: From [H1197](H1197); a *burning: -* fire.

d:
Baasha = "wicked"
**1.** third king of the northern kingdom of Israel and the founder of its second dynasty having killed the second king, Nadab
s: From an unused root meaning to *stink*; *offensiveness*; *Basha*, a king of Israel: - Baasha.
o: from an unused root meaning to stink

d:
Baaseiah = "in the service of Jehovah"
**1.** a Gershonite Levite, one of the forefathers of Asaph the singer
s: From [H6213](H6213) and [H3050](H3050) with prepositional prefix; *in* (the) *work* *of* *Jah*; *Baasejah*, an Israelite: - Baaseiah.
o: from [H6213](H6213) and [H3050](H3050) with a prepositional prefix

d:
Beeshterah = "with increase"
**1.** a Levitical city in Manasseh, east of the Jordan; probably identical with 'Ashtaroth'
s: From [H6251](H6251) (as singular of [H6252](H6252)) with prepositional prefix; *with* *Ashtoreth*; *Beeshterah*, a place East of the Jordan: - Beeshterah.
o: from [H6251](H6251) (as sing. of [H6252](H6252)) with a prepositional prefix

d:
**1.** to terrify, startle, fall upon, dismay, be overtaken by sudden terror
		**a.** (Niphal) to be terrified
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to fall upon, overwhelm
				**2.** to terrify
s: A primitive root; to *fear: -* affright, be (make) afraid, terrify, trouble.

d: **1.** terror, dismay
s: From [H1204](H1204); *fear: -* trouble.

d: **1.** mire
s: Probably the same as [H948](H948); *mud* (as *whitish* clay): - mire.

d: **1.** swamp, marsh
s: Intensive from [H1206](H1206); a *swamp: -* fen. mire (-ry place).

d:
**1.** vintage
**2.** (CLBL) inaccessible
s: From [H1219](H1219); *inaccessible*, that is, *lofty: -* vintage \[by confusion with [H1210](H1210)\].

d:
Bezai = "conqueror"
**1.** a chief of the returning exiles in the time of Ezra
s: Perhaps the same as [H1153](H1153); *Betsai*, the name of two Israelites: - Bezai.

d: **1.** vintage
s: From [H1219](H1219); *clipped*, that is, the *grape* *crop: -* vintage.

d: **1.** onion
s: From an unused root apparently meaning to *peel*; an *onion: -* onion.
o: from an unused root apparently meaning to peel

d:
Bezaleel = "in the shadow (i.e. protection) of God"
**1.** son of Uri and grandson of Hur; a skilled Judahite artisan in all works of metal, wood, and stone and one of the architects of the tabernacle
**2.** an Israelite, one of the sons of Pahath-moab, in the time of Ezra who had taken a strange wife
s: Probably from [H6738](H6738) and [H410](H410) with prepositional prefix; *in* (the) *shadow* (that is, protection) *of* *God*; *Betsalel*; the name of two Israelites: - Bezaleel.
o: probably from [H6738](H6738) and [H410](H410) with a prepositional prefix

d:
Bazlith or Bazluth = "asking"
**1.** a head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
s: From the same as [H1211](H1211); a *peeling*; *Batsluth* or *Batslith*; an Israelite: - Bazlith, Bazluth.

d:
**1.** to cut off, break off, gain by unrighteous violence, get, finish, be covetous, be greedy
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to cut off
				**2.** to stop
				**3.** to gain wrongfully or by violence
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to cut off, sever
				**2.** to finish, complete, accomplish
				**3.** to violently make gain of
s: A primitive root to *break* off, that is, (usually) *plunder*; figuratively to *finish*, or (intransitively) *stop: -* (be) covet (-ous), cut (off), finish, fulfill, gain (greedily), get, be given to \[covetousness\], greedy, perform, be wounded.

d: **1.** profit, unjust gain, gain (profit) acquired by violence
s: From [H1214](H1214); *plunder*; by extension *gain* (usually unjust): - covetousness, (dishonest) gain, lucre, profit.

d: **1.** (Qal) to swell, become blistered
s: A primitive root; perhaps to *swell* up, that is, *blister: -* swell.

d: **1.** dough (unleavened)
s: From [H1216](H1216); *dough* (as *swelling* by fermentation): - dough, flour.

d:
Bozkath or Boscath = "rocky height"
**1.** a city in Judah in the lowlands toward the Philistines, home of Josiah's mother
s: From [H1216](H1216); a *swell* of ground; *Botscath*, a place in Palestine: - Bozcath, Boskath.

d:
**1.** to gather, restrain, fence, fortify, make inaccessible, enclose
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to cut off
				**2.** fortified, cut off, made inaccessible (pass participle)
				**3.** secrets, mysteries, inaccessible things (subst)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be withheld
		**c.** (Piel) to fortify
s: A primitive root; to *clip* off; specifically (as denominative from [H1210](H1210)) to *gather* grapes; also to *be* *isolated* (that is, *inaccessible* by height or fortification): - cut off, (de-) fenced, fortify, (grape) gather (-er), mighty things, restrain, strong, wall (up), withhold.

d: **1.** gold, precious ore, ring-gold
s: From [H1219](H1219); strictly a *clipping*, that is, *gold* (as *dug* out): - gold defence.

d:
Bezer = "gold ore" or "remote fortress"
n pr m
**1.** son of Zophah, one of the heads of the houses of Asher
n pr loc
**2.** a city of refuge in Reuben in the downs on the east of the Jordan
s: The same as [H1220](H1220); an *inaccessible* spot; *Betser*, a place in Palestine: - Bezer.

d: **1.** precious ore, gold, ring-gold
s: Another form for [H1220](H1220); *gold: -* gold.

d: **1.** enclosure, fold, sheepfold (AV-Bozrah)
s: Feminine from [H1219](H1219); an *enclosure*, that is, *sheepfold: -* Bozrah.

d:
Bozrah = "sheepfold" or "fortress"
**1.** a town in Edom
**2.** a town in Moab
s: The same as [H1223](H1223); *Botsrah*, a place in Edom: - Bozrah.

d: **1.** stronghold
s: Masculine intensive from [H1219](H1219); a *fortress: -* stronghold.

d: **1.** dearth, drought, destitution
s: Feminine intensive from [H1219](H1219); *restraint* (of rain), that is, *drought: -* dearth, drought.

d:
Bakbuk = "bottle"
**1.** a head of a family of temple-slaves returning from exile with Zerubbabel
s: The same as [H1228](H1228); *Bakbuk*, one of the *Nethinim: -* Bakbuk.

d: **1.** flask, bottle
s: From [H1238](H1238); a *bottle* (from the gurgling in *emptying*): - bottle, cruse.

d:
Bakbukiah = "wasting of Jehovah"
**1.** a Levite in the time of Nehemiah
s: From [H1228](H1228) and [H3050](H3050); *emptying* (that is, *wasting*) *of* *Jah*; *Bakbukjah*, an Israelite: - Bakbukiah.

d:
Bakbakkar = "searcher"
**1.** a Levite, apparently a descendant of Asaph
s: Reduplicated from [H1239](H1239); *searcher*; *Bakbakkar*, an Israelite: - Bakbakkar.

d:
Bukki = "wasting"
**1.** son of Abishua and father of Uzzi, fifth from Aaron in the line of the high priests
**2.** son of Jogli, prince of the tribe of Dan, one of the ten men chosen to apportion the land of Canaan between the tribes
s: From [H1238](H1238); *wasteful*; *Bukki*, the name of two Israelites: - Bukki.

d:
Bukkiah = "Jehovah has emptied"
**1.** a Kohathite Levite, of the sons of Heman, one of the musicians in the temple
s: From [H1238](H1238) and [H3050](H3050); *wasting* *of* *Jah*; *Bukkijah*, an Israelite: - Bukkiah.

d:

d:

d:
**1.** to empty

		**c.** (Polel) to empty out, devastate
s: A primitive root; to *pour* out, that is, to *empty*, figuratively to *depopulate*; by analogy to *spread* out (as a fruitful vine): - (make) empty (out), fail, X utterly, make void.

d:

d:

		**b.** (Ithpael) to let search be made
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H1239](H1239): - inquire, make search.

d:

d:

d:

s: From [H1245](H1245); a *petition: -* request.

d:

		**a.** (Hiphil) to make yourselves fat
s: A primitive root; (absolutely) to *create*; (qualified) to *cut* down (a wood), *select*, *feed* (as formative processes): - choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).

d:
Berodach-baladan = "worshipper of Baal"

s: A variation of [H4757](H4757); *Berodak* *Baladan*, a Babylonian king: - Berodach-baladan.

d:
Beraiah = "Jehovah has created"
**1.** son of Shimhi, a chief man of Benjamin
s: From [H1254](H1254) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *created*; *Berajah*, an Israelite: - Beraiah.

d:

d:

d:

d:

d:
**1.** to grow, become great or important, promote, make powerful, praise, magnify, do great things
		**a.** (Qal)

				**2.** to become great
				**3.** to be magnified
		**b.** (Piel)

				**2.** to make great, powerful

		**c.** (Pual) to be brought up

				**2.** to magnify

d:

d:

		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to gird
				**2.** to gird on, bind on
				**3.** to gird oneself
s: A primitive root; to *gird* on (as a belt, armor, etc.): - be able to put on, be afraid, appointed, gird, restrain, X on every side.

d: **1.** one (number), same, single, first, each, once
s: Abridged from [H259](H259); *one: -* one.

d:
**1.** one (number)
		**a.** one
		**b.** a (indefinite article)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2297](H2297); as cardinal *one*; as article *single*; as ordinal *first*; adverbially *at* *once: -* a, first, one, together.

d: **1.** sharp
s: From [H2300](H2300); *sharp: -* sharp.

d:
**1.** to be sharp, be alert, be keen
		**a.** (Qal) to be sharp, be keen
		**b.** (Hiphil) to sharpen
		**c.** (Hophal) to be sharpened
s: A primitive root; to *be* (causatively *make*) *sharp* or (figuratively) *severe: -* be fierce, sharpen.

d:
Hadad = "mighty"
**1.** a son of Ishmael
s: From [H2300](H2300); *fierce*; *Chadad*, an Ishmaelite: - Hadad.

d:
**1.** to rejoice
		**a.** (Qal) to rejoice
		**b.** (Piel) to make glad, gladden
s: A primitive root; to *rejoice: -* make glad, be joined, rejoice.

d: **1.** sharp, pointed, sharpened
s: From [H2300](H2300); a *point: -* sharp.

d: **1.** joy, gladness
s: From [H2302](H2302); *rejoicing: -* gladness, joy.
(Chaldee); corresponding to [H2304](H2304): - joy.

d: **1.** breast, chest
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2373](H2373)*;* a *breast:* - breast.

d:
Hadid = "sharp"
**1.** a town in Benjamin
s: From [H2300](H2300); a *peak*; *Chadid*, a place in Palestine: - Hadid.

d:

		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to cease, come to an end
				**2.** to cease, leave off
s: A primitive root; properly to *be* *flabby*, that is, (by implication) *desist*; (figuratively) *be* *lacking* or *idle: -* cease, end, fail, forbear, forsake, leave (off), let alone, rest, be unoccupied, want.

d: **1.** rest, cessation
s: From [H2308](H2308); *rest*, that is, the state of the *dead: -* world.

d: **1.** rejected, forbearing, transient, fleeting, lacking
s: From [H2308](H2308); *vacant*, that is, *ceasing* or *destitute: -* he that forbeareth, frail, rejected.

d:
Hadlai = "rest of God"
**1.** an Ephraimite
s: From [H2309](H2309); *idle*; *Chadlai*, an Israelite: - Hadlai.

d: **1.** brier, thorn, prick
s: From an unused root meaning to *sting*; a *prickly* plant: - brier, thorn.
o: from an unused root meaning to sting

d:
Hiddekel = "rapid"

d: **1.** chamber, room, parlour, innermost or inward part, within
s: From [H2314](H2314); an *apartment* (usually literally): - (\[bed\] inner) chamber, innermost (-ward) part, parlour, + south, X within.

d:
Hadar = "honour"
**1.** an Edomite king
s: Another form for [H2315](H2315); *chamber*; *Chadar*, an Ishmaelite: - Hadar.

d:
Hadrach = "dwelling"
**1.** a city of Syria (mod Lebanon)
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Chadrak*, a Syrian deity: - Hadrach.

d:
**1.** to be new, renew, repair
		**a.** (Piel)

				**2.** to repair

s: A primitive root; to *be* *new*; causatively to *rebuild: -* renew, repair.

d: **1.** new, new thing, fresh
s: From [H2318](H2318); *new: -* fresh, new thing.

d:
**1.** the new moon, month, monthly
		**a.** the first day of the month
		**b.** the lunar month
s: From [H2318](H2318); the *new* moon; by implication a *month: -* month (-ly), new moon.

d:
Hodesh = "new moon"
**1.** the wife of Shaharaim, a Benjamite
s: The same as [H2320](H2320); *Chodesh*, an Israelitess: - Hodesh.

d:
Hadashah = "new"
**1.** one of the towns in the low country of Judah
s: Feminine of [H2319](H2319); *new*; *Chadashah*, a place in Palestine: - Hadashah.
(Chaldee); corresponding to [H2319](H2319); *new: -* new.

d:
**1.** to show, interpret, explain, inform, tell, declare
		**a.** (Pael) to show, interpret
		**b.** (Aphel) to show
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2331](H2331); to *show: -* shew.

d:
**1.** to be guilty, make guilty
		**a.** (Piel) to endanger
s: A primitive root; properly perhaps to *tie*, that is, (figuratively and reflexively) to *owe*, or (by implication) to *forfeit: -* make endanger.

d: **1.** a debt, debtor
s: From [H2235](H2235); *debt: -* debtor.

d:
Hobah = "hiding place"
**1.** a city north of Damascus to which Abraham pursued the kings who had pillaged Sodom
s: Feminine active participle of [H2247](H2247); *hiding* *place*; *Chobah*, a place in Syria: - Hobah.

d:
**1.** to encircle, encompass, describe a circle, draw round, make a circle
		**a.** (Qal) to encircle, encompass
s: A primitive root (compare [H2287](H2287)); to describe a *circle: -* compassive

d:
**1.** circle, circuit, compass

s: From [H2328](H2328); a *circle: -* circle, circuit, compassive

d: **1.** (Qal) to propose a riddle, propound a riddle
s: A primitive root; properly to *tie* a knot, that is, (figuratively) to *propound* a riddle: - put forth.

d:
**1.** (Piel) to tell, declare, show, make known
**2.** (CLBL) to breath
s: A primitive root; (compare [H2324](H2324), [H2421](H2421)); properly to *live*; by implication (intensively) to *declare* or *show: -* show.

d:
Eve = "life" or "living"
**1.** the first woman, wife of Adam
s: Causative from [H2331](H2331); *lifegiver*; *Chavvah* (or Eve), the first woman: - Eve.

d: **1.** village, town, tent village
s: Properly the same as [H2332](H2332) (*lifegiving*, that is, *living* *place*); by implication an encampment or *village: -* (small) town.
o: properly, the same as [H2332](H2332) (life-giving, i.e. living-place)

d:
Havoth-jair = "villages of Jair"
**1.** certain villages on the east of Jordan, in Gilead or Bashan, which were taken by Jair, the son of Manasseh, and called after his name; 60 or 23 or 30 cities in total
s: From the plural of [H2333](H2333) and a modification of [H3265](H3265); *hamlets* *of* *Jair*, a region of Palestine: - \[Bashan-\] Havoth-jair.
o: from the plural of [H2333](H2333) and a modification of [H3265](H3265)

d:

d:

o: from an unused root apparently meaning to pierce

d: **1.** rock, crevice (a hiding place)
s: Perhaps the same as [H2336](H2336); a *dell* or *crevice* (as if *pierced* in the earth): - thicket.

s: (Chaldee); corresponding to the root of [H2339](H2339), perhaps as a denominative; to *string* together, that is, (figuratively) to *repair: -* join.
o: corresponding to the root of [H2339](H2339), perhaps as a denominative

d: **1.** a thread, cord, line, string
s: From an unused root probably meaning to *sew*; a *string*; by implication a measuring *tape: -* cord, fillet, line, thread.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to sew

d:

s: Perhaps from [H2333](H2333); a *villager*; a *Chivvite*, one of the aboriginal tribes of Palestine: - Hivite.

n pr m
**3.** a son of Cush
**4.** a son of Joktan
s: Probably from [H2342](H2342); *circular*; *Chavilah*, the name of two or three eastern regions; also perhaps of two men: - Havilah.

d:
**1.** to twist, whirl, dance, writhe, fear, tremble, travail, be in anguish, be pained
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to dance
				**2.** to twist, writhe
				**3.** to whirl, whirl about
		**b.** (Polel)
				**1.** to dance
				**2.** to writhe (in travail with), bear, bring forth
				**3.** to wait anxiously
		**c.** (Pulal)
				**1.** to be made to writhe, be made to bear
				**2.** to be brought forth
		**d.** (Hophal) to be born
		**e.** (Hithpolel)
				**1.** whirling (participle)
				**2.** writhing, suffering torture (participle)
				**3.** to wait longingly
		**f.** (Hithpalpel) to be distressed
s: A primitive root; properly to *twist* or *whirl* (in a circular or spiral manner), that is, (specifically) to *dance*, to *writhe* in pain (especially of parturition) or fear; figuratively to *wait*, to *pervert: -* bear, (make to) bring forth, (make to) calve, dance, drive away, fall grievously (with pain), fear, form, great, grieve, (be) grievous, hope, look, make, be in pain, be much (sore) pained, rest, shake, shapen, (be) sorrow (-ful), stay, tarry, travail (with pain), tremble, trust, wait carefully (patiently), be wounded.

d:
Hul = "circle"
**1.** the second son of Aram and grandson of Shem
s: From [H2342](H2342); a *circle*; *Chul*, a son of Aram; also the region settled by him: - Hul.

s: From [H2342](H2342); *sand* (as *round* or whirling particles): - sand.

s: From an unused root meaning to *cover*; a *cove* (as a *sheltered* bay): - coast \[of the sea\], haven, shore, \[sea-\] side.
o: from an unused root meaning to cover

d:
Hupham = "coast-man"

d:

**1.** descendants of Hupham of the tribe of Benjamin
s: Patronymic from [H2349](H2349); a *Chuphamite* or descendant of Chupham: - Huphamites.

o: (both forms fem. in the pl.) from an unused root meaning to sever

d: **1.** hole

o: from an unused root probably meaning to bore

**5.** father of Ben-Hur who was commissariat officer for Solomon in Mount Ephraim

s: The same as [H2352](H2352); a *cavity*, *socket*, *den: -* cave, hole.

**3.** a chief architect of Solomon's temple; alternate spelling for 'Hiram'
