Hushim = "who makes haste"

n pr m

d:
Husham = "haste"

s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2372](H2372); to *gaze* upon; mentally to *dream*, *be* *usual* (that is, *seem*): - behold, have \[a dream\], see, be wont.

d:

d:

		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to see, behold
				**2.** to see as a seer in the ecstatic state
				**3.** to see, perceive
						**a.** with the intelligence
						**b.** to see (by experience)
						**c.** to provide

d: **1.** breast (of animals), breast of an animal sacrifice

**1.** seer

		**b.** vision

Hazo = "vision"

		**a.** vision
		**b.** appearance

		**b.** vision (in night)
		**c.** vision, oracle, prophecy (divine communication)
		**d.** vision (as title of book of prophecy)
s: From [H2372](H2372); a *sight* (mentally), that is, a *dream*, *revelation*, or *oracle: -* vision.

d: **1.** visions
s: From [H2372](H2372); a *revelation: -* vision.

d: **1.** view, sight, visibility
s: (Chaldee); from [H2370](H2370); a *view: -* sight.

d:
**1.** vision, conspicuousness
		**a.** vision, oracle of a prophet
				**1.** agreement
		**b.** conspicuousness in appearance
s: From [H2372](H2372); a *look*; hence (figuratively) striking *appearance*, *revelation* or (by implication) *compact: -* agreement, notable (one), vision.

d:
Haziel = "vision of God"
**1.** a Levite of the family of Shimei of the Gershonites in the time of David or Solomon
s: From [H2371](H2371) and [H410](H410); *seen* *of* *God*; *Chaziel*, a Levite: - Haziel.

d:
Hazaiah = "God has seen"
**1.** an exile and descendant of Shelah of the tribe of Judah who returned in the time of Nehemiah
s: From [H2372](H2372) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *seen*; *Chazajah*, an Israelite: - Hazaiah.

d:
Hezion = "vision"
**1.** king of Syria, father of Tabrimon and grandfather of Ben-hadad; probably identical with 'Rezon' the contemporary of Solomon

d:
**1.** vision

		**b.** vision (in the night)
		**c.** vision, oracle, prophecy (in divine communication)
s: From [H2372](H2372); a *revelation*, especially by *dream: -* vision.

d: **1.** thunderbolt, lightning flash, lightning, storm, cloud

o: from an unused root meaning to glare

d:
**1.** hog, swine, boar
		**a.** swine (as forbidden food)
		**b.** wild boar

o: from an unused root probably meaning to enclose

Hezir = "swine"

**2.** one of the heads of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: From the same as [H2386](H2386); perhaps *protected*; *Chezir*, the name of two Israelites: - Hezir.

						**e.** to be severe, be grievous

				**6.** to make rigid, make hard

				**2.** firm, hard

d: **1.** strength

d: **1.** strength
s: From [H2388](H2388); *power: -* strength.

d: **1.** strength, strong, being strong, force
s: Feminine of [H2391](H2391); prevailing *power: -* strength (-en self), (was) strong.

d: **1.** force, might, strength, violence
s: Feminine of [H2392](H2392); *vehemence* (usually in a bad sense): - force, mightily, repair, sharply.

d:
Hezekiah or Hizkiah or Hizkijah = "Jehovah is my strength"
**1.** 12th king of Judah, son of Ahaz and Abijah; a good king in that he served Jehovah and did away with idolatrous practices
**2.** great-great-grandfather of Zephaniah the prophet
**3.** son of Neariah, a descendant of David
**4.** head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah
s: From [H2388](H2388) and [H3050](H3050); *strengthened* *of* *Jah*; *Chizkijah*, a king of Judah, also the name of two other Israelites: - Hezekiah, Hizkiah, Hizkijah. Compare [H3169](H3169).

d:

d:

		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to miss
				**2.** to sin, miss the goal or path of right and duty
				**3.** to incur guilt, incur penalty by sin, forfeit
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to bear loss
				**2.** to make a sin-offering
				**3.** to purify from sin
				**4.** to purify from uncleanness
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to miss the mark
				**2.** to induce to sin, cause to sin
				**3.** to bring into guilt or condemnation or punishment
		**d.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to miss oneself, lose oneself, wander from the way
				**2.** to purify oneself from uncleanness
s: A primitive root; properly to *miss*; hence (figuratively and generally) to *sin*; by inference to *forfeit*, *lack*, *expiate*, *repent*, (causatively) *lead* *astray*, *condemn: -* bear the blame, cleanse, commit \[sin\], by fault, harm he hath done, loss, miss, (make) offend (-er), offer for sin, purge, purify (self), make reconciliation, (cause, make) sin (-ful, -ness), trespassive

d:

**1.** a town site unknown; maybe same as 'Hammath'
s: From [H2574](H2574) and [H6678](H6678); *Chamath* *of* *Tsobah*; *Chamath* *Tsobah*; probably the same as [H2574](H2574): - Hamath-Zobah.

d:
Hamath-Rabbah = "enclosure of wrath-populous"
**1.** a town site unknown; maybe same as 'Hammath'
s: From [H2574](H2574) and [H7237](H7237); *Chamath* *of* *Rabbah*; *Chamath* *Rabbah*, probably the same as [H2574](H2574).

d:
**1.** favour, grace, charm
		**a.** favour, grace, elegance
		**b.** favour, acceptance
s: From [H2603](H2603); *graciousness*, that is, subjectively (*kindness*, *favor*) or objectively (*beauty*): - favour, grace (-ious), pleasant, precious, \[well-\] favoured.

d:
Hen = "favour"
**1.** a contemporary of Zerubbabel
s: The same as [H2580](H2580); *grace*; *Chen*, a figurative name for an Israelite: - Hen.

d:
Henadad = "favour of Hadad"
**1.** head of a family of Levites who took part in the rebuilding of the temple
s: Probably from [H2580](H2580) and [H1908](H1908); *favor* *of* *Hadad*; *Chenadad*, an Israelite: - Henadad.

d:
**1.** to decline, incline, encamp, bend down, lay siege against
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to decline
				**2.** to encamp
s: A primitive root (compare [H2603](H2603)); properly to *incline*; by implication to *decline* (of the slanting rays of evening); specifically to *pitch* a tent; generally to *encamp* (for abode or siege): - abide (in tents), camp, dwell, encamp, grow to an end, lie, pitch (tent), rest in tent.

d:
Hannah = "grace"
**1.** the mother of Samuel, one of the wives of Elkanah
s: From [H2603](H2603); *favored*; *Channah*, an Israelitess: - Hannah.

d:
Enoch = "dedicated"
n pr m
**1.** eldest son of Cain
**2.** son of Jared and father of Methuselah whom God took home to heaven without dying
n pr loc
**3.** the city which Cain built and named after his son Enoch (after himself)
Hanoch = "dedicated"
n pr m
**4.** a son of Midian, the third child
**5.** the eldest son of Reuben
s: From [H2596](H2596); *initiated*; *Chanok*, an antediluvian patriarch: - Enoch.

d:
Hanun = "gracious"
**1.** son of Nahash and king of Ammon who dishonoured David's ambassadors and lost the subsequent war with David
**2.** a man who, with the people of Zanoah, repaired the ravine gate in the wall of Jerusalem
**3.** the 6th son of Zalaph, who also assisted in the repair of the wall of Jerusalem, apparently on the east side
s: From [H2603](H2603); *favored*; *Chanun*, the name of an Ammonite and of two Israelites: - Hanun.

d: **1.** gracious
s: From [H2603](H2603); *gracious: -* gracious.

d: **1.** cell, vaulted room
s: From [H2583](H2583); properly a *vault* or *cell* (with an arch); by implication a *prison: -* cabin.

d:
verb
**1.** (Qal) (TWOT) to intreat, to pity, be gracious
n fem pl
**2.** (Qal) (CLBL) gracious
s: From [H2603](H2603) (in the sense of *prayer*); *supplication: -* be gracious, intreated.

d:
v
**1.** to embalm, spice, make spicy
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to spice, make spicy
				**2.** to embalm
**2.** (CLBL) to ripen
n m pl abst
**3.** (BDB) embalming
s: A primitive root; to *spice*; by implication to *embalm*; also to *ripen: -* embalm, put forth.

d: **1.** wheat
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2406](H2406); *wheat: -* wheat.

d:
Hanniel = "favoured of God"
**1.** son of Ephod and a prince of the tribe of Manasseh
**2.** son of Ulla and a chief of the tribe of Asher; also 'Haniel'
s: From [H2603](H2603) and [H410](H410); *favor* *of* *God*; *Channiel*, the name of two Israelites: - Hanniel.

d: **1.** trained, instructed, trained servant, tried, experienced
s: From [H2396](H2396); *initiated*; that is, *practised: -* trained.

d: **1.** favour, compassion
s: From [H2603](H2603); *graciousness: -* favour.

d:
**1.** spear
		**a.** spear
				**1.** shaft of a spear
				**2.** spear-head
s: From [H2583](H2583); a *lance* (for *thrusting*, like *pitching* a tent): - javelin, spear.

d:
**1.** to train, dedicate, inaugurate
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to train, train up
				**2.** to dedicate
s: A primitive root; properly to *narrow* (compare [H2614](H2614)); figuratively to *initiate* or *discipline: -* dedicate, train up.

d: **1.** dedication
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2598](H2598); *consecration: -* dedication.

d: **1.** dedication, consecration
s: From [H2596](H2596); *initiation*, that is, *consecration: -* dedicating (-tion).

d:
Hanochites = see Hanoch "dedicated"
**1.** descendants of Hanoch
s: Patronymic from [H2585](H2585); a *Chanokite* (collectively) or descendant of Chanok: - Hanochites.

d:
**1.** freely, for nothing, without cause
		**a.** gratis, gratuitously, for nothing
		**b.** for no purpose, in vain
		**c.** gratuitously, without cause, undeservedly
s: From [H2580](H2580); *gratis*, that is, devoid of cost, reason or advantage: - without a cause (cost, wages), causeless, to cost nothing, free (-ly), innocent, for nothing (nought), in vain.

d:
Hanameel = "God is gracious"
**1.** son of Shallum and cousin of Jeremiah
s: Probably by orthographical variation for [H2606](H2606); *Chanamel*, an Israelite: - Hanameel.

d:
**1.** frost, flood, sleet (meaning uncertain)
		**a.** that which destroyed the sycamore trees
s: Of uncertain derivation; perhaps the *aphis* or plant louse: - frost.

d:
**1.** to be gracious, show favour, pity
		**a.** (Qal) to show favour, be gracious
		**b.** (Niphal) to be pitied
		**c.** (Piel) to make gracious, make favourable, be gracious
		**d.** (Poel) to direct favour to, have mercy on
		**e.** (Hophal) to be shown favour, be shown consideration
		**f.** (Hithpael) to seek favour, implore favour
**2.** to be loathsome
s: A primitive root (compare [H2583](H2583)); properly to *bend* or stoop in kindness to an inferior; to *favor*, *bestow*; causatively to *implore* (that is, move to favor by petition): - beseech, X fair, (be, find, shew) favour (-able), be (deal, give, grant (gracious (-ly), intreat, (be) merciful, have (shew) mercy (on, upon), have pity upon, pray, make supplication, X very.

d:
**1.** to show favour
		**a.** (P'al) to show favour
		**b.** (Ithpael) to implore favour
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2603](H2603); to *favor* or (causatively) to *entreat: -* shew mercy, make supplication.

d:
Canan or Hanan = "he is merciful"
**1.** one of the chief people of the tribe of Benjamin
**2.** last of the 6 sons of Azel, a descendant of Saul
**3.** son of Maachah, one of David's mighty warriors
**4.** father of some sons who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
**5.** one of the Levites who assisted Ezra in his public exposition of the law
**6.** one of the heads of the people who also sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
**7.** another of the chief laymen who also sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
**8.** son of Zaccur, grandson of Mattaniah whom Nehemiah made one of the storekeepers of the provisions collected as tithes. Same as 5 ?
**9.** son of Igdaliah
s: From [H2603](H2603); *favor*; *Chanan*, the name of seven Israelites: - Canan.

d:
Hananeel = "God has favoured"
**1.** the name of a tower in Jerusalem
s: From [H2603](H2603) and [H410](H410); *God* *has* *favored*; *Chananel*, probably an Israelite, from whom a tower of Jerusalem was named: - Hananeel.

d:
Hanani = "gracious"
**1.** one of the sons of Heman, a chief musician of David, and head of the 18th course of the service
**2.** a seer who rebuked Asa, king of Judah, and was imprisoned
		**a.** maybe, father of Jehu the seer who testified against Baasha
**3.** one of the priests who in the time of Ezra took a foreign wife
**4.** brother of Nehemiah whom Nehemiah appointed governor of Jerusalem
**5.** another priest who was the chief musician under Nehemiah
s: From [H2603](H2603); *gracious*; *Chanani*, the name of six Israelites: - Hanani.

d:
Hananiah = "God has favoured"
**1.** the godly friend of Daniel whom Nebuchadnezzar renamed Shadrach; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord. See also, 'Shadrach' ( H07714 or H07715)
**2.** one of the 14 sons of Heman and chief of the 16th course
**3.** a general in the army of King Uzziah
**4.** father of Zedekiah in the time of Jehoiakim
**5.** son of Azur, a Benjamite of Gibeon and a false prophet in the reign of Zedekiah king of Judah
**6.** grandfather of Irijah, the captain of the ward at the gate of Benjamin who arrested Jeremiah on the charge of deserting to the Chaldeans
**7.** a head of a Benjamite house
**8.** son of Zerubbabel from whom Christ derived His descent also called 'Joanna' by Luke
**9.** one of the sons of Bebai who returned with Ezra from Babylon
**10.** a priest, one of the makers of the sacred ointments and incense, who built a portion of the wall of Jerusalem in the days of Nehemiah
**11.** head of the priestly course of Jeremiah in the days of Joiakim
**12.** ruler of the palace at Jerusalem under Nehemiah and also, along with Hanani, the Tirshatha's brother, entrusted with the arrangements of guarding the gates of Jerusalem
**13.** Two post exilic Israelites
s: From [H2603](H2603) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *favored*; *Chananjah*, the name of thirteen Israelites: - Hananiah.

d:
Hanes = "grace has fled"
**1.** a place in Egypt, site uncertain but may be either of the following
		**a.** Tahpanhes, a fortified town on the eastern frontier
		**b.** a place in lower Egypt, on an island in the Nile south of Memphis
s: Of Egyptian derivation; *Chanes*, a place in Egypt: - Hanes.

d:
**1.** to be profaned, be defiled, be polluted, be corrupt
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be polluted
				**2.** to be profane, be godless
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to pollute
				**2.** to make profane, make godless, cause to be defiled
s: A primitive root; to *soil*, especially in a moral sense: - corrupt, defile, X greatly, pollute, profane.

d: **1.** hypocritical, godless, profane, hypocrite, irreligious
s: From [H2610](H2610); *soiled* (that is, with sin), *impious: -* hypocrite (-ical).

d: **1.** hypocrisy, godlessness, hypocrite, profaneness
s: From [H2610](H2610); moral *filth*, that is, *wickedness: -* hypocrisy.

d: **1.** profaneness, pollution, hypocrisy, godlessness
s: Feminine from [H2610](H2610); *impiety: -* profaneness.

d:
**1.** to strangle, strangle oneself
		**a.** (Niphal) to strangle oneself
		**b.** (Piel) to strangle
s: A primitive root (compare [H2596](H2596)); to *be* *narrow*; by implication to *throttle*, or (reflexively) to *choke* oneself to death (by a rope): - hang self, strangle.

d:
Hannathon = "gracious"
**1.** a town in Zebulun
s: Probably from [H2603](H2603); *favored*; *Channathon*, a place in Palestine: - Hannathon.

d:
**1.** to be good, be kind
		**a.** (Hithpael) to show kindness to oneself
**2.** to be reproached, be ashamed
		**a.** (Piel) to be put to shame, be reproached
s: A primitive root; properly perhaps to *bow* (the neck only (compare [H2603](H2603)) in courtesy to an equal), that is, to *be* *kind*; also (by euphemism (compare [H1288](H1288)), but rarely) to *reprove: -* shew self merciful, put to shame.

d:
**1.** goodness, kindness, faithfulness
**2.** a reproach, shame
s: From [H2616](H2616); *kindness*; by implication (towards God) *piety*; rarely (by opprobrium) *reproof*, or (subjectively) *beauty: -* favour, good deed (-liness, -ness), kindly, (loving-) kindness, merciful (kindness), mercy, pity, reproach, wicked thing.

d:
Hesed = "son of faithfulness"
**1.** father of or maybe a commissary officer under Solomon
s: The same as [H2617](H2617); *favor*; *Chesed*, an Israelite: - Hesed.

d:
Hasadiah = "Jehovah has been faithful"
**1.** a son of Zerubbabel
s: From [H2617](H2617) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *favored*; *Chasadjah*, an Israelite: - Hasadiah.

d:
**1.** (Qal) to seek refuge, flee for protection
		**a.** to put trust in (God), confide or hope in (God) (fig.)
s: A primitive root; to *flee* for protection (compare [H982](H982)); figuratively to *confide* in: - have hope, make refuge, (put) trust.

d:
Hosah = "refuge"
n pr m
**1.** a Levitical doorkeeper of the temple
n pr loc
**2.** a place in Asher, site unknown
s: From [H2620](H2620); *hopeful*; *Chosah*, an Israelite: - Hosah.

d: **1.** refuge, shelter
s: From [H2620](H2620); *confidence: -* trust.

d:
**1.** faithful, kind, godly, holy one, saint, pious
		**a.** kind
		**b.** pious, godly
		**c.** faithful ones (subst)
s: From [H2616](H2616); properly *kind*, that is, (religiously) *pious* (a saint): - godly (man), good, holy (one), merciful, saint, \[un-\] godly.

d: **1.** stork
s: Feminine of [H2623](H2623); the *kind* (maternal) bird, that is, a *stork: -*  X feather, stork.

d: **1.** locust
s: From [H2628](H2628); the *ravager*, that is, a *locust: -* caterpillar.

d: **1.** strong, mighty
s: From [H2630](H2630); properly *firm*, that is, (by implication) *mighty: -* strong.

d: **1.** lacking, wanting, deficient
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to [H2637](H2637); *deficient: -* wanting.

d: **1.** (Qal) to consume, finish off, bring to an end
s: A primitive root; to *eat* off: - consume.

d: **1.** (Qal) to stop up, muzzle
s: A primitive root; to *muzzle*; by analogy to *stop* the nose: - muzzle, stop.

d: **1.** (Niphal) to be treasured up, be hoarded, be laid up, be stored
s: A primitive root; properly to (*be*) *compact*; by implication to *hoard: -* lay up.

d: **1.** (Aphel) to take possession of
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2630](H2630); to *hold* in occupancy: - possess.

d: **1.** power, strength, power (of the king), (royal) power
s: (Chaldee); from [H2631](H2631); *strength: -* power.

d: **1.** riches, treasure, wealth
s: From [H2630](H2630); *wealth: -* riches, strength, treasure.

d: **1.** strong
s: From [H2630](H2630); *powerful: -* strong.

d: **1.** clay, potsherd
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of [H2636](H2636); a *clod: -* clay.
o: from a root corresponding to that of [H2636](H2636)

d:
**1.** (Pual) to peel, flake off (only in the participle)
		**a.** scale-like, flake-like, scaled-off
s: Reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to *peel*; a *shred* or *scale: -* round thing.
o: reduplicated from an unused root meaning apparently to peel

d:
**1.** to lack, be without, decrease, be lacking, have a need
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to lack
				**2.** to be lacking
				**3.** to diminish, decrease
		**b.** (Piel) to cause to lack
		**c.** (Hiphil) to cause to be lacking
s: A primitive root; to *lack*; by implication to *fail*, *want*, *lessen: -* be abated, bereave, decrease, (cause to) fail, (have) lack, make lower, want.

d: **1.** in need of, lacking, needy, in want of
s: From [H2637](H2637); *lacking*; hence *without: -* destitute, fail, lack, have need, void, want.

d: **1.** poverty, want
s: From [H2637](H2637); *lack*; hence *destitution: -* poverty, want.

d: **1.** want, lack, want of, lack of
s: From [H2637](H2637); *poverty: -* in want of.

d:
Hasrah = "lack"
**1.** grandfather of Shallum who was the husband of Huldah, the prophetess; also spelled 'Harhas'
s: From [H2637](H2637); *want: -* Chasrah, an Isr: - Hasrah.

d: **1.** the thing lacking, defect, deficiency
s: From [H2637](H2637); *deficiency: -* wanting.

d: **1.** innocent, pure, clean
s: From [H2653](H2653) (in the moral sense of *covered* from soil); *pure: -* innocent.
o: from [H2653](H2653) (in the moral sense of covered from soil)

d: **1.** (Piel) to cover, do secretly
s: An orthographical variation of [H2645](H2645); properly to *cover*, that is, (in a sinister sense) to *act* *covertly: -* do secretly.

d:
**1.** to cover, overlay, wainscotted, covered with boards or panelling
		**a.** (Qal) to cover
		**b.** (Niphal) to be covered
		**c.** (Piel) to cover, overlay
s: A primitive root (compare [H2644](H2644), [H2653](H2653)); to *cover*; by implication to *veil*, to *incase*, *protect: -* ceil, cover, overlay.

d:
**1.** chamber, room, canopy, closet
		**a.** canopy
		**b.** chamber
		**c.** divine protection (fig.)
s: From [H2645](H2645); a *canopy: -* chamber, closet, defence.

d:
Huppah = "canopy"
**1.** a priest of the 13th course in the time of David
s: The same as [H2646](H2646); *Chuppah*, an Israelite: - Huppah.

d:
**1.** to hurry, flee, hasten, fear, be terrified
		**a.** (Qal) to be in a hurry, be alarmed
		**b.** (Niphal) to be in a hurry
s: A primitive root; properly to *start* up suddenly, that is, (by implication) to *hasten* away, to *fear: -* (make) haste (away), tremble.

d: **1.** hurriedly, in haste, trepidation, hurried flight
s: From [H2468](H2468); *hasty* *flight: -* haste.

d:
Huppim = "protected"
**1.** the head of a Benjamite family
s: Plural of [H2646](H2646) (compare [H2349](H2349)); *Chuppim*, an Israelite: - Huppim.

d: **1.** handfuls, hollow of the hand
s: From an unused root of uncertain signification; a *fist* (only in the dual): - fists, (both) hands, hand \[-full\].
o: from an unused root of uncertain signification

d:
Hophni = "pugilist"
**1.** one of the two sons of Eli who were priests at Shiloh and were noted for their brutality and lust; their sinfulness provoked a curse against their father's house and were judged by the Lord when they took the ark into battle; the ark was lost and both brothers were killed and Eli died when he heard the news
s: From [H2651](H2651); perhaps *pugilist*; *Chophni*, an Israelite: - Hophni.

d: **1.** (Qal) to cover, enclose, shelter, shield, surround
s: A primitive root (compare [H2645](H2645), [H3182](H3182)); to *cover* (in protection): - cover.

d:
**1.** to delight in, take pleasure in, desire, be pleased with
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** of men
						**a.** to take pleasure in, delight in
						**b.** to delight, desire, be pleased to do
				**2.** of God
						**a.** to delight in, have pleasure in
						**b.** to be pleased to do
**2.** to move, bend down
		**a.** (Qal) to bend down
s: A primitive root; properly to *incline* to; by implication (literally but rarely) to *bend*; figuratively to *be* *pleased* with, *desire: -*  X any at all, (have, take) delight, desire, favour, like, move, be (well) pleased, have pleasure, will, would.

d: **1.** desiring, delighting in, having pleasure in
s: From [H2654](H2654); *pleased* with: - delight in, desire, favour, please, have pleasure, whosoever would, willing, wish.

d:
**1.** delight, pleasure
		**a.** delight
		**b.** desire, longing
		**c.** the good pleasure
		**d.** that in which one takes delight
s: From [H2654](H2654); *pleasure*; hence (abstractly) *desire*; concretely a *valuable* thing; hence (by extension) a *matter* (as something in mind): - acceptable, delight (-some), desire, things desired, matter, pleasant (-ure), purpose, willingly.

d:
Hephzi-bah = "my delight is in her"
**1.** the queen of King Hezekiah and mother of Manasseh
**2.** a name for Jesusalem (fig.)
s: From [H2656](H2656) with suffixes; *my* *delight* (is) *in* *her*; *Cheptsibah*, a fanciful name for Palestine: - Hephzi-bah.

d:
**1.** to dig, search for
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to dig
				**2.** to search, search out, explore
s: A primitive root; properly to *pry* into; by implication to *delve*, to *explore: -* dig, paw, search out, seek.

d:
**1.** to be ashamed, be confounded, be abashed, feel abashed
		**a.** (Qal) to be ashamed, be abashed
		**b.** (Hiphil) to display shame, demonstrate shame, cause embarrassment
s: A primitive root (perhaps rather the same as [H2658](H2658) through the idea of *detection*): to *blush*; figuratively to *be* *ashamed*, *disappointed*; causatively to *shame*, *reproach: -* be ashamed, be confounded, be brought to confusion (unto shame), come (be put to) shame, bring reproach.
o: a primitive root \[perhaps rath, the same as [H2658](H2658) through the idea of detection\]

d:
Hepher = "a well"
n pr m
**1.** youngest son of Gilead and head of the family of Hepherites
**2.** son of Asher, the father of Tekoa
**3.** the Mecherathite, one of David's mighty warriors
n pr loc
**4.** a place in ancient Canaan, west of the Jordan, conquered by Joshua site unknown
		**a.** a place in Judah, probably the same as 4 above
s: From [H2658](H2658) or [H2659](H2659); a *pit* or *shame*; *Chepher*, a place in Palestine; also the name of three Israelites: - Hepher.

d: **1.** mole (as digger)
s: From [H2658](H2658); a *hole*; only in connection with [H6512](H6512), which ought rather to be joined as one word (shown as second form; by reduplication from [H2658](H2658); a *burrower*, that is, probably a *rat*): -  + mole.

d:
Hepherites = see Hepher "a pit" or "shame"
**1.** descendants of Hepher, son of Gilead
s: Patronymic from [H2660](H2660); a *Chephrite* (collectively) or descendant of *Chepher: -* Hepherites.

d:
Hapharaim = "two pits"
**1.** a place in Issachar
s: Dual of [H2660](H2660); *double* *pit*; *Chapharajim*, a place in Palestine: - Haphraim.

d:
**1.** to search, search for, to search out, disguise oneself
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to search for
				**2.** to think out, devise
				**3.** to search, test
		**b.** (Niphal) to be searched out, be exposed
		**c.** (Piel) to search, search through, search for
		**d.** (Pual) to be searched for, be sought out
		**e.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to disguise oneself
				**2.** to let oneself be searched for
s: A primitive root; to *seek*; causatively to *conceal* oneself (that is, let be sought), or *mask: -* change, (make) diligent (search), disguise self, hide, search (for, out).

d: **1.** trick, plot, (shrewd) device
s: From [H2664](H2664); something *covert*, that is, a *trick: -* search.

d: **1.** (Pual) to be free, be freed
s: A primitive root; to *spread* loose, figuratively to *manumit: -* be free.

d: **1.** widespread, fabric for horseback riding, saddle-blanket, saddle-cloths; meaning dubious
s: From [H2666](H2666); something *spread* loosely, that is, a *carpet: -* precious.

d: **1.** freedom
s: From [H2666](H2666); *liberty* (from slavery): - freedom.

d: **1.** separateness, freedom
s: From [H2666](H2666); *prostration* by sickness (with [H1004](H1004), a *hospital*): - several.

d:
**1.** free
		**a.** free (from slavery)
		**b.** free (from taxes or obligations)
s: From [H2666](H2666); *exempt* (from bondage, tax or care): - free, liberty.

d: **1.** arrow
s: From [H2686](H2686); properly a *piercer*, that is, an *arrow*; by implication a *wound*; figuratively (of God) thunder *bolt*; (by interchange for [H6086](H6086)) the *shaft* of a spear: -  + archer, arrow, dart, shaft, staff, wound.

d:
**1.** to dig, cleave, divide, hew, make, cut out, dig out, cut down, quarry, hewer, mason
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to hew out, dig
				**2.** to hew
						**a.** stone
						**b.** wood
				**3.** to hew in pieces (metaph.)
				**4.** to divide, cleave
		**b.** (Niphal) to be cut, be hewn, be engraved
		**c.** (Hiphil) to hew into pieces, cut up into pieces
		**d.** (Pual) to be cut from, be hewn from
s: A primitive root; to *cut* or carve (wood, stone or other material); by implication to *hew*, *split*, *square*, *quarry*, *engrave: -* cut, dig, divide, grave, hew (out, -er), make, mason.

d:
**1.** to divide, cut in two, cut short, live half (of one's life)
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to divide
				**2.** to half, cut in two
		**b.** (Niphal) to be divided
s: A primitive root (compare [H2686](H2686)); to *cut* or *split* in two; to *halve: -* divide, X live out half, reach to the midst, part.

d:
Hazor = "castle"
**1.** a royal city of northern Palestine allotted to Naphtali
**2.** one of the cities of Judah in the extreme south
**3.** a town north of Jerusalem in which the Benjamites resided after the return from exile
**4.** a site in Arabia
s: A collective form of [H2691](H2691); *village*; *Chatsor*, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine and of one in Arabia: - Hazor.

d:
Hazor-Hadattah = "new Hazor"
**1.** a city in the south of Judah; Jos 15:25
s: From [H2674](H2674) and a Chaldaizing form of the feminine of [H2319](H2319) (compare [H2323](H2323)); *new* *Chatsor*, a place in Palestine: - Hazor, Hadattah \[as if two places\].
o: from [H2674](H2674) and a Aramaic form of the fem. of [H2319](H2319) \[compare [H2323](H2323)\]

d: **1.** middle, mid-, half, division
s: From [H2673](H2673); the *middle* (of the night): - mid \[-night\].

d:
**1.** half
		**a.** half
		**b.** middle
s: From [H2673](H2673); the *half* or *middle: -* half, middle, mid \[-night\], midst, part, two parts.

d: **1.** arrow
s: Prolonged from [H2671](H2671); an *arrow: -* arrow.

d:
(half of the) Manahethites = see Manaheth resting place
**1.** half of the Manassites; also spelled like H02680
s: From [H2677](H2677) and the plural of [H4496](H4496), with the article interposed; *midst* *of* *the* *resting* *places*; *Chatsi* *ham-Menuchoth*, an Israelite: - half of the Manahethites.
o: from [H2677](H2677) and the plural of [H4496](H4496), with the article interposed

d:
(half of the) Manassites = see Manasseh "causing to forget"
**1.** half of the Manassites; also spelled like H02679
s: Patronymic from [H2679](H2679); a *Chatsi* *ham-Menachtite* or descendant of Chatsi ham-menuchoth: - half of the Manahethites.

d: **1.** a dwelling, an abode, settled abode, haunt
s: A collateral form of [H2691](H2691); a *court* or *abode: -* court.

d:
**1.** grass, leek, green grass, herbage
		**a.** grass
		**b.** of the quickly perishing (fig.)
s: Perhaps originally the same as [H2681](H2681), from the *greenness* of a courtyard; *grass*; also a *leek* (collectively): - grass, hay, herb, leek.
o: perhaps originally the same as [H2681](H2681), from the greenness of a courtyard

d: **1.** bosom, bosom of a garment
s: From an unused root meaning to hold *firmly*; the *bosom* (as *comprised* between the arms): - bosom.
o: from an unused root meaning to hold firmly

d: **1.** bosom, lap
s: A collateral form of [H2683](H2683), and meaning the same: - arm, lap.
o: a collateral form of [H2683](H2683), and meaning the same

d: **1.** (Aphel) to be urgent, harsh, show insolence
s: (Chaldee); a primitive root; properly to *shear* or cut close; figuratively to *be* *severe: -* hasty, be urgent.

d:
**1.** to divide
		**a.** (Qal) to divide
		**b.** (Piel) to divide
		**c.** (Pual) to be cut off, be finished
**2.** to shoot arrows
		**a.** (Piel) archer (participle)
s: A primitive root (compare [H2673](H2673)); properly to *chop* into, pierce or sever; hence to *curtail*, to *distribute* (into ranks); as denominative from [H2671](H2671); to *shoot* an arrow: - archer, X bands, cut off in the midst.

d: **1.** gravel
s: From [H2686](H2686); properly something *cutting*; hence *gravel* (as *grit*); also (like [H2671](H2671)) an *arrow: -* arrow, gravel (stone).

d:
Hazezon-tamar = "dividing the date-palm"
**1.** an Amorite city
**2.** a town situated in the desert Judah; probably Engedi
**3.** maybe the 'Tamar' of Solomon's day
s: From [H2686](H2686) and [H8558](H8558); *division* (that is, perhaps *row*) *of* (the *palm* *tree*; *Chatsetson* *tamar*, a place in Palestine: - Hazezon-tamar.

d: **1.** trumpet, clarion
s: By reduplication from [H2690](H2690); a *trumpet* (from its *sundered* or quavering note): - trumpet (-er).

d:
**1.** to sound a trumpet
		**a.** (Piel) players on clarions (participle)
		**b.** (Hiphil) sound with clarions (participle)
s: A primitive root; properly to *surround* with a stockade, and thus *separate* from the open country; but used only in the reduplicated form (the second and third forms; to *trumpet*, that is, blow on that instrument): - blow, sound, trumpeter.

d:
**1.** court, enclosure
		**a.** enclosures
		**b.** court
**2.** settled abode, settlement, village, town
s: From [H2690](H2690) in its original sense; a *yard* (as *inclosed* by a fence); also a *hamlet* (as similarly *surrounded* with walls): - court, tower, village.

d:
Hazar-addar = "enclosure of glory"
**1.** a place on the southern border of Canaan
s: From [H269](H269) and [H146](H146): (the) *village* *of* *Addar*; *Chatsar* *Addar*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-addar.

d:
Hazar-gaddah = "village of good fortune"
**1.** a place in southern Judah
s: From [H2691](H2691) and a feminine of [H1408](H1408); (the) *village* *of* (female) *Fortune*; *Chatsar* *Gaddah*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-gaddah.

d:
Hazar-hatticon = "middle court"
**1.** a place in Palestine, maybe at the east corner of Hermon
s: From [H2691](H2691) and [H8484](H8484) with the article interposed; *village* *of* *the* *middle*; *Chatsar-hat-Tikon*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-hatticon.
o: from [H2691](H2691) and [H8484](H8484) with the article interposed

d:
Hezro or Hezrai = "enclosed"
**1.** the Carmelite, one of David's 30 mighty warriors in his guard
s: By an orthographical variation for [H2696](H2696); *inclosure*; *Chetsro*, an Israelite: - Hezro, Hezrai.

d:
Hezron = "surrounded by a wall"
n pr m
**1.** a son of Reuben
**2.** a son of Pharez and grandson of Judah
n pr loc
**3.** a place in the extreme south of Judah
s: From [H2691](H2691); *courtyard*; *Chetsron*, the name of a place in Palestine; also fo two Israelites: - Hezron.

d:
Hezronites = see Hezron "enclosed" or "division of song"
**1.** a descendant of Hezron
s: Patron from [H2696](H2696); a *Chetsronite* or (collectively) descendant of Chetsron: - Hezronites.

d:
Hazeroth = "settlement"
**1.** an Israelite camp in the wilderness
s: Feminine plural of [H2691](H2691); *yards*; *Chatseroth*, a place in Palestine: - Hazeroth.

d:
Hazerim = "villages"
**1.** settlements of Ishmaelites
s: Plural masculine of [H2691](H2691); *yards*; *Chatserim*, a place in Palestine: - Hazerim.

d:
Hazarmaveth = "village of death"
n pr m
**1.** the 3rd in order of the sons of Joktan
++++
He was the founder of an ancient people of southern Arabia which later became a province and important commercial centre
s: From [H2691](H2691) and [H4194](H4194); *village* *of* *death*; *Chatsarmaveth*, a place in Arabia: - Hazarmaveth.

d:
Hazar-susah = "horse village"
**1.** one of the cities allotted to Simeon in the extreme south of Judah and the place where Solomon kept horses
s: From [H2691](H2691) and [H5484](H5484); *village* *of* *cavalry*; *Chatsar* *Susah*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-susah.

d:
Hazar-susim = "village of horses"
**1.** a place in Simeon
s: From [H2691](H2691) and the plural of [H5483](H5483); *village* *of* *horses*; *Chatsar* *Susim*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-susim.

d:
Hazar-enan = "village of springs"
**1.** a city on the northeast border of Canaan; same as H02704
s: From [H2691](H2691) and a derivative of [H5869](H5869); *village* *of* *springs*; *Chatsar* *Enon*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-enon.

d:
Hazar-enan = "village of fountains"
**1.** a city on the northeast border of Canaan; same as H02703
s: From [H2691](H2691) and the same as [H5881](H5881); *village* *of* *springs*; *Chatsar* *Enan*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-enan.

d:
Hazar-shual = "jackal village"
**1.** a town in southern Judah
**2.** a place in Simeon
s: From [H2691](H2691) and [H7776](H7776); *village* *of* (the) *fox*; *Chatsar* *Shual*, a place in Palestine: - Hazar-shual.

d:
**1.** statute, ordinance, limit, something prescribed, due
		**a.** prescribed task
		**b.** prescribed portion
		**c.** action prescribed (for oneself), resolve
		**d.** prescribed due
		**e.** prescribed limit, boundary
		**f.** enactment, decree, ordinance
				**1.** specific decree
				**2.** law in general
		**g.** enactments, statutes
				**1.** conditions
				**2.** enactments
				**3.** decrees
				**4.** civil enactments prescribed by God
s: From [H2710](H2710); an *enactment*; hence an *appointment* (of time, space, quantity, labor or usage): - appointed, bound, commandment, convenient, custom, decree (-d), due, law, measure, X necessary, ordinance (-nary), portion, set time, statute, task.

d:
**1.** to cut, carve, cut in
		**a.** (Pual) carved (participle)
		**b.** (Hithpael) to engrave, cut a limit
s: A primitive root; to *carve*; by implication to *delineate*; also to *intrench: -* carved work, portrayed, set a print.

d:
**1.** statute, ordinance, limit, enactment, something prescribed
		**a.** statute
s: Feminine of [H2706](H2706), and meaning substantially the same: - appointed, custom, manner, ordinance, site, statute.

d:
Hakupha = "bent"
**1.** head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
s: From an unused root probably meaning to *bend*; *crooked*; *Chakupha*, one of the Nethinim: - Hakupha.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to bend

d:
**1.** to cut out, decree, inscribe, set, engrave, portray, govern
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to cut in
				**2.** to cut in or on, cut upon, engrave, inscribe
				**3.** to trace, mark out
				**4.** to engrave, inscribe (of a law)
		**b.** (Poel)
				**1.** to inscribe, enact, decree
				**2.** one who decrees, lawgiver (participle)
		**c.** (Pual) something decreed, the law (participle)
		**d.** (Hophal) to be inscribed
s: A primitive root; properly to *hack*, that is, *engrave* (Jdg 5:14, to *be* *a* *scribe* simply); by implication to *enact* (laws being *cut* in stone or metal tablets in primitive times) or (generally) *prescribe: -* appoint, decree, governor, grave, lawgiver, note, pourtray, print, set.

d: **1.** decree, resolve, statute, action prescribed
s: From [H2710](H2710); an *enactment*, a *resolution: -* decree, thought.

d:
Hukkok = "appointed"
**1.** a town on the boundary of Naphtali
s: From [H2710](H2710); *appointed*; *Chukkok* or *Chukok*, a place in Palestine: - Hukkok, Hukok.

d:
**1.** to search, search for, search out, examine, investigate
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to search (for)
				**2.** to search through, explore
				**3.** to examine thoroughly
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be searched out, be found out, be ascertained, be examined
		**c.** (Piel) to search out, seek out
s: A primitive root; properly to *penetrate*; hence to *examine* intimately: - find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.

d: **1.** a search, investigation, searching, enquiry, thing to be searched out
s: From [H2713](H2713); *examination*, *enumeration*, *deliberation: -* finding out, number, \[un-\] search (-able, -ed out, -ing).

d: **1.** a noble, freeborn one
s: From [H2787](H2787); properly *white* or *pure* (from the *cleansing* or *shining* power of fire (compare [H2751](H2751)); hence (figuratively) *noble* (in rank): - noble.

d: **1.** dung, excrement
s: From an unused (and vulger) root probably meaning to *evacuate* the bowels; *excrement: -* dung. Also ` chary, khar-ee.
o: from an unused (and vulgar) root probably meaning to evacuate the bowels

d:
**1.** to be waste, lay waste, make desolate, be desolate, be in ruins
		**a.** (Qal) to be waste, be desolate
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be made desolate
				**2.** desolate (participle)
		**c.** (Hiphil) to lay waste, make desolate
		**d.** (Hophal) to be laid waste
**2.** to be dry, be dried up
		**a.** (Qal) to be dried, be dried up
		**b.** (Pual) to be dried
		**c.** (Hiphil) to dry up
		**d.** (Hophal) to be dried up
**3.** to attack, smite down, slay, fight
s: A primitive root; to *parch* (through drought), that is, (by analogy) to *desolate*, *destroy,* *kill*: - decay, (be) desolate, destroy (-er), (be) dry (up), slay, X surely, (lay, lie, make) waste*.*

d:
**1.** to dry up, be waste
		**a.** (Hophal) to be laid waste
s: (Chaldee); a root corresponding to [H2717](H2717); to *demolish: -* destroy.

d:
**1.** sword, knife
		**a.** sword
		**b.** knife
		**c.** tools for cutting stone
s: From [H2717](H2717); *drought*; also a *cutting* instrument (from its *destructive* effect), as a *knife*, *sword*, or other sharp implement: - axe, dagger, knife, mattock, sword, tool.

d: **1.** waste, desolate, dry
s: From [H2717](H2717); *parched* or *ruined: -* desolate, dry, waste.

d:
**1.** dryness, desolation, drought, heat
		**a.** dryness
		**b.** drought
		**c.** parching heat
s: A collateral form of [H2719](H2719); *drought* or *desolation: -* desolation, drought, dry, heat, X utterly, waste.

d:
Horeb = "desert"
**1.** another name for Mount Sinai from which God gave the law to Moses and the Israelites
s: From [H2717](H2717); *desolate*; *Choreb*, a (generic) name for the Sinaitic mountains: - Horeb.

d: **1.** a place laid waste, ruin, waste, desolation
s: Feminine of [H2721](H2721); properly *drought*, that is, (by implication) a *desolation: -* decayed place, desolate (place, -tion), destruction, (laid) waste (place).

d: **1.** dry land, dry ground
s: Feminine of [H2720](H2720); a desert: - dry (ground, land).

d: **1.** drought
s: From [H2717](H2717); parching *heat: -* drought.

d:
Harbona or Harbonah = "ass-driver"
**1.** the 3rd of the seven chamberlains or eunuchs who served Ahasuerus
s: Of Persian origin; a eunuch of Xerxes: - Harbona, Harbonah.

d: **1.** (Qal) to shake from fear, tremble, quake
s: A primitive root; properly to *leap* suddenly, that is, (by implication) to be dismayed: - be afraid.

d: **1.** a kind of locust, a leaping creature
s: From [H2727](H2727); the *leaping* insect, that is, a *locust: -* beetle.

d:
**1.** to tremble, quake, move about, be afraid, be startled, be terrified
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to tremble, quake (of a mountain)
				**2.** to tremble (of people)
				**3.** to be anxiously careful
				**4.** to go or come trembling (with prep)
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause to tremble
				**2.** to drive in terror, rout (an army)
s: A primitive root; to *shudder* with terror; hence to *fear*; also to *hasten* (with anxiety): - be (make) afraid, be careful, discomfit, fray (away), quake, tremble.

d: **1.** trembling, fearful, afraid
s: From [H2729](H2729); *fearful*; also *reverential: -* afraid, trembling.

d:
**1.** fear, anxiety, quaking, trembling, (extreme) anxiety, anxious care
		**a.** trembling, quaking
		**b.** anxious care
s: Feminine of [H2730](H2730); *fear*, *anxiety: -* care, X exceedingly, fear, quaking, trembling.

d:
Haradah = "fear"
**1.** a desert station of Israel in the wilderness; site unknown
s: The same as [H2731](H2731); *Charadah*, a place in the Desert: - Haradah.

d:
Harodite = see Harod "trembling"
**1.** a resident or descendant of Harod otherwise unknown; two of David's 37 guards, Shammah and Elika, called Harodites
s: Patrial from a derivative of [H2729](H2729) (compare [H5878](H5878)); a *Charodite*, or inhabitant of *Charod: -* Harodite.

d:
**1.** to be hot, furious, burn, becomeangry, be kindled
		**a.** (Qal) to burn, kindle (anger)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be angry with, be incensed
		**c.** (Hiphil) to burn, kindle
		**d.** (Hithpael) to heat oneself in vexation
s: A primitive root (compare [H2787](H2787)); to *glow* or grow warm; figuratively (usually) to *blaze* up, of anger, zeal, jealousy: - be angry, burn, be displeased, X earnestly, fret self, grieve, be (wax) hot, be incensed, kindle, X very, be wroth. See [H8474](H8474).

d:
Hor-hagidgad = "cavern of Gidgad"
**1.** a desert station of Israel in the wilderness; site unknown
s: From [H2356](H2356) and a collateral (masculine) form of [H1412](H1412), with the article interposed; *hole* *of* *the* *cleft*; *Chor* *hag* *Gidgad*, a place in the Desert: - Hor-hagidgad.
o: from [H2356](H2356) and a collateral (masc.) form of [H1412](H1412), with the article interposed

d:
Harhaiah = "fear of Jehovah"
**1.** father of Uzziel who was one of the builders of the wall in Nehemiah's time
s: From [H2734](H2734) and [H3050](H3050); *fearing* *Jah*; *Charhajah*, an Israelite: - Harhaiah.

d: **1.** a beaded necklace, string of beads
s: From an unused root meaning to *perforate*; properly *pierced*, that is, a *bead* of pearl, gems or jewels (as strung): - chain.
o: from an unused root meaning to perforate

d: **1.** nettles, weeds, kind of weed (perhaps chickpea)
s: Apparently passive participle of an unused root probably meaning to *be* *prickly*; properly *pointed*, that is, a *bramble* or other thorny weed: - nettle.
o: apparently, a pass. participle of an unused root probably meaning to be prickly

d:
Harumaph = "split nose"
**1.** father of Jedaiah, one of the builders of the wall in Nehemiah's time
s: From passive participle of [H2763](H2763) and [H639](H639); *snubnosed*; *Charumaph*, an Israelite: - Harumaph.

d:
**1.** anger, heat, burning (of anger)
		**a.** always used of God's anger
s: From [H2734](H2734); a *burning* of anger: - sore displeasure, fierce (-ness), fury, (fierce) wrath (-ful).

d:
Haruphite = "native of Haruph"
**1.** an inhabitant of Hariph
s: A patrial from (probably) a collateral form of [H2756](H2756); a *Charuphite* or inhabitant of Charuph (or Chariph): - Haruphite.

d:
adj
**1.** sharp-pointed, sharp, diligent
n m
**2.** strict decision, decision
**3.** trench, moat, ditch
**4.** gold (poetical)
s: Passive participle of [H2782](H2782); properly *incised* or (active) *incisive*; hence (as noun masculine or feminine) a *trench* (as dug), *gold* (as mined), a *threshing* *sledge* (having sharp teeth); (figuratively) *determination*; also *eager: -* decision, diligent, (fine) gold, pointed things, sharp, threshing instrument, wall.

d:
Haruz = "zealous"
**1.** a man of Jotbah, father of Meshullemeth, wife of Manasseh and mother of Amon
s: The same as [H2742](H2742); *earnest*; *Charuts*, an Israelite: - Haruz.

d:
Harhur = "inflammation"
**1.** head of a family returning from exile with Zerubbabel
s: A fuller form of [H2746](H2746); *inflammation*; *Charchur*, one of the Nethinim: - Harhur.

d:
Harhas = "very poor"
**1.** grandfather of Shallum, the husband of Huldah, the prophetess
s: From the same as [H2775](H2775); perhaps *shining*; *Charchas*, an Israelite: - Harbas.

d: **1.** extreme heat, inflammation, violent heat, fever
s: From [H2787](H2787); *fever* (as *hot*): - extreme burning.

d:
**1.** an engraving tool, stylus, chisel, graving tool
		**a.** graving tool
		**b.** stylus
s: From a primitive root meaning to *engrave*; a *chisel* or *graver*; also a *style* for writing: - graving tool, pen.
o: from a primitive root meaning to engrave

d:
**1.** diviner, magician, astrologer
		**a.** engraver, writer (only in derivative sense of one possessed of occult knowledge)
s: From the same as [H2747](H2747); a *horoscopist* (as *drawing* magical lines or circles): - magician.

d: **1.** magician, magician-astrologer
s: (Chaldee); the same as [H2748](H2748): - magician.

d: **1.** heat (of anger), burning (of anger)
s: From [H2734](H2734); a *burning* (that is, intense) anger: - fierce, X great, heat.

d:
**1.** white bread, cake
**2.** (TWOT) Horite, Hori
s: From the same as [H2353](H2353); *white* bread: - white.

d:
Horite = "cave dweller"
**1.** the inhabitants of Mount Seir
**2.** the inhabitants of Edom (in later times)
s: From [H2356](H2356); *cave* *dweller* or troglodyte; a *Chorite* or aboriginal Idumaean: - Horims, Horites.

d:
Hori = "cave dweller"
**1.** a Horite, son of Lotan, the son of Seir
**2.** a Simeonite, father of Shaphat
s: The same as [H2752](H2752); *Chori*, the name of two men: - Hori.

d: **1.** bag, purse
s: From the same as [H2747](H2747); properly *cut* out (or *hollow*), that is, (by implication) a *pocket: -* bag, crisping pin.

d: **1.** dung, doves' dung
s: From the plural of [H2716](H2716) and the plural of [H3123](H3123); *excrements* *of* *doves* (or perhaps rather the plural of a single word, the second form; of similar or uncertain derivation); probably a kind of vegetable: - doves’ dung.
o: from the pl. of [H2716](H2716) and the pl. of [H3123](H3123)

d:
Hariph = "a plucking off"
**1.** head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
**2.** a head of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: From [H2778](H2778); *autumnal*; the name of two Israelites: - Hariph.

d: **1.** a cut, thing cut, sharp instrument, sharp cutting instrument, harrow, hoe

d: **1.** ploughing, ploughing time
s: From [H2790](H2790); *ploughing* or its season: - earing (time), ground.

d: **1.** harsh, hot, sultry, silent (meaning uncertain)

d:
**1.** (Qal) to set in motion, start

d: **1.** (Ithpael) to singe

o: a root probably allied to the equivalent of [H2787](H2787)

d:

		**a.** (Hiphil)

				**3.** to exterminate, completely destroy

				**3.** to be completely destroyed
**2.** to split, slit, mutilate (a part of the body)
		**a.** (Qal) to mutilate
		**b.** (Hiphil) to divide
s: A primitive root; to *seclude*; specifically (by a ban) to *devote* to religious uses (especially destruction); physically and reflexively to be *blunt* as to the nose: - make accursed, consecrate, (utterly) destroy, devote, forfeit, have a flat nose, utterly (slay, make away).

d:
**1.** a thing devoted, thing dedicated, ban, devotion

d:
Horem = "sacred"

d:

d:

d: **1.** sickle

d:

d:

d:

d:

d:

d:

d:

d:

				**3.** to devise
		**b.** (Niphal) to be ploughed
		**c.** (Hiphil) to plot evil

		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be silent
				**2.** to be deaf
		**b.** (Hiphil)

				**2.** to make silent
				**3.** to be deaf, show deafness
		**c.** (Hithpael) to remain silent
s: A primitive root; to *scratch*, that is, (by implication) to *engrave*, *plough*; hence (from the use of tools) to *fabricate* (of any material); figuratively to *devise* (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be *silent*, to *let* *alone*; hence (by implication) to *be* *deaf* (as an accompaniment of dumbness): -  X altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow (-er, -man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.

adv

n m

s: From [H2790](H2790); magical *craft*; also *silence: -* cunning, secretly.

d:

d:
**1.** decree, taste, judgment, command
		**a.** taste
		**b.** judgment, discretion
		**c.** report
		**d.** command
s: (Chaldee); from [H2939](H2939), and equivalent to [H2941](H2941); properly *flavor*; figuratively *judgment* (both subjectively and objectively); hence *account* (both subjectively and objectively): -  + chancellor, + command, commandment, decree, + regard, taste, wisdom.

d: **1.** (Qal) to load
s: A primitive root; to *load* a beast: - lade.

d: **1.** (Pual) to pierce
s: A primitive root; to *stab: -* thrust through.

d: **1.** children, little children, little ones
s: From [H2952](H2952) (perhaps referring to the *tripping* gait of children); a *family* (mostly used collectively in the singular): - (little) children (ones), families.
o: from [H2952](H2952) (perhaps referring to the tripping gait of children)

d:
**1.** to extend, spread, trip, take quick little steps
		**a.** (Piel)
				**1.** to spread out
				**2.** to carry on the palms, dandle
				**3.** to rear children
s: A primitive root; to *flatten* out or *extend* (as a tent); figuratively to *nurse* a child (as *promotive* of growth); or perhaps a denominative from [H2947](H2947), from *dandling* on the palms: - span, swaddle.

d:
**1.** span, width of the hand, hand breadth
		**a.** a unit of measurement, measurement of length
**2.** coping (an architectural term)
s: From [H2946](H2946); a *spread* of the hand, that is, a *palm* *breadth* (not “span” of the fingers); architecturally a *corbel* (as a supporting palm): - coping, hand-breadth.

d: **1.** span, hand breadth
s: From [H2946](H2946) (the same as [H2947](H2947)): - hand-breadth (broad).

d: **1.** tender care, dandling
s: From [H2946](H2946); *nursing: -* span long.

d: **1.** (Qal) to smear, plaster over, stick, glue
s: A primitive root; properly to *stick* on as a patch; figuratively to *impute* falsely: - forge (-r), sew up.

d: **1.** scribe, official, marshal
s: Of foreign derivation; a military *governor: -* captain.

d: **1.** (Qal) to skip, trip, take quick little steps
s: A primitive root; apparently to *trip* (with short steps) coquettishly: - mince.

d: **1.** fingernail, nail, claw
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to [H6852](H6852), and meaning the same as [H6856](H6856); a finger *nail*; also a *hoof* or *claw: -* nail.
o: from a root corresponding to [H6852](H6852), and meaning the same as [H6856](H6856)

d: **1.** (Qal) to be gross, be insensitive, be fat
s: A primitive root; properly apparently to *be* *thick*; figuratively to *be* *stupid: -* be fat.

d:
Taphath = "ornament"
**1.** the daughter of Solomon who was married to Ben-Abinadab
s: Probably from [H5197](H5197); a *dropping* (of ointment); *Taphath*, an Israelitess: - Taphath.

d:
**1.** to pursue, chase, be continuous
		**a.** (Qal) dripping (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *drive* on; figuratively to *follow* close: - continual.

d: **1.** (P'al) to drive away, drive from, chase away
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2956](H2956); to *expel: -* drive.

d: **1.** before, not yet, before that, ere (of time)
s: A variation of [H2962](H2962); *not* *yet: -* before.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to burden, toil, be burdened
s: A primitive root; to *overburden: -* weary.

d: **1.** burden
s: From [H2959](H2959); a *burden: -* cumbrance, trouble.

d: **1.** fresh, new
s: From an unused root apparently meaning to *be* *moist*; properly *dripping*; hence *fresh* (that is, recently made such): - new, putrefying.
o: from an unused root apparently meaning to be moist

d: **1.** before, not yet, before that
s: From an unused root apparently meaning to *interrupt* or *suspend*; properly *non-occurrence*; used adverbially *not* *yet* or *before: -* before, ere, not yet.
o: from an unused root apparently meaning to interrupt or suspend

d:
**1.** to tear, rend, pluck
		**a.** (Qal) to tear, rend
		**b.** (Niphal) to be torn in pieces
		**c.** (Poal) to be torn in pieces
		**d.** (Hiphil) to provide food
s: A primitive root; to *pluck* off or *pull* to pieces; causatively to *supply* with food (as in morsels): - catch, X without doubt, feed, ravin, rend in pieces, X surely, tear (in pieces).

d:
**1.** prey, food, leaf
		**a.** prey
		**b.** food
		**c.** leaf
s: From [H2963](H2963); something *torn*, that is, a fragment, for example a *fresh* leaf, *prey*, *food: -* leaf, meat, prey, spoil.

d: **1.** freshly picked, freshly plucked, fresh-plucked
s: From [H2963](H2963); recently *torn* off, that is, *fresh: -* pluckt off.

d: **1.** that which is torn, animal torn (by beasts)
s: Feminine (collectively) of [H2964](H2964); *prey*, that is, flocks devoured by animals: - ravin, (that which was) torn (of beasts, in pieces).

d:
Tarpelites = "they of the fallen (or wondrous) mountain"
**1.** the group of Assyrian colonists who were planted in the cities of Samaria after the captivity of the northern kingdom of Israel; identity uncertain
s: (Chaldee); from a name of foreign derivation; a *Tarpelite* (collectively) or inhabitant of Tarpel, a place in Assyria: - Tarpelites.
o: from a name of foreign derivation

d: **1.** (Qal) to long, long for, desire
s: A primitive root; to *desire: -* long.

d: **1.** (Qal) to pertain to, befit, be befitting
s: A primitive root; to *be* *suitable: -* appertain.

d:
Jaazaniah = "Jehovah hears"
**1.** a Judean, son of the Maachathite, a captain of the Judean forces who visited Gedaliah at Mizpah after Gedaliah had been appointed governor of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar
**2.** son of Shaphan, an elder of Israel in the days of Ezekiel
**3.** son of Azur, one of the princes of the people against whom Ezekiel was directed to prophesy
**4.** a Rechabite, son of Jeremiah the prophet
s: From [H238](H238) and [H3050](H3050); *heard* *of* *Jah*; *Jaazanjah*, the name of four Israelites: - Jaazaniah. Compare [H3153](H3153).

d:
Jair = "he enlightens"
**1.** a descendant of Manasseh who conquered many towns during the time of the conquest
**2.** the Gileadite, a judge of Israel for 22 years during the time of the judges; father of 30 sons
**3.** a Benjamite, son of Kish, and father of Mordecai
**4.** father of Elhanan, one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H215](H215); *enlightener*; *Jair*, the name of four Israelites: - Jair.

d:
Jairite = "descendant of Jair"
**1.** a descendant of Jair
		**a.** Ira the Jairite was a priest to David
s: Patronymic from [H2971](H2971); a *Jairite* or descendant of Jair: - Jairite.

d:
**1.** to be foolish, become fools, act foolishly, show wicked folly
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to show wicked folly
				**2.** to become fools
s: A primitive root; properly to *be* *slack*, that is, (figuratively) to *be* *foolish: -* dote, be (become, do) foolish (-ly).

d:
**1.** to begin, make a beginning, show willingness, undertake to do, be pleased, be determined
		**a.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to agree to, show willingness, acquiesce, accept an invitation, be willing
				**2.** to undertake
				**3.** to resolve, be pleased, be determined
s: A primitive root (probably rather the same as [H2973](H2973) through the idea of mental *weakness*); properly to *yield*, especially *assent*; hence (positively) to *undertake* as an act of volition: - assay, begin, be content, please, take upon, X willingly, would.
o: a primitive root \[probably rather the same as [H2973](H2973) through the idea of mental weakness\]

d:
**1.** river, stream, canal, Nile, Nile-canal
		**a.** stream, river (Nile)
		**b.** Nile-arms, Nile-canals
		**c.** watercourses
		**d.** shafts (mining)
		**e.** river (in general)
s: Of Egyptian origin; a *channel*, for example a fosse, canal, shaft; specifically the *Nile*, as the one river of Egypt, including its collateral trenches; also the *Tigris*, as the main river of Assyria: - brook, flood, river, stream.

d:
**1.** to despair
		**a.** (Niphal) to be despaired, be desperate
		**b.** (Piel) to cause to despair
interj
**2.** it is hopeless!
s: A primitive root; to *desist*, that is, (figuratively) to *despond: -* (cause to) despair, one that is desperate, be no hope.

d:
Josiah = "whom Jehovah heals"
**1.** son of Amon by Jedidah who succeeded his father to the throne of Judah and reigned for 31 years; his reign is noteworthy for the great revivals back to the worship of Jehovah which he led
**2.** a returned exile and son of Zephaniah at whose house took place the solemn and symbolical crowning of Joshua the high priest in the time of Zechariah the prophet
s: From the same root as [H803](H803) and [H3050](H3050); *founded* *of* *Jah*; *Joshijah*, the name of two Israelites: - Josiah.
o: from the same root as [H803](H803) and [H3050](H3050)

d: **1.** entrance
s: From [H857](H857); an *entry: -* entrance.

d:
Jeaterai = "whom Jehovah leads"
**1.** a Gershonite Levite, son of Zerah
s: From the same as [H871](H871); *stepping*; *Jeatherai*, an Israelite: - Jeaterai.

d: **1.** (Piel) to cry, cry shrilly
s: A primitive root; to *bawl: -* cry out.

d: **1.** produce, fruit, produce (of the soil)
s: From [H2986](H2986); *produce*, that is, a *crop* or (figuratively) *wealth: -* fruit, increase.

d:
Jebus = "threshing place"
**1.** an early name for Jerusalem, the city of the Jebusites; also 'Jebusi'
s: From [H947](H947); *trodden*, that is, threshing place; *Jebus*, the aboriginal name of Jerusalem: - Jebus.

d:
Jebusite = "descendants of Jebus"
**1.** descendants of the 3rd son of Canaan who lived in or around the site of Jebus, the early name for Jerusalem
s: Patrial from [H2982](H2982); a *Jebusite* or inhabitant of Jebus: - Jebusite(-s).

d:
Ibhar = "Jehovah chooses"
**1.** one of the sons of David, born in Jerusalem
s: From [H977](H977); *choice*; *Jibchar*, an Israelite: - Ibhar.

d:
Jabin = "whom God observes"
**1.** a king of Hazor who organised a confederacy of the northern princes against Joshua; confederacy routed by the waters of Merom
**2.** another king of Hazor whose general, Sisera, was defeated by Barak
s: From [H995](H995); *intelligent*; *Jabin*, the name of two Canaanitish kings: - Jabin.

d:
**1.** to bring, lead, carry, conduct, bear along
		**a.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to bear along, bring
				**2.** to carry away, lead away
				**3.** to lead, conduct
		**b.** (Hophal)
				**1.** to be borne along
				**2.** to be borne (to the grave)
				**3.** to be brought, be led, be conducted
s: A primitive root; properly to *flow*; causatively to *bring* (especially with pomp): - bring (forth), carry, lead (forth).

d: **1.** (Aphel) to bring, carry, bear along
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H2986](H2986); to *bring: -* bring, carry.

d:
**1.** a stream, watercourse
		**a.** as irrigating
s: From [H2986](H2986); a *stream: -* \[water-\] course, stream.

d:
Jabal = "stream of water"
**1.** the son of Lamech by Adah and brother of Jubal; described as the father of such as dwell in tents and have cattle
s: The same as [H2988](H2988); *Jabal*, an antediluvian: - Jabal.

d: **1.** running sore, runnings, suppurating, ulcer
s: From [H2986](H2986); having *running* sores: - wen.

d:
Ibleam = "devouring the people"
**1.** a city of Manasseh apparently located in the territory of either Issachar or Asher
s: From [H1104](H1104) and [H5971](H5971); *devouring* *people*; *Jibleam*, a place in Palestine: - Ibleam.

d:
**1.** (Piel) to perform levirate marriage, perform the duty of a brother-in-law
		**a.** the duty due to a brother who died childless - to marry his widow and have a son for his name
s: A primitive root of doubtful meaning; used only as a denominative from [H2993](H2993); to *marry* a (deceased) brother’s widow: - perform the duty of a husband’s brother, marry.
o: a primitive root of doubtful meaning

d: **1.** brother-in-law, husband's brother
s: From (the original of) [H2992](H2992); a *brother-in-law: -* husband’sbrother.

d: **1.** sister-in-law, brother's wife, brother's widow
s: Feminine participle of [H2992](H2992); a *sister-in-law: -* brother’s wife, sister in law.

d:
Jabneel = "God causes to build"
**1.** a town in Judah on the northern boundary near the sea
**2.** a town in Naphtali on the boundary in upper Galilee
s: From [H1129](H1129) and [H410](H410); *built* *of* *God*; *Jabneel*, the name of two places in Palestine: - Jabneel.

d:
Jabneh = "building of God"
**1.** a Philistine city
s: From [H1129](H1129); a *building*; *Jabneh*, a place in Palestine: - Jabneh.

d:
Ibneiah = "Jehovah builds"
**1.** a Benjamite, son of Jehoram
s: From [H1129](H1129) and [H3050](H3050); *built* *of* *Jah*; *Jibnejah*, an Israelite: - Ibneiah.

d:
Ibnijah = "whom Jehovah will build up"
**1.** a Benjamite
s: From [H1129](H1129) and [H3050](H3050); *building* *of* *Jah*; *Jibnijah*, an Israelite: - Ibnijah.

d:
Jabbok = "emptying"
**1.** a stream which intersects the mountain range of Gilead, and falls into the Jordan on the east about midway between the Sea of Galilee and the Dead Sea
s: Probably from [H1238](H1238); *pouring* forth; *Jabbok*, a river East of the Jordan: - Jabbok.

d:
Jeberechiah = "Jehovah blesses"
**1.** father of a Zechariah, in the reign of Ahaz and time of Isaiah
s: From [H1288](H1288) and [H3050](H3050); *blessed* *of* *Jah*; *Jeberekjah*, an Israelite: - Jeberechiah.

d:
**1.** to make dry, wither, be dry, become dry, be dried up, be withered
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be dry, be dried up, be without moisture
				**2.** to be dried up
		**b.** (Piel) to make dry, dry up
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to dry up, make dry
						**a.** to dry up (water)
						**b.** to make dry, wither
						**c.** to exhibit dryness
s: A primitive root; to *be* *ashamed*, *confused* or *disappointed*; also (as failing) to *dry* up (as water) or *wither* (as herbage): - be ashamed, clean, be confounded, (make) dry (up), (do) shame (-fully), X utterly, wither (away).

d:
**1.** dry
**2.** dried
s: From [H3001](H3001); *dry: -* dried (away), dry.

d:
Jabesh = "dry"
n pr loc
**1.** a town in the territory of Gilead; according to Eusebius, it is beyond the Jordan, 6 miles (10 km) from Pella, on the mountain road to Gerasa; site unknown but may be modern 'Wadi Yabes'
n pr m
**2.** father of Shallum, the 15th king of the northern kingdom
s: The same as [H3002](H3002).  (Also, often with the addition of [H1568](H1568), i.e. *Jabesh* *of* *Gilad)*; *Jabesh,*  the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Jabesh (\[-Gilead\]).

d: **1.** dry land, dry ground
s: From [H3001](H3001); *dry* ground: - dry (ground, land).

d:
Jibsam = "pleasant"
**1.** one of the sons of Tola and a grandson of Issachar
s: From the same as [H1314](H1314); *fragrant*; *Jibsam*, an Israelite: - Jibsam.

d: **1.** dry land
s: A variation of [H3004](H3004); *dry* ground: - dry land.

d:
**1.** the earth (as a planet)
**2.** dry land
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3006](H3006); *dry* land: - earth.

d:
Igal or Igeal = "He redeems"
**1.** son of Joseph and a spy from the tribe of Issachar
**2.** son of Nathan of Zobah, one of David's mighty warriors
**3.** a son of Shemaiah and descendant of Zerubbabel
s: From [H1350](H1350); *avenger*; *Jigal*, the name of three Israelite: - Igal, Igeal.

d: **1.** (Qal) to till, be a husbandman
s: A primitive root; to *dig* or plough: - husbandman.

d: **1.** field, ploughed field
s: From [H3009](H3009); a ploughed *field: -* field.

d:
Jogbehah = "lofty"
**1.** one of the cities east of the Jordan which was built and fortified by the tribe of Gad
s: Feminine from [H1361](H1361); *hillock*; *Jogbehah*, a place East of the Jordan: - Jogbehah.

d:
Igdaliah = "Jehovah is great"
**1.** a prophet or holy man and father of Hanan in the time of Josiah
s: From [H1431](H1431) and [H3050](H3050); *magnified* *of* *Jah*; *Jigdaljah*, an Israelite: - Igdaliah.

d:
**1.** to afflict, grieve, suffer, cause grief
		**a.** (Niphal) grieved, grieving (participle)
		**b.** (Piel) to grieve
		**c.** (Hiphil) to cause grief, cause sorrow
s: A primitive root; to *grieve: -* afflict, cause grief, grieve, sorrowful, vex.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to repel, thrust away, push away
s: A primitive root (probably rather the same as [H3013](H3013) through the common idea of *dissatisfaction*); to *push* away: - be removed.
o: a primitive root \[probably rather the same as [H3013](H3013) through thecommon idea of dissatisfaction\]

d: **1.** grief, sorrow, anguish
s: From [H3013](H3013); *affliction: -* grief, sorrow.

d: **1.** (Qal) fearful, fearing
s: From [H3025](H3025); *fearful: -* afraid, fearest.

d:
Jagur = "he sojourns"
**1.** a town of Judah, one of those farthest to the south, on the frontier of Edom
s: Probably from [H1481](H1481); a *lodging*; *Jagur*, a place in Palestine: - Jagur.

d:
**1.** toil, work
**2.** product, produce, acquired property (as a result of work)
s: From [H3021](H3021); *toil*; hence a *work*, *produce*, *property* (as the result of labor): - labour, work.

d: **1.** weary, tired
s: From [H3021](H3021); *tired: -* weary.

d:
Jogli = "he is exiled"
**1.** a Danite and father of Bukki who was one of the 12 rulers charged with the conquest of Canaan
s: From [H1540](H1540); *exiled*; *Jogli*, an Israelite: - Jogli.

d:
**1.** to toil, labour, grow weary, be weary
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to toil, labour
				**2.** to grow weary, be weary
		**b.** (Piel) to weary, make weary, cause to go toilsomely
		**c.** (Hiphil) to make to toil, make weary, cause to be weary
s: A primitive root; properly to *gasp*; hence to *be* *exhausted*, to *tire*, to *toil: -* faint, (make to) labour, (be) weary.

d: **1.** earnings, gain (product of labour)
s: From [H3021](H3021); *earnings* (as the product of toil): - that which he laboured for.

d: **1.** weary, wearisome
s: From [H3021](H3021); *tired*; hence (transitively) *tiresome: -* full of labour, weary.

d: **1.** a wearing, a tiring
s: Feminine of [H3019](H3019); *fatigue: -* weariness.

d: **1.** (Qal) to fear, dread, be afraid
s: A primitive root; to *fear: -* be afraid, fear.

d:
Jegar-sahadutha = "witness heap"
**1.** the mound of stones raised as witness between Jacob and Laban, called by Jacob in Hebrew 'Galeed'
s: (Chaldee); from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to *gather*) and a derivative of a root corresponding to [H7717](H7717); *heap* *of* *the* *testimony*; *Jegar-Sahadutha*, a cairn East of the Jordan: - Jegar-Sahadutha.
o: from a word derived from an unused root (meaning to gather) and a derivation of a root corresponding to [H7717](H7717)

d:
**1.** hand
		**a.** hand (of man)
		**b.** strength, power (fig.)
		**c.** side (of land), part, portion (metaph.) (fig.)
		**d.** (various special, technical senses)
				**1.** sign, monument
				**2.** part, fractional part, share
				**3.** time, repetition
				**4.** axle-trees, axle
				**5.** stays, support (for laver)
				**6.** tenons (in tabernacle)
				**7.** a phallus, a hand (meaning unsure)
				**8.** wrists
s: A primitive word; a *hand* (the *open* one (indicating *power*, *means*, *direction*, etc.), in distinction from [H3709](H3709), the *closed* one); used (as noun, adverb, etc.) in a great variety of applications, both literally and figuratively, both proximate and remote: -  (+ be) able, X about, + armholes, at, axletree, because of, beside, border, X bounty, + broad, \[broken-\] handed, X by, charge, coast, + consecrate, + creditor, custody, debt, dominion, X enough, + fellowship, force, X from, hand \[-staves, -y work\], X he, himself, X in, labour, + large, ledge, \[left-\] handed, means, X mine, ministry, near, X of, X order, ordinance, X our, parts, pain, power, X presumptuously, service, side, sore, state, stay, draw with strength, stroke, + swear, terror, X thee, X by them, X them-selves, X thine own, X thou, through, X throwing, + thumb, times, X to, X under, X us, X wait on, \[way-\] side, where, + wide, X with (him, me, you), work, + yield, X your-selves.

d:
**1.** hand
**2.** power (fig.)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3027](H3027): - hand, power.

d: **1.** (Aphel) to praise, give thanks
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3034](H3034); to *praise: -* (give) thank (-s).

d:
Idalah = "memorial of God"
**1.** a town in Zebulun between Shimron and Bethlehem, site unknown
s: Of uncertain derivation *Jidalah*, a place in Palestine: - Idalah.

d:
Idbash = "stout"
**1.** one of the 3 sons of Abi-etam, a descendant of Judah
s: From the same as [H1706](H1706); perhaps *honeyed*; *Jidbash*, an Israelite: - Idbash.

d:
v
**1.** (Qal) to throw lots, cast lots
n
**2.** love, loving-one, friend
s: A primitive root; properly to *handle* (compare [H3034](H3034)), that is, to *throw*, for example lots: - cast.

d: **1.** one dearly loved, beloved one, object of love
s: From [H3039](H3039); properly *affection*; concretely a *darling* object: - dearly beloved.

d:
**1.** to throw, shoot, cast
		**a.** (Qal) to shoot (arrows)
		**b.** (Piel) to cast, cast down, throw down
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to give thanks, laud, praise
				**2.** to confess, confess (the name of God)
		**d.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to confess (sin)
				**2.** to give thanks
s: A primitive root; used only as denominative from [H3027](H3027); literally to *use* (that is, hold out) *the* *hand*; physically to *throw* (a stone, an arrow) at or away; especially to *revere* or *worship* (with extended hands); intensively to *bemoan* (by wringing the hands): - cast (out), (make) confess (-ion), praise, shoot, (give) thank (-ful, -s, -sgiving).
o: a primitive root; used only as denominative from [H3027](H3027)

d:
Iddo = "timely" or "lovely"
**1.** son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh east of the Jordan in the time of David
**2.** a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
s: From [H3034](H3034); *praised*; *Jiddo*, an Israelite: - Iddo.

d:
Jadon = "thankful"
**1.** a Meronothite and one of the builders of the walls of Jerusalem
s: From [H3034](H3034); *thankful*; *Jadon*, an Israelite: - Jadon.

d:
Jaddua = "knowing"
**1.** one of the chiefs of the people who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
**2.** son and successor in the high priesthood of Jonathan, Jeshua, or Johanan; the last of the high priests mentioned in the OT, probably living in the time of Alexander the Great
s: From [H3045](H3045); *knowing*; *Jaddua*, the name of two Israelite: - Jaddua.

d:
