**8.** son of Pedaiah and a chief of the half tribe of Manasseh west of the Jordan in the time of David
**9.** a son of Nebo who returned with Ezra and had a foreign wife
**10.** a Benjamite, son of Zichri
**11.** a Levite
**12.** a Kohathite Levite in the reign of Hezekiah
**13.** a Gershonite Levite chief in the time of David
**14.** a Gershonite Levite, son of Jehiel and a descendant of Laadan; maybe same as 13
s: From [H3068](H3068) and [H410](H410); *Jehovah* (is his) *God*; *Joel*, the name of twelve Israelites: - Joel.

d:
Joash = "given by the Lord"
**1.** son of king Ahaziah and the 8th king of Judah
**2.** son of king Jehoahaz and the 12th king of the northern kingdom of Israel
**3.** father of Gideon
**4.** a son of king Ahab
**5.** a descendant of Shelah the son of Judah; either the son of Shelah or the son of Jokim
**6.** son of Shemaah of Gibeah who resorted to David at Ziklag
s: A form of [H3060](H3060); *Joash*, the name of six Israelites: - Joash.

d:
Job = "persecuted"
**1.** the 3rd son of Issachar also called 'Jashub'
s: Perhaps a form of [H3103](H3103), but more probably by erroneous transcription for [H3437](H3437); *Job*, an Israelite: - Job.
o: perhaps a form of [H3103](H3103), but more probably by erroneous transcription for [H3437](H3437)

d:
Jobab = "a desert"
**1.** the last in order of the sons of Joktan, a descendant of Shem
**2.** one of the kings of Edom
**3.** the king of Madon, located in northern Canaan, and one of the kings who opposed Joshua during the conquest and who were routed at Meron
**4.** head of a Benjamite house
**5.** another Benjamite
s: From [H2980](H2980); *howler*; *Jobab*, the name of two Israelites and of three foreigners: - Jobab.

d:
**1.** ram, ram's horn, trumpet, cornet
		**a.** ram (only in combination)
				**1.** ram's horn, trumpet
		**b.** jubilee year (marked by the blowing of cornets) (meton)
s: Apparently from [H2986](H2986); the *blast* of a horn (from its *continuous* sound); specifically the *signal* of the silver trumpets; hence the instrument itself and the festival thus introduced: - jubile, ram’s horn, trumpet.

d: **1.** stream
s: From [H2986](H2986); a *stream: -* river.

d:
Jubal = "stream"
**1.** the son of Lamech by Adah and the inventor of musical instruments
s: From [H2986](H2986); *stream*; *Jubal*, an antediluvian: - Jubal.

d:
Jozabad or Josabad = "Jehovah has endowed"
**1.** a Korhite Levite, 2nd son of Obededom, and one of the porters of the temple and of the storehouse there in the time of David
**2.** one of David's mighty warriors
**3.** another of David's mighty warriors
**4.** four other priests or Levites
s: A form of [H3075](H3075); *Jozabad*, the name of ten Israelites: - Josabad, Jozabad.

d:
Jozachar = "Jehovah remembers"
**1.** a servant of king Joash of Judah and one of his murderers
		**a.** also called 'Zabad'
s: From [H3068](H3068) and [H2142](H2142); *Jehovah-remembered*; *Jozacar*, an Israelite: - Jozacar.

d:
Joha = "Jehovah gives life"
**1.** one of the sons of Beriah the Benjamite
**2.** the Tizite, one of David's mighty warriors
s: Probably from [H3068](H3068) and a variation of [H2421](H2421); *Jehovah-revived*; *Jocha*, the name of two Israelites: - Joha.
o: probably from [H3068](H3068) and a variation of [H2421](H2421)

d:
Johanan = "Jehovah has graced"
**1.** a priest during the high priesthood of Joiakim who returned with Zerubbabel
**2.** a Jewish captain after the fall of Jerusalem
**3.** the eldest son of king Josiah
**4.** a post-exilic prince of the line of David
**5.** father of Azariah, priest in Solomon's time
**6.** a Benjamite, one of David's mighty warriors
**7.** a Gadite, one of David's mighty warriors
**8.** a returning exile
s: A form of [H3076](H3076); *Jochanan*, the name of nine Israelites: - Johanan.

d:
Joiada or Jehoiada = "Jehovah knows"
**1.** son of Paseah, who assisted to repair the old gate of Jerusalem
**2.** son of the high priest Eliashib in the time of Nehemiah
s: A form of [H3077](H3077); *Jojada*, the name of two Israelites: - Jehoiada, Joiada.

d:
Jehoiachin = "Jehovah establishes"
**1.** king of Judah, son of Jehoiakim, and the next to last king of Judah before the Babylonian captivity; kingship lasted for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar who took him to Babylon and imprisoned him for 36 years when he was finally released
s: A form of [H3078](H3078); *Jojakin*, an Israelite king: - Jehoiachin.

d:
Joiakim or Jehoiakim = "Jehovah raises up"
**1.** a priest and son of Jeshua the high priest
s: A form of [H3079](H3079); *Jojakim*, an Israelite: - Joiakim. Compare [H3137](H3137).

d:
Joiarib = "Jehovah contends"
**1.** the head of the 1st of the 24 courses of priests in David's time
**2.** a teacher in the time of Ezra
**3.** a Judaite in the time of Nehemiah
s: A form of [H3080](H3080); *Jojarib*, the name of four Israelites: - Joiarib.

d:
Jochebed = "Jehovah is glory"
**1.** the daughter of Levi, wife and at the same time aunt of Amram, and the mother of Moses, Aaron, and Miriam
s: From [H3068](H3068) contracted and [H3513](H3513); *Jehovah-gloried*; *Jokebed*, the mother of Moses: - Jochebed.

d:
Jucal = "Jehovah is able"
**1.** a son of Shelemiah and a servant of king Zedekiah whom he sent to Jeremiah to entreat his prayers and advice
s: A form of [H3081](H3081); *Jukal*, an Israelite: - Jucal.

d:
**1.** day, time, year
		**a.** day (as opposed to night)
		**b.** day (24 hour period)
				**1.** as defined by evening and morning in Genesis 1
				**2.** as a division of time
						**a.** a working day, a day's journey
		**c.** days, lifetime (pl.)
		**d.** time, period (general)
		**e.** year
		**f.** temporal references
				**1.** today
				**2.** yesterday
				**3.** tomorrow
s: From an unused root meaning to *be* *hot*; a *day* (as the *warm* hours), whether literally (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figuratively (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverbially): - age, + always, + chronicles, continually (-ance), daily, (\[birth-\], each, to) day, (now a, two) days (agone), + elder, X end, + evening, + (for) ever (-lasting, -more), X full, life, as (so) long as (. . . live), (even) now, + old, + outlived, + perpetually, presently, + remaineth, X required, season, X since, space, then, (process of) time, + as at other times, + in trouble, weather, (as) when, (a, the, within a) while (that), X whole (+ age), (full) year (-ly), + younger.
o: from an unused root meaning to be hot

d:
**1.** day
**2.** day always refers to a twenty-four hour period when the word is modified by a definite or cardinal number
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3117](H3117); a *day: -* day (by day), time.

d:
adv
**1.** by day, in the daytime
subst
**2.** daytime
s: From [H3117](H3117); *daily: -* daily, (by, in the) day (-time).

d:
Javan = "Ionia" or "Greece"
n pr m
**1.** a son of Japheth and grandson of Noah
n pr loc
**2.** Greece, Ionia, Ionians
		**a.** location of descendants of Javan
s: Probably from the same as [H3196](H3196); *effervescing* (that is, hot and active); *Javan*, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (*Ionians*, that is, Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia: - Javan.

d: **1.** mire, mirer
s: From the same as [H3196](H3196); properly *dregs* (as *effervescing*); hence *mud: -* mire, miry.

d:
Jonadab or Jehonadab = "Jehovah is willing"
**1.** a son of Rechab, chief of the Rechabites, in the time of Jehu and Ahab
**2.** a nephew of David
s: A form of [H3082](H3082); *Jonadab*, the name of an Israelite and of a Rechabite: - Jonadab.

d: **1.** dove, pigeon
s: Probably from the same as [H3196](H3196); a *dove* (apparently from the *warmth* of their mating): - dove, pigeon.

d:
Jonah = "dove"
**1.** son of Amittai and a native of Gath-hepher; 5th of the minor prophets who prophesied during the reign of Jeroboam II and whom God sent also to prophecy to Nineveh
s: The same as [H3123](H3123); *Jonah*, an Israelite: - Jonah.

d: **1.** Grecian, Ionian
s: Patronymic from [H3121](H3121); a *Jevanite*, or descendant of Javan: - Grecian.

d: **1.** sucker, suckling, sapling, young plant
s: Active participle of [H3243](H3243); a *sucker*; hence a *twig* (of a tree felled and sprouting): - tender plant.

d: **1.** young plant, twig, young shoot
s: Feminine of [H3126](H3126); a *sprout: -* (tender) branch, young twig.

d:
Jonath-elem-recho-kim = "the silent dove of far-off places"
**1.** meaning uncertain
		**a.** probably name of melody
		**b.** only used in title of Ps 56:1
s: From [H3123](H3123) and [H482](H482) and the plural of [H7350](H7350); *dove* *of* (the) *silence* (that is, *dumb* Israel) *of* (that is, among) *distances* (that is, strangers); the title of a ditty (used for a name of its melody): - Jonath-elem-rechokim.

d:
Jonathan or Jehonathan = "Jehovah has given"
**1.** a son of king Saul and a friend of David
**2.** a son of the high priest Abiathar and the last descendant of Eli of whom we hear
**3.** one of David's mighty warriors
**4.** a Levite and father of Zechariah, a priest who blew the trumpet at the dedication of the wall
**5.** a son of Kareah and a brother of Johanan; a Judaite captain after the fall of Jerusalem
**6.** another Judaite
**7.** father of Ebed in the time of Ezra
**8.** son of Asahel in the time of Ezra
**9.** a priest of the family of Melicu in the time of Nehemiah
**10.** son of Joiada and his successor to the high priesthood in the time of Nehemiah
s: A form of [H3083](H3083); *Jonathan*, the name of ten Israelites: - Jonathan.

d:
Joseph = "Jehovah has added"
**1.** the eldest son of Jacob by Rachel
**2.** father of Igal, who represented the tribe of Issachar among the spies
**3.** a son of Asaph
**4.** a man who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
**5.** a priest of the family of Shebaniah in the time of Nehemiah
s: Future of [H3254](H3254); *let* *him* *add* (or perhaps simply active participle *adding*); *Joseph*, the name of seven Israelites: - Joseph. Compare [H3084](H3084).

d:
Josiphiah = "Jehovah adds"
**1.** father or ancestor of Shelomith who returned with Ezra
s: From active participle of [H3254](H3254) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* (is) *adding*; *Josiphjah*, an Israelite: - Josiphiah.

d:
Joelah = "may he avail"
**1.** son of Jeroham of Gedor and one of David's mighty warriors
s: Perhaps feminine active participle of [H3276](H3276); *furthermore*; *Joelah*, an Israelite: - Joelah.

d:
Joed = "Jehovah is witness"
**1.** a Benjamite, son of Pedaiah
s: Apparently active participle of [H3259](H3259); *appointer*; *Joed*, an Israelite: - Joed.

d:
Joezer = "Jehovah is help"
**1.** a Korhite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag
s: From [H3068](H3068) and [H5828](H5828); *Jehovah* (is his) *help*; *Joezer*, an Israelite: - Joezer.

d:
Joash = "Jehovah hastens"
**1.** a Benjamite, son of Becher
**2.** one of the officers in David's court
s: From [H3068](H3068) and [H5789](H5789); *Jehovah-hastened*; *Joash*, the name of two Israelites: - Joash.

d:
Jozadak = "Jehovah is righteous"
**1.** grandson of the high priest Hilkiah; son of the high priest Seraiah; and father of the high priest Joshua; he never attained the office of high priest himself because he was carried captive to Babylon by Nebuchadnezzar
s: A form of [H3087](H3087); *Jotsadak*, an Israelite: - Jozadak.

d:
Jokim = "Jehovah raises up"
**1.** a descendant of Judah
s: A form of [H3113](H3113); *Jokim*, an Israelite: - Jokim.

d:
**1.** early rain, autumn shower

s: Active participle of [H3384](H3384); *sprinkling*; hence a *sprinkling* (or autumnal showers): - first rain, former \[rain\].

d:
Jorah = "he instructs"
**1.** the head or ancestor of a family who returned from Babylon with Ezra
s: From [H3384](H3384); *rainy*; *Jorah*, an Israelite: - Jorah.

d:
Jorai = "Jehovah has taught me"
**1.** one of the Gadites dwelling at Gilead in Bashan in the reign of king Jotham of Judah
s: From [H3384](H3384); *rainy*; *Jorai*, an Israelite: - Jorai.

d:
Joram = "Jehovah is exalted"
**1.** son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and himself king of Judah for 8 years; his wife was the wicked Athaliah who was probably the instigator for his returning the nation of Judah to the worship of Baal
**2.** son of king Ahab of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel himself for 12 years; he was murdered by Jehu on the plot of land for which his father had murdered Naboth thus fulfilling the prophecy of Elijah to the very letter
**3.** a Levite in the time of David and an ancestor of Shelomith
**4.** son of Toi, king of Hamath
s: A form of [H3088](H3088); *Joram*, the name of three Israelites and one Syrian: - Joram.

d:
Jushab-hesed = "whose love is returned"
**1.** son of Zerubbabel
s: From [H7725](H7725) and [H2617](H2617); *kindness* *will* *be* *returned*; *Jushab-Chesed*, an Israelites: - Jushab-heshed.

d:
Josibiah = "Jehovah causes to dwell"
**1.** a Simeonite, father of Jehu
s: From [H3427](H3427) and [H3050](H3050); *Jehovah* *will* *cause* *to* *dwell*; *Joshibjah*, an Israelite: - Josibiah.

d:
Joshah = "Jehovah makes equal"
**1.** a prince of the house of Simeon
s: Probably a form of [H3145](H3145); *Joshah*, an Israelite: - Joshah.

d:
Joshaviah = "Jehovah makes equal"
**1.** son of Elnaam and one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H3068](H3068) and [H7737](H7737); *Jehovah-set*; *Joshavjah*, an Israelite: - Joshaviah. Compare [H3144](H3144).

d:
Joshaphat or Jehoshaphat = "Jehovah judges"
n pr m
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors
**2.** a priest and trumpeter in the time of David
s: A form of [H3092](H3092); *Joshaphat*, an Israelite: - Joshaphat.

d:
Jotham = "Jehovah is perfect"
**1.** son of king Uzziah of Judah by Jerushah; king of Judah for 16 years and contemporary with Isaiah and king Pekah of Israel
**2.** son of Jahdai and a descendant of Caleb and Judah
**3.** youngest son of Gideon who escaped from the massacre of his brothers
s: From [H3068](H3068) and [H8535](H8535); *Jehovah* (is) *perfect*; *Jotham*, the name of three Israelites: - Jotham.

n m
**1.** superiority, advantage, excess
adv
**2.** excess, better
conj
**3.** besides, moreover, more
s: Active participle of [H8498](H8498); properly *redundant*; hence *over* *and* *above*, as adjective, noun, adverb or conjugation: - better, more (-over), over, profit.

d:
Jeziel = "the assembly of God"
**1.** a Benjamite and one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag
s: From an unused root (meaning to *sprinkle*) and [H410](H410); *sprinkled* *of* *God*; *Jezavel*, an Israelite: - Jeziel \[from the margin\].

d:
Jeziah = "Jehovah sprinkles"

s: From the same as the first part of [H3149](H3149) and [H3050](H3050); *sprinkled* *of* *Jah*; *Jizzijah*, an Israelite: - Jeziah.
o: from the same as the first part of [H3149](H3149) and [H3050](H3050)

d:
Jaziz = "He makes prominent"
**1.** a Hagarite, officer of David in charge of the flocks
s: From the same as [H2123](H2123); *he* *will* *make* *prominent*; *Jaziz*, an Israelite: - Jaziz.

d:
Jezliah = "whom God will preserve"
**1.** a Benjamite of the sons of Elpaal
s: Perhaps from an unused root (meaning to *draw* *up*); *he* *will* *draw* *out*; *Jizliah*, an Israelite: - Jezliah.
o: perhaps from an unused root (meaning to draw up)

d:
Jezaniah = "Jehovah has listened"
**1.** son of Hoshaiah the Maachathite and one of the captains who escaped from Jerusalem during the last siege of the Babylonians; one of the first to return to Gedaliah at Mizpah where he took a prominent part after the assassination of Gedaliah
s: Probably for [H2970](H2970); *Jezanjah*, an Israelite: - Jezaniah.

s: From an unused root mean to *ooze*; *sweat*, that is, (by implication) a *sweating* dress: - any thing that causeth sweat.
o: from an unused root mean to ooze

d:
Izrahite = "descendant of Zerah"
**1.** a descendant of Zerah of Judah
s: A variation for [H250](H250); a Jizrach (that is, Ezrachite or Zarchite) or descendant of Zerach: - Izrahite.

d:
Izrahiah or Jezrahiah = "Jehovah will shine"
**1.** a chieftain of Issachar
**2.** a Levite and leader of the chorus at the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem under Nehemiah
s: From [H2224](H2224) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *shine*; *Jizrachjah*, the name of two Israelites: - Izrahiah, Jezrahiah.

d:
Jezreel = "God sows"
n pr m
**1.** a descendant of the father or founder of Etam of Judah
**2.** first son of Hosea the prophet
n pr loc
**3.** a city in the Nekeb of Judah
**4.** a city in Issachar on the northwest spur of Mount Gilboa
s: From [H2232](H2232) and [H410](H410); *God* *will* *sow*; *Jizreel*, the name of two places in Palestine and of two Israelites: - Jezreel.

d:
Jezreelite = see Jezreel "sown of God"
**1.** an inhabitant of Jezreel
s: Patronymic from [H3157](H3157); a *Jizreelite* or native of Jizreel: - Jezreelite.

d:
Jezreelitess = see Jezreel "sown of God"
**1.** a female inhabitant of Jezreel
		**a.** used only of Ahinoam, a wife of David
s: Feminine of [H3158](H3158); a *Jezreelitess: -* Jezreelitess.

d:
Jehubbah = "hidden"
**1.** a man of Asher, son of Shomer or Shamer of the house of Beriah
s: From [H2247](H2247); *hidden*; *Jechubbah*, an Israelite: - Jehubbah.

d:
**1.** to join, unite, be joined, be united

		**b.** (Piel) to unite
s: A primitive root; to *be* (or become) *one: -* join, unite.

d:
n m
**1.** union, unitedness
adv
**2.** together, altogether, all together, alike
s: From [H3161](H3161); properly a *unit*, that is, (adverbially) *unitedly: -* alike, at all (once), both, likewise, only, (al-) together, withal.

d:
Jahdo = "His unity"
**1.** a Gileadite, son of Buz and father of Jeshishai
s: From [H3162](H3162) with pronominal suffix; *his* *unity*, that is, (adverbially) *together*; *Jachdo*, an Israelite: - Jahdo.

d:
Jahdiel = "my unity is God"
**1.** a chief of Manasseh on the east of the Jordan
s: From [H3162](H3162) and [H410](H410); *unity* *of* *God*; *Jachdiel*, an Israelite: - Jahdiel.

d:
Jehdeiah = "Jehovah is unity"
**1.** a Levite in the time of David
**2.** a Meronothite, officer of David in charge of the she-asses
s: From [H3162](H3162) and [H3050](H3050); *unity* *of* *Jah*; *Jechdijah*, the name of two Israelites: - Jehdeiah.

d:
Jahaziel = "beheld of God"
**1.** a Benjamite warrior who joined David at Ziklag
**2.** a priest in the reign of David who helped move the ark
**3.** a Kohathite Levite, 3rd son of Hebron
**4.** a Levite, son of Zechariah, of the sons of Asaph, in the reign of Jehoshaphat
**5.** an ancestor of one of the families who returned from exile with Ezra
s: From [H2372](H2372) and [H410](H410); *beheld* *of* *God*; *Jachaziel*, the name of five Israelites: - Jahaziel, Jahziel.

d:
Jahaziah = "Jehovah views"
**1.** son of Tikvah, apparently a priest and leader during the time of Ezra
s: From [H2371](H2371) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *behold*; *Jachzejah*, an Israelite: - Jahaziah.

d:
Ezekiel or Jehezekel = "God strengthens"
**1.** son of Buzi and a priest and prophet; author of the book by his name; taken captive with Jehoiachin and exiled in Babylon where he prophesied for the next 22 years
**2.** a priest in charge of the 20th course in the time of David
s: From [H2388](H2388) and [H410](H410); *God* *will* *strengthen*; *Jechezkel*, the name of two Israelites: - Ezekiel, Jehezekel.

d:
Hezekiah or Jehizkiah = "Jehovah has made strong"
**1.** son of king Ahazby Abi or Abijah and the 12th king of Judah; his reign was characterised by his godly conduct; reigned for 29 years
**2.** head of a family of returning exiles in the time of Nehemiah
**3.** an Ephraimite in the time of Ahaz
s: From [H3388](H3388) and [H3050](H3050); *strengthened* *of* *Jah*; *Jechizkijah*, the name of five Israelites: - Hezekiah, Jehizkiah. Compare [H2396](H2396).

d:
Jahzerah = "whom God leads back"
**1.** a priest of the house of Immer
s: From the same as [H2386](H2386); perhaps *protection*; *Jachzerah*, an Israelite: - Jahzerah.

d:
Jehiel = "God lives"
**1.** a Levite and one of the chief musicians in the time of David
**2.** a Gershonite Levite who had charge of the treasures in the time of David
**3.** son of Hachmoni and an officer of David and tutor of David's sons
**4.** a son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah put to death by his brother Jehoram
**5.** Hemanite who took part in the restoration of king Hezekiah
**6.** a Levite and overseer in the time of Hezekiah
**7.** a ruler of the temple during the reforms of Josiah
**8.** father of Obadiah of the sons of Joab in the time of Ezra
**9.** father of Shechaniah of the sons of Elam in the time of Ezra
**10.** a son of Elam who put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra
**11.** a priest of the sons of Harim who also had to put away his foreign wife in the time of Ezra
s: From [H2421](H2421) and [H410](H410); *God* *will* *live*; *Jechiel* (or *Jechavel*), the name of eight Israelites: - Jehiel.

d:
Jehieli = "God shall save alive" or "swept away of God"
**1.** a Gershonite Levite of the family of Laadan
s: Patronymic from [H3171](H3171); a *Jechielite* or descendant of Jechiel: - Jehieli.

d:
adj
**1.** only, only one, solitary, one
		**a.** only, unique, one
		**b.** solitary
		**c.** (TWOT) only begotten son
subst
**2.** one
s: From [H3161](H3161); properly *united*, that is, *sole*; by implication *beloved*; also *lonely*; (feminine) the *life* (as not to be replace): - darling, desolate, only (child, son), solitary.

d:
Jehiah = "Jehovah lives"
**1.** doorkeeper of the ark at the time of its establishment in Jerusalem
s: From [H2421](H2421) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *live*; *Jechijah*, an Israelite: - Jehiah.

d: **1.** waiting, hoping
s: From [H3176](H3176); *expectant: -* should hope.

d:
**1.** to wait, hope, expect
		**a.** (Niphal) to wait
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to wait, await, tarry
				**2.** to wait for, hope for
		**c.** (Hiphil) to wait, tarry, wait for, hope for
s: A primitive root; to *wait*; by implication to *be* *patient*, *hope: -* (cause to, have, make to) hope, be pained, stay, tarry, trust, wait.

d:
Jahleel = "God waits"
**1.** the 3rd of the 3 sons of Zebulun; founder of the family of the Jahleelites
s: From [H3176](H3176) and [H410](H410); *expectant* *of* *God*; *Jachleel*, an Israelite: - Jahleel.

d:
Jahleelites = "the hope of God"
**1.** descendants of Jahleel of the tribe of Zebulun
s: Patronymic from [H3177](H3177); a *Jachleelite* or descendant of Jachleel: - Jahleelites.

d:
**1.** to be hot, conceive
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be hot, become hot
				**2.** to mate (of animals)
				**3.** to be or become hot (fig. of anger)
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to conceive (sexually)
				**2.** to be in heat (of animals)
s: A primitive root; Probably to *be* *hot*; figuratively to *conceive: -* get heat, be hot, conceive, be warm.

d:
**1.** roebuck
		**a.** a kind of deer, reddish in colour
		**b.** perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning unknown
s: From [H2560](H2560); a kind of *deer* (from the color; compare [H2548](H2548)): - fallow deer.

d:
Jahmai = "whom Jehovah guards"
**1.** a man of Issachar and one of the heads of the family of Tola
s: Probably from [H3179](H3179); *hot*; *Jachmai*, an Israelite: - Jahmai.

d:
**1.** barefoot
		**a.** bareness, being unshod (subst)
s: From an unused root meaning to *take* *off* *the* *shoes*; *unsandalled: -* barefoot, being unshod.
o: from an unused root meaning to take off the shoes

d:
Jahzeel = "God divides"
**1.** the 1st of the 4 sons of Naphtali and founder of the family of Jahzeelites
s: From [H2673](H2673) and [H410](H410); *God* *will* *allot*; *Jachtseel*, an Israelite: - Jahzeel. Compare [H3185](H3185).

d:
Jahzeelites = see Jahzeel "God divides"
**1.** the descendants of Jahzeel, the 1st son of Naphtali
s: Patronymic from [H3183](H3183); a *Jachtseelite* (collectively) or descendant of Jachtseel: - Jahzeelites.

d:
Jahziel = "God divides"
**1.** the 1st of the 4 sons of Naphtali and founder of the family of Jahzeelites
s: From [H2673](H2673) and [H410](H410); *allotted* *of* *God*; *Jachtsiel*, an Israelite: - Jahziel. Compare [H3183](H3183).

d: **1.** (Qal) to delay, tarry, defer
s: A primitive root; to *delay: -* tarry longer.

d: **1.** (Hithpael) to reckon genealogically, enrol on a genealogy, enrol, be enrolled
s: A primitive root; to *sprout*; used only as denominative from [H3188](H3188); to *enroll* by pedigree: - (number after, number throughout the) genealogy (to be reckoned), be reckoned by genealogies.

d: **1.** genealogy
s: From [H3187](H3187); a *pedigree* or family list (as *growing* spontaneously): - genealogy.

d:
Jahath = "He will snatch up"
**1.** son of Reaiah and grandson of Shobal of the tribe of Judah
**2.** a son of Libni and grandson of Gershom and great grandson of Levi
**3.** a Gershonite Levite; the eldest son of Shimei and the grandson of Laadan; founder of the house of Jahath
**4.** a Levite and son of Shelomoth
**5.** a Merarite Levite in the reign of Josiah
s: From [H3161](H3161); *unity*; *Jachath*, the name of four Israelites: - Jahath.

d:
**1.** to be good, be pleasing, be well, be glad
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be glad, be joyful
				**2.** to be well placed
				**3.** to be well for, be well with, go well with
				**4.** to be pleasing, be pleasing to
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to make glad, rejoice
				**2.** to do good to, deal well with
				**3.** to do well, do thoroughly
				**4.** to make a thing good or right or beautiful
				**5.** to do well, do right
s: A primitive root; to *be* (causatively) *make* *well*, literally (*sound*, *beautiful*) or figuratively (*happy*, *successful*, *right*): - be accepted, amend, use aright, benefit, be (make) better, seem best, make cheerful, be comely, + be content, diligent (-ly), dress, earnestly, find favour, give, be glad, do (be, make) good (\[-ness\]), be (make) merry, please (+ well), shew more \[kindness\], skilfully, X very small, surely, make sweet, thoroughly, tire, trim, very, be (can, deal, entreat, go, have) well \[said, seen \].

d: **1.** (P'al) to be good, do good, be pleasing
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3190](H3190): - seem good.

d:
Jotbah = "pleasing"
**1.** a city in Judah, hometown of Meshullemeth, wife of king Manasseh
		**a.** site unknown
s: From [H3190](H3190); *pleasantness*; *Jotbah*, a place in Palestine: - Jotbah.

d:
Jotbath or Jotbathah = "pleasantness"
**1.** a stopping place in the wilderness; site unknown
s: From [H3192](H3192); *Jotbathah*, a place in the Desert: - Jotbath, Jotbathah.

d:
Juttah = "stretched out"
**1.** a town in the mountains of Judah, in the neighbourhood of Maon and Carmel; modern 'Yutta'
s: From [H5186](H5186); *extended*; *Juttah* (or *Jutah*), a place in Palestine: - Juttah.

d:
Jetur = "enclosed"
**1.** a son of Ishmael whose descendants warred with Israel east of the Jordan
		**a.** also called 'Ituraea'
s: Probably from the same as [H2905](H2905); *encircled* (that is, inclosed); *Jetur*, a son of Ishmael: - Jetur.

d: **1.** wine
s: From an unused root meaning to *effervesce*; *wine* (as fermented); by implication *intoxication: -* banqueting, wine, wine \[-bibber\].
o: from an unused root meaning to effervesce

d: **1.** hand, (way)side
s: By erroneous transcription for [H3027](H3027); a *hand* or *side: -* \[way-\] side.

d:
**1.** to prove, decide, judge, rebuke, reprove, correct, be right
		**a.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to decide, judge
				**2.** to adjudge, appoint
				**3.** to show to be right, prove
				**4.** to convince, convict
				**5.** to reprove, chide
				**6.** to correct, rebuke
		**b.** (Hophal) to be chastened
		**c.** (Niphal) to reason, reason together
		**d.** (Hithp) to argue
s: A primitive root; to *be* *right* (that is, correct); reciprocally to *argue*; causatively to *decide*, *justify* or *convict: -* appoint, argue, chasten, convince, correct (-ion), daysman, dispute, judge, maintain, plead, reason (together), rebuke, reprove (-r), surely, in any wise.

d:
Jachin = "He will establish"
n pr m
**1.** the 4th son of Simeon and founder of the family of Jachinites
**2.** a priest and the head of the 21st coursein the time of David
**3.** a post-exilic priest in the time of Nehemiah
n pr
**4.** name of the right-hand pillar before the temple
s: From [H3559](H3559); *he* (or *it*) *will* *establish*; *Jakin*, the name of three Israelites and of a temple pillar: - Jachin.

d:
Jachinites = see Jachin "he will establish"
**1.** the descendants of Jachin
s: Patronymic from [H3199](H3199); a *Jakinite* (collectively) or descendant of Jakin: - Jachinites.

d:
**1.** to prevail, overcome, endure, have power, be able
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be able, be able to gain or accomplish, be able to endure, be able to reach
				**2.** to prevail, prevail over or against, overcome, be victor
				**3.** to have ability, have strength
s: A primitive root; to *be* *able*, literally (*can*, *could*) or morally (*may*, *might*): - be able, any at all (ways), attain, can (away with, \[-not\]), could, endure, might, overcome, have power, prevail, still, suffer.

d:
**1.** to be able
		**a.** (P'al)
				**1.** to be able
				**2.** to prevail
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3201](H3201): - be able, can, couldest, prevail.

d:
Jecoliah or Jecholiah = "Jehovah is able"
**1.** wife of king Amaziah of Judah and mother of king Uzziah (Azariah)
s: From [H3201](H3201) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *enable*; *Jekoljah* or *Jekiljah*, an Israelitess: - Jecholiah, Jecoliah.

d:
Jeconiah = "Jehovah will establish"
**1.** son of king Jehoiakim of Judah and king of Judah for 3 months and 10 days before he surrendered to Nebuchadnezzar and was taken captive to Babylon where he was imprisoned for the next 36 years; released at the death of Nebuchadnezzar and lived in Babylon until his death
		**a.** primary spelling 'Jehoiachin'
s: From [H3559](H3559) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *establish*; *Jekonjah*, a Jewish king: - Jeconiah. Compare [H3659](H3659).

d:
**1.** to bear, bringforth, beget, gender, travail
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to bear, bring forth
						**a.** of child birth
						**b.** of distress (simile)
						**c.** of wicked (behaviour)
				**2.** to beget
		**b.** (Niphal) to be born
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to cause or help to bring forth
				**2.** to assist or tend as a midwife
				**3.** midwife (participle)
		**d.** (Pual) to be born
		**e.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to beget (a child)
				**2.** to bear (fig. -of wicked bringing forth iniquity)
		**f.** (Hophal) day of birth, birthday (infinitive)
		**g.** (Hithpael) to declare one's birth (pedigree)
s: A primitive root; to *bear* young; causatively to *beget*; medically to *act* *as* *midwife*; specifically to *show* *lineage: -* bear, beget, birth (\[-day\]), born, (make to) bring forth (children, young), bring up, calve, child, come, be delivered (of a child), time of delivery, gender, hatch, labour, (do the office of a) midwife, declare pedigrees, be the son of, (woman in, woman that) travail (-eth, -ing woman).

d:
**1.** child, son, boy, offspring, youth
		**a.** child, son, boy
		**b.** child, children
		**c.** descendants
		**d.** youth
		**e.** apostate Israelites (fig.)
s: From [H3205](H3205); something *born*, that is, a *lad* or *offspring: -* boy, child, fruit, son, young man (one).

d: **1.** girl, damsel, marriageable girl
s: Feminine of [H3206](H3206); a *lass: -* damsel, girl.

d: **1.** childhood, youth
s: Abstract from [H3206](H3206); *boyhood* (or *girlhood*): - childhood, youth.

d: **1.** born
s: Passive from [H3205](H3205); *born: -* born.

d:
Jalon = "Jehovah lodges"
**1.** a son of Ezra and a descendant of Caleb
s: From [H3885](H3885); *lodging*; *Jalon*, an Israelite: - Jalon.

d: **1.** born
s: From [H3205](H3205); *born: -* (\[home-\]) born, child, son.

d:
**1.** to go, walk, come
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to go, walk, come, depart, proceed, move, go away
				**2.** to die, live, manner of life (fig.)
		**b.** (Hiphil) to lead, bring, lead away, carry, cause to walk
s: A primitive root (compare [H1980](H1980)); to *walk* (literally or figuratively); causatively to *carry* (in various senses): -  X again, away, bear, bring, carry (away), come (away), depart, flow, + follow (-ing), get (away, hence, him), (cause to, make) go (away, -ing, -ne, one’s way, out), grow, lead (forth), let down, march, prosper, + pursue, cause to run, spread, take away (\[-journey\]), vanish, (cause to) walk (-ing), wax, X be weak.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to howl, wail, make a howling
s: A primitive root; to *howl* (with a wailing tone) or *yell* (with a boisterous one): - (make to) howl, be howling.

d: **1.** a howling (of beasts)
s: From [H3213](H3213); a *howl: -* howling.

d: **1.** a howling (of distress), wailing
s: Feminine of [H3214](H3214); a *howling: -* howling.

d:
**1.** (Qal) to speak rashly, talk wildly
		**a.** (TWOT) to swallow, swallow down
s: A primitive root; to *blurt* or utter inconsiderately: - devour.

d: **1.** scab, skin sore, scales, scurf, an eruptive disease
s: From an unused root apparently meaning to *stick* or *scrape*; *scurf* or *tetter: -* scabbed.
o: from an unused root apparently meaning to stick or scrape

d:
**1.** young locust (early stage of development)
		**a.** caterpillar (as devouring)
s: From an unused root meaning to *lick* up; a *devourer*; specifically the young *locust: -* cankerworm, caterpillar.
o: from an unused root meaning to lick up

d: **1.** wallet, purse, pouch, bag, receptacle
s: From [H3950](H3950); a travelling *pouch* (as if for gleanings): - scrip.

d:
**1.** sea
		**a.** Mediterranean Sea
		**b.** Red Sea
		**c.** Dead Sea
		**d.** Sea of Galilee
		**e.** sea (general)
		**f.** mighty river (Nile)
		**g.** the sea (the great basin in the temple court)
		**h.** seaward, west, westward
s: From an unused root meaning to *roar*; a *sea* (as breaking in *noisy* surf) or large body of water; specifically (with the article) the Mediterranean; sometimes a large *river*, or an artificial *basin*; locally, the *west*, or (rarely) the *south: -* sea (X -faring man, \[-shore\]), south, west (-ern, side, -ward).
o: from an unused root meaning to roar

s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3220](H3220): - sea.

d: **1.** meaning uncertain, meaning perhaps mules or hot springs
s: From the same as [H3117](H3117); a *warm* spring: - mule.

d:
Jemuel = "day of God"
**1.** the eldest son of Simeon
s: From [H3117](H3117) and [H410](H410); *day* *of* *God*; *Jemuel*, an Israelite: - Jemuel.

d:
Jemima = "day by day"
**1.** one of the daughters of Job born after the restoration
s: Perhaps from the same as [H3117](H3117); properly *warm*, that is, *affectionate*; hence *dove* (compare [H3123](H3123)); *Jemimah*, one of Job’s daughters: - Jemimah.

d:
**1.** right, right hand, right side
		**a.** right hand
		**b.** right (of direction)
		**c.** south (the direction of the right hand when facing East)
s: From [H3231](H3231); the *right* hand or side (leg, eye) of a person or other object (as the *stronger* and more dexterous); locally, the *south: -*  + left-handed, right (hand, side), south.

d:
Jamin = "right hand"
**1.** the 2nd son of Simeon; founder of the family of Jaminites
**2.** a Judaite, the 2nd son of Ram the Jerahmeelite
**3.** a Levite who helped Ezra interpret the Law
s: The same as [H3225](H3225); *Jamin*, the name of three Israelites: - Jamin. See also [H1144](H1144).

d: **1.** right, on the right, right hand
s: For [H3225](H3225); *right: -* (on the) right (hand).

d:
Jaminites = see Jamin "the right hand"
**1.** the descendants of Jamin
s: Patronymic from [H3226](H3226); a *Jeminite* (collectively) or descendant of Jamin: - Jaminites. See also [H1145](H1145).

d:
Imlah or Imla = "whom God will fill up"
**1.** father of Michaiah the prophet
s: From [H4390](H4390); *full*; *Jimla* or *Jimlah*, an Israelite: - Imla, Imlah.

d:
Jamlech = "He will reign"
**1.** a chief of the tribe of Simeon
s: From [H4427](H4427); *he* *will* *make* *king*; *Jamlek*, an Israelite: - Jamlech.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to choose the right, go to the right, use the right hand, be right handed
s: A primitive root; to *be* (physically) *right* (that is, firm); but used only as denominative from [H3225](H3225) and transitively, to *be* *right* *handed* or *take* *the* *right* *hand* side: - go (turn) to (on, use) the right hand.

d:
Imna or Imnah or Jimnah = "right hand"
n pr m
**1.** the 1st born son of Asher
**2.** a Levite, descendant of Imnah, who assisted in the reforms of Hezekiah
n patr
**3.** descendants of Imnah, son of Asher
s: From [H3231](H3231); *prosperity* (as betokened by the *right* hand); *Jimnah*, the name of two Israelites; also (with the article) of the posterity of one of them: - Imna, Imnah, Jimnah, Jimnites.

d: **1.** right, right hand
s: From [H3231](H3231); *right* (that is, at the right hand): - (on the) right (hand).

d:
Imna = "He will restrain"
**1.** son of Helem, descendant of Asher, and leader of the tribe of Asher
s: From [H4513](H4513); *he* *will* *restrain*; *Jimna*, an Israelite: - Imna.

d:
**1.** to exchange
		**a.** (Hiphil) to exchange
		**b.** (Hithpael) to enter into, be changed into
**2.** (TWOT) to promise
s: A primitive root; to *exchange*; by implication to *change* *places: -* boast selves, change.

d:
Imrah = "bitterness"
**1.** a descendant of Asher of the family of Zophah and a chief of the tribe
s: Probably from [H3235](H3235); *interchange*; *Jimrah*, an Israelite: - Imrah.

d:
**1.** to touch
		**a.** (Hiphil) to touch, feel
s: A primitive root; to *touch: -* feel.

d:
**1.** to oppress, suppress, treat violently, maltreat, vex, do wrong
		**a.** (Qal) to oppress, suppress
		**b.** (Hiphil) to treat violently, maltreat
s: A primitive root; to *rage* or *be* *violent*; by implication to *suppress*, to *maltreat: -* destroy, (thrust out by) oppress (-ing, -ion, -or), proud, vex, do violence.

d:
Janoah or Janohah = "He rests"
**1.** a place apparently in the north of Galilee in Naphtali, taken by Tiglath-pileser in his first incursion into Palestine
s: From [H3240](H3240); *quiet*; *Janoach* or *Janochah*, a place in Palestine: - Janoah, Janohah.

d:
**1.** to rest
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to rest, settle down and remain
				**2.** to repose, have rest, be quiet
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause to rest, give rest to, make quiet
				**2.** to cause to rest, cause to alight, set down
				**3.** to lay or set down, deposit, let lie, place
				**4.** to let remain, leave
				**5.** to leave, depart from
				**6.** to abandon
				**7.** to permit
		**c.** (Hophal)
				**1.** to obtain rest, be granted rest
				**2.** to be left, be placed
				**3.** open space (subst)
s: A primitive root; to *deposit*; by implication to *allow* *to* *stay*. (The Hiphil forms with the *dagesh* are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to [H5117](H5117), and the others here): - bestow, cast down, lay (down, up), leave (off), let alone (remain), pacify, place, put, set (down), suffer, withdraw, withhold. (The Hiphil forms with the dagesh are here referred to, in accordance with the older grammarians; but if any distinction of the kind is to be made, these should rather be referred to [H5117](H5117), and the others here.)

d:
Janum = "asleep"
**1.** a town in the mountains of Judah apparently not far from Hebron
s: From [H5123](H5123); *asleep*; *Janim*, a place in Palestine: - Janum \[from the margin\].

d: **1.** young plant, twig, young shoot
s: From [H3243](H3243); a *sucker* or sapling: - young twig.

d:
**1.** to suckle, nurse, suck
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to suck
				**2.** suckling, babe (subst)
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to give suck to, nurse
				**2.** nursing, nursing woman, nurse (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *suck*; causatively to *give* *milk: -* milch, nurse (-ing mother), give, make to) suck (-ing child, -ling).

d:
**1.** great owl, eared owl
		**a.** an unclean animal
s: Apparently from [H4398](H4398); an unclean (aquatic) bird; probably the *heron* (perhaps from its *blowing* cry, or because the *night* *heron* is meant (compare [H5399](H5399))): - (great) owl.

d:
**1.** to found, fix, establish, lay foundation
		**a.** (Qal) to found, establish, begin
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to fix or seat themselves close together, sit in conclave
				**2.** to be founded
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to found
				**2.** to establish, appoint, ordain
		**d.** (Pual) to be founded, be laid
		**e.** (Hophal) to be founded
s: A primitive root; to *set* (literally or figuratively); intensively to *found*; reflexively to *sit* down together, that is, *settle*, *consult: -* appoint, take counsel, establish, (lay the, lay for a) found (-ation), instruct, lay, ordain, set, X sure.

d: **1.** a beginning, foundation, that being founded
s: From [H3245](H3245); a *foundation* (figuratively that is, *beginning*): -  X began.

d:
**1.** foundation, base
		**a.** foundation
		**b.** base, bottom
s: From [H3245](H3245); a *foundation* (literally or figuratively): - bottom, foundation, repairing.

d:
**1.** foundation
		**a.** founding of city
s: Feminine of [H3246](H3246); a *foundation: -* foundation.

d: **1.** those departing, revolting
s: From [H5493](H5493); *departing: -* they that depart.

d: **1.** faultfinder, reprover, one who reproves
s: From [H3256](H3256); a *reprover: -* instruct.

d: **1.** (Qal) to anoint, be poured,
s: A primitive root; to *pour* (intransitively): - be poured.

d:
Iscah = "one who looks forth"
**1.** daughter of Haran, niece of Abraham, sister of Lot and Milcah
s: From an unused root meaning to *watch*; *observant*; *Jiskah*, sister of Lot: - Iscah.
o: from an unused root meaning to watch

d:
Ismachiah = "Jehovah sustains"
**1.** a Levite and overseer of the offerings during the revival in the time of king Hezekiah
s: From [H5564](H5564) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *sustain*; *Jismakjah*, an Israelite: - Ismachiah.

d:
**1.** to add, increase, do again
		**a.** (Qal) to add, increase, do again
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to join, join oneself to
				**2.** to be joined, be added to
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause to add, increase
				**2.** to do more, do again
s: A primitive root; to *add* or *augment* (often adverbially to *continue* to do a thing): -  add, X again, X any more, X cease, X come more, + conceive again, continue, exceed, X further, X gather together, get more, give moreover, X henceforth, increase (more and more), join, X longer (bring, do, make, much, put), X (the, much, yet) more (and more), proceed (further), prolong, put, be \[strong-\] er, X yet, yield.

d:
**1.** to add
		**a.** (Hophal) to be added
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3254](H3254): - add.

d:
**1.** to chasten, discipline, instruct, admonish
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to chasten, admonish
				**2.** to instruct
				**3.** to discipline
		**b.** (Niphal) to let oneself be chastened or corrected or admonished
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to discipline, correct
				**2.** to chasten, chastise
		**d.** (Hiphil) to chasten
		**e.** (Nithpael) to teach
s: A primitive root; to *chastise*, literally (with blows) or figuratively (with words); hence to *instruct: -* bind, chasten, chastise, correct, instruct, punish, reform, reprove, sore, teach.

d: **1.** shovel
s: From [H3261](H3261); a *shovel: -* shovel.

d: **1.** (P'al) to burn
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3344](H3344): - burning.

d: **1.** a burning
s: (Chaldee); from [H3345](H3345); a *conflagration: -* burning.

d:
Jokdeam = "burning of a people"
**1.** a city in the mountains of southern Judah; apparently south of Hebron
s: From [H3344](H3344) and [H5971](H5971); *burning* *of* (the) *people*; *Jokdeam*, a place in Palestine: - Jokdeam.

d:
Jakeh = "blameless"
**1.** father of Agur the sage
s: From an unused root probably meaning to *obey*; *obedient*; *Jakeh*, a symbolical name (for Solomon): - Jakeh.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to obey

d: **1.** obedience, cleansing, purging
s: From the same as [H3348](H3348); *obedience: -* gathering, to obey.

d: **1.** a burning
s: From [H3344](H3344); a *burning: -* burning.

d: **1.** living substance, that which stands or exists, existence, substance
s: From [H6965](H6965); properly *standing* (extant), that is, by implication a *living* *thing: -* (living) substance.

d: **1.** fowler, bait-layer
s: From [H3369](H3369); properly *entangling*; hence a *snarer: -* fowler.

d: **1.** fowler, trapper, bait-layer
s: Passive participle of [H3369](H3369); properly *entangled*, that is, by implication (intransitively) a *snare*, or (transitively) a *snarer: -* fowler, snare.

d:
Jekuthiel = "cleansing of God"
**1.** a descendant of Caleb of the tribe of Judah
s: From the same as [H3348](H3348) and [H410](H410); *obedience* *of* *God*; *Jekuthiel*, an Israelite: - Jekuthiel.

d:
Joktan = "smallness"
**1.** son of Eber and descendant of Shem and patriarch of various Arabian tribes
s: From [H6994](H6994); *he* *will* *be* *made* *little*; *Joktan*, an Arabian patriarch: - Joktan.

d:
Jakim = "He will raise"
**1.** a Benjamite and descendant of Shimhi
**2.** a Levite priest in charge of the 12th course in the time of David
s: From [H6965](H6965); *he* *will* *raise*; *Jakim*, the name of two Israelites: - Jakim. Compare [H3079](H3079).

d: **1.** rare, very precious, honour, dear
s: From [H3365](H3365); *precious: -* dear.

d:
**1.** rare, noble, famous, difficult
		**a.** honourable
		**b.** difficult (meton)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3357](H3357): - noble, rare.

d:
Jecamiah or Jekamiah = "Jehovah raises"
**1.** a descendant of Judah, son of Shallum in the line of Ahlai
**2.** a descendant of David and one of the seven introduced into the royal line on the failure of it in the person of Jehoiachin
s: From [H6965](H6965) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *rise*; *Jekamjah*, the name of two Israelites: - Jekamiah. Compare [H3079](H3079).

d:
Jekameam = "let the people rise"
**1.** a Levite, the 4th son of Hebron and grandson of Kohath in the time of David
s: From [H6965](H6965) and [H5971](H5971); (the) *people* *will* *rise*; *Jekamam*, an Israelite: - Jekameam. Compare [H3079](H3079), [H3361](H3361).

d:
Jokmeam = "gathered by the people"
**1.** a city of refuge in Ephraim given to the Kohathite Levites
s: From [H6965](H6965) and [H5971](H5971); (the) *people* *will* *be* *raised*; *Jokmeam*, a place in Palestine: - Jokmeam. Compare [H3360](H3360), [H3362](H3362).

d:
Jokneam = "the people lament"
**1.** a city of Canaan conquered by Joshua and in the territory of Zebulun but allotted to the Merarite Levites and located Mount Carmel
s: From [H6969](H6969) and [H5971](H5971); (the) *people* *will* *be* *lamented*; *Jokneam*, a place in Palestine: - Jokneam.

d:
**1.** to be dislocated, be alienated
		**a.** (Qal) to be dislocated, be torn away, be alienated
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to execute slowly (by exposure or impalation)
				**2.** to hang
		**c.** (Hophal) to be executed
s: A primitive root; properly to *sever* oneself, that is, (by implication) to *be* *dislocated*; figuratively to *abandon*; causatively to *impale* (and thus allow to drop to pieces by *rotting*): - be alienated, depart, hang (up), be out of joint.

d: **1.** (Qal) to awake, awaken, become active
s: A primitive root; to *awake* (intransitively): - (be) awake (-d).

d:
**1.** to esteem, be prized, be valuable, be precious, be costly, be appraised
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be precious, be highly valued, be esteemed, be costly
				**2.** to be appraised
		**b.** (Hiphil) to make something precious
s: A primitive root; properly apparently to *be* *heavy*, that is, (figuratively) *valuable*; causatively to *make* *rare* (figuratively to *inhibit*): - be (make) precious, be prized, be set by, withdraw.

d:
**1.** price, value, preciousness, honour, splendour, pomp
		**a.** preciousness
		**b.** price
		**c.** honour, esteem
s: From [H3365](H3365); value, that is, (concretely) *wealth*; abstractly *costliness*, *dignity: -* honour, precious (things), price.

d: **1.** honour, esteem
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3366](H3366): - glory, honour.

d:
**1.** valuable, prized, weighty, precious, rare, splendid
		**a.** precious
				**1.** costly
				**2.** precious, highly valued
				**3.** precious stones or jewels
		**b.** rare
		**c.** glorious, splendid
		**d.** weighty, influential
s: From [H3365](H3365); *valuable* (objectively or subjectively): - brightness, clear, costly, excellent, fat, honourable women, precious, reputation.

d:
**1.** to lure, entice, snare, lay a snare or lure, set a trap
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to lay snares (fig. of devices of wicked)
				**2.** fowlers (participle)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be ensnared, be caught by a bait
		**c.** (Pual) to be entrapped
s: A primitive root; to *ensnare* (literally or figuratively): - fowler (lay a) snare.

d:
Jokshan = "snarer"
**1.** a son of Abraham by Keturah and father of Sheba and Dedan
s: From [H3369](H3369); *insidious*; *Jokshan*, an Arabian patriarch: - Jokshan.

d:
Joktheel = "the blessedness of God"
**1.** a city in the low country of Judah named next to Lachish
**2.** the name given to the cliff which was the stronghold of Edom by king Amaziah after capturing it; also called 'Selah' and 'Petra'
s: Probably from the same as [H3348](H3348) and [H410](H410); *veneration* *of* *God* (compare [H3354](H3354)); *Joktheel*, the name of a place in Palestine, and of one in Idumaea: - Joktheel.
o: probably from the same as [H3348](H3348) and [H410](H410)

d:
**1.** to fear, revere, be afraid
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to fear, be afraid
				**2.** to stand in awe of, be awed
				**3.** to fear, reverence, honour, respect
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be fearful, be dreadful, be feared
				**2.** to cause astonishment and awe, be held in awe
				**3.** to inspire reverence or godly fear or awe
		**c.** (Piel) to make afraid, terrify
**2.** (TWOT) to shoot, pour
s: A primitive root; to *fear*; morally to *revere*; causatively to *frighten: -* affright, be (make) afraid, dread (-ful), (put in) fear (-ful, -fully, -ing). (be had in) reverence (-end), X see, terrible (act, -ness, thing).

d: **1.** fearing, reverent, afraid
s: From [H3372](H3372); *fearing*; morally *reverent: -* afraid, fear (-ful).

d:
**1.** fear, terror, fearing
		**a.** fear, terror
		**b.** awesome or terrifying thing (object causing fear)
		**c.** fear (of God), respect, reverence, piety
		**d.** revered
s: Feminine of [H3373](H3373); *fear* (also used as infinitive); morally *reverence: -*  X dreadful, X exceedingly, fear (-fulness).

d:
Iron = "fearing"
**1.** a city of Naphtali; site unknown
s: From [H3372](H3372); *fearfulness*; *Jiron*, a place in Palestine: - Iron.

d:
Irijah = "Jehovah sees me"
**1.** son of Shelemiah, a captain of the guard who arrested Jeremiah
s: From [H3373](H3373) and [H3050](H3050); *fearful* *of* *Jah*; *Jirijah*, an Israelite: - Irijah.

d:
Jareb = "contender"
**1.** an epithet given to the king of Assyria
s: From [H7378](H7378); *he* *will* *contend*; *Jareb*, a symbolical name for Assyria: - Jareb. Compare [H3402](H3402).

d:
Jerubbaal = "let Baal contend"
**1.** name given to Gideon by his father when he destroyed the altar of Baal
s: From [H7378](H7378) and [H1168](H1168); *Baal* *will* *contend*; *Jerubbaal*, a symbolical name of Gideon: - Jerubbaal.

d:
Jeroboam = "the people will contend"
**1.** the first king of the northern kingdom of Israel when the kingdom split at the death of Solomon and the 10 tribes split off from Judah and Benjamin and the kingdom under Solomon's son Rehoboam; idolatry was introduced at the beginning of his reign
**2.** the 8th king of the northern kingdom of Israel, son of Joash, and 4th in the dynasty of Jehu; during his reign the Syrian invaders were repelled and the kingdom restored to its former borders but the idolatry of the kingdom was maintained
s: From [H7378](H7378) and [H5971](H5971); (the) *people* *will* *contend*; *Jarobam*, the name of two Israelite kings: - Jeroboam.

d:
Jerubbesheth = "shame will contend"
**1.** a variant name of Jerubbaal (the other name of Gideon [ H03378]) substituting the word 'shame' for the name of the pagan god 'Baal'
s: From [H7378](H7378) and [H1322](H1322); *shame* (that is, the idol) *will* *contend*; *Jerubbesheth*, a symbolical name for Gideon: - Jerubbesheth.

d:
**1.** to go down, descend, decline, march down, sink down
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to go or come down
				**2.** to sink
				**3.** to be prostrated
				**4.** to come down (of revelation)
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to bring down
				**2.** to send down
				**3.** to take down
				**4.** to lay prostrate
				**5.** to let down
		**c.** (Hophal)
				**1.** to be brought down
				**2.** to be taken down
s: A primitive root; to *descend* (literally to *go* *downwards*; or conventionally to a lower region, as the shore, a boundary, the enemy, etc.; or figuratively to *fall*); causatively to *bring* *down* (in all the above applications): -  X abundantly, bring down, carry down, cast down, (cause to) come (-ing) down, fall (down), get down, go (-ing) down (-ward), hang down, X indeed, let down, light (down), put down (off), (cause to, let) run down, sink, subdue, take down.

d:
Jered or Jared = "descent"
**1.** son of Mahalaleel and father of Enoch in the 4th generation from Seth
**2.** a descendant of Judah and father of Gedor
s: From [H3381](H3381); a *descent*; *Jered*, the name of an antediluvian, and of an Israelite: - Jared.

d:
Jordan = "descender"
**1.** the river of Palestine running from the roots of Anti-Lebanon to the Dead Sea a distance of approx 200 miles (320 km)
s: From [H3381](H3381); a *descender*; *Jarden*, the principal river of Palestine: - Jordan.

d:
**1.** to throw, shoot, cast, pour
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to throw, cast
				**2.** to cast, lay, set
				**3.** to shoot arrows
				**4.** to throw water, rain
		**b.** (Niphal) to be shot
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to throw, cast
				**2.** to shoot
				**3.** to point out, show
				**4.** to direct, teach, instruct
				**5.** to throw water, rain
s: A primitive root; properly to *flow* as water (that is, to *rain*); transitively to *lay* or *throw* (especially an arrow, that is, to *shoot*); figuratively to *point* out (as if by *aiming* the finger), to *teach: -*  (+) archer, cast, direct, inform, instruct, lay, shew, shoot, teach (-er, -ing), through.

d:
Jeruel = "taught by God"
**1.** a place in the wilderness of southern Judah
s: From [H3384](H3384) and [H410](H410); *founded* *of* *God*; *Jeruel*, a place in Palestine: - Jeruel

d:
Jaroah = "new moon"
**1.** a chief man of the tribe of Gad
s: Perhaps denominative from [H3394](H3394); (born at the) new *moon*; *Jaroach*, an Israelite: - Jaroah.

d: **1.** greens, green plants, green thing
s: From [H3417](H3417); *green*, that is, an herb: - green thing.

d:
Jerushah or Jerusha = "dispossessor"
**1.** the wife of king Uzziah and mother of king Jotham of Judah
s: Feminine passive participle of [H3423](H3423); *possessed*; *Jerusha* or *Jerushah*, an Israelitess: - Jerusha, Jerushah.

d:
Jerusalem = "teaching of peace"
**1.** the chief city of Palestine and capital of the united kingdom and the nation of Judah after the split
s: A dual (in allusion to its two main hills (the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of [H3390](H3390))); probably from (the passive participle of) [H3384](H3384) and [H7999](H7999); *founded* *peaceful*; *Jerushalaim* or *Jerushalem*, the capital city of Palestine: - Jerusalem.
o: a dual (in allusion to its two main hills \[the true pointing, at least of the former reading, seems to be that of [H3390](H3390)\]), probably from (the passive participle of) [H3384](H3384) and [H7999](H7999)

d:
Jerusalem = "teaching of peace"
**1.** the chief city of Palestine and capital of the united kingdom and the nation of Judah after the split
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3389](H3389): - Jerusalem.

d:
**1.** month (lunar cycle), moon
		**a.** month
		**b.** calendar month
s: From an unused root of uncertain signification; a *lunation*, that is, *month: -* month, moon.
o: from a unused root of uncertain signification

d:
Jerah = "new moon"
**1.** a 4th son of Joktan and a progenitor of an Arabian tribe
s: The same as [H3391](H3391); *Jerach*, an Arabian patriarch: - Jerah.

d: **1.** month
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3391](H3391); a *month: -* month.

d: **1.** moon
s: From the same as [H3391](H3391); the *moon: -* moon.

d:
Jeroham = "showing pity"
**1.** father of Elkanah and grandfather of Samuel of the house of Kohath
**2.** a Benjamite and the founder of a family of Benjamites
**3.** father or progenitor of Ibneiah and a Benjamite; maybe same as 2
**4.** a descendant of Aaron and a priest of the family of Immer; son of Pashur and father of Adaiah
**5.** another priest; maybe same as 4
**6.** a resident of Gedor and father of one of David's mighty warriors
**7.** a Danite whose son or descendant Azareel was head of the tribe in the time of David
**8.** father of Azariah one of the captains with Jehoiada in the time of Athaliah
s: From [H7355](H7355); *compassionate*; *Jerocham*, the name of seven or eight Israelites: - Jeroham.

d:
Jerahmeel = "may God have pity"
**1.** the 1st son of Hezron, grandson of Pharez, and great grandson of Judah and the founder of the family of Jerahmeelites
**2.** officer sent by king Jehoiakim of Judah to arrest Baruch
**3.** a Merarite Levite the representative of the family of Kish, the son of Mahli
s: From [H7355](H7355) and [H410](H410); *God* *will* *compassionate*; *Jerachmeel*, the name of three Israelites: - Jerahmeel.

d:
Jerahmeelites = see Jerahmeel "may God have pity"
**1.** the descendants of Jerahmeel, the great grandson of Judah
s: Patronymic from [H3396](H3396); a *Jerachmeelite* or descendant of Jerachmeel: - Jerahmeelites.

d:
Jarha = "the month of sweeping away"
**1.** the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, about the time of Eli, to whom his master gave his daughter or heir as wife
s: Probably of Egyptian origin; *Jarcha*, an Egyptian: - Jarha.

d:
**1.** to precipitate, be precipitate, push headlong, drive recklessly
		**a.** (Qal) to precipitate, wring out, be precipitate
s: A primitive root; to *precipitate* or *hurl* (*rush*) headlong; (intransitively) to *be* *rash: -* be perverse, turn over.

d:
Jeriel = "taught by God"
**1.** one of the 6 heads of the house of Tola of the tribe of Issachar
s: From [H3384](H3384) and [H410](H410); *thrown* *of* *God*; *Jeriel*, an Israelite: - Jeriel. Compare [H3385](H3385).

d: **1.** contender, opponent, adversary
s: From [H7378](H7378); literally *he* *will* *contend*; properly adjectively *contentious*; used as noun, an *adversary: -* that contend (-eth), that strive.

d:
Jarib = "he contends"
**1.** a son of Simeon
**2.** one of the chief men of Israel who returned from exile with Ezra
**3.** son of Jozadak and a priest of the house of Jeshua who married a foreign wife and was compelled by Ezra to put her away
s: The same as [H3401](H3401); *Jarib*, the name of three Israelites: - Jarib.

d:
Jeribai = "my contentions"
**1.** a descendant of Elnaam and one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H3401](H3401); *contentious*; *Jeribai*, an Israelite: - Jeribai.

d:
Jerijah or Jeriah = " taught by Jehovah"
**1.** a Kohathite Levite and chief of the house of Hebron when David organised the service
s: From [H3384](H3384) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *throw*; *Jerijah*, an Israelite: - Jeriah, Jerijah.

d:
Jericho = "its moon"
**1.** a city 5 miles (8 km) west of the Jordan and 7 miles (11.5 km) north of the Dead Sea and the first city conquered by the Israelites upon entering the promised land of Canaan
s: Perhaps from [H3394](H3394); *its* *month*; or else from [H7306](H7306); *fragrant*; *Jericho* or *Jerecho*, a place in Palestine: - Jericho.

d:
Jerimoth or Jeremoth = "He is Most High"
**1.** a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a house of Benjamite
**2.** a Benjamite, son of Becher and head of a house of Benjamite
**3.** a Benjamite, son of Beriah and grandson of Elpaal
**4.** a Merarite Levite, son of Mushi
**5.** one of the men that joined David in the wilderness
**6.** a Levite, son of Heman and head of the 15th course of musicians
**7.** a Levite in the reign of Hezekiah
**8.** a son of Azriel, ruler of the tribe of Naphtali in the reign of David
**9.** a son of king David and the father of the wife of Rehoboam
**10.** a son of Elam, a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
**11.** a son of Zattu, a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
s: Feminine plural from [H7311](H7311); *elevations*; *Jerimoth* or *Jeremoth*, the name of twelve Israelites: - Jeremoth, Jerimoth, and Ramoth \[from the margin\].

d: **1.** curtain, drape
s: From [H3415](H3415); a *hanging* (as *tremulous*): - curtain.

d:
Jerioth = "curtains"
**1.** the wife or concubine of Caleb, the son of Hezron of the descendants of Judah
s: Plural of [H3407](H3407); *curtains*; *Jerioth*, an Israelitess: - Jerioth.

d:
**1.** thigh, side, loin, base
		**a.** thigh
				**1.** outside of thigh (where sword was worn)
				**2.** loins (as the seat of procreative power)
		**b.** side (flank) (of object)
		**c.** base
s: From an unused root meaning to *be* *soft*; the *thigh* (from its fleshy *softness*); by euphemism the *generative* *parts*; figuratively a *shank*, *flank*, *side: -*  X body, loins, shaft, side, thigh.
o: from an unused root meaning to be soft

d: **1.** thigh, loin, flank, side, recess
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3411](H3411); a *thigh: -* thigh.

d:
**1.** flank, side, extreme parts, recesses
		**a.** side
		**b.** sides, recesses (dual)
s: Feminine of [H3409](H3409); properly the *flank*; but used only figuratively, the *rear* or *recess: -* border, coast, part, quarter, side.

d:
Jarmuth = "heights"
**1.** a Canaanitish city in the lowlands of Judah with a king and located between Hebron and Lachish
**2.** a Levitical city of Issachar allocated to the Gershonite Levites
s: From [H7311](H7311); *elevation*; *Jarmuth*, the name of two places in Palestine: - Jarmuth.

d:
Jeremai = "my exaltations"
**1.** a descendant of Hashum who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra and was compelled to put her away
s: From [H7311](H7311); *elevated*; *Jeremai*, an Israelite: - Jeremai.

d:
Jeremiah = "whom Jehovah has appointed"
**1.** the major prophet, son of Hilkiah of the priestly family in Anathoth; author of the prophetic book bearing his name
**2.** a man of Libnah and father of Hamutal the wife of king Josiah
**3.** a Gadite who joined David at Ziklag
**4.** a Manassehite, one of the mighty men of valour of the Transjordanic half tribe of Manasseh
**5.** a Gadite and warrior of David
**6.** a warrior of David
**7.** a priest who joined Nehemiah in the covenant ceremony
**8.** a priest also in the time of Nehemiah; maybe same as 7
**9.** father of Jaazaniah the Rechabites
s: From [H7311](H7311) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *will* *rise*; *Jirmejah*, the name of eight or nine Israelites: - Jeremiah.

d: **1.** (Qal) to tremble, quiver
s: A primitive root; properly to *be* *broken* up (with any violent action), that is, (figuratively) to *fear*: - be grievous \[only Isa 15:4; the rest belong to [H7489](H7489)\].

d:
Irpeel = "God will heal"
**1.** a city in Benjamin; site unknown
s: From [H7495](H7495) and [H410](H410); *God* *will* *heal*; *Jirpeel*, a place in Palestine: - Irpeel.

d: **1.** (Qal) to spit
s: A primitive root; to *spit: -*  X but, spit.

d: **1.** green, greenness, green plants, greenery
s: From [H3417](H3417) (in the sense of *vacuity* of color); properly *pallor*, that is, hence the yellowish *green* of young and sickly vegetation; concretely *verdure*, that is, grass or vegetation: - grass, green (thing).
o: from [H3417](H3417) (in the sense of vacuity of colour)

d: **1.** herbs, herbage, vegetables, garden greens
s: From the same as [H3418](H3418); properly *green*; concretely a *vegetable: -* green, herbs.

d:
**1.** mildew, paleness, lividness
		**a.** mildew, rust
		**b.** paleness
s: From [H3418](H3418); *paleness*, whether of persons (from fright), or of plants (from drought): - mildew, paleness.

d:
Jorkoam = "the people empty"
**1.** a Calebite descendant of Judah
s: From [H7324](H7324) and [H5971](H5971); *people* *will* *be* *poured* *forth*; *Jorkeam*, a place in Palestine: - Jorkeam.

d: **1.** greenish, pale green, greenish-yellow
s: From the same as [H3418](H3418); *yellowishness: -* greenish, yellow.

d:
**1.** to seize, dispossess, take possession off, inherit, disinherit, occupy, impoverish, be an heir
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to take possession of
				**2.** to inherit
				**3.** to impoverish, come to poverty, be poor
		**b.** (Niphal) to be dispossessed, be impoverished, come to poverty
		**c.** (Piel) to devour
		**d.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause to possess or inherit
				**2.** to cause others to possess or inherit
				**3.** to impoverish
				**4.** to dispossess
				**5.** to destroy, bring to ruin, disinherit
s: A primitive root; to *occupy* (be *driving* out previous tenants, and *possessing* in their place); by implication to *seize*, to *rob*, to *inherit*; also to *expel*, to *impoverish*, to *ruin: -* cast out, consume, destroy, disinherit, dispossess, drive (-ing) out, enjoy, expel, X without fail, (give to, leave for) inherit (-ance, -or), + magistrate, be (make) poor, come to poverty, (give to, make to) possess, get (have) in (take) possession, seize upon, succeed, X utterly.

d: **1.** possession, property
s: From [H3423](H3423); *occupancy: -* possession.
