Ithra = "abundance"
**1.** father of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army; also 'Jether'
s: By variation for [H3502](H3502); *Jithra*, an Israelite (or Ishmaelite): - Ithra.

d: **1.** abundance, riches, wealth
s: Feminine of [H3499](H3499); properly *excellence*, that is, (by implication) *wealth: -* abundance, riches.

d:
Jethro = "his abundance"
**1.** father-in-law of Moses; also 'Jether'
s: From [H3499](H3499) with pronominal suffix; *his* *excellence*; *Jethro*, Moses’ father in law: - Jethro. Compare [H3500](H3500).

d: **1.** advantage, profit, excellency
s: From [H3498](H3498); *preeminence*, *gain: -* better, excellency (-leth), profit (-able).

d:
Ithrite = "a remnant: excellence"
**1.** a descendant of Jether
s: Patronymic from [H3500](H3500); a *Jithrite* or descendant of Jether: - Ithrite.

d:
Ithran = "advantage"
**1.** an Edomite, son of Dishon, a Horite, and probably a phylarch of a tribe of the Horim
**2.** an descendant of Asher
s: From [H3498](H3498); *excellent*; *Jithran*, the name of an Edomite and of an Israelite: - Ithran.

d:
Ithream = "profit of the people"
**1.** a son of David by his wife Eglah; the 6th son and born in Hebron
s: From [H3499](H3499) and [H5971](H5971); *excellence* *of* *people*; *Jithream*, a son of David: - Ithream.

d: **1.** appendage, overhang, protrusion, the caudate lobe of the liver of a sacrificial animal
s: Feminine active participle of [H3498](H3498); the *lobe* or *flap* of the liver (as if redundant or outhanging): - caul.

d:
Jetheth = "a nail"
**1.** one of the dukes of Edom who came of Esau
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Jetheth*, an Edomite: - Jetheth.

d:
**1.** to be in pain, be sore, have pain, be sorrowful
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be in pain (physical)
				**2.** to be in pain (mental)
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause pain, hurt, mar
				**2.** pain, mar (participle)
s: A primitive root; properly to feel *pain*; by implication to *grieve*; figuratively to *spoil: -* grieving, mar, have pain, make sad (sore), (be) sorrowful.

d: **1.** pain (mental and physical), sorrow
s: From [H3510](H3510); *suffering* (physical or mental), *adversity: -* grief, pain, sorrow.

d:
**1.** to be sad, be disheartened, be cowed
		**a.** (Niphal) to be disheartened, be cowed
		**b.** (Hiphil) to make sad
s: A primitive root; to *despond*; causatively to *deject: -* broken, be grieved, make sad.

d:
**1.** to be heavy, be weighty, be grievous, be hard, be rich, be honourable, be glorious, be burdensome, be honoured
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be heavy
				**2.** to be heavy, be insensible, be dull
				**3.** to be honoured
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be made heavy, be honoured, enjoy honour, be made abundant
				**2.** to get oneself glory or honour, gain glory
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to make heavy, make dull, make insensible
				**2.** to make honourable, honour, glorify
		**d.** (Pual) to be made honourable, be honoured
		**e.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to make heavy
				**2.** to make heavy, make dull, make unresponsive
				**3.** to cause to be honoured
		**f.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to make oneself heavy, make oneself dense, make oneself numerous
				**2.** to honour oneself
s: A primitive root; to *be* *heavy*, that is, in a bad sense (*burdensome*, *severe*, *dull*) or in a good sense (*numerous*, *rich*, *honorable*); causatively to *make* *weighty* (in the same two senses): - abounding with, more grievously afflict, boast, be chargeable, X be dim, glorify, be (make) glorious (things), glory, (very) great, be grievous, harden, be (make) heavy, be heavier, lay heavily, (bring to, come to, do, get, be had in) honour (self), (be) honourable (man), lade, X more be laid, make self many, nobles, prevail, promote (to honour), be rich, be (go) sore, stop.

d:
**1.** weight, heaviness, mass, great
		**a.** heaviness, weight
		**b.** mass, abundance
		**c.** vehemence, heaviness
s: From [H3513](H3513); *weight*, *multitude*, *vehemence: -* grievousness, heavy, great number.

d:
**1.** heavy, great
		**a.** heavy
		**b.** massive, abundant, numerous
		**c.** heavy, dull
		**d.** hard, difficult, burdensome
		**e.** very oppressive, numerous, rich
s: From [H3513](H3513); *heavy*; figuratively in a good sense (*numerous*) or in a bad sense (*severe*, *difficult*, *stupid*): - (so) great, grievous, hard (-ened), (too) heavy (-ier), laden, much, slow, sore, thick.

d:
**1.** the liver
		**a.** the liver (as the heaviest organ)
s: The same as [H3515](H3515); the *liver* (as the *heaviest* of the viscera): - liver.

d: **1.** heaviness, difficulty
s: Feminine of [H3515](H3515); *difficulty: -*  X heavily.

d:
**1.** to quench, put out, be put out, be quenched, be extinguished
		**a.** (Qal) to be quenched, be extinguished
		**b.** (Piel) to quench, extinguish
s: A primitive root; to *expire* or (causatively) to *extinguish* (fire, light, anger): - go (put) out, quench.

d:
**1.** glory, honour, glorious, abundance
		**a.** abundance, riches
		**b.** honour, splendour, glory
		**c.** honour, dignity
		**d.** honour, reputation
		**e.** honour, reverence, glory
		**f.** glory
s: From [H3513](H3513); properly *weight*; but only figuratively in a good sense, *splendor* or *copiousness: -* glorious (-ly), glory, honour (-able).

d:
**1.** abundance, riches, wealth
**2.** gloriousness, glorious
s: Irregular feminine passive participle of [H3513](H3513); *weightiness*; that is, *magnificence*, *wealth: -* carriage, all glorious, stately.

d:
Cabul = "binding"
**1.** a city on the border of Asher and located approx 10 miles (16 km) east of Akko; modern 'Kabul'
**2.** a district in Galilee given by Solomon to Hiram and contemptuously called 'Cabul' by Hiram
s: From the same as [H3525](H3525) in the sense of *limitation*; *sterile*; *Cabul*, the name of two places in Palestine: - Cabul.
o: from the same as [H3525](H3525) in the sense of limitation

d:
Cabbon = "the builder"
**1.** a town in the low country of Judah
s: From an unused root meaning to *heap* up; *hilly*; *Cabbon*, a place in Palestine: - Cabbon.
o: from an unused root meaning to heap up

d: **1.** (something) netted, a quilt, fly net, pillow
s: From [H3527](H3527) in the original sense of *plaiting*; a *matrass* (of intertwined materials): - pillow.
o: from [H3527](H3527) in the original sense of plaiting

d: **1.** mighty, great, powerful, many, much
s: From [H3727](H3727); *vast*, whether in extent (figuratively of power, *mighty*; of time, *aged*), or in number, *many: -*  + feeble, mighty, most, much, strong, valiant.

d: **1.** bond(s), fetter(s)
s: From an unused root meaning to *twine* or braid together; a *fetter: -* fetter.
o: from an unused root meaning to twine or braid together

d:
**1.** to wash (by treading), be washed, perform the work of a fuller
		**a.** (Qal) washer, fuller, treader (participle)
		**b.** (Piel) to wash (garments, person)
		**c.** (Pual) to be washed
		**d.** (Hothpael) to be washed out
s: A primitive root; to *trample*; hence to *wash* (properly by stamping with the feet), whether literally (including the *fulling* process) or figuratively: - fuller, wash (-ing).

d:
**1.** to be much, be many, be in abundance, intertwine, multiply
		**a.** (Hiphil) to make many, make great
s: A primitive root; properly to *plait* together, that is, (figuratively) to *augment* (especially in number or quantity, to *accumulate*): - in abundance, multiply.

d: **1.** already, long ago, a great while
s: From [H3527](H3527); properly *extent* of time, that is, a *great* *while*; hence *long* *ago*, *formerly*, *hitherto: -* already, (seeing that which), now.

d:
Chebar = "far-off"
**1.** a Babylonian river near which many Israelite exiles settled; maybe the 'Habor' or the 'Royal Canal' of Nebuchadnezzar
s: The same as [H3528](H3528); *length*; *Kebar*, a river of Mesopotamia: - Chebar. Compare [H2249](H2249).

d: **1.** distance (undetermined length)
s: Feminine of [H3528](H3528); properly *length*, that is, a *measure* (of uncertain dimension): -  X little.

d: **1.** sieve, sifter
s: From [H3527](H3527) in its original sense; a *sieve* (as netted): - sieve.

d: **1.** lamb, sheep, young ram
s: From an unused root meaning to *dominate*; a *ram* (just old enough to *butt*): - lamb, sheep.
o: from an unused root meaning to dominate

d:
**1.** to subject, subdue, force, keep under, bring into bondage
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to bring into bondage, make subservient
				**2.** to subdue, force, violate
				**3.** to subdue, dominate, tread down
		**b.** (Niphal) to be subdued
		**c.** (Piel) to subdue
		**d.** (Hiphil) to bring into bondage
s: A primitive root; to *tread* down; hence negatively to *disregard*; positively to *conquer*, *subjugate*, *violate: -* bring into bondage, force, keep under, subdue, bring into subjection.

d: **1.** footstool
s: From [H3533](H3533); a *footstool* (as trodden upon): - footstool.

d: **1.** ewe-lamb, lamb
s: Feminine of [H3532](H3532); a *ewe: -* (ewe) lamb.

d: **1.** kiln (pottery or lime), smelting forge, furnace
s: From [H3533](H3533); a smelting *furnace* (as *reducing* metals): - furnace.

d: **1.** jar, large jar (portable)
s: From an unused root meaning to *deepen*; properly a *pail*; but generally of earthenware; a *jar* for domestic purposes: - barrel, pitcher.
o: from an unused root meaning to deepen

d: **1.** false, lying
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to [H3576](H3576); *false: -* lying.

d: **1.** a precious stone (maybe ruby, agate)
s: From the same as [H3537](H3537) in the sense of *striking* *fire* from a metal forged; a *sparkling* gem, probably the ruby: - agate.
o: from the same as [H3537](H3537) in the sense of striking fire from a metal forged

d:
Chedorlaomer = "handful of sheaves"
**1.** the king of Elam defeated by Abraham
s: Of foreign origin; *Kedorlaomer*, an early Persian king: - Chedorlaomer.

d:
**1.** thus, here, in this manner
		**a.** thus, so
		**b.** here, here and there
		**c.** until now, until now...until then, meanwhile
s: From the prefix K and [H1931](H1931); properly *like* *this*, that is, by implication (of manner) *thus* (or *so*); also (of place) *here* (or *hither*); or (of time) *now: -* also, here, + hitherto, like, on the other side, so (and much), such, on that manner, (on) this (manner, side, way, way and that way), + mean while, yonder.

d: **1.** here, so far, thus
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3541](H3541): - hitherto.

d:
**1.** to grow weak, grow dim, grow faint, falter, be weak, be dim, be darkened, be restrained, be faint, fail
		**a.** (Qal) to grow dim, grow faint
		**b.** (Piel) to faint, grow weak, grow faint
s: A primitive root; to *be* *weak*, that is, (figuratively) to *despond* (causatively *rebuke*), or (of light, the eye) to *grow* *dull: -* darken, be dim, fail, faint, restrain, X utterly.

d: **1.** dim, dull, colourless, be dark, faint
s: From [H3543](H3543); *feeble*, *obscure: -* somewhat dark, darkish, wax dim, heaviness, smoking.

d: **1.** a quenching, dulling, lessening, healing, alleviation
s: Feminine of [H3544](H3544); properly a *weakening*; figuratively *alleviation*, that is, cure: - healing.

d:
**1.** to be able
		**a.** (P'al) to be able
s: (Chaldee); a root corresponding to [H3201](H3201) and [H3557](H3557); to *be* *able: -* be able, could.

d:
**1.** to act as a priest, minister in a priest's office
		**a.** (Piel)
				**1.** to minister as a priest, serve as a priest
				**2.** to be or become a priest
				**3.** to play the priest
s: A primitive root, apparently meaning to *mediate* in religious services; but used only as denominative from [H3548](H3548); to *officiate* as a priest; figuratively to *put* *on* *regalia: -* deck, be (do the office of a, execute the, minister in the) priest (‘s office).
o: a primitive root, apparently meaning to mediate in religious services

d:
**1.** priest, principal officer or chief ruler
		**a.** priest-king (Melchizedek, Messiah)
		**b.** pagan priests
		**c.** priests of Jehovah
		**d.** Levitical priests
		**e.** Zadokite priests
		**f.** Aaronic priests
		**g.** the high priest
s: Active participle of [H3547](H3547); literally one *officiating*, a *priest*; also (by courtesy) an *acting* *priest* (although a layman): - chief ruler, X own, priest, prince, principal officer.

d: **1.** priest
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3548](H3548): - priest.

d: **1.** priesthood
s: From [H3547](H3547); *priesthood: -* priesthood, priest’s office.

d: **1.** window
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to [H3854](H3854) in the sense of *piercing*; a *window* (as a perforation): - window.
o: from a root corresponding to [H3854](H3854) in the sense of piercing

d: **1.** the name of a people in alliance with Nebuchadnezzar and probably located in northern Africa; maybe same as 'Lybia' or 'Lub'
s: Of foreign derivation; *Kub*, a country near Egypt: - Chub.

d: **1.** helmet
s: From an unused root meaning to be *high* or *rounded*; a *helmet* (as *arched*): - helmet. Compare [H6959](H6959).
o: from an unused root meaning to be high or rounded

d:
**1.** to burn, scorch, brand
		**a.** (Niphal) to be burned, be scorched
s: A primitive root; properly to *prick* or *penetrate*; hence to *blister* (as smarting or eating into): - burn.

d: **1.** burning, branding, branding scar, burn
s: From [H3554](H3554); a *branding: -* burning.

d:
**1.** star
		**a.** of Messiah, brothers, youth, numerous progeny, personification, God's omniscience (fig.)
s: Probably from the same as [H3522](H3522) (in the sense of *rolling*) or [H3554](H3554) (in the sense of *blazing*); a *star* (as *round* or as *shining*); figuratively a *prince: -* star (\[-gazer\]).
o: probably from the same as [H3522](H3522) (in the sense of rolling) or [H3554](H3554) (in the sense of blazing)

d:
**1.** to seize, contain, measure
		**a.** (Qal) to measure, calculate
		**b.** (Pilpel) to sustain, maintain, contain
				**1.** to sustain, support, nourish
				**2.** to contain, hold in, restrain
				**3.** to support, endure
		**c.** (Polpal) to be supplied
		**d.** (Hilpil) to contain, hold, hold in, endure
				**1.** to contain
				**2.** to sustain, endure
s: A primitive root; properly to *keep* *in*; hence to *measure*; figuratively to *maintain* (in various senses): - (be able to, can) abide, bear, comprehend, contain, feed, forbearing, guide, hold (-ing in), nourish (-er), be present, make provision, receive, sustain, provide sustenance (victuals).

d:
**1.** ornaments, golden ornament
		**a.** maybe-armlets of gold, exact meaning not known
**2.** (TWOT) tablets
s: From an unused root meaning to *store* away; a *jewel* (probably gold beads): - tablet.
o: from an unused root meaning to store away

d:
**1.** to be firm, be stable, be established
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be set up, be established, be fixed
						**a.** to be firmly established
						**b.** to be established, be stable, be secure, be enduring
						**c.** to be fixed, be securely determined
				**2.** to be directed aright, be fixed aright, be steadfast (moral sense)
				**3.** to prepare, be ready
				**4.** to be prepared, be arranged, be settled
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to establish, set up, accomplish, do, make firm
				**2.** to fix, make ready, prepare, provide, provide for, furnish
				**3.** to direct toward (moral sense)
				**4.** to arrange, order
		**c.** (Hophal)
				**1.** to be established, be fastened
				**2.** to be prepared, be ready
		**d.** (Polel)
				**1.** to set up, establish
				**2.** to constitute, make
				**3.** to fix
				**4.** to direct
		**e.** (Pulal) to be established, be prepared
		**f.** (Hithpolel) to be established, be restored
s: A primitive root; properly to *be* *erect* (that is, stand perpendicular);. hence (causatively) to *set* *up*, in a great variety of applications, whether literal (*establish*, *fix*, *prepare*, *apply*), or figurative (*appoint*, *render* *sure*, *proper* or *prosperous*): - certain (-ty), confirm, direct, faithfulness, fashion, fasten, firm, be fitted, be fixed, frame, be meet, ordain, order, perfect, (make) preparation, prepare (self), provide, make provision, (be, make) ready, right, set (aright, fast, forth), be stable, (e-) stablish, stand, tarry, X very deed.

d:
Chun = "established"
**1.** a city belonging to Hadarezer, plundered by David's forces
s: Probably from [H3559](H3559); *established*; *Kun*, a place in Syria: - Chun.

d: **1.** cake, sacrificial cake
s: From [H3559](H3559); something *prepared*, that is, a sacrificial *wafer: -* cake.

d:
Cononiah or Conaniah = "Jehovah has established"
**1.** a Levite ruler in the time of Hezekiah
**2.** a Levite chief in the time of Josiah
s: From [H3559](H3559) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *sustained*; *Conanjah*, the name of two Israelites: - Conaniah, Cononiah. Compare [H3663](H3663).

d:
n f
**1.** cup
n m
**2.** a kind of owl (an unclean bird)
s: From an unused root meaning to *hold* together; a *cup* (as a container), often figuratively a *lot* (as if a potion); also some unclean bird, probably an *owl* (perhaps from the cup like cavity of its eye): - cup, (small) owl. Compare [H3599](H3599).
o: from an unused root meaning to hold together

d:
n m
**1.** furnace, forge, smelting furnace or pot
v
**2.** (Qal) to bore, pierce, dig, hew
s: From an unused root meaning properly to *dig* through; a *pot* or *furnace* (as if excavated): - furnace. Compare [H3600](H3600).
o: from an unused root meaning properly, to dig through

d:
Chor-ashan = "furnace of smoke"
**1.** a town in Judah
s: From [H3564](H3564) and [H6227](H6227); *furnace* *of* *smoke*; *Cor-Ashan*, a place in Palestine: - Chor-ashan.

d:
Cyrus = "posses thou the furnace"
**1.** the king of Persia and conqueror of Babylon; first ruler of Persia to make a decree allowing the Israelite exiles to return to Jerusalem
s: From the Persian; *Koresh* (or Cyrus), the Persian king: - Cyrus.

d:
Cyrus = "posses thou the furnace"
**1.** the king of Persia and conqueror of Babylon; first ruler of Persia to make a decree allowing the Israelite exiles to return to Jerusalem
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3566](H3566): - Cyrus.

d:
Cush = "black"
n pr m
**1.** a Benjamite mentioned only in the title of Ps 7:1
**2.** the son of Ham and grandson of Noah and the progenitor of the southernmost peoples located in Africa
**3.** the peoples descended from Cush
n pr loc
**4.** the land occupied by the descendants of Cush located around the southern parts of the Nile (Ethiopia)
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Cush* (or Ethiopia), the name of a son of Ham, and of his territory; also of an Israelite: - Chush, Cush, Ethiopia.

d:
Cushi or Ethiopian = see Cushan "their blackness"
**1.** one of the descendants of Cush the grandson of Noah through Ham and a member of that nation or people
**2.** one of Joab's couriers
**3.** (TWOT) Ethiopian
s: Patronymic from [H3568](H3568); a *Cushite*, or descendant of Cush: - Cushi, Cushite, Ethiopian (-s).

d:
Cushi = "their blackness"
**1.** an ancestor of Jehudi (Jer. 36.14)
**2.** the father of the prophet Zephaniah (Zep. 1.1)
s: The same as [H3569](H3569); *Cushi*, the name of two Israelites: - Cushi.

d: **1.** a Cushite woman, Moses' wife so-called by Miriam and Aaron
s: Feminine of [H3569](H3569); a *Cushite* *woman: -* Ethiopian.

d:
Cushan = "their blackness"
**1.** a place in Arabia or Mesopotamia; site unknown
s: Perhaps from [H3568](H3568); *Cushan*, a region of Arabia: - Cushan.

d:
Chushan-rishathaim = "twice-wicked Cushan"
**1.** a king of Mesopotamia defeated by the judge Othniel the son-in-law of Caleb
s: Apparently from [H3572](H3572) and the dual of [H7564](H7564); *Cushan* *of* *double* *wickedness*; *Cushan-Rishathajim*, a Mesopotamian king: - Chushan-rishathayim.
o: apparently from [H3572](H3572) and the dual of [H7564](H7564)

d:
**1.** prosperity
**2.** (TWOT) singing
s: From [H3787](H3787); *prosperity*; in plural *freedom: -*  X chain.

d:
Cuth = "crushing"
**1.** a place from which king Sargon of Assyria imported colonists into Israel; probably a location approx 20 (32 km) miles northeast of Babylon
s: Of foreign origin; *Cuth* or *Cuthah*, a province of Assyria: - Cuth.

d:
**1.** to lie, tell a lie, be a liar, be found a liar, be in vain, fail
		**a.** (Qal) liar (participle)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be proven to be lying
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to lie, tell a lie, tell a lie with, deceive
				**2.** to disappoint, fail
		**d.** (Hiphil) to make a liar, prove to be a liar
s: A primitive root; to *lie* (that is, *deceive*), literally or figuratively: - fail, (be found a, make a) liar, lie, lying, be in vain.

d: **1.** a lie, untruth, falsehood, deceptive thing
s: From [H3576](H3576); *falsehood*; literally (*untruth*) or figuratively (*idol*): - deceitful, false, leasing, + liar, lie, lying.

d:
Chozeba = "falsehood"
**1.** a city in Judah
s: From [H3576](H3576); *fallacious*; *Cozeba*, a place in Palestine: - Choseba.

d:
Cozbi = "my lie"
**1.** a daughter of Zur, a chief of the Midianites, who was slain by Phinehas because of her adultery
s: From [H3576](H3576); *false*; *Cozbi*, a Midianitess: - Cozbi.

d:
Chezib = "false"
**1.** a town in Judah
s: From [H3576](H3576); *falsified*; *Kezib*, a place in Palestine: - Chezib.

d:
**1.** strength, power, might
		**a.** human strength
		**b.** strength (of angels)
		**c.** power (of God)
		**d.** strength (of animals)
		**e.** strength, produce, wealth (of soil)
**2.** a small reptile, probably a kind of lizard, which is unclean
		**a.** perhaps an extinct animal, exact meaning is unknown
s: From an unused root meaning to *be* *firm*; *vigor*, literally (*force*, in a good or a bad sense) or figuratively (*capacity*, *means*, *produce*); also (from its hardiness) a large *lizard: -* ability, able, chameleon, force, fruits, might, power (-ful), strength, substance, wealth.
o: from an unused root meaning to be firm

d:
**1.** to hide, conceal, cut off, cut down, make desolate, kick
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be hidden
				**2.** to be effaced, be destroyed, be cut off
		**b.** (Piel) to cover, hide
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to hide
				**2.** to efface, annihilate
s: A primitive root; to *secrete*, by act or word; hence (intensively) to *destroy: -* conceal, cut down (off), desolate, hide.

d: **1.** (Qal) to paint (eyes), adorn with paint
s: A primitive root; to *paint* (with stibium): - paint.

d:
**1.** to deceive, lie, fail, grow lean, be disappointing, be untrue, be insufficient, be found liars, belie, deny, dissemble, deal falsely
		**a.** (Qal) to become lean
		**b.** (Niphal) to cringe, feign obedience
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to deceive, deny falsely
				**2.** to act deceptively
				**3.** to cringe
				**4.** to disappoint, fail
		**d.** (Hithpael) to cringe, feign obedience
s: A primitive root; to *be* *untrue*, in word (to *lie*, *feign*, *disown*) or deed (to *disappoint*, *fail*, *cringe*): - deceive, deny, dissemble, fail, deal falsely, be found liars, (be-) lie, lying, submit selves.

d:
**1.** lying, deception
**2.** leanness, failure
s: From [H3584](H3584); literally a *failure* of flesh, that is, *emaciation*; figuratively *hypocrisy: -* leanness, lies, lying.

d: **1.** deceitful, false, deceptive, lying
s: From [H3584](H3584); *faithless: -* lying.

d: **1.** burning, branding
s: From [H3554](H3554); a *brand* or *scar: -* burning.

d:
**1.** that, for, because, when, as though, as, because that, but, then, certainly, except, surely, since
		**a.** that
				**1.** yea, indeed
		**b.** when (of time)
				**1.** when, if, though (with a concessive force)
		**c.** because, since (causal connection)
		**d.** but (after negative)
		**e.** that if, for if, indeed if, for though, but if
		**f.** but rather, but
		**g.** except that
		**h.** only, nevertheless
		**i.** surely
		**j.** that is
		**k.** but if
		**l.** for though
		**m.** forasmuch as, for therefore
s: A primitive particle (the full form of the prepositional prefix) indicating *causal* relations of all kinds, antecedent or consequent; (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjugation or adverb; often largely modified by other particles annexed: - and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured \[-ly\], + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, who, yea, yet,

d: **1.** ruin, destruction
s: From a primitive root meaning to *strike*; a *crushing*; figuratively *calamity: -* destruction.
o: from a primitive root meaning to strike

d: **1.** spark
s: From the same as [H3589](H3589) (compare [H3539](H3539)); properly something *struck* off, that is, a *spark* (as struck): - spark.

d:
**1.** javelin, short sword, dart
**2.** gorget, a piece of armour for the throat (1Sa 17.6)
s: From the same as [H3589](H3589); properly something to *strike* with, that is, a *dart* (perhaps smaller than [H2595](H2595)): - lance, shield, spear, target.

d:
Chidon = "javelin"
**1.** the owner or site of Uzziah's death for touching the ark
s: The same as [H3591](H3591); *Kidon*, a place in Palestine: - Chidon.

d: **1.** attack, onslaught, onset
s: Of uncertain derivation; perhaps *tumult: -* battle.

d:
Chiun = "an image" or "pillar"
**1.** probably a statue of the Assyrian-Babylonian god of the planet Saturn and used to symbolise Israelite apostasy
s: From [H3559](H3559); properly a *statue*, that is, idol; but used (by euphemism) for some heathen deity (perhaps corresponding to Priapus or Baal-peor): - Chiun.

d:
**1.** pot, basin, laver, pan
		**a.** pot, caldron
		**b.** fire-pot, brazier
		**c.** basin, laver
		**d.** platform, stage
s: From the same as [H3564](H3564); properly something *round* (as *excavated* or *bored*), that is, a *chafing* *dish* for coals or a *caldron* for cooking; hence (from similarity of form) a *washbowl*; also (for the same reason) a *pulpit* or platform: - hearth, laver, pan, scaffold.

d: **1.** scoundrel, knave
s: From [H3557](H3557) in the sense of *withholding*; *niggardly: -* churl.
o: from [H3557](H3557) in the sense of withholding

d: **1.** large axes, axe
s: From an unused root meaning to *clap* or strike with noise; a *club* or sledge hammer: - hammer.
o: from an unused root meaning to clap or strike with noise

d: **1.** Pleiades, a constellation of seven stars
s: From the same as [H3558](H3558); a *cluster* of stars, that is, the *Pleiades: -* Pleiades, seven stars.

d:
**1.** bag, purse
		**a.** for weights, money
s: A form for [H3563](H3563); a *cup*; also a *bag* for money or weights: - bag, cup, purse.

d: **1.** stove, range, cooking furnace
s: A form for [H3564](H3564) (only in the dual); a cooking *range* (consisting of two parallel stones, across which the boiler is set): - ranges for pots.
o: a form for [H3564](H3564) (only in the dual)

d: **1.** spindle-whorl, distaff
s: From [H3787](H3787); literally a *director*, that is, the *spindle* or shank of a distaff ([H6418](H6418)) by which it is twirled: - spindle.

d: **1.** like this, thus
s: From [H3541](H3541); *just* *so*, referring to the previous or following context: - after that (this) manner, this matter, (even) so, in such a case, thus.

d:
**1.** round
		**a.** a round district (environs of the Jordan valley)
		**b.** a round loaf (of bread)
		**c.** a round weight, talent (of gold, silver, bronze, iron)
s: From [H3769](H3769); a *circle*, that is, (by implication) a circumjacent *tract* or region, especially the *Ghor* or valley of the Jordan; also a (round) *loaf*; also a *talent* (or large (round) coin): - loaf, morsel, piece, plain, talent.

d: **1.** talent
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3603](H3603); a *talent: -* talent.

d:
**1.** all, the whole
		**a.** all, the whole of
		**b.** any, each, every, anything
		**c.** totality, everything
s: From [H3634](H3634); properly the *whole*; hence *all*, *any* or *every* (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense): - (in) all (manner, \[ye\]), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, \[no-\] thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso (-ever).

d:
**1.** all, whole, the whole
		**a.** the whole of, all
		**b.** every, any, none
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3605](H3605): - all, any, + (forasmuch) as, + be- (for this) cause, every, + no (manner, -ne), + there (where) -fore, + though, what (where, who) -soever, (the) whole.

d:
**1.** to restrict, restrain, withhold, shut up, keep back, refrain, forbid
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to shut up
				**2.** to restrain
				**3.** to withhold
		**b.** (Niphal) to be restrained
		**c.** (Piel) to finish
s: A primitive root; to *restrict*, by act (*hold* back or in) or word (*prohibit*): - finish, forbid, keep (back), refrain, restrain, retain, shut up, be stayed, withhold.

d: **1.** imprisonment, confinement, restraint
s: From [H3607](H3607); a *prison*: - prison. Compare [H3610](H3610), [H3628](H3628).

d:
Chileab = "like his father"
**1.** the 2nd son of David, by Abigail
s: Apparently from [H3607](H3607) and [H1](H1); *restraint* *of* (his) *father*; *Kilab*, an Israelite: - Chileab.

d:
**1.** two kinds, mixture
		**a.** forbidden practice among cattle (cross breeding), seeds (sowing), and cloth garments (material)
s: Dual of [H3608](H3608) in the original sense of *separation*; *two* *heterogeneities: -* divers seeds (-e kinds), mingled (seed).
o: dual of [H3608](H3608) in the original sense of separation

d:
**1.** dog
		**a.** dog (literal)
		**b.** contempt or abasement (fig.)
		**c.** of pagan sacrifice
		**d.** of male cult prostitute (fig.)
s: From an unused root meaning to *yelp*, or else to *attack*; a *dog*; hence (by euphemism) a male *prostitute: -* dog.
o: from an unused root means. to yelp, or else to attack

d:
Caleb = "dog"
**1.** the godly son of Jephunneh and the faithful spy who reported the Promised Land favourably and urged its capture
**2.** son of Hezron and grandson of Pharez and great grandson of Judah and the father of Hur and grandfather of Caleb the spy
s: Perhaps a form of [H3611](H3611), or else from the same root in the sense of *forcible*; *Caleb*, the name of three Israelites: - Caleb.
o: perhaps a form of [H3611](H3611), or else from the same root in the sense of forcible

d:
Caleb-ephratah = "dog or ash heap"
**1.** a place in Gilead
s: From [H3612](H3612) and [H672](H672); *Caleb-Ephrathah*, a place in Egypt (if the text is correct): - Caleb-ephrathah.

d:
Calebite = see Caleb "dog"
**1.** a descendant of Caleb
s: The first form is probably by erroneous transcription for the second form; patronymic from [H3612](H3612); a *Calebite* or descendant of Caleb: - of the house of Caleb.
o: probably by erroneous transcription for Kalebiy kaw-lay-bee’

d:
**1.** to accomplish, cease, consume, determine, end, fail, finish, be complete, be accomplished, be ended, be at an end, be finished, be spent
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be complete, be at an end
				**2.** to be completed, be finished
				**3.** to be accomplished, be fulfilled
				**4.** to be determined, be plotted (bad sense)
				**5.** to be spent, be used up
				**6.** to waste away, be exhausted, fail
				**7.** to come to an end, vanish, perish, be destroyed
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to complete, bring to an end, finish
				**2.** to complete (a period of time)
				**3.** to finish (doing a thing)
				**4.** to make an end, end
				**5.** to accomplish, fulfil, bring to pass
				**6.** to accomplish, determine (in thought)
				**7.** to put an end to, cause to cease
				**8.** to cause to fail, exhaust, use up, spend
				**9.** to destroy, exterminate
		**c.** (Pual) to be finished, be ended, be completed
s: A primitive root; to *end*, whether intransitively (to *cease*, *be* *finished*, *perish*) or transitively (to *complete*, *prepare*, *consume*): - accomplish, cease, consume (away), determine, destroy (utterly), be (when . . . were) done, (be an) end (of), expire, (cause to) fail, faint, finish, fulfil, X fully, X have, leave (off), long, bring to pass, wholly reap, make clean riddance, spend, quite take away, waste.

d: **1.** failing with desire, longing, longing for
s: From [H3615](H3615); *pining: -* fail.

d:
**1.** completion, termination, full end, complete destruction, consumption, annihilation
		**a.** completion
				**1.** completely, altogether (adv)
		**b.** complete destruction, consumption, annihilation
s: From [H3615](H3615); a *completion*; adverbially *completely*; also *destruction: -* altogether, (be, utterly) consume (-d), consummation (-ption), was determined, (full, utter) end, riddance.

d:
**1.** bride, daughter-in-law
		**a.** daughter-in-law
		**b.** bride, young wife
s: From [H3634](H3634); a *bride* (as if *perfect*); hence a *son’s* *wife: -* bride, daughter-in-law, spouse.

d: **1.** cage, basket, dog cage
s: From the same as [H3611](H3611); a bird *trap* (as furnished with a *clapstick* or treadle to spring it); hence a *basket* (as resembling a wicker cage): - basket, cage.

d:
Chelub = "caged"
**1.** a descendant of Judah
**2.** father of Ezri, one of David's officers
s: The same as [H3619](H3619); *Kelub*, the name of two Israelites: - Chelub.

d:
Chelub ai = "my caged one"
**1.** son of Hezron of Judah; also 'Caleb'
s: A form of [H3612](H3612); *Kelubai*, an Israelite: - Chelubai.

d:
Chelluh = "my accomplishment"
**1.** a man with a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
s: From [H3615](H3615); *completed*; *Keluhai*, an Israelite: - Chelluh.

d: **1.** betrothals, espousals
s: Denominative passive participle from [H3618](H3618); *bridehood* (only in the plural): - espousal.

d: **1.** full strength, firm or rugged strength, vigour
s: From an unused root meaning to *be* *complete*; *maturity: -* full (old) age.
o: from an unused root meaning to be complete

d:
Calah = "vigour"
**1.** one of the most ancient cities of Assyria; maybe modern 'Nimrud' located at the confluence of the Tigris and Zab rivers
s: The same as [H3624](H3624); *Kelach*, a place in Assyria: - Calah.

d:
Col-hozeh = "all-seeing"
**1.** father of a repairer of Jerusalem's walls during the time of Nehemiah
s: From [H3605](H3605) and [H2374](H2374); *every* *seer*; *Col-Cho-zeh*, an Israelite: - Col-hozeh.

d:
**1.** article, vessel, implement, utensil
		**a.** article, object (general)
		**b.** utensil, implement, apparatus, vessel
				**1.** implement (of hunting or war)
				**2.** implement (of music)
				**3.** implement, tool (of labour)
				**4.** equipment, yoke (of oxen)
				**5.** utensils, furniture
		**c.** vessel, receptacle (general)
		**d.** vessels (boats) of paper-reed
s: From [H3615](H3615); something *prepared*, that is, any *apparatus* (as an implement, utensil, dress, vessel or weapon): - armour (\[-bearer\]), artillery, bag, carriage, + furnish, furniture, instrument, jewel, that is made of, X one from another, that which pertaineth, pot, + psaltery, sack, stuff, thing, tool, vessel, ware, weapon, + whatsoever.

d: **1.** imprisonment
s: From [H3607](H3607) (compare [H3608](H3608)); a *prison: -* prison.

d:
**1.** kidneys
		**a.** of physical organ (lit.)
		**b.** of seat of emotion and affection (fig.)
		**c.** of sacrificial animals
**2.** (TWOT) reins
s: Feminine of [H3627](H3627) (only in the plural); a *kidney* (as an essential *organ*); figuratively the *mind* (as the interior self): - kidneys, reins.

d:
Chilion = "pining"
**1.** an Ephraimite and son of Elimelech by Naomi and the deceased husband of Ruth (or maybe deceased husband of Orpah)
s: A form of [H3631](H3631); *Kiljon*, an Israelite: - Chilion.

d:
**1.** completion, destruction, consumption, annihilation
**2.** failing, pining
s: From [H3615](H3615); *pining*, *destruction: -* consumption, failing.

d:
adj
**1.** entire, all, perfect
adv
**2.** entirety
subst
**3.** whole, whole burnt offering, holocaust, entirety
s: From [H3634](H3634); *complete*; as noun, the *whole* (specifically a sacrifice *entirely* *consumed*); as adverb *fully: -* all, every whit, flame, perfect (-ion), utterly, whole burnt offering (sacrifice), wholly.

d:
Calcol or Chalcol = "sustaining"
**1.** son or descendant of Zerah of Judah and one of the wise men with whom Solomon was compared
s: From [H3557](H3557); *sustenance*; *Calcol*, an Israelite: - Calcol, Chalcol.

d:
**1.** to complete, perfect, make complete, make perfect
		**a.** (Qal) to perfect
s: A primitive root; to *complete: -* (make) perfect.

d:
**1.** to finish, complete
		**a.** (Shaphel) to finish
		**b.** (Ishtaphel) to be completed
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3634](H3634); to *complete: -* finish, make (set) up.

d:
Chelal = "completed"
**1.** an Israelite who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
s: From [H3634](H3634); *complete*; *Kelal*, an Israelite: - Chelal.

d:
**1.** to insult, shame, humiliate, blush, be ashamed, be put to shame, be reproached, be put to confusion, be humiliated
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be humiliated, be ashamed
				**2.** to be put to shame, be dishonoured, be confounded
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to put to shame, insult, humiliate, cause shame to
				**2.** to exhibit shame
		**c.** (Hophal)
				**1.** to be insulted, be humiliated
				**2.** to be put to shame, be dishonoured, be confounded
s: A primitive root; properly to *wound*; but only figuratively, to *taunt* or *insult: -* be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.

d:
Chilmad = "enclosure"
**1.** a city of Assyria mentioned in conjunction with Sheba and Asshur
s: Of foreign derivation; *Kilmad*, a place apparently in the Assyrian empire: - Chilmad.

d:
**1.** disgrace, reproach, shame, confusion, dishonour, insult, ignominy
		**a.** insult, reproach
		**b.** reproach, ignominy
s: From [H3637](H3637); *disgrace: -* confusion, dishonour, reproach, shame.

d: **1.** shame, disgrace, ignominy
s: From [H3639](H3639); *disgrace: -* shame.

d:
Calneh or Calno = "fortress of Anu"
**1.** a city of Babylonia named among the cities of Nimrod
		**a.** maybe modern 'Niffer'
**2.** an Assyrian city near Aleppo
		**a.** maybe same as 1 since it was captured by Assyria in the 8th century BC
s: Of foreign derivation; *Calneh* or *Calno*, a place in the Assyrian empire: - Calneh, Calno. Compare [H3656](H3656).

d: **1.** (Qal) to long for, faint, faint with longing
s: A primitive root; to *pine* after: - long.

d:
Chimham = "their longing"
n pr m
**1.** a follower and probably a son of Barzillai the Gileadite who returned from beyond Jordan with David; apparently David bestowed on him a possession in Bethlehem on which in later times an inn was standing
n pr loc
**2.** apparently the inn in Bethlehem located on the possession given by David to Chimham the follower or son of Barzillai the Gileadite
s: From [H3642](H3642); *pining*; *Kimham*, an Israelite: - Chimham.

d:
adv
**1.** like, as, the like of which
conj
**2.** when, according as, as it were
s: A form of the prefix K, but used separately (compare [H3651](H3651)); *as*, *thus*, *so: -* according to, (such) as (it were, well as), in comparison of, like (as, to, unto), thus, when, worth.
o: a form of the prefix k-, but used separately \[compare [H3651](H3651)\]

d:
Chemosh = "subduer"
**1.** the national deity of the Moabites and a god of the Ammonites
		**a.** also identified with 'Baal-peor', 'Baal-zebub', 'Mars' and 'Saturn'
		**b.** worship of this god was introduced into Jerusalem by Solomon and abolished by king Josiah of Judah
s: From an unused root meaning to *subdue*; the *powerful*; *Kemosh*, the god of the Moabites: - Chemosh.
o: from an unused root meaning to subdue

d:
**1.** cummin, cumin
		**a.** a seed used as a condiment
s: From an unused root meaning to *store* up or *preserve*; *“cummin”* (from its use as a *condiment*): - cummin.
o: from an unused root meaning to store up or preserve

d:
**1.** to store up, save
		**a.** (Qal) stored up (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *store* away, that is, (figuratively) in the memory: - lay up in store.

d:
**1.** to yearn, be kindled, be black (hot), grow warm and tender, be or grow hot, become hot, become emotionally agitated
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to grow warm and tender
				**2.** to be or grow hot
s: A primitive root; properly to *intertwine* or *contract*, that is, (by implication) to *shrivel* (as with heat); figuratively to *be* deeply *affected* with passion (love or pity): - be black, be kindled, yearn.

d: **1.** priest, idolatrous priest
s: From [H3648](H3648); properly an *ascetic* (as if *shrunk* with self maceration), that is, an idolatrous *priest* (only in plural): - Chemarims, (idolatrous) priests.

d: **1.** blackness, gloominess, darkness
s: Reduplicated from [H3648](H3648); *obscuration* (as if from *shrinkage* of light), that is, an *eclipse* (only in plural): - black-ness.

d:
adv
**1.** so, therefore, thus
		**a.** thus, so
		**b.** just so
		**c.** therefore
		**d.** so...as (paired with adv)
		**e.** then
		**f.** forasmuch as (in phrase)
		**g.** (with prep)
				**1.** therefore, this being so (specific)
				**2.** hitherto
				**3.** therefore, on this ground (general)
				**4.** afterwards
				**5.** in such case
adj
**2.** right, just, honest, true, veritable
		**a.** right, just, honest
		**b.** correct
		**c.** true, veritable
		**d.** true!, right!, correct! (in assent)
s: From [H3559](H3559); properly *set* upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) *just*; but usually (as adverb or conjugation) *rightly* or *so* (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles): -  + after that (this, -ward, -wards), as . . . as, + \[for-\] asmuch as yet, + be (for which) cause, + following, howbeit, in (the) like (manner, -wise), X the more, right, (even) so, state, straightway, such (thing), surely, + there (where) -fore, this, thus, true, well, X you.

d: **1.** thus, so, as follows
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3651](H3651); *so: -* thus.

d:
**1.** base, stand, pedestal, office, foot, place, estate
		**a.** base, pedestal
		**b.** office, place
s: The same as [H3651](H3651), used as a noun; a *stand*, that is, pedestal or station: - base, estate, foot, office, place, well.
o: the same as [H3651](H3651), used as a noun

d: **1.** gnat, gnats, gnat-swarm
s: From [H3661](H3661) in the sense of *fastening*; a *gnat* (from infixing its sting; used only in plural (and irregularly in Exo 8:17, Exo 8:18; Heb 13:14): - lice, X manner.
o: from [H3661](H3661) in the sense of fastening

d:
**1.** to title, surname, be surnamed, give an epithet or cognomen, give a flattering title
		**a.** (Piel) to call by name, give a title, betitle
s: A primitive root; to *address* by an additional name; hence, to *eulogize: -* give flattering titles, surname (himself).

d:
Canneh = "to give a flattering title"
**1.** a city apparently in Mesopotamia
s: For [H3641](H3641); *Canneh*, a place in Assyria: - Canneh

d: **1.** root, support (of tree), shoot, stock
s: From [H3661](H3661); a *plant* (as *set*): -  X vineyard.

d: **1.** lyre, harp
s: From an unused root meaning to *twang*; a *harp: -* harp.
o: from a unused root meaning to twang

d:
Coniah = "Jehovah will establish"
**1.** another name for king Jehoiachin of Judah, the next to last king on the throne before the captivity
s: For [H3204](H3204); *Conjah*, an Israelite king: - Coniah.

d: **1.** thus, so, accordingly, as follows
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3644](H3644); *so* or *thus: -* so, (in) this manner (sort), thus.

d: **1.** (Qal) root, support (of tree), shoot, stock
s: A primitive root; to *set* out, that is, *plant: -*  X vineyard.

d:
Chenani = "my station"
**1.** one of the Levites who assisted at the solemn purification of the people under Ezra
s: From [H3661](H3661); *planted*; *Kenani*, an Israelite: - Chenani.

d:
Chenaniah = "Jehovah establishes"
**1.** a Levite song leader who assisted in the procession of transporting the ark
**2.** an Izharites officer of David
s: From [H3661](H3661) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *planted*; *Kenanjah*, an Israelite: - Chenaniah.

d:
**1.** to gather, collect, wrap
		**a.** (Qal) to gather
		**b.** (Piel) to gather
		**c.** (Hithpael) to gather together, wrap oneself up
s: A primitive root; to *collect*; hence, to *enfold: -* gather (together), heap up, wrap self.

d:
**1.** to be humble, be humbled, be subdued, be brought down, be low, be under, be brought into subjection
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to humble oneself
				**2.** to be humbled, be subdued
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to humble
				**2.** to subdue
s: A primitive root; properly to *bend* the knee; hence to *humiliate*, *vanquish: -* bring down (low), into subjection, under, humble (self), subdue.

d: **1.** bundle, bag, pack
s: From [H3665](H3665) in the sense of *folding* (compare [H3664](H3664)); a *package: -* wares.
o: from [H3665](H3665) in the sense of folding \[compare [H3664](H3664)\]

d:
Canaan = "lowland"
n pr m
**1.** the 4th son of Ham and the progenitor of the Phoenicians and of the various nations who peopled the seacoast of Palestine
n pr loc
**2.** the land west of the Jordan peopled by the descendants of Canaan and subsequently conquered by the Israelites under Joshua
n m
**3.** merchant, trader
s: From [H3665](H3665); *humiliated*; *Kenaan*, a son of Ham; also the country inhabited by him: - Canaan, merchant, traffick.

d:
Chenaanah = "trader"
**1.** father of Zedekiah the false prophet of Ahab
**2.** son of Bilhan, grandson of Jediael, and great grandson of Benjamin and the founder of a house of Benjamin
s: Feminine of [H3667](H3667); *Kenaanah*, the name of two Israelites: - Chenaanah.

d:
Canaanite = see Cana "zealous"
adj
**1.** descendant of inhabitant of Canaan
n
**2.** descendant or inhabitant of Canaan
**3.** a merchant, trader
s: Patrial from [H3667](H3667); a *Kenaanite* or inhabitant of Kenaan; by implication a *pedlar* (the Cananites standing for their neighbors the Ishmaelites, who conducted mercantile caravans): - Canaanite, merchant, trafficker.

d: **1.** (Niphal) to be put or thrust in or into a corner, be hidden from view, be cornered, be thrust aside
s: A primitive root; properly to *project* laterally, that is, probably (reflexively) to *withdraw: -* be removed.

d:
**1.** wing, extremity, edge, winged, border, corner, shirt
		**a.** wing
		**b.** extremity
				**1.** skirt, corner (of garment)
s: From [H3670](H3670); an *edge* or *extremity*; specifically (of a bird or army) a *wing*, (of a garment or bed clothing) a *flap*, (of the earth) a *quarter*, (of a building) a *pinnacle: -*  + bird, border, corner, end, feather \[-ed\], X flying, + (one an-) other, overspreading, X quarters, skirt, X sort, uttermost part, wing (\[-ed\]).

d:
Chinneroth or Cinneroth or Chinnereth = "harps"
**1.** the early name of the Sea of Galilee
**2.** a town and district in Naphtali near the Sea of Galilee
s: Respectively plural and singular feminine from the same as [H3658](H3658); perhaps *harp* shaped; *Kinneroth* or *Kinnereth*, a place in Palestine: - Chinnereth, Chinneroth, Cinneroth.
o: respectively pl. and sing. fem. from the same as [H3658](H3658)

d:
**1.** to gather
		**a.** (P'al) to gather
		**b.** (Ithpael) gathered (participle)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3664](H3664); to *assemble: -* gather together.

d: **1.** associate, colleague, companion
s: From [H3655](H3655); a *colleague* (as having the same title): - companion.

d: **1.** companion, associate
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3674](H3674): - companion.

d: **1.** seat (of honour), throne, seat, stool
s: Apparently a contraction for [H3678](H3678), but probably by erroneous transcription for [H5251](H5251): - sworn.
o: apparently a contraction for [H3678](H3678), but probably by erroneous transcription for [H5251](H5251)

d: **1.** full moon
s: Apparently from [H3680](H3680); properly *fulness* or the *full* *moon*, that is, its festival: - (time) appointed.

d:
**1.** seat (of honour), throne, seat, stool
		**a.** seat (of honour), throne
		**b.** royal dignity, authority, power (fig.)
s: From [H3680](H3680); properly *covered*, that is, a *throne* (as *canopied*): - seat, stool, throne.

d:
Chaldean = see Chaldea "clod-breakers"
**1.** a group of people usually associated with the area around Babylonia
**2.** the learned class of priests, magicians, or astronomers
s: For [H3778](H3778): - Chaldean.

d:
**1.** to cover, conceal, hide
		**a.** (Qal) conceal, covered (participle)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be covered
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to cover, clothe
				**2.** to cover, conceal
				**3.** to cover (for protection)
				**4.** to cover over, spread over
				**5.** to cover, overwhelm
		**d.** (Pual)
				**1.** to be covered
				**2.** to be clothed
		**e.** (Hithpael) to cover oneself, clothe oneself
s: A primitive root; properly to *plump*, that is, *fill* *up* hollows; by implication to *cover* (for clothing or secrecy): - clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare [H3780](H3780).

d: **1.** covering, outer covering
s: Passive participle of [H3680](H3680); properly *covered*, that is, (as noun) a *covering: -* covering.

d:
**1.** covering, clothing
		**a.** covering, clothing
		**b.** covering (for concealment)
s: From [H3680](H3680); a *cover* (garment); figuratively a *veiling: -* covering, raiment, vesture.

d:
**1.** to cut down, cut away, cut off (of plants)
		**a.** (Qal) cut away (pass participle)
				**1.** of judgment (fig.)
s: A primitive root; to *cut* *off: -* cut down (up).

d: **1.** fool, stupid fellow, dullard, simpleton, arrogant one
s: From [H3688](H3688); properly *fat*, that is, (figuratively) stupid or *silly: -* fool (-ish).

d:
**1.** constellation, Orion
		**a.** Orion, the constellation
		**b.** constellation (general)
s: The same as [H3684](H3684); any notable *constellation*; specifically *Orion* (as if a *burly* one): - constellation, Orion.

d:
Chesil = "foolish"
**1.** a town in the extreme south of Judah and 15 miles southwest of Beersheba; maybe same as H01329
s: The same as [H3684](H3684); *Kesil*, a place in Palestine: - Chesil.

d: **1.** foolishness, stupidity
s: From [H3684](H3684); *silliness: -* foolish.

d: **1.** (Qal) to be foolish, be stupid
s: A primitive root; properly to *be* *fat*, that is, (figuratively) *silly: -* be foolish.

d:
**1.** loins, flank
**2.** stupidity, folly
**3.** confidence, hope
s: From [H3688](H3688); properly *fatness*, that is, by implication (literally) the *loin* (as the seat of the leaf *fat*) or (generally) the *viscera*; also (figuratively) *silliness* or (in a good sense) *trust: -* confidence, flank, folly, hope, loin.

d:
**1.** confidence
**2.** folly, stupidity
s: Feminine of [H3689](H3689); in a good sense, *trust*; in a bad one, *silliness: -* confidence, folly.

d:
Chisleu = "his confidence"
**1.** the 9th month of the calendar corresponding to Nov-Dec
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Kisleu*, the ninth Hebrew month: - Chisleu.

d:
Chislon = "confidence"
**1.** father of Elidad, the prince selected to assist in the division of the land of Canaan among the tribes
s: From [H3688](H3688); *hopeful*; *Kislon*, an Israelite: - Chislon.

d:
Chesalon = "hopes"
**1.** a town of the northern border of Judah approx 10 miles west of Jerusalem
s: From [H3688](H3688); *fertile*; *Kesalon*, a place in Palestine: - Chesalon.

d:
Chesulloth = "flanks"
**1.** a town in Issachar near Jezreel; also 'Chisloth-tabor' H03696
s: Feminine plural of passive participle of [H3688](H3688); *fattened*, *Kesulloth*, a place in Palestine: - Chesulloth.
o: fem. pl. of pass. participle of [H3688](H3688)

d:
Casluhim = "fortified"
**1.** a people or tribe descended from Mizraim (Egypt) progenitors of the Philistines and Caphtorim
s: A plural probably of foreign derivation; *Casluchim*, a people cognate to the Egyptian: - Casluhim.
o: a plural probably of foreign derivation

d:
Chisloth-tabor = "flanks of Tabor"
**1.** a town of Issachar on the slopes of Mount Tabor; also 'Chesulloth' H03694
s: From the feminine plural of [H3689](H3689) and [H8396](H8396); *flanks* *of* *Tabor*; *Kisloth* *Tabor*, a place in Palestine: - Chisloth-tabor.
o: from the fem. pl. of [H3689](H3689) and [H8396](H8396)

d: **1.** (Qal) to cut, clip, trim, shear
s: A primitive root; to *shear: -*  X only, poll. Compare [H3765](H3765).

d: **1.** spelt-a wheat-like crop planted and harvested in the fall or spring
s: From [H3697](H3697); *spelt* (from its bristliness as if just *shorn*): - fitches, rie.

d: **1.** (Qal) to estimate, reckon, compute
s: A primitive root; to *estimate: -* make count.

d:
**1.** to long for, yearn for, long after
		**a.** (Qal) to long for
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to long for (deeply)
				**2.** being longed for (participle)
s: A primitive root; properly to become *pale*, that is, (by implication) to *pine* after; also to *fear: -* \[have\] desire, be greedy, long, sore.

d:
**1.** silver, money
		**a.** silver
				**1.** as metal
				**2.** as ornament
				**3.** as colour
		**b.** money, shekels, talents
s: From [H3700](H3700); *silver* (from its *pale* color); by implication *money: -* money, price, silver (-ling).

d:
**1.** silver
		**a.** as metal
		**b.** as money
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H3701](H3701): - money, silver.

d:
Casiphia = "silvery"
**1.** a place in Babylonia on the road between Babylon and Jerusalem; site uncertain
s: Perhaps from [H3701](H3701); *silvery*; *Casiphja*, a place in Babylon: - Casiphia.

d:
**1.** band, fillet, covered amulets, false phylacteries
		**a.** used by false prophetesses in Israel to support their demonic fortune-telling schemes
s: From [H3680](H3680); a *cushion* or pillow (as *covering* a seat or bed): - pillow.

d: **1.** now, at this time, until now
s: (Chaldee); probably from [H3652](H3652); *now: -* now.

d: **1.** now, and now
s: (Chaldee); feminine of [H3705](H3705); *thus* (only in the formula “and so *forth*”): - at such a time.

d:
**1.** to be angry, be vexed, be indignant, be wroth, be grieved, provoke to anger and wrath
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be vexed, be indignant
				**2.** to be angry
		**b.** (Piel) to provoke to anger
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to vex
				**2.** to vex, provoke to anger
s: A primitive root; to *trouble*; by implication to *grieve*, *rage*, *be* *indignant: -* be angry, be grieved, take indignation, provoke (to anger, unto wrath), have sorrow, vex, be wroth.

d:
**1.** anger, vexation, provocation, grief
		**a.** vexation
				**1.** of men
				**2.** of God
		**b.** vexation, grief, frustration
s: From [H3707](H3707); *vexation: -* anger, angry, grief, indignation, provocation, provoking, X sore, sorrow, spite, wrath.

d:
**1.** palm, hand, sole, palm of the hand, hollow or flat of the hand
		**a.** palm, hollow or flat of the hand
		**b.** power
		**c.** sole (of the foot)
		**d.** hollow, objects, bending objects, bent objects
				**1.** of thigh-joint
				**2.** pan, vessel (as hollow)
				**3.** hollow (of sling)
				**4.** hand-shaped branches or fronds (of palm trees)
				**5.** handles (as bent)
s: From [H3721](H3721); the hollow *hand* or palm (so of the *paw* of an animal, of the *sole*, and even of the *bowl* of a dish or sling, the *handle* of a bolt, the *leaves* of a palm tree); figuratively *power: -* branch, + foot, hand (\[-ful\], -dle, \[-led\]), hollow, middle, palm, paw, power, sole, spoon.

d: **1.** rock, hollow of a rock
s: From [H3721](H3721); a hollow *rock: -* rock.

d: **1.** (Qal) to sooth, subdue, pacify
s: A primitive root; properly to *bend*, that is, (figuratively) to *tame* or subdue: - pacify.

d: **1.** branch, leaf, frond, palm frond, palm branch
s: Feminine of [H3709](H3709); a *leaf* of a palm tree: - branch.

d:
**1.** bowl, basin
**2.** hoar frost, frost
s: From [H3722](H3722); properly a *cover*, that is, (by implication) a *tankard* (or *covered* goblet); also white *frost* (as *covering* the ground): - bason, hoar (-y) frost.

d: **1.** rafter, girder (meaning dubious)
s: From an unused root meaning to *connect*; a *girder: -* beam.
o: from an unused root meaning to connect

d:
**1.** young lion
**2.** village
s: From [H3722](H3722); a *village* (as *covered* in by walls); also a young *lion* (perhaps as *covered* with a mane): - (young) lion, village. Compare [H3723](H3723).

d:
Chephirah = "lioness"
**1.** a city of the Gibeonites subsequently assigned to the tribe of Benjamin
s: Feminine of [H3715](H3715); the *village* (always with the article); *Kephirah*, a place in Palestine: - Chephirah.

d:
**1.** to double, fold double, double over
		**a.** (Qal) to double over
		**b.** (Niphal) to be doubled
s: A primitive root; to *fold* together; figuratively to *repeat: -* double.

d: **1.** double, a doubling
s: From [H3717](H3717); a *duplicate: -* double.

d:
**1.** (Qal) to hunger, be hungry, hungrily desire
**2.** (CLBL) to twist, bend
s: A primitive root; to *bend: -* bend.

d: **1.** hunger, famine, painful hunger
s: From [H3719](H3719); *hunger* (as making to *stoop* with emptiness and pain): - famine.

d:
**1.** to bend, bend down, bow down, be bent, be bowed
		**a.** (Qal) to bend down, bow down
		**b.** (Niphal) to bow oneself down
s: A primitive root; to *curve: -* bow down (self).

d:
**1.** to cover, purge, make an atonement, make reconciliation, cover over with pitch
		**a.** (Qal) to coat or cover with pitch
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to cover over, pacify, propitiate
				**2.** to cover over, atone for sin, make atonement for
				**3.** to cover over, atone for sin and persons by legal rites
		**c.** (Pual)
				**1.** to be covered over
				**2.** to make atonement for
		**d.** (Hithpael) to be covered
s: A primitive root; to *cover* (specifically with bitumen); figuratively to *expiate* or *condone*, to *placate* or *cancel: -* appease, make (an) atonement, cleanse, disannul, forgive, be merciful, pacify, pardon, to pitch, purge (away), put off, (make) reconcile (-liation).

d: **1.** village
s: From [H3722](H3722); a *village* (as *protected* by walls): - village. Compare [H3715](H3715).

d:
**1.** price of a life, ransom, bribe
**2.** asphalt, pitch (as a covering)
**3.** the henna plant, name of a plant (henna?)
**4.** village
s: From [H3722](H3722); properly a *cover*, that is, (literally) a *village* (as *covered* in); (specifically) *bitumen* (as used for *coating*), and the *henna* plant (as used for *dyeing*); figuratively a *redemption* price: - bribe, camphire, pitch, ransom, satisfaction, sum of money, village.

d: **1.** atonement
s: From [H3722](H3722); *expiation* (only in plural): - atonement.

d:
Chephar-haammonai = "village of the Ammonites"
**1.** a village in Benjamin
s: From [H3723](H3723) and [H5984](H5984), with the article interposed; *village* *of* *the* *Ammonite*; *Kefarha* *Ammoni*, a place in Palestine: - Chefar-haamonai.
o: from [H3723](H3723) and [H5984](H5984), with the article interposed

d:
**1.** mercy-seat, place of atonement
		**a.** the golden plate of propitiation on which the High Priest sprinkled the seat 7 times on the Day of Atonement symbolically reconciling Jehovah and His chosen people
				**1.** the slab of gold on top of the ark of the covenant which measured 2.5 by 1.5 cubits; on it and part of it were the two golden cherubim facing each other whose outstretched wings came together above and constituted the throne of God
s: From [H3722](H3722); a *lid* (used only of the *cover* of the sacred Ark): - mercy seat.

d:
**1.** (Hiphil) to make bent, press or bend together
**2.** (CLBL) to bend down
		**a.** (Hiphil) to cause to bend down, trample
s: A primitive root; to *tread* down; figuratively to *humiliate: -* cover.

d:
**1.** to bind
		**a.** (P'il) to be bound
		**b.** (Pael) to bind
s: (Chaldee); a root of uncertain correspondence; to *fetter: -* bind.

d:
**1.** bulb, knob, capital, capital of a pillar
		**a.** knob, bulb (as ornament)
		**b.** capital (of a pillar)
s: Probably from an unused root meaning to *encircle*; a *chaplet*; but used only in an architectonic sense, that is, the *capital* of a column, or a wreath like *button* or *disk* on the candelabrum: - knop, (upper) lintel.
o: probably from an unused root meaning to encircle

d:
Caphtor = "a crown"
**1.** the original home of the Philistines, perhaps on the southwest coast of Asia Minor, maybe in Egypt or close by, or more probably on the island of Crete
**2.** (TWOT) the island of Crete, homeland or staging area of the Philistines
s: Apparently the same as [H3730](H3730); *Caphtor* (that is, a *wreath* shaped island), the original seat of the Philistines: - Caphtor.

d:
Caphtorim = see Caphtor "a crown"
**1.** Cretans as the inhabitants of Caphtor as distinct from the Philistines
s: Patrial from [H3731](H3731); a *Caphtorite* (collectively) or native of Caphtor: - Caphthorim, Caphtorim (-s).

d:
**1.** howdah, palanquin, basket saddle
		**a.** an enclosed riding space erected on a camel's saddle
**2.** pasture, meadow
**3.** ram, lamb, he-lamb
**4.** battering-ram
s: From [H3769](H3769) in the sense of *plumpness*; a *ram* (as *full* *grown* and *fat*), including a *battering* *ram* (as *butting*); hence a *meadow* (as *for* *sheep*); also a *pad* or camel’s saddle (as *puffed* *out*): - captain, furniture, lamb, (large) pasture, ram. See also [H1033](H1033), [H3746](H3746).
o: from [H3769](H3769) in the sense of plumpness

d:
**1.** kor, a measure (usually dry)
		**a.** a dry or liquid measure equal to 10 ephahs or baths
				**1.** a dry measure containing 6.25 bushels (220 l)
				**2.** a liquid measure of 58 gallons (263 l)
s: From the same as [H3564](H3564); properly a deep round *vessel*, that is, (specifically) a *cor* or measure for things dry. Chaldee the same: - cor, measure. Chaldee the same.

d: **1.** (Ithp'el) to be distressed, be grieved
s: (Chaldee); probably corresponding to [H3738](H3738) in the sense of *piercing* (figuratively); to *grieve: -* be grieved.
o: probably corresponding to [H3738](H3738) in sense of piercing (fig.)

d:
**1.** to put a mantle on, be-mantle, bind around
		**a.** (Pual) bemantled (participle)
s: From the same as [H3525](H3525); to *gird* or *clothe: -* clothed.

d: **1.** mantle, robe, cap, turban, helmet
s: (Chaldee); from a verb corresponding to that of [H3736](H3736); a *mantle: -* hat.
o: from a verb corresponding to that of [H3736](H3736)

d:
**1.** to dig, excavate, dig through
		**a.** (Qal) to dig
		**b.** (Niphal) to be dug
**2.** (Qal) to give a banquet or feast
**3.** (Qal) to get by trade, trade, buy
s: A primitive root; properly to *dig*; figuratively to *plot*; generally to *bore* or open: - dig, X make (a banquet), open.

d: **1.** (Qal) to get by trade, trade, buy, bargain over
s: Usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of [H3738](H3738) (through the common idea of *planning* implied in a bargain); to *purchase: -* buy, prepare.
o: usually assigned as a primitive root, but probably only a special application of [H3738](H3738) (through the common idea of planning implied in a bargain)

d: **1.** feast
s: From [H3739](H3739); a *purchase: -* provision.

d: **1.** cottage
s: Feminine of [H3733](H3733); a *meadow: -* cottage.

d:
**1.** cherub, cherubim (pl)
		**a.** an angelic being
				**1.** as guardians of Eden
				**2.** as flanking God's throne
				**3.** as an image form hovering over the Ark of the Covenant
				**4.** as the chariot of Jehovah (fig.)
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *cherub* or imaginary figure: - cherub, \[plural\] cherubims.

d:
Cherub = "blessing"
**1.** an apparent exilic settlement in Babylonia from which some persons of doubtful extraction returned with Zerubbabel
s: The same as [H3742](H3742); *Kerub*, a place in Babylon: - Cherub.

d: **1.** a herald
s: (Chaldee); from [H3745](H3745); a *herald: -* herald.

d: **1.** (Aphel) to herald, proclaim, make proclamation
s: (Chaldee); probably of Greek origin \[[H2784](H2784)\]; to *proclaim: -* make a proclamation.

d: **1.** a group of foreign mercenary soldiers serving as a bodyguard for king David; also executioners
s: Perhaps an abridged plural of [H3733](H3733) in the sense of *leader* (of the flock); a *life* *guardsman: -* captains, Cherethites \[from the margin\].
o: perhaps an abridged plural of [H3733](H3733) in the sense of leader (of the flock)

d:
Cherith = "cutting"
**1.** the brook where Elijah was hidden during a drought; east of Jordan
s: From [H3772](H3772); a *cut*; *Kerith*, a brook of Palestine: - Cherith.

d: **1.** divorce, dismissal, divorcement
s: From [H3772](H3772); a *cutting* (of the matrimonial bond), that is, *divorce: -* divorce (-ment).

d: **1.** edge, rim
s: Expanded from the same as [H3522](H3522); a *rim* or top margin: - compassive

d:
**1.** saffron
		**a.** an orange-yellow flower of the crocus family, used for flavouring in drinks and confections in order to promote perspiration for cooling of the body
s: Probably of foreign origin; the *crocus: -* saffron.

d:
Carchemish = "fortress of Chemosh"
**1.** a Hittite capital northeast of Israel on the Euphrates river captured by Pharaoh Necho and then from him by Nebuchadnezzar
s: Of foreign derivation; *Karkemish*, a place in Syria: - Carchemish.

d:
Carcas = "severe"
**1.** the 7th of the 7 eunuchs of king Ahasuerus
s: Of Persian origin; *Karkas*, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Carcas.

d: **1.** dromedary, dromedary camel, beasts
s: From [H3769](H3769); a *dromedary* (from its *rapid* motion as if dancing): - swift beast.

d: **1.** vineyard
s: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a *garden* or *vineyard*: - vines, (increase of the) vineyard (-s), vintage. See also [H1021](H1021).
o: from an unused root of uncertain meaning

d:
**1.** to tend vines or vineyards, to dress vines or vineyards
		**a.** (Qal) vinedressers (participle)
s: Active participle of an imaginary denominative from [H3754](H3754); a *vinedresser*; as one or two words: - vine dresser \[as one or two words\].
o: act. participle of an imaginary denominative from [H3754](H3754)

d:
Carmi = "my vineyard"
**1.** the 4th son of Reuben and progenitor of the Carmites
**2.** a Judaite, father of Achan, the 'troubler of Israel' in the time of Joshua
s: From [H3754](H3754); *gardener*; *Karmi*, the name of three Israelites: - Carmi.

d:
Carmites = see Carmi "my vineyard"
**1.** the descendants of Carmi, the 4th son of Reuben
s: Patronymic from [H3756](H3756); a *Karmite* or descendant of *Karmi: -* Carmites.

d: **1.** crimson, red, carmine
s: Probably of foreign origin; *carmine*, a deep red: - crimson.

d:
**1.** plantation, garden-land, orchard, fruit orchard
**2.** fruit, garden-growth (meton)
s: From [H3754](H3754); a planted *field* (garden, orchard, vineyard or park); by implication garden *produce: -* full (green) ears (of corn), fruitful field (place), plentiful (field).

d:
Carmel = "garden-land"
**1.** a mountain on the Mediterranean coast of northern Israel, just below Haifa
**2.** a town in the mountains on the west side of the Dead Sea and south of Hebron
s: The same as [H3759](H3759); *Karmel*, the name of a hill and of a town in Palestine: - Carmel, fruitful (plentiful) field, (place).

d:
Carmelite = see Carmel "garden-land"
**1.** an inhabitant of Carmel

d:
**1.** flood, deluge.
		**a.** Noah's flood that submerged the entire planet earth under water for about a year
++++
Some think Noah's flood was only local. However the description of it found in Gen. 6 through 8 makes this patently absurd. If it was local, Noah had 120 years to migrate out of the area to safe ground! Why waste all that effort building a ship? He only had to move less than 1500 feet a day to reach the farthest point on the globe! With the possible exception of Ps 29:10, this word always refers to Noah's flood. The real reason for insisting on a local flood is the acceptance of evolution with its long geological ages. Most holding that view are not willing to allow a global world wide flood to have happened less than 5000 years ago. To admit such eliminates the need for the geological ages for most of the geological column would have been rapidly laid down by Noah's flood.
