		**a.** wonder (as a special display of God's power)
		**b.** sign, token (of future event)
s: From [H3302](H3302) in the sense of *conspicuousness*; a *miracle*; by implication a *token* or *omen: -* miracle, sign, wonder (-ed at).
o: from [H3302](H3302) in the sense of conspicuousness

d: **1.** (Qal) squeezer, extortioner, oppressor
s: A primitive root; to *press*, that is, (figuratively) to *oppress: -* extortioner.

d:
**1.** act or place of going out or forth, issue, export, source, spring
		**a.** a going forth
				**1.** rising (sun), going forth of a command
				**2.** goings forth, those going forth
				**3.** way out, exit
		**b.** that which goes forth
				**1.** utterance
				**2.** export
		**c.** place of going forth
				**1.** source or spring (of water)
				**2.** place of departure
				**3.** east (of sun)
				**4.** mine (of silver)
s: From [H3318](H3318); a *going* *forth*, that is, (the act) an *egress*, or (the place) an *exit*; hence a *source* or *product*; specifically *dawn*, the *rising* of the sun (the *East*), *exportation*, *utterance*, a *gate*, a *fountain*, a *mine*, a *meadow* (as producing grass): - brought out, bud, that which came out, east, going forth, goings out, that which (thing that) is gone out, outgoing, proceeded out, spring, vein, \[water-\] course \[springs\].

d:
Moza = "fountain"
**1.** son of Caleb by Ephah his concubine
**2.** son of Zimri and a descendant of Saul
s: The same as [H4161](H4161); *Motsa*, the name of two Israelites: - Moza.

d:
**1.** origin, place of going out from
		**a.** origin
		**b.** places of going out to or from
				**1.** privy
s: Feminine of [H4161](H4161); a family *descent*; also a *sewer* (compare [H6675](H6675)): - draught house; going forth.

d: **1.** constraint, distress
s: From [H3332](H3332); *narrowness*; figuratively *distress: -* anguish, is straitened, straitness.

d: **1.** a casting
s: From [H5694](H5694); properly *fusion*, that is, literally a *casting* (of metal); figuratively a *mass* (of clay): - casting, hardness.

d:
**1.** pipe
**2.** a casting
s: From [H3332](H3332); properly something *poured* out, that is, a *casting* (of metal); by implication a *tube* (as cast): - when it was cast, pipe.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to mock, deride, jeer
s: A primitive root; to *jeer*, that is, (intensively) *blaspheme: -* be corrupt.

d: **1.** a burning mass, burning, hearth
s: From [H3344](H3344); a *fire* or *fuel*; abstractly a *conflagration: -* burning, hearth.

d:
**1.** hearth
		**a.** hearth-the plate or top of altar
s: Feminine of [H4168](H4168); *fuel: -* burning.

d: **1.** bait, lure, snare
s: From [H3369](H3369); a *noose* (for catching animals), (literally or figuratively); by implication a *hook* (for the nose): - be ensnared, gin, (is) snare (-d), trap.

d:
**1.** to change, exchange
		**a.** (Niphal) to be changed
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to change, alter
				**2.** to exchange
s: A primitive root; to *alter*; by implication to *barter*, to *dispose* *of: -*  X at all, (ex-) change, remove.

d:
**1.** fear, reverence, terror
		**a.** fear, terror
		**b.** reverence
		**c.** object of reverence
		**d.** awe-inspiring spectacle or deed
s: From [H3372](H3372); *fear*; by implication a *fearful* thing or deed: - dread, (that ought to be) fear (-ed), terribleness, terror.

d: **1.** thresher, threshing-sledge
s: From an unused root meaning to *triturate*; a threshing *sledge: -* threshing instrument.
o: from an unused root meaning to triturate

d:
**1.** descent, slope, steep place, hanging work, bevelled work
		**a.** descent
		**b.** hanging work
s: From [H3381](H3381); a *descent*; architecturally an ornamental *appendage*, perhaps a *festoon: -* going down, steep place, thin work.

d:
**1.** (early) rain
**2.** (TWOT) teacher
s: From [H3384](H3384); an *archer*; also *teacher* or *teaching*; also the *early* *rain* (see [H3138](H3138)): - (early) rain.

d:
Moreh = "teacher"
**1.** the oak tree at Shechem where Abram stopped when he first entered Canaan; close to the mountains of Ebal and Gerizim
**2.** the hill in the valley of Jezreel at which the Midianites were camped when Gideon attacked them
s: The same as [H4175](H4175); *Moreh*, a Canaanite; also a hill (perhaps named from him): - Moreh.

d: **1.** razor
s: From [H4171](H4171) in the sense of *shearing*; a *razor: -* razor.
o: from [H4171](H4171) in the sense of shearing

d: **1.** (Pual) scoured, polished, smooth
s: From [H3399](H3399); *obstinate*, that is, independent: - peeled.

d:
Moriah = "chosen by Jehovah"
**1.** the place where Abraham took Isaac for sacrifice
**2.** the mount on the eastern edge of Jerusalem on which Solomon built the temple
s: From [H7200](H7200) and [H3050](H3050); *seen* *of* *Jah*; *Morijah*, a hill in Palestine: - Moriah.

d: **1.** possession
s: From [H3423](H3423); a *possession*; figuratively *delight: -* possession, thought.

d: **1.** a possession
s: Feminine of [H4180](H4180); a *possession: -* heritage, inheritance, possession.

d:
Moresheth-gath = "possession of Gath"
**1.** a place apparently in the neighbourhood of Gath and probably the home of the prophet Micah
s: From [H3423](H3423) and [H1661](H1661); *possession* *of* *Gath*; *Moresheth-Gath*, a place in Palestine: - Moresheth-gath.

d:
Morasthite see Moreshethgath = "possession of Gath"
**1.** an inhabitant of Moresheth
		**a.** the prophet Micah
s: Patrial from [H4182](H4182); a *Morashtite* or inhabitant of Moresheth Gath: - Morashthite.

d:
**1.** to feel
		**a.** (Qal) to feel
		**b.** (Hiphil) to feel
s: A primitive root; to *touch: -* feel, handle.

d:
**1.** to depart, remove
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to depart
				**2.** to remove
				**3.** to be removed (of inanimate objects)
		**b.** (Hiphil) to remove, depart
s: A primitive root (perhaps rather the same as [H4184](H4184) through the idea of receding by *contact*); to *withdraw* (both literally and figuratively, whether intransitively or transitively): - cease, depart, go back, remove, take away.
o: a primitive root \[perhaps rather the same as [H4184](H4184) through the idea of receding by contact\]

d:
**1.** seat, assembly, dwelling-place, dwelling, dwellers
		**a.** seat, sitting, those sitting, sitting company or assembly
		**b.** dwelling place, dwelling
		**c.** situation, location
		**d.** time of dwelling
		**e.** those dwelling, dweller
s: From [H3427](H3427); a *seat*; figuratively a *site*; abstractly a *session*; by extension an *abode* (the place or the time); by implication *population: -* assembly, dwell in, dwelling (-place), wherein (that) dwelt (in), inhabited place, seat, sitting, situation, sojourning.

d:
Mushi = "yielding"
**1.** son of Merari, grandson of Kohath, and great grandson of Levi
s: From [H4184](H4184); *sensitive*; *Mushi*, a Levite: - Mushi.

d:
Mushites = see Mushi "yielding"
**1.** descendants of Mushi, the great grandson of Levi
s: Patronymic from [H4187](H4187); a *Mushite* (collectively) or descendant of Mushi: - Mushites.

d: **1.** cord
s: Active participle feminine of [H4900](H4900); something *drawing*, that is, (figuratively) a *cord: -* band.

d: **1.** saving act, deliverance
s: From [H3467](H3467); *deliverance: -* salvation.

d:
**1.** to die, kill, have one executed
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to die
				**2.** to die (as penalty), be put to death
				**3.** to die, perish (of a nation)
				**4.** to die prematurely (by neglect of wise moral conduct)
		**b.** (Polel) to kill, put to death, dispatch
		**c.** (Hiphil) to kill, put to death
		**d.** (Hophal)
				**1.** to be killed, be put to death
						**a.** to die prematurely
s: A primitive root; to *die* (literally or figuratively); causatively to *kill: -*  X at all, X crying, (be) dead (body, man, one), (put to, worthy of) death, destroy (-er), (cause to, be like to, must) die, kill, necro \[-mancer\], X must needs, slay, X surely, X very suddenly, X in \[no\] wise.

d:
**1.** death
		**a.** meaning dubious
s: From [H4191](H4191) and [H1121](H1121) with the preposition and article interposed; *“to* *die* *for* *the* *son”*, probably the title of a popular song: - death, Muthlabben.
o: from [H4191](H4191) and [H1121](H1121) with the preposition and article interposed

d: **1.** death
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H4194](H4194); *death: -* death.

d:
**1.** death, dying, Death (personified), realm of the dead
		**a.** death
		**b.** death by violence (as a penalty)
		**c.** state of death, place of death
s: From [H4191](H4191); *death* (natural or violent); concretely the *dead*, their place or state (*hades*); figuratively *pestilence*, *ruin: -* (be) dead (\[-ly\]), death, die (-d).

d:
**1.** pre-eminence, abundance, profit, superiority
		**a.** abundance, plenty
		**b.** pre-eminence, superiority
s: From [H3498](H3498); literally *gain*; figuratively *superiority: -* plenteousness, preeminence, profit.

d: **1.** altar
s: From [H2076](H2076); an *altar: -* altar.

d: **1.** mixture, mixed wine
s: From an unused root meaning to *mingle* (water with wine); *tempered* wine: - liquor.
o: from an unused root meaning to mingle (water with wine)

d: **1.** sucked out, empty, exhausted
s: From an unused root meaning to *suck* out; *exhausted: -* burnt.
o: from an unused root meaning to suck out

d:
Mizzah = "fear"
**1.** son of Reuel and grandson of Esau
s: Probably from an unused root meaning to *faint* with fear; *terror*; *Mizzah*, an Edomite: - Mizzah.
o: probably from an unused root meaning to faint with fear

d: **1.** garner, granary
s: Probably from an unused root meaning to *gather* *in*; a *granary: -* garner.
o: probably from an unused root meaning to gather in

d: **1.** doorpost, gatepost
s: From the same as [H2123](H2123); a *door* *post* (as *prominent*): - (door, side) post.

d: **1.** food, sustenance
s: From [H2109](H2109); *food: -* meat, victual.

d: **1.** food, feed
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H4202](H4202): - meat.

d:
**1.** net, trap
		**a.** meaning dubious
s: From [H2114](H2114) in the sense of *turning* *aside* from truth; *treachery*, that is, a *plot: -* wound.
o: from [H2114](H2114) in the sense of turning aside from truth

d:
**1.** wound
		**a.** wound (fig. of injury to or sufferings of Israel or Judah)
s: From [H2115](H2115) in the sense of *binding* up; a *bandage*, that is, remedy; hence a *sore* (as needing a compress): - bound up, wound.
o: from [H2115](H2115) in the sense of binding

d: **1.** girdle
s: From [H2118](H2118); a *belt* (as movable): - girdle, strength.

d:
**1.** three-pronged fork
		**a.** a sacrificial implement
s: From an unused root meaning to *draw* up; a *fork: -* fleshhook.
o: from an unused root meaning to draw up

d:
**1.** constellations
		**a.** signs of zodiac (maybe)
s: Apparently from [H5140](H5140) in the sense of *raining*; a *constellation*, that is, Zodiacal sign (perhaps as affecting the weather): - planet. Compare [H4216](H4216).
o: apparently from [H5140](H5140) in the sense of raining

d:
**1.** purpose, discretion, device, plot
		**a.** purpose
		**b.** discretion
		**c.** devices (evil)
s: From [H2161](H2161); a *plan*, usually evil (*machination*), sometimes good (*sagacity*): - (wicked) device, discretion, intent, witty invention, lewdness, mischievous (device), thought, wickedly.

d: **1.** melody, psalm
s: From [H2167](H2167); properly instrumental *music*; by implication a *poem* set to notes: - psalm.

d: **1.** pruning knife
s: From [H2168](H2168); a *pruning* *knife: -* pruning-hook.

d: **1.** snuffers (temple utensil)
s: From [H2168](H2168); a *tweezer* (only in the plural): - snuffers.

d:
**1.** a little, a trifle, a few
		**a.** a trifle, a little (of time)
		**b.** a remnant, a very few (of number)
s: From the same as [H2191](H2191); *fewness*; by implication as superlative *diminutiveness: -* few, X very.

d: **1.** pitchfork
s: From [H2219](H2219); a winnowing *shovel* (as scattering the chaff): - fan.

d: **1.** scatterer
s: Apparently from [H2219](H2219); properly a *scatterer*, that is, the north *wind* (as dispersing clouds; only in plural): - north.

d:
**1.** Mazzaroth
		**a.** the 12 signs of the Zodiac and their 36 associated constellations
s: Apparently from [H5144](H5144) in the sense of *distinction*; some noted *constellation* (only in the plural), perhaps collectively the *zodiac*: - Mazzoroth. Compare [H4208](H4208).
o: apparently from [H5144](H5144) in the sense of distinction

d:
**1.** place of sunrise, east
		**a.** sunrise, east (with 'sun')
		**b.** the east (without 'sun')
				**1.** to or toward the place of sunrise
				**2.** to the east, eastward
s: From [H2224](H2224); *sunrise*, that is, the *east: -* east (side, -ward), (sun-) rising (of the sun).

d: **1.** seed-land, place of sowing
s: From [H2232](H2232); a planted *field: -* thing sown.

d:
**1.** bowl, basin
		**a.** bowl (for wine)
		**b.** basin (vessel for throwing or tossing a liquid)
s: From [H2236](H2236); a *bowl* (as if for sprinkling): - bason, bowl.

d: **1.** fatling, fat one
s: From [H4229](H4229) in the sense of *greasing*; *fat*; figuratively *rich: -* fatling (one).
o: from [H4229](H4229) in the sense of greasing

d: **1.** marrow
s: From the same as [H4220](H4220); *fat*, that is, marrow: - marrow.

d:
**1.** to strike, clap (the hands)
		**a.** (Qal) to clap (of joy)
		**b.** (Piel) to clap (of exultation)
s: A primitive root; to *rub* or *strike* the hands together (in exultation): - clap.

d:
**1.** to strike, smite, kill
		**a.** (P'al) to strike
		**b.** (Pael) to hinder
		**c.** (Ithp'al) to allow to be stricken
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H4222](H4222); to *strike* in pieces; also to *arrest*; specifically to *impale: -* hang, smite, stay.

d:
**1.** hiding place
**2.** (TWOT) bosom
s: From [H2244](H2244); a *refuge: -* hiding (lurking) place.

d:
**1.** thing joined, joint, seam, place of joining
		**a.** thing joined
		**b.** place of joining
s: From [H2266](H2266); a *junction*, that is, seam or sewed piece: - coupling.

d: **1.** binder, clamp, joint
s: From [H2266](H2266); a *joiner*, that is, brace or cramp: - coupling, joining.

d:
**1.** flat plate, pan, griddle
		**a.** for baking
s: From the same as [H2281](H2281); a *pan* for baking in: - pan.

d: **1.** wrapping, girding, sash, cincture
s: From [H2296](H2296); a *girdle: -* girding.

d:
**1.** to wipe, wipe out
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to wipe
				**2.** to blot out, obliterate
				**3.** to blot out, exterminate
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be wiped out
				**2.** to be blotted out
				**3.** to be exterminated
		**c.** (Hiphil) to blot out (from memory)
**2.** (Qal) to strike
**3.** (Pual) full of marrow (participle)
s: A primitive root; properly to *stroke* or *rub*; by implication to *erase*; also to *smooth* (as if with oil), that is, *grease* or make fat; also to *touch*, that is, reach to: - abolish, blot out, destroy, full of marrow, put out, reach unto, X utterly, wipe (away, out).

d: **1.** circle-instrument, compass
s: From [H2328](H2328); an instrument for marking a circle, that is, *compasses: -* compassive

d: **1.** city, haven
s: From an unused root meaning to *enclose*; a *harbor* (as *shut* in by the shore): - haven.
o: from an unused root meaning to enclose

d:
Mehujael = "smitten by God"
**1.** son of Irad and great grandson of Cain
s: From [H4229](H4229) and [H410](H410); *smitten* *of* *God*; *Mechujael* or *Mechijael*, an antediluvian patriarch: - Mehujael.

d:
Mahavite = "propagators"
**1.** apparently, an inhabitant of a place called 'Macheweh'
		**a.** the designation of Eliel, one of David's mighty warriors
s: Apparently a patrial, but from an unknown place (in the plural only for a singular); a *Machavite* or inhabitant of some place named Machaveh: - Mahavite.
o: apparently a patrial, but from an unknown place (in the pl. only for a sing.)

d: **1.** dance, dancing
s: From [H2342](H2342); a (round) *dance: -* dance (-cing).

d:
Mahol = "dancing"
**1.** father of Heman
s: The same as [H4234](H4234); *dancing*; *Machol*, an Israelite: - Mahol.

d: **1.** vision (in the ecstatic state)
s: From [H2372](H2372); a *vision: -* vision.

d: **1.** light, window, place of seeing
s: From [H2372](H2372); a *window: -* light.

d:
Mahazioth = "visions"
**1.** one of the 14 sons of Heman the Kohathite and the chief of a group of singers
s: Feminine plural from [H2372](H2372); *visions*; *Machazioth*, an Israelite: - Mahazioth.

d: **1.** stroke (of a battering ram)
s: From [H4229](H4229); a *stroke*, that is, battering *ram: -* engines.

d:
Mehida = "famous" or "noble"
**1.** head of a family of exiles returning with Zerubbabel
s: From [H2330](H2330); *junction*; *Mechida*, one of the Nethinim: - Mehida.

d:
**1.** preservation of life, sustenance
		**a.** preservation of life
		**b.** sustenance
		**c.** reviving
		**d.** the quick of the flesh, live flesh, tender or raw flesh
s: From [H2421](H2421); *preservation* *of* *life*; hence *sustenance*; also the live flesh, that is, the *quick: -* preserve life, quick, recover selves, reviving, sustenance, victuals.

d:
**1.** price, hire
		**a.** price
		**b.** hire, reward, gain
s: From an unused root meaning to *buy*; *price*, *payment*, *wages: -* gain, hire, price, sold, worth.
o: from an unused root meaning to buy

d:
Mehir = "price"
**1.** son of Chelub the brother of Shuah
s: The same as [H4242](H4242); *price*; *Mechir*, an Israelite: - Mehir.

d:
Mahlah = "disease"
**1.** the eldest of 5 daughters of Zelophehad the grandson of Manasseh
**2.** a Gileadite
s: From [H2470](H2470); *sickness*; *Machlah*, the name apparently of two Israelitesses: - Mahlah.

d: **1.** disease, sickness
s: From [H2470](H2470); *sickness: -* disease, infirmity, sickness.

d: **1.** dancing, dance
s: Feminine of [H4234](H4234); a *dance: -* company, dances (-cing).

d: **1.** hole, cavern
s: From [H2490](H2490); a *cavern* (as if excavated): - cave.

d:
Mahlon = "sick"
**1.** son of Elimelech by Naomi and first husband of Ruth
s: From [H2470](H2470); *sick*; *Machlon*, an Israelite: - Mahlon.

d:
Mahli = "sick"
**1.** son of Merari and grandson of Levi; progenitor of the family of the Mahlites
**2.** son of Mushi, grandson of Merari, and great grandson of Levi
s: From [H2470](H2470); *sick*; *Machli*, the name of two Israelites: - Mahli.

d:
Mahlites = see Mahli "my sickness"
**1.** descendants of Mahli, the grandson of Levi
s: Patronymic from [H4249](H4249); a *Machlite* or (collectively) descendant of Machli: - Mahlites.

d:
**1.** sickness, suffering
		**a.** caused by wounds
s: From [H2470](H2470); a *disease: -* disease.

d: **1.** knife
s: From [H2498](H2498); a (sacrificial) *knife* (as *gliding* through the flesh): - knife.

d:
**1.** braid, lock, plait
		**a.** of hair
s: From [H2498](H2498); a *ringlet* of hair (as *gliding* over each other): - lock.

d: **1.** robe of state
s: From [H2502](H2502); a *mantle* (as easily *drawn* *off*): - changeable suit of apparel, change of raiment.

d:
**1.** class, division
		**a.** of priests and Levites
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H4256](H4256); a *section* (of the Levites): - course.

d:
**1.** division, course, class, share, allotment
		**a.** division, part
		**b.** division, class, course
				**1.** of priests, Levites (technical term of organisation)
s: From [H2505](H2505); a *section* (of Levites, people or soldiers): - company, course, division, portion. See also [H5555](H5555).

d:
**1.** Mahalath
		**a.** found in headings of Ps 53:1 and Ps 81:1
				**1.** meaning dubious, probably a catchword in a song giving name to tune
s: From [H2470](H2470); *sickness*; *machalath*, probably the title (initial word) of a popular song: - Mahalath.

d:
Mahalath = "stringed instrument"
**1.** daughter of Jerimoth son of king David and wife, evidently the 1st, of king Rehoboam the grandson of king David
**2.** daughter of Ishmael and wife of Esau
s: The smae as [H4257](H4257); *sickness*; *Machalath*, the name of an Ishmaelitess and of an Israelitess: - Mahalath.

d:
Meholathite = Mehola "of dancing"
**1.** an inhabitant of a place evidently named 'Meholah'
		**a.** ascribed to Adriel and Barzillai
s: Patrial from [H65](H65); a *Mecholathite* or inhabitant of Abel Mecholah: - Mecholathite.

d:
**1.** curd-like, smooth, unctuous, hypocritical
		**a.** words of flattery (fig.)
s: A denominative from [H2529](H2529); something *buttery* (that is, unctuous and pleasant), as (figuratively) *flattery: -*  X than butter.

d: **1.** desire, desirable thing, pleasant thing
s: From [H2530](H2530); *delightful*; hence a *delight*, that is, object of affection or desire: - beloved, desire, goodly, lovely, pleasant (thing).

d: **1.** desirable, precious thing
s: From [H2530](H2530); *desired*; hence a *valuable: -* pleasant thing.

d:
**1.** object of compassion or pity, thing pitied
**2.** (TWOT) object of deep love
s: From [H2550](H2550); properly *sympathy*; (by paronomasia with [H4261](H4261)) *delight: -* pitieth.

d:
**1.** encampment, camp
		**a.** camp, place of encampment
		**b.** camp of armed host, army camp
		**c.** those who encamp, company, body of people
s: From [H2583](H2583); an *encampment* (of travellers or troops); hence an *army*, whether literally (of soldiers) or figuratively (of dancers, angels, cattle, locusts, stars; or even the sacred courts): - army, band, battle, camp, company, drove, host, tents.

d:
Mahaneh-dan = "camp of Dan"
**1.** campsite of the tribe of Dan; place behind Kirjath-jearim and between Zorah and Eshtaol
s: From [H4264](H4264) and [H1835](H1835); *camp* *of* *Dan*; *Machaneh-Dan*, a place in Palestine: - Mahaneh-dan.

d:
**1.** kind, sometimes a species (usually of animals)
++++
Groups of living organisms belong in the same created "kind" if they have descended from the same ancestral gene pool. This does not preclude new species because this represents a partitioning of the original gene pool. Information is lost or conserved not gained. A new species could arise when a population is isolated and inbreeding occurs. By this definition a new species is not a new "kind" but a further partitioning of an existing "kind".
s: From an unused root meaning to *portion* out; a *sort*, that is, *species*: - kind. Compare [H4480](H4480).
o: from an unused root meaning to portion out

d:

d:
Machpelah = "double" or "portion"
**1.** the location of a burial cave for the patriarchs, near Hebron

d:
**1.** to sell

d:

**1.** a native or inhabitant of Mecherah

d:

d:

d:

d:

		**e.** (Hithpael) to mass themselves against

s: Feminine of [H4394](H4394); a *filling*, that is, *setting* (of gems): - inclosing, setting.

d:
**1.** messenger, representative

o: from an unused root meaning to despatch as a deputy

d: **1.** angel

d:

d:
Malchishua or Melchishua = "my king is wealth"

d:
Hammoleketh = "the queen"
**1.** daughter of Machir and sister of Gilead
