		**a.** (Qal) to shine
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to enlighten
				**2.** to cause to shine
s: A primitive root; to *glitter*; causatively to *illuminate: -* (en-) lighten, (cause to) shine.

d: **1.** brightness
s: From [H5050](H5050); *brilliancy* (literally or figuratively): - bright (-ness), light, (clear) shining.

d:
Nogah = "brightness"
**1.** one of the 13 sons of David born to him in Jerusalem
s: The same as [H5051](H5051); *Nogah*, a son of David: - Nogah.

d: **1.** brightness, daylight
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5051](H5051); *dawn: -* morning.

d: **1.** brightness
s: Feminine of [H5051](H5051); *splendor: -* brightness.

d:
**1.** to push, thrust, gore
		**a.** (Qal) to gore
		**b.** (Piel) to push or thrust at
		**c.** (Hithpael) to engage in thrusting, wage war
s: A primitive root; to *but* with the horns; figuratively to *war* against: - gore, push (down, -ing).

d: **1.** addicted to goring, apt to gore
s: From [H5055](H5055); *butting*, that is, *vicious: -* used (wont) to push.

d:
**1.** leader, ruler, captain, prince
		**a.** ruler, prince
		**b.** prince-overseer
		**c.** ruler (in other capacities)
		**d.** princely things
s: From [H5046](H5046); a *commander* (as occupying the *front*), civil, military or religious; generally (abstract plural), *honorable* themes: - captain, chief, excellent thing, (chief) governor, leader, noble, prince, (chief) ruler.

d:
**1.** music, song, taunt song
		**a.** music (of stringed instrument)
		**b.** song
				**1.** taunting or mocking song
s: From [H5059](H5059); properly instrumental *music*; by implication a stringed *instrument*; by extension a *poem* set to music; specifically an *epigram: -* stringed instrument, musick, Neginoth \[plural\], song.

d:
**1.** to play or strike strings, play a stringed instrument
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** player (participle)
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to play
						**a.** player, minstrel (participle)
s: A primitive root; prop to *thrum*, that is, *beat* a tune with the fingers; especially to *play* on a stringed instrument; hence (generally) to *make* *music: -* player on instruments, sing to the stringed instruments, melody, ministrel, play (-er. -ing).

d:
**1.** to touch, reach, strike
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to touch
				**2.** to strike
				**3.** to reach, extend to
				**4.** to be stricken
						**a.** stricken (participle)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be stricken, be defeated
		**c.** (Piel) to strike
		**d.** (Pual) to be stricken (by disease)
		**e.** (Hiphil) to cause to touch, reach, approach, arrive
				**1.** to cause to touch, apply
				**2.** to reach, extend, attain, arrive, come
				**3.** to approach (of time)
				**4.** to befall (of fate)
s: A primitive root; properly to *touch*, that is, *lay* *the* *hand* *upon* (for any purpose; euphemistically, to *lie* *with* a woman); by implication to *reach* (figuratively to *arrive*, *acquire*); violently, to *strike* (punish, defeat, destroy, etc.): - beat, (X be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.

d:
**1.** stroke, plague, disease, mark, plague spot
		**a.** stroke, wound
		**b.** stroke (metaphorical of disease)
		**c.** mark (of leprosy)
s: From [H5060](H5060); a *blow* (figuratively *infliction*); also (by implication) a *spot* (concretely a *leprous* person or dress): - plague, sore, stricken, stripe, stroke, wound.

d:
**1.** to strike, smite
		**a.** (Qal) to strike, smite
		**b.** (Niphal) to be stricken, be smitten
		**c.** (Hithpael) to stumble
s: A primitive root; to *push*, *gore*, *defeat*, *stub* (the toe), *inflict* (a disease): - beat, dash, hurt, plague, slay, smite (down), strike, stumble, X surely, put to the worse.

d:
**1.** blow, striking, plague
		**a.** blow, plague (fatal)
		**b.** striking
s: From [H5062](H5062); a *trip* (of the foot); figuratively an *infliction* (of disease): - plague, stumbling.

d:
**1.** to pour, run, flow, pour down
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be poured, be spilt
				**2.** to pour oneself, flow, trickle
				**3.** to vanish (fig.)
				**4.** to be stretched out
		**b.** (Hiphil) to pour down
		**c.** (Hophal) to melt
s: A primitive root; to *flow*; figuratively to *stretch* out; causatively to *pour* out or down; figuratively to *deliver* over: - fall, flow away, pour down (out), run, shed, split, trickle down.

d:
**1.** to press, drive, oppress, exact, exert demanding pressure
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to press, drive
				**2.** to exact
				**3.** driver, taskmaster, ruler, oppressor, tyrant, lord, exactor of tribute (participle)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be hard pressed
s: A primitive root; to *drive* (an animal, a workman, a debtor, an army); by implication to *tax*, *harass*, *tyrannize: -* distress, driver, exact (-or), oppress (-or), X raiser of taxes, taskmaster.

d:
**1.** to draw near, approach
		**a.** (Qal) to draw or come near
				**1.** of humans
						**a.** of sexual intercourse
				**2.** of inanimate subject
						**a.** to approach one another
		**b.** (Niphal) to draw near
		**c.** (Hiphil) to cause to approach, bring near, bring
		**d.** (Hophal) to be brought near
		**e.** (Hithpael) to draw near
s: A primitive root; to *be* or *come* (causatively *bring*) *near* (for any purpose); euphemistically to *lie* *with* a woman; as an enemy, to *attack*; religiously to *worship*; causatively to *present*; figuratively to *adduce* an argument; by reversal, to *stand* *back: -* (make to) approach (nigh), bring (forth, hither, near), (cause to) come (higher, near, nigh), give place, go hard (up), (be, draw, go) near (nigh), offer, overtake, present, put, stand.

d: **1.** heap
s: From [H5110](H5110) in the sense of *piling* up; a *mound*, that is, *wave: -* heap.
o: from [H5110](H5110) in the sense of piling up

d:
**1.** to incite, impel, make willing
		**a.** (Qal) to incite, impel
		**b.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to volunteer
				**2.** to offer free-will offerings
s: A primitive root; to *impel*; hence to *volunteer* (as a soldier), to *present* spontaneously: - offer freely, be (give, make, offer self) willing (-ly).

d:
**1.** to volunteer, offer freely
		**a.** (Ithpael)
				**1.** to volunteer
				**2.** to give freely, offer freely
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5068](H5068); *be* (or *give*) *liberal* (*liberally*): - (be minded of . . . own) freewill (offering), offer freely (willingly).

d:
Nadab = "generous"
**1.** eldest son of Aaron by Elisheba; struck dead before the sanctuary in the wilderness for kindling the censers with strange fire
**2.** son of king Jeroboam I of the northern kingdom of Israel and king of Israel for 2 years before being slain by Baasha
**3.** a Jerahmeelite, son of Shammai, of the tribe of Judah
**4.** a son of Gibeon of the tribe of Benjamin
s: From [H5068](H5068); *liberal*; *Nadab*, the name of four Israelites: - Nadab.

d:
**1.** voluntariness, free-will offering
		**a.** voluntariness
		**b.** freewill, voluntary, offering
s: From [H5068](H5068); properly (abstractly) *spontaneity*, or (adjectively) *spontaneous*; also (concretely) a *spontaneous* or (by inference, in plural) *abundant* gift: - free (-will) offering, freely, plentiful, voluntary (-ily, offering), willing (-ly, offering).

d:
Nedabiah = "whom Jehovah impels"
**1.** one of the sons of king Jehoiachin (Jeconiah) of Judah
s: From [H5068](H5068) and [H3050](H3050); *largess* *of* *Jah*; *Nedabjah*, an Israelite: - Nedabiah.

d: **1.** row, layer, course (of stones)
s: (Chaldee); from a rot meaning to *stick*; a *layer* (of building materials): - row.
o: from a root meaning to stick

d:
**1.** to retreat, flee, depart, move, wander abroad, stray, flutter
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to retreat, flee
				**2.** to flee, depart
				**3.** to wander, stray
				**4.** to flutter (of birds)
		**b.** (Poal) to flee away, be chased
		**c.** (Hiphil) to chase away
		**d.** (Hophal) to be chased away
		**e.** (Hithpolel) to flee away
s: A primitive root; properly to *wave* to and fro (rarely to *flap* up and down); figuratively to *rove*, *flee*, or (causatively) to *drive* away: - chase (away), X could not, depart, flee (X apace, away), (re-) move, thrust away, wander (abroad, -er, -ing).

d: **1.** (P'al) to flee
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5074](H5074); to *depart: -* go from.

d: **1.** tossing (of sleeplessness)
s: Passive participle of [H5074](H5074); properly *tossed*; abstractly a *rolling* (on the bed): - tossing to and fro.

d:
**1.** (Hiphil) exclude, drive away, thrust aside
**2.** (Piel) cast out, put away
s: A primitive root; properly to *toss*; figuratively to *exclude*, that is, banish, postpone, prohibit: - cast out, drive, put far away.

d: **1.** gift
s: From [H5077](H5077) in the sense of freely *flinging* money; a *bounty* (for prostitution): - gifts.
o: from [H5077](H5077) in the sense of freely flinging money

d:
**1.** impurity, filthiness, menstruous, set apart
		**a.** impurity
				**1.** of ceremonial impurity
				**2.** of menstruation
		**b.** impure thing (fig.)
				**1.** of idolatry, immorality
s: From [H5074](H5074); properly *rejection*; by implication *impurity*, especially personal (menstruation) or moral (idolatry, incest): -  X far, filthiness, X flowers, menstruous (woman), put apart, X removed (woman), separation, set apart, unclean (-ness, thing, with filthiness).

d:
**1.** to impel, thrust, drive away, banish
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to impel
				**2.** to thrust away, banish
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be impelled
				**2.** to be thrust out, be banished
						**a.** banished, outcast (participle)
				**3.** to be driven away
				**4.** to be thrust away, thrust aside
		**c.** (Pual) to be thrust into
				**1.** thrust (participle)
		**d.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to thrust, move, impel
				**2.** to thrust out, banish
				**3.** to thrust away, thrust aside
		**e.** (Hophal) to be chased, be hunted
				**1.** chased, hunted (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *push* off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.): - banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.

d:
adj
**1.** inclined, willing, noble, generous
		**a.** incited, inclined, willing
		**b.** noble, princely (in rank)
		**c.** noble (in mind and character)
n m
**2.** noble one
s: From [H5068](H5068); properly *voluntary*, that is, generous; hence, *magnanimous*; as noun, a *grandee* (sometimes a *tyrant*): - free, liberal (things), noble, prince, willing (\[hearted\]).

d:
**1.** nobility, nobleness, noble deeds
		**a.** nobility (of rank), honour
		**b.** noble things
s: Feminine of [H5081](H5081); properly *nobility*, that is, reputation: - soul.

d:
**1.** gift
		**a.** of a harlot's bribe
s: Probably from an unused root meaning to *give*; a *present* (for prostitution): - gift.
o: probably from an unused root meaning to give

d: **1.** sheath
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *sheath* (of a sword): - sheath.

d:
**1.** sheath
		**a.** meaning uncertain
s: (Chaldee); from the same as [H5084](H5084); a *sheath*; figuratively the *body* (as the receptacle of the soul): - body.

d:
**1.** to drive, drive away, drive asunder
		**a.** (Qal) to drive about
		**b.** (Niphal) to be driven, be driven about
s: A primitive root; to *shove* asunder, that is, *disperse: -* drive (away, to and fro), thrust down, shaken, tossed to and fro.

d:
**1.** to vow, make a vow
		**a.** (Qal) to vow a vow
s: A primitive root; to *promise* (positively, to do or give something to God): - (make a) vow.

d: **1.** vow, votive offering
s: From [H5087](H5087); a *promise* (to God); also (concretely) a thing *promised: -* vow (\[-ed\]).

d: **1.** eminency, distinction
s: From an unused root meaning to *lament*; *lamentation: -* wailing.
o: from an unused root meaning to lament

d:
**1.** to drive, lead, guide, conduct
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to drive, lead on, drive away, drive off
				**2.** to behave itself (fig.) (of heart)
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to drive away, lead off
				**2.** to lead on, guide, guide on
				**3.** to cause to drive
**2.** (Piel) to moan, lament
s: A primitive root; to *drive* forth (a person, an animal or chariot), that is, *lead*, *carry* *away*; reflexively to *proceed* (that is, impel or guide oneself); also (from the *panting* induced by effort), to *sigh: -* acquaint, bring (away), carry away, drive (away), lead (away, forth), (be) guide, lead (away, forth).

d:
**1.** to wail, lament
		**a.** (Qal) to wail, lament
		**b.** (Niphal) to go mourning after
s: A primitive root; to *groan*, that is, *bewail*; hence (through the idea of *crying* aloud) to *assemble* (as if on proclamation): - lament, wail.

d:
**1.** wailing, lamentation, mourning song
		**a.** wailing
		**b.** mourning song
s: From [H5091](H5091); an *elegy: -* lamentation, wailing.

d: **1.** wailing, lament, lamentation, mourning song
s: Feminine of [H5092](H5092); *lamentation: -* doleful.

d: **1.** light
s: (Chaldee); from the same as [H5105](H5105); *illumination*, that is, (figuratively) wisdom: - light.

d:
**1.** to lead, give rest, lead with care, guide to a watering place or station, cause to rest, bring to a station or place of rest, guide, refresh
		**a.** (Piel)
				**1.** to lead to a watering-place or station and cause to rest there
				**2.** to lead or bring to a station or goal
				**3.** to lead, guide
				**4.** to give rest to
				**5.** to refresh (with food)
		**b.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to lead on
				**2.** to journey by stations or stages
s: A primitive root; properly to run with a *sparkle*, that is, *flow*; hence (transitively) to *conduct*, and (by inference) to *protect*, *sustain: -* carry, feed, guide, lead (gently, on).

d:
Nahalal or Nahallal or Nahalol = "pasture"
**1.** one of the cities of Zebulun given to the Merarite Levites
		**a.** site uncertain
		**b.** maybe modern 'Malul', a village in the plain of Esdraelon
s: The same as [H5097](H5097); *Nahalal* or *Nahalol*, a place in Palestine: - Nahalal, Nahallal, Nahalol.

d: **1.** pasture, watering-place
s: From [H5095](H5095); *pasture: -* bush.

d:
**1.** to growl, groan
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to growl (of lion)
				**2.** to groan (of sufferer)
s: A primitive root; to *growl: -* mourn, roar (-ing).

d:
**1.** growling, roaring
		**a.** of lion
		**b.** of king's wrath (fig.)
s: From [H5098](H5098); a *snarl: -* roaring.

d: **1.** growling, groaning
s: Feminine of [H5099](H5099); *snarling: -* disquietness, roaring.

d: **1.** (Qal) to bray, cry, cry out
s: A primitive root; to *bray* (as an ass), *scream* (from hunger): - bray.

d:
**1.** to shine, beam, light, burn
		**a.** (Qal) to beam, be radiant
**2.** to flow, stream
		**a.** (Qal) to flow, stream
s: A primitive root; to *sparkle*, that is, (figuratively) *be* *cheerful*; hence (from the *sheen* of a running stream) to *flow*, that is, (figuratively) *assemble: -* flow (together), be lightened.

d: **1.** river
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to [H5102](H5102); a *river*, especially the Euphrates: - river, stream.

d:
**1.** stream, river
		**a.** stream, river
		**b.** (underground) streams
s: From [H5102](H5102); a *stream* (including the *sea*; especially the Nile, Euphrates, etc.); figuratively, *prosperity: -* flood, river.

d: **1.** light, daylight
s: From [H5102](H5102) in its original sense; *daylight: -* light.

d:
**1.** to hinder, hold back, forbid, disallow, restrain, frustrate
		**a.** (Qal) to hinder, hold back
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to restrain, forbid, frustrate
				**2.** to restrain, make averse, discourage
s: A primitive root; to *refuse*, *forbid*, *dissuade*, or *neutralize: -* break, disallow, discourage, make of none effect.

d:
**1.** to bear fruit
		**a.** (Qal) to bear fruit
		**b.** (Pilel) to make to flourish (fig.)
s: A primitive root; to *germinate*, that is, (figuratively) to (causatively *make*) *flourish*; also (of words), to *utter: -* bring forth (fruit), make cheerful, increase.

d: **1.** fruit
s: From [H5107](H5107); *produce*, literally or figuratively: - fruit.

d:
Nebai = "fruitful"
**1.** a family of the heads of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: From [H5108](H5108); *fruitful*; *Nobai*, an Israelite: - Nebai \[from the margin\].

d:
**1.** to shake, waver, wander, move to and fro, flutter, show grief, have compassion on
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to move to and fro, wander (aimlessly), take flight
				**2.** to flutter
				**3.** to waver, wave, shake
				**4.** to show grief
						**a.** to lament, condole, show sympathy
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause to wander (aimlessly)
				**2.** to make a wagging, wag (with the head)
		**c.** (Hithpolel)
				**1.** to move oneself to and fro, sway, totter
				**2.** to shake oneself
				**3.** to bemoan oneself
s: A primitive root; to *nod*, that is, waver; figuratively to *wander*, *flee*, *disappear*; also (from *shaking* the head in sympathy), to *console*, *deplore*, or (from *tossing* the head in scorn) *taunt: -* bemoan, flee, get, mourn, make to move, take pity, remove, shake, skip for joy, be sorry, vagabond, way, wandering.

d: **1.** (P'al) to flee
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5116](H5116); to *flee: -* get away.

d: **1.** wandering (of aimless fugitive)
s: From [H5110](H5110); *exile: -* wandering.

d:
Nod = ""wandering"
**1.** land to which Cain fled or wandered after the murder of Abel
s: The same as [H5112](H5112); *vagrancy*; *Nod*, the land of Cain: - Nod.

d:
Nodab = "nobility"
**1.** an Arab tribe probably descended from Nodab, son of Ishmael and grandson of Abraham
s: From [H5068](H5068); *noble*; *Nodab*, an Arab tribe: - Nodab.

d:
**1.** to beautify
		**a.** (Hiphil) to beautify, adorn
**2.** to dwell
		**a.** (Qal) to dwell, abide, keep at home
**3.** (Hophal) rest
s: A primitive root; to *rest* (as at home); causatively (through the implied idea of *beauty* (compare [H5116](H5116))), to *celebrate* (with praises): - keep at home, prepare an habitation.

d:
n m
**1.** abode, habitation, abode of shepherds or flocks, pasture
		**a.** abode (of sheep)
		**b.** abode (of shepherds)
		**c.** meadow
		**d.** habitation
adj
**2.** dwelling, abiding
s: From [H5115](H5115); (adjective) *at* *home*; hence (by implication of satisfaction) *lovely*; also (noun) a *home*, of God (temple), men (residence), flocks (pasture), or wild animals (*den*): - comely, dwelling (place), fold, habitation, pleasant place, sheepcote, stable, tarried.

d:
**1.** to rest
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to rest, settle down and remain
				**2.** to repose, have rest, be quiet
		**b.** (Hiph)
				**1.** to cause to rest, give rest to, make quiet
				**2.** to cause to rest, cause to alight, set down
				**3.** to lay or set down, deposit, let lie, place
				**4.** to let remain, leave
				**5.** to leave, depart from
				**6.** to abandon
				**7.** to permit
		**c.** (Hoph)
				**1.** to obtain rest, be granted rest
				**2.** to be left, be placed
				**3.** open space (subst)
s: A primitive root; to *rest*, that is, *settle* down; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively, intransitively, transitively and causatively (to *dwell*, *stay*, *let* *fall*, *place*, *let* *alone*, *withdraw*, *give* *comfort*, etc.): - cease, be confederate, lay, let down, (be) quiet, remain, (cause to, be at, give, have, make to) rest, set down. Compare [H3241](H3241).

d: **1.** resting place
s: From [H5117](H5117); *quiet: -* rest (-ed, -ing place).

d:
Nohah = "rest"
**1.** the 4th son of Benjamin
s: Feminine of [H5118](H5118); *quietude*; *Nochah*, an Israelite: - Nohah.

d: **1.** (Qal) to quake, shake, dangle
s: To *quake*: - be moved.

d:
Naioth = "habitations"
**1.** a dwelling place of prophets in the time of Samuel
s: From [H5115](H5115); *residence*; *Navith*, a place in Palestine: - Naioth \[from the margin\].

d: **1.** refuse-heap, dunghill, outhouse
s: (Chaldee); from an unused root probably meaning to be *foul*; a *sink: -* dunghill.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to be foul

d:
**1.** to be drowsy, slumber, sleep
		**a.** (Qal) to slumber, be drowsy
s: A primitive root; to *slumber* (from drowsiness): - sleep, slumber.

d: **1.** drowsiness, somnolence, indolence (fig.)
s: From [H5123](H5123); *sleepiness: -* drowsiness.

d:
**1.** (Niphal) continue, to increase, propagate
**2.** (Hiphil) continue, to increase, propagate
s: A primitive root; to *resprout*, that is, propagate by shoots; figuratively, to *be* *perpetual: -* be continued.

d:
Nun = "fish" or "posterity"
**1.** father of Joshua the successor of Moses
s: From [H5125](H5125); *perpetuity*; *Nun* or *Non*, the father of Joshua: - Non, Nun.

d:
**1.** to flee, escape
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to flee
				**2.** to escape
				**3.** to take flight, m depart, disappear
				**4.** to fly (to the attack) on horseback
		**b.** (Polel) to drive at
		**c.** (Hithpolel) to take flight
		**d.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to put to flight
				**2.** to drive hastily
				**3.** to cause to disappear, hide
s: A primitive root; to *flit*, that is, *vanish* away (subside, escape; causatively chase, impel, deliver): -  X abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, X hide, lift up a standard.

d:
**1.** to quiver, totter, shake, reel, stagger, wander, move, sift, make move, wave, waver, tremble
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to wave, quiver, vibrate, swing, stagger, tremble, be unstable
				**2.** to totter, go tottering
						**a.** vagabond (participle)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be tossed about or around
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to toss about
				**2.** to shake, cause to totter
				**3.** to shake, disturb
				**4.** to cause to wander
s: A primitive root; to *waver*, in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (as subjoined): - continually, fugitive, X make to \[go\] up and down, be gone away, (be) move (-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).

d:
Noadiah = "meeting with Jehovah"
n pr m
**1.** a Levite, son of Binnui, who weighed the vessels of gold and silver belonging to the temple which were brought back from Babylon
n pr f
**2.** a prophetess who joined Sanballat and Tobiah in their attempt to intimidate Nehemiah
s: From [H3259](H3259) and [H3050](H3050); *convened* *of* *Jah*; *Noadjah*, the name of an Israelite, and a false prophetess: - Noadiah.

d:
**1.** to move to and fro, wave, besprinkle
		**a.** (Qal) to besprinkle, sprinkle
		**b.** (Polel) to wave, brandish (in threat)
		**c.** (Hiphil) to swing, wield, wave
				**1.** to wield
				**2.** to wave or shake (the hand)
						**a.** to wave (hand)
						**b.** to shake or brandish against
						**c.** to swing to and fro
				**3.** to wave (an offering), offer
				**4.** to shed abroad
		**d.** (Hophal) to be waved
s: A primitive root; to *quiver* (that is, *vibrate* up and down, or *rock* to and fro); used in a great variety of applications (including sprinkling, beckoning, rubbing, bastinadoing, sawing, waving, etc.): - lift up, move, offer, perfume, send, shake, sift, strike, wave.

d: **1.** elevation, height
s: From [H5130](H5130); *elevation*: - situation. Compare [H5297](H5297).

d:
**1.** (Qal) to fly, flee
**2.** (Hiphil) to bloom, blossom
s: A primitive root; properly to *flash*; hence, to *blossom* (from the brilliancy of color); also, to *fly* away (from the quickness of motion): - flee away, bud (forth).

d: **1.** plumage, feathers
s: Feminine active participle of [H5327](H5327) in the sense of *flying*; a *pinion* (or wing feather); often (collectively) *plumage: -* feather (-s), ostrich.
o: from [H5327](H5327) in the sense of flying

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to suckle, nurse
s: A primitive root; to *suckle: -* nurse.

d: **1.** fire
s: (Chaldee); from an unused root (corresponding to that of [H5216](H5216)) meaning to *shine*; *fire: -* fiery, fire.
o: from an unused root (corresponding to that of [H5216](H5216)) meaning to shine

d: **1.** (Qal) to be sick
s: A primitive root; to *be* *sick*, that is, (figuratively) *distressed: -* be full of heaviness.

d:
**1.** to spurt, spatter, sprinkle
		**a.** (Qal) to spurt, spatter
		**b.** (Hiphil) to cause to spurt, sprinkle upon
**2.** to spring, leap
		**a.** (Hiphil) to cause to leap, startle
s: A primitive root; to *spirt*, that is, *besprinkle* (especially in expiation): - sprinkle.

d: **1.** boiled food, soup, pottage, thing sodden or boiled
s: From [H2102](H2102); something *boiled*, that is, *soup: -* pottage.

d:
**1.** consecrated or devoted one, Nazarite
		**a.** consecrated one
		**b.** devotee, Nazarite
		**c.** untrimmed (vine)
s: From [H5144](H5144); *separate*, that is, consecrated (as *prince*, a *Nazirite*); hence (figuratively from the latter) an *unpruned* vine (like an unshorn Nazirite). (The translation, *Nazarite*, is by a false alliteration with Nazareth.): - Nazarite \[by a false alliteration with Nazareth\], separate (-d), vine undressed.

d:
**1.** to flow, distil, flow forth or down, trickle, drop
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to flow
						**a.** streams, floods (participle)
				**2.** to distil
		**b.** (Hiphil) to cause to flow
s: A primitive root; to *drip*, or *shed* by trickling: - distil, drop, flood, (cause to) flow (-ing), gush out, melt, pour (down), running water, stream.

d:
**1.** ring, nose ring, earring
		**a.** nose ring (woman's ornament)
		**b.** earring (ornament of men or women)
s: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a nose *ring: -* earring, jewel.
o: from an unused root of uncertain meaning

d:
**1.** to suffer injury
		**a.** (P'al) to suffer injury
		**b.** (Aphel) to injure
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to the root of [H5143](H5143); to *suffer* (causatively *inflict*) *loss: -* have (en-) damage, hurt (-ful).

d: **1.** injury, damage
s: From an unused root meaning to *injure*; *loss: -* damage.
o: from an unused root meaning to injure

d:
**1.** to dedicate, consecrate, separate
		**a.** (Niphal) to dedicate oneself, devote oneself
		**b.** (Hiphil) to keep sacredly separate
**2.** (Hiphil) to be a Nazarite, live as a Nazarite
s: A primitive root; to *hold* *aloof*, that is, (intransitively) *abstain* (from food and drink, from impurity, and even from divine worship (that is, *apostatize*)); specifically to *set* *apart* (to sacred purposes), that is, *devote: -* consecrate, separate (-ing, self).

d:
**1.** consecration, crown, separation, Nazariteship
		**a.** crown (as sign of consecration), earring
				**1.** stones of a crown, diadem, stones of charming
		**b.** woman's hair
		**c.** consecration
				**1.** of high priest
				**2.** of Nazarite
s: From [H5144](H5144); properly something *set* *apart*, that is, (abstractly) *dedication* (of a priest or Nazirite); hence (concretely) unshorn *locks*; also (by implication) a *chaplet* (especially of royalty): - consecration, crown, hair, separation.

d:
Noah = "rest"
**1.** son of Lamech, father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth; builder of the ark which saved his family from the destruction of the world which God sent on the world by the flood; became the new seminal head of mankind because his family were the only survivors of the flood
s: The same as [H5118](H5118); *rest*; *Noach*, the patriarch of the flood: - Noah.

d:
Nahbi = "hidden"
**1.** son of Vophsi, a Naphtalite, and one of the 12 spies sent to spy out the promised land
s: From [H2247](H2247); *occult*; *Nachbi*, an Israelite: - Nakbi.

d:
**1.** to lead, guide
		**a.** (Qal) to lead, bring
		**b.** (Hiphil) to lead, guide
s: A primitive root; to *guide*; by implication to *transport* (into exile, or as colonists): - bestow, bring, govern, guide, lead (forth), put, straiten.

d:
Nehum = "comfort"
**1.** one of the exiles who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
s: From [H5162](H5162); *comforted*; *Nechum*, an Israelite: - Nehum.

d:
**1.** comfort, compassion
		**a.** comfort
		**b.** compassion
s: From [H5162](H5162); properly *consoled*; abstractly *solace: -* comfort (-able), repenting.

d:
Nahum = "comfort"
**1.** the Elkoshite, prophet who predicted the fall and destruction of Nineveh; writer of the book by his name; personal history and situation unknown
s: From [H5162](H5162); *comfortable*; *Nachum*, an Israelitish prophet: - Nahum.

d:
Nahor = "snorting"
**1.** son of Serug, father of Terah, and grandfather of Abraham
**2.** son of Terah and brother of Abraham
s: From the same as [H5170](H5170); *snorer*; *Nachor*, the name of the grandfather and a brother of Abraham: - Nahor.

d: **1.** bronze
s: Apparently passive participle of [H5172](H5172) (perhaps in the sense of *ringing*, that is, bell metal; or from the *red* color of the throat of a serpent ([H5175](H5175), as denominative) when hissing); *coppery*, that is, (figuratively) hard: - of brass.
o: apparently pass participle of [H5172](H5172) (perhaps in the sense of ringing, i.e. bell-metal

d:
**1.** copper, bronze
		**a.** copper (made from melting copper ore)
		**b.** bronze (made from copper and alloy)
s: Feminine of [H5153](H5153); *copper*: - brass, steel. Compare [H5176](H5176).

d:
**1.** meaning uncertain
		**a.** may be name of melody
		**b.** may be a musical instrument
		**c.** found only in title of Ps 5:1
s: Probably denominative from [H2485](H2485); a *flute: -* \[plural\] Nehiloth.

d: **1.** nostril
s: From the same as [H5170](H5170); a *nostril: -* \[dual\] nostrils.

d:
**1.** to get as a possession, acquire, inherit, possess
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to take possession, inherit
				**2.** to have or get as a possession or property (fig.)
				**3.** to divide the land for a possession
				**4.** to acquire (testimonies) (fig.)
		**b.** (Piel) to divide for a possession
		**c.** (Hithpael) to possess oneself of
		**d.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to give as a possession
				**2.** to cause to inherit, give as an inheritance
		**e.** (Hophal) to be allotted, be made to possess
s: A primitive root; to *inherit* (as a (figurative) mode of descent), or (generally) to *occupy*; causatively to *bequeath*, or (generally) *distribute*, *instate: -* divide, have (\[inheritance\]), take as an heritage, (cause to, give to, make to) inherit, (distribute for, divide \[for, for an, by\], give for, have, leave for, take \[for\]) inheritance, (have in, cause to be made to) possess (-ion).

d:
**1.** torrent, valley, wadi, torrent-valley
		**a.** torrent
		**b.** torrent-valley, wadi (as stream bed)
		**c.** shaft (of mine)
**2.** palm-tree
		**a.** meaning dubious
s: From [H5157](H5157) in its original sense; a *stream*, especially a winter *torrent*; (by implication) a (narrow) *valley* (in which a brook runs); also a *shaft* (of a mine): - brook, flood, river, stream, valley.

d:
**1.** possession, property, inheritance, heritage
		**a.** property
		**b.** portion, share
		**c.** inheritance, portion
s: From [H5157](H5157) (in its usual sense); properly something *inherited*, that is, (abstractly) *occupancy*, or (concretely) an *heirloom*; generally an *estate*, *patrimony* or *portion*: - heritage, to inherit, inheritance, possession. Compare [H5158](H5158).

d:
Nahaliel = "torrents of God"
**1.** a station of Israel in the wilderness; located north of the Arnon
s: From [H5158](H5158) and [H410](H410); *valley* *of* *God*; *Nachaliel*, a place in the Desert: - Nahaliel.

d:
Nehelamite = "he of the dream"
**1.** the designation of a false prophet Shemaiah taken into captivity to Babylon; name is formed from his native place or his progenitor
s: Apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently passive participle of [H2492](H2492)); *dreamed*; a *Nechelamite*, or descendant of Nechlam: - Nehelamite.
o: apparently a patronymic from an unused name (apparently pass. participle of [H2492](H2492))

d:
**1.** to be sorry, console oneself, repent, regret, comfort, be comforted
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be sorry, be moved to pity, have compassion
				**2.** to be sorry, rue, suffer grief, repent
				**3.** to comfort oneself, be comforted
				**4.** to comfort oneself, ease oneself
		**b.** (Piel) to comfort, console
		**c.** (Pual) to be comforted, be consoled
		**d.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to be sorry, have compassion
				**2.** to rue, repent of
				**3.** to comfort oneself, be comforted
				**4.** to ease oneself
s: A primitive root; properly to *sigh*, that is, *breathe* strongly; by implication to *be* *sorry*, that is, (in a favorable sense) to *pity*, *console* or (reflexively) *rue*; or (unfavorably) to *avenge* (oneself): - comfort (self), ease \[one’s self\], repent (-er, -ing, self).

d:
Naham = "comfort"
**1.** the brother of IIodiah or Jehudijah, wife of Ezra
s: From [H5162](H5162); *consolation*; *Nacham*, an Israelite: - Naham.

d: **1.** repentance, sorrow
s: From [H5162](H5162); *ruefulness*, that is, desistance: - repentance.

d: **1.** comfort
s: From [H5162](H5162); *consolation: -* comfort.

d:
Nehemiah = "Jehovah comforts"
**1.** the son of Hachaliah, cupbearer to king Artaxerxes, who became governor of Judah after the return from exile
**2.** one of the 12 heads of the people who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
**3.** son of Azbuk and ruler of the half part of Beth-zur, who helped to repair the wall of Jerusalem
s: From [H5162](H5162) and [H3050](H3050); *consolation* *of* *Jah*; *Nechemjah*, the name of three Israelites: - Nehemiah.

d:
Nahamani = "merciful"
**1.** a chief man among the exiles who returned from Babylon with Zerubbabel
s: From [H5162](H5162); *consolatory*; *Nachamani*, an Israelite: - Nahamani.

d:
**1.** (Qal) to urge
		**a.** to be urgent (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *be* *urgent: -* require haste.

d: **1.** snorting
s: From an unused root meaning to *snort* or *snore*; a *snorting: -* nostrils, snorting.
o: from an unused root meaning to snort or snore

d:
Naharai = "snorter"
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors and the armour bearer of Joab
s: From the same as [H5170](H5170); *snorer*; *Nacharai* or *Nachrai*, an Israelite: - Naharai, Nahari.

d:
**1.** to practice divination, divine, observe signs, learn by experience, diligently observe, practice fortunetelling, take as an omen
		**a.** (Piel)
				**1.** to practice divination
				**2.** to observe the signs or omens
s: A primitive root; properly to *hiss*, that is, *whisper* a (magic) spell; generally to *prognosticate: -*  X certainly, divine, enchanter, (use) X enchantment, learn by experience, X indeed, diligently observe.

d: **1.** divination, enchantment
s: From [H5172](H5172); an *incantation* or *augury: -* enchantment.

d: **1.** copper, bronze
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5154](H5154); *copper: -* brass.

d:
**1.** serpent, snake
		**a.** serpent
		**b.** image (of serpent)
		**c.** fleeing serpent (mythological)
s: From [H5172](H5172); a *snake* (from its *hiss*): - serpent.

d:
Nahash = "serpent"
n pr m
**1.** a king of the Ammonites during the time of king Saul
**2.** the father of Abigail, the mother of Amasa, the commander of Absalom's army
s: The same as [H5175](H5175); *Nachash*, the name of two persons apparently non Israelites: - Nahash.

d:
Nahshon = "enchanter"
**1.** son of Amminadab and prince of the Judah at the first numbering in the wilderness; 5th in descent from Judah in the genealogy of Christ
s: From [H5172](H5172); *enchanter*; *Nachshon*, an Israelite: - Naashon, Nahshon.

d:
**1.** copper, bronze
		**a.** copper (ore), bronze (as copper alloy)
		**b.** fetters (of copper or bronze)
		**c.** copper (as value)
**2.** lust, harlotry
		**a.** meaning dubious
s: For [H5154](H5154); *copper*; hence, something made of that metal, that is, *coin*, a *fetter*; figuratively *base* (as compared with gold or silver): - brasen, brass, chain, copper, fetter (of brass), filthiness, steel.

d:
Nehushta = "brass"
**1.** daughter of Elnathan, wife of king Jehoiakim of Judah and mother of king Jehoiachin of Judah
s: From [H5178](H5178); *copper*; *Nechushta*, an Israelitess: - Nehushta.

d:
Nehushtan = "a thing of brass"
**1.** name by which the brazen serpent made by Moses in the wilderness was worshipped in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah before he destroyed it
s: From [H5178](H5178); something made *of* *copper*, that is, the copper *serpent* of the Desert: - Nehushtan.

d:
**1.** to go down, descend
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to go down, descend
				**2.** to descend, descend into (chastisement) (fig.)
		**b.** (Niphal) to come down into, penetrate
		**c.** (Piel) to cause to descend, press down, stretch (a bow)
		**d.** (Hiphil) to bring down
s: A primitive root; to *sink*, that is, *descend*; causatively, to *press* or *lead* down: - be broken, (cause to) come down, enter, go down, press sore, settle, stick fast.

d:
**1.** to descend
		**a.** (P'al) to descend
		**b.** (Aphel) to deposit
		**c.** (Hophal) to be deposed, be cast down
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5181](H5181); to *descend*; causatively, to *bring* *away*, *deposit*, *depose: -* carry, come down, depose, lay up, place.

d:
**1.** rest, quietness
		**a.** quietness, quiet attitude
		**b.** rest (of death)
**2.** descent (of judgment)
s: From [H5182](H5182); a *descent*, that is, imposition, unfavorable (*punishment*) or favorable (*food*); also (intransitively; perhaps from [H5117](H5117)), *restfulness: -* lighting down, quiet (-ness), to rest, be set on.

d:
Nahath = "rest"
**1.** one of the dukes of Edom, son of Reuel and grandson of Esau
**2.** a Kohathite Levite, son of Zophai and grandson of Elkanah
**3.** an Levite overseer in the time of Hezekiah
s: The same as [H5183](H5183); *quiet*; *Nachath*, the name of an Edomite and of two Israelites: - Nahath.

d: **1.** descending
s: From [H5181](H5181); *descending: -* come down.

d:
**1.** to stretch out, extend, spread out, pitch, turn, pervert, incline, bend, bow
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to stretch out, extend, stretch, offer
				**2.** to spread out, pitch (tent)
				**3.** to bend, turn, incline
						**a.** to turn aside, incline, decline, bend down
						**b.** to bend, bow
						**c.** to hold out, extend (fig.)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be stretched out
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to stretch out
				**2.** to spread out
				**3.** to turn, incline, influence, bend down, hold out, extend, thrust aside, thrust away
s: A primitive root; to *stretch* or spread out; by implication to *bend* away (including moral deflection); used in a great variety of applications: -  + afternoon, apply, bow (down, -ing), carry aside, decline, deliver, extend, go down, be gone, incline, intend, lay, let down, offer, outstretched, overthrown, pervert, pitch, prolong, put away, shew, spread (out), stretch (forth, out), take (aside), turn (aside, away), wrest, cause to yield.

d: **1.** laden
s: From [H5190](H5190); *laden: -* that bear.

d:
**1.** drop
		**a.** pendant, ornament
s: From [H5197](H5197); a *pendant* for the ears (especially of pearls): - chain, collar.

d: **1.** twig, tendril, tendrils of a vine (as spread out)
s: From [H5203](H5203); a *tendril* (as an offshoot): - battlement, branch, plant.

d:
**1.** to lift, bear, bear up
		**a.** (Qal) to lift, lift over, lift upon, set up
		**b.** (Piel) to bear up
s: A primitive root; to *lift*; by implication to *impose: -* bear, offer, take up.

d:
**1.** to lift
		**a.** (P'al) to lift, lift up
		**b.** (P'il) to be lifted
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5190](H5190); to *raise: -* take up.

d: **1.** burden, weight
s: From [H5190](H5190); a *burden: -* weighty.

d:
**1.** to plant, fasten, fix, establish
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to plant
				**2.** to plant, establish (fig.)
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be planted
				**2.** to be established (fig.)
s: A primitive root; properly to *strike* in, that is, *fix*; specifically to *plant* (literally or figuratively): - fastened, plant (-er).

d:
**1.** plantation, plant, planting
		**a.** plantation
		**b.** planting (act of)
		**c.** plant
s: From [H5193](H5193); a *plant*; collectively, a *plantation*; abstractly, a *planting: -* plant.

d: **1.** plant (fig. of vigorous sons)
s: From [H5193](H5193); a *plant: -* plant.

d:
Netaim = "among plants"
**1.** a place in Palestine
s: Plural of [H5194](H5194); *Netaim*, a place in Palestine: - plants.

d:
**1.** to drop, drip, distil, prophesy, preach, discourse
		**a.** (Qal) to drop, drip
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to drip
				**2.** to drop (prophecy)
s: A primitive root; to *ooze*, that is, *distil* gradually; by implication to *fall* *in* *drops*; figuratively to *speak* by inspiration: - drop (-ping), prophesy (-et).

d:
**1.** drop
**2.** gum, drops of stacte
		**a.** an aromatic gum resin of a shrub used in incense
s: From [H5197](H5197); a *drop*; specifically, an aromatic *gum* (probably *stacte*): - drop, stacte.

d:
Netophah = "dropping"
**1.** a town in Judah resettled by the exiles returning from Babylon with Zerubbabel
s: From [H5197](H5197); *distillation*; *Netophah*, a place in Palestine: - Netophah.

d:
Netophathite = see Netophath "dropping"
**1.** an inhabitant of Netophah
s: Patronymic from [H5199](H5199); a *Netophathite*, or inhabitant of Netophah: - Netophathite.

d:
**1.** to keep, keep guard, reserve, maintain
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to keep, maintain
				**2.** to keep, guard
s: A primitive root; to *guard*; figuratively, to *cherish* (anger): - bear grudge, keep (-er), reserve.

d: **1.** (P'al) to keep
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5201](H5201); to *retain: -* keep.

d:
**1.** to leave, permit, forsake, cast off or away, reject, suffer, join, spread out or abroad, be loosed, cease, abandon, quit, hang loose, cast down, make a raid, lie fallow, let fall, forgo, draw
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to leave, let alone, lie fallow, entrust to
				**2.** to forsake, abandon
				**3.** to permit
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be forsaken
				**2.** to be loosened, be loose
				**3.** to be let go, spread abroad
		**c.** (Pual) to be abandoned, be deserted
s: A primitive root; properly to *pound*, that is, *smite*; by implication (as if beating out, and thus expanding) to *disperse*; also, to *thrust* *off*, down, out or upon (including *reject*, *let* *alone*, *permit*, *remit*, etc.): - cast off, drawn, let fall, forsake, join \[battle\], leave (off), lie still, loose, spread (self) abroad, stretch out, suffer.

d: **1.** wailing
s: A doubtful word; apparently from [H5091](H5091); *lamentation: -* wailing.

d: **1.** quivering (motion) of lips
s: From [H5110](H5110); *motion* (of the lips in speech): - moving.

d: **1.** impure, filthiness, impurity
s: Feminine of [H5205](H5205); *removal*, that is, exile: - removed.

d: **1.** soothing, quieting, tranquillising
s: From [H5117](H5117); properly *restful*, that is, *pleasant*; abstractly *delight: -* sweet (odour).

d: **1.** soothing, tranquillising
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5207](H5207); *pleasure: -* sweet odour (savour).

d: **1.** offspring, posterity
s: From [H5125](H5125); *progeny: -* son.

d:
Nineveh = "abode of Ninus"
**1.** capital of the ancient kingdom of Assyria; located on the east bank of the Tigris river, 550 miles (880 km) from its mouth and 250 miles (400 km) north of Babylon
s: Of foreign origin; *Nineveh*, the capital of Assyria: - Nineveh.

d: **1.** refuge, a fleeing one
s: From [H5127](H5127); *fugitive: -* that fleeth.

d:
Nisan = "their flight"
**1.** the 1st month of the Jewish calendar corresponding to March or April
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Nisan*, the first month of the Jewish sacred year: - Nisan.

d: **1.** spark
s: From [H5340](H5340); a *spark: -* spark.

d: **1.** (Qal) to break up, freshly plough or till
s: A root probably identical with that of [H5216](H5216), through the idea of the *gleam* of a fresh furrow; to *till* the soil: - break up.
o: a root probably identical with that of [H5216](H5216), through the idea of the gleam of a fresh furrow

d: **1.** tillable or untilled or fallow ground
s: From [H5214](H5214); properly *ploughing*, that is, (concretely) freshly *ploughed* land: - fallow ground, ploughing, tillage.

d: **1.** lamp
s: From a primitive root (see [H5214](H5214) and [H5135](H5135)) properly meaning to *glisten*; a *lamp* (that is, the burner) or *light* (literally or figuratively): - candle, lamp, light.
o: from a primitive root \[see [H5214](H5214); [H5135](H5135)\] properly, meaning to glisten

d: **1.** (Niph) to strike, scourge, smite
s: A primitive root; to *smite*, that is, *drive* away: - be viler.

d: **1.** stricken
s: From [H5217](H5217); *smitten*, that is, (figuratively) *afflicted: -* broken, stricken, wounded.

d:
**1.** a spice
		**a.** perhaps tragacanth gum
s: From [H5218](H5218); properly a *smiting*, that is, (concretely) an aromatic *gum* (perhaps *styrax*), (as *powdered*): - spicery (-ces).

d: **1.** progeny, posterity
s: From an unused root meaning to *propagate*; *offspring: -* nephew, son’s son.
o: from an unused root meaning to propagate

d:
**1.** to strike, smite, hit, beat, slay, kill
		**a.** (Niphal) to be stricken or smitten
		**b.** (Pual) to be stricken or smitten
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to smite, strike, beat, scourge, clap, applaud, give a thrust
				**2.** to smite, kill, slay (man or beast)
				**3.** to smite, attack, attack and destroy, conquer, subjugate, ravage
				**4.** to smite, chastise, send judgment upon, punish, destroy
		**d.** (Hophal) to be smitten
				**1.** to receive a blow
				**2.** to be wounded
				**3.** to be beaten
				**4.** to be (fatally) smitten, be killed, be slain
				**5.** to be attacked and captured
				**6.** to be smitten (with disease)
				**7.** to be blighted (of plants)
s: A primitive root; to *strike* (lightly or severely, literally or figuratively): -  beat, cast forth, clap, give \[wounds\], X go forward, X indeed, kill, make \[slaughter\], murderer, punish, slaughter, slay (-er, -ing), smite (-r, -ing), strike, be stricken, (give) stripes, X surely, wound.

d: **1.** stricken, smitten
s: From [H5221](H5221); a *smiter*, that is, (figuratively) *traducer: -* abject.

d: **1.** stricken, smitten
s: *smitten*, that is, (literally) maimed, or (figuratively) dejected: - contrite, lame.

d:
Necho = "lame"
**1.** the Pharaoh of Egypt in the time of king Josiah of Judah
s: Probably of Egyptian origin; *Neko* an Egyptian king: - Necho. Compare [H6549](H6549).

d:
Nachon = "prepared"
**1.** the owner of the threshing floor which the ark was passing on the trip to Jerusalem when it started to fall off the cart, Uzzah steadied it, and God smote him dead for touching it
s: From [H3559](H3559); *prepared*; *Nakon*, probably an Israelite: - Nachon.

d:
subst
**1.** be in front of
adv
**2.** in front of, opposite to, in the sight of, before, to the front, right on
prep
**3.** towards the front of, in front of, on behalf of, as far as in front of
s: From an unused root meaning to *be* *straightforward*; properly the *fore* part; used adverbially, *opposite: -* before, over against.
o: from an unused root meaning to be straightforward

d:
subst
**1.** be in front of
adv
**2.** in front of, opposite to, in the sight of, before, to the front, right on
prep
**3.** towards the front of, in front of, on behalf of, as far as in front of
s: From the same as [H5226](H5226); properly, the *front* part; used adverbially (especially with a preposition), *opposite*, *in* *front* *of*, *forward*, *in* *behalf* *of: -* (over) against, before, direct \[-ly\], for, right (on).

d: **1.** straight, right, straightness, be in front of
s: From the same as [H5226](H5226); *straightforward*, that is, (figuratively), *equitable*, *correct*, or (abstractly), *integrity: -* plain, right, uprightness.

d:
**1.** straight in front, be in front of, straight, right, straightness
		**a.** true things (of prophecy)
		**b.** rectitude (subst)
s: Feminine of [H5228](H5228); properly *straight* *forwardness*, that is, (figuratively) *integrity*, or (concretely) a *truth: -* equity, right (thing), uprightness.

d:
**1.** to be deceitful, be crafty, be knavish
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be knavish
				**2.** deceiver (participle)
		**b.** (Piel) to beguile
		**c.** (Hithpael) to act craftily, act knavishly, deal knavishly
s: A primitive root; to *defraud*, that is, *act* *treacherously: -* beguile, conspire, deceiver, deal subtilly.

d: **1.** cunning, wiliness, craft, knavery
s: From [H5230](H5230); *deceit: -* wile.

d: **1.** riches, property
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5233](H5233): - goods.

d: **1.** riches, treasures
s: From an unused root meaning to *accumulate*; *treasure: -* riches, wealth.
o: from an unused root meaning to accumulate

d:
**1.** to recognise, acknowledge, know, respect, discern, regard
		**a.** (Niphal) to be recognised
		**b.** (Piel) to regard
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to regard, observe, pay attention to, pay regard to, notice
				**2.** to recognise (as formerly known), perceive
				**3.** to be willing to recognise or acknowledge, acknowledge with honour
				**4.** to be acquainted with
				**5.** to distinguish, understand
		**d.** (Hithpael) to make oneself known
**2.** to act or treat as foreign or strange, disguise, misconstrue
		**a.** (Niphal) to disguise oneself
		**b.** (Piel)
				**1.** to treat as foreign (profane)
				**2.** to misconstrue
		**c.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to act as alien
				**2.** to disguise oneself
s: A primitive root; properly to *scrutinize*, that is, look intently at; hence (with *recognition* implied), to *acknowledge*, *be* *acquainted* *with*, *care* *for*, *respect*, *revere*, or (with *suspicion* implied), to *disregard*, *ignore*, *be* *strange* toward, *reject*, *resign*, *dissimulate* (as if ignorant or disowning): - acknowledge, X could, deliver, discern, dissemble, estrange, feign self to be another, know, take knowledge (notice), perceive, regard, (have) respect, behave (make) self strange (-ly).

d: **1.** calamity, disaster, misfortune
s: From [H5234](H5234); something *strange*, that is, unexpected *calamity: -* strange.

d:
**1.** foreign, alien, foreignness, that which is foreign
		**a.** foreignness, foreign gods
		**b.** alien, foreigner
		**c.** foreign (vanities)
s: From [H5234](H5234); *foreign*, or (concretely) a *foreigner*, or (abstractly) *heathendom: -* alien, strange (+ -er).

d:
**1.** foreign, alien
		**a.** foreign
		**b.** foreigner (subst)
		**c.** foreign woman, harlot
		**d.** unknown, unfamiliar (fig.)
s: From [H5235](H5235) (second form); *strange*, in a variety of degrees and applications (*foreign*, *non-relative*, *adulterous*, *different*, *wonderful*): - alien, foreigner, outlandish, strange (-r, woman).

d: **1.** treasure
s: Probably for [H5219](H5219); *spicery*, that is, (generally) *valuables: -* precious things.

d:
**1.** (Hiphil) to complete, bring to an end
		**a.** meaning doubtful
s: Apparently a primitive root; to *complete: -* make an end.

d: **1.** vile, despised, disdained, held in contempt
s: From [H959](H959); *despised: -* vile.

d:
Nemuel = "day of God"
**1.** the eldest son of Simeon
**2.** a Reubenite, son of Eliab and brother of Dathan and Abiram in the time of the exodus
s: Apparently for [H3223](H3223); *Nemuel*, the name of two Israelites: - Nemuel.

d:
Nemuelites = see Nemuel "day of God"
**1.** a descendant of Nemuel
s: From [H5241](H5241); a *Nemuelite*, or descendant of Nemuel: - Nemuelite.

d: **1.** (Qal) to circumcise, become clipped, be circumcised, be cut off
s: A primitive root; to *become* *clipped* or (specifically) *circumcised: -* (branch to) be cut down (off), circumcise.
Feminine from [H5243](H5243); an *ant* (probably from its almost *bisected* form): - ant.

d: **1.** leopard
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5246](H5246): - leopard.

d: **1.** leopard
s: From an unused root meaning properly to *filtrate*, that is, *be* *limpid* (compare [H5247](H5247) and [H5249](H5249)); and thus to *spot* or *stain* as if by dripping; a *leopard* (from its stripes): - leopard.
o: from an unused root meaning properly, to filtrate, i.e. be limpid \[comp [H5247](H5247) and [H5249](H5249)\]

d:
Nimrah = "limpid" or "pure"
**1.** a place on the east of the Jordan, 10 miles (16 km) north of the Dead Sea and 3 miles (5 km) east of the Jordan
s: From the same as [H5246](H5246); *clear* water; *Nimrah*, a place East of the Jordan: - Nimrah. See also [H1039](H1039), [H5249](H5249).

d:
Nimrod = "rebellion" or "the valiant"
**1.** the son of Cush, grandson of Ham, and great grandson of Noah; a mighty hunter, he established an empire in the area of Babylon and Assyria
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Nimrod*, a son of Cush: - Nimrod.

d:
Nimrim = "limpid" or "pure"
**1.** a stream or brook in the territory of Moab
s: Plural of a masculine corresponding to [H5247](H5247); *clear* waters; *Nimrim*, a place East of the Jordan: - Nimrim. Compare [H1039](H1039).

d:
Nimshi = "rescued"
**1.** grandfather of Jehu
s: Probably from [H4871](H4871); *extricated*; *Nimshi*, the (grand-) father of Jehu: - Nimshi.

d:
**1.** something lifted up, standard, signal, signal pole, ensign, banner, sign, sail
		**a.** standard (as rallying point), signal
		**b.** standard (pole)
		**c.** ensign, signal
s: From [H5264](H5264); a *flag*; also a *sail*; by implication a *flagstaff*; generally a *signal*; figuratively a *token: -* banner, pole, sail, (en-) sign, standard.

d: **1.** turn of affairs, a bringing about
s: Feminine participle passive of [H5437](H5437); properly an *environment*, that is, *circumstance* or *turn* of affairs: - cause.

d:
**1.** to move away, backslide, move, go, turn back
		**a.** (Qal) to backslide, prove recreant to
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to displace, move back
				**2.** to remove, carry away
		**d.** (Hophal) to be driven back, be moved back
s: A primitive root; to *retreat: -* departing away, remove, take (hold), turn away.

d:
**1.** to test, try, prove, tempt, assay, put to the proof or test
		**a.** (Piel)
				**1.** to test, try
				**2.** to attempt, assay, try
				**3.** to test, try, prove, tempt
s: A primitive root; to *test*; by implication to *attempt: -* adventure, assay, prove, tempt, try.

d:
**1.** to pull or tear away
		**a.** (Qal) to tear away, tear down
		**b.** (Niphal) to be torn away
s: A primitive root; to *tear* away: - destroy, pluck, root.

d:
**1.** to pull or tear away
		**a.** (Ithp'al) to be torn away
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5255](H5255): - pull down.

d:
**1.** poured out, libation, molten image, one anointed
		**a.** libation, drink-offering
		**b.** molten image
**2.** prince, anointed one
s: From [H5258](H5258); properly something *poured* out, that is, a *libation*; also a molten *image*; by implication a *prince* (as *anointed*): - drink offering, duke, prince (-ipal).

d:
**1.** to pour out, pour, offer, cast
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to pour out
				**2.** to cast metal images
				**3.** to anoint (a king)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be anointed
		**c.** (Piel) to pour out (as a libation)
		**d.** (Hiphil) to pour out libations
		**e.** (Hophal) to be poured out
**2.** to set, install
		**a.** (Qal) to install
		**b.** (Niphal) to be installed
s: A primitive root; to *pour* out, especially a libation, or to *cast* (metal); by analogy to *anoint* a king: - cover, melt, offer, (cause to) pour (out), set (up).

d: **1.** (Qal) to weave
s: A primitive root (probably identical with [H5258](H5258) through the idea of fusion); to *interweave*, that is, (figuratively) to *overspread: -* that is spread.
o: a primitive root \[probably identical with [H5258](H5258) through the idea fusion\]

d:
**1.** to pour out, offer sacrifice
		**a.** (Pael) to pour out, offer (a sacrifice)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5258](H5258); to *pour* out a libation: - offer.

d: **1.** something poured out, libation, drink offering, libation offering
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5262](H5262); a *libation: -* drink offering.

d:
**1.** drink offering, libation, molten image, something poured out
		**a.** drink offering
		**b.** molten images
s: From [H5258](H5258); a *libation*; also a *cast* *idol: -* cover, drink offering, molten image.

d: **1.** (Qal) to be sick
s: A primitive root; to *wane*, that is, *be* *sick.*

d:
**1.** to be lifted up (meaning dubious)
		**a.** (Hithpoel) to be lifted up, be displayed
s: A primitive root; to *gleam* from afar, that is, to *be* *conspicuous* as a signal; or rather perhaps a denominative from [H5251](H5251) (and identical with [H5263](H5263), through the idea of a flag as *fluttering* in the wind); to *raise* *a* *beacon: -* lift up as an ensign, standard bearer.

d:
**1.** to pull out, pull up, set out, journey, remove, set forward, depart
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to pull out or up
				**2.** to set out, depart
				**3.** to journey, march
				**4.** to set forth (of wind)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be pulled up, be removed, be plucked up
		**c.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause to set out, lead out, cause to spring up
				**2.** to remove, quarry
s: A primitive root; properly to *pull* up, especially the tent pins, that is, *start* on a journey: - cause to blow, bring, get, (make to) go (away, forth, forward, onward, out), (take) journey, march, remove, set aside (forward), X still, be on his (go their) way.

d: **1.** (Qal) to ascend
s: A primitive root; to *go* up: - ascend.

d:
**1.** to ascend, come up
		**a.** (Aphel) to lift, take up
		**b.** (Hophal) to be taken up
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5266](H5266): - take up.

d:
Nisroch = "the great eagle"
**1.** an idol of Nineveh worshipped by Sennacherib; symbolised by the eagle-headed human figure
s: Of foreign origin; *Nisrok*, a Babylonian idol: - Nisroch.

d:
Neah = "shaking"
**1.** a boundary mark of the territory of Zebulun; site unknown
s: From [H5128](H5128); *motion*; *Neah*, a place in Palestine: - Neah.

d:
Noah = "motion"
**1.** one of the 5 daughters of Zelophehad in the time of the exodus
s: From [H5128](H5128); *movement*; *Noah*, an Israelitess: - Noah.

d: **1.** youth, early life
s: Properly passive participle from [H5288](H5288) as denominative; (only in plural collectively or emphatically) *youth*, the state (*juvenility*) or the persons (*young* people): - childhood, youth.
o: properly, pass. participle from [H5288](H5288) as denominative

d:
Neiel = "moved by God"
**1.** a place on the border of the territory of Asher
s: From [H5128](H5128) and [H410](H410); *moved* *of* *God*; *Neiel*, a place in Palestine: - Neiel.

d:
**1.** pleasant, delightful, sweet, lovely, agreeable
		**a.** delightful
		**b.** lovely, beautiful (physical)
**2.** singing, sweetly sounding, musical
s: From [H5276](H5276); *delightful* (objectively or subjectively, literally or figuratively): - pleasant (-ure), sweet.

d:
**1.** to bar, lock, bolt
		**a.** (Qal) to bar, lock, bolt
**2.** to furnish with sandals, shoe
		**a.** (Qal) to shoe
		**b.** (Hiphil) to give sandals
s: A primitive root; properly to *fasten* up, that is, with a bar or cord; hence (denominatively from [H5275](H5275)), to *sandal*, that is, furnish with slippers: - bolt, inclose, lock, shod, shut up.

d: **1.** sandal, shoe
s: From [H5274](H5274); properly a sandal *tongue*; by extension a *sandal* or slipper (sometimes as a symbol of occupancy, a refusal to marry, or of something valueless): - dryshod, (pair of) shoe (\[-latchet\], -s).

d: **1.** (Qal) to be pleasant, be beautiful, be sweet, be delightful, be lovely
s: A primitive root; to *be* *agreeable* (literally or figuratively): - pass in beauty, be delight, be pleasant, be sweet.

d:
Naam = "pleasantness"
**1.** one of the sons of Caleb and grandson of Jephunneh
s: From [H5276](H5276); *pleasure*; *Naam*, an Israelite: - Naam.

d:
**1.** kindness, pleasantness, delightfulness, beauty, favour
		**a.** delightfulness
		**b.** symbolic name of one of two staves
		**c.** pleasantness
s: From [H5276](H5276); *agreeableness*, that is, *delight*, *suitableness*, *splendor* or *grace: -* beauty, pleasant (-ness).

d:
Naamah = "loveliness"
n pr f
**1.** daughter of Lamech by his wife Zillah and sister of Tubal-cain in the days before the flood
**2.** the Ammonite wife of Solomon and mother of king Rehoboam of Judah
n pr f loc
**3.** a town in the lowlands of Judah in Philistia
s: Feminine of [H5277](H5277); *pleasantness*; *Naamah*, the name of an antediluvian woman, of an Ammonitess, and of a place in Palestine: - Naamah.

d:
Naamites = see Naamah "loveliness"
**1.** the descendants of Naaman, the grandson of Benjamin
s: Patronymic from [H5283](H5283); a *Naamanite*, or descendant of Naaman (collectively): - Naamites.

d:
Naomi = "my delight"
**1.** wife of Elimelech, mother of Mahlon and Chilion, and mother-in-law of Ruth and Orpah
s: From [H5278](H5278); *pleasant*; *Noomi*, an Israelitess: - Naomi.

d: **1.** pleasantness
s: From [H5276](H5276); *pleasantness* (plural as concrete): - pleasant.

d:
Naaman = "pleasantness"
**1.** son of Bela of the family of Benjamin; he was among the family of Jacob that went down to Egypt
**2.** commander-in-chief of the army of Syria; stricken with leprosy he went to Elisha, eventually followed his instructions, and was cured
s: The same as [H5282](H5282); *Naaman*, the name of an Israelite and of a Damascene: - Naaman.

d:
Naamathite = see Naamah "pleasantness"
**1.** an inhabitant of Naamah (site unknown); describes Zophar the friend of Job
s: Patrial from a place corresponding in nmae (but not identical) with [H5279](H5279); a *Naamathite*, or inhabitant of Naamah: - Naamathite
o: patrial from a place corresponding in name (but not identical) with [H5279](H5279)

d: **1.** thornbush
s: From an unused root meaning to *prick*; probably a *brier*; by implication a *thicket* of thorny bushes: - thorn.
o: from an unused root meaning to prick

d: **1.** (Qal) to growl
s: A primitive root; to *growl: -* yell.

d:
**1.** to shake, shake out or off
		**a.** (Qal) to shake out, show emptiness
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be shaken
				**2.** to shake oneself
		**c.** (Piel) to shake off or out
		**d.** (Hithpael) to shake oneself
s: A primitive root (probably identical with [H5286](H5286), through the idea of the *rustling* of mane, which usually accompanies the lion’s roar); to *tumble* about: - shake (off, out, self), overthrow, toss up and down.
o: a primitive root \[probably identical with [H5286](H5286), through the idea of the rustling of mane, which usually accompanies the lion’s roar\]

d:
**1.** a boy, lad, servant, youth, retainer
		**a.** boy, lad, youth
		**b.** servant, retainer
s: From [H5287](H5287); (concretely) a *boy* (as active), from the age of infancy to adolescence; by implication a *servant*; also (by interchange of sex), a *girl* (of similar latitude in age): - babe, boy, child, damsel \[from the margin\], lad, servant, young (man).

d: **1.** a shaking, scattering
s: From [H5287](H5287) in its derived sense of *tossing* about; a *wanderer: -* young one.
o: from [H5287](H5287) in its derivative sense of tossing about

d: **1.** youth, boyhood, early life
s: From [H5287](H5287); (abstractly) *boyhood* (compare [H5288](H5288)): - child, youth.

d:
**1.** girl, damsel, female servant
		**a.** girl, damsel, little girl
				**1.** of young woman, marriageable young woman, concubine, prostitute
		**b.** maid, female attendant, female servant
s: Feminine of [H5288](H5288); a *girl* (from infancy to adolescence): - damsel, maid (-en), young (woman).

d:
Naarah or Naarath = "maiden"
n pr f
**1.** the 2nd wife of Ashur of the tribe of Judah
n pr loc
**2.** one of the landmarks on the southern boundary of the territory of Ephraim
s: The same as [H5291](H5291); *Naarah*, the name of an Israelitess, and of a place in Palestine: - Naarah, Naarath.

d:
Naarai = "handmaid"
**1.** the Arbite, son of Ezbai and one of David's mighty warriors
s: From [H5288](H5288); *youthful*; *Naarai*, an Israelite: - Naarai.

d:
Neariah = "servant of Jehovah"
**1.** one of the 6 sons of Shemaiah in the line of the royal family of David of the tribe of Judah in the time after the captivity
**2.** son of Ishi and one of the captains of the 500 Simeonites who, in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah, drove out the Amalekites from Mount Seir
s: From [H5288](H5288) and [H3050](H3050); *servant* *of* *Jah*; *Nearjah*, the name of two Israelites: - Neariah.

d:
Naaran = "juvenile"
**1.** a town on the eastern limit of the territory of Ephraim
s: From [H5288](H5288); *juvenile*; *Naaran*, a place in Palestine: - Naaran.

d: **1.** a strand of flax, tow (as shaken from flax when beaten)
s: From [H5287](H5287); something *shaken* out, that is, *tow* (as the refuse of flax): - tow.

d:
Noph = "presentability"
**1.** another name for 'Memphis' the capital city of Egypt
s: A variation of [H4644](H4644); *Noph*, the capital of Upper Egypt: - Noph.

d:
Nepheg = "sprout"
**1.** one of sons of Izhar and grandson of Kohath of the tribe of Levi in the time of the exodus
**2.** one of the sons of David born to him at Jerusalem
s: From an unused root probably meaning to *spring* forth; a *sprout*; *Nepheg*, the name of two Israelites: - Nepheg.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to spring forth

d:
**1.** a lofty place, height
**2.** sieve, winnowing implement
s: From [H5130](H5130) in the sense of *lifting*; a *height*; also a *sieve: -* border, coast, region, sieve.
o: from [H5130](H5130) in the sense of lifting

d:
Nephishesim or Nephusim = "refreshed of spices"
**1.** a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel
s: For [H5304](H5304); *Nephushesim*, a Temple Servant: - Nephisesim \[from the margin\].

d:
**1.** to breathe, blow, sniff at, seethe, give up or lose (life)
		**a.** (Qal) to breathe, blow
		**b.** (Pual) to be blown
		**c.** (Hiphil) to cause to breathe out
s: A primitive root; to *puff*, in various applications (literally, to *inflate*, *blow* hard, *scatter*, *kindle*, *expire*; figuratively, to *disesteem*): - blow, breath, give up, cause to lose \[life\], seething, snuff.

d:
Nophah = "blast"
**1.** a place in Moab
