d:
Abdiel = "servant of God"
**1.** a Gadite, son of Guni and father of Ahi and one who settled in the land of Bashan in the time of king Jotham of Judah
s: From [H5650](H5650) and [H410](H410); *servant* *of* *God*; *Abdiel*, an Israelite: - Abdiel. Compare [H5655](H5655).

d:
Obadiah = "servant of Jehovah"
**1.** the 4th of the 12 minor prophets; nothing personal is known of him but it is probable that he was contemporary with Jeremiah, Ezekiel, and Daniel
		**a.** the prophetic book by him; prophesies against Edom
**2.** father of Ishmaiah, one of the chiefs of Zebulun in the time of David
**3.** a Merarite Levite overseer of the work of restoring the temple in the time of king Josiah of Judah
**4.** chief of the household of king Ahab of Israel; an devout worshipper of Jehovah who at risk to his own life hid over 100 prophets during the persecution of Jezebel
**5.** a descendant of David
**6.** a chief of the tribe of Issachar
**7.** a Benjamite, one of the 6 sons of Azel and a descendant of king Saul
**8.** a Levite, son of Shemaiah and a descendant of Jeduthun
**9.** a Gadite chief, the 2nd of the lion-faced Gadites who joined David at Ziklag
**10.** a prince of Judah in the time of king Jehoshaphat of Judah
**11.** a priest, son of Jehiel of the sons of Joab who returned from exile with Ezra
**12.** a gatekeeper in the time of Nehemiah
**13.** one of the men who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
		**a.** perhaps the same as 12
s: Active participle of [H5647](H5647) and [H3050](H3050); *serving* *Jah*; *Obadjah*, the name of thirteen Israelites: - Obadiah.

d:
Ebed-melech = "servant of the king"
**1.** an Ethiopian eunuch in the service of king Zedekiah, through whose interference Jeremiah was released from prison
s: From [H5650](H5650) and [H4428](H4428); *servant* *of* *a* *king*; *Ebed-Melek*, a eunuch of king Zedekeah: - Ebed-melech.

d:
Abed-nego = "servant of Nebo"
**1.** the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord
		**a.** also, 'Azariah' ( H05838 or H05839)
s: The same as [H5665](H5665); *Abed-Nego*, the Babylonian name of one of Daniel’s companions: - Abed-nego.

d:
Abed-nego = "servant of Nebo"
**1.** the godly friend of Daniel who Nebuchadnezzar renamed Abednego; one of the three friends who with Daniel refused to make themselves unclean by eating food from the king's table which went against the dietary laws which God had given the Jews; also one of the three who were thrown into the fiery furnace for refusing to bow down to a graven image of Nebuchadnezzar and who were saved by the angel of the Lord
		**a.** also, 'Azariah' ( H05838 or H05839)
s: (Chaldee); of foreign origin; *Abed-Nego*, the name of Azariah: - Abed-nego.

d:
**1.** to be thick, be fat, be gross
		**a.** (Qal) to be fat, be thick, be gross
s: A primitive root; to *be* *dense: -* be (grow) thick (-er).

d: **1.** pledge, a thing given as security, article pledged as security for debt
s: From [H5670](H5670); a *pawn: -* pledge.

d:
prep
**1.** for the sake of, on account of, because of, in order to
conj
**2.** in order that
s: Passive participle of [H5674](H5674); properly *crossed*, that is, (abstractly) *transit*; used only adverbially on *account* of, in *order* that: - because of, for (. . . ‘s sake), (intent) that, to.

d: **1.** produce, yield
s: The same as [H5668](H5668); *passed*, that is, *kept* over; used only of *stored* grain: - old corn.

d:
**1.** to take a pledge, give a pledge (for a debt)
		**a.** (Qal) to take a pledge, give a pledge (for a debt)
		**b.** (Piel) to interchange
		**c.** (Hiphil) to cause to give a pledge
s: A primitive root; to *pawn*; causatively to *lend* (on security); figuratively to *entangle: -* borrow, break \[ranks\], fetch \[a pledge\], lend, X surely.

d: **1.** weight of pledges, heavy debts
s: From [H5670](H5670); something *pledged*, that is, (collectively) *pawned* goods. (*thick* *clay* is by a false etym.): - thick clay \[by a false etymology\].

d: **1.** thickness
s: From [H5666](H5666); *density*, that is, *depth* or *width*: - thick (-ness). Compare [H5645](H5645).

d:
**1.** work, service, ritual, worship
		**a.** work, administration
		**b.** ritual, service
s: (Chaldee); from [H5648](H5648); *labor* or *business: -* affairs, service, work.

d:
**1.** to pass over or by or through, alienate, bring, carry, do away, take, take away, transgress
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to pass over, cross, cross over, pass over, march over, overflow, go over
				**2.** to pass beyond
				**3.** to pass through, traverse
						**a.** passers-through (participle)
						**b.** to pass through (the parts of victim in covenant)
				**4.** to pass along, pass by, overtake and pass, sweep by
						**a.** passer-by (participle)
						**b.** to be past, be over
				**5.** to pass on, go on, pass on before, go in advance of, pass along, travel, advance
				**6.** to pass away
						**a.** to emigrate, leave (one's territory)
						**b.** to vanish
						**c.** to perish, cease to exist
						**d.** to become invalid, become obsolete (of law, decree)
						**e.** to be alienated, pass into other hands
		**b.** (Niphal) to be crossed
		**c.** (Piel) to impregnate, cause to cross
		**d.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to cause to pass over, cause to bring over, cause to cross over, make over to, dedicate, devote
				**2.** to cause to pass through
				**3.** to cause to pass by or beyond or under, let pass by
				**4.** to cause to pass away, cause to take away
		**e.** (Hithpael) to pass over
s: A primitive root; to *cross* over; used very widely of any *transition* (literally or figuratively; transitively, intransitively, intensively or causatively); specifically to *cover* (in copulation): - alienate, alter, X at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass (-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) + proclaim (-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, + raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, + shave, cause to (make) sound, X speedily, X sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress (-or), translate, turn away, \[way-\] faring man, be wrath.

d: **1.** region beyond or across
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5676](H5676): - beyond, this side.

d:
**1.** region beyond or across, side
		**a.** region across or beyond
		**b.** side, opposite side
s: From [H5674](H5674); properly a region *across*; but used only adverbially (with or without a preposition) on the *opposite* side (especially of the Jordan; usually meaning the *east*): -  X against, beyond, by, X from, over, passage, quarter, (other, this) side, straight.

d:
Eber or Heber = "the region beyond"
**1.** son of Salah, great grandson of Shem, father of Peleg and Joktan
**2.** a Gadite chief
**3.** a Benjamite, son of Elpaal and descendant of Sharahaim
**4.** a Benjamite, son of Shashak
**5.** a priest in the days of Joiakim the son of Jeshua
s: The same as [H5676](H5676); *Eber*, the name of two patriarchs and four Israelites: - Eber, Heber.

d:
**1.** outpouring, overflow, excess, fury, wrath, arrogance
		**a.** overflow, excess, outburst
		**b.** arrogance
		**c.** overflowing rage or fury
s: Feminine of [H5676](H5676); an *outburst* of passion: - anger, rage, wrath.

d: **1.** ford
s: From [H5674](H5674); a *crossing* place: - ferry, plain \[from the margin\].

d:
Hebrew = "one from beyond"
n pr
**1.** a designation of the patriarchs and the Israelites
adj
**2.** a designation of the patriarchs and the Israelites
s: Patronymic from [H5677](H5677); an *Eberite* (that is, Hebrew) or descendant of Eber: - Hebrew (-ess, woman).

d:
Ibri = "Hebrew"
**1.** a Merarite Levite of the family of Jaaziah in the time of David
s: The same as [H5680](H5680); *Ibri*, an Israelite: - Ibri.

d:
Abarim = "regions beyond"
**1.** a mountain or range of mountains on the east of the Jordan, in the land of Moab, opposite to Jericho; Mount Nebo is part of this range
s: Plural of [H5676](H5676); regions *beyond*; *Abarim*, a place in Palestine: - Abarim, passages.

d:
Hebron = "alliance"
**1.** a city of Judah located in the mountains 20 (32 km) miles south of Jerusalem and 20 (32 km) miles north of Beersheba
s: From [H5676](H5676); *transitional*; *Ebron*, a place in Palestine. (Perhaps a clerical error for [H5658](H5658).): - Hebron. Perhaps a clerical error for [H5658](H5658).

d:
Ebronah = "passage"
**1.** one of the stations of the Israelites in the wilderness immediately preceding Ezion-geber
s: Feminine of [H5683](H5683); *Ebronah*, a place in the Desert: - Ebronah.

d: **1.** (Qal) to shrivel, waste away
s: A primitive root; to *dry* up: - be rotten.

d: **1.** (Piel) to wind, weave, weave together
s: A primitive root; to *interlace*, that is, (figuratively) to *pervert: -* wrap up.

d: **1.** having interwoven foliage, leafy, dense with foliage
s: From [H5686](H5686); *intwined*, that is, *dense: -* thick.

d:
**1.** cord, rope, cordage, foliage, interwoven foliage
		**a.** cord, rope, cordage, chain
		**b.** interwoven foliage
s: The same as [H5687](H5687); something *intwined*, that is, a *string*, *wreath* or *foliage: -* band, cord, rope, thick bough (branch), wreathen (chain).

d:
**1.** (Qal) to have inordinate affection or lust
		**a.** lust (participle)
		**b.** paramours (participle as subst)
s: A primitive root; to *breathe* after, that is, to *love* (sensually): - dote, lover.

d: **1.** (sensuous) love
s: From [H5689](H5689); *love* (concretely), that is, *amative* words: - much love, very lovely.

d: **1.** lustfulness
s: From [H5689](H5689); *love* (abstractly), that is, *amorousness: -* inordinate love.

d:
**1.** disc or cake (of bread)
		**a.** cake of hot stones (cake baked on hot stones)
s: From [H5746](H5746); an *ashcake* (as *round*): - cake (upon the hearth).

d:
**1.** name of a bird
		**a.** perhaps a thrush, swallow, crane
s: Passive participle (but with active sense) of an unused root meaning to *twitter*; probably the *swallow: -* swallow.
o: pass part \[but with active sense\] of an unused root meaning to twitter

d:
**1.** hoop, ring, earring
		**a.** adornment for men or women
s: From the same as [H5696](H5696); something *round*, that is, a *ring* (for the ears): - earring.

d: **1.** calf, bull-calf
s: From the same as [H5696](H5696); a (male) *calf* (as *frisking* round), especially one nearly grown (that is, a *steer*): - bullock, calf.

d: **1.** round
s: From an unused root meaning to *revolve*, *circular: -* round.
o: from an unused root meaning to revolve

d: **1.** heifer
s: Feminine of [H5695](H5695); a (female) *calf*, especially one nearly grown (that is, a *heifer*): - calf, cow, heifer.

d:
Eglah = "a heifer"
**1.** a wife of David and mother of Ithream
s: The same as [H5697](H5697); *Eglah*, a wife of David: - Eglah.

d: **1.** cart, wagon
s: From the same as [H5696](H5696); something *revolving*, that is, a wheeled *vehicle: -* cart, chariot, wagon.

d:
Eglon = "calf-like"
n pr m
**1.** king of Moab who oppressed the children of Israel for 18 years before he was killed by the judge Ehud
n pr loc
**2.** a royal city in Canaan that opposed the conquest; located in the low lands of Judah
s: From [H5695](H5695); *vituline*; *Eglon*, the name of a place in Palestine and of a Moabitish king: - Eglon.

d: **1.** (Qal) to be grieved
s: A primitive root; to *be* *sad: -* grieve.

d: **1.** (Niphal) to shut oneself in or off or up
s: A primitive root; to *debar*, that is, from marriage: - stay.

d:
**1.** perpetuity, for ever, continuing future
		**a.** ancient (of past time)
		**b.** for ever (of future time)
				**1.** of continuous existence
		**c.** for ever (of God's existence)
s: From [H5710](H5710); properly a (peremptory) *terminus*, that is, (by implication) *duration*, in the sense of *perpetuity* (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition): - eternity, ever (-lasting, -more), old, perpetually, + world without end.

d:
prep
**1.** as far as, even to, until, up to, while, as far as
		**a.** of space
				**1.** as far as, up to, even to
		**b.** in combination
				**1.** from...as far as, both...and (with 'min' -from)
		**c.** of time
				**1.** even to, until, unto, till, during, end
		**d.** of degree
				**1.** even to, to the degree of, even like
conj
**2.** until, while, to the point that, so that even
s: Properly the same as [H5703](H5703) (used as a preposition, adverb or conjugation; especially with a preposition); *as* *far* (or *long*, or *much*) *as*, whether of space (*even* *unto*) or time (*during*, *while*, *until*) or degree (*equally* *with*): - against, and, as, at, before, by (that), even (to), for (-asmuch as), \[hither-\] to, + how long, into, as long (much) as, (so) that, till, toward, until, when, while, (+ as) yet.
o: properly, the same as [H5703](H5703) (used as prep, adv or conj)

d:
prep
**1.** even to, until, up to, during
conj
**2.** until, up to the time that, ere that
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5704](H5704): - X and, at, for, \[hither-\] to, on, till, (un-) to, until, within.

d: **1.** booty, prey
s: The same as [H5703](H5703) in the sense of the *aim* of an attack; *booty: -* prey.
o: the same as [H5703](H5703) in the sense of the aim of an attack

d:
**1.** witness
		**a.** witness, testimony, evidence (of things)
		**b.** witness (of people)
s: From [H5749](H5749) contracted; concretely *a* *witness*; abstractly *testimony*; specifically a *recorder*, that is, *prince: -* witness.

d:
**1.** menstruation
		**a.** filthy rag, stained garment (fig. of best deeds of guilty people)
s: From an unused root meaning to *set* a period (compare [H5710](H5710) and [H5749](H5749)); the *menstrual* flux (as periodical); by implication (in plural) *soiling: -* filthy.
o: from an unused root meaning to set a period \[compare [H5710](H5710), [H5749](H5749)\]

d:
**1.** to pass on, pass away
		**a.** (P'al)
				**1.** to pass on, pass over
				**2.** to pass away
		**b.** (Aphel) to take away, remove, depose
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5710](H5710): - alter, depart, pass (away), remove, take (away).

d:
**1.** to pass on, advance, go on, pass by, remove
		**a.** (Qal) to pass on, put on
		**b.** (Hiphil) to remove
s: A primitive root; to *advance*, that is, *pass* on or *continue*; causatively to *remove*; specifically to *bedeck* (that is, bring an ornament upon): - adorn, deck (self), pass by, take away.

d:
Adah = "ornament"
**1.** the 1st of the 2 wives of Lamech and mother of Jabal and Jubal
**2.** a Hittitess, 1 of the 3 wives of Esau and mother of Eliphaz
		**a.** also called 'Bashemath'
s: From [H5710](H5710); *ornament*; *Adah*, the name of two women: - Adah.

d: **1.** congregation, gathering
s: Feminine of [H5707](H5707) in the original sense of *fixture*; a stated *assemblage* (specifically a *concourse*, or generally a *family* or *crowd*): - assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare [H5713](H5713).
o: from [H5707](H5707) in the original sense of fixture

d:
**1.** testimony, witness
		**a.** always plural and always of laws as divine testimonies
s: Feminine of [H5707](H5707) in its technical sense; *testimony*: - testimony, witness. Compare [H5712](H5712).

d:
Iddo = "His witness"
**1.** father of Abinadab, an officer of Solomon
**2.** grandfather of the prophet Zechariah
**3.** a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah
**4.** a priest in the time of Nehemiah
**5.** a seer in the time of king Jeroboam of the northern kingdom of Israel
**6.** son of Zechariah, ruler of the tribe of Manasseh in the time of David
**7.** a chief of the temple slaves who assembled at Casiphia at the time of the 2nd caravan from Babylon
s: From [H5710](H5710); *timely*; *Iddo* (or *Iddi*), the name of five Israelites: - Iddo. Compare [H3035](H3035), [H3260](H3260).

d: **1.** testimony
s: Feminine of [H5707](H5707); *testimony: -* testimony, witness.

d:
**1.** ornaments
		**a.** ornaments
		**b.** trappings (of horses)
s: From [H5710](H5710) in the sense of *trappings*; *finery*; generally an *outfit*; specifically a *headstall: -*  X excellent, mouth, ornament.
o: from [H5710](H5710) in the sense of trappings

d:
Adiel = "ornament of God"
**1.** a prince of the Simeon of the family of Shimei in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
**2.** a priest, ancestor of Maasiai
**3.** ancestor of Azmaveth, the treasurer of David
s: From [H5716](H5716) and [H410](H410); *ornament* *of* *God*; *Adiel*, the name of three Israelites: - Adiel.

d:
Adaiah = "Jehovah has adorned Himself"
**1.** maternal grandfather of king Josiah of Judah and native of Boscath in the lowlands of Judah
**2.** a Gershonite Levite and ancestor of Asaph
**3.** a Benjamite, son of Shimhi
**4.** a priest, son of Jehoram
**5.** ancestor of Maaseiah, one of the captains who supported Jehoiada
**6.** a descendant of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
**7.** a descendant of another Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
**8.** a descendant of Pharez of the tribe of Judah
s: From [H5710](H5710) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *adorned*; *Adajah*, the name of eight Israelites: - Adaiah.

d: **1.** voluptuous
s: From [H5727](H5727); *voluptuous: -* given to pleasures.

d:
Adin = "dainty" or "delicate"
**1.** ancestor of a family of exiles who returned with Zerubbabel
**2.** a chief among the returned exiles who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: The same as [H5719](H5719); *Adin*, the name of two Israelites: - Adin.

d:
Adina = "slender"
**1.** a chief of the Reubenites, and a captain of David
s: From [H5719](H5719); *effeminacy*; *Adina*, an Israelite: - Adina.

d:
Adino = "his ornament"
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors
s: Probably from [H5719](H5719) in the original sense of *slender* (that is, a *spear*); *his* *spear: -* Adino.
o: probably from [H5719](H5719) in the original sense of slender (ie spear)

d:
Adithaim = "double ornament"
**1.** a town in the lowland of Judah
s: Dual of a feminine of [H5706](H5706); *double* *prey*; *Adithajim*, a place in Palestine: - Adithaim.

d:
Adlai = "justice of Jehovah"
**1.** ancestor of Shaphat, the overseer of David's herds
s: Probably from an unused root of uncertain meaning; *Adlai*, an Israelite: - Adlai.
o: probably from an unused root of uncertain meaning

d:
Adullam = "justice of the people"
**1.** a town of the Canaanites allotted to Judah and lying in the lowlands; site of the cave where David hid
s: Probably from the passive participle of the same as [H5724](H5724); *Adullam*, a place in Palestine: - Adullam.
o: probably from the pass. part. of the same as [H5724](H5724)

d:
Adullamite = see Adullam "justice of the people"
**1.** an inhabitant of Adullam
s: Patrial from [H5725](H5725); an *Adullamite* or native of Adullam: - Adullamite.

d: **1.** (Hithpael) to luxuriate, delight oneself
s: A primitive root; to be *soft* or *pleasant*; figuratively and reflexively to *live* *voluptuously: -* delight self.

d: **1.** hitherto, still, yet

Eden = "pleasure"
**1.** a place conquered by Assyria; probably located in the northwest of Mesopotamia
s: From [H5727](H5727); *pleasure*; *Eden*, a place in Mesopotamia: - Eden.

d:
**1.** luxury, dainty, delight, finery
**2.** delight
s: From [H5727](H5727); *pleasure*: - delicate, delight, pleasure. See also [H1040](H1040).

d:
Eden= "pleasure"
n pr m loc
**1.** the first habitat of man after the creation; site unknown
n pr m
**2.** a Gershonite Levite, son of Joah in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah
s: The same as [H5730](H5730) (masculine); *Eden*, the region of Adam’s home: - Eden.

d:
**1.** time
		**a.** time (of duration)
		**b.** year
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to that of [H5708](H5708); a set *time*; technically a *year: -* time.
o: from a root corresponding to that of [H5708](H5708)

d:
Adna = "rest" or "pleasure"
**1.** one of the family of Pahath-moab who returned with Ezra and married a foreign wife
**2.** a priest, descendant of Harim in the days of Joiakim, the son of Jeshua
s: From [H5727](H5727); *pleasure*; *Adna*, the name of two Israelites: - Adna.

d:
Adnah = "pleasure"
**1.** a Manassite who deserted from Saul and joined David at Ziklag
**2.** a captain in charge of over 300,000 men of Judah in the time of Jehoshaphat
s: From [H5727](H5727); *pleasure*; *Adnah*, the name of two Israelites: - Adnah.

d:
Adadah = "festival" or "boundary"
**1.** one of the towns in the extreme south of Judah
s: From [H5712](H5712); *festival*; *Adadah*, a place in Palestine: - Adadah.

d:
**1.** to remain over, be in excess
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be in excess
						**a.** excess (subst)
						**b.** surplus (participle)
		**b.** (Hiphil) to have a surplus
s: A primitive root; to *be* (causatively *have*) *redundant: -* be more, odd number, be (have) over (and above), overplus, remain.

d:
**1.** to help
		**a.** (Qal) to help
**2.** to hoe
		**a.** (Niphal) to be hoed
**3.** to be lacking, fail
		**a.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be lacking
				**1.** to leave lacking
		**b.** (Piel) to leave lacking
s: A primitive root; to *arrange*, as a battle, a vineyard (to *hoe*); hence to *muster*, and so to *miss* (or find *wanting*): - dig, fail, keep (rank), lack.

d:
Ader = "flock"
**1.** a Benjamite, son of Beriah, chief of the inhabitants of Aijalon
		**a.** also 'Eder'
s: From [H5737](H5737); an *arrangement* (that is, drove); *Eder*, an Israelite: - Ader.

d:
**1.** flock, herd
		**a.** flock
		**b.** herds, flocks and herds
s: From [H5737](H5737); an *arrangement*, that is, *muster* (of animals): - drove, flock, herd.

d:
Eder = "a flock"
n pr m
**1.** a Merarite Levite in the time of David
n pr loc
**2.** a town in the extreme south of Judah on the border of Edom; site unknown
s: The same as [H5739](H5739); *Eder*, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine: - Edar, Eder.

d:
Adriel = "flock of God"
**1.** son of Barzillai, and the man to whom Saul gave his daughter Merab in marriage although she was already promised to David
s: From [H5739](H5739) and [H410](H410); *flock* *of* *God*; *Adriel*, an Israelite: - Adriel.

d: **1.** lentil
s: From an unused root of uncertain meaning; a *lentil: -* lentile.
o: from an unused root of uncertain meaning

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to becloud
s: A primitive root; to be *dense* or *dark*, that is, to *becloud: -* cover with a cloud.

d:
Obed = "serving"
**1.** son of Boaz by Ruth and the grandfather of David
**2.** a Judaite, a descendant of Jarha, the Egyptian slave of Sheshan, in the line of Jerahmeel
**3.** a Judaite, father of Azariah, one of the captains of hundreds who joined with Jehoiada in the revolution by which Athaliah fell
**4.** one of David's mighty warriors
**5.** son of Shemaiah and a gatekeeper of the temple
s: Active participle of [H5647](H5647); *serving*; *Obed*, the name of five Israelites: - Obed.

d:
Obal = "stripped bare"
**1.** a son of Joktan and the founder of an Arab tribe
s: Of foreign derivation; *Obal*, a son of Joktan: - Obal.

d: **1.** (Qal) to bake, bake a cake
s: A primitive root; properly to *gyrate*; but used only as denominative from [H5692](H5692), to *bake* (round cakes on the hearth): - bake.

d:
Og = "long-necked"
**1.** the Amorite king of Bashan and one of the last representatives of the giants of Rephaim
s: Probably from [H5746](H5746); *round*; *Og*, a king of Bashan: - Og.

d:
**1.** a musical instrument
		**a.** perhaps a flute, reed-pipe, or panpipes
s: From [H5689](H5689) in the original sense of *breathing*; a *reed* instrument of music: - organ.
o: from [H5689](H5689) in the original sense of breathing

d:
**1.** to return, repeat, go about, do again
		**a.** (Piel) to surround, go round and round
		**b.** (Pilel) to restore, relieve
		**c.** (Hithpalel) to be restored
**2.** to bear witness
		**a.** (Qal) to bear witness, say again and again
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to testify, bear witness
				**2.** to cause to testify, take or call as witness, invoke
				**3.** to protest, affirm solemnly, warn, exhort or enjoin solemnly, admonish, charge
		**c.** (Hophal) to protest, give warning
s: A primitive root; to *duplicate* or *repeat*; by implication to *protest*, *testify* (as by reiteration); intensively to *encompass*, *restore* (as a sort of reduplication): - admonish, charge, earnestly, lift up, protest, call (take) to record, relieve, rob, solemnly, stand upright, testify, give warning, (bear, call to, give, take to) witness.

d:
subst
**1.** a going round, continuance
adv
**2.** still, yet, again, besides
		**a.** still, yet (of continuance or persistence)
		**b.** still, yet, more (of addition or repetition)
		**c.** again
		**d.** still, moreover, besides
s: From [H5749](H5749); properly *iteration* or *continuance*; used only adverbially (with or without preposition), *again*, *repeatedly*, *still*, *more: -* again, X all life long, at all, besides, but, else, further (-more), henceforth, (any) longer, (any) more (-over), X once, since, (be) still, when, (good, the) while (having being), (as, because, whether, while) yet (within).

d: **1.** still, while, yet
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5750](H5750): - while.

d:
Oded = "restorer"
**1.** father of Azariah the prophet in the reign of king Asa of Judah
**2.** a prophet of Jehovah in Samaria at the time of Pekah's invasion of Judah
s: From [H5749](H5749); *reiteration*; *Oded*, the name of two Israelites: - Oded.

d:
**1.** to bend, twist, distort
		**a.** (Niphal) to be bent, be bowed down, be twisted, be perverted
		**b.** (Piel) to twist, distort
		**c.** (Hiphil) to do perversely
**2.** to commit iniquity, do wrong, pervert
		**a.** (Qal) to do wrong, commit iniquity
		**b.** (Hiphil) to commit iniquity
s: A primitive root; to *crook*, literally or figuratively: - do amiss, bow down, make crooked, commit iniquity, pervert, (do) perverse (-ly), trouble, X turn, do wickedly, do wrong.

d: **1.** distortion, ruin
s: Intensive from [H5753](H5753) abbreviated; *overthrow: -*  X overturn.

d:
Ava or Ivah = "ruin"
**1.** a city conquered by the Assyrians
s: For [H5754](H5754); *Ivvah* or *Avva*, a region of Assyria: - Ava, Ivah.

d: **1.** (Hiphil) to take refuge, bring to refuge, seek refuge
s: A primitive root; to *be* *strong*; causatively to *strengthen*, that is, (figuratively) to *save* (by flight): - gather (self, self to flee), retire.

d:
Avims or Avites = "perverters"
**1.** inhabitants of Ava or Ivah
s: Patrial from [H5755](H5755); an *Avvite* or native of Avvah (only plural): - Avims, Avites.

d: **1.** perversity, iniquity
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to [H5753](H5753); *perverseness: -* iniquity.

d: **1.** young male or man or boy, boy
s: From [H5764](H5764); a *babe: -* young child, little one.

d: **1.** perverse one, unjust one
s: From [H5765](H5765); *perverse* (morally): - ungodly.

d:
Avim = "ruins"
n pr m
**1.** a people among the early inhabitants of Palestine located in the southwest corner of the seacoast
n pr loc
**2.** a city in Benjamin
s: Plural of [H5757](H5757); *Avvim* (as inhabited by Avvites), a place in Palestine (with the article prefixed): - Avim.

d:
Avith = "ruins"
**1.** the city of Hadad Ben-Bedad, one of the kings of Edom
s: From [H5753](H5753); *ruin*; *Avvith* (or *Avvoth*), a place in Palestine: - Avith.

d:
**1.** to give suck, suckle, nurse
		**a.** (Qal) giving suck (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *suckle*, that is, *give* *milk: -* milch, (ewe great) with young.

d: **1.** suckling, sucking child
s: From [H5763](H5763); a *babe: -* sucking child, infant.

d:
**1.** to act wrongfully or unjustly, deviate from
		**a.** (Piel) to act wrongfully
s: A primitive root; to *distort* (morally): - deal unjustly, unrighteous.

d:
**1.** injustice, unrighteousness, wrong
		**a.** violent deeds of injustice
		**b.** injustice (of speech)
		**c.** injustice (generally)
s: From [H5765](H5765); (moral) *evil: -* iniquity, perverseness, unjust (-ly), unrighteousness (-ly), wicked (-ness).

d: **1.** unjust one, perverse one, unrighteous one
s: Intensive from [H5765](H5765); *evil* (morally): - unjust, unrighteous, wicked.

d: **1.** child, boy
s: From [H5763](H5763); a *suckling: -* babe, (young) child, infant, little one.

d:
**1.** long duration, antiquity, futurity, for ever, ever, everlasting, evermore, perpetual, old, ancient, world
		**a.** ancient time, long time (of past)
		**b.** (of future)
				**1.** for ever, always
				**2.** continuous existence, perpetual
				**3.** everlasting, indefinite or unending future, eternity
s: From [H5956](H5956); properly *concealed*, that is, the *vanishing* point; generally time *out* *of* *mind* (past or future), that is, (practically) *eternity*; frequentative adverbially (especially with prepositional prefix) *always*: - always (-s), ancient (time), any more, continuance, eternal, (for, \[n-\]) ever (-lasting, -more, of old), lasting, long (time), (of) old (time), perpetual, at any time, (beginning of the) world (+ without end). Compare [H5331](H5331), [H5703](H5703).

d:
**1.** to eye, look at
		**a.** (Qal) to eye, look at
s: Denominative from [H5869](H5869); to *watch* (with jealousy): - eye.

d:
**1.** perversity, depravity, iniquity, guilt or punishment of iniquity
		**a.** iniquity
		**b.** guilt of iniquity, guilt (as great), guilt (of condition)
		**c.** consequence of or punishment for iniquity
s: From [H5753](H5753); *perversity*, that is, (moral) *evil: -* fault, iniquity, mischief, punishment (of iniquity), sin.

d: **1.** cohabitation, conjugal rights
s: From an unused root apparently meaning to *dwell* together; (sexual) *cohabitation: -* duty of marriage.
o: from an unused root apparently meaning to dwell together

d: **1.** distorting, perverting, warping
s: From [H5753](H5753); *perversity: -*  X perverse.

d:
v
**1.** to fly, fly about, fly away
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to fly, hover
				**2.** to fly away
		**b.** (Hiphil) to cause to fly, light upon
		**c.** (Polel)
				**1.** to fly about or to and fro
				**2.** to cause to fly to and fro, brandish
		**d.** (Hithpolel) to fly away
**2.** (Qal) to cover, be dark
n f
**3.** gloom
s: A primitive root; to *cover* (with wings or obscurity); hence (as denominative from [H5775](H5775)) to *fly*; also (by implication of dimness) to *faint* (from the darkness of swooning): - brandish, be (wax) faint, flee away, fly (away - ), X set, shine forth, weary.

d:
**1.** flying creatures, fowl, insects, birds
		**a.** fowl, birds
		**b.** winged insects
s: From [H5774](H5774); a *bird* (as *covered* with feathers, or rather as *covering* with wings), often collective: - bird, that flieth, flying, fowl.

d: **1.** fowl
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5775](H5775): - fowl.

d: **1.** lead
s: Feminine participle active of [H6080](H6080); *lead* (from its *dusty* color): - lead.

d:
Ephai = "gloomy"
**1.** a Netophathite, whose sons were among the captains of the forces left in Judah after the deportation to Babylon
s: From [H5775](H5775); *birdlike*; *Ephai*, an Israelite: - Ephai \[from margin\].

d: **1.** (Qal) to counsel, plan
s: A primitive root; to *consult: -* take advice (\[counsel\] together).

d:
Uz = "wooded"
n pr m
**1.** son of Aram and grandson of Seth
**2.** son of Nahor by Milcah
**3.** an Edomite, son of Dishan and grandson of Seir
n pr loc
**4.** the country of Job; probably east and southeast of Palestine somewhere in the Arabian desert
s: Apparently from [H5779](H5779); *consultation*; *Uts*, a son of Aram, also a Seirite, and the regions settled by them: - Uz.

d:
**1.** (Hiphil) to totter, cause to totter, crush
		**a.** meaning dubious
s: A primitive root; to *pack: -* be pressed.

d:
**1.** to rouse oneself, awake, awaken, incite
		**a.** (Qal) to rouse oneself, awake
		**b.** (Niphal) to be roused
		**c.** (Polel) to stir up, rouse, incite
		**d.** (Hithpolel) to be excited, be triumphant
		**e.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to rouse, stir up
				**2.** to act in an aroused manner, awake
s: A primitive root (rather identical with [H5783](H5783) through the idea of *opening* the eyes); to *wake* (literally or figuratively): - (a-) wake (-n, up), lift up (self), X master, raise (up), stir up (self).
o: a primitive root \[rather identical with [H5783](H5783) through the idea of opening the eyes\]

d: **1.** (Niphal) to be exposed, be bared, be laid bare
s: A primitive root; to (*be*) *bare: -*  be made naked.

d: **1.** chaff
s: (Chaldee); *chaff* (as the *naked* husk): - chaff.

d:
**1.** skin, hide
		**a.** skin (of men)
		**b.** hide (of animals)
s: From [H5783](H5783); *skin* (as *naked*); by implication *hide*, *leather: -* hide, leather, skin.

s: A primitive root (rather denominative from [H5785](H5785) through the idea of a *film* over the eyes); to *blind*: - blind, put out. See also [H5895](H5895).
o: a primitive root \[rather denominatively from [H5785](H5785) through the idea of a film over the eyes\]

d:
**1.** blind
		**a.** blind (physically)
		**b.** blind (fig.)
s: Intensive from [H5786](H5786); *blind* (literally or figuratively): - blind (men, people).

d: **1.** blindness
s: From [H5787](H5787); *blindness: -* blind (-ness).

d: **1.** (Qal) to lend aid, come to help, hasten
s: A primitive root; to *hasten: -* assemble self.

d:
**1.** (Qal) to hasten to, help, succour
		**a.** meaning dubious
s: From [H5789](H5789); to *hasten*, that is, *succor: -* speak in season.

d:
**1.** to be bent, be crooked, bend, make crooked, pervert
		**a.** (Piel)
				**1.** to make crooked, falsify, pervert, subvert
				**2.** to bend, make crooked
		**b.** (Pual) thing bent (participle)
		**c.** (Hithpael) to bend oneself
s: A primitive root; to *wrest: -* bow self, (make) crooked, falsifying, overthrow, deal perversely, pervert, subvert, turn upside down.

d: **1.** subversion, bending
s: From [H5791](H5791); *oppression: -* wrong.

d:
Uthai = "helpful"
**1.** son of Ammihud and a descendant of Pharez of Judah
**2.** one of the sons of Bigvai who returned from exile with the 2nd caravan with Ezra
s: From [H5790](H5790); *succoring*; *Uthai*, the name of two Israelites: - Uthai.

d: **1.** strong, mighty, fierce
s: From [H5810](H5810); *strong*, *vehement*, *harsh: -* fierce, + greedy, mighty, power, roughly, strong.

d: **1.** female goat, she-goat, goat, kid
s: From [H5810](H5810); a she *goat* (as *strong*), but masculine in plural (which also is used elliptically for *goats’* *hair*): - (she) goat, kid.

d: **1.** she-goat
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5795](H5795): - goat.

d:
**1.** might, strength
		**a.** material or physical
		**b.** personal or social or political
s: From [H5810](H5810); *strength* in various applications (*force*, *security*, *majesty*, *praise*): - boldness, loud, might, power, strength, strong.

d:
Uzza or Uzzah = "strength"
n pr m
**1.** a man slain by Jehovah for touching the sacred ark
**2.** a Benjamite of the sons of Ehud
**3.** ancestor of a family of temple slaves who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
**4.** a Merarite Levite
n pr loc
**5.** the garden where kings Manasseh and Amon of Judah were buried
s: Feminine of [H5797](H5797); *strength*; *Uzza* or *Uzzah*, the name of five Israelites: - Uzza, Uzzah.

d:
**1.** entire removal, scapegoat
		**a.** refers to the goat used for sacrifice for the sins of the people
		**b.** meaning dubious
s: From [H5795](H5795) and [H235](H235); *goat* *of* *departure*; the *scapegoat: -* scapegoat.

d:
**1.** to leave, loose, forsake
		**a.** (Qal) to leave
				**1.** to depart from, leave behind, leave, let alone
				**2.** to leave, abandon, forsake, neglect, apostatise
				**3.** to let loose, set free, let go, free
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be left to
				**2.** to be forsaken
		**c.** (Pual) to be deserted
**2.** to restore, repair
		**a.** (Qal) to repair
s: A primitive root; to *loosen*, that is, *relinquish*, *permit*, etc.: - commit self, fail, forsake, fortify, help, leave (destitute, off), refuse, X surely.

d: **1.** wares, goods
s: From [H5800](H5800) in the sense of *letting* *go* (for a price, that is, *selling*); *trade*, that is, the palce (*mart*) or the payment (*revenue*): - fair, ware.
o: from [H5800](H5800) in the sense of letting go (for a price, i.e. selling)

d:
Azbuk = "strong devastation"
**1.** father of Nehemiah, leader of half the district of Beth Zur, and a repairer of the walls of Jerusalem under another Nehemiah
s: From [H5794](H5794) and the root of [H950](H950); *stern* *depopulator*; *Azbuk*, an Israelite: - Azbuk.

d:
Azgad = "Gad is mighty"
**1.** ancestor of a family of laymen who returned from exile with Zerubbabel
**2.** a man who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: From [H5794](H5794) and [H1409](H1409); *stern* *troop*; *Azgad*, an Israelite: - Azgad.

d:
Azzah = "the strong"
**1.** another name for 'Gaza', a city of the Philistines located in the extreme southwest of Palestine close to the Mediterranean
s: Feminine of [H5794](H5794); *strong*; *Azzah*, a place in Palestine: - Azzah, Gaza.

d: **1.** forsakenness, desolation
s: Feminine passive participle of [H5800](H5800); *desertion* (of inhabitants): - forsaking.

d:
Azubah = "forsaken"
**1.** wife of Caleb, the son of Hezron
**2.** daughter of Shilhi, wife of king Asa, and mother of king Jehoshaphat of Judah
s: The same as [H5805](H5805); *Azubah*, the name of two Israelitesses: - Azubah.

d: **1.** strength, fierceness, might
s: From [H5810](H5810); *forcibleness: -* might, strength.

d: **1.** powerful, mighty
s: From [H5810](H5810); *forcible*; collectively and concretely an *army: -* power, strong.

d:
Azur or Azzur = "he that assists"
**1.** a Benjamite of Gibeon, father of the false prophet Hananiah
**2.** father of Jaazaniah, one of the princes against whom Ezekiel was commanded to prophecy
s: From [H5826](H5826); *helpful*; *Azzur*, the name of three Israelites: - Azur, Azzur.

d:
**1.** to be strong
		**a.** (Qal) to be strong, prevail
		**b.** (Hiphil) to make firm, strengthen
s: A primitive root; to *be* *stout* (literally or figuratively): - harden, impudent, prevail, strengthen (self), be strong.

d:
Azaz = "strong"
**1.** a Reubenite, father of Bela
s: From [H5810](H5810); *strong*; *Azaz*, an Israelite: - Azaz.

d:
Azaziah = "Jehovah is mighty"
**1.** a Levite musician in the reign of David who played the harp in the procession which brought the ark from Obed-edom to Jerusalem
**2.** a Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah in charge of the tithes
**3.** father of Hoshea, prince of the tribe of Ephraim when David took the census
s: From [H5810](H5810) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *strengthened*; *Azazjah*, the name of three Israelites: - Azaziah.

d:
Uzzi = "strong"
**1.** a Levite, son of Bukki and father of Zerahiah in the line of the high priest although apparently never high priest himself
**2.** son of Tola and grandson of Issachar
**3.** a Benjamite, son of Bela and head of a family of Benjamin
**4.** son of Michri and father of Elah and an ancestor of a family of returned exiles settling in Jerusalem. Maybe same as 3
**5.** a Levite, son of Bani, and an overseer of the Levites in Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
**6.** a priest, chief of the father's house of Jedaiah, in the time of Joiakim the high priest
**7.** one of the priests who helped Ezra in the dedication of the wall of Jerusalem. Maybe same as 6
s: From [H5810](H5810); *forceful*; *Uzzi*, the name of six Israelites: - Uzzi.

d:
Uzzia = "strength of Jehovah"
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors
s: Perhaps for [H5818](H5818); *Uzzija*, an Israelite: - Uzzia.

d:
Aziel = "whom God comforts"
**1.** a Levite; also 'Jaaziel'
s: From [H5756](H5756) and [H410](H410); *strengthened* *of* *God*; *Aziel*, an Israelite: - Aziel. Compare [H3268](H3268).

d:
Uzziel = "my strength is God"
**1.** the 4th son of Kohath and grandson of Levi, uncle of Moses and Aaron
**2.** a Simeonite captain, son of Ishi, in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah
**3.** descendant of Bela, head of a family in the tribe of Benjamin
**4.** a musician of the sons of Heman in the time of David
**5.** a Levite of the sons of Jeduthun in the days of king Hezekiah of Judah
**6.** son of Harhaiah, probably a priest and a goldsmith, who took part in repairing the wall under Nehemiah
s: From [H5797](H5797) and [H410](H410); *strength* *of* *God*; *Uzziel*, the name of six Israelites: - Uzziel.

d:
Uzzielites = see Uzziel "my strength is God"
**1.** descendants of Uzziel
s: Patronymic from [H5816](H5816); an *Uzzielite* (collectively) or descendant of Uzziel: - Uzzielites.

d:
Uzziah = "my strength is Jehovah"
**1.** son of king Amaziah of Judah and king of Judah himself for 52 years; also 'Azariah'
**2.** a Kohathite Levite and ancestor of Samuel
**3.** a priest of the sons of Harim who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
**4.** a Judaite, father of Athaiah or Uthai
**5.** father of Jehonathan, one of David's overseers
s: From [H5797](H5797) and [H3050](H3050); *strength* *of* *Jah*; *Uzzijah*, the name of five Israelites: - Uzziah.

d:
Aziza = "strong"
**1.** a layman of the family of Zattu who took a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
s: From [H5756](H5756); *strengthfulness*; *Aziza*, an Israelite: - Aziza.

d:
Azmaveth = "strong unto death"
n pr m
**1.** one of David's mighty warriors

**3.** a Benjamite, father of Jeziel and Pelet who were two of David's men who joined him at Ziklag
**4.** overseer of the royal treasures in the reign of David
n pr loc
**5.** a place in Benjamin; also 'Beth-azmeveth'
s: From [H5794](H5794) and [H4194](H4194); *strong* one *of* *death*; *Azmaveth*, the name of three Israelites and of a place in Palestine: - Azmaveth. See also [H1041](H1041).

d:
Azzan = "very strong"
**1.** father of Paltiel prince of the tribe of Issachar who represented his tribe in the division of the promised land
s: From [H5794](H5794); *strong* one; *Azzan*, an Israelite: - Azzan.

d:
**1.** an unclean bird of prey

		**b.** perhaps an extinct bird, exact meaning unknown
s: Probably feminine of [H5797](H5797); probably the *sea* *eagle* (from its *strength*): - ospray.

d: **1.** (Piel) to dig about
s: A primitive root; to *grub* over: - fence about.

d: **1.** signet-ring
s: (Chaldee); from a root corresponding to [H5823](H5823); a *signet* ring (as engraved): - signet.

d:
Azekah = "dug over"
**1.** a town in the lowlands of Judah
s: From [H5823](H5823); *tilled*; *Azekah*, a place in Palestine: - Azekah.

d:
**1.** to help, succour, support
		**a.** (Qal) to help
		**b.** (Niphal) to be helped
		**c.** (Hiphil) to help
s: A primitive root; to *surround*, that is, *protect* or *aid: -* help, succour.

d:
Ezer = "treasure"

**2.** a priest who helped at the dedication of the walls of Jerusalem under Nehemiah

d:
**1.** help, succour
		**a.** help, succour
		**b.** one who helps

d:
Ezer = "treasure"
**1.** father of Hushah of the sons of Hur
**2.** a Gadite chief who fought with David
**3.** a Levite who aided in repairing the wall of Jerusalem in the time of Nehemiah
s: The same as [H5828](H5828); *Ezer*, the name of four Israelites: - Ezer. Compare [H5827](H5827).

d:
Ezra = "help"
**1.** the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah
**2.** a priest with Zerubbabel
**3.** another post-exilic Jew
s: A variation of [H5833](H5833); *Ezra*, an Israelite: - Ezra.

d:
Ezra = "help"
**1.** the priest and scribe who led the reforms of the returned exiles in Jerusalem; co-worker with Nehemiah
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H5830](H5830); *Ezra*, an Israelite: - Ezra.

d:
Azarael or Azareel = "God has helped"
**1.** a Korhite warrior of David who joined him at Ziklag

**1.** father of Ahiezer, prince of the tribe of Dan at the time of the exodus
s: From [H5971](H5971) and [H7706](H7706); *people* *of* (the) *Almighty*; *Ammishaddai*, an Israelite: - Ammishaddai.

d: **1.** relation, neighbour, associate, fellow
s: From a primitive root meaning to *associate*; *companionship*; hence (concretely) a *comrade* or kindred man: - another, fellow, neighbour.
o: from a primitive root meaning to associate

d:
**1.** to labour, toil
		**a.** (Qal) to labour
s: A primitive root; to *toil*, that is, *work* *severely* and with irksomeness: - \[take\] labour (in).

d:
**1.** toil, trouble, labour
		**a.** trouble
		**b.** trouble, mischief
		**c.** toil, labour
s: From [H5998](H5998); *toil*, that is, *wearing* *effort*; hence *worry*, whether of body or mind: - grievance (-vousness), iniquity, labour, mischief, miserable (-sery), pain (-ful), perverseness, sorrow, toil, travail, trouble, wearisome, wickedness.

d:
Amal = "labour"
**1.** an Asherite, son of Helem
s: The same as [H5999](H5999); *Amal*, an Israelite: - Amal.

d:
n m
**1.** labourer, sufferer, wretched one
		**a.** labourer, workman
		**b.** sufferer
adj v
**2.** toiling
s: From [H5998](H5998); *toiling*; concretely a *laborer*; figuratively *sorrowful: -* that laboureth, that is a misery, had taken \[labour\], wicked, workman.

d:
Amalek = "dweller in a valley"
**1.** son of Eliphaz by his concubine Timnah, grandson of Esau, and progenitor of a tribe of people in southern Canaan
**2.** descendants of Amalek
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Amalek*, a descendant of Esau; also his posterity and their country: - Amalek.

d:
Amalekite = see Amalek "people of lapping"
**1.** descendants of Amalek, the grandson of Esau
s: Patronymic from [H6002](H6002); an *Amalekite* (or collectively the *Amalekites*) or descendant of Amalek: - Amalekite (-s).

d:
**1.** to dim, darken, grow dark
		**a.** (Qal) to dim, eclipse, be held dark
		**b.** (Hophal) to be dimmed, grow dark
s: A primitive root; to *associate*; by implication to *overshadow* (by *huddling* together): - become dim, hide.

d:
Immanuel = "God with us" or "with us is God"
**1.** symbolic and prophetic name of the Messiah, the Christ, prophesying that He would be born of a virgin and would be 'God with us'
s: From [H5973](H5973) and [H410](H410) with suffix pronoun inserted; *with* *us* (is) *God*; *Immanuel*, a name of Isaiah’s son: - Immanuel.
o: from [H5973](H5973) and [H410](H410) with a pronominal suffix inserted

d:
**1.** to load, carry, carry a load
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to load
				**2.** to carry a load
		**b.** (Hiphil) to lay a load on
s: A primitive root; to *load*, that is, *impose* a burden (or figuratively infliction): - be borne, (heavy) burden (self), lade, load, put.

d:
Amasiah = "Jehovah is strength"
**1.** son of Zichri and captain of 200,000 warriors of Judah in the reign of king Jehoshaphat of Judah
s: From [H6006](H6006) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *loaded*; *Amasjah*, an Israelite: - Amasiah.

d:
Amad = "enduring"
**1.** a town in Asher on the border between Alammelech and Misheal
s: From [H5971](H5971) and [H5703](H5703); *people* *of* *time*; *Amad*, a place in Palestine: - Amad.

d:
**1.** to be deep, be profound, make deep
		**a.** (Qal) to be deep
		**b.** (Hiphil) to make deep, make profound
s: A primitive root; to *be* (causatively *make*) *deep* (literally or figuratively): - (be, have, make, seek) deep (-ly), depth, be profound.

d: **1.** valley, vale, lowland, open country
s: From [H6009](H6009); a *vale* (that is, broad *depression*).: - dale, vale, valley \[often used as a part of proper names\]. See also [H1025](H1025).

d: **1.** depth
s: From [H6009](H6009); *depth: -* depth.

d:
**1.** deep, unfathomable
		**a.** unintelligible (of speech)
s: From [H6009](H6009); *deep* (literally or figuratively): - deeper, depth, strange.

d:
**1.** deep, mysterious, depths
		**a.** deep
		**b.** unsearchable
s: From [H6009](H6009); *deep* (literally or figuratively): -  (X exceeding) deep (thing)

d:
**1.** to bind sheaves
		**a.** (Piel) to gather
**2.** to manipulate, deal tyrannically with
		**a.** (Hithpael) to treat as a slave
s: A primitive root; properly apparently to *heap*; figuratively to *chastise* (as if *piling* blows); specifically (as denominative from [H6016](H6016)) to *gather* grain: - bind sheaves, make merchandise of.

d: **1.** wool
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6785](H6785); *wool: -* wool.

d:
**1.** omer
		**a.** a dry measure of 1/10 ephah (about 2 litres)
**2.** sheaf
s: From [H6014](H6014); properly a *heap*, that is, a *sheaf*; also an *omer*, as a dry measure: - omer, sheaf.

d:
Gomorrah = "submersion"
**1.** the twin-city in evil with Sodom, both destroyed in judgment by God with fire from heaven
		**a.** of iniquity (fig.)
s: From [H6014](H6014); a (ruined) *heap*; *Amorah*, a place in Palestine: - Gomorrah.

d:
Omri = "pupil of Jehovah"
**1.** king of the northern kingdom of Israel, successor to king Elah for whom he was the captain of the army; ruled for 12 years and succeeded by his infamous son Ahab
**2.** one of the sons of Becher the son of Benjamin
**3.** a descendant of Pharez the son of Judah
**4.** son of Michael and chief of the tribe of Issachar in the time of David
s: From [H6014](H6014); *heaping*; *Omri*, an Israelite: - Omri.

d:
Amram = "exalted people"
**1.** a descendant of Kohath and Levi and father of Moses
**2.** one of the sons of Bani who had a foreign wife in the time of Ezra
s: Probably from [H5971](H5971) and [H7311](H7311); *high* *people*; *Amram*, the name of two Israelites: - Amram.

d:
Amramites = see Aram "exalted"
**1.** a branch of the Kohathite family of the tribe of Levi and descendants of Amram, the father of Moses
s: Patronymic from [H6019](H6019); an *Amramite* or descendant of Amram: - Amramite.

d:
Amasa = "burden"
**1.** son of Ithra or Jether by Abigail the sister of David and general of the army of Absalom
**2.** son of Hadlai and a prince of Ephraim in the reign of king Ahaz
s: From [H6006](H6006); *burden*; *Amasa*, the name of two Israelites: - Amasa.

d:
Amasai = "burdensome"
**1.** a warrior and chief of the captains of Judah and Benjamin who joined David at Ziklag
**2.** a Kohathite Levite, father of Mahath and ancestor of Samuel
**3.** a priest who blew the trumpet before the ark
**4.** another Kohathite Levite in the reign of king Hezekiah of Judah
s: From [H6006](H6006); *burdensome*; *Amasai*, the name of three Israelites: - Amasai.

d:
Amashai = "burdensome"
**1.** a priest, son of Azareel in the time of Nehemiah
s: Probably form [H6006](H6006); *burdensome*; *Amashsay*, an Israelite: - Amashai.

d:
Anab = "fruit"
**1.** a city in the mountains of southern Judah, 18 miles southwest of Hebron
s: From the same as [H6025](H6025); *fruit*; *Anab*, a place in Palestine: - Anab.

d: **1.** grape(s)
s: From an unused root probably meaning to *bear* fruit; a *grape: -* (ripe) grape, wine.
o: from an unused root probably meaning to bear fruit

d:
**1.** to be soft, be delicate, be dainty
		**a.** (Pual) to be delicate
		**b.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to be of dainty habit, be pampered
				**2.** to be happy about, take exquisite delight
				**3.** to make merry over, make sport of
s: A primitive root; to be *soft* or pliable, that is, (figuratively) *effeminate* or luxurious: - delicate (-ness), (have) delight (self), sport self.

d: **1.** exquisite delight, daintiness, delight, pleasantness
s: From [H6026](H6026); *luxury: -* delight, pleasant.

d: **1.** dainty, delicate
s: From [H6026](H6026); *luxurious: -* delicate.

d:
**1.** to bind, tie up, bind around or upon
		**a.** (Qal) to tie up
s: A primitive root; ot *lace* fast: - bind, tie.

d:
**1.** to answer, respond, testify, speak, shout
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to answer, respond to
				**2.** to testify, respond as a witness
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to make answer
				**2.** to be answered, receive answer
**2.** (Qal) to sing, utter tunefully
**3.** (Qal) to dwell
s: A primitive root; properly to *eye* or (generally) to *heed*, that is, *pay* *attention*; by implication to *respond*; by extension to *begin* to speak; specifically to *sing*, *shout*, *testify*, *announce*: - give account, afflict \[by mistake for [H6031](H6031)\], (cause to, give) answer, bring low \[by mistake for [H6031](H6031)\], cry, hear, Leannoth, lift up, say, X scholar, (give a) shout, sing (together by course), speak, testify, utter, (bear) witness. See also [H1042](H1042), [H1043](H1043).

d:
**1.** (Qal) to be occupied, be busied with
**2.** to afflict, oppress, humble, be afflicted, be bowed down
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be put down, become low
				**2.** to be depressed, be downcast
				**3.** to be afflicted
				**4.** to stoop
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to humble oneself, bow down
				**2.** to be afflicted, be humbled
		**c.** (Piel)
				**1.** to humble, mishandle, afflict
				**2.** to humble, be humiliated
				**3.** to afflict
				**4.** to humble, weaken oneself
		**d.** (Pual)
				**1.** to be afflicted
				**2.** to be humbled
		**e.** (Hiphil) to afflict
		**f.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to humble oneself
				**2.** to be afflicted
s: A primitive root (possibly rather identical with [H6030](H6030) through the idea of *looking* down or *browbeating*); to *depress* literally or figuratively, transitively or intransitively (in various applications). (*sing* is by mistake for [H6030](H6030).): - abase self, afflict (-ion, self), answer \[by mistake for [H6030](H6030)\], chasten self, deal hardly with, defile, exercise, force, gentleness, humble (self), hurt, ravish, sing \[by mistake for [H6030](H6030)\], speak \[by mistake for [H6030](H6030)\], submit self, weaken, X in any wise.
o: a primitive root \[possibly rather ident. with [H6030](H6030) through the idea of looking down or browbeating\]

d:
**1.** to answer, respond
		**a.** (P'al)
				**1.** to answer, make reply
				**2.** to respond
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6030](H6030): - answer, speak.

d:
v
**1.** (P'al) to be humble, be low
adj
**2.** poor, needy
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6031](H6031): - poor.

d:
Anah = "answer"
n pr m
**1.** son of Zibeon and father of Aholibamah, a wife of Esau
**2.** a Horite chief
n pr f
**3.** daughter of Zibeon
s: Probably form [H6030](H6030); an *answer*; *Anah*, the name of two Edomites and one Edomitess: - Anah.

d:
**1.** poor, humble, afflicted, meek
		**a.** poor, needy
		**b.** poor and weak
		**c.** poor, weak and afflicted
		**d.** humble, lowly, meek
s: The second form is by intermixture with [H6041](H6041); from [H6031](H6031); *depressed* (figuratively), in mind (*gentle*) or circumstances (*needy*, especially *saintly*): - humble, lowly, meek, poor`. Compare [H6041](H6041).

d:
Anub = "confederate"
**1.** son of Coz, descendant of Judah and Caleb through Ashur, the father of Tekoa
s: Passive participle from the same as [H6025](H6025); *borne* (as fruit); *Anub*, an Israelite: - Anub.
o: pass. part. from the same as [H6025](H6025)

d:
**1.** humility, meekness
		**a.** humility, meekness
		**b.** condescension
s: Feminine of [H6035](H6035); *mildness* (royal); also (concretely) *oppressed: -* gentleness, meekness.

d: **1.** humility, meekness
s: From [H6035](H6035); *condescension*, human and subjective (*modesty*), or divine and objective (*clemency*): - gentleness, humility, meekness.

d: **1.** affliction
s: From [H6031](H6031); *affliction: -* affliction.

d:
**1.** affliction, poverty, misery
		**a.** affliction
		**b.** poverty
s: From [H6031](H6031); *depression*, that is, misery: - afflicted (-ion), trouble.

d:
**1.** poor, afflicted, humble, wretched
		**a.** poor, needy
		**b.** poor and weak
		**c.** poor, weak, afflicted, wretched
		**d.** humble, lowly
s: From [H6031](H6031); *depressed*, in mind or circumstances (practically the same as [H6035](H6035) subjectively and [H6041](H6041) objectively): - afflicted, humble`, lowly`, needy, poor.

d:
Unni = "afflicted"
**1.** a Levite doorkeeper in the time of David
**2.** a Levite concerned in the sacred office after the return from exile in Babylon
s: From [H6031](H6031); *afflicted*; *Unni*, the name of two Israelites: - Unni.

d:
Anaiah = "Jehovah has answered"
**1.** a priest who helped Ezra and signed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: From [H6030](H6030); *Jah* *has* *answered*; *Anajah*, the name of two Israelites: - Anaiah.

d:
Anim = "fountains"
**1.** a town in the mountains of southern Judah
s: For the plural of [H5869](H5869); *fountains*; *Anim*, a place in Palestine: - Anim.

d: **1.** occupation, task, job
s: From [H6031](H6031); *ado*, that is, (generally) *employment* or (specifically) an *affair: -* business, travail.

d:
Anem = "fountains"
**1.** a Levitical city in Issachar allotted to the Gershonites
s: From the dual of [H5869](H5869); *two* *fountains*; *Anem*, a place in Palestine: - Anem.

d:
Anamim = "affliction of the waters"
**1.** a tribe of Egyptians
s: As if plural of some Egyptian word; *Anamim*, a son of Mizraim and his descendants, with their country: - Anamim.
o: as if pl. of some Egyptian word

d:
Anammelech = "image of the king"
**1.** an Assyrian false god introduced to Israel during the monarchy; worshipped with rites resembling those of Molech; companion god of 'Adrammelech'
s: Of foreign origin; *Anammelek*, an Assyrian deity: - Anammelech.

d:
**1.** (Piel) to make appear, produce, bring (clouds)
**2.** (Poel) to practise soothsaying, conjure
		**a.** to observe times, practice soothsaying or spiritism or magic or augury or witchcraft
		**b.** soothsayer, enchanter, sorceress, diviner, fortuneteller, barbarian, Meonenim (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *cover*; used only as denominative from [H6051](H6051), to *cloud* over; figuratively to *act* *covertly*, that is, practise magic: -  X bring, enchanter, Meonemin, observe (-r of) times, soothsayer, sorcerer.

d: **1.** cloud
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6051](H6051): - cloud.

d:
**1.** cloud, cloudy, cloud-mass
		**a.** cloud-mass (of theophanic cloud)
		**b.** cloud
s: From [H6049](H6049); a *cloud* (as *covering* the sky), that is, the *nimbus* or thunder cloud: - cloud (-y).

d:
Anan = "cloud"
**1.** one of the heads of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
s: The same as [H6051](H6051); *cloud*; *Anan*, an Israelite: - Anan.

d: **1.** cloud, cloudy
s: Feminine of [H6051](H6051); *cloudiness: -* cloud.

d:
Anani = "my cloud"
**1.** the 7th son of Elioenai, descendant of David
s: From [H6051](H6051); *cloudy*; *Anani*, an Israelite: - Anani.

d:
Ananiah = "Jehovah clouds"
n pr m
**1.** ancestor of Azariah who assisted in rebuilding the city wall in the time of Nehemiah
n pr loc
**2.** a city northwest of Jerusalem to which some Benjamite exiles returned
s: From [H6049](H6049) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *covered*; *Ananjah*, the name of an Israelite and of a place in Palestine: - Ananiah.

d: **1.** bough, branch
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6057](H6057): - bough, branch.

d: **1.** bough, branch
s: From an unused root meaning to *cover*; a *twig* (as *covering* the limbs): - bough, branch.
o: from an unused root meaning to cover

d: **1.** full of branches, dense
s: From the same as [H6057](H6057); *branching: -* full of branches.

d:
**1.** to serve as a necklace, adorn with a neck ornament
		**a.** (Qal) to serve as a necklace
		**b.** (Hiphil) to make a necklace
s: A primitive root; properly to *choke*; used only as denominative from [H6060](H6060), to *collar*, that is, adorn with a necklace; figuratively to *fit* *out* with supplies: - compass about as a chain, furnish, liberally.

d:
**1.** necklace, neck-pendant
**2.** (TWOT) neck
s: From [H6059](H6059); a *necklace* (as if *strangling*): - chain.

d:
Anak = "neck"
**1.** progenitor of a family, or tribe of the giant people in Canaan
s: The same as [H6060](H6060); *Anak*, a Canaanite: - Anak.

d:
Anakims = "long-necked"
**1.** a tribe of giants, descendants of Anak, which dwelled in southern Canaan
s: Patronymic from [H6061](H6061); an *Anakite* or descendant of Anak: - Anakim.

d:
Aner = "boy"
n pr m
**1.** one of the Amorite chiefs who aided Abraham in the pursuit of the 4 invading kings
n pr loc
**2.** a Levitical city west of the Jordan in Manasseh allotted to the Kohathite Levites
s: Probably for [H5288](H5288); *Aner*, an Amorite, also a place in Palestine: - Aner.

d:
**1.** to fine, amerce, punish, condemn, mulct
		**a.** (Qal) to fine, punish
		**b.** (Niphal) to be fined, be punished, be mulcted
s: A primitive root; properly to *urge*; by implication to *inflict* a penalty, specifically to *fine: -* amerce, condemn, punish, X surely.

d:
v
**1.** (CLBL) to fine
**2.** (BDB/TWOT) confiscation, fining, amercing
s: [H1](H1) (Chaldee); coresp. to [H6066](H6066); a *mulct: -* confiscation.

d: **1.** fine, penalty, indemnity
s: From [H6064](H6064); a *fine: -* punishment, tribute.

d:
Anath = "answer"
**1.** father of Shamgar
s: From [H6030](H6030); *answer*; *Anath*, an Israelite: - Anath.

d:
Anathoth = "answers to prayer"
n pr m
**1.** son of Becher and grandson of Benjamin
**2.** one of the heads of the people who signed the covenant with Nehemiah
n pr loc
**3.** a city of Benjamin allotted to the priest; located approximately 3 miles (5 km) from Jerusalem; birthplace of the prophet Jeremiah
s: Plural of [H6067](H6067); *Anathoth*, the name of two Israelites, also of a place in Palestine: - Anathoth.

d:
Anethothite = see Anathoth "affliction"
**1.** a descendant or inhabitant of Anathoth
s: Patrial from [H6068](H6068); an *Antothite* or inhabitant of Anathoth: - of Anathoth, Anethothite, Anetothite, Antothite.

d:
Antothijah = "Jehovah's answer"
**1.** a Benjamite, one of the sons of Jeroham
s: From the same as [H6068](H6068) and [H3050](H3050); *answers* *of* *Jah*; *Anthothijah*, an Israelite: - Antothijah.

d: **1.** sweet wine, wine, pressed out juice
s: From [H6072](H6072); *must* or fresh grape juice (as just *trodden* out): - juice, new (sweet) wine.

d:
**1.** to press, crush, press by treading, tread down or out, press (grapes)
		**a.** (Qal) to press
s: A primitive root; to *squeeze* out juice; figuratively to *trample: -* tread down.

d: **1.** branch, foliage
s: From an unused root meaning to *cover*; a *bough* (as covering the tree): - branch.
o: from an unused root meaning to cover

d: **1.** leafage, foliage
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6073](H6073); a *twig*; bough, that is, (collectively) *foliage: -* leaves.

d:
**1.** to lift up, swell, be lifted up
		**a.** (Pual) to swell
		**b.** (Hiphil) to be bold, be swelled
**2.** to presume, be heedless
		**a.** (Hiphil) to be heedless, show heedlessness
s: A primitive root; to *swell*; figuratively *be* *elated: -* be lifted up, presume.

d:
**1.** hill, mound, fort, stronghold, Ophel
**2.** tumour, hemorrhoid
s: From [H6075](H6075); a *turior*; also a *mound*, that is, fortress: - emerod, fort, strong hold, tower.

d:
Ophel = "hill"
**1.** a ridge of hills in Jerusalem, fortified for defense of the city
s: The same as [H6076](H6076); *Ophel*, a ridge in Jerusalem: - Ophel.

d:
Ophni = "mouldy"
**1.** a town of Benjamin located 2.5 (4.5 km) miles northwest of Bethel; modern 'Jifna'
s: From an unused noun (denoting a place in Palestine; from an unused root of uncertain meaning); an *Ophnite* (collectively) or inhabitant of Ophen: - Ophni.
o: from an unused noun \[denoting a place in Palestine\]

d:
**1.** eyelid
		**a.** eyelid
		**b.** of dawn, rays of sun (fig.)
s: From [H5774](H5774); an *eyelash* (as *fluttering*); figuratively morning *ray: -* dawning, eye-lid.

d: **1.** (Piel) to dust, powder
s: A primitive root; meaning either to *be* *gray* or perhaps rather to *pulverize*; used only as denominative from [H6083](H6083), to *be* *dust: -* cast \[dust\].
o: a primitive root: meaning either to be gray or perhaps rather to pulverise; used only as denominative from [H6083](H6083), to be dust

d:
Epher = "a calf"
**1.** the 2nd son of Midian
**2.** a son of Ezra, among the descendants of Judah
**3.** one of the heads of the families of Manasseh on the east of the Jordan
s: Probably a variation of [H6082](H6082); *gazelle*; *Epher*, the name of an Arabian and of two Israelites: - Epher.

d: **1.** deer, fawn, stag, young hart
s: From [H6080](H6080); a *fawn* (from the *dusty* color): - young roe \[hart\].

d:
**1.** dry earth, dust, powder, ashes, earth, ground, mortar, rubbish
		**a.** dry or loose earth
		**b.** debris
		**c.** mortar
		**d.** ore
s: From [H6080](H6080); *dust* (as *powdered* or *gray*); hence *clay*, *earth*, *mud: -* ashes, dust, earth, ground, morter, powder, rubbish.

d:
Ophrah = "fawn"
n pr m
**1.** a Judaite, son of Meonothai
n pr loc
**2.** a town of Benjamin approximately 5 miles (8 km) east of Bethel
**3.** a place in Manasseh, native place of Gideon; probably located close to Shechem
s: Feminine of [H6082](H6082); *female* *fawn*; *Ophrah*, the name of an Israelite and of two places in Palestine: - Ophrah.

d:
Ephron = "fawn-like"
n pr m
**1.** a Hittite, son of Zohar and the one from whom Abraham bought the field and cave of Machpelah
n pr loc
**2.** a city on the borders of Benjamin
**3.** a mountain on the northern border of Judah
s: From the same as [H6081](H6081); *fawn* *like*; *Ephron*, the name of a Canaanite and of two places in Palestine: - Ephron, Ephrain \[from the margin\].

d:
**1.** tree, wood, timber, stock, plank, stalk, stick, gallows
		**a.** tree, trees
		**b.** wood, pieces of wood, gallows, firewood, cedar-wood, woody flax
s: From [H6095](H6095); a *tree* (from its *firmness*); hence *wood* (plural *sticks*): -  + carpenter, gallows, helve, + pine, plank, staff, stalk, stick, stock, timber, tree, wood.

d:
**1.** to hurt, pain, grieve, displease, vex, wrest
		**a.** (Qal) to hurt, pain
		**b.** (Niphal) to be in pain, be pained, be grieved
		**c.** (Piel) to vex, torture
		**d.** (Hiphil) to cause pain
		**e.** (Hithpael) to feel grieved, be vexed

		**a.** (Piel) to shape, form
		**b.** (Hiphil) to form, copy, fashion
s: A primitive root; properly to *carve*, that is, *fabricate* or *fashion*; hence (in a bad sense) to *worry*, *pain* or *anger: -* displease, grieve, hurt, make, be sorry, vex, worship, wrest.

d:
**1.** to pain, grieve
		**a.** (P'al) pained (participle)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6087](H6087); to *afflict: -* lamentable.

d:
**1.** pain, hurt, toil, sorrow, labour, hardship
		**a.** pain
		**b.** hurt, offense
		**c.** toil, hardship
**2.** vessel, creation, object
**3.** (TWOT) idol
s: From [H6087](H6087); an earthen *vessel*; usually (painful) *toil*; also a *pang* (whether of body or mind): - grievous, idol, labor, sorrow.

d:
**1.** pain, sorrow
**2.** idol
s: A variation of [H6089](H6089); an *idol* (as fashioned); also *pain* (bodily or mental): - idol, sorrow, X wicked.

d: **1.** idol, image
s: From [H6087](H6087); an (idolatrous) *image: -* idol, image.

d: **1.** labourer, toiler, labour
s: From [H6087](H6087); a (hired) *workman: -* labour.

d: **1.** pain, labour, hardship, sorrow, toil
s: From [H6087](H6087); *worrisomeness*, that is, *labor* or *pain: -* sorrow, toil.

d: **1.** pain, hurt, injury, sorrow, wound
s: From [H6087](H6087); an *idol*; also a *pain* or *wound: -* sorrow, wound.

d: **1.** (Qal) to shut
s: A primitive root; properly to *fasten* (or *make* *firm*), that is, to *close* (the eyes): - shut.

d:
**1.** spine, backbone, os sacrum
		**a.** either spine or os sacrum
				**1.** bone close to fat-tail
s: From [H6095](H6095); the *spine* (as giving *firmness* to the body): - back bone.

d: **1.** trees, wood
s: Feminine of [H6086](H6086); *timber: -* trees.

d: **1.** counsel, advice, purpose
s: From [H3289](H3289); *advice*; by implication *plan*; also *prudence: -* advice, advisement, counsel (\[-lor\]), purpose.

d:
**1.** mighty, vast, numerous
		**a.** mighty, strong (in number)
		**b.** numerous, countless
s: Passive participle of [H6105](H6105); *powerful* (specifically a *paw*); by implication *numerous: -*  + feeble, great, mighty, must, strong.

d:
Ezion-geber = "backbone of a man"
**1.** the last station during the exodus of the Israelites before they came to the wilderness of Zin; located near Elath at the head of the Gulf of Akaba
s: From [H6096](H6096) and [H1397](H1397); *backbone* *like* *of* *a* *man*; *Etsjon-Geber*, a place on the Red Sea: - Ezion-gaber, Ezion-geber.

d: **1.** (Niphal) to be sluggish
s: A primitive root; to *lean* idly, that is, to be *indolent* or *slack: -* be slothful.

d:
**1.** sluggish, lazy
		**a.** sluggard (subst)
s: From [H6101](H6101); *indolent: -* slothful, sluggard.

d: **1.** sluggishness, laziness
s: Feminine of [H6102](H6102); (as abstraction) *indolence: -* slothfulness.

d: **1.** sluggishness, laziness
s: From [H6101](H6101); *indolence: -* idleness.

d:
**1.** to be vast, be numerous, be mighty
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be mighty
				**2.** to be numerous
		**b.** (Hiphil) to make strong, make mighty
**2.** to shut (the eyes), close (the eyes)
		**a.** (Qal) to shut (the eyes)
		**b.** (Piel) to shut tightly (the eyes)
s: A primitive root; to *bind* fast, that is, *close* (the eyes); intransitively to *be* (causatively *make*) *powerful* or *numerous*; denominatively (from [H6106](H6106)) to *crunch* the bones: - break the bones, close, be great, be increased, be (wax) mighty (-ier), be more, shut, be (-come, make) strong (-er).

d:
**1.** bone, essence, substance
		**a.** bone
				**1.** body, limbs, members, external body
		**b.** bone (of animal)
		**c.** substance, self
s: From [H6105](H6105); a *bone* (as *strong*); by extension the *body*; figuratively the *substance*, that is, (as pronoun) *selfsame: -* body, bone, X life, (self-) same, strength, X very.

d:
Azem or Ezem = "bone"
**1.** a city in the Nekeb of Judah afterwards allotted to Simeon
s: The same as [H6106](H6106); *bone*; *Etsem*, a place in Palestine: - Azem, Ezem.

d:
**1.** power, bones, might
		**a.** might
		**b.** bones
s: From [H6105](H6105); *power*; hence *body: -* might, strong, substance.

d: **1.** power, strength, might
s: Feminine of [H6108](H6108); *powerfulness*; by extension *numerousness: -* abundance, strength.

d: **1.** defence, argument, strong
s: Feminine of [H6099](H6099); a *bulwark*, that is, (figuratively) *argument: -* strong.

d:
Azmon = "strong"
**1.** a place on the extreme southern border of Canaan
s: From [H6107](H6107); *bone* *like*; *Atsmon*, a place near Palestine: - Azmon.

d:
**1.** sharp, strong, spear
		**a.** meaning uncertain
s: From an unused root meaning to *be* *sharp* or *strong*; a *spear: -* Eznite \[from the margin\].
o: from an unused root meaning to be sharp or strong

d:
**1.** to restrain, retain, close up, shut, withhold, refrain, stay, detain
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to restrain, halt, stop
				**2.** to retain
		**b.** (Niphal) to be restrained, be stayed, be under restraint
s: A primitive root; to *inclose*; by analogy to *hold* *back*; also to *maintain*, *rule*, *assemble: -*  X be able, close up, detain, fast, keep (self close, still), prevail, recover, refrain, X reign, restrain, retain, shut (up), slack, stay, stop, withhold (self).

d: **1.** restraint, oppression
s: From [H6113](H6113); *restraint: -*  + magistrate.

d:
**1.** restraint, coercion
		**a.** restraint, coercion
		**b.** barrenness (of womb)
s: From [H6113](H6113); *closure*; also *constraint: -*  X barren, oppression, X prison.

d:
**1.** assembly, solemn assembly
		**a.** assembly (sacred or festive meeting)
		**b.** assemblage, company, group
s: From [H6113](H6113); an *assembly*, especially on a *festival* or *holiday: -* (solemn) assembly (meeting).

d:
**1.** to supplant, circumvent, take by the heel, follow at the heel, assail insidiously, overreach
		**a.** (Qal) to supplant, overreach, attack at the heel
		**b.** (Piel) to hold back
s: A primitive root; properly to *swell* out or up; used only as denominative from [H6119](H6119), to *seize* *by* *the* *heel*; figuratively to *circumvent* (as if *tripping* up the heels); also to *restrain* (as if holding by the heel): - take by the heel, stay, supplant, X utterly.

d:
n m
**1.** consequence
		**a.** consequence
		**b.** consequence, gain, reward
		**c.** end
adv
**2.** as a consequence, because, consequently
conj
**3.** as a consequence of, that, because
s: From [H6117](H6117) in the sense of [H6119](H6119); a *heel*, that is, (figuratively) the *last* of anything (used adverbially *for* *ever*); also *result*, that is, *compensation*; and so (adverbially with preposition or relatively) on *account* of: -  X because, by, end, for, if, reward.

d:
**1.** heel, rear, footprint, hinder part, hoof, rear of a troop, footstep
		**a.** heel
		**b.** mark of heel, footprint
		**c.** hinder part, rear
s: From [H6117](H6117); a *heel* (as *protuberant*); hence a *track*; figuratively the *rear* (of an army). (*lier* *in* *wait* is by mistake for [H6120](H6120).): - heel, \[horse-\] hoof, last, lier in wait \[by mistake for [H6120](H6120)\], (foot-) step.

d: **1.** overreacher, supplanter
s: From [H6117](H6117) in its denominative sense; a *lier* *in* *wait*. (*heel* is by mistake for [H6119](H6119).): - heel \[by mistake for [H6119](H6119)\].

d:
**1.** deceitful, sly, insidious
		**a.** deceitful, sly, insidious, slippery
		**b.** foot-tracked
**2.** steep, hilly
s: From [H6117](H6117); in the original sense, a *knoll* (as *swelling* up); in the denominative sense (transitively) *fraudulent* or (intransitively) *tracked: -* crooked, deceitful, polluted.

d: **1.** subtlety, insidiousness, craftiness
s: Feminine of an unused form from [H6117](H6117) meaning a *trick*; *trickery: -* subtilty.
o: from an unused form from [H6117](H6117) meaning a trick

d: **1.** (Qal) to bind, tie
s: A primitive root; to *tie* with thongs: - bind.

d: **1.** streaked, striped
s: From [H6123](H6123); *striped* (with *bands*): - ring straked.

d: **1.** oppression, pressure
s: From [H5781](H5781); *constraint: -* oppression.

d:
Akkub = "insidious"
**1.** son of Elioenai and descendant of David through Zerubbabel
**2.** a head of a family returning from exile
**3.** head of a family of temple slaves returning from exile
**4.** a Levite gatekeeper
**5.** a Levite who helped Ezra expound the law to the people
**6.** a Levite gatekeeper after the return from exile
s: From [H6117](H6117); *insidious*; *Akkub*, the name of five Israelites: - Akkub.

d:
**1.** to bend, twist
		**a.** (Pual) to be bent out of shape, be distorted, be crooked
s: A primitive root; to *wrest: -* wrong.

d: **1.** winding, devious, crooked
s: From [H6127](H6127); *winding: -* by \[-way\], crooked way.

d: **1.** crooked
s: From [H6127](H6127); *tortuous: -* crooked.

d:

s: From an unused root meaning to *twist*; *tortuous*; *Akan*, an Idumaean: - Akan. Compare [H3292](H3292).
o: from an unused root meaning to twist

d:
**1.** to pluck up, root up

		**b.** (Niphal) to be plucked up
**2.** to cut, hamstring
		**a.** (Piel) to cut, hamstring
s: A primitive root; to *pluck* up (especially by the roots); specifically to *hamstring*; figuratively to *exterminate: -* dig down, hough, pluck up, root up.

d:
**1.** to pluck, be rooted up
		**a.** (Ithp'al) to be rooted up
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6131](H6131): - pluck up by the roots.

d: **1.** member, offspring, offshoot
s: From [H6131](H6131); figuratively a *transplanted* person, that is, naturalized citizen: - stock.
o: from [H6131](H6131) fig., a transplanted person, i.e. naturalised citizen

d:
Eker = "offspring"
**1.** a descendant of Judah
s: The same as [H6133](H6133); *Eker*, an Israelite: - Eker.

d: **1.** barren, sterile
s: From [H6131](H6131); *sterile* (as if *extirpated* in the generative organs): -  (X male or female) barren (woman).

d: **1.** root, stock
s: (Chaldee); from [H6132](H6132); a *stock: -* stump.

d: **1.** scorpion
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *scorpion*; figuratively a *scourge* or knotted whip: - scorpion.

d:
Ekron = "emigration" or "torn up by the roots"
**1.** the most northerly of the 5 principal cities of the Philistines; located in the lowlands of Judah and later given to Dan
s: From [H6131](H6131); *eradication*; *Ekron*, a place in Palestine: - Ekron.

d:
Ekronites = see Ekron "emigration"
**1.** an inhabitant of Ekron
s: Patrial from [H6138](H6138); an *Ekronite* or inhabitant of Ekron: - Ekronite.

d:
**1.** to be perverse, twist, pervert, make crooked, prove perverse, declare perverse
		**a.** (Niphal) to be crooked
		**b.** (Piel) to twist, distort, pervert, make crooked
		**c.** (Hiphil) to declare crooked
		**d.** (Qal) perverse
s: A primitive root; to *knot* or *distort*; figuratively to *pervert* (act or declare perverse): - make crooked, (prove, that is) perverse (-rt).

d: **1.** twisted, distorted, crooked, perverse, perverted
s: From [H6140](H6140); *distorted*; hence *false: -* crooked, froward, perverse.

d:
Ikkesh = "twisted"
**1.** father of Ira, the Tekoite, and one of David's mighty warriors
s: The same as [H6141](H6141); *perverse*; *Ikkesh*, an Israelite: - Ikkesh.

d: **1.** distortion, crookedness
s: From [H6141](H6141); *perversity: -*  X froward.

d:
Ar = "a city"

s: The same as [H5892](H5892); a *city*; *Ar*, a place in Moab: - Ar.

d: **1.** enemy, adversary, foe
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6145](H6145): - enemy.

d:
Er = "awake"
**1.** the eldest son of Judah
**2.** son of Shelah and grandson of Judah
s: From [H5782](H5782); *watchful*; *Er*, the name of two Israelites: - Er.

d:
**1.** to pledge, exchange, mortgage, engage, occupy, undertake for, give pledges, be or become surety, take on pledge, give in pledge

		**b.** (Hithpael)

				**2.** to have fellowship with, share
s: A primitive root; to *braid*, that is, *intermix*; technically to *traffic* (as if by barter); also to *give* or *be* *security* (as a kind of exchange): - engage, (inter-) meddle (with), mingle (self), mortgage, occupy, give pledges, be (-come, put in) surety, undertake.

d:
**1.** (Qal) to be pleasant, be sweet, be pleasing
		**a.** (TWOT) sweet, pleasant
s: A primitive root (rather identical with [H6148](H6148) through the idea of close *association*); to be *agreeable: -* be pleasant (-ing), take pleasure in, be sweet.
o: a primitive root \[identical with [H614](H614) idea of close association\]; to be agreeable

d:
**1.** to become evening, grow dark
		**a.** (Qal) to become evening, grow dark
		**b.** (Hiphil) to spend the evening, do at evening
s: A primitive root (rather identical with [H6148](H6148) through the idea of *covering* with a texture); to *grow* *dusky* at sundown: - be darkened, (toward) evening.
o: a primitive root \[identical with [H6148](H6148) through the idea of covering with a texture\]

d:

		**a.** (Pael) mixed (participle)
		**b.** (Ithpael) mixed (participle)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H6148](H6148); to *commingle: -* mingle (self), mix.

d:

		**b.** Arabians, Arabs
s: From [H6150](H6150) in the figuratively sense of *sterility*; *Arab* (that is, *Arabia*), a country East of Palestine: - Arabia.
o: from [H6150](H6150) in the fig. sense of sterility

d:
**1.** evening, night, sunset

		**b.** night
s: From [H6150](H6150); *dusk: -*  + day, even (-ing, tide), night.

**1.** woof

		**b.** knitted material
