d:
Shelesh = "might"
**1.** an Asherite, son of Helem
s: From [H8027](H8027); *triplet*; *Shelesh*, an Israelite: - Shelesh.

d: **1.** pertaining to the third, third (generation)

**1.** a Benjamite of the family of Saul, one of the 6 sons of Azel
s: From [H8176](H8176) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *stormed*; *Shearjah*, an Israelite: - Sheariah.

d:
Seorim = "barley"
**1.** a priest in the time of David in charge of the 4th course of service
s: Masculine plural of [H8184](H8184); *barley* grains; *Seorim*, an Israelite: - Seorim.

d:
Shaaraim = "double gate"
**1.** a town in Judah
**2.** a town in Simeon
s: Dual of [H8179](H8179); *double* *gates*; *Shaarajim*, a place in Palestine: - Shaaraim.

d:
Shaashgaz = "servant of the beautiful"
**1.** the eunuch in the palace of Xerxes who was in charge of the women in the 2nd house
s: Of Persian derivation; *Shaashgaz*, a eunuch of Xerxes: - Shaashgaz.

d:
**1.** delight, enjoyment
		**a.** delight
		**b.** object of delight
s: From [H8173](H8173); *enjoyment: -* delight, pleasure.

d:
**1.** to sweep bare, scrape
		**a.** (Niphal) to be wind-swept, be bare, be scraped barren (by wind)
		**b.** (Pual) to be bare, be laid bare
s: A primitive root; to *abrade*, that is, *bare: -* high, stick out.

d:
**1.** lip, language, speech, shore, bank, brink, brim, side, edge, border, binding
		**a.** lip (as body part)
		**b.** language
		**c.** edge, shore, bank (of cup, sea, river, etc)
s: (The second form is in dual and plural); Probably from [H5595](H5595) or [H8192](H8192) through the idea of *termination* (compare [H5490](H5490)); the *lip* (as a natural boundary); by implication *language*; by analogy a *margin* (of a vessel, water, cloth, etc.): - band, bank, binding, border, brim, brink, edge, language, lip, prating, (\[sea-\]) shore, side, speech, talk, \[vain\] words.
o: probably from [H5595](H5595) or [H8192](H8192) through the idea of termination (compare [H5490](H5490))

d:
**1.** cream, cheese
		**a.** meaning dubious
s: From [H8192](H8192) in the sense of *clarifying*; a *cheese* (as *strained* from the whey): - cheese.
o: from [H8192](H8192) in the sense of clarifying

d:
Shepho or Shephi = "bold"
**1.** an Edomite, son of Shobal of the sons of Seir
s: From [H8192](H8192); *baldness* (compare [H8205](H8205)); *Shepho* or *Shephi*, an Idumaean: - Shephi, Shepho.

d: **1.** judgment, act of judgment
s: From [H8199](H8199); a judicial *sentence*, that is, *punishment: -* judgment.

d:
Shephuphan or Shupham = "serpent"
**1.** son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin
s: From the same as [H8207](H8207); *serpent* *like*; *Shephupham* or *Shephuphan*, an Israelite: - Shephuphan, Shupham.

d:
**1.** maid, maid-servant, slavegirl
		**a.** maid, maid-servant (as belonging to a mistress)
		**b.** of address, speaker, humility (fig)
s: Feminine from an unused root meaning to *spread* out (as a *family*; see [H4940](H4940)); a *female* *slave* (as a member of the *household*): - (bond-, hand-) maid (-en, -servant), wench, bondwoman, womanservant.

d:
**1.** to judge, govern, vindicate, punish
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to act as law-giver or judge or governor (of God, man)
						**a.** to rule, govern, judge
				**2.** to decide controversy (of God, man)
				**3.** to execute judgment
						**a.** discriminating (of man)
						**b.** vindicating
						**c.** condemning and punishing
						**d.** at theophanic advent for final judgment
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to enter into controversy, plead, have controversy together
				**2.** to be judged
		**c.** (Poel) judge, opponent-at-law (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *judge*, that is, pronounce *sentence* (for or against); by implication to *vindicate* or *punish*; by extension to *govern*; passively to *litigate* (literally or figuratively): -  + avenge, X that condemn, contend, defend, execute (judgment), (be a) judge (-ment), X needs, plead, reason, rule.

d:
**1.** to judge
		**a.** (P'al) judge (participle)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H8199](H8199); to *judge: -* magistrate.

d: **1.** judgment, act of judgment
s: From [H8199](H8199); a *sentence*, that is, *infliction: -* judgment.

d:
Shaphat = "judged" or "he hath judged"
**1.** son of Hori and the prince of Simeon chosen to spy out the promised land
**2.** father of the prophet Elisha
**3.** a Judaite, son of Shemaiah and descendant of Zerubbabel in the royal line of Judah
**4.** a chief of the tribe of Gad
**5.** son of Adlai and chief herdsman for David over the herds in the valleys
s: From [H8199](H8199); *judge*; *Shaphat*, the name of four Israelites: - Shaphat.

d:
Shephatiah = "Jehovah has judged"
**1.** a son of David by Abital; David's 5th son
**2.** head of a family of exiles returning from Babylon with Zerubbabel
**3.** another head of a family of exiles returning from Babylon with Zerubbabel
**4.** a Judaite, son of Mahalaleel and father of Amariah
**5.** a prince of Judah, son of Mattan and one of the counsellors who advised king Zedekiah of Judah to kill the prophet Jeremiah
**6.** the Haruphite, one of David's mighty warriors who joined him at Ziklag
**7.** son of Maachah and prince of the tribe of Simeon in the time of David
**8.** son of king Jehoshaphat of Judah and brother to his successor Jehoram
s: From [H8199](H8199) and [H3050](H3050); *Jah* *has* *judged*; *Shephatjah*, the name of ten Israelites: - Shephatiah.

d:
Shiphtan = "judicial"
**1.** an Ephraimite, father of Kemuel, the leader of the tribe selected to divide the promised land between the tribes
s: From [H8199](H8199); *judge* *like*; *Shiphtan*, an Israelite.

d:
**1.** bareness, smooth or bare height, bare place, high places, barren height
		**a.** bareness
		**b.** bare place, bare height
s: From [H8192](H8192); *bareness*; concretely a *bare* hill or plain: - high place, stick out.

d:
Shuppim = "serpents"
**1.** son of Iri or Ir, grandson of Bela, and great grandson of Benjamin
**2.** a Merarite Levite, son of Hosah, and in charge of the West Gate of the temple in the time of David
s: Plural of an unused noun from the same as [H8207](H8207) and meaning the same; *serpents*; *Shuppim*, an Israelite: - Shuppim.
o: pl. of an unused noun from the same as [H8207](H8207) and meaning the same

d:
**1.** horned snake
**2.** (CLBL) a serpent, perhaps an adder or horned snake
s: From an unused root meaning the same as [H7779](H7779); a kind of *serpent* (as *snapping*), probably the *cerastes* or horned adder: - adder.
o: from an unused root meaning the same as [H7779](H7779)

d:
Saphir = "fair"
**1.** a place in Judah; site unknown
s: From [H8231](H8231); *beautiful*; *Shaphir*, a place in Palestine: - Saphir.

d: **1.** fair, beautiful (of foliage)
s: (Chaldee); intensive of a form corresponding to [H8208](H8208); *beautiful: -* fair.
o: intensive of a form corresponding to [H8208](H8208)

d:
**1.** to pour, pour out, spill
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to pour, pour out
				**2.** to shed (blood)
				**3.** to pour out (anger or heart) (fig)
		**b.** (Niphal) to be poured out, be shed
		**c.** (Pual) to be poured out, be shed
		**d.** (Hithpael)
				**1.** to be poured out
				**2.** to pour out oneself
s: A primitive root; to *spill* forth (blood, a libation, liquid metal; or even a solid, that is, to *mound* up); also (figuratively) to *expend* (life, soul, complaint, money, etc.); intensively to *sprawl* out: - cast (up), gush out, pour (out), shed (-der, out), slip.

d: **1.** place of pouring
s: From [H8210](H8210); an *emptying* place, for example an ash *heap: -* are poured out.

d:
**1.** penis, urethra, male organ
		**a.** as fluid duct
s: Feminine of a derivative from [H8210](H8210); a *pipe* (for *pouring* forth, for example wine), that is, the *penis: -* privy member.

d:
**1.** to be or become low, sink, be humbled, be abased
		**a.** (Qal) to be or become low
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to lay or bring low, humiliate
				**2.** to set in a lower place, show abasement
				**3.** to make low, sit down
s: A primitive root; to *depress* or *sink* (especially figuratively to *humiliate*, intransitively or transitively): - abase, bring (cast, put) down, debase, humble (self), be (bring, lay, make, put) low (-er).

d:
**1.** to be or bring low, humble
		**a.** (Aphel) to bring low, humble
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H8213](H8213): - abase, humble, put down, subdue.

d: **1.** low, lowliest (of station)
s: (Chaldee); from [H8214](H8214); *low: -* basest.

d: **1.** lowliness, low estate or condition
s: From [H8213](H8213); an *humble* rank: - low estate (place).

d:
**1.** low, humble
		**a.** low (in height)
		**b.** low (in station), humble (of condition or spirit)
		**c.** humiliated
		**d.** lowly (as subst)
s: From [H8213](H8213); *depressed*, literally or figuratively: - base (-st), humble, low (-er, -ly).

d: **1.** lowliness, humiliation, a low place
s: Feminine of [H8216](H8216); *depression: -* low place.

d:
**1.** lowland, valley
		**a.** lowland
				**1.** strip west of Judean mountains (technical term)
						**a.** the Shephelah
				**2.** strip near coast north of Carmel
s: From [H8213](H8213); *Lowland*, that is, (with the article) the maritime slope of Palestine: - low country, (low) plain, vale (-ley).

d: **1.** sinking, idleness, inactivity
s: From [H8213](H8213); *remissness: -* idleness.

d:
Shepham = "bald"
**1.** a place or region in northeastern Canaan on the eastern border
s: Probably from [H8192](H8192); *bare* spot; *Shepham*, a place in or near Palestine: - Shepham.

d: **1.** moustache
s: From [H8193](H8193); the *beard* (as a *lip* *piece*): - beard, (upper) lip.

d:
Shapham = "bold"
**1.** a subchief of the tribe of Gad in the land of Bashan
s: Formed like [H8221](H8221); *baldly*; *Shapham*, an Israelite: - Shapham.

d:
Siphmoth = "fruitful"
**1.** a place in the Nekeb in southern Judah
s: Feminine plural of [H8221](H8221); *Siphmoth*, a place in Palestine: - Siphmoth.

d:
Shiphmite = see Siphmoth "fruitful"
**1.** an inhabitant of Shepham or Siphmoth
s: Patrial from [H8221](H8221); a *Shiphmite* or inhabitant of Shepham: - Shiphmite.

d:
**1.** to cover, cover in, panel, hide, treasure up
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** covered, panelled, treasures (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *conceal* (as a valuable): - treasure.

d:
n m
**1.** rock badger, coney, the hyrax
n pr m
**2.** secretary or scribe of king Josiah of Judah
**3.** father of Ahikam in the time of king Josiah of Judah
		**a.** improbably the same as 2
**4.** father of Elasah in the time of the prophet Jeremiah
		**a.** perhaps the same as 3
**5.** a scribe and father of Gemariah
		**a.** perhaps the same as 2
**6.** father of Jaazaniah in the time of Ezekiel
		**a.** perhaps the same as 2
s: From [H8226](H8226); a species of *rock* *rabbit* (from its *hiding*), that is, probably the *hyrax: -* coney.

d: **1.** abundance
s: From an unused root meaning to *abound*; *resources: -* abundance.
o: from an unused root meaning to abound

d: **1.** abundance, quantity, multitude
s: Feminine of [H8228](H8228); *copiousness: -* abundance, company, multitude.

d:
Shiphi = "abundant"
**1.** a Simeonite, son of Allon and father of Ziza in the time of king Hezekiah of Judah
s: From [H8228](H8228); *copious*; *Shiphi*, an Israelite: - Shiphi.

d:
**1.** to be pleasing, be beautiful, be fair, be comely, be bright, glisten
		**a.** (Qal) to be beautiful
s: A primitive root; to *glisten*, that is, (figuratively) *be* (causatively *make*) *fair: -*  X goodly.

d:
**1.** to be fair, be seemly, seem good, seem pleasing
		**a.** (P'al) to seem good, be acceptable
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H8231](H8231); to *be* *beautiful: -* be acceptable, please, + think good.

d: **1.** beauty, goodness, goodliness
s: From [H8231](H8231); *beauty: -*  X goodly.

d:
Shapher = "beauty"
**1.** a station of Israel in the wilderness
s: The same as [H8233](H8233); *Shepher*, a place in the Desert: - Shapper.

d: **1.** (Piel) fairness, clearness
s: From [H8231](H8231); *brightness: -* garnish.

d:
Shiphrah = "fair"
**1.** one of the two Hebrew midwives who were ordered by Pharaoh to kill all the male children born to the Hebrews but who disobeyed
s: The same as [H8235](H8235); *Shiphrah*, an Israelitess: - Shiphrah.

d:
**1.** canopy, royal pavilion
		**a.** meaning doubtful
s: From [H8231](H8231); *splendid*, that is, a *tapestry* or *canopy: -* royal pavilion.

d: **1.** dawn, early morning
s: (Chaldee); from [H8231](H8231); the *dawn* (as *brilliant* with aurora): -  X very early in the morning.

d:
**1.** to set, place, put, ordain
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to set
				**2.** to ordain, establish
s: A primitive root; to *locate*, that is, (generally) *hang* on or (figuratively) *establish*, *reduce: -* bring, ordain, set on.

d:
**1.** hook-shaped pegs, hooks, pots, fold
		**a.** meaning doubtful
s: From [H8239](H8239); a (double) *stall* (for cattle); also a (two pronged) *hook* (for flaying animals on): - hook, pot.

d: **1.** flood, downpour, overflowing
s: From [H7857](H7857) (for alliteration with [H7110](H7110)); an *outburst* (of anger): - little.

d:
**1.** mesh, sackcloth, sack, sacking
		**a.** sack (for grain)
		**b.** sackcloth
				**1.** worn in mourning or humiliation
				**2.** same material spread out to lie on
s: From [H8264](H8264); properly a *mesh* (as allowing a liquid to *run* through), that is, coarse loose cloth or *sacking* (used in mourning and for bagging); hence a *bag* (for grain, etc.): - sack (-cloth, -clothes).

d: **1.** leg (lower)
s: (Chaldee); corresponding to [H7785](H7785); the *leg: -* leg.

d:
**1.** to bind, bind on, be kept on (meaning doubtful)
		**a.** (Niphal) to be kept on
s: A primitive root; to *fasten: -* bind.

d:
**1.** to wake, watch, awake, be alert
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to keep watch of, be wakeful over
				**2.** to be wakeful, wake (as mourner or sufferer)
s: A primitive root; to *be* *alert*, that is, *sleepless*; hence to *be* *on* *the* *lookout* (whether for good or ill): - hasten, remain, wake, watch (for).

d: **1.** (Pual) cups shaped like almond blossoms (participle)
s: A denominative from [H8247](H8247); to *be* (intensively *make*) *almond* *shaped: -* make like (unto, after the fashion of) almonds.

d:
**1.** almond tree, almonds
		**a.** almond (the nut)
		**b.** almond-tree
s: From [H8245](H8245); the *almond* (tree or nut; as being the *earliest* in bloom): - almond (tree).

d:
**1.** to give to drink, irrigate, drink, water, cause to drink water
		**a.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to water, irrigate
				**2.** to water, give drink to
		**b.** (Pual) to be watered
		**c.** (Niphal) variant
s: A primitive root; to *quaff*, that is, (causatively) to *irrigate* or *furnish* *a* *potion* to: - cause to (give, give to, let, make to) drink, drown, moisten, water. See [H7937](H7937), [H8354](H8354).

d: **1.** drink, refreshment
s: From [H8248](H8248); (plural collectively) a *draught: -* drink.

d: **1.** drink, refreshment
s: From [H8248](H8248); a *beverage*; *moisture*, that is, (figuratively) *refreshment: -* drink, marrow.

d: **1.** detestable thing or idol, abominable thing, abomination, idol, detested thing
s: From [H8262](H8262); *disgusting*, that is, *filthy*; especially *idolatrous* or (concretely) an *idol: -* abominable filth (idol, -ation), detestable (thing).

d:
**1.** to be quiet, be tranquil, be at peace, be quiet, rest, lie still, be undisturbed
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to be quiet, be undisturbed
						**a.** to be at peace (of land)
				**2.** to be quiet, be inactive
		**b.** (Hiphil)
				**1.** to show quietness
						**a.** quietness, display of quietness (subst)
				**2.** to quiet, be quiet
				**3.** to cause quietness, pacify, allay
s: A primitive root; to *repose* (usually figuratively): - appease, idleness, (at, be at, be in, give) quiet (-ness), (be at, be in, give, have, take) rest, settle, be still.

d: **1.** quiet, tranquillity, quietness
s: From [H8252](H8252); *tranquillity: -* quietness.

d:
**1.** to weigh, weigh out, pay out
		**a.** (Qal)
				**1.** to weigh
				**2.** to weigh out (a price)
				**3.** of grief (fig)
		**b.** (Niphal)
				**1.** to be weighed
				**2.** to be weighed out
s: A primitive root; to *suspend* or *poise* (especially in trade): - pay, receive (-r), spend, X throughly, weigh.

d:
**1.** shekel
		**a.** the chief unit of weight or measure
				**1.** gold-1/10000 of a talent and equal to 220 grains
				**2.** silver-1/3000 of a talent and equal to 132 grains
				**3.** copper-1/1500 of a talent and equal to 528 grains
s: From [H8254](H8254); probably a *weight*; used as a commercial standard: - shekel.

d: **1.** sycamore tree (bearing figs)
s: (The second form is feminine); of uncertain derivation; a *sycamore* (usually the tree): - sycamore (fruit, tree).

d:
**1.** to sink, sink down, subside
		**a.** (Qal) to sink
		**b.** (Niphal) to sink, collapse
		**c.** (Hiphil) to sink down, cause to settle
s: (Abbreviated in Amo 8:8); a primitive root; to *subside*; by implication to *be* *overflowed*, *cease*; causatively to *abate*, *subdue: -* make deep, let down, drown, quench, sink.

d: **1.** depression, hollow
s: From [H8257](H8257); a *depression: -* hollow strake.

d:
**1.** to overlook, look down or out, overhang, look out and down
		**a.** (Niphal) to lean over (and look), look down
		**b.** (Hiphil) to look down, look down upon
s: A primitive root; properly to *lean* *out* (of a window), that is, (by implication) *peep* or *gaze* (passively *be* *a* *spectacle*): - appear, look (down, forth, out).

d: **1.** framework, casing (of doors), door, lintel
s: From [H8259](H8259); a *loophole* (for *looking* *out*), to admit light and air: - window.

d: **1.** frame, casing (of windows), beams laid over, window frames
s: Passive participle of [H8259](H8259); an *embrasure* or opening (compare [H8260](H8260)) with bevelled jam: - light, window.

d:
**1.** (Piel) to detest, make abominable, count filthy, make detestable
		**a.** to detest
		**b.** to make detestable
s: A primitive root; to *be* *filthy*, that is, (intensively) to *loathe*, *pollute: -* abhor, make abominable, have in abomination, detest, X utterly.

d: **1.** detestable thing or idol, an unclean thing, an abomination, detestation
s: From [H8262](H8262); *filth*, that is, (figuratively and specifically) an *idolatrous* object: - abominable (-tion).

d:
**1.** to run, run about, rush, run to and fro, be eager or greedy or thirsty
		**a.** (Qal) roving, ranging, longing, rush out upon (participle)
		**b.** (Hithpalpel) to rush to and fro, rush back and forth
s: A primitive root; to *course* (like a beast of prey); by implication to *seek* greedily: - have appetite, justle one against another, long, range, run (to and fro).

d:
**1.** (Piel) to ogle, be wanton
		**a.** ogling (participle)
s: A primitive root; to *ogle*, that is, *blink* coquettishly: - wanton.

d:
**1.** to do or deal falsely, be false, trick, cheat
		**a.** (Piel) to deal falsely
		**b.** (Qal) to deal falsely
s: A primitive root; to *cheat*, that is, *be* *untrue* (usually in words): - fail, deal falsely, lie.

d:
**1.** lie, deception, disappointment, falsehood
		**a.** deception (what deceives or disappoints or betrays one)
		**b.** deceit, fraud, wrong
				**1.** fraudulently, wrongfully (as adverb)
		**c.** falsehood (injurious in testimony)
				**1.** testify falsehood, false oath, swear falsely
		**d.** falsity (of false or self-deceived prophets)
		**e.** lie, falsehood (in general)
				**1.** false tongue
		**f.** in vain
s: From [H8266](H8266); an *untruth*; by implication a *sham* (often adverbially): - without a cause, deceit (-ful), false (-hood, -ly), feignedly, liar, + lie, lying, vain (thing), wrongfully.

d: **1.** watering trough
s: From [H8248](H8248); a *trough* (for *watering*): - trough.

d:
**1.** prince, ruler, leader, chief, chieftain, official, captain
		**a.** chieftain, leader
		**b.** vassal, noble, official (under king)
		**c.** captain, general, commander (military)
		**d.** chief, head, overseer (of other official classes)
		**e.** heads, princes (of religious office)
		**f.** elders (of representative leaders of people)
		**g.** merchant-princes (of rank and dignity)
		**h.** patron-angel
		**i.** Ruler of rulers (of God)
		**j.** warden
s: From [H8323](H8323); a *head* person (of any rank or class): - captain (that had rule), chief (captain), general, governor, keeper, lord, (\[-task-\]) master, prince (-ipal), ruler, steward.

d: **1.** umbilical cord, navel, navel-string
s: From [H8324](H8324); a *string* (as *twisted* (compare [H8306](H8306))), that is, (specifically) the umbilical cord (also figuratively as the centre of strength): - navel.

d:
**1.** to loosen, abide, begin
		**a.** (P'al)
				**1.** to loosen
				**2.** to abide (from loosing girths for camp)
		**b.** (Pael) to begin, open
		**c.** (Ithpael) to be loosened
s: (Chaldee); a root corresponding to that of [H8293](H8293); to *free*, *separate*; figuratively to *unravel*, *commence*; by implication (of unloading beasts) to *reside: -* begin dissolve, dwell, loose.
o: a root corresponding to that of [H8293](H8293)

d:
Sharezer or Sherezer = "prince of fire"
**1.** son of king Sennacherib of Assyria and murderer of his father
**2.** an Israelite whom the people sent to the house of God to pray in the time of the prophet Zechariah and king Darius
s: Of foreign derivation; *Sharetser*, the name of an Assyrian and an Israelite: - Sharezer.

d: **1.** burning or scorching heat, parched ground
s: From an unused root meaning to *glare*; quivering *glow* (of the air), especially the *mirage: -* heat, parched ground.
o: from an unused root meaning to glare

d:
Sherebiah = "Jehovah has scorched"
**1.** a Levite who assisted Ezra at the reading of the Law and who sealed the covenant with Nehemiah

++++
When the female of the scarlet worm species was ready to give birth to her young, she would attach her body to the trunk of a tree, fixing herself so firmly and permanently that she would never leave again. The eggs deposited beneath her body were thus protected until the larvae were hatched and able to enter their own life cycle. As the mother died, the crimson fluid stained her body and the surrounding wood. From the dead bodies of such female scarlet worms, the commercial scarlet dyes of antiquity were extracted. What a picture this gives of Christ, dying on the tree, shedding His precious blood that He might "bring many sons unto glory" (Heb 2:10)! He died for us, that we might live through him! Ps 22:6 describes such a worm and gives us this picture of Christ. (cf. Isa 1:18) (from page 73, "Biblical Basis for Modern Science", 1985, Baker Book House, by Henry Morris)

d: **1.** ninety

d:

d:
Aaron = light-bringer

Abaddon = destruction

d:
**1.** not burdensome
**2.** not heavy
**3.** light without weight
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G922](G922); *weightless*, that is (figuratively) *not* *burdensome:* - from being burdensome.

d:
Abba = father

Whenever it occurs in the New Testament it has the Greek interpretation joined to it, that is apparently to be explained by the fact that the Chaldee ABBA through frequent use in prayer, gradually acquired the nature of a most sacred proper name, to which the Greek speaking Jews added the name from their own tongue.
s: Of Chaldee origin \[[H2](H2)\]; *father* (as a vocative): - Abba.

d:
Abel = vanity (that is: transitory)
**1.** the second son of Adam, murdered by his brother Cain
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H1893](H1893)\]; *Abel*, the son of Adam: - Abel.

d:
Abijah = my father is Jah (Jehovah)

**2.** son and successor to Rehoboam on the throne of Judah

d:
Abiathar = father of abundance
**1.** the name of a high priest
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H54](H54)\]; *Abiathar*, an Israelite: - Abiathar.

d:
Abilene = grassy meadow
**1.** a region of Syria between Lebanon and hermon towards Phoenicia, 18 miles (29 km) from Damascus and 37 miles (60 km) from heliopolis
s: Of foreign origin (compare \[[H58](H58)\]); *Abilene*, a region of Syria: - Abilene.

d:
Abiud = my father is majesty
**1.** the son of Bela and grandson of Benjamin (1Ch 8:3)
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H31](H31)\]; *Abihud*, an Israelite: - Abiud.

d:
Abraham = father of a multitude
**1.** the son of Terah and the founder of the Jewish nation
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H85](H85)\]; *Abraham*, the Hebrew patriarch. In Act 7:16 the text should probably read *Jacob:* - Abraham.

d:
**1.** bottomless
**2.** unbounded
**3.** the abyss
  **a.** the pit
  **b.** the immeasurable depth
  **c.** of Orcus, a very deep gulf or chasm in the lowest parts of the earth used as the common receptacle of the dead and especially as the abode of demons
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a variation of [G1037](G1037); *depthless*, that is, (specifically), (infernal) *“abyss”:* - deep, (bottomless) pit.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a variation of [G1037](G1037)

d:
Agabus = locust
**1.** a Christian prophet
s: Of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H2285](H2285)\]); *Agabus*, an Israelite: - Agabus.

d: **1.** to work good, to do good, to do well, act rightly
s: From [G18](G18) and [G2041](G2041); to *work* *good:* - do good.

d:
**1.** to do good, do something which profits others
  **a.** to be a good help to someone
  **b.** to do someone a favour
  **c.** to benefit
**2.** to do well, do right
s: From [G17](G17); to *be* *a* *well-doer* (as a favor or a duty): - (when) do good (well).

d: **1.** a course of right action, well doing, virtue
s: From [G17](G17); *well-doing*, that is, *virtue:* - well-doing.

d: **1.** acting rightly, doing well, virtuous
s: From [G18](G18) and [G4160](G4160); a *well-doer*, that is, *virtuous:* - them that do well.

d:
**1.** of good constitution or nature
**2.** useful, salutary
**3.** good, pleasant, agreeable, joyful, happy
**4.** excellent, distinguished
**5.** upright, honourable
s: A primary word; “good” (in any sense, often as noun): - benefit, good (-s, things), well. Compare [G2570](G2570).

d: **1.** uprightness of heart and life, goodness, kindness
s: From [G18](G18); *goodness*, that is, *virtue* or *beneficence:* - goodness.

d: **1.** exultation, extreme joy, gladness
s: From [G21](G21); *exultation*; specifically *welcome:* - gladness, (exceeding) joy.

d: **1.** to exult, rejoice exceedingly, be exceeding glad
s: From ἄγαν agan (*much*) and [G242](G242); properly to *jump* *for* *joy*, that is, *exult:* - be (exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).

d: **1.** unmarried, unwedded, single
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1062](G1062); *unmarried:* - unmarried.

d: **1.** to be indignant, moved with indignation, be very displeased
s: From ἄγαν agan (*much*) and ἄχθος achhos̄ (*grief*; akin to the base of [G43](G43)); to *be* *greatly* *afflicted*, that is, (figuratively) *indignant:* - be much (sore) displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.
o: from agan (much) and achthos (grief, akin to the base of [G43](G43))

d: **1.** indignation, irritation, vexation
s: From [G23](G23); *indignation:* - indignation.

d:
**1.** of persons
  **a.** to welcome, to entertain, to be fond of, to love dearly
**2.** of things
  **a.** to be well pleased, to be contented at or with a thing
s: Perhaps from ἄγαν agan (*much*; or compare \[[H5689](H5689)\]); to *love* (in a social or moral sense): - (be-) love (-ed). Compare [G5368](G5368).

d:
**1.** brotherly love, affection, good will, love, benevolence
**2.** love feasts
s: From [G25](G25); *love*, that is, *affection* or *benevolence*; specifically (plural) a *love* *feast:* - (feast of) charity (\[-ably\]), dear, love.

d: **1.** beloved, esteemed, dear, favourite, worthy of love
s: From [G25](G25); *beloved:* - (dearly, well) beloved, dear.

d:
Hagar = flight
**1.** Abraham’s concubine and mother to Ishmael
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H1904](H1904)\]; *Hagar*, the concubine of Abraham: - Hagar.

d: **1.** to employ a courier, dispatch a mounted messenger, press into public service, compel to go
s: Of foreign origin (compare \[[H104](H104)\]); properly to *be* *a* *courier*, that is, (by implication) to *press* into public service: - compel (to go).

d: **1.** a vessel, receptacle, a pail, a reservoir
s: From ἄγκάλη aggos (a *pail*, perhaps as *bent*; compare the base of [G43](G43)); a *receptacle:* - vessel.
o: from aggos (a pail, perhaps as bent, cf base of [G43](G43))

d:
**1.** message, announcement, news
**2.** a proclamation, command, order
s: From [G32](G32); an *announcement*, that is, (by implication) *precept:* - message.

d: **1.** a messenger, envoy, one who is sent, an angel, a messenger from God
s: From ἀγγέλλω aggellō (probably derived from [G71](G71); compare [G34](G34); to *bring* *tidings*); a *messenger*; especially an *“angel”*; by implication a *pastor:* - angel, messenger.
o: from aggello \[probably derived from [G71](G71), cf [G34](G34)\] (to bring tidings)

d: **1.** go to, come!, come now!
s: Imperative of [G71](G71); properly *lead*, that is, *come* on: - go to.

d: **1.** herd or oxen or cattle, a herd or company
s: From [G71](G71) (compare [G32](G32)); a *drove:* - herd.

d: **1.** one whose descent there is no record of, without genealogy
s: From [G1](G1) (as negative particle) and [G1075](G1075); *unregistered* as to birth: - without descent.

d: **1.** ignoble, coward, mean, base, of no family, that is: low born
s: From [G1](G1) (as negative particle) and [G1085](G1085); properly *without* *kin*, that is, (of unknown descent, and by implication) *ignoble:* - base things.

d:
**1.** to render or acknowledge, or to be venerable or hallow

  **a.** consecrate things to God
  **b.** dedicate people to God

  **a.** to cleanse externally
  **b.** to purify by expiation: free from the guilt of sin
  **c.** to purify internally by renewing of the soul
s: From [G40](G40); to *make* *holy*, that is, (ceremonially) *purify* or *consecrate*; (mentally) to *venerate:* - hallow, be holy, sanctify.

d:
**1.** consecration, purification
**2.** the effect of consecration
  **a.** sanctification of heart and life
s: From [G37](G37); properly *purification*, that is, (the state) *purity*; concretely (by Hebraism) a *purifier:* - holiness, sanctification.

d:
**1.** reverend, worthy of veneration

  **b.** of persons whose services God employs, for example, apostles
**2.** set apart for God, to be as it were, exclusively his
**3.** services and offerings
  **a.** prepared for God with solemn rite, pure, clean
**4.** in a moral sense, pure sinless upright holy
s: Neuter of [G40](G40); a *sacred* thing (that is, spot): - holiest (of all), holy place, sanctuary.

d: **1.** most holy thing, a saint
s: From ἅγος hagos (an *awful* thing) compare [G53](G53), \[[H2282](H2282)\]; *sacred* (physically *pure*, morally *blameless* or *religious*, ceremonially *consecrated*): - (most) holy (one, thing), saint.

d:
**1.** sanctity
**2.** in a moral sense: holiness
s: From [G40](G40); *sanctity* (that is, properly the state): - holiness.

d:
**1.** majesty, holiness
**2.** moral purity
s: From [G40](G40); *sacredness* (that is, properly the quality): - holiness.

d:

From ἄγκος
agkos (a *bend*, “ache”); an *arm* (as *curved*): - arm.

d: **1.** a fishing hook, a small hook
s: From the same as [G43](G43); a *hook* (as *bent*): - hook.

d:

d: **1.** purification, expiation

d:
**1.** to be ignorant, not to know

s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3539](G3539); *not* *to* *know* (through lack of information or intelligence); by implication to *ignore* (through disinclination): - (be) ignorant (-ly), not know, not understand, unknown.

d:

d: **1.** purity, chastity, uprightness of life

d: **1.** chaste, clean, pure, with sincerity

d:

d: **1.** illiterate, unlearned

d:
**1.** to hunt, to take by hunting, catch

s: From [G61](G61); to *hunt*, that is, (figuratively) to *entrap:* - catch.

d:
**1.** of or belonging to the oleaster or wild olive
**2.** the oleaster, wild olive tree
s: From [G66](G66) and [G1636](G1636); an *oleaster:* - olive tree (which is) wild.

d:

  **b.** of countries, wild, uncultivated, unreclaimed

  **a.** boorish, rude
  **b.** of any violent passion, vehement, furious
s: From [G68](G68); *wild* (as pertaining to the *country*), literally (*natural*) or figuratively (*fierce*): - wild, raging.

  **c.** the farms, country seats, neighbouring hamlets
s: From [G71](G71); a *field* (as a *drive* for cattle); generally the *country*; specifically a *farm*, that is, *hamlet:* - country, farm, piece of ground, land.

d:
**1.** to be sleepless, keep awake, watch
**2.** to be circumspect, attentive, ready
s: Ultimately from [G1](G1) (as negative particle) and [G5258](G5258); to *be* *sleepless*, that is, *keep* *awake:* - watch.

d: **1.** sleeplessness, watching

  **c.** to lead with one’s self, attach to one’s self as an attendant
  **d.** to conduct, bring
  **e.** to lead away, to a court of justice, magistrate, etc.

  **a.** to lead, guide, direct

  **c.** to move, impel: of forces and influences on the mind
**3.** to pass a day, keep or celebrate a feast, etc.
**4.** to go, depart
s: A primary verb; properly to *lead*; by implication to *bring*, *drive*, (reflexively) *go*, (specifically) *pass* (time), or (figuratively) *induce:* - be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.

d:
**1.** a leading
**2.** metaph.: conduct
  **a.** a conducting, training, education, discipline
  **b.** the life led, way or course of life
s: Reduplicated from [G71](G71); a *bringing* up, that is, *mode* *of* *living:* - manner of life.

d:
**1.** an assembly,

  **b.** the place of contest, the arena or stadium
**2.** the assembly of the Greeks at their national games
  **a.** hence the contest for a prize at their games
  **b.** generally, any struggle or contest
  **c.** a battle
  **d.** an action at law, trial
s: From [G71](G71); properly a place of *assembly* (as if *led*), that is, (by implication) a *contest* (held there); figuratively an *effort* or *anxiety:* - conflict, contention, fight, race.

d:
**1.** a struggle for victory
  **a.** gymnastic exercise, wrestling
**2.** of severe mental struggles and emotions, agony, anguish
s: From [G73](G73); a *struggle* (properly the state), that is, (figuratively) *anguish:* - agony.

d:
**1.** to enter a contest: contend in the gymnastic games
**2.** to contend with adversaries, fight
**3.** metaph. to contend, struggle, with difficulties and dangers
**4.** to endeavour with strenuous zeal, strive: to obtain something
s: From [G73](G73); to *struggle*, literally (to *compete* for a prize), figuratively (to *contend* with an adversary), or generally (to *endeavor* to accomplish something): - fight, labor fervently, strive.

d:
Adam = the red earth
**1.** Adam, the first man, the parent of the whole human family
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H121](H121)\]; *Adam*, the first man; typically (of Jesus) *man* (as his representative): - Adam.

d: **1.** without expense, requiring no outlay, costing nothing
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1160](G1160); *costless*, that is, *gratuitous:* - without expense.

d:
Addi = ornament
**1.** son of Cosam, and father of melchi in our Lord’s genealogy
s: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H5716](H5716)\]); *Addi*, an Israelite: - Addi.

d:
**1.** a full, own sister
**2.** one connected by the tie of the Christian religion
s: Feminine of [G80](G80); a *sister* (natural or ecclesiastical): - sister.

d:
**1.** a brother, whether born of the same two parents or only of the same father or mother
**2.** having the same national ancestor, belonging to the same people, or countryman
**3.** any fellow or man
**4.** a fellow believer, united to another by the bond of affection
**5.** an associate in employment or office
**6.** brethren in christ
  **a.** his brothers by blood
  **b.** all men
  **c.** apostles
  **d.** Christians, as those who are exalted to the same heavenly place
s: From [G1](G1) (as a connective particle) and δελφύς delphus (the *womb*); a *brother* (literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like \[[H1](H1)\]): - brother.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a connective particle) and delphus (the womb)

d:
**1.** brotherhood, brotherly kindness
**2.** a family of brothers, the brotherhood
s: From [G80](G80); *brotherhood* (properly the feeling of *brotherliness*), that is, (the (Christian) *fraternity:* - brethren, brotherhood.

d: **1.** not manifest, indistinct, uncertain, obscure
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1212](G1212); *hidden*, figuratively *indistinct:* - appear not, uncertain.

d: **1.** uncertainty
s: From [G82](G82); *uncertainty:* - X uncertain.

d: **1.** uncertainly
s: Adverb from [G82](G82); *uncertainly:* - uncertainly.

d:
**1.** to be troubled, great distress or anguish, depressed This is the strongest of the three Greek words (85, 916,
**•** inthe NT for depression.
s: From a derivative of ἀδέω adeō (to be *sated* to loathing); to *be* *in* *distress* (of mind): - be full of heaviness, be very heavy.
o: from a derivative of adeo (to be sated to loathing)

d:
**1.** name Hades or Pluto, the God of the lower regions
**2.** Orcus, the nether world, the realm of the dead
**3.** later use of this word: the grave, death, hell
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1492](G1492); properly *unseen*, that is, “Hades” or the place (state) of departed souls: - grave, hell.

d:
**1.** undistinguished, unintelligible
**2.** without dubiousness, ambiguity or uncertainty
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G1252](G1252); properly *undistinguished*, that is, (actively) *impartial:* - without partiality.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G1252](G1252)

d: **1.** unintermitted, unceasing, continual
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of [G1223](G1223) and [G3007](G3007); *unintermitted*, that is, *permanent:* - without ceasing, continual.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of [G1223](G1223) and [G3007](G3007)

d: **1.** without intermission, incessantly, without ceasing
s: Adverb from [G88](G88); *uninterruptedly*, that is, *without* *omission* (on an appropriate occasion): - without ceasing.

d: AV - uncorruptness 1; 1
s: From a derivative of a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G1311](G1311); *incorruptibleness*, that is, (figuratively) *purity* (of doctrine): - uncorruptness.

d:
**1.** absolutely
  **a.** to act unjustly or wickedly, to sin,
  **b.** to be a criminal, to have violated the laws in some way
  **c.** to do wrong
  **d.** to do hurt
**2.** transitively
  **a.** to do some wrong or sin in some respect
  **b.** to wrong some one, act wickedly towards him
  **c.** to hurt, damage, harm
s: From [G94](G94); to *be* *unjust*, that is, (actively) *do* *wrong* (morally, socially or physically): - hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer, take) wrong.

d: **1.** a misdeed, evil doing, iniquity
s: From [G91](G91); a *wrong* done: - evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.

d:
**1.** injustice, of a judge
**2.** unrighteousness of heart and life
**3.** a deed violating law and justice, act of unrighteousness
s: From [G94](G94); (legal) *injustice* (properly the quality, by implication the act); moral *wrongfulness* (of charater, life or act): - iniquity, unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.

d:
**1.** descriptive of one who violates or has violated justice
  **a.** unjust
  **b.** unrighteous, sinful
  **c.** of one who deals fraudulently with others, deceitful
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1349](G1349); *unjust*; by extension *wicked*; by implication *treacherous*; specifically *heathen:* - unjust, unrighteous.

d: **1.** unjustly, undeserved, without fault
s: Adverb from [G94](G94); *unjustly:* - wrongfully.

d:
**1.** not standing the test, not approved
  **a.** properly used of metals and coins
**2.** that which does not prove itself such as it ought
  **a.** unfit for, unproved, spurious, reprobate
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1384](G1384); *unapproved*, that is, *rejected*; by implication *worthless* (literally or morally): - castaway, rejected, reprobate.

d:
**1.** guileless
  **a.** in things: unmixed, unadulterated, pure
  **b.** in persons: without dishonest intent, guileless
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1388](G1388); *undeceitful*, that is, (figuratively) *unadulterated:* - sincere.

d:
Adramyttium = I shall abide in death
**1.** Adramyttium, a seaport of mysia
s: From Ἀδραμύττειον Adramutteion (a place in Asia Minor); *Adramyttene* or belonging to Adramyttium: - of Adramyttium.
o: from Adramutteion (a place in Asia Minor)

d:
Adriatic = without wood
**1.** Adriatic Sea, Adrias, the sea between Greece and Italy
s: From Ἀδρία Adria (a place near its shore); the *Adriatic* sea (including the Ionian): - Adria.
o: from Adria (a place near its shore)

d:
**1.** bountiful collection, great abundance
**2.** thickness, ripeness, fulness, esp. of the body
s: From ἁδρός hadros (*stout*); *plumpness*, that is, (figuratively) *liberality:* - abundance.

d:
**1.** impossible
  **a.** not to have strength, power, or ability, to be weak
  **b.** can not be done, to be impossible
s: From [G102](G102); to *be* *unable*, that is, (passively) *impossible:* - be impossible.

d:
**1.** without strength, impotent, powerless, weakly, disabled
**2.** unable to be done, impossible
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1415](G1415); *unable*, that is, *weak* (literally or figuratively); passively *impossible:* - could not do, impossible, impotent, not possible, weak.

d: **1.** to the praise of anyone, to sing
s: A primary verb; to *sing:* - sing.

d:
**1.** perpetually, incessantly
**2.** invariably, at any and every time: when according to the circumstances something is or ought to be done again
s: From an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued *duration*); *“ever”*; by qualification *regularly*; by implication *earnestly:* - always, ever.
o: from an obsolete primary noun (apparently meaning continued duration)

d:
**1.** an eagle: since eagles do not usually go in quest of carrion, this may to a vulture that resembles an eagle
**2.** an eagle as a standard (Roman Military)
s: From the same as [G109](G109); an *eagle* (from its *wind* like flight): - eagle.

d:
**1.** unfermented, free from leaven or yeast
  **a.** of the unleavened loaves used in the paschal feast of the Jews
  **b.** metaph. free from faults or the leaven of iniquity
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2219](G2219); *unleavened*, that is, (figuratively) *uncorrupted*; (in the neuter plural) specifically (by implication) the *Passover* week: - unleavened (bread).

d:
Azor = helper
**1.** A son of Eliakim, in the line of our Lord. Mat 1:13, Mat 1:14.
s: Of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H5809](H5809)\]); *Azor*, an Israelite: - Azor.

d:
Ashdod or Azotus = a stronghold
**1.** one of the five chief cities of the Philistines, lying between Ashkelon and Jamnia and near the mediterranean
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H795](H795)\]; *Azotus* (that is, Ashdod), a place in Palestine: - Azotus.

d:
**1.** the air, particularly the lower and denser air as distinguished from the higher and rarer air
**2.** the atmospheric region
s: From ἄημι aēmi (to *breathe* unconsciously, that is, *respire*; by analogy to *blow*); “air” (as naturally *circumambient*): - air. Compare [G5594](G5594).
o: from aemi (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to blow)

d: **1.** undying, immortality, everlasting
s: From a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2288](G2288); *deathlessness:* - immortality.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2288](G2288)

d: **1.** contrary to law and justice, prohibited by law, illicit, criminal
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of θέμις themis (*statute*; from the base of [G5087](G5087)); *illegal*; by implication *flagitious:* - abominable, unlawful thing.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of themis (statute, from the base of [G5087](G5087))

d:
**1.** without God, knowing and worshipping no God
**2.** denying the Gods, esp. the recognised Gods of the state
**3.** godless, ungodly
**4.** abandoned by the Gods
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2316](G2316); *godless:* - without God.

d: **1.** one who breaks through the restraint of law and gratifies his lusts
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087) (in the sense of *enacting*); *lawless*, that is, (by implication) *criminal:* - wicked.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087) (in the sense of enacting)

d:
**1.** to do away with, to set aside, disregard
**2.** to thwart the efficacy of anything, nullify, make void, frustrate
**3.** to reject, to refuse, to slight
s: From a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087); to *set* *aside*, that is, (by implication) to *disesteem*, *neutralize* or *violate:* - cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought, reject.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087)

d: **1.** abolition, disannulling, put away, rejection
s: From [G114](G114); *cancellation* (literally or figuratively): - disannulling, put away.

d:
Athens = uncertainty
**1.** A famous city in Greece, the capital of Attica, and the chief seat of learning and civilisation during the golden period of the history of Greece
s: Plural of Ἀθήνη Athēnē (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city); *Athenae*, the captital of Greece: - Athens.
o: plural of Athene (the Goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have founded the city)

d: **1.** a person who lives in Athens, an Athenian
s: From [G116](G116); an *Athenaean* or inhabitant of Athenae: - Athenian.

d:
**1.** to engage in a contest, contend in public games, contend for a prize
**2.** to endure, suffer
s: From ἄθλος athlos (a *contest* in the public lists); to *contend* in the competitive games: - strive.
o: from athlos (a contest in the public lists)

d: **1.** to contest, to combat, to strive, struggle, hard trial
s: From [G118](G118); a *struggle* (figuratively): - fight.

d: **1.** to be disheartened, dispirited, broken in spirit
s: From a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2372](G2372); to *be* *spiritless*, that is, *disheartened:* - be dismayed.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2372](G2372)

d: **1.** not guilty, innocent, unpunished
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a probable derivative of [G5087](G5087) (meaning a *penalty*); *not* *guilty:* - innocent.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of [G5087](G5087) (meaning a penalty)

d: **1.** of a goat, goatskin
s: Form αἴξ aix (a *goat*); belonging to a *goat:* - goat.

d: **1.** the shore of the sea, the beach
s: From ἀΐ́σσω aissō (to *rush*) and [G251](G251) (in the sense of the *sea*); a *beach* (on which the *waves* *dash*): - shore.
o: from aisso (to rush) and [G251](G251) (in the sense of the sea)

d: **1.** an Egyptian
s: From [G125](G125); an *Egyptian* or inhabitant of *AEgyptus:* - Egyptian.

d:
Egypt = double straits
**1.** a country occupying the northeast angle of Africa
**2.** metaph. Jerusalem, for the Jews persecuting the christ and his followers, and so to be likened to the Egyptians treating the Jews
s: Of uncertain derivation; *AEgyptus*, the land of the Nile: - Egypt.

d: **1.** eternal, everlasting
s: From [G104](G104); *everduring* (forward and backward, or foward only): - eternal, everlasting.

d: **1.** a sense of shame or honour, modesty, bashfulness, reverence, regard for others, respect
s: Perhaps from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1492](G1492) (through the idea of *downcast* eyes); *bashfulness*, that is, (towards men), *modesty* or (towards God) *awe:* - reverence, shamefacedness.
o: perhaps from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1492](G1492) (through the idea of downcast eyes)

d:
Ethiopian = black
**1.** an Ethiopian
s: From αἴθω aithō (to *scorch*) and ὤψ ōps (the *face*, from [G3700](G3700)); an *Ethiopian* (as a *blackamoor*): - Ethiopian.
o: from aitho (to scorch) and ops (the face, from [G3700](G3700))

d:
**1.** blood
  **a.** of man or animals
  **b.** refers to the seat of life
  **c.** of those things that resemble blood, grape juice
**2.** blood shed, to be shed by violence, slay, murder
s: Of uncertain derivation; *blood*, literally (of men or animals), figuratively (the *juice* of grapes) or specifically (the atoning *blood* of Christ); by implication *bloodshed*, also *kindred:* - blood.

d: **1.** shedding of blood
s: From [G129](G129) and a derivative of [G1632](G1632); an *effusion* *of* *blood:* - shedding of blood.

d: **1.** to suffer from a flow of blood, to have a discharge of blood, to lose blood
s: From [G129](G129) and [G4482](G4482); to *flow* *blood*, that is, *have* *a* *haemorrhage:* - diseased with an issue of blood.

d:
Aeneas = laudable
**1.** the name of a paralytic cured by Peter at Lydia
s: Of uncertain derivation; *AEneas*, an Israelite: - AEneas.

d: **1.** praise, a thank offering
s: From [G134](G134); a *praising* (the act), that is, (specifically) a *thank* (offering): - praise.

d:
**1.** to praise, extol, to sing praises in honour to God
**2.** to allow, recommend
**3.** to promise or vow
s: From [G136](G136); to *praise* (God): - praise.

d:
**1.** an obscure saying, enigma, riddle
**2.** an obscure thing
s: From a derivative of [G136](G136) (in its primary sense); an *obscure* saying (“enigma”), that is, (abstractly) *obscureness:* - X darkly.
o: from a derivative of [G136](G136) (in its primary sense)

d:
**1.** a saying, proverb
**2.** praise, laudatory discourse
s: Apparently a primary word; properly a *story*, but used in the sense of [G1868](G1868); *praise* (of God): - praise.
o: apparently a primary word, properly, a story, but used in the sense of [G1868](G1868)

d:
Aenon meaning springs
**1.** the name of a place near to Salim at which John baptised
s: Of Hebrew origin (a derivative of \[[H5869](H5869)\], *place* *of* *springs*); *AEnon*, a place in Palestine: - AEnon.
o: of hebrew origin, a derivative of [G5869](G5869)

d:
**1.** to take for oneself, to prefer, choose
**2.** to choose by vote, elect to office
s: Probably akin to [G142](G142); to *take* *for* *oneself*, that is, to *prefer*. Some of the forms are borrowed from a cognate (ἕλλομαι hellomai), which is otherwise obsolete: - choose. Some of the forms are borrowed from a cognate hellomai, hel-lom-ahee; which is otherwise obsolete.

d:
**1.** act of taking, capture: e.g. storming a city
**2.** choosing, choice
**3.** that which is chosen
**4.** a body of men following their own tenets (sect or party)
  **a.** of the Sadducees
  **b.** of the Pharisees
  **c.** of the Christians
**5.** dissensions arising from diversity of opinions and aims
s: From [G138](G138); properly a *choice*, that is, (specifically) a *party* or (abstractly) *disunion*. (“heresy” is the Greek word itself.): - heresy \[which is the Greekord itself\], sect.

d:
**1.** to choose
**2.** to belong to a sect
s: From a derivative of [G138](G138); to *make* *a* *choice:* - choose.

d:
**1.** fitted or able to take or choose a thing
**2.** schismatic, factious, a follower of a false doctrine
**3.** heretic
s: From the same as [G140](G140); a *schismatic*. (“heretic” is the Greek word itself.): - heretic \[the Greekord itself\].

d:
**1.** to raise up, elevate, lift up
  **a.** to raise from the ground, take up: stones
  **b.** to raise upwards, elevate, lift up: the hand
  **c.** to draw up: a fish
**2.** to take upon one’s self and carry what has been raised up, to bear
**3.** to bear away what has been raised, carry off
  **a.** to move from its place
  **b.** to take off or away what is attached to anything
  **c.** to remove
  **d.** to carry off, carry away with one
  **e.** to appropriate what is taken
  **f.** to take away from another what is his or what is committed to him, to take by force
  **g.** to take and apply to any use
  **h.** to take from among the living, either by a natural death, or by violence
  **i.** cause to cease
s: A primary verb; to *lift*; by implication to *take* *up* or *away*; figuratively to *raise* (the voice), *keep* *in* *suspense* (the mind); specifically to *sail* away (that is, *weigh* *anchor*); by Hebraism (compare \[[H5375](H5375)\]) to *expiate* sin: - away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose, make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).

d:
**1.** to perceive
  **a.** by the bodily senses
  **b.** with the mind, understand
s: Of uncertain derivation; to *apprehend* (properly by the senses): - perceive.

d:
**1.** perception, not only by the senses but by the intellect
**2.** cognition, discernment
  **a.** of moral discernment in ethical matters
s: From [G143](G143); *perception*, that is, (figuratively) *discernment:* - judgment.

d: **1.** faculty of the mind for perceiving, understanding, judging
s: From a derivative of [G143](G143); properly an *organ* *of* *perception*, that is, (figuratively) judgment: - senses.

d: **1.** eager for base gain, greedy for money
s: From [G150](G150) and κέρδος kerdos (*gain*); *sordid:* - given to (greedy of) filthy lucre.

d: **1.** eagerness for base gain
s: Adverb from [G146](G146); *sordidly:* - for filthy lucre’s sake.

d: **1.** foul speaking, low and obscene speech
s: From [G150](G150) and [G3056](G3056); *vile* *conversation:* - filthy communication.

d: **1.** shame, base, dishonourable
s: Neuter of [G150](G150); a *shameful* thing, that is, *indecorum:* - shame.

d: **1.** filthy, baseness, dishonour
s: From the same as [G153](G153); *shameful*, that is, *base* (specifically *venal*): - filthy.

d: **1.** obscenity, filthiness
s: From [G150](G150); *shamefulness*, that is, *obscenity:* - filthiness.

d:
**1.** the confusion of one who is ashamed of anything, sense of shame
**2.** ignominy, disgrace, dishonour
**3.** a thing to be ashamed of
s: From [G153](G153); *shame* or *disgrace* (abstractly or concretely): - dishonesty, shame.

d:
**1.** to disfigure
**2.** to dishonour
**3.** to suffuse with shame, make ashamed, be ashamed
s: From αἶσχος aischos (*disfigurement*, that is, *disgrace*); to *feel* *shame* (for oneself): - be ashamed.

d: **1.** to ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require
s: Of uncertain derivation; to *ask* (in generally): - ask, beg, call for, crave, desire, require. Compare [G4441](G4441).

d: **1.** petition, request, required
s: From [G154](G154); a *thing* *asked* or (abstractly) an *asking:* - petition, request, required.

d:
**1.** cause, reason
**2.** cause for which one is worthy of punishment, crime
**3.** charge of crime, accusation
s: From the same as [G154](G154); a *cause* (as if *asked* for), that is, (logical) *reason* (motive, matter), (legal) *crime* (alleged or proved): - accusation, case, cause, crime, fault, \[wh-\]ere\[-fore\].

d: **1.** to accuse, bring a charge against, complaint
s: From a derivative of [G156](G156); a *thing* *charged:* - complaint.

d: **1.** cause, fault
s: Neuter of [G159](G159); a *reason* or *crime* (like [G156](G156)): - cause, fault.

d:
**1.** that which is the cause of anything resides, causative, causing
  **a.** the author
    **1.** of a cause
    **2.** of crime or offence
s: From the same as [G154](G154); *causative*, that is, (concretely) a *causer:* - author.

d: **1.** unexpected, sudden, unforeseen
s: From a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G5316](G5316) (compare [G1810](G1810)), (meaning *non* *apparent*); *unexpected*, that is, (adverbially) *suddenly:* - sudden, unawares.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G5316](G5316) \[cf [G1810](G1810)\]

d: **1.** captivity
s: From [G164](G164); *captivity:* - captivity.

d: **1.** to make captive, take captive, capture
s: From [G164](G164); to *capture* (like [G163](G163)): - lead captive.

d:
**1.** to lead away captive
**2.** metaph. to capture ones mind, captivate
s: From [G164](G164); to *make* *captive:* - lead away captive, bring into captivity.

d: **1.** a captive
s: Fromαἰχμή aichmē (a *spear*) and a derivative of the same as [G259](G259); properly a *prisoner* *of* *war*, that is, (generally) a *captive:* - captive.
o: from aichme (a spear) and a derivative of the same as [G259](G259)

d:
**1.** for ever, an unbroken age, perpetuity of time, eternity
**2.** the worlds, universe
**3.** period of time, age
s: From the same as [G104](G104); properly an *age*; by extension *perpetuity* (also past); by implication the *world*; specifically (Jewish) a Messianic period (present or future): - age, course, eternal, (for) ever (-more), \[n-\]ever, (beginning of the, while the) world (began, without end). Compare [G5550](G5550).

d:
**1.** without beginning and end, that which always has been and always will be
**2.** without beginning
**3.** without end, never to cease, everlasting
s: From [G165](G165); *perpetual* (also used of past time, or past and future as well): - eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

d:
**1.** uncleanness
  **a.** physical
  **b.** in a moral sense: the impurity of lustful, luxurious, profligate living
    **1.** of impure motives
s: From [G169](G169); *impurity* (the quality), physically or morally: - uncleanness.

d: **1.** impurity, filthiness
s: From [G169](G169); *impurity* (the state), morally: - filthiness.

d:
**1.** not cleansed, unclean
  **a.** in a ceremonial sense: that which must be abstained from according to the levitical law
  **b.** in a moral sense: unclean in thought and life
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G2508](G2508) (meaning *cleansed*); *impure* (ceremonially, morally (*lewd*) or specifically (*demonic*)): - foul, unclean.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G2508](G2508) (meaning cleansed)

d: **1.** to lack opportunity
s: From a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2540](G2540) (meaning *unseasonable*); to *be* *inopportune* (for oneself), that is, to *fail* *of* *a* *proper* *occasion:* - lack opportunity.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2540](G2540) (meaning unseasonable)

d: **1.** unseasonable
s: Adverb from the same as [G170](G170); *inopportunely:* - out of season.

d:
**1.** without guile or fraud, harmless, free from guilt
**2.** fearing no evil from others, distrusting no one
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2556](G2556); *not* *bad*, that is, (objectively) *innocent* or (subjectively) *unsuspecting:* - harmless, simple.

d:
**1.** thorn, bramble
**2.** bush, brier, a thorny plant
s: Probably from the same as [G188](G188); a *thorn:* - thorn.

d: **1.** thorny, woven out of twigs of a thorny plant
s: From [G173](G173); *thorny:* - of thorns.

d: **1.** metaph. without fruit, barren, not yielding what it ought to yield
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2590](G2590); *barren* (literally or figuratively): - without fruit, unfruitful.

d: **1.** that cannot be condemned, not to be censored
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2607](G2607); *unblamable:* - that cannot be condemned.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2607](G2607)

d: **1.** not covered, unveiled
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of [G2596](G2596) and [G2572](G2572); *unveiled:* - uncovered.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2619](G2619) a derivative of a compound of [G2596](G2596) and [G2572](G2572)

d: **1.** uncondemned, punished without being tried
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2632](G2632); *without* (legal) *trial:* - uncondemned.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2632](G2632)

d: **1.** indissoluble, not subject to destruction
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2647](G2647); *indissoluble*, that is, (figuratively) *permanent:* - endless.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2647](G2647)

d:
**1.** unable to stop, unceasing
**2.** not quieted, that cannot be quieted
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2664](G2664); *unrefraining:* - that cannot cease.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2664](G2664)

d: **1.** instability, a state of disorder, disturbance, confusion
s: From [G182](G182); *instability*, that is, *disorder:* - commotion, confusion, tumult.

d: **1.** unstable, inconstant, restless
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2525](G2525); *inconstant:* - unstable.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G2525](G2525)

d: **1.** that can not be restrained

d:

s: Of Chaldee origin (meaning *field* *of* *blood*; corresponding to \[[H2506](H2506)\] and \[[H1818](H1818)\]); *Akeldama*, a place near Jerusalem: - Aceldama.

d:
**1.** unmixed, pure as in wines or metals
**2.** of the mind, without a mixture of evil, free from guile, innocent, simple

o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G2767](G2767)

d: **1.** not inclining, firm, unmoved
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2827](G2827); *not* *leaning*, (that is, (figuratively) *firm:* - without wavering.

d: **1.** to flourish, come to maturity
s: From the same as [G188](G188); to *make* *a* *point*, that is, (figuratively) *mature:* - be fully ripe.

d:
**1.** a point
**2.** extremity, climax, acme, highest degree
**3.** the present time
s: Accusative case of a noun (*“acme”*) akin to ἀκή akē (a *point*) and meaning the same; adverbially *just* now, that is, *still:* - yet.
o: accusative case of a noun (acme) akin to ake (a point) and meaning the same

d:
**1.** the sense of hearing
**2.** the organ of hearing, the ear
**3.** the thing heard
  **a.** instruction, namely oral
    **1.** of preaching the gospel
  **b.** hearsay, report or rumour
s: From [G191](G191); *hearing* (the act, the sense or the thing heard): - audience, ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.

d:
**1.** to follow one who precedes, join him as his attendant, accompany him

  **a.** side with his party
s: From [G1](G1) (as a particle of union) and κέλευθος keleuthos (a *road*); properly to *be* *in* *the* *same* *way* *with*, that is, to *accompany* (specifically as a disciple): - follow, reach.

d:
**1.** to be endowed with the faculty of hearing, not deaf
**2.** to hear
  **a.** to attend to, consider what is or has been said
  **b.** to understand, perceive the sense of what is said
**3.** to hear something
  **a.** to perceive by the ear what is announced in one’s presence
  **b.** to get by hearing learn
  **c.** a thing comes to one’s ears, to find out, learn
  **d.** to give ear to a teaching or a teacher
  **e.** to comprehend, to understand
s: A primary verb; to *hear* (in various senses): - give (in the) audience (of), come (to the ears), (\[shall\]) hear (-er, -ken), be noised, be reported, understand.

d: **1.** want of self-control, incontinence, intemperance

d: **1.** without self-control, intemperate
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2904](G2904); *powerless*, that is, *without* *self* *control:* - incontinent.

d: **1.** unmixed, pure
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G2767](G2767); *undiluted:* - without mixture.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G2767](G2767)

d: **1.** exactness, exactest care: in accordance with the strictness of the Mosaic law
s: From the same as [G196](G196); *exactness:* - perfect manner.

d:
**1.** exact, careful
**2.** of the strictest sect: the most precise and rigorous in interpreting the Mosaic law, and in observing even the more minute precepts of the law and tradition
s: Superlative of ἀκριβης akribēs (a derivative of the same as [G206](G206)); *most* *exact:* - most straitest.
o: superlative of akribes (a derivative of the same as [G206](G206))

d: **1.** more exactly, more perfectly
s: Neuter of the comparative of the same as [G196](G196); (adverbially) *more* *exactly:* - more perfect (-ly).
o: neuter of the comparative of the same as [G196](G196)

d:
**1.** to know accurately, to do exactly
**2.** to investigate diligently
s: From the same as [G196](G196); to *be* *exact*, that is, *ascertain:* - enquire diligently.

d: **1.** exactly, accurately, diligently
s: Adverb from the same as [G196](G196); *exactly:* - circumspectly, diligently, perfect (-ly).

d: **1.** a locust, particularly that species which especially infests oriental countries, stripping fields and trees. Numberless swarms of them almost every spring are carried by the wind from Arabia into Palestine, and having devastated that country, migrate to regions farther north, until they perish by falling into the sea. The Orientals accustomed to feed upon locusts, either raw or roasted and seasoned with salt (or prepared in other ways), and the Israelites also were permitted to eat them.
s: Apparently from the same as [G206](G206); a *locust* (as *pointed*, or as *lighting* on the *top* of vegetation): - locust.

d: **1.** a place set aside for hearing and deciding cases
s: From [G202](G202); an *audience* *room:* - place of hearing.

d: **1.** a hearer
s: From ἀκροάομαι akroaomai (to *listen*; apparently an intensive of [G191](G191)); a *hearer* (merely): - hearer.

d:

d: **1.** placed at an extreme corner, the corner foundation stone

d:

d:
**1.** the farthest bounds, uttermost parts, end, highest, extreme
  **a.** of the earth
  **b.** of heaven
s: Neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of [G188](G188); the *extremity:* - one end . . . other, tip, top, uttermost part.
o: neuter of an adj. probably akin to the base of [G188](G188)

d:
Aquila = an eagle

d: **1.** to render void, deprive of force and authority

d: **1.** not of one’s own will, unwillingly, against the will

d:

d: **1.** a catching, capture, to be taken

  **a.** at the beginning of a discourse - surely, truly, of a truth
  **b.** at the end - so it is, so be it, may it be fulfilled. It was a custom, which passed over from the synagogues to the Christian assemblies, that when he who had read or discoursed, had offered up solemn prayer to God, the others responded amen, and thus made the substance of what was uttered their own. The word amen is a most remarkable word. It was transliterateddirectly from the hebrew into the Greek of the New Testament, theninto Latin and into English and many other languages, so that it ispractically a universal word. It has been called the best known wordin human speech. The word is directly related -- in fact, almostidentical -- to the hebrew word for believe (amam), or faithful.Thus, it came to mean sure or truly, an expression of absolutetrust and confidence. -- HMM
