**4.** to turn away violently from a right state, to unsettle, subvert
s: From [G303](G303) (in the sense of *reversal*) and a derivative of [G4632](G4632); properly to *pack* *up* (baggage), that is, (by implication and figuratively) to *upset:* - subvert.
o: from [G303](G303) (in the sense of reversal) and a derivative of [G4632](G4632)

d: **1.** to draw up
s: From [G303](G303) and [G4685](G4685); to *take* *up* or *extricate:* - draw up, pull out.

d:
**1.** a raising up, rising (e.g. from a seat)
**2.** a rising from the dead
  **a.** that of christ
  **b.** that of all men at the end of this present age
  **c.** the resurrection of certain ones throughout history who were restored to life (Heb 11:35)
s: From [G450](G450); a *standing* *up* again, that is, (literally) a *resurrection* from death (individual, general or by implication (its author)), or (figuratively) a (moral) *recovery* (of spiritual truth): - raised to life again, resurrection, rise from the dead, that should rise, rising again.

d:
**1.** to stir up, excite, unsettle
  **a.** to excite tumults and seditions in the state
  **b.** to upset, unsettle, minds by disseminating religious error
s: From a derivative of [G450](G450) (in the sense of *removal*); properly to *drive* *out* of home, that is, (by implication) to *disturb* (literally or figuratively): - trouble, turn upside down, make an uproar.
o: from a derivative of [G450](G450) (in the sense of removal)

d: **1.** to raise up upon a cross, crucify
s: From [G303](G303) and [G4717](G4717); to *recrucify* (figuratively): - crucify afresh.

d: **1.** to draw up deep sighs from the bottom of the breast, to sigh deeply
s: From [G303](G303) and [G4727](G4727); to *sigh* *deeply:* - sigh deeply.

d:
**1.** to turn upside down, overturn
**2.** to turn back
**3.** to turn hither and thither, to turn one’s self about, sojourn dwell in a place
**4.** metaph. to conduct one’s self, behave one’s self, live
s: From [G303](G303) and [G4762](G4762); to *overturn*; also to *return*; by implication to *busy* oneself, that is, *remain*, *live:* - abide, behave self, have conversation, live, overthrow, pass, return, be used.

d: **1.** manner of life, conduct, behaviour, deportment
s: From [G390](G390); *behavior:* - conversation.

d: **1.** to put together in order, arrange, compose
s: From [G303](G303) and the middle of [G5021](G5021); to *arrange:* - set in order.
o: from [G303](G303) and the middle voice of [G5021](G5021)

d:
**1.** rise
  **a.** to cause to rise
    **1.** of the earth bring forth plants
  **b.** to rise, arise, to rise from, be descended from
    **1.** of sun moon and stars)
s: From [G303](G303) and the base of [G5056](G5056); to (*cause* to) *arise:* - (a-, make to) rise, at the rising of, spring (up), be up.

d: **1.** to set forth (in words), communicate
s: From [G303](G303) and the middle of [G5087](G5087); to *set* *forth* (for oneself), that is, *propound:* - communicate, declare.
o: from [G303](G303) and the middle voice of [G5087](G5087)

d:
**1.** a rising (of the sun and stars)
**2.** the east (the direction of the sun’s rising)
s: From [G393](G393); a *rising* of light, that is, *dawn* (figuratively); by implication the *east* (also in plural): - dayspring, east, rising.

d:
**1.** to overthrow, overturn, destroy
**2.** to subvert
s: From [G303](G303) and the base of [G5157](G5157); to *overturn* (figuratively): - overthrow, subvert.

d:
**1.** to nurse up, nourish up
  **a.** of young children and animals nourished to promote growth
**2.** to bring up
  **a.** with the predominant idea of forming the mind
s: From [G303](G303) and [G5142](G5142); to *rear* (physically or mentally): - bring up, nourish (up).

d:
**1.** to bring to light, hold up to view, show
**2.** to appear, be made apparent
s: From [G303](G303) and [G5316](G5316); to *show*, that is, (reflexively) *appear*, or (passively) *have* *pointed* out: - (should) appear, discover.

d:
**1.** to carry or bring up, to lead up
  **a.** men to a higher place
**2.** to put upon the altar, to bring to the altar, to offer
**3.** to lift up one’s self, to take upon one’s self
  **a.** to place on one’s self anything as a load to be carried
  **b.** to sustain, i.e. their punishment
s: From [G303](G303) and [G5342](G5342); to *take* *up* (literally or figuratively): - bear, bring (carry, lead) up, offer (up).

d: **1.** to cry out with a loud voice, call aloud, exclaim
s: From [G303](G303) and [G5455](G5455); to *exclaim:* - speak out.

d:
**1.** an overflowing, a pouring out
**2.** metaph. the excess (flood) of riot in which a dissolute life pours itself forth
s: From a compound of [G303](G303) and χέω cheō (to *pour*); properly *effusion*, that is, (figuratively) *license:* - excess.
o: from a comparative of [G303](G303) and cheo (to pour)

d:
**1.** to go back, return
**2.** to withdraw
  **a.** so as to leave a room
  **b.** of those who through fear seek some other place, or shun sight
s: From [G303](G303) and [G5562](G5562); to *retire:* - depart, give place, go (turn) aside, withdraw self.

d: **1.** a cooling, refreshing
s: From [G404](G404); properly a *recovery* *of* *breath*, that is, (figuratively) *revival:* - revival.

d:
**1.** to cool again, to cool off, recover from the effects of heat
  **a.** to refresh (one’s spirit)
**2.** to recover breath, take the air, cool off, revive, refresh one’s self
s: From [G303](G303) and [G5594](G5594); properly to *cool* *off*, that is, (figuratively) *relieve:* - refresh.

d:
**1.** a slave-dealer, kidnapper, man-stealer
  **a.** of one who unjustly reduces free men to slavery
  **b.** of one who steals the slaves of others and sells them
s: From a derivative of a compound of [G435](G435) and [G4228](G4228); an *enslaver* (as bringing *men* to his *feet*): - men-stealer.
o: from a derivative of a compound of [G435](G435) and [G4228](G4228)

d:
Andrew = manly
**1.** A native of Bethsaida in Galilee, brother of Simon Peter, a disciple of John the Baptist, and afterwards an apostle of christ. He is said to have been crucified at Patrae in Archaia.
s: From [G435](G435); *manly*; *Andreas*, an Israelite: - Andrew.

d:
**1.** to make a man of or make brave
**2.** to show one’s self a man, be brave
s: Middle voice from [G435](G435); to *act* *manly:* - quit like men.

d:
Andronicus = man of victory
**1.** a Jewish Christian and a kinsman of Paul
s: From [G435](G435) and [G3534](G3534); *man* *of* *victory*; *Andronicos*, an Israelite: - Andronicus.

d: **1.** a murderer
s: From [G435](G435) and [G5408](G5408); a *murderer:* - manslayer.

d: **1.** that cannot be called into to account, unreproveable, unaccused, blameless
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G1458](G1458); *unaccused*, that is, (by implication) *irreproachable:* - blameless.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G1458](G1458)

d: **1.** the unspeakable, indescribable
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1555](G1555); *not* *expounded* in full, that is, *indescribable:* - unspeakable.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1555](G1555)

d: **1.** unspeakable
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1583](G1583); *not* *spoken* *out*, that is, (by implication) *unutterable:* - unspeakable.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1583](G1583)

d: **1.** unfailing
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1587](G1587); *not* *left* *out*, that is, (by implication) *inexhaustible:* - that faileth not.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1587](G1587)

d: **1.** bearable, tolerable
s: Comparative of a derivative of [G430](G430); *more* *endurable:* - more tolerable.

d: **1.** without mercy, merciless
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G1655](G1655); *merciless:* - unmerciful.

d: **1.** to agitate or drive by the wind
s: From [G417](G417); to *toss* *with* *the* *wind:* - drive with the wind.

d:
**1.** wind, a violent agitation and stream of air
**2.** a very strong tempestuous wind
**3.** the four principal or cardinal winds, hence the four corners of heaven
s: From the base of [G109](G109); *wind*; (plural) by implication (the four) *quarters* (of the earth): - wind.

d: **1.** that cannot be admitted, inadmissible, unallowable, improper
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as [G1735](G1735); *unadmitted*, that is, (by implication) *not* *supposable:* - impossible.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of the same as [G1735](G1735)

d: **1.** that cannot be searched out
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1830](G1830); *not* *searched* *out*, that is, (by implication) *inscrutable:* - unsearchable.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G1830](G1830)

d: **1.** patient of ills and wrongs, forbearing
s: From [G430](G430) and [G2556](G2556); *enduring* *of* *ill*, that is, *forbearing:* - patient.

d: **1.** that cannot be searched out, that cannot be comprehended
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of [G2487](G2487); *not* *tracked* *out*, that is, (by implication) *untraceable:* - past finding out, unsearchable.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of [G2487](G2487)

d: **1.** having no cause to be ashamed
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G153](G153); *not* *ashamed*, that is, (by implication) *irreprehensible:* - that neededth not to be ashamed.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G153](G153)

d:
**1.** not apprehended, that cannot be laid hold of
**2.** that cannot be reprehended, not open to censure, irreproachable
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G1949](G1949); *not* *arrested*, that is, (by implication) *inculpable:* - blameless, unrebukeable.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G1949](G1949)

d:
**1.** to go up
**2.** to go up to a higher place: to Jerusalem
s: From [G303](G303) and [G2064](G2064); to *ascend:* - go up.

d:
**1.** a loosening, relaxing
  **a.** spoken of a more tolerable condition in captivity, to be held in less vigorous confinement
  **b.** relief, rest, from persecutions
s: From [G447](G447); *relaxation* or (figuratively) *relief:* - eased, liberty, rest.

d:
**1.** to investigate, to examine
**2.** to examine judicially
s: From [G303](G303) and ἐτάζω etazō (to *test*); to *investigate* (judicially): - (should have) examine (-d).

d: **1.** without one’s will or intervention
s: A primary particle; *without*: - without. Compare [G1](G1).

d: **1.** not convenient, not commodious, not fit
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2111](G2111); *not* *well* *set*, that is, *inconvenient:* - not commodious.

d: **1.** to find out by search
s: From [G303](G303) and [G2147](G2147); to *find* *out:* - find.

d:
**1.** to hold up
**2.** to hold one’s self erect and firm
**3.** to sustain, to bear, to endure
s: Middle voice from [G303](G303) and [G2192](G2192); to *hold* *oneself* *up* against, that is, (figuratively) *put* *up* with: - bear with endure, forbear, suffer.

d: **1.** a cousin
s: From [G1](G1) (as a particle of union) and an obsolete form νέπος nepos (a *brood*); properly *akin*, that is, (specifically) a *cousin:* - sister’s son.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a particle of union) and an obsolete nepos (a brood)

d:
**1.** anise, dill
  **a.** a used plant used as a spice and for medicine
s: Probably of foreign origin; *dill:* - anise.

d:
**1.** to have come up to, arrived at, to reach to
**2.** to pertain to what is due, duty, as was fitting
s: From [G303](G303) and [G2240](G2240); to *attain* *to*, that is, (figuratively) *be* *proper:* - convenient, be fit.

d: **1.** not tame, savage, fierce
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and ἥμερος hēmeros (*lame*); *savage:* - fierce.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and hemeros (lame)

d:
**1.** with reference to sex
  **a.** of a male
  **b.** of a husband
  **c.** of a betrothed or future husband
**2.** with reference to age, and to distinguish an adult man from a boy
**3.** any male
**4.** used generically of a group of both men and women
s: A primary word (compare [G444](G444)); a *man* (properly as an individual male): - fellow, husband, man, sir.

d:
**1.** to set one’s self against, to withstand, resist, oppose
**2.** to set against
s: From [G473](G473) and [G2476](G2476); to *stand* *against*, that is, *oppose:* - resist, withstand.

d:
**1.** to reply by professing or by confessing
**2.** to agree mutually (in turn), to make a compact
**3.** to acknowledge in the presence of
  **a.** to give thanks
s: From [G473](G473) and the middle of [G3670](G3670); to *confess* *in* *turn*, that is, *respond* in praise: - give thanks.
o: from [G473](G473) and the middle voice of [G3670](G3670)

d: **1.** a flower
s: A primary word; a *blossom:* - flower.

d: **1.** a heap of burning coals
s: From [G440](G440); a bed of burning *coals:* - fire of coals.

d: **1.** a burning or live coal
s: Of uncertain derivation; a live *coal:* - coal of fire.

d: **1.** studying to please man, courting the favour of men
s: From [G444](G444) and [G700](G700); *man* *courting*, that is, *fawning:* - men-pleaser.

d:
**1.** human
  **a.** applied to things belonging to men
s: From [G444](G444); *human:* - human, common to man, man\[-kind\], \[man-\]kind, men’s, after the manner of men.

d: **1.** a manslayer, murderer
s: From [G444](G444) and κτείνω kteinē (to *kill*); a *manslayer:* - murderer. Compare [G5406](G5406).

d:
**1.** a human being, whether male or female
  **a.** generically, to include all human individuals
  **b.** to distinguish man from beings of a different order
    **1.** of animals and plants
    **2.** of from God and christ
    **3.** of the angels
  **c.** with the added notion of weakness, by which man is led into a mistake or prompted to sin
  **d.** with the adjunct notion of contempt or disdainful pity
  **e.** with reference to two fold nature of man, body and soul
  **f.** with reference to the two fold nature of man, the corrupt and the truly Christian man, conformed to the nature of God
  **g.** with reference to sex, a male
**2.** indefinitely, someone, a man, one
**3.** in the plural, people
**4.** joined with other words, merchantman
s: From [G435](G435) and ὤψ ōps (the *countenance*; from [G3700](G3700)); *manfaced*, that is, a *human* being: - certain, man.
o: from [G435](G435) and ops (the countenance, from [G3700](G3700)); man-faced, i.e. a human being

d: **1.** to be a proconsul
s: From [G446](G446); to *act* *as* *proconsul:* - be the deputy.

d:
**1.** a proconsul
  **a.** the emperor Augustus divided the Roman provinces into senatorial and imperial. The former were governed by proconsuls; the later by legates of the emperor, sometimes called propraetors
s: From [G473](G473) and a superlative of [G5228](G5228); *instead* of the *highest* officer, that is, (specifically) a Roman *proconsul:* - deputy.

d:
**1.** to send back, relax, loosen
**2.** to give up, omit, calm
**3.** to leave, not to uphold, to let sink
s: From [G303](G303) and ἵημι hiēmi (to *send*); to *let* *up*, that is, (literally) *slacken*, or (figuratively) *desert*, *desist* from: - forbear, leave, loose.

d: **1.** without mercy, merciless
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G2436](G2436); *inexorable:* - without mercy.

d: **1.** unwashed
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G3538](G3538); *without* *ablution:* - unwashen.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G3538](G3538)

d:
**1.** to cause to rise up, raise up
  **a.** raise up from laying down
  **b.** to raise up from the dead
  **c.** to raise up, cause to be born, to cause to appear, bring forward
**2.** to rise, stand up
  **a.** of persons lying down, of persons lying on the ground
  **b.** of persons seated
  **c.** of those who leave a place to go elsewhere
    **1.** of those who prepare themselves for a journey
  **d.** of the dead
**3.** at arise, appear, stand forth
  **a.** of kings prophets, priests, leaders of insurgents
  **b.** of those about to enter into conversation or dispute with anyone, or to undertake some business, or attempt something against others
  **c.** to rise up against any one
s: From [G303](G303) and [G2476](G2476); to *stand* *up* (literally or figuratively, transitively or intransitively): - arise, lift up, raise up (again), rise (again), stand up (-right).

d:
Anna = grace
**1.** A prophetess in Jerusalem at the time of the Lord’s presentation in the temple. She was of the tribe of Asher.
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2584](H2584)\]; *Anna*, an Israelitess: - Anna.

d:
Annas = humble
**1.** high priest of the Jews, elevated to the priesthood by Quirinius the governor of Syria c. 6 or 7 A.D., but afterwards deposed by Valerius Gratus, the procurator of Judaea, who put in his place, first Ismael, son of Phabi, and shortly after Eleazar, son of Annas. From the latter, the office passed to Simon; from Simon c. 18 A.D. to Caiaphas; but Annas even after he had been put out of office, continued to have great influence.
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2608](H2608)\]; *Annas* (that is, [G367](G367)), an Israelite: - Annas.

d:
**1.** not understood, unintelligible
**2.** not understanding, unwise, foolish
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3539](G3539); *unintelligent*; by implication *sensual:* - fool (-ish), unwise.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3539](G3539)

d:
**1.** want of understanding, folly
**2.** madness expressing itself in rage
s: From a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3563](G3563); *stupidity*; by implication *rage:* - folly, madness.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3563](G3563)

d: **1.** to open
s: From [G303](G303) and οἴγω oigō (to *open*); to *open* *up* (literally or figuratively, in various applications): - open.

d: **1.** to build again
s: From [G303](G303) and [G3618](G3618); to *rebuild:* - build again.

d: **1.** an opening
s: From [G455](G455); *opening* (throat): - X open.

d:
**1.** the condition of without law
  **a.** because ignorant of it
  **b.** because of violating it
**2.** contempt and violation of law, iniquity, wickedness
s: From [G459](G459); *illegality*, that is, *violation* *of* *law* or (generally) *wickedness:* - iniquity, X transgress (-ion of) the law, unrighteousness.

d:
**1.** destitute of (the Mosaic) law
  **a.** of the Gentiles
**2.** departing from the law, a violator of the law, lawless, wicked
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3551](G3551); *lawless*, that is, (negatively) *not* *subject* *to* (the Jewish) *law*; (by implication a *Gentile*), or (positively) *wicked:* - without law, lawless, transgressor, unlawful, wicked.

d:
**1.** without the law, without the knowledge of the law
**2.** to sin in ignorance of the Mosaic law
**3.** live ignorant of law and discipline
s: Adverb from [G459](G459); *lawlessly*, that is, (specifically) *not* *amenable* *to* (the Jewish) *law:* - without law.

d:
**1.** to set up, make erect
  **a.** of a deformed person
**2.** to rear again, build anew
s: From [G303](G303) and a derivative of the base of [G3717](G3717); to *straighten* *up:* - lift (set) up, make straight.
o: from [G303](G303) and a derivative of the base of [G3717](G3717)

d: **1.** unholy, impious, wicked
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3741](G3741); *wicked:* - unholy.

d: **1.** toleration, forbearance
s: From [G430](G430); *selfrestraint*, that is, *tolerance:* - forbearance.

d: **1.** to struggle, fight
s: From [G473](G473) and [G75](G75); to *struggle* *against* (figuratively), (“antagonize”): - strive against.

d:
**1.** that which is given in place of another thing by way of exchange
**2.** what is given either in order to keep or to acquire anything
s: From a compound of [G473](G473) and [G236](G236); an *equivalent* or *ransom:* - in exchange.

d:
**1.** to fill up in turn
  **a.** in Col 1:24, the meaning is, ’what is wanting in the afflictions of christ to be borne by me, that I supply in order to repay the benefits which christ conferred on me by filling up the measure of the afflictions laid upon me’.
s: From [G473](G473) and [G378](G378); to *supplement:* - fill up.

d:
**1.** in a good sense, to repay, requite
**2.** in a bad sense, penalty and vengeance
s: From [G473](G473) and [G591](G591); to *requite* (good or evil): - recompense, render, repay.

d: **1.** the thing paid back, requital
s: From [G467](G467); a *requital* (properly the thing): - recompense.

d: **1.** recompence, to reward or repay someone
s: From [G467](G467); *requital* (properly the act): - reward.

d: **1.** to contradict in reply, to answer by contradiction, reply against
s: From [G473](G473) and [G611](G611); to *contradict* or *dispute:* - answer again, reply against.

d: **1.** to speak against, gainsay
s: From [G473](G473) and [G2036](G2036); to *refute* or *deny:* - gainsay, say against.

d:
**1.** to hold before or against, hold back, withstand, endure
**2.** to keep one’s self directly opposite to any one, hold to him firmly, cleave to, paying heed to him
s: From [G473](G473) and the middle of [G2192](G2192); to *hold* oneself *opposite* to, that is, (by implication) *adhere* *to*; by extension to *care* for: - hold fast, hold to, support.
o: from [G473](G473) and the middle voice of [G2192](G2192)

d:
**1.** over against, opposite to, before
**2.** for, instead of, in place of (something)
  **a.** instead of
  **b.** for
  **c.** for that, because
  **d.** wherefore, for this cause
s: A primary particle; *opposite*, that is, *instead* or *because* of (rarely *in* *addition* to): - for, in the room of. Often used in composition to denote *contrast*, *requital*, *substitution*, *correspondence*, etc.

d: **1.** to throw in turn
s: From [G473](G473) and [G906](G906); to *bandy:* - have.

d: **1.** to place one’s self in opposition, to oppose, to dispose in turn, to take in hand in turn, to retaliate
s: From [G473](G473) and [G1303](G1303); to *set* *oneself* *opposite*, that is, *be* *disputatious:* - that oppose themselves.

d:
**1.** opponent
  **a.** an opponent in a suit of law
  **b.** an adversary, enemy
s: From [G473](G473) and [G1349](G1349); an *opponent* (in a lawsuit); specifically *Satan* (as the arch enemy): - adversary.

d: **1.** opposition, that which is opposed
s: From a compound of [G473](G473) and [G5087](G5087); *opposition*, that is, a *conflict* (of theories): - opposition.

d:
**1.** to put in place of another
**2.** to place in opposition
  **a.** to dispose troops, set an army in line of battle
  **b.** to stand against, resist
s: From [G473](G473) and [G2525](G2525); to *set* *down* (troops) *against*, that is, *withstand:* - resist.

d: **1.** to invite in turn
s: From [G473](G473) and [G2564](G2564); to *invite* *in* *return:* - bid again.

d:
**1.** to be set over against, opposite to
**2.** to oppose, be adverse to, withstand
s: From [G473](G473) and [G2749](G2749); to *lie* *opposite*, that is, *be* *adverse* (figuratively *repugnant*) to: - adversary, be contrary, oppose.

d: **1.** over against, opposite
s: Prolonged from [G473](G473); *opposite:* - over against.

d:
**1.** to lay hold of, hold fast to anything
**2.** to take a person or thing in order as it were to be held, to take to, embrace
**3.** to help, to be a partaker of, partake of (the benefits of the services rendered by the slaves)
s: From [G473](G473) and the middle of [G2983](G2983); to *take* hold of *in* *turn*, that is, *succor*; also to *participate:* - help, partaker support.
o: from [G473](G473) and the middle voice of [G2983](G2983)

d:
**1.** to speak against, gainsay, contradict
**2.** to oppose one’s self to one, decline to obey him, declare one’s self against him, refuse to have anything to do with him
s: From [G473](G473) and [G3004](G3004); to *dispute*, *refuse:* - answer again, contradict, deny, gainsay (-er), speak against.

d:
**1.** a laying hold of, apprehension, perception, objection of a disputant
**2.** in NT, to aid, help
s: From [G482](G482); *relief:* - help.

d:
**1.** gainsaying, contradiction
**2.** opposition, rebellion
s: From a derivative of [G483](G483); *dispute*, *disobedience:* - contradiction, gainsaying, strife.

d: **1.** to revile in turn, to retort railing
s: From [G473](G473) and [G3058](G3058); to *rail* *in* *reply:* - revile again.

d: **1.** what is given in exchange for another as the price of his redemption, ransom
s: From [G473](G473) and [G3083](G3083); a *redemption* *price:* - ransom.

d: **1.** to measure back, to measure in return, repay
s: From [G473](G473) and [G3354](G3354); to *mete* *in* *return:* - measure again.

d: **1.** a reward given in compensation, requital, recompence
s: From a compound of [G473](G473) and [G3408](G3408); *requital*, *correspondence:* - recompense.

d:
Antioch = ’driven against
**1.** Capital of Syria, situated on the river Orontes, founded by Seleucus Nicanor in 300 B.C. and named in honour of his father, Antiochus. Many Greek-Jews lived there and it was here that the followers of christ were first called Christians.
**2.** A city in Pisidia on the borders Phrygia, founded by Seleucus Nicanor. Under the Romans it became a colonia and was also called Caesarea
s: From Ἀντίοχος Antiochos (a Syrian king); *Antiochia*, a place in Syria: - Antioch.

d: **1.** an Antiochian, a native of Antioch
s: From [G490](G490); an *Antiochian* or inhabitant of Antiochia: - of Antioch.

d: **1.** to pass by opposite to
s: From [G473](G473) and [G3928](G3928); to *go* *along* *opposite:* - pass by on the other side.

d:
Antipas = like the father
**1.** a Christian of Pergamos who suffered martyrdom
s: Contracted for a compound of [G473](G473) and a derivative of [G3962](G3962); *Antipas*, a Christian: - Antipas.
o: contracted for a compound of [G473](G473) and a derivative of [G3962](G3962)

d:
Antipatris = for forefather
**1.** a city situated between Joppa and Caesarea, in a very fertile region, not far from the coast; rebuilt by herod the great and named Antipatris in honour of his father Antipater
s: From the same as [G493](G493); *Antipatris*, a place in Palestine: - Antipatris.

d: **1.** over against, on the opposite shore, on the other side
s: From [G473](G473) and [G4008](G4008); *on* *the* *opposite* *side:* - over against.

d:
**1.** to fall upon, run against
**2.** to be adverse, oppose, strive against
s: From [G473](G473) and [G4098](G4098) (including its alternate); to *oppose:* - resist.

d:
**1.** to make a military expedition, or take the field, against anyone
**2.** to oppose, war against
s: From [G473](G473) and [G4754](G4754); (figuratively) to *attack*, that is, (by implication) *destroy:* - war against.

d:
**1.** to range in battle against
**2.** to oppose one’s self, resist
s: From [G473](G473) and the middle of [G5021](G5021); to *range* *oneself* *against*, that is, *oppose:* - oppose themselves, resist.
o: from [G473](G473) and the middle voice of [G5021](G5021)

d:
**1.** a thing formed after some pattern
**2.** a thing resembling another, its counterpart
  **a.** something in the messianic times which answers to the type, as baptism corresponds to the deluge (1Pe 3:21)
s: Neuter of a compound of [G473](G473) and [G5179](G5179); *corresponding* (“antitype”), that is, a *representative*, *counterpart:* - (like) figure (whereunto).
o: neuter of a compound of [G473](G473) and [G5179](G5179)

d: **1.** the adversary of the messiah
s: From [G473](G473) and [G5547](G5547); an *opponent* *of* *the* *Messiah:* - antichrist.

d:
**1.** to draw out of a ship’s bilge-water, to bale or pump out
**2.** to draw water
s: From ἄντλος antlos (the *hold* of a ship); to *bale* up (properly bilge water), that is, *dip* water (with a bucket, pitcher, etc.): - draw (out).
o: from antlos (the hold of a ship)

d:
**1.** what is drawn
**2.** the act of drawing water
**3.** a thing to draw with, e.g. bucket and rope let down into a well
s: From [G501](G501); a *baling* *vessel:* - thing to draw with.

d:
**1.** to look against or straight at
**2.** metaph. to bear up against, withstand
s: From a compound of [G473](G473) and [G3788](G3788); to *face:* - bear up into.

d: **1.** without water
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G5204](G5204); *waterless*, that is, *dry:* - dry, without water.

d: **1.** unfeigned, undisguised, sincere
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G5271](G5271); *undissembled*, that is, *sincere:* - without dissimulation (hypocrisy), unfeigned.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G5271](G5271)

d:
**1.** not made subject, unsubjected
**2.** that cannot be subjected to control, disobedient, unruly, refractory
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G5293](G5293); *unsubdued*, that is, *insubordinate* (in fact or temper): - disobedient, that is not put under, unruly.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G5293](G5293)

d:
**1.** up, upwards, above, on high
**2.** of the quarters of the heaven, northward
**3.** of countries, inland, up from the coast
**4.** of time, formerly In Gal 4:26 the word could refer to either place or time, i.e. place - the Jerusalem which is above - in the heavens time - the eternal Jerusalem which preceded the earthly one
s: Adverb from [G473](G473); *upward* or *on* *the* *top:* - above, brim, high, up.

d:
**1.** anything above the ground
**2.** a room in the upper part of a house
s: From [G507](G507) and [G1093](G1093); *above* the *ground*, that is, (properly) the *second* *floor* of a building; used for a *dome* or a *balcony* on the upper story: - upper room.

d:
**1.** from above, from a higher place
  **a.** of things which come from heaven or God
**2.** from the first, from the beginning, from the very first
**3.** anew, over again
s: From [G507](G507); *from* *above*; by analogy *from* *the* *first*; by implication *anew:* - from above, again, from the beginning (very first), the top.

d: **1.** upper
s: From [G511](G511); *superior*, that is, (locally) *more* *remote:* - upper.

d:
**1.** higher
  **a.** of motion: to a higher place, up higher
  **b.** of rest: in a higher place, above
s: Comparative degree of [G507](G507); *upper*, that is, (neuter as adverb) to a *more* *conspicuous* place, in a *former* part of the book: - above, higher.

d: **1.** unprofitable, useless
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of [G5624](G5624); *useless* or (neuter) *inutility:* - unprofitable(-ness).
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of [G5624](G5624)

d: **1.** an axe
s: Probably from ἄγνυμι agnumi (to *break*; compare [G4486](G4486)); an *axe:* - axe.

d:
**1.** weighing, having weight, having the weight of another thing of like value, worth as much
**2.** befitting, congruous, corresponding to a thing
**3.** of one who has merited anything worthy
  **a.** both in a good and a bad sense
s: Probably from [G71](G71); *deserving*, *comparable* or *suitable* (as if *drawing* praise): - due reward, meet, \[un-\] worthy.

d:
**1.** to think meet, fit, right
**2.** to judge worthy, deem, deserving
s: From [G514](G514); to *deem* *entitled* or *fit:* - desire, think good, count (think) worthy.

d: **1.** suitably, worthily, in a manner worthy of
s: Adverb from [G514](G514); *appropriately:* - as becometh, after a godly sort, worthily (-thy).

d: **1.** unseen, or that which can not be seen, e.g. invisible
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3707](G3707); *invisible:* - invisible (thing).

d:
**1.** to bring tidings (from a person or a thing), bring word, report
**2.** to proclaim, to make known openly, declare
s: From [G575](G575) and the base of [G32](G32); to *announce:* - bring word (again), declare, report, shew (again), tell.

d:
**1.** to throttle, strangle, in order to put out of the way or kill
**2.** to hang one’s self, to end one’s life by hanging
s: From [G575](G575) and ἄγχω agchō (to *choke*; akin to the base of [G43](G43)); to *strangle* *oneself* *off* (that is, to death): - hang himself.
o: from [G575](G575) and agcho (to choke akin to the base of [G43](G43))

d:
**1.** to lead away
  **a.** esp. of those who are led off to trial, prison, or punishment
s: From [G575](G575) and [G71](G71); to *take* *off* (in various senses): - bring, carry away, lead (away), put to death, take away.

d: **1.** without instruction, and disciple, uneducated, ignorant, rude
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3811](G3811); *uninstructed*, that is, (figuratively) *stupid:* - unlearned.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3811](G3811)

d:
**1.** to lift off, take or carry away
**2.** to be taken away from anyone
s: From [G575](G575) and [G142](G142); to *lift* *off*, that is, *remove:* - take (away).

d: **1.** to ask back, demand back, exact something due
s: From [G575](G575) and [G154](G154); to *demand* *back:* - ask again, require.

d:
**1.** to cease to feel pain or grief
  **a.** to bear troubles with greater equanimity, cease to feel pain at
  **b.** to become callous, insensible to pain, apathetic
s: From [G575](G575) and ἀλγέω algeō (to *smart*); to *grieve* *out*, that is, *become* *apathetic:* - be past feeling.

d:
**1.** to remove, release, to be removed, to depart
**2.** to set free, deliver
s: From [G575](G575) and [G236](G236); to *change* *away*, that is, *release*, (reflexively) *remove:* - deliver, depart.

d:
**1.** to alienate, estrange
**2.** to be shut out from one’s fellowship and intimacy
s: From [G575](G575) and a derivative of [G245](G245); to *estrange* *away*, that is, (passively and figuratively) to *be* *non* *participant:* - alienate, be alien.

d:
**1.** tender
  **a.** of a branch of a tree that is full of sap
s: Of uncertain derivation; *soft:* - tender.

d:
**1.** to go to meet, to meet
  **a.** in a military sense: a hostile meeting
s: From [G575](G575) and a derivative of [G473](G473); to *meet* *away*, that is, *encounter:* - meet.

d: **1.** to meet one
s: From [G528](G528); a (friendly) *encounter:* - meet.

d:
**1.** once, one time
**2.** once for all
s: Probably from [G537](G537); *one* (or a *single*) *time* (numerically or conclusively): - once.

d:
**1.** unviolated, not to be violated, inviolable
**2.** unchangeable and therefore not liable to pass to a successor
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3845](G3845); *not* *passing* *away*, that is, *untransferable* (perpetual): - unchangeable.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3845](G3845)

d: **1.** unprepared
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3903](G3903); *unready:* - unprepared.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a derivative of [G3903](G3903)

d:
**1.** to deny
  **a.** to affirm that one has no acquaintance or connection with someone
  **b.** to forget one’s self, lose sight of one’s self and one’s own interests
s: From [G575](G575) and [G720](G720); to *deny* *utterly*, that is, *disown*, *abstain:* - deny.

d: **1.** from now, henceforth
s: From [G575](G575) and [G737](G737); *from* *now*, that is, *henceforth* (*already*): - from henceforth.

d: **1.** completion
s: From a derivative of [G534](G534); *completion:* - finishing.

d:
**1.** to offer firstlings or firstfruits
**2.** to take away the firstfruits of the productions of the earth which was offered to God. The first portion of the dough, from which sacred loaves were to be prepared. Hence term used of persons consecrated to God for all time.
**3.** persons superior in excellence to others of the same class
s: From a compound of [G575](G575) and [G756](G756); a *beginning* of sacrifice, that is, the (Jewish) *first* *fruit* (figuratively): - first-fruits.

d: **1.** quite, all, the whole, all together, all
s: From [G1](G1) (as a particle of union) and [G3956](G3956); absolutely *all* or (singular) *every* one: - all (things), every (one), whole.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a particle of union) and [G3956](G3956)

d: **1.** to cheat, beguile, deceive
s: Of uncertain derivation; to *cheat*, that is, *delude:* - deceive.

d: **1.** deceit, deceitfulness
s: From [G538](G538); *delusion:* - deceit (-ful, -fulness), deceivableness (-ving).

d: **1.** whose father is not recorded in the genealogies
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3962](G3962); *fatherless*, that is, *of* *unrecorded* *paternity:* - without father.

d:
**1.** reflected brightness
  **a.** of christ in that he perfectly reflects the majesty of God
**2.** effulgence
  **a.** shining forth, of a light coming from a luminous body (Vine)
  **b.** out-raying (Vincent)
s: From a compound of [G575](G575) and [G826](G826); an *off* *flash*, that is, *effulgence:* - brightness.

d:
**1.** to look away from one thing and at another
**2.** to look at from somewhere, either from a distance or from a certain present condition of things
**3.** to perceive
s: From [G575](G575) and the same as [G1492](G1492); to *see* fully: - see.

d: **1.** obstinacy, obstinate opposition to the divine will
s: From [G545](G545); *disbelief* (obstinate and rebellious): - disobedience, unbelief.

d:
**1.** not to allow one’s self to be persuaded
  **a.** to refuse or withhold belief
  **b.** to refuse belief and obedience
**2.** not to comply with
s: From [G545](G545); to *disbelieve* (wilfully and perversely): - not believe, disobedient, obey not, unbelieving.

d: **1.** impersuasible, not compliant, disobedient, contumacious
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3982](G3982); *unpersuadable*, that is, *contumacious:* - disobedient.

d: **1.** to threaten, menace
s: Of uncertain derivation; to *menace*; by implication to *forbid:* - threaten.

d: **1.** a threatening, threat
s: From [G546](G546); a *menace:* - X straitly, threatening.

d: **1.** to go away, depart
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1510](G1510); to *be* *away*: - be absent. Compare [G549](G549).

d: **1.** to go away, depart
s: From [G575](G575) and εἶμι eimi (to *go*); to *go* *away*: - go. Compare [G548](G548).

d:
**1.** to speak out, set forth, declare
**2.** to forbid
**3.** to give up, renounce
s: Reflexive past of a compound of [G575](G575) and [G2036](G2036); to *say* *off* for oneself, that is, *disown:* - renounce.
o: reflexive past of a compound of [G575](G575) and [G2036](G2036)

d: **1.** that can not be tempted by evil, not liable to temptation to sin
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G3987](G3987); *untried*, that is, *not* *temptable:* - not to be tempted.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G3987](G3987)

d: **1.** inexperienced in, without experience of
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G3984](G3984); *inexperienced*, that is, *ignorant:* - unskilful.

d: **1.** assiduously and patiently waiting for
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1551](G1551); to *expect* *fully:* - look (wait) for.

d:
**1.** wholly put off from one’s self
  **a.** denoting separation from what is put off
**2.** wholly to strip off for one’s self (for one’s own advantage)
**3.** despoil, disarm
s: Middle voice from [G575](G575) and [G1562](G1562); to *divest* *wholly* oneself, or (for oneself) *despoil:* - put off, spoil.

d: **1.** a putting off, laying aside
s: From [G554](G554); *divestment:* - putting off.

d: **1.** to drive away, drive off
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1643](G1643); to *dismiss:* - drive.

d: **1.** censure, repudiation of a thing shown to be worthless
s: From a compound of [G575](G575) and [G1651](G1651); *refutation*, that is, (by implication) *contempt:* - nought.

d: **1.** a slave that has been released from servitude, a freeman
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1658](G1658); one *freed* *away*, that is, a *freedman:* - freeman.

d:
Apelles = called
**1.** a certain Christian
s: Of Latin origin; *Apelles*, a Christian: - Apelles.

d:
**1.** nothing despairing
**2.** despairing of no one
**3.** causing no one to despair
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1679](G1679); to *hope* *out*, that is, *fully* *expect:* - hope for again.

d:
**1.** over against, opposite
**2.** in sight of, before
**3.** in opposition to, against
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1725](G1725); *from* *in* *front*, that is, *opposite*, *before* or *against:* - before, contrary, over against, in the presence of.

d: **1.** that can not be passed through, boundless, endless
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of [G4008](G4008); *unfinished*, that is, (by implication) *interminable:* - endless.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a secondary derivative of [G4008](G4008)

d: **1.** without distraction, without solicitude or anxiety or care
s: Adverb from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G4049](G4049); *undistractedly*, that is, *free* *from* (domestic) *solicitude:* - without distraction.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative participle) and a presumed derivative of [G4049](G4049)

d:
**1.** uncircumcised
  **a.** metaph. those whose heart and ears are covered, i.e. whose soul and senses are closed to divine admonition
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G4059](G4059); *uncircumcised* (figuratively): - uncircumcised.
o: from [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of [G4059](G4059)

d:
**1.** to go away, depart
  **a.** to go away in order to follow any one, go after him, to follow his party, follow him as a leader
**2.** to go away
  **a.** of departing evils and sufferings
  **b.** of good things taken away from one
  **c.** of an evanescent state of things
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2064](G2064); to *go* *off* (that is, *depart*), *aside* (that is, *apart*) or *behind* (that is, *follow*), literally or figuratively: - come, depart, go (aside, away, back, out, . . . ways), pass away, be past.

d: **1.** it is sufficient, it is enough
s: Third person singular present indicative active of [G568](G568) used impersonally; *it* *is* *sufficient:* - it is enough.
o: third person singular present indicative active of [G568](G568) used impersonally

d: **1.** to hold one’s self off, refrain, abstain
s: Middle voice (reflexive) of [G568](G568); to *hold* *oneself* *off*, that is, *refrain:* - abstain.

d:
**1.** have
  **a.** to hold back, keep off, prevent
  **b.** to have wholly or in full, to have received
  **c.** it is enough, sufficient
**2.** to be away, absent, distant
**3.** to hold one’s self off, abstain have in Mat 6:2, is modified with a prefix which changes itsmeaning to have in full and was commonly used on business receiptsto mean paid in full. No payment or service was expected to followthe close of the transaction.
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2192](G2192); (active) to *have* *out*, that is, *receive* *in* *full*; (intransitive) to *keep* (oneself) *away*, that is, *be* *distant* (literally or figuratively): - be, have, receive.

d:
**1.** to betray a trust, be unfaithful
**2.** to have no belief, disbelieve
s: From [G571](G571); to *be* *unbelieving*, that is, (transitively) *disbelieve*, or (by implication) *disobey:* - believe not.

d:
**1.** unfaithfulness, faithless
**2.** want of faith, unbelief
**3.** weakness of faith
s: From [G571](G571); *faithlessness*, that is, (negatively) *disbelief* (*want* *of* Christian *faith*), or (positively) *unfaithfulness* (*disobedience*): - unbelief.

d:
**1.** unfaithful, faithless, (not to be trusted, perfidious)
**2.** incredible
  **a.** of things
**3.** unbelieving, incredulous
  **a.** without trust (in God)
s: From [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and [G4103](G4103); (actively) *disbelieving*, that is, *without* Christian *faith* (specifically a *heathen*); (passively) *untrustworthy* (person), or *incredible* (thing): - that believeth not, faithless, incredible thing, infidel, unbeliever (-ing).

d:
**1.** singleness, simplicity, sincerity, mental honesty
  **a.** the virtue of one who is free from pretence and hypocrisy
**2.** not self seeking, openness of heart manifesting itself by generousity
s: From [G573](G573); *singleness*, that is, (subjectively) *sincerity* (*without* *dissimulation* or *self* *seeking*), or (objectively) *generosity* (*copious* *bestowal*): - bountifulness, liberal (-ity), simplicity, singleness.

d:
**1.** simple, single
**2.** whole
**3.** good fulfilling its office, sound
  **a.** of the eye
s: Probably from [G1](G1) (as a particle of union) and the base of [G4120](G4120); properly *folded* *together*, that is, *single* (figuratively *clear*): - single.
o: probably from [G1](G1) (as a particle of union) and the base of [G4120](G4120)

d: **1.** simply, openly, frankly, sincerely
s: Adverb from [G573](G573) (in the objective sense of [G572](G572)); *bountifully:* - liberally.

d:
**1.** of separation
  **a.** of local separation, after verbs of motion from a place i.e. of departing, of fleeing, ...
  **b.** of separation of a part from the whole
    **1.** where of a whole some part is taken
  **c.** of any kind of separation of one thing from another by which the union or fellowship of the two is destroyed
  **d.** of a state of separation, that is of distance
    **1.** physical, of distance of place
    **2.** temporal, of distance of time
**2.** of origin
  **a.** of the place whence anything is, comes, befalls, is taken
  **b.** of origin of a cause
s: A primary particle; *“off”*, that is, *away* (from something near), in various senses (of place, time, or relation; literally or figuratively): - (X here-) after, ago, at, because of, before, by (the space of), for (-th), from, in, (out) of, off, (up-) on (-ce), since, with. In composition (as a prefix) it usually denotes *separation*, *departure*, *cessation*, *completion*, *reversal*, etc.

d:
**1.** to come down from, i.e. a ship
**2.** to turn out, result, to be the outcome
s: From [G575](G575) and the base of [G939](G939); literally to *disembark*; figuratively to *eventuate:* - become, go out, turn.

d: **1.** to throw off, cast away
s: From [G575](G575) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *off*; figuratively to *lose:* - cast away.

d:
**1.** to turn the eyes away from other things and fix them on some one thing
  **a.** to look at attentively
**2.** to look with steadfast mental gaze
s: From [G575](G575) and [G991](G991); to *look* *away* from everything else, that is, (figuratively) intently *regard:* - have respect.

d:
**1.** thrown away, to be thrown away, rejected, despised, abominated
  **a.** as unclean
s: From [G577](G577); *cast* *off*, that is, (figuratively) such as to *be* *rejected:* - be refused.

d:
**1.** rejection, repudiation
  **a.** to throw away from one’s self, cast off, repudiate
**2.** a losing, a loss
s: From [G577](G577); *rejection*; figuratively *loss:* - casting away, loss.

d:
**1.** to be removed from, depart
**2.** to die, to die to anything
s: Past participle of a compound of [G575](G575) and [G1096](G1096); *absent*, that is, *deceased* (figuratively *renounced*): - being dead.
o: past participle of a compound of [G575](G575) and [G1096](G1096)

d:
**1.** a writing off, transcript (from some pattern)
**2.** an enrolment or registration in the public records of persons together with their income and property, as the basis of a census or valuation, i.e. that it might appear how much tax should be levied upon each one
s: From [G583](G583); an *enrollment*; by implication an *assessment:* - taxing.

d:
**1.** to write off, copy (from some pattern)
**2.** to enter in a register or records
  **a.** spec. to enter in public records the names of men, their property and income
  **b.** to enrol
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1125](G1125); to *write* *off* (a copy or list), that is, *enrol:* - tax, write.

d:
**1.** to point away from one’s self, to point out, show forth, to expose to view, exhibit
**2.** to declare, to show, to prove what kind of person anyone is, to prove by arguments, demonstrate
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1166](G1166); to *show* *off*, that is, *exhibit*; figuratively to *demonstrate*, that is, *accredit:* - (ap-) prove, set forth, shew.

d:
**1.** a making manifest, showing forth
**2.** a demonstration, proof
s: From [G584](G584); *manifestation:* - demonstration.

d:
**1.** to give, pay a tithe of anything
**2.** to exact receive a tenth from anyone
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1183](G1183); to *tithe* (as debtor or creditor): - (give, pay, take) tithe.

d: **1.** accepted, acceptable, agreeable
s: From [G588](G588); *accepted*, that is, *agreeable:* - acceptable.

d:
**1.** to accept from, receive
**2.** to accept what is offered from without
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1209](G1209); to *take* *fully*, that is, *welcome* (persons), *approve* (things): - accept, receive (gladly).

d: **1.** to go away into foreign parts, go abroad
s: From [G590](G590); to *go* *abroad*, that is, *visit* *a* *foreign* *land:* - go (travel) into a far country, journey.

d: **1.** away from one’s people, go abroad
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1218](G1218); *absent* *from* one’s own *people*, that is, a *foreign* *traveller:* - taking a far journey.

d:
**1.** to deliver, to give away for one’s own profit what is one’s own, to sell
**2.** to pay off, discharge what is due
  **a.** a debt, wages, tribute, taxes, produce due
  **b.** things promised under oath
  **c.** conjugal duty
  **d.** to render account
**3.** to give back, restore
**4.** to requite, recompense in a good or a bad sense
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1325](G1325); to *give* *away*, that is, *up*, *over*, *back*, etc. (in various applications): - deliver (again), give (again), (re-) pay (-ment be made), perform, recompense, render, requite, restore, reward, sell, yield,

d:
**1.** to disjoin, part, separate from another
**2.** making divisions or separations
s: From [G575](G575) and a compound of [G1223](G1223) and [G3724](G3724); to *disjoin* (by a boundary, figuratively a party): - separate.
o: from [G575](G575) and a compound of [G223](G223) and [G3724](G3724)

d: **1.** to disapprove, reject, repudiate
s: From [G575](G575) and [G1381](G1381); to *disapprove*, that is, (by implication) to *repudiate:* - disallow, reject.

d: **1.** reception, admission, acceptance, approbation
s: From [G588](G588); *acceptance:* - acceptation.

d: **1.** a putting off or away
s: From [G659](G659); a *laying* *aside* (literally or figuratively): - putting away (off).

d:
**1.** a place in which anything is laid by or up
**2.** a storehouse, granary
s: From [G659](G659); a *repository*, that is, *granary:* - barn, garner.

d:
**1.** to put away, lay by in store, to treasure away
**2.** to store up abundance for future use
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2343](G2343); to *treasure* *away:* - lay up in store.

d:
**1.** to press on all sides, squeeze, press hard
  **a.** of pressing out grapes and olives
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2346](G2346); to *crowd* from (every side): - press.

d:
**1.** to die
  **a.** of the natural death of man
  **b.** of the violent death of man or animals
  **c.** to perish by means of something
  **d.** of trees which dry up, of seeds which rot when planted
  **e.** of eternal death, to be subject to eternal misery in hell
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2348](G2348); to *die* off (literally or figuratively): - be dead, death, die, lie a-dying, be slain (X with).

d:
**1.** to restore to its former state
**2.** to be in its former state
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2525](G2525); to *reconstitute* (in health, home or organization): - restore (again).

d:
**1.** to uncover, lay open what has been veiled or covered up
  **a.** disclose, make bare
**2.** to make known, make manifest, disclose what before was unknown
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2572](G2572); to take *off* *the* *cover*, that is, *disclose:* - reveal.

d:
**1.** laying bear, making naked
**2.** a disclosure of truth, instruction
  **a.** concerning things before unknown
  **b.** used of events by which things or states or persons hitherto withdrawn from view are made visible to all
**3.** manifestation, appearance
s: From [G601](G601); *disclosure:* - appearing, coming, lighten, manifestation, be revealed, revelation.

d: **1.** anxious and persistent expectation
s: From a compound of [G575](G575) and a compound of κάρα kara (the *head*) and [G1380](G1380) (in the sense of *watching*); intense anticipation: - earnest expectation.
o: from a comparative of [G575](G575) and a compound of kara (the head) and [G1380](G1380) (in the sense of watching)

d:
**1.** to reconcile completely
**2.** to reconcile back again
**3.** bring back a former state of harmony
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2644](G2644); to *reconcile* *fully:* - reconcile.

d:
**1.** restoration
  **a.** of a true theocracy
  **b.** of the perfect state before the fall
s: From [G600](G600); *reconstitution:* - restitution.

d:
**1.** to be laid away, laid by, reserved
**2.** reserved for one, awaiting him
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2749](G2749); to *be* *reserved*; figuratively to *await:* - be appointed, (be) laid up.

d: **1.** to cut off the head, behead, decapitate
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2776](G2776); to *decapitate:* - behead.

d: **1.** to shut up
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2808](G2808); to *close* *fully:* - shut up.

d: **1.** to cut off, amputate
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2875](G2875); to *amputate*; reflexively (by irony) to *mutilate* (the privy parts): - cut off. Compare [G2699](G2699).

d:
**1.** an answer

s: From [G611](G611) (in its original sense of *judging*); a judicial *decision:* - sentence.
o: from [G611](G611) (in its original sense of judging)

d:
**1.** to give an answer to a question proposed, to answer
**2.** to begin to speak, but always where something has preceded (either said or done) to which the remarks refer
s: From [G575](G575) and κρινω krino; to *conclude* *for* *oneself*, that is, (by implication) to *respond*; by Hebraism (compare \[[H6030](H6030)\]) to *begin* *to* *speak* (where an address is expected): - answer.

d: **1.** a replying, an answer
s: From [G611](G611); a *response:* - answer.

d:
**1.** to hide
**2.** concealing, keeping secret
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2928](G2928); to *conceal* *away* (that is, *fully*); figuratively to *keep* *secret:* - hide.

d:
**1.** hidden, secret
**2.** stored up
s: From [G613](G613); *secret*; by implication *treasured:* - hid, kept secret.

d:
**1.** to kill in any way whatever
  **a.** to destroy, to allow to perish

  **a.** to inflict mortal death
  **b.** to deprive of spiritual life and procure eternal misery in hell
s: From [G575](G575) and κτείνω kteinō (to *slay*); to *kill* outright; figuratively to *destroy:* - put to death, kill, slay.

d:
**1.** to bring forth
  **a.** from the womb
  **b.** give birth to
**2.** produce
s: From [G575](G575) and the base of [G2949](G2949); to *breed* *forth*, that is, (by transformation) to *generate* (figuratively): - beget, bring forth.

d: **1.** to roll off or away This word is used in the Gospels to refer to the stone that was infront of the tomb of Jesus. In Palestine, graves were usually in adepression and the stone was rolled down an incline to cover themouth of the tomb. For a small grave, about twenty men were requiredto roll a stone down hill to cover the door of the tomb. The Bibletells us that the stone covering the door of the tomb was a largestone. The women would have needed more men than even a full Romanguard of sixteen men to roll away the stone. This was a major task.
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2947](G2947); to *roll* *away:* - roll away (back).

d:
**1.** to receive

  **a.** to receive by way of retribution
**3.** to take from others, take apart or aside
**4.** to receive any one hospitably
s: From [G575](G575) and [G2983](G2983); to *receive* (specifically in *full*, or as a host); also to *take* *aside:* - receive, take.

d: **1.** enjoyment

o: from a comparative of [G575](G575) and lauo (to enjoy)

d:
**1.** to leave, to leave behind
**2.** to desert or forsake
s: From [G575](G575) and [G3007](G3007); to *leave* behind (passively *remain*); by implication to *forsake:* - leave, remain.

d: **1.** to lick off, lick up
s: From [G575](G575) and λείχω leichō (to “lick”); to *lick* clean: - lick.

d:
**1.** to destroy
  **a.** to put out of the way entirely, abolish, put an end to ruin
  **b.** render useless
  **c.** to kill
  **d.** to declare that one must be put to death
  **e.** metaph. to devote or give over to eternal misery in hell
  **f.** to perish, to be lost, ruined, destroyed
**2.** to destroy
  **a.** to lose
s: From [G575](G575) and the base of [G3639](G3639); to *destroy* fully (reflexively to *perish*, or *lose*), literally or figuratively: - destroy, die, lose, mar, perish.

d:
Apollyon = Destroyer
**1.** the angel of the bottomless pit, the Destroyer

Apollonia = belonging to Apollo
**1.** a maritime city of Macedonia, about a day’s journey from amphipolis

o: from the pagan deity Apollon (i.e. the sun, from [G622](G622))

d: Apollos =  given by Apollo
s: Probably from the same as [G624](G624); *Apollos*, an Israelite: - Apollos.

d:

**3.** to give a full account of
  **a.** to calculate or consider well

d:
**1.** verbal defence, speech in defence
**2.** a reasoned statement or argument
s: From the same as [G626](G626); a *plea* (“apology”): - answer (for self), clearing of self, defence.

s: From [G575](G575) and [G3068](G3068); to *wash* fully, that is, (figuratively) *have* *remitted* (reflexively): - wash (away).

  **b.** to bid depart, send away

  **a.** a captive i.e. to loose his bonds and bid him depart, to give him liberty to depart

  **c.** indulgently to grant a prisoner leave to depart
  **d.** to release a debtor, i.e. not to press one’s claim against him, to remit his debt

d:
**1.** to wipe off

s: From [G575](G575) and the base of [G3551](G3551); to *apportion*, that is, *bestow:* - give.

d:
**1.** to wash off
**2.** to wash off one’s self, to wash off for one’s self
s: From [G575](G575) and [G3538](G3538); to *wash* *off* (reflexively one’s own hands symbolically): - wash.

d: **1.** to fall off, slip down from
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4098](G4098); to *fall* *off:* - fall.

d:
**1.** to cause to go astray
**2.** to lead away from the truth to error
**3.** to go astray, stray away from
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4105](G4105); to *lead* *astray* (figuratively); passively to *stray* (from truth): - err, seduce.

d: **1.** to sail away, depart by ship, set sail
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4126](G4126); to *set* *sail:* - sail away.

d: **1.** to wash off
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4150](G4150); to *rinse* *off:* - wash.

d:
**1.** to choke
  **a.** to suffocate with water, drown
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4155](G4155); to *stifle* (by drowning or overgrowth): - choke.

d:
**1.** to be without resources, to be in straits, to be left wanting, to be embarrassed, to be in doubt, not to know which way to turn

**3.** not to know how to decide or what to do, to be perplexed
s: From a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of [G4198](G4198); to *have* *no* *way* out, that is, *be* *at* *a* *loss* (mentally): - (stand in) doubt, be perplexed.
o: from a compound of [G1](G1) (as a negative particle) and the base of [G4198](G4198)

d: **1.** the state of one who is in perplexity
s: From the same as [G639](G639); a (state of) *quandary:* - perplexity.

d:
**1.** to throw away, cast down
**2.** to cast one’s self down
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4496](G4496); to *hurl* *off*, that is, *precipitate* (oneself): - cast.

d: **1.** to bereave of a parent or parents
s: From [G575](G575) and a derivative of [G3737](G3737); to *bereave* *wholly*, that is, (figuratively) *separate* (from intercourse): - take.

d:
**1.** to carry off goods and chattels
**2.** to pack up and carry off
**3.** to carry off one’s personal property or provide for its carrying away
s: From [G575](G575) and a derivative of [G4632](G4632); to *pack* *up* (one’s) *baggage:* - take up . . . carriages.

d: **1.** a shade cast by one object on another, a shadow
s: From a compound of [G575](G575) and a derivative of [G4639](G4639); a *shading* *off*, that is, *obscuration:* - shadow.
o: from a compound of [G575](G575) and a derivative of [G4639](G4639)

d: **1.** to draw off, tear away
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4685](G4685); to *drag* *forth*, that is, (literally) *unsheathe* (a sword), or relatively (with a degree of force implied) *retire* (personally or factiously): - (with-) draw (away), after we were gotten from.

d: **1.** a falling away, defection, apostasy
s: Feminine of the same as [G647](G647); *defection* from truth (properly the state), (“apostasy”): - falling away, forsake.

d:
**1.** divorce, repudiation
**2.** a bill of divorce
s: Neuter of a (presumed) adjective from a derivative of [G868](G868); properly something *separative*, that is, (specifically) *divorce:* - (writing of) divorcement.
o: neuter of a (presumed) adj. from a derivative of [G868](G868)

d: **1.** to uncover, take off the roof
s: From [G575](G575) and a derivative of [G4721](G4721); to *unroof:* - uncover.

d:
**1.** to order (one) to go to a place appointed
**2.** to send away, dismiss
  **a.** to allow one to depart, that he may be in a state of liberty
  **b.** to order one to depart, send off
  **c.** to drive away
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4724](G4724); *set* *apart*, that is, (by implication) to *send* *out* (properly on a mission) literally or figuratively: - put in, send (away, forth, out), set \[at liberty\].

d: **1.** to defraud, rob, despoil
s: From [G575](G575) and στερέω stereō (to *deprive*); to *despoil:* - defraud, destitute, kept back by fraud.

d:

  **b.** of consuls with an army, i.e. of an expedition
**2.** a sending away, i.e. a dismissal, release
**3.** a thing sent, esp. of gifts
**4.** in the NT, the office and dignity of the apostles of christ, apostleship

d:
**1.** a delegate, messenger, one sent forth with orders

  **b.** in a broader sense applied to other eminent Christian teachers
    **1.** of Barnabas
    **2.** of Timothy and Silvanus
s: From [G649](G649); a *delegate*; specifically an *ambassador* of the Gospel; officially a *commissioner* of Christ (“apostle”), (with miraculous powers): - apostle, messenger, he that is sent.

d:
**1.** to recite from memory
  **a.** to repeat to a pupil (anything) for him to commit to memory
**2.** to ply with questions, to catechise, and so to entice to answers
s: From [G575](G575) and a (presumed) derivative of [G4750](G4750); to *speak* *off* *hand* (properly *dictate*), that is, to *catechize* (in an invidious manner): - provoke to speak.

d:
**1.** to turn away
  **a.** to remove anything from anyone
  **b.** to turn him away from allegiance to any one
  **c.** tempt to defect
**2.** to turn back, return, bring back
  **a.** of putting a sword back in its sheath
  **b.** of Judas returning money to temple
**3.** to turn one’s self away, turn back, return
**4.** to turn one’s self away from, deserting
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4762](G4762); to *turn* *away* or *back* (literally or figuratively): - bring again, pervert, turn away (from).

d: **1.** to dislike, abhor, have a horror of

d: **1.** excluded from sacred assemblies of Israelites, excommunicated
s: From [G575](G575) and [G4864](G4864); *excommunicated:* - (put) out of the synagogue (-s).

d:
**1.** to set apart, separate
  **a.** to separate one’s self, withdraw one’s self from anyone
