Thecoins were comparatively soft and of course many people shaved themclosely. In one century, more than eighty laws were passed inAthens, to stop the practice of shaving down the coins then incirculation. But some money changers were men of integrity, whowould accept no counterfeit money. They were men of honour who putonly genuine full weighted money into circulation. Such men werecalled dokimos or approved. Donald Barnhouse
s: From [G1380](G1380); properly *acceptable* (*current* after assayal), that is, *approved:* - approved, tried.

d: **1.** a beam
s: From [G1209](G1209) (through the idea of *holding* up); a *stick* of timber: - beam.
o: from [G1209](G1209) (through the idea of holding up)

d: **1.** deceitful
s: From [G1388](G1388); *guileful:* - deceitful.

d: **1.** to deceive, use deceit
s: From [G1386](G1386); to *be* *guileful:* - use deceit.

d: **1.** craft, deceit, guile
s: From δέλλω dellō (an obsolete primary probably meaning to *decoy*; compare [G1185](G1185)); a *trick* (*bait*), that is, (figuratively) *wile:* - craft, deceit, guile, subtilty.
o: from an obsolete primary verb, dello (probably meant to decoy compare [G1185](G1185))

d:
**1.** to ensnare
**2.** to corrupt
s: From [G1388](G1388); to *ensnare*, that is, (figuratively) *adulterate:* - handle deceitfully.

d: **1.** a gift
s: From the base of [G1325](G1325); a *present:* - gift.

d:
**1.** opinion, judgment, view
**2.** opinion, estimate, whether good or bad concerning someone
  **a.** in the NT always a good opinion concerning one, resulting in praise, honour, and glory
**3.** splendour, brightness
  **a.** of the moon, sun, stars
  **b.** magnificence, excellence, preeminence, dignity, grace
  **c.** majesty
    **1.** a thing belonging to God
    **2.** the kingly majesty which belongs to him as supreme ruler, majesty in the sense of the absolute perfection of the deity
    **3.** a thing belonging to christ
  **d.** the kingly majesty of the messiah
  **e.** the absolutely perfect inward or personal excellency of christ; the majesty
    **1.** of the angels
  **f.** as apparent in their exterior brightness
**4.** a most glorious condition, most exalted state
  **a.** of that condition with God the father in heaven to which christ was raised after he had achieved his work on earth
  **b.** the glorious condition of blessedness into which is appointed and promised that true Christians shall enter after their saviour’s return from heaven
s: From the base of [G1380](G1380); *glory* (as very *apparent*), in a wide application (literally or figuratively, objectively or subjectively): - dignity, glory (-ious), honour, praise, worship.

d:
**1.** to think, suppose, be of opinion
**2.** to praise, extol, magnify, celebrate
**3.** to honour, do honour to, hold in honour
**4.** to make glorious, adorn with lustre, clothe with splendour
  **a.** to impart glory to something, render it excellent
  **b.** to make renowned, render illustrious
    **1.** to cause the dignity and worth of some person or thing to become manifest and acknowledged
s: From [G1391](G1391); to *render* (or *esteem*) *glorious* (in a wide application): - (make) glorify (-ious), full of (have) glory, honour, magnify.

d:
Dorcas = gazelle
**1.** the name of a woman Peter raised from the dead
s: *gazelle*; *Dorcas*, a Christian woman: - Dorcas.

d:
**1.** a giving
**2.** a gift
s: From the base of [G1325](G1325); a *giving*; by implication (concretely) a *gift:* - gift, giving.

d: **1.** a giver, bestower
s: From the base of [G1325](G1325); a *giver:* - giver.

d:
**1.** to lead away into slavery, claim as one’s slave
**2.** to make a slave and to treat as a slave i.e. with severity, subject to stern and rigid discipline
s: From a presumed compound of [G1401](G1401) and [G71](G71); to *be* *a* *slave* *driver*, that is, to *enslave* (figuratively *subdue*): - bring into subjection.
o: from a presumed compound of [G1401](G1401) and [G71](G71)

d: **1.** slavery, bondage, the condition of a slave
s: From [G1398](G1398); *slavery* (ceremonially or figuratively): - bondage.

d:
**1.** to be a slave, serve, do service
  **a.** of a nation in subjection to other nations
**2.** metaph. to obey, submit to
  **a.** in a good sense, to yield obedience
  **b.** in a bad sense, of those who become slaves to some base power, to yield to, give one’s self up to
s: From [G1401](G1401); to *be* *a* *slave* to (literally or figuratively, involuntarily or voluntarily): - be in bondage, (do) serve (-ice).

d: **1.** a female slave, bondmaid, handmaid
s: Feminine of [G1401](G1401); a *female* *slave* (involuntarily or voluntarily): - handmaid (-en).

d: Neuter of [G1401](G1401); *subservient:* - servant.
s: Neuter of [G1401](G1401); *subservient:* - servant.

d:
**1.** a slave, bondman, man of servile condition
  **a.** a slave
  **b.** metaph., one who gives himself up to another’s will those whose service is used by christ in extending and advancing his cause among men
  **c.** devoted to another to the disregard of one’s own interests
**2.** a servant, attendant
s: From [G1210](G1210); a *slave* (literally or figuratively, involuntarily or voluntarily; frequently therefore in a qualified sense of *subjection* or *subserviency*): - bond (-man), servant.

d:
**1.** to make a slave of, reduce to bondage
**2.** metaph. give myself wholly to one’s needs and service, make myself a bondman to him
s: From [G1401](G1401); to *enslave* (literally or figuratively): - bring into (be under) bondage, X given, become (make) servant.

d: **1.** a feast, banquet
s: From [G1209](G1209); a *reception*, that is, convivial *entertainment:* - feast.

d: **1.** a dragon, a great serpent, a name for Satan
s: Probably from an alternate form of δέρκομαι derkomai (to *look*); a fabulous kind of *serpent* (perhaps as supposed to *fascinate*): - dragon.
o: probably from an alternate form of derkomai (to look)

d: **1.** to grasp with the hand, take
s: Perhaps akin to the base of [G1404](G1404) (through the idea of *capturing*); to *grasp*, that is, (figuratively) *entrap:* - take.
o: perhaps akin to the base of [G1404](G1404) (through the idea of capturing)

d: **1.** a drachma, a Greek silver coin about the same weight as a Roman denarius
s: From [G1405](G1405); a *drachma* or (silver) coin (as *handled*): - piece (of silver).

d: **1.** a sickle, a pruning-hook, a hooked vine knife, such as reapers and vinedressers use
s: From δρέπω drepō (to *pluck*); a gathering *hook* (especially for harvesting): - sickle.

d:
**1.** a course
  **a.** in the NT figuratively, the course of life or of office
s: From the alternate of [G5143](G5143); a *race*, that is, (figuratively) *career:* - course.

d:
Drusilla = watered by the dew
**1.** the daughter of Agrippa the elder, wife of Felix, the governor of Judaea, a most licentious woman
s: A feminine diminutive of *Drusus* (a Roman name); *Drusilla*, a member of the Herodian family: - Drusilla.
o: a diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name)

d:
**1.** to be able, have power whether by virtue of one’s own ability and resources, or of a state of mind, or through favourable circumstances, or by permission of law or custom
**2.** to be able to do something
**3.** to be capable, strong and powerful
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *be* *able* or *possible:* - be able, can (do, + -not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power.

d:
**1.** strength power, ability
  **a.** inherent power, power residing in a thing by virtue of its nature, or which a person or thing exerts and puts forth
  **b.** power for performing miracles
  **c.** moral power and excellence of soul
  **d.** the power and influence which belong to riches and wealth
  **e.** power and resources arising from numbers
  **f.** power consisting in or resting upon armies, forces, hosts
s: From [G1410](G1410); *force* (literally or figuratively); specifically miraculous *power* (usually by implication a *miracle* itself): - ability, abundance, meaning, might (-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle (-s), power, strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work.

d: **1.** to make strong, confirm, strengthen
s: From [G1411](G1411); to *enable:* - strengthen.

d:
**1.** a prince, a potentate
**2.** a courtier, high officer, royal minister of great authority
s: From [G1410](G1410); a *ruler* or *officer:* - of great authority, mighty, potentate.

d:
**1.** to be powerful or mighty
**2.** show one’s self powerful
**3.** to be able, have power
s: From [G1415](G1415); to *be* *efficient* (figuratively): - be mighty.

d:
**1.** able, powerful, mighty, strong
  **a.** mighty in wealth and influence
  **b.** strong in soul
    **1.** to bear calamities and trials with fortitude and patience
    **2.** strong in Christian virtue
**2.** to be able (to do something)
  **a.** mighty, excelling in something
  **b.** having power for something
s: From [G1410](G1410); *powerful* or *capable* (literally or figuratively); neuter *possible:* - able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power, strong.

d:
**1.** to go into, enter
**2.** go under, be plunged into, sink in
  **a.** used in the NT of the setting of the sun
s: Prolonged forms of an obsolete primary word δύω duō (to *sink*); to *go* “down”: - set.
o: prolonged forms of an obsolete primary duo doo’-o (to sink)

d: **1.** the two, the twain
s: A primary numeral; “two”: - both, twain, two.

d: **1.** prefix conveying the idea of difficulty, opposition, injuriousness, similar to our mis- or un- prefixes
s: A primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation; used only in composition as a prefix; *hard*, that is, *with* *difficulty:* - + hard, + grievous, etc.
o: a primary inseparable particle of uncertain derivation

d: **1.** hard to be borne
s: From [G1418](G1418) and a derivative of [G941](G941); *oppressive:* - grievous to be borne.

d: **1.** dysentery, bowel ailment
s: From [G1418](G1418) and a compound of [G1787](G1787) (meaning a *bowel*); a “dysentery”: - bloody flux.
o: from [G1418](G1418) and a comparative of [G1787](G1787) (meaning a bowel)

d: **1.** hard to interpret, difficult to explain
s: From [G1418](G1418) and a presumed derivative of [G2059](G2059); *difficult* *of* *explanation:* - hard to be uttered.
o: from [G1418](G1418) and a presumed derivative of [G2059](G2059)

d:
**1.** hard to find agreeable food for, fastidious about food
**2.** difficult to please, always finding fault
**3.** difficult
s: From [G1418](G1418) and κόλον kolon (*food*); properly *fastidious* *about* *eating* (*peevish*), that is, (generally) *impracticable:* - hard.

d: **1.** with difficulty
s: Adverb from [G1422](G1422); *impracticably:* - hardly.

d:
**1.** the setting of the sun
**2.** the region of the sunset, the west
s: From [G1416](G1416); the sun *set*, that is, (by implication) the *western* region: - west.

d: **1.** hard to be understood
s: From [G1418](G1418) and a derivation of [G3539](G3539); *difficult* *of* *perception:* - hard to be understood.

d:
**1.** the condition of one who is defamed
  **a.** ill-repute, and the action of one who uses disgraceful language
s: From a compound of [G1418](G1418) and [G5345](G5345); *defamation:* - evil report.

d:
**1.** twelve
  **a.** the twelve apostles of Jesus, so called by way of eminence
s: From [G1417](G1417) and [G1176](G1176); *two* and *ten*, that is, a *dozen:* - twelve.

d: **1.** twelfth
s: From [G1427](G1427); *twelfth:* - twelfth.

d: **1.** the twelve tribes, used collectively of the Israelitish people, as consisting of the twelve tribes
s: From [G1427](G1427) and [G5443](G5443); the *commonwealth* of Israel: - twelve tribes.

d:
**1.** a building, house
**2.** a part of a building, dining room, hall
**3.** house top, roof
  **a.** the house tops of the Orientals were (and still are) level and frequented not only for walking, but also for meditation and prayer
s: From δέμο demō (to *build*); properly an *edifice*, that is, (specifically) a *roof:* - housetop.

d: **1.** a gift
s: From [G1435](G1435); a *gratuity:* - gift.

d: **1.** freely, undeservedly
s: Accusative case of [G1431](G1431) as adverb; *gratuitously* (literally or figuratively): - without a cause, freely, for naught, in vain.

d: **1.** to present, bestow
s: Middle voice from [G1435](G1435); to *bestow* gratuitously: - give.

d: **1.** a gift, bounty, benefaction
s: From [G1433](G1433); a *bestowment:* - gift.

d:
**1.** a gift, present
  **a.** gifts offered in expression of honour
    **1.** of sacrifices and other gifts offered to God
    **2.** of money cast into the treasury for the purposes of the temple and for the support of the poor
**2.** the offering of a gift or of gifts
s: A *present*; specifically a *sacrifice:* - gift, offering.

d: **1.** interjection expressive of indignation, or of wonder mixed with fear, ha! ah!
s: Apparent imperative of [G1439](G1439); properly *let* it *be*, that is, (as interjection) *aha* *!*: - let alone.

d: **1.** if, in case
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G302](G302); a *conditional* particle; *in* *case* that, *provided*, etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote *indefiniteness* or *uncertainty*: - before, but, except, (and) if, (if) so, (what-, whither-) soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to whom, \[who-\] so (-ever). See [G3361](G3361).

d: **1.** himself, herself, itself, themselves
s: (Including all the other cases); from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive (dative or accusative) of [G846](G846); *him* (*her*, *it*, *them*, also \[in conjunction with the personal pronoun of the other persons\] *my*, *thy*, *our*, *your*) -self (-selves), etc.: - alone, her (own, -self), (he) himself, his (own), itself, one (to) another, our (thine) own (-selves), + that she had, their (own, own selves), (of) them (-selves), they, thyself, you, your (own, own conceits, own selves, -selves).
o: from a reflexive pronoun otherwise obsolete and the genitive case (dative case or accusative case) of [G846](G846)

d:
**1.** to allow, permit, let
**2.** to allow one to do as he wishes, not to restrain, to let alone
**3.** to give up, let go, leave
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *let* *be*, that is, *permit* or *leave* alone: - commit, leave, let (alone), suffer. See also [G1436](G1436).

d:
**1.** seventy
  **a.** the seventy disciples whom Jesus sent out in addition to the twelve apostles
s: From [G1442](G1442) and a modified form of [G1176](G1176), *seventy:* - seventy, three score and ten.
o: from [G1442](G1442) and a modified form of [G1176](G1176)

d:
**1.** seventy times seven times
  **a.** countless times
s: Multiple adverb from [G1440](G1440); *seventy* *times:* - seventy times.

d: **1.** seventh
s: Ordinal from [G2033](G2033); *seventh:* - seventh.

d:
Eber or hebrew = the region beyond
**1.** the son of Salah, and great grandson of Shem, one of Abraham’s ancestors
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H5677](H5677)\]; *Eber*, a patriarch: - Eber.

d: **1.** Hebrew
s: From [G1443](G1443); *Hebraic* or the *Jewish* language: - Hebrew.

d:
**1.** Hebrew
  **a.** any one of the Jewish or Israelitish nations
**2.** in a narrower sense, those who live in Palestine and use the language of the country
**3.** all Jewish Christians, whether they spoke Aramaic or Greek
s: From [G1443](G1443); a *Hebraean* (that is, Hebrew) or *Jew:* - Hebrew.

d: **1.** Hebrew, the hebrew language, not that however in which the OT was written but the Chaldee, which at the time of Jesus and the apostles had long superseded it in Palestine
s: From [G1443](G1443); the *Hebraistic* (that is, *Hebrew*) or *Jewish* (*Chaldee*) language: - Hebrew.

d: **1.** in hebrew, i.e. in Chaldee
s: Adverb from [G1446](G1446); *Hebraistically* or in the Jewish (Chaldee) language: - in (the) Hebrew (tongue).

d:
**1.** to bring near, to join one thing to another
**2.** to draw or come near to, to approach
s: From [G1451](G1451); to make *near*, that is, (reflexively) *approach:* - approach, be at hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.

d:
**1.** to engrave, inscribe, write in or on
  **a.** to record, enrol
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1125](G1125); to “engrave”, that is, *inscribe:* - write (in).

d: **1.** a surety, a sponsor
s: From [G1722](G1722) and γυῖον guion (a *limb*); *pledged* (as if *articulated* by a member), that is, a *bondsman:* - surety.

d:
**1.** near, of place and position
  **a.** near
  **b.** those who are near access to God
    **1.** Jews, as opposed to those who are alien from God and his blessings
    **2.** The Rabbis used the term to make nigh as equivalent to to make a proselyte
**2.** of time
  **a.** of times imminent and soon to come pass
s: From a primary verb ἄγχω agchō (to *squeeze* or *throttle*; akin to the base of [G43](G43)); *near* (literally or figuratively, of place or time): - from, at hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.
o: from a primary verb agcho (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of [G43](G43))

d: **1.** nearer
s: Neuter of the compound of [G1451](G1451); *nearer:* - nearer.

d:
**1.** to arouse, cause to rise
  **a.** to arouse from sleep, to awake
  **b.** to arouse from the sleep of death, to recall the dead to life
  **c.** to cause to rise from a seat or bed etc.
  **d.** to raise up, produce, cause to appear
    **1.** to cause to appear, bring before the public
    **2.** to raise up, stir up, against one
    **3.** to raise up i.e. cause to be born
    **4.** of buildings, to raise up, construct, erect
s: Probably akin to the base of [G58](G58) (through the idea of *collecting* one’s faculties); to *waken* (transitively or intransitively), that is, *rouse* (literally from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from death; or figuratively from obscurity, inactivity, ruins, nonexistence): - awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-) rise (again, up), stand, take up.
o: probably akin to the base of [G58](G58) (through the idea of collecting one’s faculties)

d:
**1.** a rousing, excitation
**2.** a rising up
**3.** resurrection from the dead
s: From [G1453](G1453); a *resurgence* (from death): - resurrection.

d:
**1.** secretly to lie in wait, a spy
**2.** one who is bribed by others to entrap a man by crafty words
s: From [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of [G2524](G2524); *subinduced*, that is, surreptitiously *suborned* as a lier in wait: - spy.

d:
**1.** dedication, consecration
  **a.** in particular the annual feast celebrated eight days beginning in the 25th of Chislev (middle of our December), instituted by Judas Maccabaeus \[164 BC\] in memory of the cleansing of the temple from the pollution of Antiochus Epiphanes
s: Neuter plural of a presumed compound from [G1722](G1722) and [G2537](G2537); *innovatives*, that is, (specifically) *renewal* (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption): - dedication.
o: plural of a presumed compound from [G1722](G1722) and [G2537](G2537)

d:
**1.** to renew
**2.** to do anew, again
**3.** to initiate, consecrate, dedication
s: From [G1456](G1456); to *renew*, that is, *inaugurate:* - consecrate, dedicate.

d:
**1.** to come forward as accuser against, bring charge against
**2.** to be accused
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2564](G2564); to *call* *in* (as a debt or demand), that is, *bring* *to* *account* (*charge*, *criminate*, etc.): - accuse, call in question, implead, lay to the charge.

d:
**1.** abandon, desert
  **a.** leave in straits, leave helpless
  **b.** totally abandoned, utterly forsaken
**2.** to leave behind among, to leave surviving
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2641](G2641); to *leave* *behind* *in* some place, that is, (in a good sense) *let* *remain* *over*, or (in a bad one) to *desert:* - forsake, leave.

d: **1.** to dwell among
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2730](G2730); to *settle* *down* *in* a place, that is, *reside:* - dwell among.

d:
**1.** to cut into for the sake of inserting a scion
**2.** to inoculate, ingraft, graft in
s: From [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of [G2759](G2759); to *prick* *in*, that is, *ingraft:* - graff in (-to).

d: **1.** accusation: the crime of which one is accused
s: From [G1458](G1458); an *accusation*, that is, *offence* alleged: - crime laid against, laid to charge.

d: **1.** knot or band by which two things are fastened together, to fasten or gird one’s self
s: Middle voice from [G1722](G1722) κομβόω komboō (to *gird*); to *engirdle* oneself (for labor), that is, figuratively (the apron being a badge of servitude) to *wear* (in token of mutual deference): - be clothed with.
o: middle voice from [G1722](G1722) and komboo (to gird)

d:
**1.** a cutting (made in a road to impede an enemy in pursuit)
**2.** a hindrance
s: From [G1465](G1465); a *hindrance:* - X hinder.

d:
**1.** to cut into, to impede one’s course by cutting off his way
**2.** hinder
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2875](G2875); to *cut* *into*, that is, (figuratively) *impede*, *detain:* - hinder, be tedious unto.

d: **1.** self-control (the virtue of one who masters his desires and passions, esp. his sensual appetites)
s: From [G1468](G1468); *self* *control* (especially *continence*): - temperance.

d:
**1.** to be self-controlled, continent
  **a.** to exhibit self-government, conduct, one’s self temperately
  **b.** in a figure drawn from athletes, who in preparing themselves for the games abstained from unwholesome food, wine, and sexual indulgence
s: Middle voice from [G1468](G1468); to *exercise* *self* *restraint* (in diet and chastity): - can(\[-not\]) contain, be temperate.

d:
**1.** strong, robust
**2.** having power over, possessed of (a thing)
**3.** mastering, controlling, curbing, restraining
  **a.** controlling one’s self, temperate, continent
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2904](G2904); *strong* *in* a thing (*masterful*), that is, (figuratively and reflexively) *self* *controlled* (in appetite, etc.): - temperate.

d:
**1.** to reckon among, judge among
**2.** to judge one worthy of being admitted to a certain class
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2919](G2919); to *judge* *in*, that is, *count* among: - make of the number.

d:
**1.** to conceal in something
**2.** to mingle one thing with another
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2928](G2928); to *conceal* *in*, that is, *incorporate* *with:* - hid in.

d: **1.** big with child, pregnant
s: From [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G2949](G2949); *swelling* inside, that is, *pregnant:* - great with child.

d:
**1.** to rub in, besmirch, anoint
**2.** to anoint one’s self
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5548](G5548); to *rub* *in* (oil), that is, *besmear:* - anoint.

A primary pronoun of the first person, “I” (only expressed when emphatic): - I, me. For the other cases and the plural see [G1691](G1691), [G1698](G1698), [G1700](G1700), [G2248](G2248), [G2249](G2249), [G2254](G2254), [G2257](G2257), etc.
o: a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when emphatic)

d:
**1.** to throw to the ground
  **a.** both of cities and buildings, to raze, level with the earth
  **b.** metaph. of men
s: From [G1475](G1475); to *raze:* - lay even with the ground.

d: **1.** bottom, base, ground
s: From the base of [G1476](G1476); a *basis* (*bottom*), that is, the *soil:* - ground.

d:
**1.** sitting, sedentary
**2.** firm, immovable, steadfast
s: From a derivative of ἕζομαι hezomai (to *sit*); *sedentary*, that is, (by implication) *immovable:* - settled, stedfast.
o: from a derivative of hezomai (to sit)

d: **1.** a stay, prop, support
s: From a derivative of [G1476](G1476); a *support*, that is, (figuratively) *basis:* - ground.

d:
hezekiah = the might of Jehovah
**1.** the twelfth king of Judah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2396](H2396)\]; *Ezekias* (that is, *Hezekiah*), an Israelite: - Ezekias.

d:
**1.** voluntary, arbitrary worship
  **a.** worship which one prescribes and devises for himself, contrary to the contents and nature of faith which ought to be directed to christ
  **b.** said of the misdirected zeal and the practice of ascetics
s: From [G2309](G2309) and [G2356](G2356); *voluntary* (*arbitrary* and *unwarranted*) *piety*, that is, *sanctimony:* - will worship.

d: **1.** to accustomed, usage, custom
s: From [G1485](G1485); to *accustom*, that is, (neuter passive participle) *customary:* - custom.

d: **1.** an ethnarch, one set over a people as ruler, but without the authority and name of a king
s: From [G1484](G1484) and [G746](G746); the *governor* \[not king\] *of* *a* *district:* - ethnarch.

d:
**1.** adapted to the genius or customs of a people, peculiar to a people, national
**2.** suited to the manners or language of foreigners, strange, foreign
**3.** in the NT savouring of the nature of pagans, alien to the worship of the true God, heathenish
  **a.** of the pagan, the Gentile
s: From [G1484](G1484); *national* (“ethnic”), that is, (specifically) a *Gentile:* - heathen (man).

d: **1.** like the Gentiles
s: Adverb from [G1482](G1482); *as* *a* *Gentile:* - after the manner of Gentiles.

d:
**1.** a multitude (whether of men or of beasts) associated or living together
  **a.** a company, troop, swarm
**2.** a multitude of individuals of the same nature or genus
  **a.** the human family
**3.** a tribe, nation, people group
**4.** in the OT, foreign nations not worshipping the true God, pagans, Gentiles
**5.** Paul uses the term for Gentile Christians
s: Probably from [G1486](G1486); a *race* (as of the same *habit*), that is, a *tribe*; specifically a *foreign* (*non-Jewish*) one (usually by implication *pagan*): - Gentile, heathen, nation, people.

d:
**1.** custom
**2.** usage prescribed by law, institute, prescription, rite
s: From [G1486](G1486); a *usage* (prescribed by habit or law): - custom, manner, be wont.

d:
**1.** to be accustomed, used, wont
**2.** that which is wont
**3.** usage, custom
s: A primary verb; to *be* *used* (by habit or conventionality); neuter perfect participle *usage:* - be custom (manner, wont).

d: **1.** if, whether
s: A primary particle of conditionality; *if*, *whether*, *that*, etc.: - forasmuch as, if, that, (\[al-\]) though, whether. Often used in connection or composition with other particles, especially as in [G1489](G1489), [G1490](G1490), [G1499](G1499), [G1508](G1508), [G1509](G1509), [G1512](G1512), [G1513](G1513), [G1536](G1536), and [G1537](G1537). See also [G1437](G1437).

d: **1.** you are, thou art
s: Second parson singular present of [G1510](G1510); thou *art:* - art, be.

d: **1.** if, indeed, inasmuch, as, since
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G1065](G1065); *if* *indeed*, *seeing* *that*, *unless*, (with negative) *otherwise:* - if (so be that, yet).

d: **1.** otherwise, but if not
s: From [G1487](G1487), [G1161](G1161) and [G3361](G3361) (sometimes with [G1065](G1065) added); *but* *if* *not:* - (or) else, if (not, otherwise), otherwise.

d:
**1.** the external or outward appearance, form figure, shape
**2.** form, kind
s: From [G1492](G1492); a *view*, that is, *form* (literally or figuratively): - appearance, fashion, shape, sight.

d:
**1.** to see
  **a.** to perceive with the eyes
  **b.** to perceive by any of the senses
  **c.** to perceive, notice, discern, discover
  **d.** to see
    **1.** i.e. to turn the eyes, the mind, the attention to anything
    **2.** to pay attention, observe
    **3.** to see about something
**2.** i.e. to ascertain what must be done about it
    **1.** to inspect, examine
    **2.** to look at, behold
  **a.** to experience any state or condition
  **b.** to see i.e. have an interview with, to visit
**3.** to know
  **a.** to know of anything
  **b.** to know, i.e. get knowledge of, understand, perceive
    **1.** of any fact
    **2.** the force and meaning of something which has definite meaning
    **3.** to know how, to be skilled in
  **c.** to have regard for one, cherish, pay attention to (1Th 5:12)
s: A primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being borrowed from the equivalent, [G3700](G3700) and [G3708](G3708); properly to *see* (literally or figuratively); by implication (in the perfect only) to *know*: - be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have) known (-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand, wist, wot. Compare [G3700](G3700).

d: **1.** an idol’s temple, temple consecrated to idols
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G1497](G1497); an *image* *fane:* - idol’s temple.

d:
**1.** sacrificed to idols, the flesh left over from the heathen sacrifices
  **a.** it was either eaten at the feasts or sold (by the poor and the miserly) in the market
s: Neuter of a compound of [G1497](G1497) and a presumed derivative of [G2380](G2380); an *image* *sacrifice*, that is, part of an *idolatrous* *offering:* - (meat, thing that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.
o: neuter of a compound of [G1497](G1497) and a presumed derivative of [G2380](G2380)

d:
**1.** the worship of false Gods, idolatry
  **a.** of the formal sacrificial feats held in honour of false Gods
  **b.** of avarice, as a worship of Mammon
**2.** in the plural, the vices springing from idolatry and peculiar to it
s: From [G1497](G1497) and [G2999](G2999); *image* *worship* (literally or figuratively): - idolatry.

d:
**1.** a worshipper of false Gods, a idolater
  **a.** used of any one even Christian, participant in any way in the worship of the heathen, esp. one who attends their sacrificial feasts and eats of the remains of offered victims
**2.** a covetous man as a worshipper of Mammon
s: From [G1497](G1497) and the base of [G3000](G3000); an *image* (*servant* or) *worshipper* (literally or figuratively): - idolater.

d:
**1.** an image, likeness
  **a.** i.e. whatever represents the form of an object, either real or imaginary
  **b.** used of the shades of the departed, apparitions, spectres, phantoms of the mind, etc.
**2.** the image of an heathen God
**3.** a false God
s: From [G1491](G1491); an *image* (that is, for worship); by implication a heathen *god*, or (plural) the *worship* of such: - idol.

d: **1.** to be, to exist, to happen, to be present
s: Optative (that is, English subjunctive) present of [G1510](G1510) (including the other person); *might* (*could*, *would* or *should*) *be:* - mean, + perish, should be, was, were.
o: optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of [G1510](G1510) (including the other person)

d: **1.** even, if, although
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G2532](G2532); *if* *also* (or *even*): - if (that), though.

d:
**1.** inconsiderably, without purpose, without just cause
**2.** in vain
  **a.** without success or effort
s: Probably from [G1502](G1502) (through the idea of *failure*); *idly*, that is, *without* *reason* (or *effect*): - without a cause, (in) vain (-ly.)
o: probably from [G1502](G1502) (through the idea of failure)

d: **1.** twenty
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *score:* - twenty.

d: **1.** to yield
s: Apparently a primary verb; properly to *be* *weak*, that is, *yield:* - give place.

d: **1.** to be like
s: Apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to [G1502](G1502) through the idea of *faintness* as a copy); to *resemble:* - be like.
o: apparently a root word \[perhaps akin to [G1502](G1502) through the idea of faintness as a copy\]

d:
**1.** an image, figure, likeness
  **a.** an image of the things (the heavenly things)
    **1.** used of the moral likeness of renewed men to God
    **2.** the image of the son of God, into which true Christians are transformed, is likeness not only to the heavenly body, but also to the most holy and blessed state of mind, which christ possesses
  **b.** the image of one
    **1.** one in whom the likeness of any one is seen
    **2.** applied to man on account of his power of command
    **3.** to christ on account of his divine nature and absolute moral excellence
s: From [G1503](G1503); a *likeness*, that is, (literally) *statue*, *profile*, or (figuratively) *representation*, *resemblance:* - image.

d: **1.** purity, sincerity, ingenuousness
s: From [G1506](G1506); *clearness*, that is, (by implication) *purity* (figuratively): - sincerity.

d:
**1.** pure, sincere, unsullied
**2.** found pure when unfolded and examined by the sun’s light
s: From εἵλη heilē (the sun’s *ray*) and [G2919](G2919); *judged* *by* *sunlight*, that is, tested as *genuine* (figuratively): - pure, sincere.

d: **1.** to roll up or together
s: A prolonged form of a primary but defective verb εἵλω heilō (of the same meaning); to *coil* or *wrap*: - roll together. See also [G1667](G1667).
o: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb heilo (of the same meaning)

d: **1.** if not, except, but
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G3361](G3361); *if* *not:* - but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till.

d: **1.** unless indeed, except, unless perhaps
s: From [G1508](G1508) and the neuter of [G5100](G5100); *if* *not* *somewhat:* - except.

d: **1.** to be, to exist, to happen, to be present
s: First person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I *exist* (used only when emphatic): - am, have been, X it is I, was. See also [G1488](G1488), [G1498](G1498), [G1511](G1511), [G1527](G1527), [G2258](G2258), [G2071](G2071), [G2070](G2070), [G2075](G2075), [G2076](G2076), [G2771](G2771), [G2468](G2468), [G5600](G5600).
o: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb

d: **1.** to be, to exist, to happen, to be present
s: Present infinitive from [G1510](G1510); *to* *exist:* - am, are, come, is, X lust after, X please well, there is, to be, was.

d: **1.** if indeed, since, if after all
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G4007](G4007); *if* *perhaps:* - if so be (that), seeing, though.

d: **1.** if indeed, since, if after all
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G4458](G4458); *if* *somehow:* - if by any means.

d:
**1.** to make peace
**2.** to cultivate or keep peace, harmony
**3.** to be at peace, live in peace
s: From [G1515](G1515); to *be* (*act*) *peaceful:* - be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.

d:
**1.** a state of national tranquillity
  **a.** exemption from the rage and havoc of war
**2.** peace between individuals, i.e. harmony, concord
**3.** security, safety, prosperity, felicity, (because peace and harmony make and keep things safe and prosperous)
**4.** of the messiah’s peace
  **a.** the way that leads to peace (salvation)
**5.** of Christianity, the tranquil state of a soul assured of its salvation through christ, and so fearing nothing from God and content with its earthly lot, of whatsoever sort that is
**6.** the blessed state of devout and upright men after death
s: Probably from a primary verb εἴρω eirō (to *join*); *peace* (literally or figuratively); by implication *prosperity:* - one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again.
o: probably from a primary verb eiro (to join)

d:
**1.** relating to peace
**2.** peaceable, pacific, loving peace
**3.** bring peace with it, peaceful, salutary
s: From [G1515](G1515); *pacific*; by implication *salutary:* - peaceable.

d: **1.** to make peace, establish harmony
s: From [G1518](G1518); to *be* *a* *peace* *maker*, that is, (figuratively) to *harmonize:* - make peace.

d:
**1.** a peacemaker
**2.** pacific, loving peace
s: From [G1518](G1518) and [G4160](G4160); *pacificatory*, that is, (subjectively) *peaceable:* - peacemaker.

d: **1.** into, unto, to, towards, for, among For (as used in Act 2:38 for the forgiveness...) could have twomeanings. If you saw a poster saying Jesse James wanted forrobbery, for could mean Jesse is wanted so he can commit arobbery, or is wanted because he has committed a robbery. The latersense is the correct one. So too in this passage, the word forsignifies an action in the past. Otherwise, it would violate theentire tenor of the NT teaching on salvation by grace and not by works.
s: A primary preposition; *to* or *into* (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases.: - \[abundant-\] ly, against, among, as, at, \[back-\] ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for \[intent, purpose\], fore, + forth, in (among, at unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-) on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore (-unto), throughout, till, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-) until (-to), . . . ward, \[where-\] fore, with. Often used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs (etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively.

(Including the neuter \[etc.\] ἕν hen); a primary numeral; *one*: - a (-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See also [G1527](G1527), [G3367](G3367), [G3391](G3391), [G3762](G3762).

d:
**1.** to lead in
**2.** to bring in, the place into which not being expressly stated
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G71](G71); to *introduce* (literally or figuratively): - bring in (-to), (+ as to) lead into.

d:
**1.** to give heed to, comply with admonition, to obey
**2.** to listen to, assent to, a request, to be heard, have request granted
  **a.** of persons offering prayers to God
  **b.** of prayers offered up
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G191](G191); to *listen* to: - hear.

d: **1.** to receive kindly, to treat with favour
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G1209](G1209); to *take* *into* one’s favor: - receive.

d: **1.** to go into, enter
s: From [G1519](G1519) and εἶμι eimi (to *go*); to *enter:* - enter (go) into.

d:
**1.** to go out or come in: to enter
  **a.** of men or animals, as into a house or a city
  **b.** of Satan taking possession of the body of a person
  **c.** of things: as food, that enters into the eater’s mouth
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** of entrance into any condition, state of things, society, employment
    **1.** to arise, come into existence, begin to be
    **2.** of men, to come before the public
    **3.** to come into life
  **b.** of thoughts that come into the mind
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G2064](G2064); to *enter* (literally or figuratively): - X arise, come (in, into), enter in (-to), go in (through).

d: **1.** are, be, were, etc.
s: Third person plural present indicative of [G1510](G1510); they *are:* - agree, are, be, dure, X is, were.
o: third person plural present indicative of [G1510](G1510)

d: **1.** one after another
s: From [G1520](G1520) repeated with [G2596](G2596) inserted; *severally:* - one by one.

d: **1.** to call into one’s self, to invite in to one’s house
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G2564](G2564); to *invite* in: - call in.

d:
**1.** an entrance
  **a.** the place or way leading into a place (as a gate)
  **b.** the act of entering
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G3598](G3598); an *entrance* (literally or figuratively): - coming, enter (-ing) in (to).

d: **1.** to spring in, to rush in impetuously
s: From [G1519](G1519) and πηδάω pēdaō (to *leap*); to *rush* *in:* - run (spring) in.

d:
**1.** to go into, enter
  **a.** of persons
  **b.** of things
    **1.** to be carried into or put into
    **2.** as food into a mouth
**2.** metaph. of affections entering the soul
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G4198](G4198); to *enter* (literally or figuratively): - come (enter) in, go into.

d: **1.** to run in
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G5143](G5143); to *hasten* *inward:* - run in.

d:
**1.** to bring into, in or to
**2.** to lead into
s: From [G1519](G1519) and [G5342](G5342); to *carry* *inward* (literally or figuratively): - bring (in), lead into.

d:
**1.** then
**2.** next, after that
s: Of uncertain affinity; a particle of *succession* (in time or logical enumeration), *then*, *moreover*: - after that (-ward), furthermore, then. See also [G1899](G1899).

d:
**1.** if ... if
**2.** whether ... or
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G5037](G5037); *if* *too:* - if, or, whether.

d: **1.** whoever, whatever
s: From [G1487](G1487) and [G5100](G5100); *if* *any:* - he that, if a (-ny) man (‘s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever.

d: **1.** out of, from, by, away from
s: A primary preposition denoting *origin* (the point *whence* motion or action proceeds), *from*, *out* (of place, time or cause; literally or figuratively; direct or remote)*:* - after, among, X are, at betwixt (-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for (-th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, . . . ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth, through, X unto, X vehemently, with (-out). Often used in composition, with the same general import; often of *completion*.
o: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause

d: **1.** each, every
s: As if a superlative of ἕκας hekas (*afar*); *each* or *every:* - any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.
o: as if a superlative of hekas (afar)

d: **1.** at every time, always
s: As if from [G1538](G1538) and [G5119](G5119); at *every* *time:* - always.

d: **1.** a hundred
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *hundred:* - hundred.

d: **1.** centenarian, a hundred years old
s: From [G1540](G1540) and [G2094](G2094); *centenarian:* - hundred years old.

d: **1.** hundredfold, a hundred times as much
s: From [G1540](G1540) and a presumed derivative of [G4111](G4111); a *hundred* *times:* - hundredfold.
o: from [G1540](G1540) and a presumed derivative of [G4111](G4111)

d: **1.** an officer in the Roman army
s: From [G1540](G1540) and [G757](G757); the *captain* *of* *one* *hundred* *men:* - centurion.

d:
**1.** to cast out, drive out, to send out
  **a.** with notion of violence
    **1.** to drive out (cast out)
    **2.** to cast out
  **b.** of the world, i.e. be deprived of the power and influence he exercises in the world
  **c.** a thing: excrement from the belly into the sink
    **1.** to expel a person from a society: to banish from a family
    **2.** to compel one to depart; to bid one depart, in stern though not violent language
    **3.** so employed that the rapid motion of the one going is transferred to the one sending forth
**2.** to command or cause one to depart in haste
    **1.** to draw out with force, tear out
    **2.** with implication of force overcoming opposite force
  **a.** to cause a thing to move straight on its intended goal
    **1.** to reject with contempt, to cast off or away
  **b.** without the notion of violence
    **1.** to draw out, extract, one thing inserted in another
    **2.** to bring out of, to draw or bring forth
    **3.** to except, to leave out, i.e. not receive
    **4.** to lead one forth or away somewhere with a force which he cannot resist
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G906](G906); to *eject* (literally or figuratively): - bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).

d:
**1.** an egress, way out, exit
  **a.** applied figuratively to the way of escape from temptation
**2.** the issue referring to the end of one’s life
  **a.** Heb 13:7 refers not only to end of physical life, but the manner in which they closed a well spent life as exhibited by their spirit in dying
s: From a compound of [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G939](G939) (meaning to *go* *out*); an *exit* (literally or figuratively): - end, way to escape.
o: from a compound of [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G939](G939) (meaning to go out)

d:
**1.** a casting out
**2.** the throwing overboard of goods and lading whereby sailors lighten a ship in a storm to keep her from sinking
s: From [G1544](G1544); *ejection*, that is, (specifically) a *throwing* *overboard* of the cargo: - + lighten the ship.

d:
**1.** to give away in marriage: a daughter
**2.** to marry, to be given in marriage
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a form of [G1061](G1061) (compare [G1548](G1548)); to *marry* *off* a daughter: - give in marriage.

d:
**1.** to give away in marriage: a daughter
**2.** to marry, to be given in marriage
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1061](G1061); the same as [G1547](G1547): - give in marriage.

d:
**1.** sprung from one, born, begotten
**2.** a son, daughter, offspring, children, descendants
**3.** grandchildren
s: Neuter of a derivative of a compound of [G1537](G1537) and [G1096](G1096); a *descendant*, that is, (specifically) *grandchild:* - nephew.
o: neuter of a derivative of a compound of [G1537](G1537) and [G1096](G1096)

d:
**1.** to exhaust by expending, to spend wholly, use up,
**2.** to spend one’s self wholly
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1159](G1159); to *expend* (wholly), that is, (figuratively) *exhaust:* - spend.

d:
**1.** to receive, accept
**2.** to look for, expect, wait for, await
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1209](G1209); to *accept* *from* some source, that is, (by implication) to *await:* - expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

d: **1.** evident, clear, conspicuous
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1212](G1212); *wholly* *evident:* - manifest.

d:
**1.** to go abroad
**2.** emigrate, depart
**3.** to be or live abroad
s: From a compound of [G1537](G1537) and [G1218](G1218); to *emigrate*, that is, (figuratively) *vacate* or *quit:* - be absent.

d:
**1.** to give out of one’s house, power, hand, stores
**2.** to give out, give up, give over
**3.** to let out for hire
**4.** to farm out
**5.** to let out for one’s advantage
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1325](G1325); to *give* *forth*, that is, (specifically) to *lease:* - let forth (out).

d:
**1.** to narrate in full or wholly
**2.** to relate, tell, declare
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a compound of [G1223](G1223) and [G2233](G2233); to *narrate* through wholly: - declare.
o: from [G1537](G1537) and a compound of [G1223](G1223) and [G2233](G2233)

d:
**1.** to vindicate one’s right, do one justice
  **a.** to protect, defend, one person from another
**2.** to avenge a thing
  **a.** to punish a person for a thing
s: From [G1558](G1558); to *vindicate*, *retaliate*, *punish:* - a (re-) venge.

d: **1.** a revenging, vengeance, punishment In 2Co 7:11 -- meeting out of justice; doing justice to allparties. See Luk 18:3, Luk 21:22. The word also has the sense ofacquittal and carries the sense of vindication. - Vincent III p. 329
s: From [G1556](G1556); *vindication*, *retribution:* - (a-, re-) venge (-ance), punishment.

d:
**1.** without law and justice
**2.** exacting penalty from one
  **a.** an avenger, punisher
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1349](G1349); carrying *justice* *out*, that is, a *punisher:* - a (re-) venger.

d:
**1.** to drive out, banish
**2.** to pursue
  **a.** to persecute, oppress with calamities
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1377](G1377); to *pursue* *out*, that is, *expel* or *persecute* implacably: - persecute.

d:
**1.** given over, delivered up
  **a.** to enemies, or to the power, the will, of some one
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of [G1325](G1325); *given* *out* or *over*, that is, *surrendered:* - delivered.

d:
**1.** the act or manner of receiving from
  **a.** reception
  **b.** succession
  **c.** interpretation
  **d.** expectation, waiting
s: From [G1551](G1551); *expectation:* - looking for.

d:
**1.** to take off
  **a.** to strip one of his garments
**2.** to take off from one’s self, to put off the one’s raiments
**3.** fig., to put off the body, the clothing of the soul
s: From [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G1416](G1416); to cause to *sink* *out* of, that is, (specifically as of clothing) to *divest:* - strip, take off from, unclothe.

d: **1.** there, in or to that place
s: Of uncertain affinity; *there*; by extension *thither:* - there, thither (-ward), (to) yonder (place).

d: **1.** thence, from that place
s: From [G1563](G1563); *thence:* - from that place, (from) thence, there.

d: **1.** he, she it, etc.
s: From [G1563](G1563); *that* one (or \[neuter\] thing); often intensified by the article prefixed: - he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), X their, X them, they, this, those. See also [G3778](G3778).

d: **1.** there, at that place
s: From [G1563](G1563); *thither:* - there.

d:
**1.** to seek out, search for
**2.** to seek out, i.e. investigate, scrutinise
**3.** to seek out for one’s self, beg, crave
**4.** to demand back, require
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2212](G2212); to *search* *out*, that is, (figuratively) *investigate*, *crave*, *demand*, (by Hebraism) *worship:* - en- (re-) quire, seek after (carefully, diligently).

d:
**1.** to throw into terror or amazement
  **a.** to alarm thoroughly, to terrify
**2.** to be struck with amazement
  **a.** to be thoroughly amazed, astounded
  **b.** to be struck with terror
s: From [G1569](G1569); to *astonish* utterly: - affright, greatly (sore) amaze.

d:
**1.** quite astonished, amazed
**2.** terrifying, dreadful
**3.** wonder or marvel greatly
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2285](G2285); *utterly* *astounded:* - greatly, wondering.

d: **1.** cast out, exposed
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087); *put* *out*, that is, *exposed* to perish: - cast out.

d: **1.** to cleanse out, clean thoroughly, to cleanse
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2508](G2508); to *cleanse* *thoroughly:* - purge (out).

d:
**1.** to burn out
**2.** to set on fire
**3.** to be kindled, to burn
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2545](G2545); to *inflame* deeply: - burn.

d: **1.** to be utterly spiritless, to be wearied out, exhausted
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2556](G2556); to *be* (*bad* or) *weak*, that is, (by implication) to *fail* (in heart): - faint, be weary.

d:
**1.** to put out, dig out
**2.** to dig through, transfix, pierce
s: From [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G2759](G2759); to *transfix:* - pierce.

d: **1.** to break off, to cut off
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2806](G2806); to *exscind:* - break off.

d:
**1.** to shut out, to turn out of doors
**2.** to prevent the approach of one
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2808](G2808); to *shut* *out* (literally or figuratively): - exclude.

d:
**1.** a gathering of citizens called out from their homes into some public place, an assembly
  **a.** an assembly of the people convened at the public place of the council for the purpose of deliberating
  **b.** the assembly of the Israelites
  **c.** any gathering or throng of men assembled by chance, tumultuously
  **d.** in a Christian sense
    **1.** an assembly of Christians gathered for worship in a religious meeting
    **2.** a company of Christian, or of those who, hoping for eternal salvation through Jesus christ, observe their own religious rites, hold their own religious meetings, and manage their own affairs, according to regulations prescribed for the body for order’s sake
    **3.** those who anywhere, in a city, village, constitute such a company and are united into one body
    **4.** the whole body of Christians scattered throughout the earth
    **5.** the assembly of faithful Christians already dead and received into heaven
s: From a compound of [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of [G2564](G2564); a *calling* *out*, that is, (concretely) a popular *meeting*, especially a religious *congregation* (Jewish *synagogue*, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both): - assembly, church.
o: from a compound of [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of [G2564](G2564)

d:
**1.** to turn aside, deviate (from the right way and course)
**2.** to turn (one’s self) away, to turn away from, keep aloof from one’s society
**3.** to shun one
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2827](G2827); to *deviate*, that is, (absolutely) to *shun* (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to *decline* (from piety): - avoid, eschew, go out of the way.

d: **1.** to swim out of
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2860](G2860); to *escape* by *swimming:* - swim out.

d:
**1.** to carry out
  **a.** a dead man for burial
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2865](G2865); to *bear* *forth* (to burial): - carry out.

d:
**1.** to cut out, cut off
  **a.** of a tree
**2.** metaph. to cut off occasion
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2875](G2875); to *exscind*; figuratively to *frustrate:* - cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder.

d: **1.** to hang from
s: Middle voice from [G1537](G1537) and [G2910](G2910); to *hang* *upon* the lips of a speaker, that is, *listen* *closely:* - be very attentive.

d: **1.** to speak out, divulge
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2980](G2980); to *divulge:* - tell.

d: **1.** to shine forth
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2989](G2989); to *be* *resplendent:* - shine forth.

d:
**1.** to cause to forget
**2.** to forget
s: Middle voice from [G1537](G1537) and [G2990](G2990); to *be* utterly *oblivious* of: - forget.

d:
**1.** to pick out, choose, to pick or choose out for one’s self
  **a.** choosing one out of many, i.e. Jesus choosing his disciples
  **b.** choosing one for an office
  **c.** of God choosing whom he judged fit to receive his favours and separated from the rest of mankind to be peculiarly his own and to be attended continually by his gracious oversight
    **1.** i.e. the Israelites
  **d.** of God the father choosing Christians, as those whom he set apart from the irreligious multitude as dear unto himself, and whom he has rendered, through faith in christ, citizens in the messianic kingdom: (Jas 2:5)
  **e.** so that the ground of the choice lies in christ and his merits only
s: Middle voice from [G1537](G1537) and [G3004](G3004) (in its primary sense); to *select:* - make choice, choose (out), chosen.
o: middle voice from [G1537](G1537) and [G3004](G3004) (in its primary sense)

d:
**1.** fail
  **a.** to leave out, omit, pass by
  **b.** to leave, quit
**2.** to fail
  **a.** to leave off, cease, stop
  **b.** of the failing or eclipse of the light of the sun and the moon
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3007](G3007); to *omit*, that is, (by implication) *cease* (*die*): - fail.

d:
**1.** picked out, chosen
  **a.** chosen by God,
    **1.** to obtain salvation through christ
  **b.** Christians are called chosen or elect of God
    **1.** the messiah in called elect, as appointed by God to the most exalted office conceivable
    **2.** choice, select, i.e. the best of its kind or class, excellence preeminent: applied to certain individual Christians
s: From [G1586](G1586); *select*; by implication *favorite:* - chosen, elect.

d:
**1.** the act of picking out, choosing
  **a.** of the act of God’s free will by which before the foundation of the world he decreed his blessings to certain persons
  **b.** the decree made from choice by which he determined to bless certain persons through christ by grace alone
**2.** a thing or person chosen
  **a.** of persons: God’s elect
s: From [G1586](G1586); (divine) *selection* (abstractly or concretely): - chosen, election.

d:
**1.** to loose, unloose, to set free
**2.** to dissolve, metaph., to weaken, relax, exhaust
  **a.** to have one’s strength relaxed, to be enfeebled through exhaustion, to grow weak, grow weary, be tired out
  **b.** to despond, become faint hearted
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3089](G3089); to *relax* (literally or figuratively): - faint.

d: **1.** to wipe off, to wipe away
s: From [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G3145](G3145); to *knead* *out*, that is, (by analogy) to *wipe* *dry:* - wipe.

d: **1.** to deride by turning up the nose, to sneer at, to scoff at
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3456](G3456); to *sneer* outright at: - deride.

d:
**1.** to bend to one side
**2.** to take one’s self away, to turn one’s self, to avoid a thing
**3.** to swim away, escape by swimming
**4.** to escape, slip away secretly
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3506](G3506); (by analogy) to *slip* *off*, that is, quietly *withdraw:* - convey self away.

d:
**1.** to return to one’s self from drunkenness, become sober
**2.** metaph. to return to soberness of mind
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3525](G3525); (figuratively) to *rouse* (oneself) *out* of stupor: - awake.

d: **1.** voluntary
s: Neuter of a derivative from [G1635](G1635); *voluntariness:* - willingly.

d:
**1.** voluntarily, willingly, of one’s own accord
  **a.** to sin wilfully as opposed to sins committed inconsiderately, and from ignorance or from weakness
s: Adverb from the same as [G1595](G1595); *voluntarily:* - wilfully, willingly.

d:
**1.** from of old
**2.** of a long time
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3819](G3819); *long* *ago*, *for* *a* *long* *while:* - of a long time, of old.

d:
**1.** to prove, test, thoroughly
**2.** to put to proof God’s character and power
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3985](G3985); to *test* *thoroughly:* - tempt.

d: **1.** to send away, send forth
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3992](G3992); to *despatch:* - send away (forth).

d: **1.** to spread out, stretch forth
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a form of [G4072](G4072); to *fly* *out*, that is, (by analogy) *extend:* - stretch forth.

d:
**1.** to fall out of, to fall down from, to fall off
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to fall from a thing, to lose it
  **b.** to perish, to fall
    **1.** to fall from a place from which one cannot keep
    **2.** fall from a position
    **3.** to fall powerless, to fall to the ground, be without effect
  **c.** of the divine promise of salvation
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4098](G4098); to *drop* *away*; specifically *be* *driven* *out* of one’s course; figuratively to *lose*, *become* *inefficient:* - be cast, fail, fall (away, off), take none effect.

d: **1.** to sail from, sail away, depart by ship
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4126](G4126); to *depart* by ship: - sail (away, thence).

d:
**1.** to fill full, to fill up completely
**2.** metaph. to fulfil, make good
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4137](G4137); to *accomplish* entirely: - fulfill.

d: **1.** a completing, fulfilment
s: From [G1603](G1603); *completion:* - accomplishment.

d:
**1.** to strike out, expel by a blow, drive out or away
**2.** to cast off by a blow, to drive out
  **a.** commonly, to strike one out of self-possession, to strike with panic, shock, astonish
**3.** to be struck with amazement, astonished, amazed
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4141](G4141); to *strike* with astonishment: - amaze, astonish.

d: **1.** to breathe out, breathe out one’s life, breathe one’s last, expire
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4154](G4154); to *expire:* - give up the ghost.

d:
**1.** to go forth, go out, depart
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to come forth, to issue, to proceed
    **1.** of feelings, affections, deeds, sayings
  **b.** to flow forth
    **1.** of a river
  **c.** to project, from the mouth of one
  **d.** to spread abroad, of a rumour
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4198](G4198); to *depart*, *be* *discharged*, *proceed*, *project:* - come (forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).

d: **1.** to go a whoring, give one’s self over to fornication
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4203](G4203); to *be* *utterly* *unchaste:* - give self over to fornication.

d:
**1.** to spit out
**2.** reject, spurn, loathe
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4429](G4429); to *spit* *out*, that is, (figuratively) *spurn:* - reject.

d: **1.** to root out, pluck up by the roots
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4492](G4492); to *uproot:* - pluck up by the root, root up.

d:
**1.** any casting down of a thing from its proper place or state, displacement
**2.** a throwing of the mind out of its normal state, alienation of mind, whether such as makes a lunatic or that of a man who by some sudden emotion is transported as it were out of himself, so that in this rapt condition, although he is awake, his mind is drawn off from all surrounding objects and wholly fixed on things divine that he sees nothing but the forms and images lying within, and thinks that he perceives with his bodily eyes and ears realities shown him by God.
**3.** amazement, the state of one who, either owing to the importance or the novelty of an event, is thrown into a state of blended fear and wonderment
s: From [G1839](G1839); a *displacement* of the mind, that is, *bewilderment*, “ecstasy”: - + be amazed, amazement, astonishment, trance.

d:
**1.** to turn or twist out, tear up
**2.** to turn inside out, invert
**3.** to change for the worse, pervert, corrupt
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G4762](G4762); to *pervert* (figuratively): - subvert.

d: **1.** to agitate, trouble, exceedingly
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5015](G5015); to *disturb* *wholly:* - exceedingly trouble.

d:
**1.** to stretch out, stretch forth
  **a.** over, towards, against one
s: From [G1537](G1537) and τείνω teinō (to *stretch*); to *extend:* - cast, put forth, stretch forth (out).

d: **1.** to finish, complete
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5055](G5055); to *complete* fully: - finish.

d:
**1.** extension
**2.** intentness (of mind), earnestness
s: From [G1618](G1618); *intentness:* - X instantly.

d: **1.** more intently, more earnestly
s: Neuter of the compound of [G1618](G1618); *more* *intently:* - more earnestly.

d:
**1.** stretched out
**2.** metaph. intent, earnestly, assiduously
s: From [G1614](G1614); *intent:* - without ceasing, fervent.

d: **1.** earnestly, fervently, intensely From a verb which means to stretch out the hand., thus it means tobe stretched out -- earnest, resolute, tense.
s: Adverb from [G1618](G1618); *intently:* - fervently.

d:
**1.** to place or set out, put outside, expose
**2.** to set up, exhibit
**3.** metaph. to set forth, declare, expound
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5087](G5087); to *expose*; figuratively to *declare:* - cast out, expound.

d:
**1.** to shake off so that something adhering shall fall
  **a.** by this symbolic act a person, expresses extreme contempt for another and refuses to have any further dealings with him
  **b.** to shake off for (the cleansing of) one’s self
s: From [G1537](G1537) and τινάσσω tinassō (to *swing*); to *shake* violently: - shake (off).

d:
**1.** outside, beyond
**2.** the outside, exterior
**3.** outside of
**4.** beyond, besides, except
s: From [G1537](G1537); the *exterior*; figuratively (as a preposition) *aside* *from*, *besides:* - but, except (-ed), other than, out of, outside, unless, without.

d: **1.** the sixth
s: Ordinal from [G1803](G1803); *sixth:* - sixth.

d:
**1.** to turn or twist out
  **a.** in a medical sense used of dislocated limbs
**2.** to turn off or aside
**3.** to be turned aside
**4.** to turn aside
**5.** to turn away from, to shun a thing, to avoid meeting or associating with one
s: From [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G5157](G5157); to *deflect*, that is, *turn* *away* (literally or figuratively): - avoid, turn (aside, out of the way).

d:
**1.** to nourish up to maturity, to nourish
**2.** to nurture, bring up
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5142](G5142); to *rear* *up* to maturity, that is, (generally) to *cherish* or *train:* - bring up, nourish.

d:
**1.** an abortion, abortive birth
**2.** an untimely birth
s: From a compound of [G1537](G1537) and τιτρώσκω titrōskō (to *wound*); a *miscarriage* (*abortion*), that is, (by analogy) *untimely* *birth:* - born out of due time.
o: from a comparative of [G1537](G1537) and titrosko (to wound)

d:
**1.** to carry out, to bear forth
  **a.** the dead for burial
**2.** to bring i.e. lead out
**3.** to bring forth, i.e. produce
  **a.** of the earth bearing plants
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5342](G5342); to *bear* *out* (literally or figuratively): - bear, bring forth, carry forth (out).

d:
**1.** to flee out of, flee away
  **a.** to seek safety in flight
  **b.** to escape
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5343](G5343); to *flee* *out:* - escape, flee.

d:
**1.** to frighten away, to terrify
**2.** to throw into violent flight
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5399](G5399); to *frighten* *utterly:* - terrify.

d: **1.** stricken with fear or terror, exceedingly, frightened, terrified
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5401](G5401); *frightened* *out* of one’s wits: - sore afraid, exceedingly fear.

d:
**1.** to generate or produce from
**2.** to cause to grow out
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5453](G5453); to *sprout* *up:* - put forth.

d:
**1.** to pour out, shed forth
**2.** metaph. to bestow or distribute largely
s: From [G1537](G1537) and χέω cheō (to *pour*); to *pour* *forth*; figuratively to *bestow:* - gush (pour) out, run greedily (out), shed (abroad, forth), spill.

d:
**1.** to depart from
**2.** to remove from in the sense of fleeing from
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5562](G5562); to *depart:* - depart out.

d: **1.** to expire, to breathe out one’s life
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5594](G5594); to *expire:* - give (yield) up the ghost.

d:
**1.** unforced, voluntary, willing
**2.** of one’s own will
**3.** of one’s own accord
s: Of uncertain affinity; *voluntary:* - willingly.

d:
**1.** an olive tree
**2.** an olive, the fruit of an olive tree
s: Feminine of a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary; an *olive* (the tree or the fruit): - olive (berry, tree).
o: from a presumed derivative from an obsolete primary

d:
**1.** olive oil
  **a.** for fuel for lamps
  **b.** for healing the sick
  **c.** for anointing the head and body at feasts
  **d.** mentioned among articles of commerce
s: Neuter of the same as [G1636](G1636); olive *oil:* - oil.

d:
**1.** an olive orchard, a place planted with olive trees
  **a.** Mount of Olives
s: From [G1636](G1636); an *olive* *orchard*, that is, (specifically) the *Mount* *of* *Olives:* - Olivet.

d: **1.** an Elamite, i.e. an inhabitant of the province of Elymais, a region stretching southwards to the Persian Gulf, but boundaries of which are variously given
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H5867](H5867)\]; an *Elamite* or Persian: - Elamite.

d:
**1.** less
  **a.** in age (younger)
  **b.** in rank
  **c.** in excellence, worse
s: Compound of the same as [G1646](G1646); *smaller* (in size, quantity, age or quality): - less, under, worse, younger.

d:
**1.** to be less, inferior, (in possessions)
**2.** to make less, diminish
s: From [G1640](G1640); to *diminish*, that is, *fall* *short:* - have lack.

d:
**1.** to make less or inferior: in dignity
**2.** to be made less or inferior: in dignity
**3.** to decrease in authority or popularity
s: From [G1640](G1640); to *lessen* (in rank or influence): - decrease, make lower.

d:
**1.** to drive
  **a.** of the wind driving ships or clouds
  **b.** of sailors propelling a vessel by oars, to row
  **c.** to be carried in a ship, to sail
  **d.** of demons driving to some place the men whom they possess
s: A prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an alternate of this) of uncertain affinity; to *push* (as wind, oars or daemoniacal power): - carry, drive, row.
o: a prolonged form of a primary verb (obsolete except in certain tenses as an altern. of this) of uncertain affin

d:
**1.** lightness
  **a.** used of levity and fickleness of mind
s: From [G1645](G1645); *levity* (figuratively), that is, *fickleness:* - lightness.

d: **1.** light in weight, quick, agile
s: Probably akin to [G1643](G1643) and the base of [G1640](G1640); *light*, that is, *easy:* - light.
o: probably akin to [G1643](G1643) and the base of [G1640](G1640)

d:
**1.** smallest least
  **a.** in size
  **b.** in amount: of management of affairs
  **c.** in importance: what is the least moment
  **d.** in authority: of commandments
  **e.** in the estimation of men: of persons
  **f.** in rank and excellence: of persons
s: The superlative of ἔλαχυς elachus (*short*); used as equivalent to [G3398](G3398); *least* (in size, amount, dignity, etc.): - least, very little (small), smallest.
o: superlative of elachus (short); used as equivalent to [G3398](G3398)

d: **1.** less than the least, lower the lowest
s: Compound of [G1646](G1646); *far* *less:* - less than the least.

d:
Eleazar = help of God
**1.** one of the ancestors of christ
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H499](H499)\]; *Eleazar*, an Israelite: - Eleazar.

d: **1.** refutation, rebuke
s: From [G1651](G1651); *refutation*, that is, *reproof:* - rebuke.

d:
**1.** a proof, that by which a thing is proved or tested
**2.** conviction
s: From [G1651](G1651); *proof*, *conviction:* - evidence, reproof.

d:
**1.** to convict, refute, confute
  **a.** generally with a suggestion of shame of the person convicted
  **b.** by conviction to bring to the light, to expose
**2.** to find fault with, correct
  **a.** by word
    **1.** to reprehend severely, chide, admonish, reprove
    **2.** to call to account, show one his fault, demand an explanation
  **b.** by deed
    **1.** to chasten, to punish
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *confute*, *admonish:* - convict, convince, tell a fault, rebuke, reprove.

d: **1.** to be pitied, miserable
s: From [G1656](G1656); *pitiable:* - miserable.

d:
**1.** to have mercy on
**2.** to help one afflicted or seeking aid
**3.** to help the afflicted, to bring help to the wretched
**4.** to experience mercy
s: From [G1656](G1656); to *compassionate* (by word or deed, specifically by divine grace): - have compassion (pity on), have (obtain, receive, shew) mercy (on).

d:
**1.** mercy, pity
  **a.** esp. as exhibited in giving alms, charity
**2.** the benefaction itself, a donation to the poor, alms
s: From [G1656](G1656); *compassionateness*, that is, (as exercised towards the poor) *beneficence*, or (concretely) a *benefaction:* - alms (-deeds).

d: **1.** merciful
s: From [G1653](G1653); *compassionate* (actively): - merciful.

d:
**1.** mercy: kindness or good will towards the miserable and the afflicted, joined with a desire to help them
  **a.** of men towards men: to exercise the virtue of mercy, show one’s self merciful
  **b.** of God towards men: in general providence; the mercy and clemency of God in providing and offering to men salvation by christ
  **c.** the mercy of christ, whereby at his return to judgment he will bless true Christians with eternal life
s: Of uncertain affinity; *compassion* (human or divine, especially active): - (+ tender) mercy.

d:
**1.** liberty to do or to omit things having no relationship to salvation
**2.** fancied liberty
  **a.** licence, the liberty to do as one pleases
**3.** true liberty is living as we should not as we please
s: From [G1658](G1658); *freedom* (legitimate or licentious, chiefly moral or ceremonial): - liberty.

d:
**1.** freeborn
  **a.** in a civil sense, one who is not a slave
  **b.** of one who ceases to be a slave, freed, manumitted
**2.** free, exempt, unrestrained, not bound by an obligation
**3.** in an ethical sense: free from the yoke of the Mosaic Law
s: Probably from the alternate of [G2064](G2064); *unrestrained* (to *go* at pleasure), that is, (as a citizen) *not* *a* *slave* (whether *freeborn* or *manumitted*), or (generally) *exempt* (from obligation or liability): - free (man, woman), at liberty.

d:
**1.** to make free
**2.** set at liberty: from the dominion of sin
s: From [G1658](G1658); to *liberate*, that is, (figuratively) to *exempt* (from moral, ceremonial or mortal liability): - deliver, make free.

d: **1.** a coming, advent
s: From the alternate of [G2064](G2064); an *advent:* - coming.

d: **1.** of ivory
s: From ἔλεφας elephas (an “elephant”); *elephantine*, that is, (by implication) composed of *ivory:* - of ivory.

d:
Eliakim = raising up by God
**1.** the eldest son of Abiud or Judah, bother of Joseph, and father of Azor Mat 1:13
**2.** son of melea, and father of Jonan Luk 3:30, Luk 3:31
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H471](H471)\]; *Eliakim*, an Israelite: - Eliakim.

d:
Eliezer = God is his help
**1.** the son of Jorim, in the genealogy of christ. Luk 3:29
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H461](H461)\]; *Eliezer*, an Israelite: - Eliezer.

d:
Eliud = God his Praise
**1.** the son of Achim in the genealogy of christ. Mat 1:15
s: Of Hebrew origin (\[[H410](H410)\] and \[[H1935](H1935)\]); *God* *of* *majesty*; *Eliud*, an Israelite: - Eliud.

d:
Elisabeth = oath of God
**1.** the wife of Zacharias and mother of John the Baptist, of the priestly family, and a relative of Mary, Luk 1:36
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H472](H472)\]; *Elisabet*, an Israelitess: - Elisabeth.

d:
Eliseus or Elisha = God his salvation
**1.** a distinguished OT prophet, the disciple, companion, and successor of Elijah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H477](H477)\]; *Elissaeus*, an Israelite: - Elissus.

d: **1.** to roll up, fold together
s: A form of [G1507](G1507); to *coil* or *wrap:* - fold up.

d:
**1.** a wound, esp. a wound producing a discharge pus
**2.** a sore, an ulcer
s: Probably from [G1670](G1670); an *ulcer* (as if drawn together): - sore.

d:
**1.** to make sore, cause to ulcerate
**2.** to be ulcerated
**3.** full of sores
s: From [G1668](G1668); to *cause* *to* *ulcerate*, that is, (passively) *be* *ulcerous:* - full of sores.

d:
**1.** to draw, drag off
**2.** metaph., to draw by inward power, lead, impel
s: Probably akin to [G138](G138); to *drag* (literally or figuratively): - draw. Compare [G1667](G1667).

d:
Greece = unstable: the miry one
**1.** a country in southern Europe
s: Of uncertain affinity; *Hellas* (or *Greece*), a country of Europe: - Greece.

d:
**1.** a Greek either by nationality, whether a native of the main land or of the Greek islands or colonies
**2.** in a wider sense the name embraces all nations not Jews that made the language, customs, and learning of the Greeks their own; the primary reference is to a difference of religion and worship
s: From [G1671](G1671); a *Hellen* (*Grecian*) or inhabitant of Hellas; by extension a *Greek* *speaking* person, especially a *non-Jew:* - Gentile, Greek.

d: **1.** a Grecian
s: From [G1672](G1672); *Hellenic*, that is, *Grecian* (in language): - Greek.

d:
**1.** a Greek women
**2.** a Gentile women, not a Jewess
s: Feminine of [G1672](G1672); a *Grecian* (that is, *non-Jewish*) woman: - Greek.

d:
**1.** a hellenist
  **a.** one who imitates the manners and customs or the worship of the Greeks, and use the Greek tongue
  **b.** used in the NT of Jews born in foreign lands and speaking Greek
s: From a derivative of [G1672](G1672); a *Hellenist* or Greek speaking Jew: - Grecian.

d: **1.** in Greek, the Greek language
s: Adverb from the same as [G1675](G1675); *Hellenistically*, that is, in the Grecian language: - Greek.

d: **1.** to reckon in, set to one’s account, lay to one’s charge, impute
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3056](G3056) (in the sense of *account*); to *reckon* *in*, that is, *attribute:* - impute, put on account.
o: from [G1722](G1722) and [G3056](G3056) (in the sense of account)

d:
Elmodam = measure
**1.** son of Er, in the genealogy of Joseph, Luk 3:28
s: Of Hebrew origin (perhaps for \[[H486](H486)\]); *Elmodam*, an Israelite: - Elmodam.

d:
**1.** to hope
  **a.** in a religious sense, to wait for salvation with joy and full confidence
**2.** hopefully to trust in
s: From [G1680](G1680); to *expect* or *confide:* - (have, thing) hope (-d) (for), trust.

d:
**1.** expectation of evil, fear
**2.** expectation of good, hope
  **a.** in the Christian sense
    **1.** joyful and confident expectation of eternal salvation
**3.** on hope, in hope, having hope
  **a.** the author of hope, or he who is its foundation
  **b.** the thing hoped for
s: Fromἔλπω elpō which is a primary word (to *anticipate*, usually with pleasure); *expectation* (abstract or concrete) or *confidence:* - faith, hope.
o: from a primary elpo (to anticipate, usually with pleasure)

d:
Elymas = a wise man
**1.** the Arabic name of the Jewish magnus or sorcerer Barjesus, Act 13:6
s: Of foreign origin; *Elymas*, a wizard: - Elymas.

d:
Eloi = my God
**1.** Aramaic for the phrase my God
s: Of Chaldee origin (\[[H426](H426)\] with pronoun suffix); *my* *God:* - Eloi.
o: of Aramaic origin, [G426](G426) with pronominal stuff.

d: **1.** I, me, myself etc.
s: Genitive, dative and accusative of a compound of [G1700](G1700) and [G846](G846); *of* *myself:* - me, mine own (self), myself.

d: **1.** to go into, step into
s: From [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G939](G939); to *walk* *on*, that is, *embark* (aboard a vessel), *reach* (a pool): - come (get) into, enter (into), go (up) into, step in, take ship.

d: **1.** to throw in, cast into
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *on*, that is, (figuratively) *subject* *to* (eternal punishment): - cast into.

d: **1.** to dip in
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G911](G911); to *whelm* *on*, that is, *wet* (a part of the person, etc.) by contact with a fluid: - dip.

d:
**1.** to enter, to frequent, haunt
  **a.** often of the Gods frequenting favourite sports
  **b.** often to come into possession of a thing
  **c.** to invade, make hostile incursion into
**2.** to enter
  **a.** to go into details in narrating
  **b.** to investigate, search into, scrutinise minutely
s: From [G1722](G1722) and a presumed derivative of the base of [G939](G939); equivalent to [G1684](G1684); to *intrude* *on* (figuratively): - intrude into.
o: from [G1722](G1722) and a presumed derivative of the base of [G939](G939)

d: **1.** to put in or on, lead in, cause to enter
s: From [G1722](G1722) and βιβάζω bibazō (to *mount*; causative of [G1684](G1684)); to *place* *on*, that is, *transfer* (aboard a vessel): - put in.
o: from [G1722](G1722) and bibazo (to mount, causative of [G1684](G1684))

d:
**1.** to turn one’s eyes on
**2.** look at
**3.** metaph. to look at with the mind, to consider
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G991](G991); to *look* *on*, that is, (relatively) to *observe* fixedly, or (absolutely) to *discern* clearly: - behold, gaze up, look upon, (could) see.

d: **1.** to charge with earnest admonition, sternly to charge, threatened to enjoin
s: From [G1722](G1722) and βριμάομαι brimaomai (to *snort* with anger); to have *indignation* *on*, that is, (transitively) to *blame*, (intransitively) to *sigh* with chagrin, (specifically) to sternly *enjoin:* - straitly charge, groan, murmur against.
o: from [G1722](G1722) and brimaomai (to snort with anger)

d: **1.** I, me, myself, etc.
s: A prolonged form of [G3165](G3165); *me:* - I, me, my (-self).

d: **1.** to vomit, vomit forth, throw up
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *vomit:* - (will) spue.

d: **1.** to rage against one
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3105](G3105); to *rave* *on*, that is, *rage* *at:* - be mad against.

d:
Emmanuel = God with us
**1.** the title applied to the messiah, born of the virgin, Mat 1:23, Isa 7:14, because Jesus was God united with man, and showed that God was dwelling with man
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H6005](H6005)\]; *God* *with* *us*; *Emmanuel*, a name of Christ: - Emmanuel.

d:
Emmaus = warm baths
**1.** the village to which the two disciples were going when our Lord appeared to them on the way, on the day of resurrection. Luk 24:13. Luke makes its distance from Jerusalem, sixty stadia, or 7.5 miles (12 km); and Josephus mentions a village called Emmaus at the same distance. The site of Emmaus remains yet to be identified.
s: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H3222](H3222)\]); *Emmaus*, a place in Palestine: - Emmaus.

d:
**1.** to remain in, continue
**2.** to persevere in anything, a state of mind etc.
**3.** to hold fast, to be true to, abide by, keep
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3306](G3306); to *stay* *in* the same place, that is, (figuratively) to *persevere:* - continue.

d:
Emmor = an ass
**1.** the father of Sychem, Act 7:16
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2544](H2544)\]; *Emmor* (that is, *Chamor*), a Canaanite: - Emmor.

d: **1.** I, me, myself, etc.
s: A prolonged form of [G3427](G3427); *to* *me:* - I, me, mine, my.

d: **1.** my, mine, etc.
s: From the oblique cases of [G1473](G1473) ([G1698](G1698), [G1700](G1700), [G1691](G1691)); *my:* - of me, mine (own), my.

d: **1.** me, my, mine, etc.
s: A prolonged form of [G3449](G3449); *of* *me:* - me, mine, my.

d: **1.** a mocking, scoffing
