s: From [G1702](G1702); *derision:* - mocking.

d:
**1.** to play with, trifle with
  **a.** to mock
  **b.** to delude, deceive
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3815](G3815); to *jeer* *at*, that is, *deride:* - mock.

d: **1.** a mocker, a scoffer
s: From [G1702](G1702); a *derider*, that is, (by implication) a *false* *teacher:* - mocker, scoffer.

d: **1.** to go about in, walk in
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G4043](G4043); to *perambulate* *on* a place, that is, (figuratively) to *be* *occupied* *among* persons: - walk in.

d:
**1.** to fill up, fill full
**2.** to take one’s fill of, glut one’s desire for, satisfy, satiate
s: From [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G4118](G4118); to *fill* *in* (*up*), that is, (by implication) to *satisfy* (literally or figuratively): - fill.

d:
**1.** to fall into
  **a.** to fall among robbers
  **b.** fall into one’s power
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G4098](G4098); to *fall* *on*, that is, (literally) *be* *entrapped* *by*, or (figuratively) *be* *overwhelmed* *with:* - fall among (into).

d:
**1.** to inweave
**2.** of a thing: to entangle, involve in
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G4120](G4120); to *entwine*, that is, (figuratively) *involve* with: - entangle (in, self with).

d:
**1.** an interweaving, braiding, a knot
**2.** an elaborate gathering of one’s hair into knots
s: From [G1707](G1707); elaborate *braiding* of the hair: - plaiting.

d:
**1.** to breathe in or on
**2.** to inhale
  **a.** threatenings and slaughter were so to speak the element from which he drew his breath
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G4154](G4154); to *inhale*, that is, (figuratively) to *be* *animated* *by* (*bent* *upon*): - breathe.

d:
**1.** to go a trading, to travel for business, to traffic, trade
**2.** of a thing, to import for sale
**3.** to deal in
**4.** to use a person or a thing for gain
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G4198](G4198); to *travel* *in* (a country as a pedlar), that is, (by implication) to *trade:* - buy and sell, make merchandise.

d: **1.** trade, merchandise
s: Feminine from [G1713](G1713); *traffic:* - merchandise.

d:
**1.** a place were trade is carried on, esp. a seaport
  **a.** a mart, an emporium
s: Neuter from [G1713](G1713); a *mart* (“emporium”): - merchandise.

d:
**1.** one on a journey, whether by sea or by land, esp. for trade
**2.** a merchant as opposed to a retailer or petty tradesman
s: From [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G4198](G4198); a (wholesale) *tradesman:* - merchant.

d:
**1.** to burn
**2.** destroy by fire
s: From [G1722](G1722) and πρήθω prēthō (to *blow* a flame); to *enkindle*, that is, *set* *on* *fire:* - burn up.
o: from [G1722](G1722) and pretho (to blow a flame)

d:
**1.** in front, before
  **a.** before, i.e. in that local region which is in front of a person or thing
  **b.** before, in the presence of, i.e. opposite to, over against one
  **c.** before, in the sight of
  **d.** before, denoting rank
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G4314](G4314); *in* *front* *of* (in place \[literally or figuratively\] or time): - against, at, before, (in presence, sight) of.

d: **1.** to spit upon
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G4429](G4429); to *spit* *at* or *on:* - spit (upon).

d:
**1.** manifest
  **a.** fig. of God giving proofs of his saving grace and thus manifesting himself
s: From a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G5316](G5316); *apparent* *in* self: - manifest, openly.

d:
**1.** to manifest, exhibit to view
**2.** to show one’s self, come to view, appear, be manifest
**3.** to indicate, disclose, declare, make known
s: From [G1717](G1717); to *exhibit* (in person) or *disclose* (by words): - appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.

d: **1.** thrown into fear, terrified, affrighted
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5401](G5401); *in* *fear*, that is, *alarmed:* - affrighted, afraid, tremble.

d: **1.** to blow or breathe upon. This word used only once by the LXX translators in Gen 2:7 where God breathed on Adam and he became a living soul. Just as the original creation was completed by an act of God, so to the new creation was completed by an act from the head of the new creation. (AWP Joh 20:22)
s: From [G1722](G1722) and φυσάω phusaō (to *puff*; compare [G5453](G5453)); to *blow* *at* or *on:* - breathe on.

d: **1.** inborn, implanted by nature, implanted by others instruction
s: From [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of [G5453](G5453); *implanted* (figuratively): - engrafted.

d: **1.** in, by, with etc.
s: A primary preposition denoting (fixed) *position* (in place, time or state), and (by implication) *instrumentality* (medially or constructively), that is, a relation of *rest* (intermediate between [G1519](G1519) and [G1537](G1537)); *“in”*, *at*, (up-) *on*, *by*, etc.: - about, after, against, + almost, X altogether, among, X as, at, before, between, (here-) by (+ all means), for (. . . sake of), + give self wholly to, (here-) in (-to, -wardly), X mightily, (because) of, (up-) on, \[open-\] ly, X outwardly, one, X quickly, X shortly, \[speedi-\] ly, X that, X there (-in, -on), through (-out), (un-) to(-ward), under, when, where (-with), while, with (-in). Often used in compounds, with substantially the same import; rarely with verbs of motion, and then not to indicate direction, except (elliptically) by a separate (and different) prep.
o: a primary preposition denoting (fixed) position (in place, time or state), and (by implication) instrumentality (medially or constructively), i.e. a relation of rest (intermediate between [G1519](G1519) and [G1537](G1537))

d: **1.** to take into one’s arms, embrace
s: From [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of [G43](G43); to *take* *in* one’s *arms*, that is, *embrace:* - take up in arms.

d: **1.** that which is in the sea, marine
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G251](G251); *in* the *sea*, that is, *marine:* - thing in the sea.

d: **1.** before
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G473](G473); *in* *front* (that is, figuratively *presence*) *of:* - before.

d:
**1.** over against, opposite
  **a.** of place, opposite, contrary (of the wind)
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** opposed as an adversary, hostile, antagonistic in feeling or act
  **b.** an opponent
s: Neuter of [G1727](G1727); (adverb) *in* the *presence* (*view*) *of:* - before, in the presence of.

d:
**1.** over against, opposite
  **a.** of place, opposite, contrary (of the wind)
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** opposed as an adversary, hostile, antagonistic in feeling or act
  **b.** an opponent
s: From [G1725](G1725); *opposite*; figuratively *antagonistic:* - (over) against, contrary.

d: **1.** to begin, to make a beginning
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G756](G756); to *commence* *on*: - rule \[by mistake for [G757](G757)\].

d: **1.** needy, destitute
s: From a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G1210](G1210) (in the sense of *lacking*); *deficient* *in:* - lacking.
o: from a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G1210](G1210) (in the sense of lacking)

d: **1.** token, evidence, proof
s: From [G1731](G1731); an *indication* (concretely): - manifest token.

d:
**1.** to point out
  **a.** to show, demonstrate, prove, whether by arguments or by acts
**2.** to manifest, display, put forth
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1166](G1166); to *indicate* (by word or act): - do, show (forth).

d:
**1.** demonstration, proof
  **a.** manifestation made by act
  **b.** sign, evidence
s: From [G1731](G1731); *indication* (abstractly): - declare, evident token, proof.

d:
**1.** eleven
  **a.** of the eleven disciples alive after the death of Judas
s: From (the neuter of) [G1520](G1520) and [G1176](G1176); *one* and *ten*, that is, *eleven:* - eleven.

d: **1.** eleventh
s: Ordinal from [G1733](G1733); *eleventh:* - eleventh.

d:
**1.** to receive, admit, approve, allow
**2.** it can be allowed, is possible, may be
s: Third person singular present of a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G1209](G1209); (impersonally) *it* *is* *accepted* *in*, that is, *admitted* (*possible*): - can (+ not) be.
o: third person singular present of a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G1209](G1209)

d: **1.** to be among one’s own people, dwell in one’s own country, stay at home
s: From a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G1218](G1218); to *be* *in* one’s own *country*, that is, *home* (figuratively): - be at home (present).

d: **1.** to put on, clothe, to put on one’s self, be clothed in
s: A prolonged form of [G1746](G1746); to *invest* (with a garment): - clothe in, wear.

d: **1.** according to right, righteous, just
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1349](G1349); *in* the *right*, that is, *equitable:* - just.

d:
**1.** that which is build in
  **a.** the material built into a wall, i.e. of which the wall is composed
  **b.** a mole built into the sea to form a breakwater, and so construct a harbour
s: From a compound of [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of the base of [G1218](G1218); a *housing* *in* (*residence*), that is, *structure:* - building.
o: from a compound of [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of the base of [G1218](G1218)

d: **1.** glorify, adorn with glory
s: From [G1741](G1741); to *glorify:* - glorify.

d:
**1.** held in good or in great esteem, of high repute
  **a.** illustrious, honourable, esteemed
  **b.** notable, glorious
  **c.** splendid
    **1.** of clothing
    **2.** fig., free from sins
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1391](G1391); *in* *glory*, that is, *splendid*, (figuratively) *noble:* - glorious, gorgeous \[-ly\], honourable.

d: **1.** garment, raiment, cloak, an outer garment
s: From [G1746](G1746); *apparel* (especially the outer *robe*): - clothing, garment, raiment.

d:
**1.** to be strong, endue with strength, strengthen
**2.** to receive strength, be strengthened, increase in strength
**3.** in a bad sense
  **a.** be bold, headstrong
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1412](G1412); to *empower:* - enable, (increase in) strength (-en), be (make) strong.

d:
**1.** to put on, to envelop in, to hide in
  **a.** literally: to put on, clothe with a garment
  **b.** metaph. put on armour
**2.** to creep into, insinuate one’s self into, to enter
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1416](G1416); to *sink* (by implication *wrap* (compare [G1746](G1746))) *on*, that is, (figuratively) *sneak:* - creep.

d: **1.** a putting on
s: From [G1746](G1746); *investment* with clothing: - putting on.

d: **1.** to sink into (clothing), put on, clothe one’s self
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1416](G1416) (in the senese of *sinking* into a garment); to *invest* with clothing (literally or figuratively): - array, clothe (with), endue, have (put) on.
o: from [G1722](G1722) and [G1416](G1416) (in the sense of sinking into a garment)

d: **1.** a lying in wait, an ambush
s: Feminine from [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G1476](G1476); an *ambuscade*, that is, (figuratively) murderous *purpose*: - lay wait. See also [G1749](G1749).

d: **1.** to lie in wait for, to lay wait for, prepare a trap for
s: From [G1747](G1747); to *lurk*, that is, (figuratively) *plot* assassination: - lay wait for.

d: **1.** a lying in wait for, an ambush
s: Neuter of the same as [G1747](G1747); an *ambush*, that is, (figuratively) murderous *design:* - lying in wait.

d: **1.** to roll in, wind up
s: From [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G1507](G1507); to *enwrap:* - wrap in.

d: **1.** to be in, what is within, i.e. the soul
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G1510](G1510); to *be* *within* (neuter participle plural): - such things as . . . have. See also [G1762](G1762).

d:
**1.** on account of, for the sake of, for
**2.** for this cause, therefore
s: Of uncertain affinity; *on* *account* *of:* - because, for (cause, sake), (where-) fore, by reason of, that.

d:
**1.** working, efficiency
  **a.** in the NT used only of superhuman power, whether of God or of the devil
s: From [G1756](G1756); *efficiency* (“energy”): - operation, strong, (effectual) working.

d:
**1.** to be operative, be at work, put forth power
  **a.** to work for one, aid one
**2.** to effect
**3.** to display one’s activity, show one’s self operative
s: From [G1756](G1756); to *be* *active*, *efficient:* - do, (be) effectual (fervent), be mighty in, shew forth self, work (effectually in).

d:
**1.** thing wrought
**2.** effect operation
s: From [G1754](G1754); an *effect:* - operation, working.

d: **1.** active
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2041](G2041); *active*, *operative:* - effectual, powerful.

d: **1.** to confer benefits on, to bless
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2127](G2127); to *confer* *a* *benefit* *on:* - bless.

d:
**1.** to have within, to hold in
  **a.** to be held, entangled, be held ensnared
  **b.** to be engaged with, set one’s self against, hold a grudge against someone
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2192](G2192); to *hold* *in* or *upon*, that is, *ensnare*; by implication to *keep* *a* *grudge:* - entangle with, have a quarrel against, urge.

d:
**1.** here
**2.** hither
s: From a prolonged form of [G1722](G1722); properly *within*, that is, (of place) *here*, *hither:* - (t-) here, hither.

d:
**1.** to bring to mind, revolve in mind, ponder
**2.** to think, to deliberate
s: From a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G2372](G2372); to *be* *inspirited*, that is, *ponder:* - think.

d:
**1.** a thinking, consideration
**2.** thoughts
s: From [G1760](G1760); *deliberation:* - device, thought.

d:
**1.** is in, is among, has place, is present
**2.** it can be, is possible, is lawful
s: Contracted for third person singular present indicative of [G1751](G1751); impersonally *there* *is* in or among: - be, (there) is.
o: contraction for the third person singular present indicative of [G1751](G1751)

d: **1.** a year, in a wider sense, for some fixed definite period of time
s: Prolonged from a primary word ἔνος enos (a *year*); a *year:* - year.
o: prolongation from a primary enos (a year)

d:
**1.** to place in or among, to put in
**2.** to be upon, impend, threaten
**3.** close at hand
**4.** present
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2476](G2476); to *place* *on* hand, that is, (reflexively) *impend*, (participle) be *instant:* - come, be at hand, present.

d:
**1.** to grow strong, to receive strength
**2.** to make strong, to strengthen
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G2480](G2480); to *invigorate* (transitively or reflexively): - strengthen.

d:
**1.** ninth
  **a.** the ninth hour corresponds to our 3 o’clock in the afternoon for the sixth hour of the Jews coincides with the twelfth of the day as divided by our method, and the first hour of the day Isa_6 A.M. to us
s: Ordinal from [G1767](G1767); *ninth:* - ninth.

d: **1.** nine
s: A primary number; *nine:* - nine.

d: **1.** ninety nine
s: From a (tenth) multiple of [G1767](G1767) and [G1767](G1767) itself; *ninety* *nine:* - ninety and nine.
o: from a (tenth) multiple of [G1767](G1767)>1767) and 1767 itself

d:
**1.** dumb, mute, destitute of power of speech
**2.** unable to speak for terror, struck dumb, astounded
s: From [G1770](G1770); *dumb* (as *making* *signs*), that is, *silent* from astonishment: - speechless.

d: **1.** to nod to, signify or express by a nod or a sign
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3506](G3506); to *nod* *at*, that is, *beckon* or *communicate* *by* *gesture:* - make signs.

d:
**1.** the act of thinking, consideration, meditation
**2.** a thought, notion, conception
**3.** mind, understanding, will, manner of feeling, and thinking
s: From a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G3563](G3563); *thoughtfulness*, that is, moral *understanding:* - intent, mind.

d:
**1.** bound to the law
**2.** bound by the law, lawful
**3.** lawful, regular
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3551](G3551); (subjectively) *legal*, or (objectively) *subject* to: - lawful, under law.

d: **1.** nightly, nocturnal
s: Neuter of a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G3571](G3571); (adverbially) *by* *night:* - before day.
o: neuter of a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G3571](G3571)

d:
**1.** to dwell in
**2.** metaph. to dwell in one and influence him (for good)
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3611](G3611); to *inhabit* (figuratively): - dwell in.

d:
**1.** unity
**2.** unanimity, agreement
s: From [G1520](G1520); *oneness*, that is, (figuratively) *unanimity:* - unity.

d: **1.** to excite, disturbance, to trouble, annoy
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G3791](G3791); to *crowd* *in*, that is, (figuratively) to *annoy:* - trouble.

d:
**1.** bound, under obligation, subject to, liable
  **a.** used of one who is held by, possessed with love, and zeal for anything
  **b.** in a forensic sense, denoting the connection of a person either with his crime, or with the penalty or trial, or with that against whom or which he has offended
    **1.** guilty, worthy of punishment
    **2.** guilty of anything
    **3.** of the crime
    **4.** of the penalty
    **5.** liable to this or that tribunal i.e. the punishment to by imposed by this or that tribunal
    **6.** of the place where punishment is to be suffered
s: From [G1758](G1758); *liable* to (a condition, penalty or imputation): - in danger of, guilty of, subject to.

d: **1.** a precept
s: From [G1781](G1781); an *injunction*, that is, religious *precept:* - commandment.

d:
**1.** to prepare a body for burial, by the use of every requisite provision and funeral adornment, that is, baths, vestments, flowers, wreathes, perfumes, libations, etc.
**2.** to lay out a corpse
s: From a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G5028](G5028); to *inswathe* with cerements for interment: - bury.

d: **1.** preparation of a body for burial
s: From [G1779](G1779); *preparation* for interment: - burying.

d: **1.** to order, command to be done, enjoin
s: From [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G5056](G5056); to *enjoin:* - (give) charge, (give) command(-ments), injoin.

d:
**1.** from this place, hence
**2.** on the one side and on the other, on each side
s: From the same as [G1759](G1759); *hence* (literally or figuratively); (repeated) *on* *both* *sides:* - (from) hence, on either side.

d:
**1.** a falling in with, meeting with
  **a.** an interview
    **1.** a coming together
    **2.** to visit
    **3.** converse or for any other cause
  **b.** that for which an interview is held
    **1.** a conference or conversation
    **2.** a petition, supplication
s: From [G1793](G1793); an *interview*, that is, (specifically) *supplication:* - intercession, prayer.

d: **1.** held in honour, prized, precious
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5092](G5092); *valued* (figuratively): - dear, more honourable, precious, in reputation.

d:
**1.** an order, command, charge, precept, injunction
  **a.** that which is prescribed to one by reason of his office
**2.** a commandment
  **a.** a prescribed rule in accordance with which a thing is done
    **1.** a precept relating to lineage, of the Mosaic precept concerning the priesthood
    **2.** ethically used of the commandments in the Mosaic law or Jewish tradition
s: From [G1781](G1781); *injunction*, that is, an authoritative *prescription:* - commandment, precept.

d:
**1.** a dweller in a place
**2.** a resident or native of a place
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5117](G5117); a *resident:* - of that place.

d:
**1.** within, inside
  **a.** within you i.e. in the midst of you
  **b.** within you i.e. your soul
s: From [G1722](G1722); *inside* (adverb or noun): - within.

d:
**1.** to shame one
**2.** to be ashamed
**3.** to reverence a person
**4.** to turn about
s: From [G1722](G1722) and the base of [G5157](G5157); to *invert*, that is, (figuratively and reflexively) in a good sense, to *respect*; or in a bad one, to *confound:* - regard, (give) reverence, shame.

d:
**1.** to nourish in: a person or a thing
**2.** metaph. to educate, form the mind
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5142](G5142); (figuratively) to *educate:* - nourish up in.

d: **1.** trembling, terrified
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5156](G5156); *terrified:* - X quake, X trembled.

d:
**1.** shame
**2.** respect, reverence
s: From [G1788](G1788); *confusion:* - shame.

d:
**1.** to live in luxury, live delicately or luxuriously, to revel in
**2.** to take delight in
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5171](G5171); to *revel* *in:* - sporting selves.

d:
**1.** to light upon a person or a thing, fall in with, hit upon, a person or a thing
**2.** to go to or meet a person, esp. for the purpose of conversation, consultation, or supplication
**3.** to pray, entreat
**4.** make intercession for any one
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5177](G5177); to *chance* *upon*, that is, (by implication) *confer* *with*; by extension to *entreat* (in favor or against): - deal with, make intercession.

d: **1.** to roll up, wrap together
s: From [G1722](G1722) andτυλίσσω tulissō (to *twist*; probably akin to [G1507](G1507)); to *entwine*, that is, *wind* up in: - wrap in (together).
o: from [G1722](G1722) and tulisso (to twist, probably akin to [G1507](G1507))

d: **1.** to engrave, imprint (a figure)
s: From [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of [G5179](G5179); to *enstamp*, that is, *engrave:* - engrave.

d: **1.** to insult
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5195](G5195); to *insult:* - do despite unto.

d:
**1.** to dream (divinely suggested) dreams
**2.** metaph., to be beguiled with sensual images and carried away to an impious course of conduct
s: Middle voice from [G1798](G1798); to *dream:* - dream (-er).

d: **1.** a dream
s: From [G1722](G1722) and [G5258](G5258); something seen *in* *sleep*, that is, a *dream* (*vision* in a dream): - dream.

d:
**1.** in the presence of, before
  **a.** of occupied place: in that place which is before, or over against, opposite, any one and towards which another turns his eyes
s: Neuter of a compound of [G1722](G1722) and a derivation of [G3700](G3700); *in* the *face* of (literally or figuratively): - before, in the presence (sight) of, to.
o: neuter of a compound of [G1722](G1722) and a derivative of [G3700](G3700)

d:
Enos = mortal man
**1.** the son of Seth
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H583](H583)\]; *Enos* (that is, *Enosh*), a patriarch: - Enos.

d: **1.** to receive into the ear, to give ear to, listen
s: Middle voice from a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G3775](G3775); to take *in* *one’s* *ear*, that is, to *listen:* - hearken.
o: middle voice from a compound of [G1722](G1722) and [G3775](G3775)

d:
Enoch = dedicated
**1.** the son of Jared and father of methuselah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2585](H2585)\]; *Enoch* (that is, *Chanok*), an antediluvian: - Enoch.
A primary numeral; *six:* - six.

d:
**1.** to tell out or forth
**2.** to declare abroad, divulge, publish
**3.** to make known by praising or proclaiming, to celebrate
s: From [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G32](G32); to *publish*, that is, *celebrate:* - shew forth.

d:
**1.** to redeem
  **a.** by payment of a price to recover from the power of another, to ransom, buy off
  **b.** metaph. of christ freeing the elect from the dominion of the Mosaic Law at the price of his vicarious death
**2.** to buy up, to buy up for one’s self, for one’s use
  **a.** to make wise and sacred use of every opportunity for doing good, so that zeal and well doing are as it were the purchase money by which we make the time our own
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G59](G59); to *buy* *up*, that is, *ransom*; figuratively to *rescue* from loss (*improve* opportunity): - redeem.

d: **1.** to lead out
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G71](G71); to *lead* *forth:* - bring forth (out), fetch (lead) out.

d:
**1.** to pluck out, draw out, i.e. root out
**2.** to choose out (for one’s self), select, one person from many
**3.** to rescue, deliver
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G138](G138); active voice to *tear* *out*; middle voice to *select*; figuratively to *release:* - deliver, pluck out, rescue.

d:
**1.** to lift up or take away out of a place
**2.** to remove
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G142](G142); to *remove:* - put (take) away.

d:
**1.** to ask from, demand of
  **a.** to ask or beg for one’s self, to ask that one be given up to one from the power of another
  **b.** in a good sense,
    **1.** to beg one from another
    **2.** ask for the pardon
    **3.** the safety of some one
  **c.** in a bad sense
    **1.** for torture
    **2.** for punishment
s: Middle voice from [G1537](G1537) and [G154](G154); to *demand* (for trial): - desire.

d: **1.** of a sudden, suddenly, unexpectedly
s: From [G1537](G1537) and the base of [G160](G160); *of* a *sudden* (*unexpectedly*): - suddenly. Compare [G1819](G1819).

d:
**1.** to follow out or up, tread in one’s steps
  **a.** metaph., to imitate one’s ways of acting
  **b.** to follow one’s authority
  **c.** to comply with, yield to
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G190](G190); to *follow* *out*, that is, (figuratively) to *imitate*, *obey*, yield to: - follow.

d: **1.** six hundred
s: Plural ordinal from [G1803](G1803) and [G1540](G1540); *six* *hundred:* - six hundred.

d:
**1.** to anoint or wash in every part
  **a.** to besmear: i.e. cover with lime (to whitewash or plaster)
**2.** to wipe off, wipe away
  **a.** to obliterate, erase, wipe out, blot out
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G218](G218); to *smear* *out*, that is, *obliterate* (*erase* tears, figuratively *pardon* sin): - blot out, wipe away.

d: **1.** to leap up
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G242](G242); to *spring* *forth:* - leap up.

d:
**1.** a rising up, a rising again
**2.** resurrection
s: From [G1817](G1817); a *rising* *from* death: - resurrection.

d:
**1.** to make spring up, cause to shoot forth
**2.** to spring up
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G393](G393); to *start* *up* *out* of the ground, that is, *germinate:* - spring up.

d:
**1.** to make to rise up, to rise up, to produce
**2.** to rise (in an assembly to speak)
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G450](G450); objectively to *produce*, that is, (figuratively) *beget*; subjectively to *arise*, that is, (figuratively) *object:* - raise (rise) up.

d: **1.** to deceive
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G538](G538); to *seduce* *wholly:* - beguile, deceive.

d: **1.** suddenly
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of the same as [G160](G160); *of* a *sudden*, that is, *unexpectedly*: - suddenly. Compare [G1810](G1810).
o: from [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of the same as [G160](G160)

d: **1.** to be utterly at loss, be utterly destitute of measures or resources, to renounce all hope, be in despair
s: Middle voice from [G1537](G1537) and [G639](G639); to *be* *utterly* *at* *a* *loss*, that is, *despond:* - (in) despair.

d:
**1.** to send forth
**2.** to send away
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G649](G649); to *send* *away* *forth*, that is, (on a mission) to *despatch*, or (peremptorily) to *dismiss:* - send (away, forth, out).

d:
**1.** to complete, finish
  **a.** to furnish perfectly
  **b.** to finish, accomplish, (as it were, to render the days complete)
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of [G739](G739); to *finish* *out* (time); figuratively to *equip* *fully* (a teacher): - accomplish, thoroughly furnish.

d:
**1.** to send forth lightning, to lighten
**2.** to flash out like lightning, to shine, be radiant
  **a.** of garments
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G797](G797); to *lighten* *forth*, that is, (figuratively) to *be* *radiant* (of very white garments): - glistening.

d: **1.** on the instant, forthwith
s: From [G1537](G1537) and the genitive singular feminine of [G846](G846) ([G5610](G5610) being understood); *from* *that* hour, that is, *instantly:* - by and by, immediately, presently, straightway.
o: from [G1537](G1537) and the genitive case singular feminine of [G846](G846) ([G5610](G5610) being understood)

d:
**1.** to arouse, raise up (from sleep)
**2.** to rouse up, stir up, incite
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1453](G1453); to *rouse* *fully*, that is, (figuratively) to *resuscitate* (from death), *release* (from infliction): - raise up.

d: **1.** to go forth, go out
s: From [G1537](G1537) and εἶμι eimi (to *go*); to *issue*, that is, *leave* (a place), *escape* (to the shore): - depart, get \[to land\], go out.

d: **1.** to prove to be in the wrong, convict
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1651](G1651); to *convict* *fully*, that is, (by implication) to *punish:* - convince.

d:
**1.** to draw out
**2.** metaph. lure forth: in hunting and fishing as game is lured from its hiding place, so man by lure is allured from the safety of self-restraint to sin. In Jas 1:14, the language of the hunting is transferred to the seduction of a harlot.
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G1670](G1670); to *drag* *forth*, that is, (figuratively) to *entice* (to sin): - draw away.

d:
**1.** vomit
**2.** what is cast out by vomiting
s: From a compound of [G1537](G1537) and a presumed form of ἐραω eraō (to *spue*); *vomit*, that is, *food* *disgorged:* - vomit.
o: from a comparative of [G1537](G1537) and a presumed erao (to spue)

d: **1.** to search out, search anxiously and diligently To search after, thoroughly investigate (first used to tellof a dog sniffing out something with his nose). The prophetssearched to find out the time of messiah’s appearance.
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2045](G2045); to *explore* (figuratively): - search diligently.

d:
**1.** to go or come forth of
  **a.** with mention of the place out of which one goes, or the point from which he departs
    **1.** of those who leave a place of their own accord
    **2.** of those who are expelled or cast out
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to go out of an assembly, i.e. forsake it
  **b.** to come forth from physically, arise from, to be born of
  **c.** to go forth from one’s power, escape from it in safety
  **d.** to come forth (from privacy) into the world, before the public, (of those who by novelty of opinion attract attention)
  **e.** of things
    **1.** of reports, rumours, messages, precepts
    **2.** to be made known, declared
    **3.** to be spread, to be proclaimed
    **4.** to come forth
  **f.** emitted as from the heart or the mouth
  **g.** to flow forth from the body
  **h.** to emanate, issue
    **1.** used of a sudden flash of lightning
    **2.** used of a thing vanishing
    **3.** used of a hope which has disappeared
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2064](G2064); to *issue* (literally or figuratively): - come-(forth, out), depart (out of), escape, get out, go (abroad, away, forth, out, thence), proceed (forth), spread abroad.

d: **1.** it is lawful
s: Third person singular present indicative of a compound of [G1537](G1537) and [G1510](G1510); so also ἐξόν exon; neuter present participle of the same (with or without some form of [G1510](G1510) expressed); impersonally *it* *is* *right* (through the figurative idea of *being* *out* in public): - be lawful, let, X may (-est).
o: third person singular present indicative of a compound of [G1537](G1537) and [G1510](G1510)

d:
**1.** to search out
  **a.** to examine strictly, enquire
  **b.** enquire of someone
s: From [G1537](G1537) and ἐτάζω etazō (to *examine*); to *test* *thoroughly* (by questions), that is, *ascertain* or *interrogate:* - ask, enquire, search.

d:
**1.** to lead out, be leader, go before
**2.** metaph., to draw out in narrative, unfold a teaching
  **a.** to recount, rehearse
  **b.** to unfold, declare
    **1.** the things relating to God
    **2.** used in Greek writing of the interpretation of things sacred and divine, oracles, dreams, etc.
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2233](G2233); to *consider* *out* (aloud), that is, *rehearse*, *unfold:* - declare, tell.

d: **1.** sixty
s: The tenth multiple of [G1803](G1803); *sixty:* - sixty \[-fold\], threescore.

d:
**1.** successively in order
**2.** the next following, the next in succession
s: From [G2192](G2192) (in the sense of *taking* *hold* of, that is, *adjoining*); *successive:* - after, following, X morrow, next.
o: from [G2192](G2192) (in the sense of taking hold of, i.e. adjoining)

d: **1.** to sound forth, emit, sound, resound
s: Middle voice from [G1537](G1537) and [G2278](G2278); to “echo” *forth*, that is, *resound* (*be* generally *reported*): - sound forth.

d:
**1.** a habit whether of body or mind
**2.** a power acquired by custom, practice, use
s: From [G2192](G2192); *habit*, that is, (by implication) *practice:* - use.

d:
**1.** to throw out of position, displace
  **a.** to amaze, to astonish, throw into wonderment
  **b.** to be amazed, astounded
  **c.** to be out of one’s mind, besides one’s self, insane
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2476](G2476); to *put* (*stand*) *out* of wits, that is, *astound*, or (reflexively) *become* *astounded*, *insane:* - amaze, be (make) astonished, be beside self (selves), bewitch, wonder.

d: **1.** to be eminently able, able, to have full strength
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G2480](G2480); to *have* *full* *strength*, that is, *be* *entirely* *competent:* - be able.

d:
**1.** exit i.e. departure
**2.** the close of one’s career, one’s final fate
**3.** departure from life, decease
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3598](G3598); an *exit*, that is, (figuratively) *death:* - decease, departing.

d: **1.** to destroy out of its place, destroy utterly, to extirpate
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3645](G3645); to *extirpate:* - destroy.

d:
**1.** to confess
**2.** to profess
  **a.** acknowledge openly and joyfully
  **b.** to one’s honour: to celebrate, give praise to
  **c.** to profess that one will do something, to promise, agree, engage
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3670](G3670); to *acknowledge* or (by implication of *assent*) *agree* *fully:* - confess, profess, promise.

d:
**1.** to extract an oath, to force to an oath
**2.** to adjure
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3726](G3726); to *exact* *an* *oath*, that is, *conjure:* - adjure.

d:
**1.** he who extracts an oath of one
**2.** an exorcist
  **a.** one who employs a formula of conjuration for expelling demons
s: From [G1844](G1844); *one* *that* *binds* *by* *an* *oath* (or *spell*), that is, (by implication) an “exorcist” (*conjurer*): - exorcist.

d:
**1.** to dig out, to pluck out (the eyes)
**2.** to dig through
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G3736](G3736); to *dig* *out*, that is, (by extension) to *extract* (an eye), *remove* (a roofing): - break up, pluck out.

d:
**1.** to hold and treat as of no account, utterly to despise
**2.** to set at nought, treat with contempt
s: From [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of the neuter of [G3762](G3762); to *make* *utterly* *nothing* *of*, that is, *despise*: - set at nought. See also [G1848](G1848).
o: from [G1537](G1537) and a derivative of the neuter of [G3762](G3762)

d: **1.** to make of no account, despise utterly
s: A variation of [G1847](G1847) and meaning the same: - contemptible, despise, least esteemed, set at nought.

d:
**1.** power of choice, liberty of doing as one pleases
  **a.** leave or permission
**2.** physical and mental power
  **a.** the ability or strength with which one is endued, which he either possesses or exercises
**3.** the power of authority (influence) and of right (privilege)
**4.** the power of rule or government (the power of him whose will and commands must be submitted to by others and obeyed)
  **a.** universally
    **1.** authority over mankind
  **b.** specifically
    **1.** the power of judicial decisions
    **2.** of authority to manage domestic affairs
  **c.** metonymically
    **1.** a thing subject to authority or rule
  **d.** jurisdiction
    **1.** one who possesses authority
  **e.** a ruler, a human magistrate
  **f.** the leading and more powerful among created beings superior to man, spiritual potentates
  **g.** a sign of the husband’s authority over his wife
    **1.** the veil with which propriety required a women to cover herself
  **h.** the sign of regal authority, a crown
s: From [G1832](G1832) (in the sense of *ability*); *privilege*, that is, (subjectively) *force*, *capacity*, *competency*, *freedom*, or (objectively) *mastery* (concretely *magistrate*, *superhuman*, *potentate*, *token* *of* *control*), delegated *influence:* - authority, jurisdiction, liberty, power, right, strength.

d:
**1.** to have power or authority, use power
  **a.** to be master of any one, exercise authority over one
  **b.** to be master of the body
    **1.** to have full and entire authority over the body
    **2.** to hold the body subject to one’s will
  **c.** to be brought under the power of anyone
s: From [G1849](G1849); to *control:* - exercise authority upon, bring under the (have) power of.

d:
**1.** any prominence or projection, as a peak or summit of a mountain
  **a.** in medical writing a proturbance, swelling, wart, etc.
**2.** metaph. eminence, excellence, superiority
s: From a compound of [G1537](G1537) and [G2192](G2192) (meaning to *stand* *out*); *prominence* (figuratively): - principal.
o: from a compound of [G1537](G1537) and [G2192](G2192) (meaning to stand out)

d: **1.** to wake up, awaken out of a sleep
s: From [G1853](G1853); to *waken:* - awake out of sleep.

d: **1.** roused out of a sleep
s: From [G1537](G1537) and [G5258](G5258); *awake:* - X out of sleep.

d: AV - without 23, out 16, out of 15, forth 8, outward 1, strange 1, away 1; 65
s: Adverb from [G1537](G1537); *out* (*side*, *of* *doors*), literally or figuratively: - away, forth, (with-) out (of, -ward), strange.

d: AV - without 4, outside 2, from without 2, outward 2, outwardly 1; 11
s: From [G1854](G1854); *external* (-ly): - out (-side, -ward, -wardly), (from) without.

d: AV - drive out 1, thrust in 1, 2
s: From [G1537](G1537) and ὠθέω ōtheō (to *push*); to *expel*; by implication to *propel:* - drive out, thrust in.

d: **1.** outer
s: Compound of [G1854](G1854); *exterior:* - outer.

d: **1.** to keep a feast day, celebrate a feast
s: From [G1859](G1859); to *observe* *a* *festival:* - keep the feast.

d: **1.** a feast day, festival
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *festival:* - feast, holyday.

d:
**1.** announcement
**2.** promise
  **a.** the act of promising, a promise given or to be given
  **b.** a promised good or blessing
s: From [G1861](G1861); an *announcement* (for information, assent or pledge; especially a divine *assurance* of good): - message, promise.

d:
**1.** to announce that one is about to do or furnish something
  **a.** to promise (of one’s own accord) to engage voluntarily
**2.** to profess
  **a.** an art, to profess one’s skill in something
s: From [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G32](G32); to *announce* *upon* (reflexively), that is, (by implication) to *engage* to do something, to *assert* something respecting oneself: - profess, (make) promise.

d: **1.** a promise
s: From [G1861](G1861); a *self* *committal* (by *assurance* of conferring some good): - promise.

d:
**1.** to lead or bring upon
**2.** to bring a thing on one
  **a.** to cause something to befall one, usually something evil
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G71](G71); to *superinduce*, that is, *inflict* (an evil), *charge* (a crime): - bring upon.

d: **1.** to contend
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G75](G75); to *struggle* for: - earnestly contend for.

d: **1.** to gather together (to others already present)
s: From [G1909](G1909) and ἀθροίζω athroizō (to *assemble*); to *accumulate:* - gather thick together.

d:
Epaenetus = praiseworthy
**1.** a Christian at Rome, greeted by the Paul in Rom 16:5
s: From [G1867](G1867); *praised*; *Epaenetus*, a Christian: - Epenetus.

d: **1.** to approve, to praise
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G134](G134); to *applaud:* - commend, laud, praise.

d: **1.** approbation, commendation, praise
s: From [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G134](G134); *laudation*; concretely a *commendable* thing: - praise.

d:
**1.** to lift up, raise up, raise on high
**2.** metaph. to be lifted up with pride, to exalt one’s self
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G142](G142); to *raise* *up* (literally or figuratively): - exalt self, poise (lift, take) up.

d: **1.** to be ashamed
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G153](G153); to *feel* *shame* *for* something: - be ashamed.

d:
**1.** to ask besides, ask for more
**2.** to ask again and again, importunately
**3.** to beg, to ask alms
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G154](G154); to *ask* for: - beg.

d:
**1.** to follow (close) upon, follow after
**2.** to tread in one’s footsteps i.e. to imitate his example
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G190](G190); to *accompany:* - follow (after).

d:
**1.** to give ear to, listen to
  **a.** to perceive by the ear
**2.** to listen to
  **a.** to hear with favour, grant one’s request
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G191](G191); to *hearken* (favorably) *to:* - hear.

d: **1.** to listen to
s: From [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G202](G202); to *listen* (intently) *to:* - hear.

d: **1.** after, when
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G302](G302); a particle of indefinite contemporaneousnes; *whenever*, *as* *soon* *as:* - when.

d: **1.** necessarily
s: Neuter of a presumed compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G318](G318); (adverb) *on* *necessity*, that is, *necessarily:* - necessary.
o: from a presumed compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G318](G318)

d:
**1.** to lead up upon
  **a.** a ship upon the deep, to put out
**2.** to lead back
**3.** to return
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G321](G321); to *lead* *up* *on*, that is, (technically) to *put* *out* (to sea); (intransitively) to *return:* - launch (thrust) out, return.

d:
**1.** to recall to mind again
**2.** reminding one
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G363](G363); to *remind* *of:* - put in mind.

d:
**1.** to cause to rest upon anything
**2.** to rest upon anything
**3.** to settle upon, fix its abode upon
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G373](G373); to *settle* *on*; literally (*remain*) or figuratively (*rely*): - rest in (upon).

d: **1.** to return, come back again
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G424](G424); to *come* *up* *on*, that is, *return:* - come again, return.

d: **1.** to cause to rise up against, to raise up against
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G450](G450); to *stand* *up* *on*, that is, (figuratively) to *attack:* - rise up against.

d:
**1.** restoration to an upright or right state
**2.** correction, improvement of life or character
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G461](G461); a *straightening* *up* *again*, that is, (figuratively) *rectification* (*reformation*): - correction.

d:
**1.** above
  **a.** of place
  **b.** of number: more than
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G507](G507); *up* *above*, that is, *over* or *on* (of place, amount, rank, etc.): - above, more than, (up-) on, over.

d:
**1.** to avail or be strong enough for
  **a.** to ward off or drive away, a thing for another’s advantage
    **1.** a thing from anyone, to defend
  **b.** to aid, give assistance, relieve
    **1.** to give aid from one’s own resources
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G714](G714); to *avail* *for*, that is, *help:* - relieve.

d:
**1.** the office of a governor or prefect
**2.** the region subject to a prefect
  **a.** a province of the Roman empire, either a larger province, or an appendage to a larger province, as Palestine was to that of Syria
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G757](G757) (meaning a *governor* of a district, “eparch”); a special *region* of government, that is, a Roman *praefecture:* - province.
o: from a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G757](G757) (meaning a governor of a district, eparch)

d:
**1.** a farm
**2.** a dwelling
s: From [G1909](G1909) and an equivalent of [G833](G833); a *hut* *over* the head, that is, a *dwelling.*

d: **1.** on the morrow, the next day
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G839](G839); occuring *on* the *succeeding* day, that is, ([G2250](G2250) being implied) *tomorrow:* - day following, morrow, next day (after).

d:
**1.** in the act
**2.** caught in the act of theft
**3.** caught in the act of perpetuating any other crime
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G846](G846) and (the dative singular of) a derivative of φώρ phōr (a *thief*); *in* *theft* *itself*, that is, (by analogy) *in* *actual* *crime:* - in the very act.
o: from [G1909](G1909) and [G846](G846) and (the dative case singular of) a derivative of phor (a thief)

d:
Epaphras = lovely
**1.** a Christian man mentioned in Paul’s epistles
s: Contracted from [G1891](G1891); *Epaphras*, a Christian: - Epaphras.

d:
**1.** to foam up
**2.** to cast out as foam, foam out
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G875](G875); to *foam* *upon*, that is, (figuratively) to *exhibit* (a vile passion): - foam out.

d:
Epaphroditus = lovely
**1.** an associate with Paul in the ministry
s: From [G1909](G1909) (in the sense of *devoted* to) and Ἀφροδίτη Aphroditē (*Venus*); *Epaphroditus*, a Christian: - Epaphroditus. Compare [G1889](G1889).
o: from [G1909](G1909) (in the sense of devoted to) and Aphrodite (Venus)

d: **1.** to raise or excite against
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1453](G1453); to *rouse* *upon*, that is, (figuratively) to *excite* against: - raise, stir up.

d:
**1.** when, since
  **a.** of time: after
  **b.** of cause: since, seeing that, because
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1487](G1487); *there* *upon*, that is, *since* (of time or cause): - because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing that, since, when.

d:
**1.** when now, since now
  **a.** of time: when now, after that
  **b.** of cause: since, seeing that, forasmuch as
s: From [G1893](G1893) and [G1211](G1211); *since* *now*, that is, (of time) *when*, or (of cause) *whereas:* - after that, because, for, (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.

d: **1.** seeing that, forasmuch as
s: From [G1894](G1894) and [G4007](G4007); *since* *indeed* (of cause): - forasmuch.

d: **1.** to look upon, to regard
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1492](G1492); to *regard* (favorably or otherwise): - behold, look upon.
o: and other moods and persons of the same tense, from [G1909](G1909) and [G1492](G1492)

d: **1.** since indeed, since at all events
s: From [G1893](G1893) and [G4007](G4007); *since* indeed (of cause): - seeing.

d:
**1.** a bringing in besides or in addition to what is or has been brought in
  **a.** used of the introduction of a new wife in the place of one repudiated
  **b.** to come in besides or to those who are already within
    **1.** to enter afterwards
  **c.** to come in upon, come upon by entering
    **1.** to enter against
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G1521](G1521); a *superintroduction:* - bringing in.

d: **1.** thereupon, thereafter, then, afterwards
s: From [G1909](G1909) nad [G1534](G1534); *thereafter:* - after that (-ward), then.

d: **1.** beyond
s: From [G1909](G1909) and (the accusative plural neuter of) [G1565](G1565); *upon* *those* parts of, that is, *on* *the* *further* *side* *of:* - beyond.
o: from [G1909](G1909) and (the accusative case plural neuter of) [G1565](G1565)

d:
**1.** to stretch out to or towards
**2.** to stretch (one’s self) forward to
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G1614](G1614); to *stretch* (oneself) forward *upon:* - reach forth.

d: **1.** to put on over
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G1746](G1746); to *invest* *upon* oneself: - be clothed upon.

d:
**1.** an upper garment
  **a.** Joh 21:7 seems to denote a kind of linen blouse or frock which fishermen used to wear at their work
s: From [G1902](G1902); a *wrapper*, that is, outer garment: - fisher’s coat.

d:
**1.** to come to arrive
  **a.** of time, come on, be at hand, be future
**2.** to come upon, overtake, one
  **a.** of sleep
  **b.** of disease
  **c.** of calamities
  **d.** of the holy spirit, descending and operating in one
  **e.** of an enemy attacking one
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2064](G2064); to *supervene*, that is, *arrive*, *occur*, *impend*, *attack*, (figuratively) *influence:* - come (in, upon).

d:
**1.** to accost one with an enquiry, put a question to, enquiry of, ask, interrogate
**2.** to address one with a request or demand
  **a.** to ask of or demand of one
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2065](G2065); to *ask* *for*, that is, *inquire*, *seek:* - ask (after, questions), demand, desire, question.

d:
**1.** an enquiry, a question
**2.** a demand
**3.** earnestly seeking
  **a.** craving, an intense desire
s: From [G1905](G1905); an *inquiry:* - answer.

d:
**1.** to have or hold upon, apply, to observe, attend to
  **a.** to give attention to
**2.** to hold towards, hold forth, present
**3.** to check
  **a.** delay, stop, stay
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2192](G2192); to *hold* *upon*, that is, (by implication) to *retain*; (by extension) to *detain*; (with implication of [G3563](G3563)) to *pay* *attention* *to:* - give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.

d:
**1.** to insult
**2.** to treat abusively, use despitefully
**3.** to revile
**4.** in a forensic sense, to accuse falsely
**5.** to threaten
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and (probably) ἀρειά areia (*threats*); to *insult*, *slander:* - use despitefully, falsely accuse.
o: from a comparative of [G1909](G1909) and (probably) areia (threats)

d:
**1.** upon, on, at, by, before
**2.** of position, on, at, by, over, against
**3.** to, over, on, at, across, against
s: A primary preposition properly meaning *superimposition* (of time, place, order, etc.), as a relation of *distribution* \[with the genitive case\], that is, *over*, *upon*, etc.; of *rest* (with the dative case) *at*, *on*, etc.; of *direction* (with the accusative case) *towards*, *upon*, etc.: - about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as (touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, \[where-\]) fore, in (a place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-) on (behalf of) over, (by, for) the space of, through (-out), (un-) to (-ward), with. In compounds it retains essentially the same import, *at*, *upon*, etc. (literally or figuratively).

d:
**1.** to get upon, mount
  **a.** to embark in
  **b.** to go aboard (a ship)
**2.** to set foot in, enter
s: From [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G939](G939); to *walk* *upon*, that is, *mount*, *ascend*, *embark*, *arrive:* - come (into), enter into, go aboard, sit upon, take ship.

d:
**1.** to cast upon, to lay upon
  **a.** used of seizing one to lead him off as a prisoner
  **b.** to put (i.e. sew) on
**2.** to throw one’s self upon, rush in
  **a.** used of waves rushing into a ship
  **b.** to put one’s mind upon a thing
  **c.** attend to
**3.** it belongs to me, falls to my share
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *upon* (literally or figuratively, transitively or reflexively; usually with more or less force); specifically (with [G1438](G1438) implied) to *reflect*; impersonally to *belong* *to:* - beat into, cast (up-), on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.

d:
**1.** to put a burden upon, to load
**2.** to be burdensome
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G916](G916); to *be* *heavy* *upon*, that is, (pecuniarily) to *be* *expensive* *to*; figuratively to *be* *severe* *towards:* - be chargeable to, overcharge.

d:
**1.** to cause to mount
**2.** to place upon
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a reduplicated derivation of the base of [G939](G939) (compare [G307](G307)); to *cause* *to* *mount* (an animal): - set on.
o: from [G1909](G1909) and a redupl. deriv. of the base of [G939](G939) \[cf [G307](G307)\]

d:
**1.** to turn the eyes upon, to look upon, gaze upon
**2.** to look up to, regard
**3.** to have regard for, to regard
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G991](G991); to *gaze* *at* (with favor, pity or partiality): - look upon, regard, have respect to.

d:
**1.** that which is thrown or put upon a thing, or that which is added to it
  **a.** an addition
  **b.** that which is sewed on to cover a rent, a patch
s: From [G1911](G1911); a *patch:* - piece.

d: **1.** to cry out to, cry out
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G994](G994); to *exclaim* *against:* - cry.

d: **1.** a plan formed against one, a plot
s: From a presumed compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G1014](G1014); a *plan* *against* someone, that is, a *plot:* - laying (lying) in wait.
o: from a presumed compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G1014](G1014)

d:
**1.** to be related to by marriage, enter into affinity with
  **a.** become any one’s father-in-law or son-in-law
  **b.** to marry the widow of a brother who has died childless
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of [G1062](G1062); to *form* *affinity* *with*, that is, (specifically) in a levirate way: - marry.

d: **1.** existing upon the earth, earthly, terrestrial
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1093](G1093); *worldly* (physically or morally): - earthly, in earth, terrestrial.

d:
**1.** to become or happen afterwards
  **a.** to be born after
**2.** to come to, arrive: of time
**3.** to arise, spring up, come on
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1096](G1096); to *arrive* *upon*, that is, *spring* *up* (as a wind): - blow.

d:
**1.** to become thoroughly acquainted with, to know thoroughly
  **a.** to know accurately, know well
**2.** to know
  **a.** to recognise
    **1.** by sight, hearing, of certain signs, to perceive who a person is
  **b.** to know i.e. to perceive
  **c.** to know i.e. to find out, ascertain
  **d.** to know i.e. to understand
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1097](G1097); to *know* *upon* some mark, that is, *recognise*; by implication to *become* *fully* *acquainted* *with*, to *acknowledge:* - (ac-, have, take) know (-ledge, well), perceive.

d:
**1.** precise and correct knowledge
  **a.** used in the NT of the knowledge of things ethical and divine
s: From [G1921](G1921); *recognition*, that is, (by implication) full *discernment*, *acknowledgement:* - (ac-) knowledge (-ing, -ment).

d:
**1.** an inscription, title
  **a.** in the NT of an inscription in black letters upon a whitened tablet
  **b.** of the inscription on a coin
s: From [G1924](G1924); an *inscription:* - superscription.

d:
**1.** to write upon, inscribe
**2.** metaph. to write upon the mind
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1125](G1125); to *inscribe* (physically or mentally): - inscription, write in (over, thereon).

d:
**1.** to exhibit, show
  **a.** to bring forth to view, to show
    **1.** furnish to be looked at, produce what may looked at
    **2.** to display something belonging to one’s self
  **b.** to prove, demonstrate, set forth to be known and acknowledged
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1166](G1166); to *exhibit* (physically or mentally): - shew.

d:
**1.** to receive hospitality
**2.** to admit, i.e. not to reject
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1209](G1209); to *admit* (as a guest or \[figuratively\] teacher): - receive.

d:
**1.** to be present among one’s people, in one’s city or one’s native land
**2.** to be a sojourner
  **a.** of a foreign resident, among any people, in any country
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G1218](G1218); to *make* *oneself* *at* *home*, that is, (by extension) to *reside* (in a foreign country): - \[be\] dwelling (which were) there, stranger.

d: **1.** to ordain besides, to add something to what has been ordained
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G1299](G1299); to *appoint* *besides*, that is, *supplement* (as a codicil): - add to.

d:
**1.** to hand, give by hand
**2.** to give over
  **a.** give up to the power or will of one
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1325](G1325); to *give* *over* (by hand or surrender): - deliver unto, give, let (+ \[her drive\]), offer.

d: **1.** to set in order besides or further
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of [G3717](G3717); to *straighten* *further*, that is, (figuratively) *arrange* *additionally:* - set in order.

d: **1.** to go down, set (of the sun)
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1416](G1416); to *set* fully (as the sun): - go down.

d: **1.** mildness, gentleness, fairness
s: From [G1933](G1933); *suitableness*, that is, (by implication) *equity*, *mildness:* - clemency, gentleness.

d:
**1.** seemingly, suitable
**2.** equitable, fair, mild, gentle
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G1503](G1503); *appropriate*, that is, (by implication) *mild:* - gentle, moderation, patient.

d:
**1.** to enquire for, seek for, search for, seek diligently
**2.** to wish for, crave
**3.** to demand, clamour for
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2212](G2212); to *search* (*inquire*) *for*; intensively to *demand*, to *crave:* - desire, enquire, seek (after, for).

d: **1.** doomed to death
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2288](G2288); doomed *to* *death:* - appointed to death.

d: **1.** a laying on, imposition
s: From [G2007](G2007); an *imposition* (of hands officially): - laying (putting) on.

d:
**1.** to turn upon a thing
**2.** to have a desire for, long for, to desire
**3.** to lust after, covet
  **a.** of those who seek things forbidden
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2372](G2372); to set the *heart* *upon*, that is, *long* for (rightfully or otherwise): - covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).

d: **1.** one who longs for, a craver, lover, one eager for
s: From [G1937](G1937); a *craver:* - + lust after.

d: **1.** desire, craving, longing, desire for what is forbidden, lust
s: From [G1937](G1937); a *longing* (especially for what is forbidden): - concupiscence, desire, lust (after).

d:
**1.** to cause to sit upon, to set upon
**2.** to sit upon
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2523](G2523); to *seat* *upon:* - set on.

d:
**1.** to put a name upon, to surname
  **a.** to permit one’s self to be surnamed
**2.** to be named after someone
**3.** to call something to one
  **a.** to cry out upon or against one
  **b.** to charge something to one as a crime or reproach
  **c.** to summon one on any charge, prosecute one for a crime
  **d.** to blame one for, accuse one of
**4.** to invoke
  **a.** to call upon for one’s self, in one’s behalf
    **1.** any one as a helper
    **2.** as my witness
    **3.** as my judge
    **4.** to appeal unto
**5.** to call upon by pronouncing the name of Jehovah
  **a.** an expression finding its explanation in the fact that prayers addressed to God ordinarily began with an invocation of the divine name
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G2564](G2564); to *entitle*; by implication to *invoke* (for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.): - appeal (unto), call (on, upon), surname.

d:
**1.** a covering, veil
**2.** metaph. a pretext, cloak
s: From [G1943](G1943); a *covering*, that is, (figuratively) *pretext:* - cloke.

d: **1.** to cover over
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2572](G2572); to *conceal*, that is, (figuratively) *forgive:* - cover.

d: **1.** accursed, execrable, exposed to divine vengeance, lying under God’s curse
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of [G2672](G2672); *imprecated*, that is, *execrable:* - accursed.

d:
**1.** to lie upon or over, rest upon, be laid or placed upon
  **a.** on the burning coals
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** of things, of the pressure of a violent tempest
  **b.** of men, to press upon, to be urgent
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2749](G2749); to *rest* *upon* (literally or figuratively): - impose, be instant, (be) laid (there-, up-) on, (when) lay (on), lie (on), press upon.

d:
Epicurean = a helper: defender
**1.** belonging to the sect of Epicurius, the philosopher
s: From Ἐπίκουρος Epikouros (compare [G1947](G1947); a noted philosopher); an *Epicurean* or follower of Epicurus: - Epicurean.

d: **1.** aid, succour, help
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and a (prolonged) form of the base of [G2877](G2877) (in the sense of *servant*); *assistance:* - help.
o: from a compound of [G1909](G1909) and a (prolonged) form of the base of [G2877](G2877) (in the sense of servant)

d: **1.** to adjudge, approve by one’s decision, decree, give sentence
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2919](G2919); to *adjudge:* - give sentence.

d:
**1.** to take in addition, to lay hold of, take possession of, overtake, attain, attain to
  **a.** to lay hold of or to seize upon anything with the hands, to take hold of, lay hold of
  **b.** metaph. to rescue one from peril, to help, succour
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G2983](G2983); to *seize* (for help, injury, attainment or any other purpose; literally or figuratively): - catch, lay hold (up-) on, take (by, hold of, on).

d:
**1.** to forget
**2.** neglecting, no longer caring for
**3.** forgotten, given over to oblivion, i.e. uncared for
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G2990](G2990); to *lose* *out* of mind; by implication to *neglect:* - (be) forget (-ful of).

d:
**1.** to say besides
**2.** to surname
**3.** to choose for
**4.** to choose for one’s self
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and [G3004](G3004); to *surname*, *select:* - call, choose.

d: **1.** to fail, not to suffer for (any purpose, for the attainment of an end)
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3007](G3007); to *leave* *upon*, that is, (figuratively) to *be* *insufficient* for: - fall.

d: **1.** forgetfulness
s: From a derivative of [G1950](G1950); *negligence:* - X forgetful.

d: **1.** remaining besides, left over
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3062](G3062); *left* *over*, that is, *remaining:* - rest.

d:
**1.** a loosening, unloosing
**2.** metaph. interpretation
s: From [G1956](G1956); *explanation*, that is, *application:* - interpretation.

d:
**1.** to unloose, untie
**2.** to clear (a controversy), decide, settle
**3.** to explain (what is obscure and hard to understand)
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3089](G3089); to *solve* *further*, that is, (figuratively) to *explain*, *decide:* - determine, expound.

d: **1.** to bear witness to, establish by testimony
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3140](G3140); to *attest* *further*, that is, *corroborate:* - testify.

d: **1.** care, attention
s: From [G1959](G1959); *carefulness*, that is, kind *attention* (*hospitality*): - + refresh self.

d: **1.** to take care of a person or thing
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and the same as [G3199](G3199); to *care* *for* (physically or otherwise): - take care of.
o: middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and the same as [G3199](G3199)

d: **1.** diligently, carefully
s: Adverb from a derivative of [G1959](G1959); *carefully:* - diligently.

d:
**1.** to stay at or with, to tarry still, still to abide, to continue, remain
  **a.** of tarrying in a place
  **b.** to persevere, continue
    **1.** of the thing continued in
    **2.** in the work of teaching
    **3.** of the blessing for which one keeps himself fit
    **4.** denoting the action persisted in
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3306](G3306); to *stay* *over*, that is, *remain* (figuratively *persevere*): - abide (in), continue (in), tarry.

d:
**1.** to nod to
**2.** to express approval, to assent
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3506](G3506); to *nod* *at*, that is, (by implication) to *assent:* - consent.

d: **1.** thought, purpose
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3563](G3563); *attention* of the mind, that is, (by implication) *purpose:* - thought.

d: **1.** to swear falsely, forswear one’s self
s: From [G1965](G1965); to *commit* *perjury:* - forswear self.

d: **1.** a false swearer, a perjurer
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3727](G3727); *on* *oath*, that is, (falsely) a *forswearer:* - perjured person.

d:
**1.** to come upon, approach
  **a.** of time, to come on, be at hand, next, following, on the following day
s: Feminine singular participle of a compound of [G1909](G1909) and εἷμι heimi (to *go*); *supervening*, that is, ([G2250](G2250) or [G3571](G3571) being expressed or implied) the *ensuing* day or night: - following, next.
o: feminine singular participle of a comparative of [G1909](G1909) and heimi (to go)

d:
**1.** word found in the phrase
  **a.** the bread of our necessity
  **b.** the bread that suffices for each day
s: Perhaps from the same as [G1966](G1966); *to-morrow’s*; but more probably from [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of the present participle feminine of [G1510](G1510); *for* *subsistence*, that is, *needful:* - daily.

d:
**1.** to fall upon, to rush or press upon
  **a.** to lie upon one
  **b.** to fall into one’s embrace
  **c.** to fall back upon
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to fall upon one i.e. to seize, take possession of him
    **1.** of the holy spirit, in his inspiration and impulse
    **2.** of reproaches cast upon one
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4098](G4098); to *embrace* (with affection) or *seize* (with more or less violence; literally or figuratively): - fall into (on, upon), lie on, press upon.

d:
**1.** to strike upon, beat upon
**2.** to chastise with words, to chide, upbraid, rebuke
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4141](G4141); to *chastise*, that is, (with words) to *upbraid:* - rebuke.

d: **1.** to throttle upon, to overgrow, to choke
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4155](G4155); to *throttle* *upon*, that is, (figuratively) *overgrow:* - choke.

d:
**1.** to long for, desire
**2.** to pursue with love, to long after
**3.** to lust, harbour forbidden desire
s: From [G1909](G1909) and ποθέω potheō (to *yearn*); to *dote* *upon*, that is, *intensely* *crave* possession (lawfully or wrongfully): - (earnestly) desire (greatly), (greatly) long (after), lust.

d: **1.** longing
s: From [G1971](G1971); a *longing* *for*: - earnest (vehement) desire.

d: **1.** longed for
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of the latter part of [G1971](G1971); *yearned* *upon*, that is, *greatly* *loved:* - longed for.
o: from [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of the latter part of [G1971](G1971)

d: **1.** longing
s: From [G1971](G1971); *intense* *longing:* - great desire.

d:
**1.** to go or journey to
**2.** to go to, traverse
  **a.** regions, cities
**3.** to make a hostile inroad, overrun, march over
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4198](G4198); to *journey* *further*, that is, *travel* *on* (*reach*): - come.

d: **1.** to sew upon, sew to
s: From [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G4476](G4476); to *stitch* *upon*, that is, *fasten* with the needle: - sew on.

d: **1.** to throw upon, place upon
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4496](G4496); to *throw* *upon* (literally or figuratively): - cast upon.

d:
**1.** having a mark on it, marked, stamped, coined
**2.** marked
  **a.** in a good sense
    **1.** of note, illustrious
  **b.** in a bad sense
    **1.** notorious, infamous
s: From [G1909](G1909) and some form of the base of [G4591](G4591); *remarkable*, that is, (figuratively) *eminent:* - notable, of note.
o: from [G1909](G1909) and some form of the base of [G4591](G4591)

d:
**1.** foraging, providing food
**2.** supplies, provisions, food
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of [G4621](G4621); a *provisioning*, that is, (concretely) *food:* - victuals.
o: from a compound of [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of [G4621](G4621)

d:
**1.** to look upon or after, to inspect, examine with the eyes
  **a.** in order to see how he is, i.e. to visit, go to see one
    **1.** the poor and afflicted, the sick
  **b.** to look upon in order to help or to benefit
    **1.** to look after, have care for, provide for: of God
  **c.** to look (about) for, look out (one to choose, employ, etc.)
s: Middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G4649](G4649); to *inspect*, that is, (by implication) to *select*; by extension to *go* *to* *see*, *relieve:* - look out, visit.
o: middle voice from [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G4649](G4649)

d:
**1.** to fix a tent or habitation on
  **a.** to take possession of and live in the houses
    **1.** of the citizens
    **2.** of the power of christ descending upon one, working within him and giving him help
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4637](G4637); to *tent* *upon*, that is, (figuratively) *abide* *with:* - rest upon.

d: **1.** to throw a shadow upon, to envelop in a shadow, to overshadow
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of [G4639](G4639); to *cast* *a* *shade* *upon*, that is, (by analogy) to *envelop* in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively to *invest* with preternatural influence: - overshadow.

d:
**1.** to look upon, inspect, oversee, look after, care for
  **a.** of the care of the church which rested upon the elders
  **b.** to look carefully, beware
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4648](G4648); to *oversee*; by implication to *beware:* - look diligently, take the oversight.

d:
**1.** investigation, inspection, visitation
  **a.** that act by which God looks into and searches out the ways, deeds character, of men, in order to adjudge them their lot accordingly, whether joyous or sad
  **b.** oversight
    **1.** overseership, office, charge, the office of an elder
    **2.** the overseer or presiding officers of a Christian church
s: From [G1980](G1980); *inspection* (for relief); by implication *superintendence*; specifically the Christian “episcopate”: - the office of a “bishop”, bishoprick, visitation.

d:
**1.** an overseer
  **a.** a man charged with the duty of seeing that things to be done by others are done rightly, any curator, guardian or superintendent
  **b.** the superintendent, elder, or overseer of a Christian church
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4649](G4649) (in the sense of [G1983](G1983)); a *superintendent*, that is, Christian officer in general charge of a (or the) church (literally or figuratively): - bishop, overseer.

d: **1.** to draw on (let him not draw on his foreskin)
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4685](G4685); to *draw* *over*, that is, (with [G203](G203) implied) *efface* the mark of *circumcision* (by recovering with the foreskin): - become uncircumcised.

d:
**1.** to put one’s attention on, fix one’s thoughts on, to turn one’s self or one’s mind to, put one’s thought upon a thing
  **a.** to be acquainted with, to understand
  **b.** to know
s: Apparently a middle voice of [G2186](G2186) (with [G3563](G3563) implied); to *put* the mind *upon*, that is, *comprehend*, or *be* *acquainted* *with:* - know, understand.
o: apparently a middle voice of [G2186](G2186) (with [G3563](G3563) implied)

d: **1.** any sort of superintendent or overseer
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a presumed derivative of [G2476](G2476); an *appointee* *over*, that is, *commander* (*teacher*): - master.
o: from [G1909](G1909) and a presumed derivative of [G2476](G2476)

d:
**1.** to send one a message, command
**2.** to write a letter
**3.** to enjoin by letter, to write instructions
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4724](G4724); to *enjoin* (by writing), that is, (generally) to *communicate* *by* *letter* (for any purpose): - write (a letter, unto).

d: **1.** intelligent, experienced, one having the knowledge of an expert
s: From [G1987](G1987); *intelligent:* - endued with knowledge.

d:
**1.** to establish besides, strengthen more
**2.** to render more firm, confirm
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4741](G4741); to *support* *further*, that is, *reestablish:* - confirm, strengthen.

d: **1.** a letter, epistle
s: From [G1989](G1989); a *written* *message:* - ”epistle”, letter.

d:
**1.** to bridle or stop up the mouth
**2.** metaph. to stop the mouth, reduce to silence
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4750](G4750); to put something *over* the *mouth*, that is, (figuratively) to *silence:* - stop mouths.

d:
**1.** transitively
  **a.** to turn to
    **1.** to the worship of the true God
  **b.** to cause to return, to bring back
    **1.** to the love and obedience of God
    **2.** to the love for the children
    **3.** to love wisdom and righteousness
**2.** intransitively
  **a.** to turn to one’s self
  **b.** to turn one’s self about, turn back
  **c.** to return, turn back, come back
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4762](G4762); to *revert* (literally, figuratively or morally): - come (go) again, convert, (re-) turn (about, again).

d: **1.** conversion (of the Gentiles from idolatry to the true God)
s: From [G1994](G1994); *reversion*, that is, moral *revolution:* - conversion.

d:
**1.** to gather together besides, to bring together to others already assembled
**2.** to gather together against
**3.** to gather together in one place
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4863](G4863); to *collect* *upon* the same place: - gather (together).

d:
**1.** a gathering together in one place
**2.** the (religious) assembly (of Christians)
s: From [G1996](G1996); a complete *collection*; specifically a Christian *meeting* (for worship): - assembling (gathering) together.

d:
**1.** to run together besides
  **a.** to others already gathered
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4936](G4936); to *hasten* *together* *upon* one place (or a particular occasion): - come running together.

d:
**1.** a hostile banding together or concourse
  **a.** to excite to a riotous gathering of the people to make a mob
  **b.** a troublesome throng of persons seeking help, counsel, comfort
  **c.** throng to one
s: From the middle of a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G4921](G4921); a *conspiracy*, that is, *concourse* (riotous or friendly): - that which cometh upon, + raising up.
o: from the middle voice of a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G4921](G4921)

d: **1.** prone to fall
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and σφάλλω sphallō (to *trip*); figuratively *insecure:* - dangerous.
o: from a compound of [G1909](G1909) and sphallo (to trip)

d:
**1.** to give additional strength, to make stronger
**2.** to receive greater strength, grow stronger
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2480](G2480); to *avail* *further*, that is, (figuratively) *insist* *stoutly:* - be the more fierce.

d: **1.** to heap up, accumulate in piles
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G4987](G4987); to *accumulate* *further*, that is, (figuratively) *seek* additionally: - heap.

d: **1.** an injunction, mandate, command
s: From [G2004](G2004); an *injunction* or *decree*; by implication *authoritativeness:* - authority, commandment.

d: **1.** to enjoin upon, order, command, charge
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5021](G5021); to *arrange* *upon*, that is, *order:* - charge, command, injoin.

d:
**1.** to bring to an end, accomplish, perfect, execute, complete
  **a.** to take upon one’s self
  **b.** to make an end for one’s self
    **1.** to leave off
**2.** to appoint to, impose upon
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5055](G5055); to *fulfill* *further* (or *completely*), that is, *execute*; by implication to *terminate*, *undergo:* - accomplish, do, finish, (make) (perfect), perform (X -ance).

d:
**1.** fit, suitable, convenient, advantageous
**2.** needful, esp. of the necessities of life
s: From ἐπιτηδές epitēdes (*enough*); *serviceable*, that is, (by implication) *requisite:* - things which are needful.

d:
**1.** in the active voice
  **a.** to put or lay upon
  **b.** to add to
**2.** in the middle voice
  **a.** to have put on, bid to be laid on
  **b.** to lay or throw one’s self upon
  **c.** to attack one, to make an assault on one
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5087](G5087); to *impose* (in a friendly or hostile sense): - add unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up), + surname, X wound.

d:
**1.** to show honour to, to honour
**2.** to raise the price of
**3.** to adjudge, award, in the sense of merited penalty
**4.** to tax with fault, rate, chide, rebuke, reprove, censure severely
  **a.** to admonish or charge sharply
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5091](G5091); to *tax* *upon*, that is, *censure* or *admonish*; by implication *forbid:* - (straitly) charge, rebuke.

d: **1.** punishment
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G5092](G5092); properly *esteem*, that is, *citizenship*; used (in the sense of [G2008](G2008)) of a *penalty:* - punishment.

d:
**1.** to turn to, transfer, commit, instruct
**2.** to permit, allow, give leave
s: From [G1909](G1909) and the base of [G5157](G5157); to *turn* *over* (*transfer*), that is, *allow:* - give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

d: **1.** permission, power, commission
s: From [G2010](G2010); *permission*, that is, (by implication) full *power:* - commission.

d:
**1.** one to whose care or honour anything has been instructed
  **a.** a curator, a guardian
  **b.** a steward or manager of a household, or of lands
    **1.** overseer
  **c.** one who has the care and tutelage of children, either where the father is dead (a guardian of minors), or where the father is still alive
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5158](G5158) (in the sense of [G2011](G2011)); a *commissioner*, that is, domestic *manager*, *guardian:* - steward, tutor.

d:
**1.** to light or hit upon any person or thing
**2.** to attain to, obtain
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5177](G5177); to *chance* *upon*, that is, (by implication) *attain:* - obtain.

d:
**1.** to show to or upon
  **a.** to bring to light
**2.** to appear, become visible
  **a.** of stars
**3.** to become clearly known, to show one’s self
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5316](G5316); to *shine* *upon*, that is, *become* (literally) *visible* or (figuratively) *known:* - appear, give light.

d: **1.** an appearing, appearance
s: From [G2016](G2016); a *manifestation*, that is, (specifically) the *advent* of Christ (past or future): - appearing, brightness.

d: **1.** conspicuous, manifest, illustrious
s: From [G2014](G2014); *conspicuous*, that is, (figuratively) *memorable:* - notable.

d:
**1.** to shine upon
  **a.** christ will pour upon you the divine truth as the sun gives light to men aroused from sleep
s: A form of [G2014](G2014); to *illuminate* (figuratively): - give light.

d:
**1.** to bring upon, bring forward
  **a.** used of accusers
**2.** to lay upon, to inflict
**3.** to bring upon, i.e. in addition, to add, increase
**4.** to put upon, cast upon, impose
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5342](G5342); to *bear* *upon* (or *further*), that is, *adduce* (personally or judicially \[*accuse*, *inflict*\]), *superinduce:* - add, bring (against), take.

d: **1.** to call out to, shout
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5455](G5455); to *call* *at* something, that is, *exclaim:* - cry (against), give a shout.

d: **1.** to grow light, to dawn
s: A form of [G2017](G2017); to begin to *grow* *light:* - begin to dawn, X draw on.

d:
**1.** to put the hand to
**2.** to take in hand, undertake, attempt
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5495](G5495); to put the *hand* *upon*, that is, *undertake:* - go about, take in hand (upon).

d: **1.** to pour upon
s: From [G1909](G1909) and χέω cheō (to *pour*); to *pour* *upon:* - pour in.

d:
**1.** to supply, furnish, present
**2.** to be supplied, ministered to, assisted
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5524](G5524); to *furnish* *besides*, that is, fully *supply*, (figuratively) *aid* or *contribute:* - add, minister (nourishment, unto).

d: **1.** a supplying, supply
s: From [G2023](G2023); *contribution:* - supply.

d: **1.** to spread on, anoint anything upon anything
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G5548](G5548); to *smear* *over:* - anoint.

d: **1.** to build upon, build up
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3618](G3618); to *build* *upon*, that is, (figuratively) to *rear* *up:* - build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).

d:
**1.** to drive upon, strike against
  **a.** to run a ship aground
s: From [G1909](G1909) and ὀκέλλω okellō (to *urge*); to *drive* *upon* the shore, that is, to *beach* a vessel: - run aground.

d:
**1.** to put a name upon, name
**2.** to be named
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3687](G3687); to *name* *further*, that is, *denominate:* - call.

d:
**1.** to be an overseer
**2.** to look upon, view attentively
**3.** to watch
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a derivative of [G3700](G3700); to *inspect*, that is, *watch:* - behold.

d:
**1.** an overseer, inspector
**2.** spectator, eye witness of anything
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a presumed derivative of [G3700](G3700); a *looker* *on:* - eye-witness.
o: from [G1909](G1909) and a presumed derivative of [G3700](G3700)

d: **1.** a word
s: From [G2036](G2036); a *word:* - X say.

d:
**1.** existing in heaven
  **a.** things that take place in heaven
  **b.** the heavenly regions
    **1.** heaven itself, the abode of God and angels
    **2.** the lower heavens, of the stars
    **3.** the heavens, of the clouds
  **c.** the heavenly temple or sanctuary
**2.** of heavenly origin or nature
