s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G3772](G3772); *above* the *sky:* - celestial, (in) heaven (-ly), high.

d: **1.** seven
s: A primary number; *seven:* - seven.

d: **1.** seven times
s: Adverb from [G2033](G2033); *seven* *times:* - seven times.

d: **1.** seven thousand
s: From [G2034](G2034) and [G5507](G5507); *seven* *times* *a* *thousand:* - seven thousand.

d: **1.** to speak, say
s: A primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from [G2046](G2046), [G4483](G4483) and [G5346](G5346)); to *speak* or *say* (by word or writting): - answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on), speak, tell. Compare [G3004](G3004).
o: a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being borrowed from [G2046](G2046), [G4483](G4483), and [G5346](G5346))

d:
Erastus = beloved
**1.** a companion of the apostle Paul
**2.** the chamberlain or rather the public treasurer, of Corinth
s: From ἐράω eraō (to *love*); *beloved*; *Erastus*, a Christian: - Erastus.

d:
**1.** to work, labour, do work
**2.** to trade, to make gains by trading, do business
**3.** to do, work out
  **a.** exercise, perform, commit
  **b.** to cause to exist, produce
**4.** to work for, earn by working, to acquire
s: Middle voice from [G2041](G2041); to *toil* (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by implication) *effect*, *be* *engaged* *in* or *with*, etc.: - commit, do, labor for, minister about, trade (by), work.

d:
**1.** a working, performing
**2.** work, business
**3.** gain got by work, profit
**4.** endeavour, pains
s: From [G2040](G2040); *occupation*; by implication *profit*, *pains:* - craft, diligence, gain, work.

d:
**1.** a workman, a labourer
  **a.** usually one who works for hire esp. an agricultural worker
**2.** one who does, a worker, perpetrator
s: From [G2041](G2041); a *toiler*; figuratively a *teacher:* - labourer, worker (-men).

d:
**1.** business, employment, that which any one is occupied
  **a.** that which one undertakes to do, enterprise, undertaking
**2.** any product whatever, any thing accomplished by hand, art, industry, or mind
**3.** an act, deed, thing done: the idea of working is emphasised in opp. to that which is less than work
s: From ἔργω ergō (a primary but obsolete word; to *work*); *toil* (as an effort or occupation); by implication an *act:* - deed, doing, labour, work.
o: from a primary (but obsolete) ergo (to work)

d: **1.** to stir up, excite, stimulate, to provoke
s: From a presumed prolonged form of [G2054](G2054); to *stimulate* (especially to anger): - provoke.
o: from a presumed prolonged form of [G2054](G2054)

d: **1.** to fix, prop firmly
s: Of obscure affinity; to *prop*, that is, (reflexively) *get* *fast:* - stick fast.

d:
**1.** to spit or spew out
**2.** to be emptied, discharge itself, used of streams
  **a.** to empty, discharge, cast forth, used of rivers and waters
**3.** to pour forth words, to speak out, utter
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *belch*, that is, (figuratively) to *speak* *out:* - utter.

d: **1.** to search, examine into
s: Apparently from [G2046](G2046) (through the idea of *inquiry*); to *seek*, that is, (figuratively) to *investigate:* - search.
o: apparently from [G2046](G2046) (through the idea of enquiry)

d: **1.** to utter, speak, say
s: Probably a fuller form of [G4483](G4483); an alternate for [G2036](G2036) in certain tenses; to *utter*, that is, *speak* or *say:* - call, say, speak (of), tell.
o: probably a fuller form of [G4483](G4483), an alternate for [G2036](G2036) in cert. tenses

d: **1.** a solitude, an uninhabited region, a waste
s: From [G2048](G2048); *solitude* (concretely): - desert, wilderness.

d:
**1.** solitary, lonely, desolate, uninhabited
  **a.** used of places
    **1.** a desert, wilderness
    **2.** deserted places, lonely regions
    **3.** an uncultivated region fit for pasturage
  **b.** used of persons
    **1.** deserted by others
    **2.** deprived of the aid and protection of others, especially of friends, acquaintances, kindred
    **3.** bereft
  **c.** of a flock deserted by the shepherd
  **d.** of a woman neglected by her husband, from whom the husband withholds himself
s: Of uncertain affinity; *lonesome*, that is, (by implication) *waste* (usually as a noun, [G5561](G5561) being implied): - desert, desolate, solitary, wilderness.

d:
**1.** to make desolate, lay waste
**2.** to ruin, bring to desolation
**3.** to despoil one, strip her of her treasures
s: From [G2048](G2048); to *lay* *waste* (literally or figuratively): - (bring to, make) desolate (-ion), come to nought.

d: **1.** a making desolate, desolation
s: From [G2049](G2049); *despoliation:* - desolation.

d:
**1.** to wrangle, engage in strife
  **a.** used to describe the calm temper of Jesus in contrast with the vehemence of the Jewish doctors wrangling together about tenets and practices
s: From [G2054](G2054); to *wrangle:* - strive.

d:
**1.** electioneering or intriguing for office
  **a.** apparently, in the NT a courting distinction, a desire to put one’s self forward, a partisan and fractious spirit which does not disdain low arts
  **b.** partisanship, fractiousness This word is found before NT times only in Aristotle where it denotes a self-seeking pursuit of political office by unfair means. (A&G)Paul exhorts to be one in the mind of christ not putting self forward or being selfish (Php 2:2)
s: Perhaps from the same as [G2042](G2042); properly *intrigue*, that is, (by implication) *faction:* - contention (-ious), strife.

d: **a.** wool
s: Of obscure affinity; *wool:* - wool.

d: **a.** contention, strife, wrangling
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *quarrel*, that is, (by implication) *wrangling:* - contention, debate, strife, variance.

d: **a.** a kid, a young goat
s: From [G2056](G2056); a *kidling*, that is, (generally) *goat* (symbolically *wicked* person): - goat.

d: **a.** a kid, a young goat
s: Perhaps from the same as [G2053](G2053) (through the idea of *hairiness*); a *kid* or (generally) *goat:* - goat, kid.
o: perhaps from the same as [G2053](G2053) (through the idea of hairiness)

d:
hermas = Mercury
**a.** a Christian mentioned in Rom 16:14. According to tradition, he was one of the seventy disciples, and afterwards bishop of Dalmatia. (A.D. )
s: Probably from [G2060](G2060); *Hermas*, a Christian: - Hermas.

d:
**a.** interpretation
**1.** of what has been spoken more or less obscurely by others
s: From the same as [G2059](G2059); *translation:* - interpretation.

d:
**1.** to explain in words, expound
**2.** to interpret
  **a.** to translate what has been spoken or written in a foreign tongue into the vernacular
s: From a presumed derivative of [G2060](G2060) (as the god of language); to *translate:* - interpret.
o: from a presumed derivative of [G2060](G2060) (as the God of language)

d:
mercurius or hermes = herald of the Gods
**1.** a Greek deity called by the Romans mercurius (Mercury)
**2.** a certain Christian
s: Perhaps from [G2046](G2046); *Hermes*, the name of the messenger of the Greek deities; also of a Christian: - Hermes, Mercury.

d:
hermogenes = lucky born or born of mercury
**1.** a certain Christian mentioned in 2Ti 1:15
s: From [G2060](G2060) and [G1096](G1096); *born* *of* *Hermes*; *Hermogenes*, an apostate Christian: - Hermogenes.

d:
**1.** a creeping animal, reptile
  **a.** used chiefly of snakes
**2.** an animal of any sort
  **a.** four-legged animals and birds
  **b.** marine animals
s: Neuter of a derivative of ἕρπω herpō (to *creep*); a *reptile*, that is, (by Hebraism (compare \[[H7431](H7431)\]) a small *animal:* - creeping thing, serpent.
o: neuter of a derivative of herpo (to creep)

d:
**1.** the Red Sea
  **a.** the Indian Ocean washing the shores of Arabia and Persia, with its two gulfs, of which the one on the east is called the Persian Gulf, the other on the opposite side the Arabian. In the NT the phrase denotes the upper part of the Arabian Gulf (the heropolitie Gulf, so called \[i.e. the Gulf of Suez\]), through which the Israelites made their passage out of Egypt to the shore of Arabia.
s: Of uncertain affinity; *red*, that is, (with [G2281](G2281)) the *red* Sea: - red.

d:
**1.** to come
  **a.** of persons
    **1.** to come from one place to another, and used both of persons arriving
    **2.** to appear, make one’s appearance, come before the public
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to come into being, arise, come forth, show itself, find place or influence
  **b.** be established, become known, to come (fall) into or unto
**3.** to go, to follow one
s: Middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred \[middle voice\] word, ἐλεύθομαι eleuthomai or ἔλθω elthō; which do not otherwise occur); to *come* or *go* (in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively): - accompany, appear, bring, come enter, fall out, go, grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.
o: middle voice of a primary verb (used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being supplied by a kindred \[middle voice\] eleuthomai el-yoo’-thom-ahee, or \[active\] eltho el’-tho, which do not otherwise occur)

d:
**1.** to question
**2.** to ask
  **a.** to request, entreat, beg, beseech
s: Apparently from [G2046](G2046) (compare [G2045](G2045)); to *interrogate*; by implication to *request*: - ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray. Compare [G4441](G4441).

d: **1.** clothing, raiment, apparel
s: From ἔννυμι hennumi (to *clothe*); *dress:* - apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.

d: **1.** clothing, apparel
s: From a derivative of [G2066](G2066); *clothing* (concretely): - garment.

d:
**1.** to eat
**2.** to eat (consume) a thing
  **a.** to take food, eat a meal
**3.** metaph. to devour, consume
s: Strengthened for a primary word ἔδω edō (to *eat*); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by [G5315](G5315); to *eat* (usually literally): - devour, eat, live.
o: strengthened for a primary edo (to eat); used only in certain tenses, the rest being supplied by [G5315](G5315)

d:
Esli = reserved of Jehovah
**1.** the son of Nagge or Naggai in the genealogy of christ. Luk 3:25.
s: Of Hebrew origin (probably for \[[H454](H454)\]); *Esli*, an Israelite: - Esli.

d: **1.** first person plural of to be
s: Frist person plural indicative of [G1510](G1510); we *are:* - are, be, have our being, X have hope, + \[the gospel\] was \[preached unto\] us.

d: **1.** future first person singular of to be
s: Future tense of [G1510](G1510); *will* *be:* - shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.

d:
**1.** a mirror
  **a.** the mirrors of the ancients were made, not of glass, but steel
s: From [G1519](G1519) and a presumed derivative of [G3700](G3700); a *mirror* (for *looking* *into*): - glass. Compare [G2734](G2734).
o: from [G1519](G1519) and a presumed derivative of [G3700](G3700)

d: **1.** evening, eventide
s: Feminine of an adjective ἑσπερός hesperos (*evening*); the *eve* ([G5610](G5610) being implied): - evening (-tide).

d:
Esrom or hezron or hesron = enclosed
**1.** the son of Reuben, and ancestor of the hezronites
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2696](H2696)\]; *Esrom* (that is, *Chetsron*), an Israelite: - Esrom.

d: **1.** second person plural of to be
s: Second person plural present indicative of [G1510](G1510); ye *are:* - be, have been, belong.
o: second person plural present indicative of [G1510](G1510)

d: **1.** third person singular of to be
s: Third person singular present indicative of [G1510](G1510); he (she or it) *is*; also (with neuter plural) they *are:* - are, be (-long), call, X can \[-not\], come, consisteth, X dure for awhile, + follow, X have, (that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, + remaineth, + wrestle.
o: third person singular present indicative of [G1510](G1510)

d: **1.** third persons singular imperative of to be
s: Second person singular present imperative and third person of [G1510](G1510); *be* thou; *let* them *be:* - be.
o: second person singular present imperative of [G1510](G1510), estosan es’-to-santhird person of the same

d:
**1.** extreme
  **a.** last in time or in place
  **b.** last in a series of places
  **c.** last in a temporal succession
**2.** the last
  **a.** last, referring to time
  **b.** of space, the uttermost part, the end, of the earth
  **c.** of rank, grade of worth, last i.e. lowest
s: A superlative probably from [G2192](G2192) (in the sense of *contiguity*); *farthest*, *final* (of place or time): - ends of, last, latter end, lowest, uttermost.
o: a superlative probably from [G2192](G2192) (in the sense of contiguity)

d: **1.** extreme, to be in the last gasp, at the point of death
s: Adverb from [G2078](G2078); *finally*, that is, (with [G2192](G2192)) *at* *the* *extremity* of life: - point of death.

d:
**1.** to within, into
**2.** within
  **a.** the internal inner man
  **b.** the soul, conscience
s: From [G1519](G1519); *inside* (as preposition or adjective): - (with-) in (-ner, -to, -ward).

d:
**1.** from within
**2.** within, that which is within, the inside
  **a.** your soul
s: From [G2080](G2080); *from* *inside*; also used as equivalent to [G2080](G2080) (*inside*): - inward (-ly), (from) within, without.

d:
**1.** inner
  **a.** the inner space which is behind the veil
  **b.** the shrine, the holy of Holies, said of heaven by a figure drawn from earthly temple
s: Comparative of [G2080](G2080); *interior:* - inner, within.

d:
**1.** a comrade, mate, partner
**2.** in kindly address
  **a.** friend, (my good friend)
s: From ἔτης etēs (a *clansman*); a *comrade:* - fellow, friend.

d: **1.** one who speaks a foreign language
s: From [G2087](G2087) and [G1100](G1100); *other* *tongued*, that is, a *foreigner:* - man of other tongue.

d:
**1.** to teach other or different doctrine
  **a.** deviating from the truth
s: From [G2087](G2087) and [G1320](G1320); to *instruct* *differently:* - teach other doctrine (-wise).

d:
**1.** to come under an unequal or different yoke, to be unequally yoked
  **a.** to have fellowship with one who is not an equal: 2Co 6:14, where the apostle is forbidding Christians to have intercourse with idolaters
s: From a compound of [G2087](G2087) and [G2218](G2218); to *yoke* up *differently*, that is, (figuratively) to *associate* *discordantly:* - unequally yoke together with.

d:
**1.** the other, another, other
  **a.** to number
    **1.** to number as opposed to some former person or thing
    **2.** the other of two
  **b.** to quality
    **1.** another: i.e. one not of the same nature, form, class, kind, different
s: Of uncertain affinity; (an-, the) *other* or *different:* - altered, else, next (day), one, (an-) other, some, strange.

d: **1.** otherwise, differently
s: Adverb from [G2087](G2087); *differently:* - otherwise.

d:
**1.** yet, still
  **a.** of time
    **1.** of a thing which went on formerly, whereas now a different state of things exists or has begun to exist
    **2.** of a thing which continues at present
  **b.** even, now
    **1.** with negatives
  **c.** no longer, no more
  **d.** of degree and increase
    **1.** even, yet
    **2.** besides, more, further
s: Perhaps akin to [G2094](G2094); *“yet”*, *still* (of time or degree): - after that, also, ever, (any) further, (t-) henceforth (more), hereafter, (any) longer, (any) more (-one), now, still, yet.

d:
**1.** to make ready, prepare
  **a.** to make the necessary preparations, get everything ready
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** drawn from the oriental custom of sending on before kings on their journeys persons to level the roads and make them passable
  **b.** to prepare the minds of men to give the messiah a fit reception and secure his blessings
s: From [G2092](G2092); to *prepare*: - prepare, provide, make ready. Compare [G2680](G2680).

d:
**1.** the act of preparing
**2.** the condition of a person or thing so far forth as prepared, preparedness, readiness
s: From [G2090](G2090); *preparation:* - preparation.

d:
**1.** prepare ready
  **a.** of things
    **1.** ready at hand
    **2.** opportune, seasonable
  **b.** of persons
    **1.** ready prepared
  **c.** to do something
  **d.** to receive one coming
s:
From an old noun ἕτεος
heteos (*fitness*); *adjusted*, that is, *ready:* - prepared, (made) ready (-iness, to our hand).

d: **1.** readily, to be ready
s: Adverb from [G2092](G2092); *in* *readiness:* - ready.

d: **1.** year
s: Apparently a primary word; a *year:* - year.

d:
**1.** to be well off, fare well, prosper
**2.** acting well
s: Neuter of a primary word εὖς eus (*good*); (adverbially) *well:* - good, well (done).

d:
Eve meaning life
**1.** first woman in the scriptures, mother of the entire human family
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2332](H2332)\]; *Eua* (or *Eva*, that is, *Chavvah*), the first woman: - Eve.

d:
**1.** to bring good news, to announce glad tidings
  **a.** used in the OT of any kind of good news
    **1.** of the joyful tidings of God’s kindness, in particular, of the messianic blessings
  **b.** in the NT used especially of the glad tidings of the coming kingdom of God, and of the salvation to be obtained in it through christ, and of what relates to this salvation
  **c.** glad tidings are brought to one, one has glad tidings proclaimed to him
  **d.** to proclaim glad tidings
    **1.** instruct (men) concerning the things that pertain to Christian salvation
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G32](G32); to *announce* *good* news (“evangelize”) especially the gospel: - declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach (the gospel).

d:
**1.** a reward for good tidings
**2.** good tidings
  **a.** the glad tidings of the kingdom of God soon to be set up, and subsequently also of Jesus the messiah, the founder of this kingdom. After the death of christ, the term comprises also the preaching of (concerning) Jesus christ as having suffered death on the cross to procure eternal salvation for the men in the kingdom of God, but as restored to life and exalted to the right hand of God in heaven, thence to return in majesty to consummate the kingdom of God
  **b.** the glad tidings of salvation through christ
  **c.** the proclamation of the grace of God manifest and pledged in christ
  **d.** the gospel
  **e.** as the messianic rank of Jesus was proved by his words, his deeds, and his death, the narrative of the sayings, deeds, and death of Jesus christ came to be called the gospel or glad tidings
s: From the same as [G2097](G2097); a *good* *message*, that is, the *gospel:* - gospel.

d:
**1.** a bringer of good tidings, an evangelist
**2.** the name given to the NT heralds of salvation through christ who are not apostles
s: From [G2097](G2097); a *preacher* of the gospel: - evangelist.

d:
**1.** to be well pleasing
**2.** to be well pleased with a thing
s: From [G2101](G2101); to *gratify* *entirely:* - please (well).

d: **1.** well pleasing, acceptable
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G701](G701); *fully* *agreeable:* - acceptable (-ted), wellpleasing.

d: **1.** in a manner well pleasing to one, acceptable
s: From [G2101](G2101); *quite* *agreeably:* - acceptably, + please well.

d:
Eubulus = prudent
**1.** a Christian at Rome
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G1014](G1014); *good* *willer*; *Eubulus*, a Christian: - Eubulus.

d:
**1.** well born, of a noble family
**2.** noble minded
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G1096](G1096); *well* *born*, that is, (literally) *high* in rank, or (figuratively) *generous:* - more noble, nobleman.

d: **1.** a serene sky, fair weather
s: Feminine from [G2095](G2095) and the alternate of [G2203](G2203) (as the god of the weather); a *clear* *sky*, that is, *fine* *weather:* - fair weather.
o: feminine from [G2095](G2095) and the alternate of [G2203](G2203) (as the God of the weather)

d:
**1.** it seems good to one, is one’s good pleasure
  **a.** think it good, choose, determine, decide
  **b.** to do willingly
  **c.** to be ready to, to prefer, choose rather
**2.** to be well pleased with, take pleasure in, to be favourably inclined towards one
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G1380](G1380); to *think* *well* of, that is, *approve* (an act); specifically to *approbate* (a person or thing): - think good, (be well) please (-d), be the good (have, take) pleasure, be willing.

d:
**1.** will, choice
  **a.** good will, kindly intent, benevolence
**2.** delight, pleasure, satisfaction
**3.** desire
  **a.** for delight in any absent thing easily produces longing for it
s: From a presumed compound of [G2095](G2095) and the base of [G1380](G1380); *satisfaction*, that is, (subjectively) *delight*, or (objectively) *kindness*, *wish*, *purpose:* - desire, good pleasure (will), X seem good.
o: from a presumed compound of [G2095](G2095) and the base of [G1380](G1380)

d: **1.** a good deed, benefit
s: From [G2110](G2110); *beneficence* (generally or specifically): - benefit, good deed done.

d: **1.** to do good, bestow benefits
s: From [G2110](G2110); to *be* *philanthropic:* - do good.

d:
**1.** benefactor
**2.** a title of honour, conferred on such as had done their country service, and upon princes, equivalent to Soter, Pater Patriae
s: From [G2095](G2095) and the base of [G2041](G2041); a *worker* *of* *good*, that is, (specifically) a *philanthropist:* - benefactor.

d:
**1.** well placed
  **a.** fit
  **b.** useful
s: From [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087); *well* *placed*, that is, (figuratively) *appropriate:* - fit, meet.

d: **1.** straightway, immediately, forthwith
s: Adverb from [G2117](G2117); *directly*, that is, *at* *once* or *soon:* - anon, as soon as, forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.

d: **1.** to make a straight course, run a straight course
s: From [G2117](G2117) and [G1408](G1408); to *lay* *a* *straight* *course*, that is, *sail* *direct:* - (come) with a straight course.

d:
**1.** to put in good spirits, gladden, make cheerful
  **a.** to be of good spirits, to be cheerful
**2.** to be joyful, be of good cheer, of good courage
s: From [G2115](G2115); to *cheer* *up*, that is, (intransitively) *be* *cheerful*; neuter comparative (adverb) *more* *cheerfully:* - be of good cheer (merry).

d:
**1.** well disposed, kind
**2.** of good cheer, of good courage
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G2372](G2372); in *fine* *spirits*, that is, *cheerful:* - of good cheer, the more cheerfully.

d:
**1.** to make straight, level, plain
**2.** to lead or guide straight, to keep straight or direct
  **a.** of the steersman or helmsman of a ship
  **b.** of a charioteer
s: From [G2117](G2117); to *straighten* (*level*); technically to *steer:* - governor, make straight.

d:
**1.** straight, level
**2.** straight forward, upright, true, sincere
**3.** straightway, immediately, forthwith
s: Perhaps from [G2095](G2095) and [G5087](G5087); *straight*, that is, (literally) *level*, or (figuratively) *true*; adverbially (of time) *at* *once:* - anon, by and by, forthwith, immediately, straightway.

d: **1.** rectitude, righteousness
s: From [G2117](G2117); *rectitude:* - righteousness.

d:
**1.** to have opportunity
**2.** to have leisure
**3.** to do something
**4.** to give one’s time to a thing
s: From [G2121](G2121); to *have* *good* *time*, that is, *opportunity* or *leisure:* - have leisure (convenient time), spend time.

d: **1.** seasonable time, opportunity
s: From [G2121](G2121); a favorable *occasion:* - opportunity.

d: **1.** seasonable, timely, opportune
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G2540](G2540); *well* *timed*, that is, *opportune:* - convenient, in time of need.

d:
**1.** seasonably, opportunely
**2.** when the opportunity occurs
s: Adverb from [G2121](G2121); *opportunely:* - conveniently, in season.

d:
**1.** with easy labour
**2.** easy
s: Comparative of a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G2873](G2873); *better* *for* *toil*, that is, *more* *facile:* - easier.
o: comparative of a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G2873](G2873)

d:
**1.** caution, circumspection, discretion
  **a.** avoidance
  **b.** a reasonable shunning
**2.** reverence, veneration
  **a.** reverence toward God, Godly fear, piety
**3.** fear anxiety, dread
s: From [G2126](G2126); properly *caution*, that is, (religiously) *reverence* (*piety*); by implication *dread* (concretely): - fear (-ed).

d:
**1.** to act cautiously, circumspectly
**2.** to beware, fear
**3.** to reverence, stand in awe of
s: Middle voice from [G2126](G2126); to *be* *circumspect*, that is, (by implication) to *be* *apprehensive*; religiously, to *reverence:* - (moved with) fear.

d:
**1.** taking hold well
  **a.** carefully and surely
  **b.** cautiously
**2.** reverencing God, pious, religious
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G2983](G2983); *taking* *well* (*carefully*), that is, *circumspect* (religiously, *pious*): - devout.

d:
**1.** to praise, celebrate with praises
**2.** to invoke blessings
**3.** to consecrate a thing with solemn prayers
  **a.** to ask God’s blessing on a thing
  **b.** pray God to bless it to one’s use
  **c.** pronounce a consecratory blessing on
**4.** of God
  **a.** to cause to prosper, to make happy, to bestow blessings on
  **b.** favoured of God, blessed
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G3056](G3056); to *speak* *well* *of*, that is, (religiously) to *bless* (*thank* or *invoke* *a* *benediction* *upon*, *prosper*): - bless, praise.

d: **1.** blessed, praised
s: From [G2127](G2127); *adorable:* - blessed.

d:
**1.** praise, laudation, panegyric: of christ or God
**2.** fine discourse, polished language
  **a.** in a bad sense, language artfully adapted to captivate the hearer: fair speaking, fine speeches
**3.** an invocation of blessing, benediction
**4.** consecration
**5.** a (concrete) blessing, benefit
s: From the same as [G2127](G2127); *fine* *speaking*, that is, *elegance* *of* *language*; *commendation* (“eulogy”), that is, (reverentially) *adoration*; religiously, *benediction*; by implication *consecration*; by extension *benefit* or *largess:* - blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.

d:
**1.** ready or free to impart
**2.** liberal
s: From [G2095](G2095) and a presumed derivative of [G3330](G3330); *good* *at* *imparting*, that is, *liberal:* - ready to distribute.
o: from [G2095](G2095) and a presumed derivative of [G3330](G3330)

d:
Eunice = good victory
**1.** the mother of Timothy
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G3529](G3529); *victorious*; *Eunice*, a Jewess: - Eunice.

d:
**1.** to wish (one) well
**2.** to be well disposed, of a peaceable spirit
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G3563](G3563); to *be* *well* *minded*, that is, *reconcile:* - agree.

d: **1.** good will, kindness
s: From the same as [G2132](G2132); *kindness*; euphemistically *conjugal* *duty:* - benevolence, good will.

d:
**1.** to castrate, to neuter a man
**2.** metaph. to make one’s self a eunuch i.e. by abstaining (like a eunuch from marriage)
s: From [G2135](G2135); to *castrate* (figuratively *live* *unmarried*): - make . . . eunuch.

d:
**1.** a bed keeper, bed guard, superintendent of the bedchamber, chamberlain
  **a.** in the palace of oriental monarchs who support numerous wives the superintendent of the women’s apartment or harem, an office held by eunuchs
  **b.** an emasculated man, a eunuch
    **1.** eunuchs in oriental courts held by other offices of greater, held by the Ethiopian eunuch mentioned in Act 8:27-39.
  **c.** one naturally incapacitated
    **1.** for marriage
    **2.** begetting children
  **d.** one who voluntarily abstains from marriage
s: From εὐνή eunē (a *bed*) and [G2192](G2192); a *castrated* person (such being employed in Oriental bed chambers); by extension an *impotent* or *unmarried* man; by implication a *chamberlain* (*state* *officer*): - eunuch.

d:
Euodias = fragrant
**1.** a Christian woman at Philippi
s: From the same as [G2137](G2137); *fine* *travelling*; *Euodia*, a Christian woman: - Euodias.

d:
**1.** to grant a prosperous and expeditious journey, to lead by a direct and easy way
**2.** to grant a successful issue, to cause to prosper
**3.** to prosper, be successful
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G3598](G3598); to *help* on the *road*, that is, (passively) *succeed* *in* *reaching*; figuratively to *succeed* in business affairs: - (have a) prosper (-ous journey).

d: **1.** easily obeying, compliant
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G3982](G3982); *good* for *persuasion*, that is, (intransitively) *compliant:* - easy to be intreated.

d: **1.** skilfully surrounding i.e. besetting
s: From [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of a presumed compound of [G4012](G4012) and [G2476](G2476); *well* *standing* *around*, that is, (a *competitor*) *thwarting* (a racer) in every direction (figuratively of sin in general): - which doth so easily beset.
o: from [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of a presumed compound of [G4012](G4012) and [G2476](G2476)

d: **1.** adoring good, beneficence
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G4160](G4160); *well* *doing*, that is, *beneficence:* - to do good.

d: **1.** to be well off, have means
s: From a compound of [G2090](G2090) and the base of [G4197](G4197); (intransitively) to *be* *good* for *passing* through, that is, (figuratively) *have* pecuniary *means:* - ability.
o: from a compound of [G2090](G2090) and the base of [G4197](G4197)

d: **1.** riches, means, wealth
s: From the same as [G2141](G2141); pecuniary *resources:* - wealth.

d: **1.** goodly appearance, shapeliness, beauty, comeliness
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G4241](G4241); *good* *suitableness*, that is, *gracefulness:* - grace.

d: **1.** well received, accepted, acceptable
s: From [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of [G4327](G4327); *well* *received*, that is, *approved*, *favorable:* - acceptable (-ted).

d: **1.** sitting constantly by, devoted
s: From [G2095](G2095) and the same as [G4332](G4332); *sitting* *well* *towards*, that is, (figuratively) *assiduous* (neuter *diligent* *service*): - X attend upon.

d:
**1.** to make a fair show
**2.** to please
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G4383](G4383); to *be* *of* *good* *countenance*, that is, (figuratively) to *make* *a* *display:* - make a fair show.

d:
**1.** to come upon, hit upon, to meet with
  **a.** after searching, to find a thing sought
  **b.** without previous search, to find (by chance), to fall in with
  **c.** those who come or return to a place
**2.** to find by enquiry, thought, examination, scrutiny, observation, to find out by practice and experience
  **a.** to see, learn, discover, understand
  **b.** to be found i.e. to be seen, be present
  **c.** to be discovered, recognised, detected, to show one’s self out, of one’s character or state as found out by others (men, God, or both)
  **d.** to get knowledge of, come to know, God
**3.** to find out for one’s self, to acquire, get, obtain, procure
s: A prolonged form of a primary word εὕρω heurō; which (together with another cognate form, εὑρέω heureō) is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect; to *find* (literally or figuratively): - find, get, obtain, perceive, see.
o: a prolonged form of a primary heuro hyoo’-ro, which (together with another cognate form heureo hyoo-reh’-o) is used for it in all the tenses except the present and imperfect

d:
Euroclydon = a violent agitation
**1.** south east wind raising mighty waves
**2.** a wind causing broad waves
s: From Εὖρος Euros (the *east* wind) and [G2830](G2830); a *storm* *from* *the* *east* (or south east), that is, (in modern phrase) a *Levanter:* - Euroklydon.

d: **1.** spacious, broad
s: From εὐρύς eurus (*wide*) and [G5561](G5561); *spacious:* - broad.

d:
**1.** reverence, respect
**2.** piety towards God, Godliness
s: From [G2152](G2152); *piety*; specifically the *gospel* scheme: - godliness, holiness.

d:
**1.** to act piously or reverently
  **a.** towards God, one’s country, magistrates, relations, and all to whom dutiful regard or reverence is due
s: From [G2152](G2152); to *be* *pious*, that is, (towards God) to *worship*, or (towards parents) to *respect* (*support*): - show piety, worship.

d: **1.** pious, dutiful
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G4576](G4576); *well* *reverent*, that is, *pious:* - devout, godly.

d: **1.** piously, Godly
s: Adverb from [G2152](G2152); *piously:* - godly.

d: **1.** well marked, clear and definite, distinct
s: From [G2095](G2095) and the base of [G4591](G4591); *well* *indicated*, that is, (figuratively) *significant:* - easy to be understood.

d:
**1.** having strong bowels
**2.** compassionate, tender hearted
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G4698](G4698); *well* *compassioned*, that is, *sympathetic:* - pitiful, tender-hearted.

d: **1.** in a seemly manner, decently
s: Adverb from [G2158](G2158); *decorously:* - decently, honestly.

d:
**1.** charm or elegance of figure, external beauty, decorum, modesty, seemliness
  **a.** of external charm, comeliness
s: From [G2158](G2158); *decorousness:* - comeliness.

d:
**1.** of elegant figure
  **a.** shapely, graceful, comely, bearing one’s self becomingly in speech or behaviour
**2.** of good standing
  **a.** honourable, influential, wealthy, respectable
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G4976](G4976); *well* *formed*, that is, (figuratively) *decorous*, *noble* (in rank): - comely, honourable.

d: **1.** vehemently, forcibly
s: Adverb from a compound of [G2095](G2095) and a derivation of τείνω teinō (to *stretch*); *in* *a* *well* *strung* *manner*, that is, (figuratively) *intensely* (in a good sense, *cogently*; in a bad one, *fiercely*): - mightily, vehemently.
o: from a compound of [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of teino (to stretch)

d:
**1.** pleasantry, humour, facetiousness
**2.** in a bad sense
  **a.** scurrility, ribaldry, low jesting
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of the base of [G5157](G5157) (meaning *well* *turned*, that is, *ready* *at* *repartee*, *jocose*); *witticism*, that is, (in a vulgar sense) *ribaldry:* - jesting.
o: from a compound of [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of the base of [G5157](G5157) (meaning well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose)

d:
Eutychus = fortunate
**1.** a youth restored to life by Paul
s: From [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of [G5177](G5177); *well* *fated*, that is, *fortunate*; *Eutychus*, a young man: - Eutychus.

d:
**1.** the utterance of good or auspicious words
**2.** good report, praise
s: From [G2163](G2163); *good* *language* (“euphemy”), that is, *praise* (*repute*): - good report.

d:
**1.** sounding well
**2.** uttering words of good omen, speaking auspiciously
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G5345](G5345); *well* *spoken* *of*, that is, *reputable:* - of good report.

d: **1.** to be fertile, bring forth plentifully
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G5409](G5409); to *bear* *well*, that is, *be* *fertile:* - bring forth abundantly.

d:
**1.** to gladden, make joyful
  **a.** to be glad, to be merry, to rejoice
  **b.** to rejoice in, be delighted with a thing
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G5424](G5424); to *put* (middle voice or passive voice *be*) *in* *a* *good* frame of *mind*, that is, *rejoice:* - fare, make glad, be (make) merry, rejoice.

d:
Euphrates = the good and abounding river
**1.** a large, famous river which rises in the mountains of Armenia Major, flows through Assyria, Syria, mesopotamia and the city of Babylon, and empties into the Gulf of Persia
s: Of foreign origin (compare \[[H6578](H6578)\]); *Euphrates*, a river of Asia: - Euphrates.

d: **1.** good cheer, joy, gladness
s: From the same as [G2165](G2165); *joyfulness:* - gladness, joy.

d:
**1.** to be grateful, feel thankful
**2.** give thanks
s: From [G2170](G2170); to *be* *grateful*, that is, (actually) to *express* *gratitude* (towards); specifically to *say* *grace* at a meal: - (give) thank (-ful, -s).

d:
**1.** thankfulness
**2.** the giving of thanks
s: From [G2170](G2170); *gratitude*; actually *grateful* *language* (to God, as an act of worship): - thankfulness, (giving of) thanks (-giving).

d:
**1.** mindful of favours, grateful, thankful
**2.** pleasing, agreeable
**3.** acceptable to others, winning, liberal, beneficent
s: From [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of [G5483](G5483); *well* *favored*, that is, (by implication) *grateful:* - thankful.

d:
**1.** a prayer to God
**2.** a vow
s: From [G2172](G2172); properly a *wish*, expressed as a *petition* to God, or in *votive* obligation: - prayer, vow.

d:
**1.** to pray to God
**2.** to wish, to pray, to pray for
s: Middle voice of a primary verb; to *wish*; by implication to *pray* to God: - pray, will, wish.
o: middle voice of a primary verb

d: **1.** easy to make use of, useful
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G5543](G5543); *easily* *used*, that is, *useful:* - profitable, meet for use.

d: **1.** to be of good courage, to be of a cheerful spirit
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and [G5590](G5590); to *be* *in* *good* *spirits*, that is, *feel* *encouraged:* - be of good comfort.

d:
**1.** a sweet smell, fragrance
**2.** a fragrant or sweet smelling thing, incense, on odour or something sweet smelling
  **a.** an odour of acquiescence, satisfaction
  **b.** a sweet odour, spoken of the smell of sacrifices and obligations, agreeably to the ancient notion that God smells and is pleased with the odour of sacrifices
**3.** metaph. a thing well pleasing to God
s: From a compound of [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of [G3605](G3605); *good* *scentedness*, that is, *fragrance:* - sweet savour (smell, -smelling).
o: from a compound of [G2095](G2095) and a derivative of [G3605](G3605)

d:
**1.** of good name and of good omen
  **a.** in the latter sense used in taking auguries; but those omens were euphemistically called euonumos which in fact were regarded as unlucky, i.e. which came from the left, sinister omens, (for which a good name was desired)
**2.** left, on the left hand
s: From [G2095](G2095) and [G3686](G3686); properly *well* *named* (*good* *omened*), that is, the *left* (which was the *lucky* side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as adverb *at* *the* *left* hand: - (on the) left.

d: **1.** to leap upon, spring upon
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G242](G242); to *spring* *upon:* - leap on.

d:
**1.** once, at once
  **a.** all at once
  **b.** once for all
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G530](G530); *upon* *one* *occasion* (only): - (at) once (for all).

d: **1.** a native or inhabitant of Ephesus
s: From [G2181](G2181); *Ephesine*, or situated at Ephesus: - of Ephesus.

d: **1.** a native or inhabitant of Ephesus
s: From [G2181](G2181); an *Ephesian* or inhabitant of Ephesus: - Ephesian, of Ephesus.

d:
Ephesus = permitted
**1.** a maritime city of Asia Minor, capital of Ionia and under the Romans, of proconsular Asia, situated on the Icarian Sea between Smyrna and Miletus
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Ephesus*, a city of Asia Minor: - Ephesus.

d: **1.** an inventor, contriver
s: From a compound of [G1909](G1909) and [G2147](G2147); a *discoverer*, that is, *contriver:* - inventor.

d:
**1.** a service limited to a stated series of days
**2.** the class or course itself of priests who for a week at a time performed the duties of the priestly office. David divided the priests into twenty four classes, each of which in its turn discharged the duties of the office for an entire week, from sabbath to sabbath
s: From [G2184](G2184); *diurnality*, that is, (specifically) the quotidian *rotation* or *class* of the Jewish priests’ service at the Temple, as distributed by families: - course.

d:
**1.** lasting for a day
**2.** daily
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2250](G2250); *for* *a* *day* (“ephemeral”), that is, *diurnal:* - daily.

d: **1.** to come to
s: From [G1909](G1909) and a cognate of [G2240](G2240); to arrive *upon*, that is, *extend* *to:* - reach.

d:
**1.** to place at, place upon, place over
  **a.** to stand by, be present
  **b.** to stand over one, place one’s self above
    **1.** used esp. of persons coming upon one suddenly
  **c.** an angel, of the advent of angels
  **d.** of dreams
    **1.** of evils coming upon one
  **e.** to be at hand
    **1.** be ready,
  **f.** of time
    **1.** to come upon
  **g.** of rain
s: From [G1909](G1909) and [G2476](G2476); to *stand* *upon*, that is, *be* *present* (in various applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literally): - assault, come (in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before, by, over).

d:
Ephraim = double fruitfulness
**1.** a city about a short day’s journey from Jerusalem
s: Of Hebrew origin (\[[H669](H669)\] or better \[[H6085](H6085)\]); *Ephraim*, a place in Palestine: - Ephraim.

d:
**1.** be thou opened
  **a.** receive the power of hearing, the ears of the deaf and the eyes of the blind being considered as closed
s: Of Chaldee origin \[[H6606](H6606)\]; *be* *opened!*: - Ephphatha.

d:
**1.** enmity
**2.** cause of enmity
s: Feminine of [G2190](G2190); *hostility*; by implication a reason for *opposition:* - enmity, hatred.

d:
**1.** hated, odious, hateful
**2.** hostile, hating, and opposing another
  **a.** used of men as at enmity with God by their sin
    **1.** opposing (God) in the mind
    **2.** a man that is hostile
    **3.** a certain enemy
    **4.** the hostile one
    **5.** the devil who is the most bitter enemy of the divine government
s: From a primary word ἔχθω echthō (to *hate*); *hateful* (passively *odious*, or actively *hostile*); usually as a noun, an *adversary* (especially *Satan*): - enemy, foe.
o: from a primary echtho (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or actively, hostile)

d:
**1.** a viper, offspring of vipers
  **a.** addressed to cunning, malignant, wicked men
s: Of uncertain origin; an *adder* or other poisonous snake (literally or figuratively): - viper.

d:
**1.** to have, i.e. to hold
  **a.** to have (hold) in the hand, in the sense of wearing, to have (hold) possession of the mind (refers to alarm, agitating emotions, etc.), to hold fast keep, to have or comprise or involve, to regard or consider or hold as
**2.** to have i.e. own, possess
  **a.** external things such as pertain to property or riches or furniture or utensils or goods or food etc.
  **b.** used of those joined to any one by the bonds of natural blood or marriage or friendship or duty or law etc, of attendance or companionship
**3.** to hold one’s self or find one’s self so and so, to be in such or such a condition
**4.** to hold one’s self to a thing, to lay hold of a thing, to adhere or cling to
  **a.** to be closely joined to a person or a thing
s: A primary verb (including an alternate form σχέω scheō *skheh’-o* used in certain tenses only); to *hold* (used in very various applications, literally or figuratively, direct or remote; such as *possession*, *ability*, *contiguity*, *relation* or *condition*): - be (able, X hold, possessed with), accompany, + begin to amend, can (+ -not), X conceive, count, diseased, do, + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, + lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, + recover, + reign, + rest, return, X sick, take for, + tremble, + uncircumcised, use.
o: including an alternate form scheo skheh’-o, used in certain tenses only), a primary verb

d: **1.** till, until
s: Of uncertain affinity; a conjugation, preposition and adverb of continuance, *until* (of time and place): - even (until, unto), (as) far (as), how long, (un-) til (-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while (-s).

d:
Zebulun meaning a habitation
**1.** the tenth of the sons of Jacob
**2.** the tribe of Zebulun
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2074](H2074)\]; *Zabulon* (that is, *Zebulon*), a region of Palestine: - Zabulon.

d:
Zacchaeus = pure
**1.** a chief tax collector
s: Of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H2140](H2140)\]); *Zacchaeus*, an Israelite: - Zacchus.

d:
Zara = a rising (as the sun)
**1.** the son of Judah, ancestor of christ
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2226](H2226)\]; *Zara* (that is, *Zerach*), an Israelite: - Zara.

d:
Zacharias meaning remembered of Jehovah
**1.** the father of John the Baptist
**2.** son of Barachias, who was slain by the Jews between the altar and the temple
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2148](H2148)\]; *Zacharias* (that is, *Zechariah*), the name of two Israelites: - Zacharias.

d:
**1.** to live, breathe, be among the living (not lifeless, not dead)
**2.** to enjoy real life
  **a.** to have true life and worthy of the name
  **b.** active, blessed, endless in the kingdom of God
**3.** to live i.e. pass life, in the manner of the living and acting
  **a.** of mortals or character
**4.** living water, having vital power in itself and exerting the same upon the soul
**5.** metaph. to be in full vigour
  **a.** to be fresh, strong, efficient,
  **b.** as adj. active, powerful, efficacious
s: A primary verb; to *live* (literally or figuratively): - life (-time), (a-) live (-ly), quick.

d:
Zebedee = my gift
**1.** a fisherman of Galilee, the father of the apostles James the great and John, and the husband of Salome
s: Of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H2067](H2067)\]); *Zebedaeus*, an Israelite: - Zebedee.

d:
**1.** boiling hot, hot
**2.** metaph. of fervour of mind an zeal
s: From [G2204](G2204); *boiled*, that is, (by implication) *calid* (figuratively *fervent*): - hot.

d:
**1.** two draught cattle (horses or mules or oxen) yoked together, a pair or yoke of beasts
**2.** a pair
s: From the same as [G2218](G2218); a *couple*, that is, a *team* (of oxen yoked together) or *brace* (of birds tied together): - yoke, pair.

d: **1.** a band, fastening
s: Feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as [G2218](G2218); a *fastening* (*tiller* *rope*): - band.
o: from a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as [G2218](G2218)

d:
Jupiter or Zeus = a father of helps
**1.** the national God of the Greeks and corresponds to the Roman Jupiter
s: Of uncertain affinity; in the oblique cases there is used instead of it a (probably cognate) name Δίς Dis *deece* which is otherwise obsolete; *Zeus* or *Dis* (among the Latins *Jupiter* or *Jove*), the supreme deity of the Greeks: - Jupiter.

d:
**1.** to boil with heat, be hot
  **a.** used of water
  **b.** metaph.
    **1.** used of boiling anger, love, zeal, for what is good or bad etc.
    **2.** fervent in spirit, said of zeal for what is good
s: A primary verb; to *be* *hot* (*boil*, of liquids; or *glow*, of solids), that is, (figuratively) *be* *fervid* (*earnest*): - be fervent.

d:
**1.** excitement of mind, ardour, fervour of spirit
  **a.** zeal, ardour in embracing, pursuing, defending anything
    **1.** zeal in behalf of, for a person or thing
    **2.** the fierceness of indignation, punitive zeal
  **b.** an envious and contentious rivalry, jealousy
s: From [G2204](G2204); properly *heat*, that is, (figuratively) “zeal” (in a favorable sense, *ardor*; in an unfavorable one, *jealousy*, as of a husband \[figuratively of God\], or an enemy, *malice*): - emulation, envy (-ing), fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.

d:
**1.** to burn with zeal
  **a.** to be heated or to boil with envy, hatred, anger
    **1.** in a good sense, to be zealous in the pursuit of good
  **b.** to desire earnestly, pursue
    **1.** to desire one earnestly, to strive after, busy one’s self about him
    **2.** to exert one’s self for one (that he may not be torn from me)
    **3.** to be the object of the zeal of others, to be zealously sought after
  **c.** to envy
s: From [G2205](G2205); to *have* *warmth* of feeling for or against: - affect, covet (earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be) zealous (-ly affect).

d:
**1.** one burning with zeal, a zealot
**2.** used of God as jealous of any rival and sternly vindicating his control
**3.** most eagerly desirous of, zealous for, a thing
  **a.** to acquire a thing, (zealous of)
  **b.** to defend and uphold a thing, vehemently contending for a thing
s: From [G2206](G2206); a “zealot”: - zealous.

d:
**1.** one burning with zeal, a zealot
**2.** used of God as jealous of any rival and sternly vindicating his control
**3.** most eagerly desirous of, zealous for, a thing
  **a.** to acquire a thing, (zealous of)
  **b.** to defend and uphold a thing, vehemently contending for a thing
s: The same as [G2207](G2207); a *Zealot*, that is, (specifically) *partisan* for Jewish political independence: - Zelotes.

d: **1.** damage, loss
s: Probably akin to the base of [G1150](G1150) (through the idea of *violence*); *detriment:* - damage, loss.
o: probably akin to the base of [G1150](G1150) (through the idea of violence)

d:
**1.** to affect with damage, do damage to
**2.** to sustain damage, to receive injury, suffer loss
s: From [G2209](G2209); to *injure*, that is, (reflexively or passively) to *experience* *detriment:* - be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.

d:
Zenas = Jupiter
**1.** a teacher of the Jewish law and afterwards a Christian
s: Probably contracted from a poetic form of [G2203](G2203) and [G1435](G1435); *Jove* *given*; *Zenas*, a Christian: - Zenas.
o: probably contracted from a poetic form of [G2203](G2203) and [G1435](G1435)

d:
**1.** to seek in order to find
  **a.** to seek a thing
  **b.** to seek \[in order to find out\] by thinking, meditating, reasoning, to enquire into
  **c.** to seek after, seek for, aim at, strive after
**2.** to seek i.e. require, demand
  **a.** to crave, demand something from someone
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *seek* (literally or figuratively); specifically (by Hebraism) to *worship* (God), or (in a bad sense) to *plot* (against life): - be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X will) seek (after, for, means). Compare [G4441](G4441).

d:
**1.** a question, debate
  **a.** about the law
s: From [G2212](G2212); a *search* (properly concrete), that is, (in words) a *debate:* - question.

d:
**1.** a seeking
**2.** enquiry
**3.** a questioning, debate
**4.** a subject of questioning or debate, matter of controversy
s: From [G2212](G2212); a *searching* (properly the act), that is, a *dispute* or its *theme:* - question.

d: **1.** a kind of darnel, resembling wheat except the grains are black
s: Of uncertain origin; *darnel* or false grain: - tares.

d:
Zerubbabel = born at babel, i.e. Babylon
**1.** the head of the tribe of Judah at the time of the return from Babylonish captivity in the first year of Cyrus
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2216](H2216)\]; *Zorobabel* (that is, *Zerubbabel*), an Israelite: - Zorobabel.

d:
**1.** darkness, blackness
  **a.** used of the darkness of the nether world
s: Akin to the base of [G3509](G3509); *gloom* (as shrouding like a *cloud*): - blackness, darkness, mist.

d:
**1.** a yoke
  **a.** a yoke that is put on draught cattle
  **b.** metaph., used of any burden or bondage
    **1.** as that of slavery
    **2.** of troublesome laws imposed on one, esp. of the Mosaic law, hence the name is so transferred to the commands of christ as to contrast them with the commands of the Pharisees which were a veritable ’yoke’; yet even christ’s commands must be submitted to, though easier to be kept
**2.** a balance, pair of scales
s: From the root of ζεύγνυμι zeugnumi (to *join*, especially by a “yoke”); a *coupling*, that is, (figuratively) *servitude* (a *law* or *obligation*); also (literally) the *beam* of the balance (as *connecting* the scales): - pair of balances, yoke.
o: from the root of zeugnumi (to join, especially by a yoke)

d:
**1.** leaven
**2.** metaph. of inveterate mental and moral corruption, viewed in its tendency to infect others
s: Probably from [G2204](G2204); *ferment* (as if *boiling* up): - leaven.

d:
**1.** to leaven
**2.** to mix leaven with dough so as to make it ferment
s: From [G2219](G2219); to *cause* *to* *ferment:* - leaven.

d:
**1.** to take alive
**2.** to take, catch, capture
s: From the same as [G2226](G2226) and [G64](G64); to *take* *alive* (*make* *a* *prisoner* *of* *war*), that is, (figuratively) to *capture* or *ensnare:* - take captive, catch.

d:
**1.** life
  **a.** the state of one who is possessed of vitality or is animate
  **b.** every living soul
**2.** life
  **a.** of the absolute fulness of life, both essential and ethical, which belongs to God, and through him both to the hypostatic logos and to christ in whom the logos put on human nature
  **b.** life real and genuine, a life active and vigorous, devoted to God, blessed, in the portion even in this world of those who put their trust in christ, but after the resurrection to be consummated by new accessions (among them a more perfect body), and to last for ever.
s: From [G2198](G2198); *life* (literally or figuratively): - life (-time). Compare [G5590](G5590).

d: **1.** a girdle, belt, serving not only to gird on flowing garments but also, since it was hollow, to carry money in
s: Probably akin to the base of [G2218](G2218); a *belt*; by implication a *pocket:* - girdle, purse.
o: probably akin to the base of [G2218](G2218)

d:
**1.** to gird
**2.** to gird one’s self
s: From [G2223](G2223); to *bind* *about* (especially with a belt): - gird.

d:
**1.** to bring forth alive
**2.** to give life
**3.** to preserve alive
s: From the same as [G2226](G2226) and a derivative of [G1096](G1096); to *engender* *alive* that is, (by analogy) to *rescue* (passively *be* *saved*) from death: - live, preserve.
o: from the same as [G2226](G2226) and a derivative of [G1096](G1096)

d:
**1.** a living being
**2.** an animal, brute, beast
s: Neuter of a derivative of [G2198](G2198); a *live* thing, that is, an *animal:* - beast.

d:
**1.** to produce alive, begat or bear living young
**2.** to cause to live, make alive, give life
  **a.** by spiritual power to arouse and invigorate
  **b.** to restore to life
  **c.** to give increase of life: thus of physical life
  **d.** of the spirit, quickening as respects the spirit, endued with new and greater powers of life
**3.** metaph., of seeds quickened into life, i.e. germinating, springing up, growing
s: From the same as [G2226](G2226) and [G4160](G4160); to (*re-*) *vitalize* (literally or figuratively): - make alive, give life, quicken.

d: **1.** either, or, than
s: A primary particle of distinction between two connected terms; disjunctive, *or*; comparative, *than*: - and, but (either), (n-) either, except it be, (n-) or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea. Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially [G2235](G2235), [G2260](G2260), [G2273](G2273).
o: a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms

d: **1.** assuredly, most certainly, full surely
s: An adverb of *confirmation*; perhaps intensive of [G2228](G2228); used only (in the N. T.) before [G3303](G3303); *assuredly:* - surely.
o: an adverb of confirmation, perhaps intensive of [G2228](G2228)

d:
**1.** to be leader, to lead the way
**2.** to rule, command
  **a.** of a province, to be governor of a province
  **b.** said of a proconsul, of a procurator
s: From [G2232](G2232); to *act* *as* *ruler:* - be governor.

d:
**1.** chief command, rule, sovereignty
  **a.** of the reign of a Roman emperor
s: From [G2232](G2232); *government*, that is, (in time) official *term:* - reign.

d:
**1.** a leader of any kind, a guide, ruler, prefect, president, chief, general, commander, sovereign
  **a.** a legatus Caesaris, an officer administering a province in the name and with the authority of the Roman emperor
    **1.** the governor of a province
  **b.** a procurator, an officer who was attached to a proconsul or a proprietor and had charge of the imperial revenues
    **1.** in causes relating to these revenues he administered justice. In the smaller provinces also, which were so to speak appendages of the greater, he discharged the functions of governor of the province; and such was the relation of the procurator of Judaea to the governor of Syria.
  **c.** first, leading, chief
  **d.** of a principal town as the capital of the region
s: From [G2233](G2233); a *leader*, that is, *chief* person (or figuratively place) of a province: - governor, prince, ruler.

d:
**1.** to lead
  **a.** to go before
  **b.** to be a leader
    **1.** to rule, command
    **2.** to have authority over
    **3.** a prince, of regal power, governor, viceroy, chief, leading as respects influence, controlling in counsel, overseers or leaders of the churches
    **4.** used of any kind of leader, chief, commander
    **5.** the leader in speech, chief, spokesman
**2.** to consider, deem, account, think
s: Middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of [G71](G71); to *lead*, that is, *command* (with official authority); figuratively to *deem*, that is, *consider:* - account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have the rule over, suppose, think.
o: middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of [G71](G71)

d: **1.** with pleasure, gladly
s: Adverb from a derivative of the base of [G2237](G2237); *sweetly*, that is, (figuratively) *with* *pleasure:* - gladly.
o: from a derivative of the base of [G2237](G2237)

d: **1.** now, already

d:
herod = heroic
**1.** the name of a royal family that flourished among the Jews in the times of christ and the Apostles. Herod the great was the son of Antipater of Idumaea. Appointed king of Judaea B.C. 40 by the Roman Senate at the suggestion of Antony and with the consent of Octavian, he at length overcame the great opposition which the country made to him and took possession of the kingdom B.C. 37; and after the battle of Actium, he was confirmed by Octavian, whose favour he ever enjoyed. He was brave and skilled in war, learned and sagacious; but also extremely suspicious and cruel. Hence he destroyed the entire royal family of Hasmonaeans, put to death many of the Jews that opposed his government, and proceeded to kill even his dearly beloved wife Mariamne of the Hasmonaean line and his two sons she had borne him. By these acts of bloodshed, and especially by his love and imitation of Roman customs and institutions and by the burdensome taxes imposed upon his subjects, he so alienated the Jews that he was unable to regain their favour by his splendid restoration of the temple and other acts of munificence. He died in the 70th year of his age, the 37th year of his reign, the 4th before the Dionysian era. In his closing years John the Baptist and christ were born; Matthew narrates that he commanded all the male children under two years old in Bethlehem to be slain.
**2.** Herod surnamed Antipas, was the son of herod the great and Malthace, a Samaritan woman. After the death of his father he was appointed by the Romans tetrarch of Galilee and Peraea. His first wife was the daughter of Aretas, king of Arabia; but he subsequently repudiated her and took to himself herodias, the wife of his brother herod Philip; and in consequence Aretas, his father-in-law, made war against him and conquered him. He cast John the Baptist into prison because John had rebuked him for this unlawful connection; and afterwards, at the instigation of herodias, he ordered him to be beheaded. Induced by her, too, he went to Rome to obtain from the emperor the title of king. But in consequence of the accusations brought against him by herod Agrippa I, Caligula banished him (A.D. )
**3.** to Lugdunum in Gaul, where he seems to have died. He was light minded, sensual and vicious.
**4.** Herod Agrippa I was the son of Aristobulus and Berenice, and grandson of herod the great. After various changes in fortune, he gained the favour of Caligula and Claudius to such a degree that he gradually obtained the government of all of Palestine, with the title of king. He died at Caesarea, A.D. 44, at the age of 54, in the seventh \[or the 4th, reckoning from the extension of his dominions by Claudius\] year of his reign, just after having ordered James the apostle, son of Zebedee, to be slain, and Peter to be cast into prison: Act 12:1-21
**5.** (Herod) Agrippa II, son of herod Agrippa I. When his father died he was a youth of seventeen. In A.D. 48 he received from Claudius Caesar the government of Chalcis, with the right of appointing the Jewish high priests, together with the care and oversight of the temple at Jerusalem. Four years later Claudius took from him Chalcis and gave him instead a larger domain, of Batanaea, Trachonitis, and Gaulanitis, with the title of king. To those reigns Nero, in A.D. 53, added Tiberias and Taricheae and Peraean Julias, with fourteen neighbouring villages. He is mentioned in Act_25 and 26. In the Jewish war, although he strove in vain to restrain the fury of the seditious and bellicose populace, he did not desert to the Roman side. After the fall of Jerusalem, he was vested with praetorian rank and kept the kingdom entire until his death, which took place in the third year of the emperor Trajan, \[the 73rd year of his life, and the 52nd of his reign\] He was the last representative of the herodian dynasty.
s: Compound of ἥρως hērōs (a “*hero”*) and [G1491](G1491); *heroic*; *Herodes*, the name of four Jewish kings: - Herod.
