**3.** spoken of the only and true God
  **a.** refers to the things of God
  **b.** his counsels, interests, things due to him
**4.** whatever can in any respect be likened unto God, or resemble him in any way
  **a.** God’s representative or viceregent
    **1.** of magistrates and judges
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *deity*, especially (with [G3588](G3588)) *the* supreme *Divinity*; figuratively a *magistrate*; by Hebraism *very:* - X exceeding, God, god \[-ly, -ward\].
o: of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with [G3588](G3588)) the supreme Divinity

d: **1.** reverence towards God’s goodness
s: From [G2318](G2318); *devoutness*, that is, *piety:* - godliness.

d: **1.** worshipping God, pious
s: From [G2316](G2316) and [G4576](G4576); *reverent* *of* *God*, that is, *pious:* - worshipper of God.

d: **1.** hateful to God, exceptionally impious and wicked
s: From [G2316](G2316) and the base of [G4767](G4767); *hateful* *to* *God*, that is, *impious:* - hater of God.

d:
**1.** deity
  **a.** the state of being God, Godhead
s: From [G2316](G2316); *divinity* (abstractly): - godhead.

d:
theophilus = friend of God
**1.** the person to whom Luke addressed his Gospel and the book of Acts
s: From [G2316](G2316) and [G5384](G5384); *friend* *of* *God*; *Theophilus*, a Christian: - Theophilus.

d:
**1.** service rendered by one to another
**2.** spec. medical service: curing, healing
**3.** household service
  **a.** body of attendants, servants, domestics
s: From [G2323](G2323); *attendance* (specifically medical, that is, *cure*); figuratively and collectively *domestics:* - healing, household.

d:
**1.** to serve, do service
**2.** to heal, cure, restore to health
s: From the same as [G2324](G2324); to *wait* *upon* menially, that is, (figuratively) to *adore* (God), or (specifically) to *relieve* (of disease): - cure, heal, worship.

d:
**1.** an attendant, servant: of God
  **a.** spoken of Moses discharging the duties committed to him by God
s: Apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivation of the base of [G2330](G2330); a menial *attendant* (as if *cherishing*): - servant.
o: apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the base of [G2330](G2330)

d:
**1.** to reap, harvest
**2.** proverbial expression for sowing and reaping
**3.** cut off, destroy
  **a.** as crops are cut down with a sickle
s: From [G2330](G2330) (in the sense of the *crop*); to *harvest:* - reap.
o: from [G2330](G2330) (in the sense of the crop)

d:
**1.** harvest, the act of reaping
  **a.** fig. of the gathering of men into the kingdom of God
  **b.** referring to time of reaping, the final judgment, when the righteous are gathered into the kingdom of God and the wicked are cast into hell for ever
s: From [G2325](G2325); *reaping*, that is, the *crop:* - harvest.

d: **1.** a reaper
s: From [G2325](G2325); a *harvester:* - reaper.

d:
**1.** to make warm, to heat
**2.** to warm one’s self
s: From [G2329](G2329); to *heat* (oneself): - (be) warm (-ed, self).

d: **1.** heat
s: From the base of [G2330](G2330); *warmth:* - heat.

d: **1.** summer
s: From a primary word θέρω therō (to *heat*); properly *heat*, that is, *summer:* - summer.

d: **1.** a thessalonians
s: From [G2332](G2332); a *Thessalonican*, that is, inhabitant of Thessalonice: - Thessalonian.

d:
thessalonica = victory of falsity
**1.** a famous and populous city, situated on the thermaic Gulf, the capital of the second division of Macedonia and the residence of a Roman governor and quaestor
s: From Θεσσαλός Thessalos (a *Thessalian*) and [G3529](G3529); *Thessalonice*, a place in Asia Minor: - Thessalonica.

d:
theudas = God-given
**1.** the name of an insurgent mentioned in Gamaliel’s speech before the Jewish council, Act 5:35-39, at the time of the arraignment of the apostles. He appeared, according to Luke’s account, at the head of about four hundred men. He was probably one of the insurrectionary chiefs or fanatics by whom the land was overrun in the last year of herod’s reign. Josephus speaks of a theudas who played a similar part at the time of Claudius, about A.D. 44; but the theudas mentioned by Luke must be a different person from the one spoken of by Josephus.
s: Of uncertain origin; *Theudas*, as Israelite: - Theudas.

d:
**1.** to be a spectator, look at, behold
  **a.** to view attentively, take a view of, survey
    **1.** to view mentally, consider
**2.** to see
  **a.** to perceive with the eyes, to enjoy the presence of one
  **b.** to discern, descry
  **c.** to ascertain, find out by seeing
s: From a derivative of [G2300](G2300) (perhaps by adverb of [G3708](G3708)); to *be* *a* *spectator* of, that is, *discern*, (literally, figuratively \[*experience*\] or intensively \[*acknowledge*\]): - behold, consider, look on, perceive, see. Compare [G3700](G3700).
o: from a derivative of [G2300](G2300) (perhaps by add. of [G3708](G3708))

d:
**1.** a viewing, beholding
**2.** that which is viewed, a spectacle, sight
s: From the same as [G2334](G2334); *spectatorship*, that is, (concretely) a *spectacle:* - sight.

d:
**1.** that which a thing is put or laid away, a receptacle, repository, chest, box
  **a.** used of the sheath of a sword
s: From [G5087](G5087); a *receptacle*, that is, *scabbard:* - sheath.

d:
**1.** to give the breast, give suck, to suckle
**2.** to suck
s: From θηλή thēlē (the *nipple*); to *suckle*; by implication to *suck:* - (give) suck (-ling).

d:
**1.** of the female sex
**2.** a woman, a female
s: From the same as [G2337](G2337); *female:* - female, woman.

d:
**1.** a hunting of wild beasts to destroy them
**2.** metaph. of preparing destruction for men
s: From θήρ thēr (a wild *animal*, as *game*); *hunting*, that is, (figuratively) *destruction:* - trap.
o: from ther (a wild animal, as game)

d:
**1.** to go a hunting, to hunt, to catch in hunting
**2.** metaph. to lay wait for, strive to ensnare, catch artfully
s: From [G2339](G2339); to *hunt* (an animal), that is, (figuratively) to *carp* *at:* - catch.

d: **1.** to fight with wild beasts
s: From a compound of [G2342](G2342) and [G3164](G3164); to *be* *a* *beast* *fighter* (in the gladiatorial show), that is, (figuratively) to *encounter* (furious men): - fight with wild beasts.

d:
**1.** an animal
**2.** a wild animal, wild beast, beast
**3.** metaph. a brutal, bestial man, savage, ferocious
s: Diminutive from the same as [G2339](G2339); a *dangerous* *animal:* - (venomous, wild) beast.

d:
**1.** to gather and lay up, to heap up, store up
  **a.** to accumulate riches
  **b.** to keep in store, store up, reserve
**2.** metaph. so to live from day to day as to increase either the bitterness or the happiness of one’s consequent lot
s: From [G2344](G2344); to *amass* or *reserve* (literally or figuratively): - lay up (treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).

d:
**1.** the place in which good and precious things are collected and laid up
  **a.** a casket, coffer, or other receptacle, in which valuables are kept
  **b.** a treasury
  **c.** storehouse, repository, magazine
**2.** the things laid up in a treasury, collected treasures
s: From [G5087](G5087); a *deposit*, that is, *wealth* (literally or figuratively): - treasure.

d:
**1.** to touch, handle
  **a.** to do violence to, injury
s: A prolonged form of an obsolete primary word θίγω thigō (to *finger*); to *manipulate*, that is, *have* *to* *do* *with*; by implication to *injure:* - handle, touch.
o: a prolonged form of an obsolete primary thigo (to finger)

d:
**1.** to press (as grapes), press hard upon
**2.** a compressed way
  **a.** narrow straitened, contracted
**3.** metaph. to trouble, afflict, distress
s: Akin to the base of [G5147](G5147); to *crowd* (literally or figuratively): - afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.

d:
**1.** a pressing, pressing together, pressure
**2.** metaph. oppression, affliction, tribulation, distress, straits
s: From [G2346](G2346); *pressure* (literally or figuratively): - afflicted, (-tion), anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.

d:
**1.** to die, to be dead
**2.** metaph. to be spiritually dead
s: A strengthened form of a simpler primary word θάνω thanō (which is used for it only in certain tenses); to *die* (literally or figuratively): - be dead, die.
o: a strengthened form of a simpler primary thano than’-o (which is used for it only in certain tenses)

d: **1.** liable to death, mortal
s: From [G2348](G2348); *liable* *to* *die:* - mortal (-ity).

d:
**1.** to make a noise or uproar, be turbulent
**2.** to disturb, throw into confusion
  **a.** to be troubled in mind
  **b.** to wail tumultuously
s: From [G2351](G2351); to *be* *in* *tumult*, that is, *disturb*, *clamor:* - make ado (a noise), trouble self, set on an uproar.

d:
**1.** a noise, tumult, uproar
  **a.** of persons wailing
  **b.** of a clamorous and excited multitude
  **c.** of riotous persons
**2.** a tumult, as a breach of public order
s: From the base of [G2360](G2360); a *disturbance:* - tumult, uproar.

d: **1.** to break, break in pieces, shatter, smite through
s: A primary verb; to *crush*: - bruise. Compare [G4486](G4486).

d:
**1.** whatever is fed or nursed
  **a.** a ward, nursling, child
**2.** a flock, cattle, esp. sheep and goats
s: From [G5142](G5142); *stock* (as *raised* on a farm): - cattle.

d:
**1.** to mourn, to lament
  **a.** of singers of dirges, \[to wail\]
**2.** to bewail, deplore
s: From [G2355](G2355); to *bewail:* - lament, mourn.

d: **1.** a lamentation
s: From the base of [G2360](G2360); *wailing:* - lamentation.

d:
**1.** religious worship
  **a.** esp. external, that which consists of ceremonies
    **1.** religious discipline, religion
s: From a derivative of [G2357](G2357); ceremonial *observance:* - religion, worshipping.

d:
**1.** fearing or worshipping God
**2.** to tremble
  **a.** trembling, fearful
s: Probably from the base of [G2360](G2360); *ceremonious* in worship (as *demonstrative*), that is, *pious:* - religious.

d:
**1.** to triumph, to celebrate a triumph
**2.** cause one to triumph
s: From a prolonged compound of the base of [G2360](G2360) and a derivative of [G680](G680) (meaning a *noisy* *iambus*, sung in honor of Bacchus); to *make* *an* *acclamatory* *procession*, that is, (figuratively) to *conquer* or (by Hebraism) to *give* *victory:* - (cause) to triumph (over).
o: from a prolonged compound of the base of [G2360](G2360)

d:
**1.** the hair of the head
**2.** the hair of animals
s: Of uncertain derivation; *hair*: - hair. Compare [G2864](G2864).
o: genitive case trichos, etc., of uncertain derivation

d:
**1.** to cry aloud, make a noise by outcry
  **a.** in the NT, to trouble, frighten
  **b.** to be troubled in mind, to be frightened, alarmed
s: From θρέομαι threomai (to *wail*); to *clamor*, that is, (by implication) to *frighten:* - trouble.

d: **1.** a large thick drop, esp. of clotted blood
s: Perhaps from [G5142](G5142) (in the sense of *thickening*); a *clot:* - great drop.
o: perhaps from [G5142](G5142) (in the sense of thickening)

d:
**1.** a throne seat
  **a.** a chair of state having a footstool
  **b.** assigned in the NT to kings, hence, kingly power or royalty
    **1.** metaph. to God, the governor of the world
    **2.** to the messiah, christ, the partner and assistant in the divine administration
  **c.** hence divine power belonging to christ
    **1.** to judges i.e. tribunal or bench
    **2.** to elders
s: From θράω thraō (to *sit*); a stately *seat* (“throne”); by implication *power* or (concretely) a *potentate:* - seat, throne.
o: from thrao (to sit), a stately seat (throne)

d:
thyatira = odour of affliction
**1.** a colony of Macedonia Greeks, situated between Sardis and Pergamos on the river Lycus; its inhabitants gained their living by traffic and the art of dyeing in purple
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Thyatira*, a place in Asia Minor: - Thyatira.

d:
**1.** a daughter
  **a.** a daughter of God
    **1.** acceptable to God, rejoicing in God’s peculiar care and protection
  **b.** with the name of a place, city, or region
    **1.** denotes collectively all its inhabitants and citizens
  **c.** a female descendant
s: Apparently a primary word (compare “daughter”); a *female* *child*, or (by Hebraism) *descendant* (or *inhabitant*): - daughter.

d: **1.** a little daughter
s: From [G2364](G2364); a *daughterling:* - little (young) daughter.

d: **1.** a sudden storm, tempest, whirlwind
s: From [G2380](G2380) (in the sense of *blowing*) a storm: - tempest.

d: **1.** the citrus, an odoriferous North African tree used as incense, prized by the ancient Greeks and Romans on account of the beauty of its wood for various ornamental purposes
s: From a derivative of [G2380](G2380) (in the sense of *blowing*; denoting a certain *fragrant* tree); made of *citron* wood: - thyine.
o: from a derivative of [G2380](G2380) (in the sense of blowing, denoting a certain fragrant tree)

d: **1.** an aromatic substance burnt, incense
s: From [G2370](G2370); an *aroma*, that is, fragrant *powder* burnt in religious service; by implication the *burning* itself: - incense, odour.

d:
**1.** a utensil for fumigating or burning incense
**2.** an altar of incense
s: From a derivative of [G2370](G2370); a *place* *of* *fumigation*, that is, the *altar* *of* *incense* (in the Temple): - censer.

d: **1.** to burn incense
s: From a derivative of [G2380](G2380) (in the sense of *smoking*); to *fumigate*, that is, *offer* aromatic *fumes:* - burn incense.
o: from a derivative of [G2380](G2380) (in the sense of smoking)

d:
**1.** to carry on war with great animosity
**2.** to be very angry, be exasperated
s: From a presumed compound of [G2372](G2372) and [G3164](G3164); to *be* *in* *a* *furious* *fight*, that is, (figuratively) to *be* *exasperated:* - be highly displeased.
o: from a presumed compound of [G2372](G2372) and [G3164](G3164)

d:
**1.** passion, angry, heat, anger forthwith boiling up and soon subsiding again
**2.** glow, ardour, the wine of passion, inflaming wine (which either drives the drinker mad or kills him with its strength)
s: From [G2380](G2380); *passion* (as if *breathing* hard): - fierceness, indignation, wrath. Compare [G5590](G5590).

d:
**1.** to cause one to become incensed, to provoke to anger
**2.** to be wroth
s: From [G2372](G2372); to *put* *in* *a* *passion*, that is, *enrage:* - be wroth.

d:
**1.** a door
  **a.** the vestibule
  **b.** used of any opening like a door, an entrance, way or passage into
  **c.** in a parable or metaphor
    **1.** the door through which sheep go in and out, the name of him who brings salvation to those who follow his guidance
    **2.** an open door is used of the opportunity of doing something
    **3.** the door of the kingdom of heaven (likened to a palace) denotes the conditions which must be complied with in order to be received into the kingdom of God
s: Apparently a primary word (compare “door”); a *portal* or entrance (the opening or the closure, literally or figuratively): - door, gate.

d: **1.** a shield, a large oblong, four cornered shield
s: From [G2374](G2374); a large *shield* (as *door* shaped): - shield.

d: **1.** a window
s: From [G2374](G2374); an *aperture*, that is, *window:* - window.

d:
**1.** a doorkeeper, porter
  **a.** a male or female janitor
s: From [G2374](G2374) and οὖρος ouros (a *watcher*); a *gate* *warden:* - that kept the door, porter.

d: **1.** a sacrifice, victim
s: From [G2380](G2380); *sacrifice* (the act or the victim, literally or figuratively): - sacrifice.

d:
**1.** the altar for slaying and burning of victims used of
  **a.** the altar of whole burnt offerings which stood in the court of the priests in the temple at Jerusalem
  **b.** the altar of incense which stood in the sanctuary or the holy Place
  **c.** any other altar
    **1.** metaph., the cross on which christ suffered an expiatory death: to eat of this altar i.e. to appropriate to one’s self the fruits of christ’s expiatory death
s: From a derivative of [G2378](G2378); a *place* *of* *sacrifice*, that is, an *altar* (specifically or generally, literally or figuratively): - altar.

d:
**1.** to sacrifice, immolate
**2.** to slay, kill
  **a.** of the paschal lamb
**3.** slaughter
s: A primary verb; properly to *rush* (*breathe* hard, *blow*, *smoke*), that is, (by implication) to *sacrifice* (properly by fire, but generally); by extension to *immolate* (*slaughter* for any purpose): - kill, (do) sacrifice, slay.

d:
Thomas = a twin
**1.** one of the apostles
s: Of Chaldee origin (compare \[[H8380](H8380)\]); *the* *twin*; *Thomas*, a Christian: - Thomas.

d:
**1.** the breast, the part of the body from the neck to the navel, where the ribs end
**2.** a breastplate or corset consisting of two parts and protecting the body on both sides from the neck to the middle
s: Of uncertain affinity; the *chest* (“thorax”), that is, (by implication) a *corslet:* - breastplate.

d:
Jairus = whom God enlightens
**1.** a ruler of a synagogue, probably near the western shore of the Sea of Galilee
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H2971](H2971)\]; *Jairus* (that is, *Jair*), an Israelite: - Jairus.

d:
Jacob = heel-catcher or supplanter
**1.** was the second son of Isaac
**2.** the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3290](H3290)\]; *Jacob* (that is, *Ja’akob*), the pogenitor of the Israelites; also an Israelite: - Jacob.

d:
James = supplanter
**1.** son of Zebedee, an apostle and brother of the apostle John, commonly called James the greater or elder, slain by herod, Acts
**2.** an apostle, son of alphaeus, called the less
**3.** James the half-brother of christ
**4.** an unknown James, father of the apostle Judas (?)
s: The same as [G2384](G2384) Graecized; *Jacobus*, the name of three Israelites: - James.

d:
**1.** a means of healing, remedy, medicine
**2.** a healing
s: From [G2390](G2390); a *cure* (the effect): - healing.

d: Jambres = foamy healer
s: Of Egyptian origin; *Jambres*, an Egyptian: - Jambres.

d:
Janna = flourishing
**1.** son of Joseph and the father of melchi, in the genealogy of christ
s: Probably of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H3238](H3238)\]); *Janna*, an Israelite: - Janna.

d:
Janna = he vexed
**1.** he and Jambres, were two Egyptian magicians who in the presence of Pharaoh imitated the miracles of Aaron in order to destroy his influence with the king. The author of the epistle derived their names from the tradition of the Talmudists and the Rabbins
s: Of Egyptian origin; *Jannes*, an Egyptian: - Jannes.

d:
**1.** to cure, heal
**2.** to make whole
  **a.** to free from errors and sins, to bring about (one’s) salvation
s: Middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to *cure* (literally or figuratively): - heal, make whole.
o: middle voice of apparently a primary verb

d:
Jared = descent
**1.** one of the antediluvian patriarchs, the father of Enoch
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3382](H3382)\]; *Jared* (that is, *Jered*), an antediluvian: - Jared.

d: **1.** a healing, cure
s: From [G2390](G2390); *curing* (the act): - cure, heal (-ing).

d: **1.** jasper, a precious stone of various colours (for some are purple, others blue, others green, and others the colour of brass) There is one kind called the Aeizusa, like to air and anotherCrystallizusa, clear as crystal. So Pliny speaks of a white Jaspercalled Astrios, and which, he says is crystallo propinquans, nearto crystal, found in India, and on the shores of Pallene. (Gill)
s: Probably of foreign origin (see \[[H3471](H3471)\]); “jasper”, a gem: - jasper.

d:
Jason = one who will heal
**1.** a thessalonians who entertained Paul and Silas, and maybe a cousin of Paul (Rom 16:21)
s: Future active participle masculine of [G2390](G2390); *about* *to* *cure*; *Jason*, a Christian: - Jason.

d: **1.** a physician
s: From [G2390](G2390); a *physician:* - physician.

d: **1.** behold, see
s: Second person singular imperative active of [G1492](G1492); used as interjection to denote *surprise*; *lo!*: - behold, lo, see.
o: second person singular imperative active of [G1492](G1492)

d:
**1.** form, external appearance
**2.** aspect, look
s: From [G1492](G1492); a *sight* (compare figuratively “idea”), that is, *aspect:* - countenance.

d: **1.** pertaining to one’s self, one’s own, belonging to one’s self
s: Of uncertain affinity; *pertaining* *to* *self*, that is, *one’s* *own*; by implication *private* or *separate:* - X his acquaintance, when they were alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our, thine, your) own (business), private (-ly), proper, severally, their (own).

d:
**1.** a private person as opposed to a magistrate, ruler, king
**2.** a common soldier, as opposed to a military officer
**3.** a writer of prose as opposed to a poet
**4.** in the NT, an unlearned, illiterate, man as opposed to the learned and educated: one who is unskilled in any art
s: From [G2398](G2398); a *private* person, that is, (by implication) an *ignoramus* (compare “idiot”): - ignorant, rude, unlearned.

d: **1.** behold, see, lo
s: Second person singular imperative middle voice of [G1492](G1492); used as imperative *lo!*: - behold, lo, see.
o: second person singular imperative middle voice of [G1492](G1492)

d: **1.** Idumaea, the name of a region between southern Palestine and the Arabian Petraea inhabited by Edom or Esau and his posterity
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H123](H123)\]; *Idumaea* (that is, *Edom*), a region East (and South) of Palestine: - Iduma.

d: **1.** sweat
s: A strengthened form of a primary word ἴδος idos (*sweat*); *perspiration:* - sweat.
o: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat)

d:
Jezebel = chaste
**1.** wife of Ahab, an impious and cruel queen who protected idolatry and persecuted the prophets
**2.** the symbolic name of a woman who pretended to be a prophetess, and who, addicted to antinomianism, claimed Christian liberty of eating things sacrificed to idols
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H348](H348)\]; *Jezabel* (that is, *Jezebel*), a Tyrian woman (used as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher): - Jezabel.

d:
Hierapolis = holy city
**1.** a city of Phrygia, situated above the junction of the rivers Lycus and Maeander, near Colosse and Laodicea
s: From [G2413](G2413) and [G4172](G4172); *holy* *city*; *Hierapolis*, a place in Asia Minor: - Hierapolis.

d: **1.** the priesthood, the office of a priest
s: From [G2407](G2407); *priestliness*, that is, the *sacerdotal* *function:* - office of the priesthood, priest’s office.

d:
**1.** the office of a priest
**2.** the order or body of priests
s: From [G2407](G2407); the *priestly* *fraternity*, that is, a *sacerdotal* *order* (figuratively): - priesthood.

d: **1.** to be a priest, discharge the office of a priest, to be busied in sacred duties
s: Prolongation from [G2409](G2409); to *be* *a* *priest*, that is, *perform* *his* *functions:* - execute the priest’s office.

d:
Jeremiah = whom Jehovah has appointed
**1.** the son of Hilkiah of the priests that were in Anathoth. He was called very young (B.C.
**2.** to the prophetic office, and prophesied 42 years. He probably died in Egypt.
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3414](H3414)\]; *Hieremias* (that is, *Jermijah*), an Israelite: - Jeremiah.

d:
**1.** a priest, one who offers sacrifices and in general in busied with sacred rites
  **a.** referring to priests of Gentiles or the Jews,
**2.** metaph. of Christians, because, purified by the blood of christ and brought into close intercourse with God, they devote their life to him alone and to christ
s: From [G2413](G2413); a *priest* (literally or figuratively): - (high) priest.

d:
Jericho = place of fragrance
**1.** a noted city, abounding in balsam, honey, cyprus, myrobalanus, roses and other fragrant products. It was near the north shore of the Dead Sea in the tribe of Benjamin, between Jerusalem and the Jordan River
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3405](H3405)\]; *Jericho*, a place in Palestine: - Jericho.

d:
**1.** a sacred place, temple
  **a.** used of the temple of Artemis at Ephesus
  **b.** used of the temple at Jerusalem
s: Neuter of [G2413](G2413); a *sacred* place, that is, the entire precincts (whereas [G3485](G3485) denotes the central *sanctuary* itself) of the *Temple* (at Jerusalem or elsewhere): - temple.

d:
**1.** befitting men, places, actions or sacred things to God
**2.** reverent
s: From [G2413](G2413) and the same as [G4241](G4241); *reverent:* - as becometh holiness.

d:
**1.** sacred, consecrated to the deity, pertaining to God
  **a.** sacred Scriptures, because inspired by God, treating of divine things and therefore to be devoutly revered
s: Of uncertain affinity; *sacred:* - holy.

d:
Jerusalem = set ye double peace
**1.** denotes either the city itself or the inhabitants
**2.** the Jerusalem that now is, with its present religious institutions, i.e. the Mosaic system, so designated from its primary external location
**3.** Jerusalem that is above, that is existing in heaven, according to the pattern of which the earthly Jerusalem was supposed to be built
  **a.** metaph. the City of God founded by christ, now wearing the form of the church, but after christ’s return to put on the form of the perfected messianic kingdom
**4.** the heavenly Jerusalem, that is the heavenly abode of God, christ, the angels, saints of the Old and New Testament periods and those Christians that are alive at christ’s return
**5.** the New Jerusalem, a splendid visible city to be let down from heaven after the renovation of the world, the future abode of the blessed
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3389](H3389)\]; *Hierosolyma* (that is, *Jerushalaim*), the capital of Palestine: - Jerusalem. Compare [G2419](G2419).

d: **1.** a citizen or inhabitant of Jerusalem
s: From [G2414](G2414); a *Hierosolymite*, that is, inhabitant of Hierosolyma: - of Jerusalem.

d:
**1.** to commit sacrilege, to rob a temple
  **a.** in Rom 2:22, where the meaning is, thou who abhorrest idols and their contamination, doest yet not hesitate to plunder their shrines
s: From [G2417](G2417); to *be* *a* *temple* *robber* (figuratively): - commit sacrilege.

d: **1.** guilty of sacrilege
s: From [G2411](G2411) and [G4813](G4813); a *temple* *despoiler:* - robber of churches.

d:
**1.** to minister in the manner of a priest, minister in priestly service
  **a.** of those who defend the sanctity of the law by undergoing a violent death
  **b.** of the preaching of the gospel
s: From a compound of [G2411](G2411) and the base of [G2041](G2041); to *be* *a* *temple* *worker*, that is, *officiate* *as* *a* *priest* (figuratively): - minister.
o: from a compound of [G2411](G2411) and the base of [G2041](G2041)

d:
Jerusalem = set ye double peace
**1.** denotes either the city itself or the inhabitants
**2.** the Jerusalem that now is, with its present religious institutions, i.e. the Mosaic system, so designated from its primary external location
**3.** Jerusalem that is above, that is existing in heaven, according to the pattern of which the earthly Jerusalem was supposed to be built
  **a.** metaph. the City of God founded by christ, now wearing the form of the church, but after christ’s return to put on the form of the perfected messianic kingdom
**4.** the heavenly Jerusalem, that is the heavenly abode of God, christ, the angels, saints of the Old and New Testament periods and those Christians that are alive at christ’s return
**5.** the New Jerusalem, a splendid visible city to be let down from heaven after the renovation of the world, the future abode of the blessed
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3389](H3389)\]; *Hierusalem* (that is, *Jerushalem*), the capital of Palestine: - Jerusalem. Compare [G2414](G2414).

d: **1.** priesthood, the priestly office
s: From [G2413](G2413); *sacredness*, that is, (by implication) the *priestly* *office:* - priesthood.

d:
Jesse = wealthy
**1.** the father of David the king
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3448](H3448)\]; *Jessae* (that is, *Jishai*), an Israelite: - Jesse.

d:
Jephthah = whom God sets free
**1.** son of Gilead, and a judge in Israel
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3316](H3316)\]; *Jephthae* (that is, *Jiphtach*), an Israelite: - Jephthah.

d:
Jeconiah or Jehoiachin = whom Jehovah establishes
**1.** was the son of Jehoiakim, and for three months and ten days king of Judah until Nebuchadnezzar carried him into captivity (597 BC)
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3204](H3204)\]; *Jechonias* (. e. *Jekonjah*), an Israelite: - Jechonias.

d:
Jesus = Jehovah is salvation
**1.** Jesus, the son of God, the saviour of mankind, God incarnate
**2.** Jesus Barabbas was the captive robber whom the Jews begged Pilate to release instead of christ
**3.** Joshua was the famous captain of the Israelites, Moses’ successor (Act 7:45, Heb 4:8)
**4.** Jesus, son of Eliezer, one of the ancestors of christ (Luk 3:29)
**5.** Jesus, surnamed Justus, a Jewish Christian, an associate with Paul in the preaching of the gospel (Col 4:11)
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3091](H3091)\]; *Jesus* (that is, *Jehoshua*), the name of our Lord and two (three) other Israelites: - Jesus.

d:
**1.** sufficient
  **a.** many enough, enough
  **b.** sufficient in ability, i.e. meet, fit
s: From ἵκω hikō (ἱκάνω or ἱκνέομαι; akin to [G2240](G2240); to *arrive*); *competent* (as if *coming* in season), that is, *ample* (in amount) or *fit* (in character): - able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long (while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.
o: from hiko \[hikano or hikneomai, akin to [G2240](G2240)\] (to arrive)

d: **1.** sufficient, ability or competency to do a thing
s: From [G2425](G2425); *ability:* - sufficiency.

d:
**1.** to make sufficient, render fit
  **a.** to equip one with adequate power to perform duties of one
s: From [G2425](G2425); to *enable*, that is, *qualify:* - make able (meet).

d:
**1.** an olive branch
  **a.** for suppliants approached the one whose aid they would implore holding an olive branch entwined with white wool and fillets, to signify that they came as suppliants
**2.** supplication
s: From a derivative of the base of [G2425](G2425) (through the idea of *approaching* for a favor); *intreaty:* - supplication.
o: from a derivative of the base of [G2425](G2425) (through the idea of approaching for a favour)

d: **1.** moisture
s: Of uncertain affinity; *dampness:* - moisture.

d:
Iconium = little image
**1.** a famous city of Asia Minor, which was the capital of Lycaonia
s: Perhaps from [G1504](G1504); *image* *like*; *Iconium*, a place in Asia Minor: - Iconium.

d: **1.** cheerful, joyous, prompt to do anything
s: From the same as [G2436](G2436); *propitious* or *merry* (“hilarious”), that is, *prompt* or *willing:* - cheerful.

d: **1.** cheerfulness, readiness of mind
s: From [G2431](G2431); *alacrity:* - cheerfulness.

d:
**1.** to render one’s self, to appease, conciliate to one’s self
  **a.** to become propitious, be placated or appeased
  **b.** to be propitious, be gracious, be merciful
**2.** to expiate, make propitiation for
s: Middle voice from the same as [G2436](G2436); to *conciliate*, that is, (transitively) to *atone* for (sin), or (intransitively) *be* *propitious:* - be merciful, make reconciliation for.
o: middle voice from the same as [G2436](G2436)

d:
**1.** an appeasing, propitiating
**2.** the means of appeasing, a propitiation
s: *atonement*, that is, (concretely) an *expiator:* - propitiation.

d:
**1.** relating to an appeasing or expiating, having placating or expiating force, expiatory; a means of appeasing or expiating, a propitiation
  **a.** used of the cover of the ark of the covenant in the holy of Holies, which was sprinkled with the blood of the expiatory victim on the annual day of atonement (this rite signifying that the life of the people, the loss of which they had merited by their sins, was offered to God in the blood as the life of the victim, and that God by this ceremony was appeased and their sins expiated); hence the lid of expiation, the propitiatory
  **b.** an expiatory sacrifice
  **c.** a expiatory victim
s: Neuter of a derivative of [G2433](G2433); an *expiatory* (place or thing), that is, (concretely) an atoning *victim*, or (specifically) the *lid* of the Ark (in the Temple): - mercyseat, propitiation.

d: **1.** propitious, merciful
s: Perhaps from the alternate form of [G138](G138); *cheerful* (as *attractive*), that is, *propitious*; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be *gracious!*, that is, (in averting some calamity) *far* be it: - be it far, merciful.
o: perhaps from the alternate form of [G138](G138)

d:
Illyricum = the lyric band
**1.** a region lying between Italy, Germany, Macedonia and Thrice, having on one side the Adriatic Sea, and on the other the Danube
s: Neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation; (the) *Illyrican* (shore), that is, (as a name itself) *Illyricum*, a region of Europe: - Illyricum.
o: from an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation

d:
**1.** a thong of leather, a strap
  **a.** in the NT of the thongs with which captives or criminals were either bound or beaten
  **b.** of the thongs or ties by which sandals were fastened to the feet
s: Perhaps from the same as [G260](G260); a *strap*, that is, (specifically) the *tie* (of a sandal) or the *lash* (of a scourge): - latchet, thong.

d: **1.** to clothe
s: From [G2440](G2440); to *dress:* - clothe.

d:
**1.** a garment (of any sort)
  **a.** garments, i.e. the cloak or mantle and the tunic
**2.** the upper garment, the cloak or mantle
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of ἕννυμι hennumi (to *put* *on*); a *dress* (inner or outer): - apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.
o: from a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on)

d: **1.** clothing, apparel
s: From [G2439](G2439); *clothing:* - apparel (X -led), array, raiment, vesture.

d: **1.** to desire, long for, esp. the longing of love
s: Middle voice from ἵμερος himeros (a *yearning*; of uncertain affinity); to *long* for: - be affectionately desirous.
o: middle voice from himeros (a yearning, of uncertain affinity)

d: **1.** that, in order that, so that Wigram’s frequency count is 569 not 621. The original J.B. Smithcount is 665 but this includes many places where the word isassigned a different Strong’s number because it is used in a phrase.
s: Probably from the same as the former part of [G1438](G1438) (through the *demonstrative* idea; compare [G3588](G3588)); in order *that* (denoting the *purpose* or the *result*): - albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as, (so) that, (for) to. Compare [G3363](G3363).
o: probably from the same as the former part of [G1438](G1438) (through the demonstrative idea, cf [G3588](G3588))

d: **1.** for what purpose, wherefore, why
s: From [G2443](G2443) and [G5101](G5101); *for* *what* reason?, that is, *why?*: - wherefore, why.

d:
Joppa or Japho = beautiful
**1.** a city of Palestine on the mediterranean, lying on the border of the tribes of Dan and Ephraim. It was subject to the Jews from the times of the Maccabees. It had a famous but dangerous port and carried on a flourishing trade. It is now called Jaffa.
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3305](H3305)\]; *Joppe* (that is, *Japho*), a place in Palestine: - Joppa.

d:
Jordan = the descender
**1.** the one river of Palestine, has its course of little more than 200 miles (300 km), from the roots of Anti-Lebanon to the head of the Dead Sea.
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3383](H3383)\]; the *Jordanes* (that is, *Jarden*), a river of Palestine: - Jordan.

d:
**1.** poison (of animals)
  **a.** poison of asps is under their lips,
  **b.** spoken of men given to reviling and calumniating and thereby injuring others
**2.** rust
s: Perhaps from εἶμι eimi (to *go*) or ἵημι hiēmi (to *send*); *rust* (as if *emitted* by metals); also *venom* (as *emitted* by serpents): - poison, rust.
o: perhaps from eimi (to go) or hiemi (to send)

d:
Judah = he shall be praised
**1.** the fourth son of the patriarch Jacob
**2.** the tribe that were the offspring of Judah
**3.** the region occupied by the tribe
**4.** a city of the tribe of Judah, conjectured to be hebron, which was a city assigned to the priests and located in the hill country, and the native place of John the Baptist according to Jewish tradition
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3063](H3063)\] or perhaps \[[H3194](H3194)\]; *Judah* (that is, *Jehudah* or *Juttah*), a part of (or place in) Palestine: - Judah.

d:
Judaea = he shall be praised
**1.** in a narrower sense, to the southern portion of Palestine lying on this side of the Jordan and the Dead Sea, to distinguish it from Samaria, Galilee, Peraea, and Idumaea
**2.** in a broader sense, referring to all Palestine
s: Feminine of [G2453](G2453) (with [G1093](G1093) implied); the *Judaean* land (that is, *judaea*), a region of Palestine: - Juda.

d:
**1.** to adopt Jewish customs and rites, imitate the Jews, Judaise
  **a.** one who observes the ritual law of the Jews
s: From [G2453](G2453); to *become* *a* *Judaean*, that is, “judaize”: - live as the Jews.

d: **1.** Jewish
s: From [G2453](G2453); *Judaic*, that is, *resembling* *a* *Judaean:* - Jewish.

d: **1.** Jewishly, after the manner of the Jews
s: Adverb from [G2451](G2451); *Judaically* or *in* *a* *manner* *resembling* *a* *Judaean:* - as do the Jews.

d:
**1.** Jewish, belonging to the Jewish nation
**2.** Jewish as respects to birth, origin, religion
s: From [G2448](G2448) (in the sense of [G2455](G2455) as a country); *udaean*, that is, belonging to *Jehudah:* - Jew (-ess), of Juda.
o: from [G2448](G2448) (in the sense of [G2455](G2455) as a country)

d: **1.** the Jewish faith and worship, religion of the Jews, Judaism
s: From [G2450](G2450); “judaism”, that is, the *Jewish* *faith* and usages: - Jews’ religion.

d:
Judah or Judas = he shall be praised
**1.** the fourth son of Jacob
**2.** an unknown ancestor of christ
**3.** a man surnamed the Galilean, who at the time of the census of Quirinus, excited the revolt in Galilee, Act 5:37
**4.** a certain Jew of Damascus, Act 9:11
**5.** a prophet surnamed Barsabas, of the church at Jerusalem, Act 15:22, Act 15:27, Act 15:32
**6.** the apostle, Joh 14:22, who was surnamed Lebbaeus or Thaddaeus, and according to opinion wrote the Epistle of Jude.
**7.** the half-brother of Jesus, Mat 13:55
**8.** Judas Iscariot, the apostle who betrayed Jesus
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3063](H3063)\]; *Judas* (that is, *Jehudah*), the name of ten Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its region: - Juda (-h, -s); Jude.

d:
Julia = soft haired
**1.** a Christian woman
s: Feminine of the same as [G2457](G2457); *Julia*, a Christian woman: - Julia.

d:
Julius = soft-haired
**1.** the centurion of Augustus Band, to whose charge Paul was delivered when he was sent prisoner from Caesarea to Rome
s: Of Latin origin; *Julius*, a centurion: - Julius.

d:
Junia = youthful
**1.** a Christian woman at Rome, mentioned by Paul as one of his kinsfolk and fellow prisoners
s: Of Latin origin; *Junias*, a Christian: - Junias.

d:
Justus = just
**1.** a surname of Joseph, called Barsabas. Act 1:23
**2.** of Titus, a Christian at Corinth, with whom Paul lodged. Act 18:7
**3.** a surname of Jesus, a friend of Paul. Col 4:11
s: Of Latin origin (“just”); *Justus*, the name of three Christians: - Justus.

d: **1.** a horseman
s: From [G2462](G2462); an *equestrian*, that is, member of a *cavalry* corps: - horseman.

d: **1.** equestrian, the horse(men), cavalry
s: Neuter of a derivative of [G2462](G2462); the *cavalry* force: - horse \[-men\].

d: **1.** a horse
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *horse:* - horse.

d: **1.** a rainbow
s: Perhaps from [G2046](G2046) (as a symbol of the female *messenger* of the pagan deities); a *rainbow* (“iris”): - rainbow.
o: perhaps from [G2046](G2046) (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan deities)

d:
Isaac = to laugh
**1.** the son of Abraham and Sarah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3327](H3327)\]; *Isaac* (that is, *Jitschak*), the son of Abraham: - Isaac.

d: **1.** like the angels
s: From [G2470](G2470) and [G32](G32); *like* *an* *angel*, that is, *angelic:* - equal unto the angels.

d:
Issachar = reward
**1.** the ninth son of Jacob and the fifth of Leah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3485](H3485)\]; *Isachar* (that is, *Jissaskar*), a son of Jacob (figuratively his descendants): - Issachar.

d: **1.** to know
s: Assumed by some as the base of certain irregular forms of [G1942](G1942); to *know:* - know.
o: assumed by some as the base of cert. irregular forms of [G1942](G1942)

d: **1.** be thou
s: Second person imperative present of [G1510](G1510); *be* thou: - + agree, be, X give thyself wholly to.

d:
Iscariot = men of Kerioth
**1.** the apostle who betrayed Jesus
s: Of Hebrew origin (probably \[[H377](H377)\] and \[[H7149](H7149)\]); *inhabitants* *of* *Kerioth*; *Iscariotes* (that is, *Keriothite*), an epithet of Judas the traitor: - Iscariot.

d: **1.** equal, in quantity or quality
s: Probably from [G1492](G1492) (through the idea of *seeming*); *similar* (in amount or kind): - + agree, as much, equal, like.
o: probably from [G1492](G1492) (through the idea of seeming)

d:
**1.** equality
**2.** equity, fairness, what is equitable
s: *likeness* (in condition or proportion); by implication *equity:* - equal (-ity).

d:
**1.** equally precious
**2.** equally honoured, to be esteemed equal to
s: From [G2470](G2470) and [G5092](G5092); *of* *equal* *value* or *honor:* - like precious.

d: **1.** equal in soul
s: From [G2470](G2470) and [G5590](G5590); *of* *similar* *spirit:* - likeminded.

d:
Israel = he shall be a prince of God
**1.** the name given to the patriarch Jacob (and borne by him in addition to his former name)
**2.** the family or descendants of Israel, the nation of Israel
**3.** Christians, the Israel of God (Gal 6:16)
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3478](H3478)\]; *Israel* (that is, *Jisrael*), the adopted name of Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively): - Israel.

d: **1.** an Israelite, one of the nation of Israel, a name to be held in honour
s: From [G2474](G2474); an “israelite”, that is, descendant of Israel (literally or figuratively): - Israelite.

d:
**1.** to cause or make to stand, to place, put, set
  **a.** to bid to stand by, \[set up\]
    **1.** in the presence of others, in the midst, before judges, before members of the Sanhedrin;
    **2.** to place
  **b.** to make firm, fix establish
    **1.** to cause a person or a thing to keep his or its place
    **2.** to stand, be kept intact (of family, a kingdom), to escape in safety
    **3.** to establish a thing, cause it to stand
**2.** to uphold or sustain the authority or force of anything
  **a.** to set or place in a balance
    **1.** to weigh: money to one (because in very early times before the introduction of coinage, the metals used to be weighed)
**3.** to stand
  **a.** to stand by or near
    **1.** to stop, stand still, to stand immovable, stand firm
  **b.** of the foundation of a building
  **c.** to stand
    **1.** continue safe and sound, stand unharmed, to stand ready or prepared
    **2.** to be of a steadfast mind
    **3.** of quality, one who does not hesitate, does not waiver
s: A prolonged form of a primary word στάω staō (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses); to *stand* (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively): - abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up). Compare [G5087](G5087).
o: a prolonged form of a primary stao stah’-o (of the same meaning, and used for it in certain tenses)

d:
**1.** to enquire into, examine, investigate
**2.** to find out, learn, by enquiry
**3.** to gain knowledge of by visiting
  **a.** of some distinguished person, to become personally acquainted with, know face to face
s: From a derivative of [G1492](G1492); to *be* *knowing* (*learned*), that is, (by implication) to *visit* for information (*interview*): - see.

d:
**1.** strong, mighty
  **a.** of living beings
    **1.** strong either in body or in mind
    **2.** of one who has strength of soul to sustain the attacks of Satan, strong and therefore exhibiting many excellences
  **b.** on inanimate things
    **1.** strong, violent, forcibly uttered, firm, sure
s: From [G2479](G2479); *forcible* (literally or figuratively): - boisterous, mighty (-ier), powerful, strong (-er, man), valiant.

d: **1.** ability, force, strength, might
s: From a derivative of ἱς his (*force*; compare ἔσχον eschon; a form of [G2192](G2192)); *forcefulness* (literally or figuratively): - ability, might (\[-ily\]), power, strength.
o: from a derivative of is (force, cf eschon, a form of [G2192](G2192))

d:
**1.** to be strong
  **a.** to be strong in body, to be robust, to be in sound health
**2.** to have power
  **a.** to have power as shown by extraordinary deeds
    **1.** to exert, wield power, to have strength to overcome
  **b.** to be a force, avail
  **c.** to be serviceable
  **d.** to be able, can
s: From [G2479](G2479); to *have* (or *exercise*) *force* (literally or figuratively): - beable, avail, can do (\[-not\]), could, be good, might, prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.

d:
**1.** equally, in like manner
**2.** agreeably to expectation, i.e. it may be, probably
s: Adverb from [G2470](G2470); *likely*, that is, *perhaps:* - it may be.

d:
Italy = calf like
**1.** the whole peninsula between the Alps and the Straits of messina
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Italia*, a region of Europe: - Italy.

d: **1.** Italian
s: From [G2482](G2482); *Italic*, that is, belonging to Italia: - Italian.

d:
Ituraea = past the limits or he will arrange
**1.** a mountainous region, lying northeast of Palestine and west of Damascus. At the time when John the Baptist made his public appearance it was subject to Philip the tetrarch, son of herod the great, among the regions assigned to this prince after his father’s death. It was brought under Jewish control by king Aristobulus around 100 B.C. Its inhabitants had been noted for robbery and skilful use of the bow.
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3195](H3195)\]; *Ituraea* (that is, *Jetur*), a region of Palestine: - Itura.

d: **1.** a little fish
s: Diminutive from [G2486](G2486); a *petty* *fish:* - little (small) fish.

d: **1.** a fish
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *fish:* - fish.

d:
**1.** a footprint, track, footstep
**2.** in the NT, metaph. of imitating the example of any one
s: From ἰκνέομαι ikneomai (to *arrive*; compare [G2240](G2240)); a *track* (figuratively): - step.

d:
Jotham = Jehovah is upright
**1.** the son of king Uzziah or Azariah and Jerusha
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3147](H3147)\]; *Joatham* (that is, *Jotham*), an Israelite: - Joatham.

d:
Joanna = Jehovah is a gracious giver
**1.** the wife of Chuza, herod’s steward, and a follower of Jesus
s: Feminine of the same as [G2491](G2491); *Joanna*, a Christian: - Joanna.

d:
Joanna = grace or gift of God
**1.** one of the ancestors of christ
s: A form of [G2491](G2491); *Joannas*, an Israelite: - Joannas.

d:
John = Jehovah is a gracious giver
**1.** John the Baptist was the son of Zacharias and Elisabeth, the forerunner of christ. By order of herod Antipas he was cast into prison and afterwards beheaded.
**2.** John the apostle, the writer of the Fourth Gospel, son of Zebedee and Salome, brother of James the elder. He is that disciple who (without mention by name) is spoken of in the Fourth Gospel as especially dear to Jesus and according to the traditional opinion is the author of the book of Revelation.
**3.** John surnamed Mark, the companion of Barnabas and Paul. Act 12:12
**4.** John a certain man, a member of the Sanhedrin Act 5:6
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3110](H3110)\]; *Joannes* (that is, *Jochanan*), the name of four Israelites: - John.

d:
Job = the cry of woe or I will exclaim
**1.** a man known for his piety and, consistency and fortitude in the endurance of trials. His experiences are related in the OT book bearing his name.
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H347](H347)\]; *Job* (that is, *Ijob*), a patriarch: - Job.

d:
Joel = to whom Jehovah is God
**1.** the second of the twelve minor prophets, the son of Pethuel, probably prophesied in Judah in the reign of Uzziah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3100](H3100)\]; *Joel*, an Israelite: - Joel.

d:

  **a.** of only, at least
  **b.** even if
s: From [G2532](G2532) nad [G1437](G1437); *and* (or *even*) *if:* - and (also) if (so much as), if but, at the least, though, yet.

d:
Cana = place of reeds
**1.** a village in Galilee about 5 miles (8 km) NW from Nazareth
s: Of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H7071](H7071)\]); *Cana*, a place in Palestine: - Cana.

d:
Canaanite = zealous
**1.** the surname of apostle Simon, otherwise known as Simon Zelotes
s: Of Chaldee origin (compare \[[H7067](H7067)\]); *zealous*; *Cananites*, an epithet. (By mistake for a derivative from [G5477](G5477)): - Canaanite \[by mistake for a derivationfrom [G5477](G5477)\].

d:
Candace = prince of servants
**1.** a queen of Ethiopia mentioned in Act 8:27. (A.D.
**2.** The name was not a proper name of an individual, but that of a dynasty of Ethiopian queens.
s: Of foreign origin; *Candace*, an Egyptian queen: - Candace.

d:
**1.** a rod or straight piece of rounded wood to which any thing is fastened to keep it straight
  **a.** used for various purposes
    **1.** a measuring rod, rule
    **2.** a carpenter’s line or measuring tape
    **3.** the measure of a leap, as in the Olympic games
**2.** a definitely bounded or fixed space within the limits of which one’s power of influence is confined
  **a.** the province assigned one
  **b.** one’s sphere of activity
**3.** metaph. any rule or standard, a principle or law of investigating, judging, living, acting
s: Fromκάνη kanē (a straight *reed*, that is, *rod*); a *rule* (“canon”), that is, (figuratively) a *standard* (of faith and practice); by implication a *boundary*, that is, (figuratively) a *sphere* (of activity): - line, rule.
o: from kane (a straight reed, i.e. rod)

d: Capernaum = village of comfort
s: Of Hebrew origin (probably \[[H3723](H3723)\] and \[[H5151](H5151)\]); *Capernaum* (that is, *Caphanachum*), a place in Palestine: - Capernaum.

d:
**1.** to be a retailer, to peddle
**2.** to make money by selling anything
  **a.** to get sordid gain by dealing in anything, to do a thing for base gain
  **b.** to trade in the word of God
    **1.** to try to get base gain by teaching divine truth
  **c.** to corrupt, to adulterate
    **1.** peddlers were in the habit of adulterating their commodities for the sake of gain
s: From κάπηλος kapēlos (a *huckster*); to *retail*, that is, (by implication) to *adulterate* (figuratively): - corrupt.

d: **1.** smoke
s: Of uncertain affinity; *smoke:* - smoke.

d: Cappadocia = province of good horses
s: Of foreign origin; *Cappadocia*, a region of Asia Minor: - Cappadocia.

d:
**1.** the heart
  **a.** that organ in the animal body which is the centre of the circulation of the blood, and hence was regarded as the seat of physical life
  **b.** denotes the centre of all physical and spiritual life
  **c.** the vigour and sense of physical life
  **d.** the centre and seat of spiritual life
    **1.** the soul or mind, as it is the fountain and seat of the thoughts, passions, desires, appetites, affections, purposes, endeavours
    **2.** of the understanding, the faculty and seat of the intelligence
    **3.** of the will and character
    **4.** of the soul so far as it is affected and stirred in a bad way or good, or of the soul as the seat of the sensibilities, affections, emotions, desires, appetites, passions
  **e.** of the middle or central or inmost part of anything, even though inanimate
s: Prolonged from a primary κάρ kar (Latin *cor*, “heart”); the *heart*, that is, (figuratively) the *thoughts* or *feelings* (*mind*); also (by analogy) the *middle:* - (+ broken-) heart (-ed).
o: prolonged from a primary kar (Latin, cor, heart)

d: **1.** knower of the hearts
s: From [G2588](G2588) and [G1097](G1097); a *heart* *knower:* - which knowest the hearts.

d:
**1.** fruit
  **a.** the fruit of the trees, vines, of the fields
  **b.** the fruit of one’s loins, i.e. his progeny, his posterity
**2.** that which originates or comes from something, an effect, result
  **a.** work, act, deed
  **b.** advantage, profit, utility
  **c.** praises, which are presented to God as a thank offering
  **d.** to gather fruit (i.e. a reaped harvest) into life eternal (as into a granary), is used in fig. discourse of those who by their labours have fitted souls to obtain eternal life
s: Probably from the base of [G726](G726); *fruit* (as *plucked*), literally or figuratively: - fruit.

d:
Carpus = fruit
**1.** a Christian at Troas 2Ti 4:13
s: Perhaps for [G2590](G2590); *Carpus*, probably a Christian: - Carpus.

d:
**1.** to bear fruit
**2.** to bear, bring forth, deeds
**3.** to bear fruit of one’s self
s: From [G2593](G2593); to *be* *fertile* (literally or figuratively): - be (bear, bring forth) fruit (-ful).

d: **1.** fruit bearing, fruitful, productive
s: From [G2590](G2590) and [G5342](G5342); *fruitbearing* (figuratively): - fruitful.

d: **1.** to be steadfast
s: From a derivative of [G2904](G2904) (transposed); to *be* *strong*, that is, (figuratively) *steadfast* (*patient*): - endure.

d:
**1.** a dry stalk or twig, a straw
**2.** chaff
s: From κάρφω karpho (to *wither*); a dry *twig* or *straw:* - mote.

d:
**1.** down from, through out
**2.** according to, toward, along
s: A primary particle; (preposition) *down* (in place or time), in varied relations (according to the case \[genitive, dative or accusative\] with which it is joined)*:* - about, according as (to), after, against, (when they were) X alone, among, and, X apart, (even, like) as (concerning, pertaining to, touching), X aside, at, before, beyond, by, to the charge of, \[charita-\] bly, concerning, + covered, \[dai-\] ly, down, every, (+ far more) exceeding, X more excellent, for, from . . . to, godly, in (-asmuch, divers, every, -to, respect of), . . . by, after the manner of, + by any means, beyond (out of) measure, X mightily, more, X natural, of (up-) on (X part), out (of every), over against, (+ your) X own, + particularly, so, through (-oughout, -oughout every), thus, (un-) to (-gether, -ward), X uttermost, where (-by), with. In composition it retains many of these applications, and frequently denotes *opposition*, *distribution* or *intensity*.

d:
**1.** to go down, come down, descend
  **a.** the place from which one has come down from
  **b.** to come down
    **1.** as from the temple at Jerusalem, from the city of Jerusalem
    **2.** of celestial beings coming down to earth
  **c.** to be cast down
**2.** of things
  **a.** to come (i.e. be sent) down
  **b.** to come (i.e. fall) down
    **1.** from the upper regions of the air
**3.** metaph. to (go i.e.) be cast down to the lowest state of wretchedness and shame
s: From [G2596](G2596) and the base of [G939](G939); to *descend* (literally or figuratively): - come (get, go, step) down, descend, fall (down).

d:
**1.** to cast down
  **a.** to throw to the ground, prostate
**2.** to put in a lower place
  **a.** to lay (down) a foundation
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *down:* - cast down, lay.

d:
**1.** to press down by an imposing weight
**2.** to weigh down
**3.** metaph. to burden
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G916](G916); to *impose* *upon:* - burden

d:
**1.** descent
  **a.** the act of descending
  **b.** the place of descent
    **1.** that part of the mountain where the descent is made
s: From [G2597](G2597); a *declivity:* - descent.

d:
**1.** to cause to go down
**2.** to bring down
**3.** to cast down, thrust down
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of the base of [G939](G939); to *cause* *to* *go* *down*, that is, *precipitate:* - bring (thrust) down.
o: from [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of the base of [G939](G939)

d:
**1.** a throwing or laying down
  **a.** the injection or depositing of the virile semen in the womb
  **b.** of the seed of plants and animals
**2.** a founding (laying down a foundation)
s: From [G2598](G2598); a *deposition*, that is, *founding*; figuratively *conception:* - conceive, foundation.

d:
**1.** to decide as umpire against someone
**2.** to defraud or beguile of the prize of victory
**3.** metaph. to deprive of salvation
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1018](G1018) (in its original sense); to *award* the price *against*, that is, (figuratively) to *defraud* (of salvation): - beguile of reward.

d: **1.** announcer, proclaimer
s: From [G2605](G2605); a *proclaimer:* - setter forth.

d:
**1.** to announce, declare, promulgate, make known
**2.** to proclaim publicly, publish
**3.** to denounce, report, betray
s: From [G2596](G2596) and the base of [G32](G32); to *proclaim*, *promulgate:* - declare, preach, shew, speak of, teach.

d: **1.** to deride
s: To *laugh* *down*, that is, *deride:* - laugh to scorn.

d:
**1.** to find fault with, blame
**2.** to accuse, condemn
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1097](G1097); to *note* *against*, that is, *find* *fault* *with:* - blame, condemn.

d: **1.** to break
s: From [G2596](G2596) and the base of [G4486](G4486); to *rend* *in* *pieces*, that is, *crack* *apart:* - break.

d:
**1.** to lead down, bring down
**2.** to bring the vessel from deep water to the land
**3.** to be brought (down) in a ship, to land, touch at
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G71](G71); to *lead* *down*; specifically to *moor* a vessel: - bring (down, forth), (bring to) land, touch.

d:
**1.** to struggle against
**2.** to overcome
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G75](G75); to *struggle* *against*, that is, (by implication) to *overcome:* - subdue.

d: **1.** to bind up
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1210](G1210); to *tie* *down*, that is, *bandage* (a wound): - bind up.

d: **1.** thoroughly clear, plain, evident
s: From [G2596](G2596) intensively and [G1212](G1212); *manifest:* - far more evident.

d:
**1.** to give judgment against (one), to pronounce guilty
**2.** to condemn
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G1349](G1349); to *adjudge* *against*, that is, *pronounce* *guilty:* - condemn.

d: **1.** to follow after, follow up
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1377](G1377); to *hunt* *down*, that is, *search* *for*: - follow after.

d:
**1.** to bring into bondage, enslave
**2.** to enslave to one’s self, bring into bondage to one’s self
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1402](G1402); to *enslave* *utterly:* - bring into bondage.

d:
**1.** to exercise harsh control over one, to use one’s power against one
**2.** to oppress one
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G1413](G1413); to *exercise* *dominion* *against*, that is, *oppress:* - oppress.

d:
**1.** to dishonour, disgrace
**2.** to put to shame, make ashamed
  **a.** to be ashamed, blush with shame
  **b.** one is said to be put to shame who suffers a repulse, or whom some hope has deceived
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G153](G153); to *shame* *down*, that is, *disgrace* or (by implication) *put* *to* *the* *blush:* - confound, dishonour, (be a-, make a-) shame (-d).

d: **1.** to burn up, consume by fire
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2545](G2545); to *burn* *down* (to the ground), that is, *consume* *wholly:* - burn (up, utterly).

d:
**1.** to cover up
**2.** to veil or cover one’s self
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2572](G2572); to *cover* *wholly*, that is, *veil:* - cover, hide.

d: **1.** to glory against, to exult over, to boast one’s self to the injury (of a person or thing)
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2744](G2744); to *exult* *against* (that is, *over*): - boast (against), glory, rejoice against.

d:
**1.** to have lain down, i.e. to lie prostrate
  **a.** of the sick
  **b.** of those at meals, to recline
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2749](G2749); to *lie* *down*, that is, (by implication) *be* *sick*; specifically to *recline* at a meal: - keep, lie, sit at meat (down).

d: **1.** to break in pieces
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2806](G2806); to *break* *down*, that is, *divide:* - break.

d: **1.** to shut up, confine
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2808](G2808); to *shut* *down* (in a dungeon), that is, *incarcerate:* - shut up.

d:
**1.** to distribute by lot
**2.** to distribute as an inheritance
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of a compound of [G2819](G2819) and [G1325](G1325); to *be* *a* *giver* *of* *lots* *to* *each*, that is, (by implication) to *apportion* *an* *estate:* - divide by lot.
o: from [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of a compound of [G2819](G2819) and [G1325](G1325)

d:
**1.** in the NT in reference to eating, to make to recline
**2.** to recline (at a table)
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2827](G2827); to *recline* *down*, that is, (specifically) to *take* *a* *place* at table: - (make) sit down (at meat).

d: **1.** to overwhelm with water, to submerge, deluge
s: From [G2596](G2596) and the base of [G2830](G2830); to *dash* (*wash*) *down*, that is, (by implication) to *deluge:* - overflow.

d:
**1.** inundation, deluge
  **a.** of Noah’s deluge
s: From [G2626](G2626); an *inundation:* - flood.

d: **1.** to follow after
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G190](G190); to *accompany* *closely:* - follow (after).

d:
**1.** to cut up in pieces
**2.** to slay
**3.** to beat, bruise
**4.** to cut, gash, mangle
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2875](G2875); to *chop* *down*, that is, *mangle:* - cut.

d:
**1.** to cast down a precipice
**2.** to through down headlong
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G2911](G2911); to *precipitate* *down:* - cast down headlong.

d: **1.** damnatory sentence, condemnation
s: From [G2632](G2632); an *adverse* *sentence* (the verdict): - condemnation.

d:
**1.** to give judgment against, to judge worthy of punishment
  **a.** to condemn
  **b.** by one’s good example to render another’s wickedness the more evident and censurable
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2919](G2919); to *judge* *against*, that is, *sentence:* - condemn, damn.

d: **1.** condemnation
s: From [G2632](G2632); *sentencing* *adversely* (the act): - condemn (-ation).

d:
**1.** to bring under one’s power, to subject one’s self, to subdue, master
**2.** to hold in subjection, to be master of, exercise Lordship over
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2961](G2961); to *lord* *against*, that is, *control*, *subjugate:* - exercise dominion over (lordship), be lord over, overcome.

d: **1.** to speak against one, to criminate, traduce
s: From [G2637](G2637); to *be* *a* *traducer*, that is, to *slander:* - speak against (evil of).

d: **1.** defamation, evil speaking
s: From [G2637](G2637); *defamation:* - backbiting, evil speaking.

d: **1.** a defamer, evil speaker
s: From [G2596](G2596) and the base of [G2980](G2980); *talkative* *against*, that is, a *slanderer:* - backbiter.

d:
**1.** to lay hold of
  **a.** to lay hold of so as to make one’s own, to obtain, attain to, to make one’s own, to take into one’s self, appropriate
  **b.** to seize upon, take possession of
    **1.** of evils overtaking one, of the last day overtaking the wicked with destruction, of a demon about to torment one
    **2.** in a good sense, of christ by his holy power and influence laying hold of the human mind and will, in order to prompt and govern it
  **c.** to detect, catch
  **d.** to lay hold of with the mind
    **1.** to understand, perceive, learn, comprehend
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1983](G1983); to *take* *eagerly*, that is, *seize*, *possess*, etc. (literally or figuratively): - apprehend, attain, come upon, comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-) take.

d:
**1.** to lay down, to lie down
**2.** to narrate at length, recount, set forth
**3.** to set down in a list or register, to enrol
  **a.** of soldiers
  **b.** of those widows who held a prominent place in the church and exercised a certain superintendence over the rest of the women, and had charge of the widows and orphans supported at the public expense
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3004](G3004) (in its original meaning); to *lay* *down*, that is, (figuratively) to *enrol:* - take into the number.

d: **1.** remnant, remains
s: From [G2641](G2641); a *remainder*, that is, (by implication) a *few:* - remnant.

d:
**1.** to leave behind
  **a.** to depart from, leave
    **1.** to be left
  **b.** to bid (one) to remain
  **c.** to forsake, leave to one’s self a person or thing by ceasing to care for it, to abandon, leave in the lurch
    **1.** to be abandoned, forsaken
  **d.** to cause to be left over, to reserve, to leave remaining
  **e.** like our leave behind, it is used of one who on being called away cannot take another with him
    **1.** especially of the dying (to leave behind)
  **f.** like our leave, leave alone, disregard
    **1.** of those who sail past a place without stopping
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3007](G3007); to *leave* *down*, that is, *behind*; by implication to *abandon*, *have* *remaining:* - forsake, leave, reserve.

d: **1.** to overwhelm with stones, to stone
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3034](G3034); to *stone* *down*, that is, *to* *death:* - stone.

d:
**1.** exchange
  **a.** of the business of money changers, exchanging equivalent values
**2.** adjustment of a difference, reconciliation, restoration to favour
  **a.** in the NT of the restoration of the favour of God to sinners that repent and put their trust in the expiatory death of christ
s: From [G2644](G2644); *exchange* (figuratively *adjustment*), that is, *restoration* to (the divine) favor: - atonement, reconciliation (-ing).

d:
**1.** to change, exchange, as coins for others of equivalent value
  **a.** to reconcile (those who are at variance)
  **b.** return to favour with, be reconciled to one
  **c.** to receive one into favour
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G236](G236); to *change* *mutually*, that is, (figuratively) to *compound* a difference: - reconcile.

d: **1.** left remaining
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3062](G3062); *left* *down* (*behind*), that is, *remaining* (plural the *rest*): - residue.

d:
**1.** an inn, lodging place
**2.** an eating room, dining room
s: From [G2647](G2647); properly a *dissolution* (breaking up of a journey), that is, (by implication) a *lodging* *place:* - guestchamber, inn.

d:
**1.** to dissolve, disunite
  **a.** (what has been joined together), to destroy, demolish
  **b.** metaph. to overthrow i.e. render vain, deprive of success, bring to naught
    **1.** to subvert, overthrow
  **c.** of institutions, forms of government, laws, etc., to deprive of force, annul, abrogate, discard
  **d.** of travellers, to halt on a journey, to put up, lodge (the figurative expression originating in the circumstance that, to put up for the night, the straps and packs of the beasts of burden are unbound and taken off; or, more correctly from the fact that the traveller’s garments, tied up when he is on the journey, are unloosed at it end)
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3089](G3089); to *loosen* *down* (*disintegrate*), that is, (by implication) to *demolish* (literally or figuratively); specifically (compare [G2646](G2646)) to *halt* for the night: - destroy, dissolve, be guest, lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down.

d:
**1.** to learn thoroughly, examine carefully
**2.** to consider well
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3129](G3129); to *learn* *thoroughly*, that is, (by implication) to *note* *carefully:* - consider.

d: **1.** to bear witness against, to testify against one
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3140](G3140); to *testify* *against:* - witness against.

d: **1.** to remain permanently, to abide
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3306](G3306); to *stay* *fully*, that is, *reside:* - abide.

d: **1.** apart, alone
s: From [G2596](G2596) and the accusative plural feminine of [G3441](G3441) (with [G5561](G5561) implied); *according* *to* *sole* places, that is, (adverbially) *separately:* - alone.
o: from [G2596](G2596) and accusative case plural feminine of [G3441](G3441) (with [G5561](G5561) implied)

d: **1.** curse
s: From [G2596](G2596) (intensive) and [G331](G331); an *imprecation:* - curse.

d: **1.** to curse
s: From [G2596](G2596) (intensive) and [G332](G332); to *imprecate:* - curse.

d:
**1.** to consume
  **a.** of fire
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G355](G355); to *consume* *utterly:* - consume.

d:
**1.** to cause to grow numb or torpid
**2.** to be torpid, inactive, to be to the detriment of one
**3.** to weigh heavily upon, be burdensome to
s: From [G2596](G2596) and ναρκάω narkaō (to *be* *numb*); to *grow* *utterly* *torpid*, that is, (by implication) *slothful* (figuratively *expensive*): - be burdensome (chargeable).

d:
**1.** to nod to, make a sign
**2.** to indicate to another by a nod or sign what one wishes him to do
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3506](G3506); to *nod* *down* (*towards*), that is, (by analogy) to *make* *signs* to: - beckon.

d:
**1.** to perceive, remark, observe, understand
**2.** to consider attentively, fix one’s eyes or mind upon
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3539](G3539); to *observe* *fully:* - behold, consider, discover, perceive.

d:
**1.** to come to, arrive
  **a.** to come to a place over against, opposite another
  **b.** metaph. to attain to a thing
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G473](G473); to *meet* *against*, that is, *arrive* at (literally or figuratively): - attain, come.

d:
**1.** a pricking, piercing
**2.** severe sorrow, extreme grief
**3.** insensibility or torpor of mind, such as extreme grief easily produces
  **a.** hence a spirit of stupor, which renders their souls torpid so insensible that they are not affected at all by the offer made them of salvation through the messiah
s: From [G2660](G2660); a *prickling* (sensation, as of the limbs *asleep*), that is, (by implication \[perhaps by some confusion with [G3506](G3506) or even with [G3571](G3571)\]) *stupor* (*lethargy*): - slumber.

d:
**1.** to prick, pierce
**2.** metaph. to pain the mind sharply, agitate it vehemently
  **a.** esp. of the emotion of sorrow
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3572](G3572); to *pierce* *thoroughly*, that is, (figuratively) to *agitate* violently (“sting to the quick”): - prick.

d: **1.** to account worthy, judge worthy
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G515](G515); to *deem* *entirely* *deserving:* - (ac-) count worthy.

d:
**1.** to tread down, trample under foot, to trample on
**2.** metaph. to treat with rudeness and insult
  **a.** to spurn, treat with insulting neglect
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3961](G3961); to *trample* *down*; figuratively to *reject* with disdain: - trample, tread (down, underfoot).

d:
**1.** a putting to rest
  **a.** calming of the winds
**2.** a resting place
  **a.** metaph. the heavenly blessedness in which God dwells, and of which he has promised to make persevering believers in christ partakers after the toils and trials of life on earth are ended
s: From [G2664](G2664); *reposing* *down*, that is, (by Hebraism) *abode:* - rest.

d:
**1.** to make quiet, to cause to be at rest, to grant rest
  **a.** to lead to a quiet abode
  **b.** to still, restrain, to cause (one striving to do something) to desist
**2.** to rest, take rest
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3973](G3973); to *settle* *down*, that is, (literally) to *colonize*, or (figuratively) to (*cause* *to*) *desist:* - cease, (give) rest (-rain).

d:
**1.** a veil spread out, a curtain
  **a.** the name given to the two curtains in the temple at Jerusalem, one of them at the entrance to the temple separated the holy Place from the outer court, the other veiled the holy of Holies from the holy Place
s: From a compound of [G2596](G2596) and a congener of [G4072](G4072); something *spread* *thoroughly*, that is, (specifically) the door *screen* (to the Most Holy Place) in the Jewish Temple: - vail.
o: from a compound of [G2596](G2596) and a congener of [G4072](G4072)

d:
**1.** to drink down, swallow down
**2.** to devour
**3.** to swallow up, destroy
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4095](G4095); to *drink* *down*, that is, *gulp* *entire* (literally or figuratively): - devour, drown, swallow (up).

d: **1.** to fall down
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4098](G4098); to *fall* *down:* - fall (down).

d:
**1.** to sail down from the deep sea to the land
**2.** to put in
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4126](G4126); to *sail* *down* upon a place, that is, to *land* at: - arrive.

d:
**1.** to tire down with toil, exhaust with labour
  **a.** to afflict or oppress with evils
  **b.** to make trouble for
  **c.** to treat roughly
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G4192](G4192); to *labor* *down*, that is, *wear* *with* *toil* (figuratively *harass*): - oppress, vex.

d:
**1.** to plunge or sink into the sea
  **a.** to sink, to go down
  **b.** a grievous offender for the purpose of killing him, to drown
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of the same as [G4195](G4195); to *plunge* *down*, that is, *submerge:* - drown, sink.
o: from [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of the same as [G4195](G4195)

d: **1.** an execration, imprecation, curse
s: From [G2596](G2596) (intensive) and [G685](G685); *imprecation*, *execration:* - curse (-d, -ing).

d: **1.** to curse, doom, imprecate evil upon
s: Middle voice from [G2671](G2671); to *execrate*; by analogy to *doom:* - curse.

d:
**1.** to render idle, unemployed, inactivate, inoperative
  **a.** to cause a person or thing to have no further efficiency
  **b.** to deprive of force, influence, power
**2.** to cause to cease, put an end to, do away with, annul, abolish
  **a.** to cease, to pass away, be done away
  **b.** to be severed from, separated from, discharged from, loosed from any one
  **c.** to terminate all intercourse with one
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G691](G691); to *be* (*render*) *entirely* *idle* (*useless*), literally or figuratively: - abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away, become (make) of no (none, without) effect, fail, loose, bring (come) to nought, put away (down), vanish away, make void.

d: **1.** to number with
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G705](G705); to *reckon* *among:* - number with.

d:
**1.** to render, i.e. to fit, sound, complete
  **a.** to mend (what has been broken or rent), to repair
    **1.** to complete
  **b.** to fit out, equip, put in order, arrange, adjust
    **1.** to fit or frame for one’s self, prepare
  **c.** ethically: to strengthen, perfect, complete, make one what he ought to be
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G739](G739); to *complete* *thoroughly*, that is, *repair* (literally or figuratively) or *adjust:* - fit, frame, mend, (make) perfect (-ly join together), prepare, restore.

d:
**1.** a strengthening, perfecting of the soul
  **a.** a training, disciplining, instructing
s: From [G2675](G2675); *thorough* *equipment* (subjectively): - perfection.

d: **1.** complete furnishing, equipping
s: From [G2675](G2675); *complete* *furnishing* (objectively): - perfecting.

d:
**1.** to shake down, throw down
**2.** to shake
  **a.** to make a sign, to signal with the hand to one
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4579](G4579); to *sway* *downward*, that is, *make* *a* *signal:* - beckon.

d: **1.** to dig under, dig down, demolish, destroy
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4626](G4626); to *undermine*, that is, (by implication) *destroy:* - dig down, ruin.

d:
**1.** to furnish, equip, prepare, make ready
  **a.** of one who makes anything ready for a person or thing
  **b.** of builders, to construct, erect, with the included idea of adorning and equipping with all things necessary
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G4632](G4632); to *prepare* *thoroughly* (properly by external *equipment*; whereas [G2090](G2090) refers rather to internal *fitness*); by implication to *construct*, *create:* - build, make, ordain, prepare.

d: **1.** to pitch one’s tent, to fix one’s abode, to dwell
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4637](G4637); to *camp* *down*, that is, *haunt*; figuratively to *remain:* - lodge, rest.

d:
**1.** the pitching of tents, encamping
**2.** place of tarrying, encampment, abode
  **a.** of the nest of birds
s: From [G2681](G2681); an *encamping*, that is, (figuratively) a *perch:* - nest.

d: **1.** to overshadow, cover with shade
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G4639](G4639); to *overshade*, that is, *cover:* - shadow.

d: **1.** to inspect, view closely, in order to spy out and plot against
s: From [G2685](G2685); to *be* *a* *sentinel*, that is, to *inspect* insidiously: - spy out.

d: **1.** an inspector, a spy
s: From [G2596](G2596) (intensive) and [G4649](G4649) (in the sense of a *watcher*); a *reconnoiterer:* - spy.
o: from [G2596](G2596) (intensive) and [G4649](G4649) (in the sense of a watcher)

d:
**1.** to circumvent by artifice or fraud, conquer by subtle devices
**2.** to outwit
**3.** overreach
**4.** to deal craftily with
s: Middle voice from [G2596](G2596) and [G4679](G4679); to *be* *crafty* *against*, that is, *circumvent:* - deal subtilly with.

d:
**1.** to send or put down, to lower
**2.** to put or keep down one who is roused or incensed, to repress, restrain, appease, quiet
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4724](G4724); to *put* *down*, that is, *quell:* - appease, quiet.

d: **1.** demeanour, deportment, bearing
s: From [G2525](G2525); properly a *position* or *condition*, that is, (subjectively) *demeanor:* - behaviour.

d:
**1.** a lowering, letting down
**2.** a garment let down, dress, attire
s: From [G2687](G2687); a *deposit*, that is, (specifically) *costume:* - apparel.

d:
**1.** to turn over, turn under
  **a.** the soil with a plough
**2.** to overturn, overthrow, throw down
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4762](G4762); to *turn* upside *down*, that is, *upset:* - overthrow.

d: **1.** to feel the impulses of sexual desire
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4763](G4763); to *become* *voluptuous* *against:* - begin to wax wanton against.

d:
**1.** overthrow, destruction
  **a.** of cities
**2.** metaph. of the extinction of a spirit of consecration
s: From [G2690](G2690); an *overturn* (“catastrophe”), that is, *demolition*; figuratively *apostasy:* - overthrow, subverting.

d:
**1.** to strew over (the ground)
**2.** to prostrate, slay, (cf to lay low)
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4766](G4766); to *strew* *down*, that is, (by implication) to *prostrate* (*slay*): - overthrow.

d:
**1.** to draw down, pull down
**2.** to draw along, drag forcibly
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4951](G4951); to *drag* *down*, that is, *arrest* judicially: - hale.

d: **1.** to kill off, to slaughter
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4969](G4969); to *kill* *down*, that is, *slaughter:* - slay.

d: **1.** to cover with a seal, to close up, close with a seal
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G4972](G4972); to *seal* *closely:* - seal.

d:
**1.** a holding back, hindering
**2.** a holding fast, possession
s: From [G2722](G2722); a *holding* *down*, that is, *occupancy:* - possession.

d:
**1.** to lay down, deposit, lay up
**2.** to lay by or up for one’s self, for future use
**3.** to lay up favour for one’s self with any one, to gain favour with (to do something for one which may win favour)
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5087](G5087); to *place* *down*, that is, *deposit* (literally or figuratively): - do, lay, shew.

d: **1.** to cut up, mutilation
s: From a compound of [G2596](G2596) and τέμνω temnō (to *cut*); a *cutting* *down* (*off*), that is, *mutilation* (ironically): - concision. Compare [G609](G609).
o: from a compound of [G2596](G2596) and temno (to cut)

d: **1.** to shoot down or thrust through with an arrow
