s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G5115](G5115); to *shoot* *down* with an arrow or other missile: - thrust through.

d: **1.** to run down, hasten down
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5143](G5143); to *run* *down*, that is, *hasten* from a tower: - run down.

d:
**1.** to bear down, bring down, cast down
  **a.** to cast a pebble or calculus into the urn
    **1.** to give one’s vote, to approve
  **b.** to be born down, to sink, (from the window to the pavement)
  **c.** metaph.
    **1.** to be weighted down by, overcome, carried away
    **2.** to sink into sleep, drop asleep
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5342](G5342) (including its alternate); to *bear* *down*, that is, (figuratively) *overcome* (with drowsiness); specifically to *cast* a vote: - fall, give, sink down.

d: **1.** to flee away, flee for refuge
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5343](G5343); to *flee* *down* (*away*): - flee.

d:
**1.** to corrupt, deprave
  **a.** corrupted in mind
**2.** to destroy
  **a.** to be destroyed, to perish
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5351](G5351); to *spoil* *entirely*, that is, (literally) to *destroy*; or (figuratively) to *deprave:* - corrupt, utterly perish.

d: **1.** to kiss much, kiss again and again, kiss tenderly
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5368](G5368); to *kiss* *earnestly:* - kiss.

d: **1.** to contemn, despise, disdain, think little or nothing of
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5426](G5426); to *think* *against*, that is, *disesteem:* - despise.

d: **1.** despiser
s: From [G2706](G2706); a *contemner:* - despiser.

d:
**1.** to pour down upon
**2.** pour over, pour upon
s: From [G2596](G2596) and χέω cheō (to *pour*); to *pour* *down* (*out*): - pour.

d:
**1.** subterranean
  **a.** refers to those who dwell in the world below, departed souls
s: From [G2596](G2596) and χθών chthōn (the *ground*); *subterranean*, that is, *infernal* (belonging to the world of departed spirits): - under the earth.

d:
**1.** to use much or excessively or ill
**2.** to use up, consume by use
**3.** to use fully
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5530](G5530); to *overuse*, that is, *misuse:* - abuse.

d: **1.** to cool off, make cool
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G5594](G5594); to *cool* *down* (*off*), that is, *refresh:* - cool.

d: **1.** full of idols
s: From [G2596](G2596) (intensive) and [G1497](G1497); *utterly* *idolatrous:* - wholly given to idolatry.

d:
**1.** over against, opposite before
**2.** metaph. before one i.e. he being judge
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1725](G1725); *directly* *opposite:* - before, over against.

d:
**1.** over against, before the face of, before the presence of, in the sight of, before
  **a.** referring to places
  **b.** metaph.
    **1.** having one as it were before the eyes, before one as witness
    **2.** before God as judge
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1799](G1799); *directly* *in* *front* *of:* - before (the presence of), in the sight of.

d: **1.** to exercise authority, wield power
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G1850](G1850); to *have* (*wield*) *full* *privilege* *over:* - exercise authority.

d:
**1.** to perform, accomplish, achieve
**2.** to work out i.e. to do that from which something results
  **a.** of things: bring about, result in
**3.** to fashion i.e. render one fit for a thing
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2038](G2038); to *work* *fully*, that is, *accomplish*; by implication to *finish*, *fashion:* - cause, do (deed), perform, work (out).

d:
**1.** to come down, go down
  **a.** of one who goes from a higher to a lower locality
  **b.** of those who come to a place by a ship
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2064](G2064) (including its alternate); to *come* (or *go*) *down* (literally or figuratively): - come (down), depart, descend, go down, land.

d:
**1.** to consume by eating, to eat up, devour
  **a.** of birds
  **b.** of a dragon
  **c.** of a man eating up the little book
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to devour i.e. squander, waste: substance
  **b.** to devour i.e. forcibly appropriate: widows’ property
  **c.** to strip one of his goods
    **1.** to ruin (by the infliction of injuries)
  **d.** by fire, to devour i.e. to utterly consume, destroy
  **e.** of the consumption of the strength of body and mind by strong emotions
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2068](G2068) (including its alternate); to *eat* *down*, that is, *devour* (literally or figuratively): - devour.

d:
**1.** to make straight, guide, direct
  **a.** of the removal of the hindrances to coming to one
s: From [G2590](G2590) and [G2116](G2116); to *straighten* *fully*, that is, (figuratively) *direct:* - guide, direct.

d: **1.** to set up against
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2186](G2186); to *stand* *over* *against*, that is, *rush* *upon* (*assault*): - make insurrection against.

d:
**1.** to hold back, detain, retain
  **a.** from going away
  **b.** to restrain, hinder (the course or progress of)
    **1.** that which hinders, Antichrist from making his appearance
    **2.** to check a ship’s headway i.e. to hold or head the ship
  **c.** to hold fast, keep secure, keep firm possession of
**2.** to get possession of, take
  **a.** to possess
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2192](G2192); to *hold* *down* (*fast*), in various applications (literally or figuratively): - have, hold (fast), keep (in memory), let, X make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold.

d:
**1.** to accuse
  **a.** before a judge: to make an accusation
  **b.** of an extra-judicial accusation
s: From [G2725](G2725); to *be* *a* *plaintiff*, that is, to *charge* with some offence: - accuse, object.

d: **1.** accusation, charge
s: From [G2725](G2725); a *complaint* (“category”), that is, criminal *charge:* - accusation (X -ed).

d:
**1.** an accuser
  **a.** a name given to the devil by the rabbis
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G58](G58); *against* one in the *assembly*, that is, a *complainant* at law; specifically *Satan:* - accuser.

d:
**1.** a downcast look expressive of sorrow
**2.** shame, dejection, gloom
s: From a compound of [G2596](G2596) and perhaps a derivative of the base of [G5316](G5316) (meaning *downcast* in look); *demureness*, that is, (by implication) *sadness:* - heaviness.
o: from a compound of [G2596](G2596) and perhaps a derivative of the base of [G5316](G5316) (meaning downcast in look)

d:
**1.** to sound towards, sound down upon, resound
  **a.** to charm with resounding sound, to fascinate
**2.** to teach orally, to instruct
**3.** to inform by word of mouth
  **a.** to be orally informed
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2279](G2279); to *sound* *down* into the ears, that is, (by implication) to *indoctrinate* (“catechize”) or (generally) to *apprise* of: - inform, instruct, teach.

d: **1.** to rust over, cover with rust
s: From [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G2447](G2447); to *rust* *down*, that is, *corrode:* - canker.

d:
**1.** to be strong to another’s detriment, to prevail against
**2.** to be superior in strength
**3.** to overcome
**4.** to prevail
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G2480](G2480); to *overpower:* - prevail (against).

d:
**1.** to dwell, settle
  **a.** metaph. divine powers, influences, etc., are said to dwell in his soul, to pervade, prompt, govern it
**2.** to dwell in, inhabit
  **a.** God is said to dwell in the temple, i.e. to be always present for worshippers
s: From [G2596](G2596) and [G3611](G3611); to *house* *permanently*, that is, *reside* (literally or figuratively): - dwell (-er), inhabitant (-ter).

d: **1.** dwelling, abode
s: From [G2730](G2730); *residence* (properly the act; but by implication concretely the mansion): - dwelling.

d: **1.** an abode, a habitation
s: From a derivative of [G2730](G2730); a *dwelling* *place:* - habitation.

d:
**1.** dwelling, habitation
**2.** to cause to dwell, to send or bring into an abode
**3.** to give a dwelling to
s: *residence* (properly the condition; but by implication the abode itself): - habitation.

d:
**1.** to show in a mirror, to make to reflect, to mirror
**2.** to look at one’s self in a mirror
**3.** to behold one’s self in a mirror
s: Middle voice from a compound of [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G3700](G3700) (compare [G2072](G2072)); to *mirror* *oneself*, that is, to *see* *reflected* (figuratively): - behold as in a glass.
o: middle voice from a compound of [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G3700](G3700) \[cf [G2072](G2072)\]

d:
**1.** a right action, a successful achievement
  **a.** of wholesome public measures or institutions
s: From a compound of [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G3717](G3717) (compare [G1357](G1357)); something *made* *fully* *upright*, that is, (figuratively) *rectification* (specifically *good* public *administration*): - very worthy deed.
o: from a compound of [G2596](G2596) and a derivative of [G3717](G3717) \[cf [G1357](G1357)\]

d: \[Compare [G2737](G2737)\]; adverb from [G2596](G2596); *downwards*: - beneath, bottom, down, under.
s: \[Compare [G2737](G2737)\]; adverb from [G2596](G2596); *downwards*: - beneath, bottom, down, under.

d: **1.** lower
s: Compound from [G2736](G2736); *inferior* (locally, of Hades): - lower.

d:
**1.** heat
  **a.** of painful and burning heat
s: From [G2545](G2545); properly a *burn* (concretely), but used (abstractly) of a *glow:* - heat.

d:
**1.** to burn with heat, to scorch
**2.** to be tortured with intense heat
s: From [G2738](G2738); to *burn:* - scorch.

d: **1.** burning, burning up
s: From [G2545](G2545); *burning* (the act): - be burned.

d:
**1.** to burn up, set fire to
**2.** to suffer with feverish burning, be parched with fever
s: From [G2740](G2740); to *set* *on* *fire:* - with fervent heat.

d:
**1.** burning heat
  **a.** of the sun
**2.** Eurus, a very dry hot, east wind, scorching and drying up everything
s: From [G2741](G2741); a *glare:* - (burning) heat.

d:
**1.** to mark by branding, to brand, branded with their own consciences
  **a.** whose souls are branded with the marks of sin
  **b.** who carry about with them the perpetual consciousness of sin
**2.** seared
**3.** in a medical sense, to cauterise, remover by cautery
s: From a derivative of [G2545](G2545); to *brand* (“cauterize”), that is, (by implication) to *render* *unsensitive* (figuratively): - sear with a hot iron.

d:
**1.** to glory (whether with reason or without)
**2.** to glory on account of a thing
**3.** to glory in a thing
s: From some (obsolete) base akin to that of αὐχέω aucheō (to *boast*) and [G2172](G2172); to *vaunt* (in a good or a bad sense): - (make) boast, glory, joy, rejoice.
o: from some (obsolete) base akin to that of aucheo (to boast) and [G2172](G2172)

d:
**1.** that of which one glories or can glory, matter or ground of glorying
**2.** a glorying or boasting
s: From [G2744](G2744); a *boast* (properly the objective; by implication the act) in a good or bad sense: - boasting, (whereof) to glory (of), glorying, rejoice (-ing).

d: **1.** the act of glorying
s: From [G2744](G2744); *boasting* (properly the act; by implication the objective), in a good or a bad sense: - boasting, whereof I may glory, glorifying, rejoicing.

d:
Cenchrea = millet
**1.** the eastern harbour of Corinth (i.e. its harbour on the Saronic Gulf) and the emporium of its trade with the Asiatic shores of the mediterranean, as Lechaeum on the Corinthian Gulf connected it with Italy and the west
s: Probably from κέγχρος kegchros (*millet*); *Cenchreae*, a port of Corinth: - Cenchrea.

d:
Cedron or Kidron = turbid
**1.** the name of a winter torrent, rising near Jerusalem and flowing down through a valley of Kidron, having the Mount of Olives on the east, into the Dead Sea
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H6939](H6939)\]; *Cedron* (that is, *Kidron*), a brook near Jerusalem: - Cedron.

d:
**1.** to lie
  **a.** of an infant
  **b.** of one buried
  **c.** of things that quietly cover some spot
    **1.** of a city situated on a hill
  **d.** of things put or set in any place, in ref. to which we often use to stand
    **1.** of vessels, of a throne, of the site of a city, of grain and other things laid up together, of a foundation
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to be (by God’s intent) set, i.e. destined, appointed
  **b.** of laws, to be made, laid down
  **c.** lies in the power of the evil one, i.e. is held in subjection by the devil
s: Middle voice of a primary verb; to *lie* outstretched (literally or figuratively): - be (appointed, laid up, made, set), lay, lie. Compare [G5087](G5087).
o: middle voice of a primary verb

d: **1.** a band, either for bed-girth, or for tying up a corpse after it has been swathed in linen
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *swathe*, that is, *winding* *sheet:* - graveclothes.

d:
**1.** to sheer: a sheep
**2.** to get or let be shorn
**3.** of shearing or cutting short the hair of the head
s: A primary verb; to *shear:* - shear (-er).

d: **1.** an order, command, spec. a stimulating cry, either that by which animals are roused and urged on by man, as horses by charioteers, hounds by hunters, etc., or that by which a signal is given to men, e.g. to rowers by the master of a ship, to soldiers by a commander (with a loud summons, a trumpet call)
s: From [G2753](G2753); a *cry* of incitement: - shout.

d: **1.** to command, to order
s: From a primary word κέλλω kellō (to *urge* on); “hail”; to *incite* by word, that is, *order:* - bid, (at, give) command (-ment).
o: from a primary kello (to urge on)

d:
**1.** vain glory, groundless, self esteem, empty pride
**2.** a vain opinion, error
s: From [G2755](G2755); *empty* *glorying*, that is, *self* *conceit:* - vain-glory.

d: **1.** glorying without reason, conceited, vain glorious, eager for empty glory
s: From [G2756](G2756) and [G1391](G1391); *vainly* *glorifying*, that is, *self* *conceited:* - desirous of vain-glory.

d:
**1.** empty, vain, devoid of truth
  **a.** of places, vessels, etc. which contain nothing
  **b.** of men
    **1.** empty handed
    **2.** without a gift
  **c.** metaph. destitute of spiritual wealth, of one who boasts of his faith as a transcendent possession, yet is without the fruits of faith
  **d.** metaph. of endeavours, labours, acts, which result in nothing, vain, fruitless, without effect
    **1.** vain of no purpose
s: Apparently a primary word; *empty* (literally or figuratively): - empty, (in) vain.

d: **1.** empty discussion, discussion of vain and useless matters
s: From a presumed compound of [G2756](G2756) and [G5456](G5456); *empty* *sounding*, that is, *fruitless* *discussion:* - vain.
o: from a presumed compound of [G2756](G2756) and [G5456](G5456)

d:
**1.** to empty, make empty
  **a.** of christ, he laid aside equality with or the form of God
**2.** to make void
  **a.** deprive of force, render vain, useless, of no effect
**3.** to make void
  **a.** cause a thing to be seen to be empty, hollow, false
s: From [G2756](G2756); to *make* *empty*, that is, (figuratively) to *abase*, *neutralize*, *falsify:* - make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain.

d:
**1.** a sting, as that of bees, scorpions, locusts. Since animals wound by their sting and even cause death, Paul attributes death, personified as a sting, i.e. a deadly weapon
**2.** an iron goad, for urging on oxen, horses and other beasts of burden
  **a.** hence the proverb, to kick against the goad, i.e. to offer vain and perilous or ruinous resistance
s: From κεντέω kenteō (to *prick*); a *point* (“centre”), that is, a *sting* (figuratively *poison*) or *goad* (figuratively divine *impulse*): - prick, sting.

d: **1.** centurion, an officer in the Roman army
s: Of Latin origin; a *centurion*, that is, *captain* of one hundred soldiers: - centurion.

d: **1.** vainly, in vain
s: Adverb from [G2756](G2756); *vainly*, that is, *to* *no* *purpose:* - in vain.

d:
**1.** a little horn
**2.** extremity, apex, point
  **a.** used by grammarians of the accents and diacritical points. Jesus used it of the little lines or projections, by which the hebrew letters in other respects similar differ from one another; the meaning is, not even the minutest part of the law shall perish.
s: Feminine of a presumed derivative of the base of [G2768](G2768); something *horn* *like*, that is, (specifically) the *apex* of a Hebrew letter (figuratively the least *particle*): - tittle.
o: from a presumed derivative of the base of [G2768](G2768)

d: **1.** a potter
s: From [G2766](G2766); a *potter:* - potter.

d:
**1.** of or belonging to a potter
**2.** made of clay, earthen
s: From [G2766](G2766); *made* *of* *clay*, that is, *earthen:* - of a potter.

d:
**1.** an earthen vessel, a pot, jar
**2.** a jug or pitcher
**3.** a water pitcher
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G2766](G2766); an *earthenware* vessel, that is, *jar:* - pitcher.

d:
**1.** clay, potter’s earth
**2.** anything made of clay, earthen ware
**3.** a roofing tile
  **a.** the roof itself
  **b.** the phrase through the roof, means through the door in the roof to which a ladder or stairway led up from the street (according to the Rabbis distinguish two ways of entering a house, the way through the door and the way through the roof
s: Probably from the base of [G2767](G2767) (through the idea of *mixing* clay and water); *earthenware*, that is, a *tile* (by analogy a thin *roof* or *awning*): - tiling.
o: probably from the base of [G2767](G2767) (through the idea of mixing clay and water)

d:
**1.** to mix, mingle
**2.** to mix wine, water
**3.** to pour out for drinking.
s: A prolonged form of a more primary word κεράω keraō (which is used in certain tenses); to *mingle*, that is, (by implication) to *pour* out (for drinking): - fill, pour out. Compare [G3396](G3396).
o: a prolonged form of a more primary kerao ker-ah’-o (which is used in certain tenses)

d:
**1.** a horn
  **a.** of animals
  **b.** since animals (esp. bulls) defend themselves with their horns, the horn with the hebrews (and other nations) is a symbol of strength and courage, and used as such in a variety of phrases
    **1.** a mighty and valiant helper, the author of deliverance, of the messiah
  **c.** a projecting extremity in a shape like a horn, a point, apex: as of an altar
s: From a primary word κάρ kar (the *hair* of the head); a *horn* (literally or figuratively): - horn.
o: from a primary kar (the hair of the head)

d:
**1.** a little horn
**2.** the name of the fruit, Ceratonia silqua or carobtree (called also John’s bread \[from the notion that its pods, which resemble those of the locust, constituted the food of the Baptist\]. This fruit was shaped like a horn and has a sweet taste; it was and is used not only for fattening swine, but as an article of food by the lower classes.
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G2768](G2768); something *horned*, that is, (specifically) the *pod* of the carob tree: - husk.

d:
**1.** to gain, acquire, to get gain
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** of gain arising from shunning or escaping from evil (where we say to spare one’s self, be spared)
  **b.** to gain any one i.e. to win him over to the kingdom of God, to gain one to faith in christ
  **c.** to gain christ’s favour and fellowship
s: From [G2771](G2771); to *gain* (literally or figuratively): - (get) gain, win.

d: **1.** gain, advantage
s: Of uncertain affinity; *gain* (pecuniary or generally): - gain, lucre.

d: **1.** small pieces of money, small coin, change, money
s: From [G2751](G2751); a *clipping* (*bit*), that is, (specifically) a *coin:* - money.

d: **1.** a money changer, money broker
s: From a derivative of [G2772](G2772); a *handler* *of* *coins*, that is, *money* *broker:* - changer of money.

d:
**1.** the chief or main point, the principal thing
**2.** the pecuniary sum total of a reckoning, amount
  **a.** the principal, capital, as distinguished from the interest
  **b.** a sum of money, sum
s: Neuter of a derivative of [G2776](G2776); a *principal* thing, that is, *main* *point*; specifically an *amount* (of money): - sum.

d:
**1.** to bring under headings, to sum up, to summarise
**2.** to smite or wound in the head, to smite on the cheek
s: From the same as [G2774](G2774); (specifically) to *strike* *on* *the* *head:* - wound in the head.

d:
**1.** the head, both of men and often of animals. Since the loss of the head destroys life, this word is used in the phrases relating to capital and extreme punishment.
**2.** metaph. anything supreme, chief, prominent
  **a.** of persons, master Lord: of a husband in relation to his wife
  **b.** of christ: the Lord of the husband and of the Church
  **c.** of things: the corner stone
s: Probably from the primary wordκάπτω kaptō (in the sense of *seizing*); the *head* (as the part most readily *taken* hold of), literally or figuratively: - head.
o: from the primary kapto (in the sense of seizing)

d:
**1.** a little head
**2.** the highest part, extremity of anything
  **a.** as the capital of a column
  **b.** the tips or knobs of the wooden rod around which parchments were rolled were called by this word, because they resembled little heads
**3.** the Alexandrian writers transferred the name to the roll or volume itself
  **a.** in the roll of the book
s: From [G2776](G2776); properly a *knob*, that is, (by implication) a *roll* (by extension from the *end* of a stick on which the *manuscript* was rolled): - volume.

d:
**1.** census (among the Romans, denoting a register and valuation of property in accordance with which taxes were paid), in the NT the tax or tribute levied on individuals and to be paid yearly. (our capitation or poll tax)
**2.** the coin with which the tax is paid, tribute money
s: Of Latin origin; properly an *enrolment* (“census”), that is, (by implication) a *tax:* - tribute.

d: **1.** a garden
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *garden:* - garden.

d: **1.** a keeper of a garden, a gardener
s: From [G2779](G2779) and οὖρος ouros (a *warden*); a *garden* *keeper*, that is, *gardener:* - gardener.

d: **1.** honeycomb
s: Diminutive from κηός kēos (*wax*); a *cell* for honey, that is, (collectively) the *comb:* - \[honey-\] comb.

d:
**1.** that which is proclaimed by a herald or public crier, a proclamation by herald
**2.** in the NT the message or proclamation of the heralds of God or christ
s: From [G2784](G2784); a *proclamation* (especially of the gospel; by implication the *gospel* itself): - preaching.

d: **1.** a herald or messenger vested with public authority, who conveyed the official messages of kings, magistrates, princes, military commanders, or who gave a public summons or demand, and performed various other duties. In the NT God’s ambassador, and the herald or proclaimer of the divine word.
s: From [G2784](G2784); a *herald*, that is, of divine truth (especially of the gospel): - preacher.

d:
**1.** to be a herald, to officiate as a herald
  **a.** to proclaim after the manner of a herald
  **b.** always with the suggestion of formality, gravity and an authority which must be listened to and obeyed
**2.** to publish, proclaim openly: something which has been done
**3.** used of the public proclamation of the gospel and matters pertaining to it, made by John the Baptist, by Jesus, by the apostles and other Christian teachers
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *herald* (as a public *crier*), especially divine truth (the gospel): - preach (-er), proclaim, publish.

d: **1.** a sea monster, whale, huge fish
s: Probably from the base of [G5490](G5490); a huge *fish* (as *gaping* for prey): - whale.

d:
Cephas = stone
**1.** another name for the apostle Peter
s: Of Chaldee origin (compare \[[H3710](H3710)\]); *the* *Rock*; *Cephas* (that is, *Kepha*), surname of Peter: - Cephas.

d:
**1.** a wooden chest or box
**2.** in the NT the ark of the covenant, in the temple at Jerusalem
**3.** of Noah’s vessel built in the form of an ark
s: Of uncertain derivative; a *box*, that is, the sacred *ark* and that of Noah: - ark.

d: **1.** a harp to which praises of God are sung in heaven
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *lyre:* - harp.

d: **1.** to play upon the harp
s: From [G2788](G2788); to *play* *on* *a* *lyre:* - harp.

d: **1.** a harper, one who plays the harp and accompanies it with his voice
s: From [G2788](G2788) and a derivative of the same as [G5603](G5603); a *lyre* *singer* (*player*), that is, *harpist:* - harper.
o: from [G2788](G2788) and a derivative of the same as [G5603](G5603)

d:
Cilicia = the land of Celix
**1.** a maritime province in the southeast of Asia Minor, boarding on Pamphylia in the west, Lycaonia and Cappadocia in the north and Syria in the east. Its capital, Tarsus, was the birth place of Paul
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Cilicia*, a region of Asia Minor: - Cilicia.

d: **1.** cinnamon was a well known aromatic substance, the rind of Laurus cinnamonum called Korunda-gauhah in Ceylon
s: Of foreign origin (compare \[[H7076](H7076)\]); *cinnamon:* - cinnamon.

d: **1.** to be in jeopardy, to be in danger, to put in peril
s: From [G2794](G2794); to *undergo* *peril:* - be in danger, be (stand) in jeopardy.

d: **1.** a danger, a peril
s: Of uncertain derivation; *danger:* - peril.

d:
**1.** to cause to go, i.e. to move, set in motion
  **a.** to be moved, move: of that motion which is evident in life
  **b.** to move from a place, to remove
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to move excite
  **b.** a riot, disturbance
  **c.** to throw into commotion
s: From κίω kiō (poetic for \[εἶμι eimi to *go*\]); to *stir* (transitively), literally or figuratively: - (re-) move (-r), way.
o: from kio (poetic for eimi, to go)

d: **1.** a moving, agitation
s: From [G2795](G2795); a *stirring:* - moving.

d:
Kish = a snare
**1.** the father of Saul, the first king of Israel
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H7027](H7027)\]); *Cis* (that is, *Kish*), an Israelite: - Cis.

d:
**1.** a young tender shoot, broken off for grafting
**2.** a branch
  **a.** as the Jewish patriarchs are likened to a root, so their posterity are likened to branches
s: From [G2806](G2806); a *twig* or *bough* (as if broken off): - branch.

d:
**1.** to mourn, weep, lament
  **a.** weeping as the sign of pain and grief for the thing signified (i.e. for the pain and grief)
  **b.** of those who mourn for the dead
**2.** to weep for, mourn for, bewail, one
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *sob*, that is, *wail* aloud (whereas [G1145](G1145) is rather to *cry* silently): - bewail. weep.

d: **1.** a breaking
s: From [G2806](G2806); *fracture* (the act): - breaking.

d:
**1.** a fragment, broken piece
  **a.** remnants of food
s: From [G2806](G2806); a *piece* (*bit*): - broken, fragment.

d:
Clauda = lame
**1.** a small island nearly due west of Cape Malta on the south coast of Crete, and nearly due south of Phoenice
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Claude*, an island near Crete: - Clauda.

d:
Claudia = lame
**1.** a Christian woman
s: Feminine of [G2804](G2804); *Claudia*, a Christian woman: - Claudia.

d:
Claudius = lame
**1.** C. Caesar the name of the fourth Roman emperor, who came to power in 41 A.D. and was poisoned by his wife Agrippina, in 54 A.D.
**2.** C. Lysias a tribune of the Roman cohort who rescued Paul from the hands of the mob at Jerusalem
s: Of Latin origin; *Claudius*, the name of two Romans: - Claudius.

d: **1.** weeping, lamentation
s: From [G2799](G2799); *lamentation:* - wailing, weeping, X wept.

d:
**1.** to break
  **a.** used in the NT of the breaking of bread or communion
s: A primary verb; to *break* (specifically of bread): - break.

d:
**1.** a key
  **a.** since the keeper of the keys has the power to open and to shut
  **b.** metaph. in the NT to denote power and authority of various kinds
s: From [G2808](G2808); a *key* (as *shutting* a lock), literally or figuratively: - key.

d:
**1.** to shut, shut up
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to cause the heavens to withhold rain
  **b.** to shut up compassion so that it is like a thing inaccessible to one, to be devoid of pity towards one
  **c.** to obstruct the entrance into the kingdom of heaven
s: A primary verb; to *close* (literally or figuratively): - shut (up).

d:
**1.** thing stolen
**2.** the act of theft
s: From [G2813](G2813); *stealing* (properly the thing stolen, but used of the act): - theft.

d:
Cleopas = of a renowned father
**1.** one of the two disciples who were going to Emmaus on the day of the resurrection
s: Probably contracted from Κλεόπατρος Kleopatros (compounded from [G2811](G2811) and [G3962](G3962)); *Cleopas*, a Christian: - Cleopas.
o: probably contracted from Kleopatros (compound of [G2811](G2811) and [G3962](G3962))

d:
**1.** rumour, report
**2.** glory, praise
s: From a shorter form of [G2564](G2564); *renown* (as if *being* *called*): - glory.

d:
**1.** an embezzler, pilferer
  **a.** the name is transferred to false teachers, who do not care to instruct men, but abuse their confidence for their own gain
s: From [G2813](G2813); a *stealer* (literally or figuratively): - thief. Compare [G3027](G3027).

d:
**1.** to steal
  **a.** to commit a theft
  **b.** take away by theft i.e take away by stealth
s: A primary verb; to *filch:* - steal.

d:
**1.** a tender and flexible branch
**2.** spec. the shoot or branch of a vine, a vine sprout
s: From [G2806](G2806); a *limb* or *shoot* (as if *broken* off): - branch.

d:
Clement = mild, merciful
**1.** a companion of Paul and apparently a member of the church of Philippi. According to tradition, he is identical with that Clement who was bishop of Rome towards the close of the first century.
s: Of Latin origin; *merciful*; *Clemes* (that is, *Clemens*), a Christian: - Clement.

d:
**1.** to receive a lot, receive by lot
  **a.** esp. to receive a part of an inheritance, receive as an inheritance, obtain by right of inheritance
  **b.** to be an heir, to inherit
**2.** to receive the portion assigned to one, receive an allotted portion, receive as one’s own or as a possession
**3.** to become partaker of, to obtain
s: From [G2818](G2818); to *be* an *heir* to (literally or figuratively): - be heir, (obtain by) inherit (-ance).

d:
**1.** an inheritance, property received (or to be received) by inheritance
**2.** what is given to one as a possession
  **a.** the eternal blessedness of the consummated kingdom of God which is to be expected after the visible return of christ
  **b.** the share which an individual will have in that eternal blessedness
s: From [G2818](G2818); *heirship*, that is, (concretely) a *patrimony* or (generally) a *possession:* - inheritance.

d:
**1.** one who receives by lot, an heir
  **a.** an heir
  **b.** in messianic usage, one who receives his allotted possession by right of sonship
**2.** one who has acquired or obtained the portion allotted to him
s: From [G2819](G2819) and the base of [G3551](G3551) (in its original sense of *partitioning*, that is, \[reflexively\] *getting* by apportionment); a *sharer* *by* *lot*, that is, an *inheritor* (literally or figuratively); by implication a *possessor:* - heir.
o: from [G2819](G2819) and the base of [G3551](G3551) (in its original sense of partitioning, i.e. \[reflexively\] getting by apportionment)

d:
**1.** an object used in casting or drawing lots, which was either a pebble, or a potsherd, or a bit of wood
  **a.** the lots of several persons concerned, inscribed with their names, were thrown together into a vase, which was then shaken, and he whose lot fell out first upon the ground was the one chosen
**2.** what is obtained by lot, allotted portion
  **a.** a portion of the ministry common to the apostles
  **b.** used of the part which one will have in eternal salvation
    **1.** of salvation itself
    **2.** the eternal salvation which God has assigned to the saints
  **c.** of persons
    **1.** those whose care and oversight has been assigned to one \[allotted charge\], used of Christian churches, the administration of which falls to the lot of presbyters
s: Probably from [G2806](G2806) (through the idea of using *bits* of wood, etc., for the purpose); a *die* (for drawing chances); by implication a *portion* (as if so secured); by extension an *acquisition* (especially a *patrimony*, figuratively): - heritage, inheritance, lot, part.
o: probably from [G2806](G2806) (through the idea of using bits of wood, etc., for the purpose)

d:
**1.** to cast lots, determine by lot
**2.** to choose by lot
**3.** to allot, assign by lot
  **a.** on to another as a possession
**4.** in NT: to make a lot, i.e. a heritage, private possession
s: From [G2819](G2819); to *allot*, that is, (figuratively) to *assign* (a privilege): - obtain an inheritance.

d:
**1.** a calling, calling to
**2.** a call, invitation
  **a.** to a feast
  **b.** of the divine invitation to embrace salvation of God
s: From a shorter form of [G2564](G2564); an *invitation* (figuratively): - calling.

d:
**1.** called, invited (to a banquet)
  **a.** invited (by God in the proclamation of the Gospel) to obtain eternal salvation in the kingdom through christ
  **b.** called to (the discharge of) some office
    **1.** divinely selected and appointed
s: From the same as [G2821](G2821); *invited*, that is, *appointed*, or (specifically) a *saint:* - called.

d:
**1.** a clibanus, a earthen vessel for baking bread. It was broader at the bottom than above at the orifice, and when sufficiently heated by a fire kindled within, the dough was baked by being spread upon the outside. \[but according to others, the dough was baked by being placed inside and the fire or coals outside, the vessel being perforated with small holes that the heat might better penetrate.
**2.** a furnace, oven
s: Of uncertain derivation; an earthen *pot* used for baking in: - oven.

d:
**1.** an inclination, slope, declivity
**2.** the \[supposed\] sloping of the earth from the equator towards the poles, a zone
**3.** a tract of land, a region
s: From [G2827](G2827); a *slope*, that is, (specifically) a “clime” or *tract* of country: - part, region.

d:
**1.** a small bed, a couch
**2.** a couch to recline on at meals
**3.** a couch on which a sick man is carried
s: From [G2827](G2827); a *couch* (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating): - bed, table.

d: **1.** a small bed, a couch
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G2825](G2825); a *pallet* or *little* *couch:* - bed.

d:
**1.** transitively
  **a.** to incline, bow
  **b.** to cause to fall back
  **c.** to recline
    **1.** in a place for repose
**2.** intransitively
  **a.** to incline one’s self
    **1.** of the declining of the day
s: A primary verb; to *slant* or *slope*, that is, *incline* or *recline* (literally or figuratively): - bow (down), be far spent, lay, turn to flight, wear away.

d:
**1.** a hut erected to pass the night in
**2.** a tent
**3.** anything to recline on
  **a.** a chair in which to lean back the head
  **b.** a reclining chair
**4.** a company reclining
  **a.** a row or party of persons reclining at meal
s: From a derivative of [G2827](G2827); properly *reclination*, that is, (concretely and specifically) a *party* at a meal: - company.

d: **1.** theft
s: From [G2813](G2813); *stealing:* - theft.

d: **1.** a dashing or surging wave, a surge, a violent agitation of the sea
s: From κλύζω kluzō (to *billow* or *dash* over); a *surge* of the sea (literally or figuratively): - raging, wave.
o: from kluzo (to billow or dash over)

d:
**1.** to be tossed by the waves
**2.** metaph. to be agitated (like the waves) mentally
s: Middle voice from [G2830](G2830); to *surge*, that is, (figuratively) to *fluctuate:* - toss to and fro.

d:
Cleophas = my exchanges
**1.** the father of James the less, the husband of Mary the sister of the mother of Jesus
s: Of Chaldee origin (corresponding to [G256](G256)); *Clopas*, an Israelite: - Clopas.

d:
**1.** to scratch, tickle, make to itch
**2.** to itch
**3.** desirous of hearing something pleasant
s: From a primary word κνάω knaō (to *scrape*); to *scratch*, that is, (by implication) to *tickle:* - X itching.

d:
Cnidus or Gnidus = nettled
**1.** a peninsula \[now Cape Crio\] and a city by the same name, situated at the extreme south west of the peninsula of Asia Minor, on a promontory now called Cape Crio, which projects between the islands of Cos and Rhodes
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Cnidus*, a place in Asia Minor: - Cnidus.

d: **1.** a quadrans (about the fourth part of an as); in the NT a coin equal to one half the Attic chalcus worth about 3/8 of a cent
s: Of Latin origin; a *quadrans*, that is, fourth part of an as: - farthing.

d:
**1.** the whole belly, the entire cavity
  **a.** the upper \[i.e. stomach\] and the lower belly are distinguished
**2.** the lower belly, the lower region, the receptacle of the excrement
**3.** the gullet
  **a.** to be given up to the pleasures of the palate, to gluttony
**4.** the womb, the place where the foetus is conceived and nourished until birth
  **a.** of the uterus of animals
**5.** the innermost part of a man, the soul, heart as the seat of thought, feeling, choice
s: From κοῖλος koilos (“hollow”); a *cavity*, that is, (specifically) the *abdomen*; by implication the *matrix*; figuratively the *heart:* - belly, womb.

d:
**1.** to cause to sleep, put to sleep
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to still, calm, quiet
  **b.** to fall asleep, to sleep
  **c.** to die
s: From [G2749](G2749); to *put* *to* *sleep*, that is, (passively or reflexively) to *slumber*; figuratively to *decease:* - (be a-, fall a-, fall on) sleep, be dead.

d:
**1.** a reposing, taking rest
**2.** a lying, reclining
s: From [G2837](G2837); *sleeping*, that is, (by implication) *repose:* - taking of rest.

d:
**1.** common
**2.** common i.e. ordinary, belonging to generality
  **a.** by the Jews, unhallowed, profane, Levitically unclean
s: Probably from [G4862](G4862); *common*, that is, (literally) shared by all or several, or (ceremonially) *profane:* - common, defiled, unclean, unholy.

d:
**1.** to make common
  **a.** to make (Levitically) unclean, render unhallowed, defile, profane
  **b.** to declare or count unclean
s: From [G2839](G2839); to *make* (or *consider*) *profane* (ceremonially): - call common, defile, pollute, unclean.

d:
**1.** to come into communion or fellowship with, to become a sharer, be made a partner
**2.** to enter into fellowship, join one’s self to an associate, make one’s self a sharer or partner
s: From [G2844](G2844); to *share* with others (objectively or subjectively): - communicate, distribute, be partaker.

d:
**1.** fellowship, association, community, communion, joint participation, intercourse
  **a.** the share which one has in anything, participation
  **b.** intercourse, fellowship, intimacy
    **1.** the right hand as a sign and pledge of fellowship (in fulfilling the apostolic office)
  **c.** a gift jointly contributed, a collection, a contribution, as exhibiting an embodiment and proof of fellowship
s: From [G2844](G2844); *partnership*, that is, (literally) *participation*, or (social) *intercourse*, or (pecuniary) *benefaction:* - (to) communicate (-ation), communion, (contri-), distribution, fellowship.

d:
**1.** social, sociable, ready and apt to form and maintain communion and fellowship
**2.** inclined to make others sharers in one’s possessions, inclined to impart, free in giving, liberal
s: From [G2844](G2844); *communicative*, that is, (pecuniarily) *liberal:* - willing to communicate.

d:
**1.** a partner, associate, comrade, companion
**2.** a partner, sharer, in anything
  **a.** of the altar in Jerusalem on which the sacrifices are offered
    **1.** sharing in the worship of the Jews
  **b.** partakers of (or with) demons
    **1.** brought into fellowship with them, because they are the authors of heathen worship
s: From [G2839](G2839); a *sharer*, that is, *associate:* - companion, X fellowship, partaker, partner.

d:
**1.** a place for laying down, resting, sleeping in
  **a.** a bed, couch
**2.** the marriage bed
  **a.** of adultery
**3.** cohabitation, whether lawful or unlawful
  **a.** sexual intercourse
s: From [G2749](G2749); a *couch*; by extension *cohabitation*; by implication the male *sperm:* - bed, chambering, X conceive.

d:
**1.** a sleeping room, bed chamber
  **a.** the officer who is over the bed chamber, the chamberlain
s: From [G2845](G2845); a *bed* *room:* - + chamberlain.

d:
**1.** crimson, scarlet coloured. A kernel, the grain or berry of the ilex coccifera; these berries are the clusters of the eggs of a female insect, the kermes (resembling the cochineal), and when collected and pulverised produces a red which was used in dyeing (Pliny)
**2.** scarlet cloth or clothing
s: From [G2848](G2848) (from the *kernel* shape of the insect); *crimson* colored: - scarlet (colour, coloured).
o: from [G2848](G2848) (from the kernel-shape of the insect)

d: **1.** a grain
s: Apparently a primary word; a *kernel* of seed: - corn, grain.

d:
**1.** to lop or prune, as trees and wings
**2.** to curb, check, restrain
**3.** to chastise, correct, punishment
**4.** to cause to be punished
s: From κόλος kolos (*dwarf*); properly to *curtail*, that is, (figuratively) to *chastise* (or *reserve* for infliction): - punish.

d: **1.** flattery, flattering discourse
s: From a derivative of κόλαξ kolax (a *fawner*); *flattery:* - X flattering.
o: from a derivative of kolax (a fawner)

d: **1.** correction, punishment, penalty
s: From [G2849](G2849); penal *infliction:* - punishment, torment.

d:
**1.** to strike with the fist, give one a blow with the fist
**2.** to maltreat, treat with violence and contumely
s: From a derivative of the base of [G2849](G2849); to *rap* with the fist: - buffet.
o: from a derivative of the base of [G2849](G2849)

d:
**1.** to glue, to glue together, cement, fasten together
**2.** to join or fasten firmly together
**3.** to join one’s self to, cleave to
s: From κόλλα kolla (“glue”); to *glue*, that is, (passively or reflexively) to *stick* (figuratively): - cleave, join (self), keep company.

d: **1.** a preparation composed of various materials and used as a remedy for tender eyelids
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of κολλύρα kollura (a *cake*; probably akin to the base of [G2853](G2853)); properly a *poultice* (as made of or in the form of *crackers*), that is, (by analogy) a *plaster:* - eyesalve.
o: from a presumed derivative of kollura (a cake - prob akin to the base of [G2853](G2853))

d: **1.** a money-changer, banker
s: From a presumed derivative of κόλλυβος kollubos (a small *coin*; probably akin to [G2854](G2854)); a *coin* *dealer:* - (money-) changer.
o: from a presumed derivative of kollubos (a small coin - probably akin to [G2854](G2854))

d:
**1.** to mutilate
**2.** in NT: to shorten, abridge, curtail
s: From a derivative of the base of [G2849](G2849); to *dock*, that is, (figuratively) *abridge:* - shorten.
o: from a derivative of the base of [G2849](G2849)

d:
Colosse = monstrosities
**1.** anciently a large and flourishing city, but in Strabo’s time a small town of Phrygia Major situated on the Lycus not far from its junction with the Maeander and in the neighbourhood of Laodicea and Hierapolis
s: Apparently feminine plural of κολοσσός kolossos (“colossal”); *Colossae*, a place in Asia Minor: - Colosse.

d: **1.** a Colossian
s: From [G2857](G2857); a *Colossaean*, that is, inhabitant of Colossae: - Colossian.

d:
**1.** the front of the body between the arms
**2.** the bosom of a garment, i.e. the hollow formed by the upper forepart of a rather loose garment bound by a girdle or sash, used for keeping and carrying things (the fold or pocket)
**3.** a bay of the sea
s: Apparently a primary word; the *bosom*; by analogy a *bay:* - bosom, creek.

d: **1.** to dive, to swim
s: From κολυμβος kolumbos (a *diver*); to *plunge* into water: - swim.

d: **1.** a place for diving, a swimming hole, a reservoir or pool for bathing
s: From [G2860](G2860); a *diving* *place*, that is, *pond* for bathing (or swimming): - pool.

d:
**1.** a colony
  **a.** the city of Philippi is so called, where Octavius had planted a Roman colony
s: Of Latin origin; a Roman “colony” for veterans: - colony.

d: **1.** to let the hair grow, have long hair
s: From [G2864](G2864); to *wear* *tresses* of hair: - have long hair.

d: **1.** hair, head of hair
s: Apparently from the same as [G2865](G2865); the *hair* of the head (*locks*, as *ornamental*, and thus differing from [G2359](G2359), which properly denotes merely the *scalp*): - hair.

d:
**1.** to care for, take care of, provide for
**2.** to take up or carry away in order to care for and preserve
**3.** to carry away, bear off
**4.** to carry, bear, bring to, to carry away for one’s self, to carry off what is one’s own, to bring back
  **a.** to receive, obtain: the promised blessing
  **b.** to receive what was previously one’s own, to get back, receive back, recover
s: From a primary word κολυμβος kolumbos (to *tend*, that is, take care of); properly to *provide* for, that is, (by implication) to *carry* off (as if from harm; generally *obtain*): - bring, receive.
o: from a primary komeo (to tend, i.e. take care of)

d: **1.** more finely, better
s: Neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of [G2865](G2865) (meaning properly *well* *dressed*, that is, *nice*); figuratively *convalescent:* - + began to amend.
o: neuter comparative of a derivative of the base of [G2865](G2865) (meaning properly, well dressed, i.e. nice)

d:
**1.** to cover with lime, plaster over, whitewash
  **a.** the Jews were accustomed to whitewash the entrances to their sepulchres, as a warning against defilement by touching them
  **b.** term applied to a hypocrite who conceals his malice under an outward assumption of piety
s: Fromκονία konia (*dust*; by analogy *lime*); to *whitewash:* - whiten.

d:
**1.** raised dust, flying dust
**2.** dust
s: From the base of [G2867](G2867) and ὄρνυμι ornumi (to “rouse”); *pulverulence* (as *blown* about): - dust.
o: from the base of [G2867](G2867) and ornumi (to rouse)

d:
**1.** to grow weary or tired
**2.** to cease from violence, cease raging
s: From [G2873](G2873); to *tire*, that is, (figuratively) to *relax:* - cease.

d: **1.** lamentation with beating of the breast as a sign of grief
s: From [G2875](G2875); *mourning* (properly by *beating* the breast): - lamentation.

d:
**1.** the act of cutting, a cut
**2.** a cutting in pieces, slaughter
s: From [G2875](G2875); *cutting*, that is, *carnage:* - slaughter.

d:
**1.** to grow weary, tired, exhausted (with toil or burdens or grief)
**2.** to labour with wearisome effort, to toil
  **a.** of bodily labour
s: From a derivative of [G2873](G2873); to *feel* *fatigue*; by implication to *work* *hard:* - (bestow) labour, toil, be wearied.

d:
**1.** a beating
**2.** a beating of the breast with grief, sorrow
**3.** labour
  **a.** trouble
    **1.** to cause one trouble, make work for him
  **b.** intense labour united with trouble and toil
s: From [G2875](G2875); a *cut*, that is, (by analogy) *toil* (as *reducing* the strength), literally or figuratively; by implication *pains:* - labour, + trouble, weariness.

d: **1.** dung, manure
s: From κόπρος kopros (*ordure*; perhaps akin to [G2875](G2875)); *manure:* - dung (-hill).

d:
**1.** to cut, strike, smite
**2.** to cut from, cut off
**3.** to beat one’s breast for grief
s: A primary verb; to “chop”; specifically to *beat* the breast in grief: - cut down, lament, mourn, (be-) wail. Compare the base of [G5114](G5114).

d: **1.** a raven
s: Perhaps from [G2880](G2880); a *crow* (from its *voracity*): - raven.

d: **1.** a girl, damsel, maiden
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of κόρη korē (a *maiden*); a (little) *girl:* - damsel, maid.
o: from a presumed derivative of kore (a maiden)

d:
**1.** a gift offered (or to be offered) to God
**2.** the sacred treasury
s: Of Hebrew and Chaldee origin respectively \[[H7133](H7133)\]; a votive *offering* and *the* *offering*; a *consecrated* *present* (to the Temple fund); by extension (the latter term) the *Treasury* itself, that is, the room where the contribution boxes stood: - Corban, treasury.
o: of hebrew and Aramaic origin respectively [G7133](G7133)

d:
Korah = baldness
**1.** a man who, with others, rebelled against Moses
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H7141](H7141)\]; *Core* (that is, *Korach*), an Israelite: - Core.

d: **1.** to satiate, sate, satisfy
s: A primary verb; to *cram*, that is, *glut* or *sate:* - eat enough, full.

d: **1.** a Corinthian, and inhabitant of Corinth
s: From [G2882](G2882); a *Corinthian*, that is, inhabitant of Corinth: - Corinthian.

d:
Corinth = satiated
**1.** an ancient and famous city of Greece, on the Isthmus of Corinth, and about 40 miles (65 km) west of Athens
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Corinthus*, a city of Greece: - Corinth.

d:
Cornelius = of a horn
**1.** a Roman centurion of the Italian cohort stationed in Caesarea who converted to Christianity
s: Of Latin original; *Cornelius*, a Roman: - Cornelius.

d: **1.** a corus or cor, the largest hebrew dry measure (i.e, for wheat, meal etc.) about 10 to 11 bushels (350 to 400 l)
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3734](H3734)\]; a *cor*, that is, a specific measure: - measure.

d:
**1.** to put in order, arrange, make ready, prepare
**2.** to ornament, adore
**3.** metaph. to embellish with honour, gain honour
s: From [G2889](G2889); to *put* *in* proper *order*, that is, *decorate* (literally or figuratively); specifically to *snuff* (a wick): - adorn, garnish, trim.

d:
**1.** of or belonging to the world
  **a.** relating to the universe
  **b.** earthly
  **c.** worldly, i.e. having the character of this present corrupt age
s: From [G2889](G2889) (in its secondary sense); *terrene* (“cosmic”), literally (*mundane*) or figuratively (*corrupt*): - worldly.

d: **1.** well arranged, seemly, modest
s: From [G2889](G2889) (in its primary sense); *orderly*, that is, *decorous:* - of good behaviour, modest.

d:
**1.** lord of the world, prince of this age
  **a.** the devil and his demons
s: From [G2889](G2889) and [G2902](G2902); a *world* *ruler*, an epithet of Satan: - ruler.

d:
**1.** an apt and harmonious arrangement or constitution, order, government
**2.** ornament, decoration, adornment, i.e. the arrangement of the stars, ’the heavenly hosts’, as the ornament of the heavens. 1Pe 3:3
**3.** the world, the universe
**4.** the circle of the earth, the earth
**5.** the inhabitants of the earth, men, the human family
**6.** the ungodly multitude; the whole mass of men alienated from God, and therefore hostile to the cause of christ
**7.** world affairs, the aggregate of things earthly
  **a.** the whole circle of earthly goods, endowments riches, advantages, pleasures, etc, which although hollow and frail and fleeting, stir desire, seduce from God and are obstacles to the cause of christ
**8.** any aggregate or general collection of particulars of any sort
  **a.** the Gentiles as contrasted to the Jews (Rom 11:12 etc)
  **b.** of believers only, Joh 1:29; Joh 3:16; Joh 3:17; Joh 6:33; Joh 12:47 1Co 4:9; 2Co 5:19
s: Probably from the base of [G2865](G2865); orderly *arrangement*, that is, *decoration*; by implication the *world* (in a wide or narrow sense, including its inhabitants, literally or figuratively \[morally\]): - adorning, world.

d:
Quartus = fourth
**1.** a Roman; probably before he lived at Rome, and therefore sends his salutations to the Christians there: he is mentioned among the seventy disciples, and said to be bishop of Berytus. (Gill)
s: Of Latin origin (*fourth*); *Quartus*, a Christian: - Quartus.

d: **1.** arise
s: Of Chaldee origin \[[H6966](H6966)\]; *cumi* (that is, *rise!*): - cumi.

d: **1.** guard: used of Roman soldiers guarding the sepulchre of christ
s: Of Latin origin; “custody”, that is, a Roman *sentry:* - watch.

d:
**1.** to be light
**2.** to lighten
  **a.** a ship by throwing the cargo overboard
s: From κοῦφος kouphos (*light* in weight); to *unload:* - lighten.

d: **1.** a basket, wicker basket
s: Of uncertain derivation; a (small) *basket:* - basket.

d: **1.** a pallet, camp bed (a rather simple bed holding only one person)
s: Probably of foreign origin; a *mattress:* - bed.

d:
**1.** to croak
  **a.** of the cry of a raven
  **b.** hence, to cry out, cry aloud, vociferate
  **c.** to cry or pray for vengeance
**2.** to cry
  **a.** cry out aloud, speak with a loud voice
s: A primary verb; properly to “croak” (as a raven) or *scream*, that is, (generally) to *call* aloud (*shriek*, *exclaim*, *intreat*): - cry (out).

d: **1.** the giddiness and headache caused by drinking wine to excess
s: Probably from the same as [G726](G726); properly a *headache* (as a *seizure* of pain) from drunkenness, that is, (by implication) a *debauch* (by analogy a *glut*): - surfeiting.

d: **1.** a skull
s: Diminutive of a derivative of the base of [G2768](G2768); a *skull* (“cranium”): - Calvary, skull.
o: diminutive of a derivative of the base of [G2768](G2768)

d:
**1.** the extremity or prominent part of a thing, edge, skirt, margin
  **a.** the fringe of a garment
  **b.** in the NT a little appendage hanging down from the edge of the mantle or cloak, made of twisted wool
  **c.** a tassel, tuft: the Jews had such appendages attached to their mantles to remind them of the law
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *margin*, that is, (specifically) a *fringe* or *tassel:* -  border, hem.

d:
**1.** mighty
  **a.** of the mighty power of God
s: From [G2904](G2904); *powerful:* - mighty.

d:
**1.** to strengthen, make strong
**2.** to be made strong, to increase in strength, to grow strong
s: From [G2900](G2900); to *empower*, that is, (passively) *increase* *in* *vigor:* - be strenghtened, be (wax) strong.

d:
**1.** to have power, be powerful
  **a.** to be chief, be master of, to rule
**2.** to get possession of
  **a.** to become master of, to obtain
  **b.** to take hold of
  **c.** to take hold of, take, seize
    **1.** to lay hands on one in order to get him into one’s power
**3.** to hold
  **a.** to hold in the hand
  **b.** to hold fast, i.e. not discard or let go
    **1.** to keep carefully and faithfully
  **c.** to continue to hold, to retain
    **1.** of death continuing to hold one
    **2.** to hold in check, restrain
s: From [G2904](G2904); to *use* *strength*, that is, *seize* or *retain* (literally or figuratively): - hold (by, fast), keep, lay hand (hold) on, obtain, retain, take (by).

d:
**1.** mightiest, strongest, noblest, most illustrious, best, most excellent
  **a.** used in addressing men of prominent rank or office
s: Superlative of a derivative of [G2904](G2904); *strongest*, that is, (in dignity) *very* *honorable:* - most excellent (noble).

d:
**1.** force, strength
**2.** power, might: mighty with great power
  **a.** a mighty deed, a work of power
**3.** dominion
s: Perhaps a primary word; *vigor* \[“great”\], (literally or figuratively): - dominion, might \[-ily\], power, strength.

d: **1.** to cry out, cry aloud, to shout, to cry out to one
s: From [G2906](G2906); to *clamor:* - cry out.

d: **1.** a crying, outcry, clamour
s: From [G2896](G2896); an *outcry* (in notification, tumult or grief): - clamour, cry (-ing).

d: **1.** (the) flesh (of a sacrificed animal)
s: Perhaps a primary word; (butcher’s) *meat:* - flesh.

d: **1.** better
s: Neuter of an alternate form of [G2909](G2909); (as noun) *better*, that is, *greater* *advantage:* - better.
o: neuter of an alternate form of [G2909](G2909)

d:
**1.** more useful, more serviceable, more advantageous
**2.** more excellent
s: Comparative of a derivative of [G2904](G2904); *stronger*, that is, (figuratively) *better*, that is, *nobler:* - best, better.

d:
**1.** to hang up, suspend
**2.** to be suspended, to hang
  **a.** used of one hanging on a cross
  **b.** used of the Law and the Prophets, they is summed up or hanging on two precepts
s: A prolonged form of a primary verb; to *hang:* - hang.
o: a prolonged form of a primary verb

d: **1.** a steep place, a precipice
s: From [G2910](G2910); *overhanging*, that is, a *precipice:* - steep place.

d: **1.** a Cretan, an inhabitant of the island of Crete
s: From [G2914](G2914); a *Cretan*, that is, inhabitant of Crete: - Crete, Cretian.

d:
Crescens = growing
**1.** an assistant of Paul, said to be one of the seventy disciples
s: Of Latin origin; *growing*; *Cresces* (that is, *Crescens*), a Christian: - Crescens.

d:
Crete = fleshy
**1.** the largest and most fertile island of the mediterranean archipelago or Aegean Sea, now the modern Candia
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Crete*, an island in the Mediterranean: - Crete.

d: **1.** barley
s: Of uncertain derivation; *barley:* - barley.

d: **1.** of barley, made of barley
s: From [G2915](G2915); consisting *of* *barley:* - barley.

d:
**1.** a decree, judgments
**2.** judgment
  **a.** condemnation of wrong, the decision (whether severe or mild) which one passes on the faults of others
  **b.** in a forensic sense
    **1.** the sentence of a judge
    **2.** the punishment with which one is sentenced
    **3.** condemnatory sentence, penal judgment, sentence
**3.** a matter to be judicially decided, a lawsuit, a case in court
s: From [G2919](G2919); a *decision* (the function or the effect, for or against \[“crime”\]): - avenge, condemned, condemnation, damnation, + go to law, judgment.

d: **1.** a flower, the lily
s: Perhaps a primary word; a *lily:* - lily.

d:
**1.** to separate, put asunder, to pick out, select, choose
**2.** to approve, esteem, to prefer
**3.** to be of opinion, deem, think, to be of opinion
**4.** to determine, resolve, decree
**5.** to judge
  **a.** to pronounce an opinion concerning right and wrong
    **1.** to be judged, i.e. summoned to trial that one’s case may be examined and judgment passed upon it
  **b.** to pronounce judgment, to subject to censure
    **1.** of those who act the part of judges or arbiters in matters of common life, or pass judgment on the deeds and words of others
**6.** to rule, govern
  **a.** to preside over with the power of giving judicial decisions, because it was the prerogative of kings and rulers to pass judgment
**7.** to contend together, of warriors and combatants
  **a.** to dispute
  **b.** in a forensic sense
    **1.** to go to law, have suit at law
s: Properly to *distinguish*, that is, *decide* (mentally or judicially); by implication to *try*, *condemn*, *punish:* - avenge, conclude, condemn, damn, decree, determine, esteem, judge, go to (sue at the) law, ordain, call in question, sentence to, think.

d:
**1.** a separating, sundering, separation
  **a.** a trial, contest
**2.** selection
**3.** judgment
  **a.** opinion or decision given concerning anything
    **1.** esp. concerning justice and injustice, right or wrong
  **b.** sentence of condemnation, damnatory judgment, condemnation and punishment
**4.** the college of judges (a tribunal of seven men in the several cities of Palestine; as distinguished from the Sanhedrin, which had its seat at Jerusalem)
**5.** right, justice
s: (Subjectively or objectively, for or against); by extension a *tribunal*; by implication *justice* (specifically divine *law*): - accusation, condemnation, damnation, judgment.

d:
Crispus = curled
**1.** the ruler of the Jewish synagogue in Corinth, baptised by Paul
s: Of Latin origin; “crisp”; *Crispus*, a Corinthian: - Crispus.

d:
**1.** the instrument or means of trying or judging anything
  **a.** the rule by which one judges
**2.** the place where judgment is given
  **a.** the tribunal of a judge
  **b.** a bench of judges
**3.** the matter judged, thing to be decided, suit, case
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G2923](G2923); a *rule* of judging (“criterion”), that is, (by implication) a *tribunal:* - to judge, judgment (seat).

d:
**1.** one who passes or arrogates to himself, judgment on anything
  **a.** an arbiter
  **b.** of a Roman procurator administering justice
  **c.** of God passing judgment on men
  **d.** of the leaders or rulers of the Israelites
s: From [G2919](G2919); a *judge* (generally or specifically): - judge.

d: **1.** relating to judging, fit for judging, skilled in judging
s: From [G2923](G2923); *decisive* (“critical”), that is, *discriminative:* - discerner.

d: **1.** to knock: at the door
s: Apparently a primary verb; to *rap:* - knock.

d: **1.** crypt, a covered way, vault, cellar
s: Feminine of [G2927](G2927); a *hidden* place, that is, *cellar* (“crypt”): - secret.

d: **1.** hidden, concealed, secret
s: From [G2928](G2928); *concealed*, that is, *private:* - hid (-den), inward \[-ly\], secret.

d:
**1.** to hide, conceal, to be hid
**2.** escape notice
**3.** metaph. to conceal (that it may not become known)
s: A primary verb; to *conceal* (properly by *covering*): - hide (self), keep secret, secret \[-ly\].

d:
**1.** to be of crystalline brightness and transparency
**2.** to shine like crystal
s: From [G2930](G2930); to *make* (that is, intransitively *resemble*) *ice* (“crystallize”): - be clear as crystal.

d: **1.** crystal, a kind of precious stone
s: From a derivative of κρύος kruos (*frost*); *ice*, that is, (by analogy) rock “crystal”: - crystal.

d: **1.** secretly, in secret
s: Adverb from [G2928](G2928); *privately:* - in secret.

d:
**1.** to acquire, get, or procure a thing for one’s self, to possess
  **a.** to marry a wife
s: A primary verb; to *get*, that is, *acquire* (by any means; *own*): - obtain, possess, provide, purchase.

d:
**1.** a possession
  **a.** of property, lands, estates
s: From [G2932](G2932); an *acquirement*, that is, *estate:* - possession.

d:
**1.** a beast
  **a.** esp. a beast of burden
  **b.** used for four legged animals as opposed to fishes and birds
s: From [G2932](G2932); *property*, that is, (specifically) a domestic *animal:* - beast.

d: **1.** a possessor
s: From [G2932](G2932); an *owner:* - possessor.

d:
**1.** to make habitable, to people, a place, region, island
  **a.** to found a city, colony, state
**2.** to create
  **a.** of God creating the worlds
  **b.** to form, shape, i.e. to completely change or transform
s: Probably akin to [G2932](G2932) (through the idea of the *proprietorship* of the *manufacturer*); to *fabricate*, that is, *found* (*form* originally): - create, Creator, make.
o: probably akin to [G2932](G2932) (through the idea of proprietor-ship of the manufacturer)

d:
**1.** the act of founding, establishing, building etc
  **a.** the act of creating, creation
  **b.** creation i.e. thing created
    **1.** of individual things, beings, a creature, a creation
  **c.** anything created
  **d.** after a rabbinical usage (by which a man converted from idolatry to Judaism was called)
  **e.** the sum or aggregate of things created
  **f.** institution, ordinance
s: From [G2936](G2936); original *formation* (properly the act; by implication the thing, literally or figuratively): - building, creation, creature, ordinance.

d:
**1.** thing founded
**2.** created thing
s: From [G2936](G2936); an original *formation* (concretely), that is, *product* (created thing): - creature.

d:
**1.** a founder
**2.** a creator
s: From [G2936](G2936); a *founder*, that is, *God* (as author of all things): - Creator.

d:
**1.** dice playing
**2.** metaph. the deception of men, because dice players sometimes cheated and defrauded their fellow players
s: From κύβος kubos (a “cube”, that is, *die* for playing); *gambling*, that is, (figuratively) *artifice* or *fraud:* - sleight.
o: from kubos (a cube, i.e. die for playing)

d: **1.** a governing, government
s: From κυβερνάω kubernaō (of Latin origin, to *steer*); *pilotage*, that is, (figuratively) *directorship* (in the church): - government.
o: from kubernao (of Latin origin, to steer)

d: **1.** steersman, helmsman, sailing master
s: From the same as [G2941](G2941); *helmsman*, that is, (by implication) *captain:* - (ship) master.

d: **1.** round about, from all sides, all around
s: Adverb from the same as [G2945](G2945); *from* the *circle*, that is, *all* *around:* - (round) about.

d:
**1.** to go around, lead around
**2.** to surround, encircle, encompass
  **a.** of persons standing around
  **b.** of besiegers
s: From the same as [G2945](G2945); to *encircle*, that is, *surround:* - compass (about), come (stand) round about.

d: **1.** in a circle, around, round about, on all sides
s: As if dative case of κύκλος kuklos (a *ring*, “cycle”; akin to [G2947](G2947)); that is, *in* *a* *circle* (by implication of [G1722](G1722)), that is, (adverbially) *all* *around:* - round about.
o: as if dative case of kuklos (a ring, cycle - akin to [G2947](G2947))

d: **1.** thing rolled, rolled (wallowed) mud or mire
s: From [G2947](G2947); a *wallow* (the effect of *rolling*), that is, *filth:* - wallowing.

d:
**1.** a rolling, wallowing
**2.** to roll itself in mud
**3.** to wallowing in the mire
s: From the base of [G2949](G2949) (through the idea of *circularity*; compare [G2945](G2945) and [G1507](G1507)); to *roll* about: - wallow.
o: from base of [G2949](G2949) (through the idea of circularity, cf [G2945](G2945), [G1507](G1507))

d:
**1.** crooked
  **a.** of the members of the body
  **b.** injured, disabled
**2.** maimed, mutilated
s: From the same as [G2947](G2947); *rocking* about, that is, *crippled* (*maimed*, in feet or hands): - maimed.

d:
**1.** a wave (swell) esp. of the sea or of a lake
  **a.** of impulse and restless men, tossed to and fro by their raging passions
s: From κύω kuō (to *swell* \[with young\], that is, *bend*, *curve*); a *billow* (as *bursting* or *toppling*): - wave.
o: from kuo (to swell \[with young\], i.e bend, curve)

d: **1.** a cymbal, i.e. a hollow basin of brass, producing when struck together a musical sound
s: From a derivative of the base of [G2949](G2949); a “cymbal” (as *hollow*): - cymbal.
o: from a derivative of the base of [G2949](G2949)

d: **1.** cummin is a cultivated plant in Palestine with seeds that have a bitter warm taste and an aromatic flavour
s: Of foreign origin (compare \[[H3646](H3646)\]); *dill* or *fennel* (“cummin”): - cummin.

d: **1.** a little dog
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G2965](G2965); a *puppy:* - dog.

d: **1.** a Cyprian or Cypriote, i.e. a native of Cyprus
s: From [G2954](G2954); a *Cyprian* (*Cypriot*), that is, inhabitant of Cyprus: - of Cyprus.

d:
Cyprus = love: a blossom
**1.** a very fertile and delightful island of the mediterranean, lying between Cilicia and Syria
s: Of uncertain origin; *Cyprus*, an island in the Mediterranean: - Cyprus.

d: **1.** to stoop down, bend forward, to bow the head
s: Probably from the base of [G2949](G2949); to *bend* forward: - stoop (down).

d: **1.** a native of Cyrene
s: From [G2957](G2957); a *Cyrenaean*, that is, inhabitant of Cyrene: - of Cyrene, Cyrenian.

d:
Cyrene = supremacy of the bridle
**1.** a large and very flourishing city of Libya Cyrenaica or Pentapolitana, about 11 miles (17 km) from the sea. Among its inhabitants were a great number of Jews, whom Ptolemy I. had brought there, and invested with the right of citizens
s: Of uncertain derivation; *Cyrene*, a region of Africa: - Cyrene.

d:
Cyrenius = warrior
**1.** the Greek form of the Roman name Quirinus. His full name is Publius Sulpicius Quirinus. He was consul B.C. 12., and was made governor of Syria after the banishment of Archelaus in A.D. 6. He was probably twice governor of Syria; his first governorship extended from B.C. 4 (the year of christ’s birth) to B.C. 1. It was during this time that he was sent to make enrolment which caused Joseph and Mary to visit Bethlehem. Luk 2:2. The second enrolment is mentioned in Act 5:37.
s: Of Latin origin; *Cyrenius* (that is, *Quirinus*), a Roman: - Cyrenius.

d: **1.** a Christian woman to whom the second Epistle of John is addressed
s: Feminine of [G2962](G2962); *Cyria*, a Christian woman: - lady.

d:
**1.** belonging to the Lord
**2.** related to the Lord
s: From [G2962](G2962); *belonging* *to* the *Lord* (Jehovah or Jesus): - Lord’s.

d:
**1.** to be Lord of, to rule, have dominion over
**2.** of things and forces
  **a.** to exercise influence upon, to have power over
s: From [G2962](G2962); to *rule:* - have dominion over, lord, be lord of, exercise lordship over.

d:
**1.** he to whom a person or thing belongs, about which he has power of deciding; master, Lord
  **a.** the possessor and disposer of a thing
    **1.** the owner; one who has control of the person, the master
    **2.** in the state: the sovereign, prince, chief, the Roman emperor
  **b.** is a title of honour expressive of respect and reverence, with which servants greet their master
  **c.** this title is given to: God, the messiah
s: From κῦρος kuros (*supremacy*); *supreme* in authority, that is, (as noun) *controller*; by implication *Mr*. (as a respectful title): - God, Lord, master, Sir.

d:
**1.** dominion, power, Lordship
**2.** in the NT: one who possesses dominion
s: From [G2962](G2962); *mastery*, that is, (concretely and collectively) *rulers:* - dominion, government.

d:
**1.** to make valid
**2.** to confirm publicly or solemnly, to ratify
s: From the same as [G2962](G2962); to *make* *authoritative*, that is, *ratify:* - confirm.

d:
**1.** a dog
**2.** metaph. a man of impure mind, an impudent man
s: A primary word; a *dog* (“hound”), (literally or figuratively): - dog.

d:
**1.** a member of a body, particularly the more external and prominent members esp. the feet
**2.** a dead body, corpse, inasmuch as the members of a corpse are loose and fall apart
s: From the base of [G2849](G2849); a *limb* of the body (as if *lopped*): - carcase.

d:
**1.** to hinder, prevent forbid
**2.** to withhold a thing from anyone
**3.** to deny or refuse one a thing
s: From the base of [G2849](G2849); to *estop*, that is, *prevent* (by word or act): - forbid, hinder, keep from, let, not suffer, withstand.

d:
**1.** the common sleeping place to which labourers in the field return, a village
**2.** the name of the city near which the villages lie and to whose municipality they belong
**3.** the inhabitants of villages
s: From [G2749](G2749); a *hamlet* (as if *laid* down): - town, village.

d: **1.** a village approximating in size and number of inhabitants to a city, a village city, a town
s: From [G2968](G2968) and [G4172](G4172); an unwalled *city:* - town.

d:
**1.** a revel, carousal
  **a.** a nocturnal and riotous procession of half drunken and frolicsome fellows who after supper parade through the streets with torches and music in honour of Bacchus or some other deity, and sing and play before houses of male and female friends; hence used generally of feasts and drinking parties that are protracted till late at night and indulge in revelry
s: From [G2749](G2749); a *carousal* (as if a *letting* *loose*): - revelling, rioting.

d: **1.** a wine gnat or midge that is bred in fermenting and evaporating wine
s: Apparently from a derivative of the base of [G2759](G2759) and a derivative of [G3700](G3700); a *mosquito* (from its *stinging* *proboscis*): - gnat.
o: apparently a derivative of the base of [G2759](G2759) and a derivative of [G3700](G3700)

d: Coos = a public prison
s: Of uncertain origin; *Cos*, an island in the Mediterranean: - Cos.

d:
Cosam = divining
**1.** ancestor of christ’s
s: Of Hebrew origin (compare \[[H7081](H7081)\]); *Cosam* (that is, *Kosam*), an Israelite: - Cosam.

d:
**1.** blunted, dull
  **a.** blunted (or lamed) in tongue, dumb
  **b.** blunted, dull in hearing
  **c.** deaf
s: From [G2875](G2875); *blunted*, that is, (figuratively) of hearing (*deaf*) or speech (*dumb*): - deaf, dumb, speechless.

d:
**1.** to obtain by lot
  **a.** to receive by divine allotment, obtain
**2.** to cast lots, determine by lot
s: A prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses; to *lot*, that is, *determine* (by implication *receive*) especially by lot: - his lot be, cast lots, obtain.
o: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses

d:
Lazarus = whom God helps (a form of the hebrew name Eleazar)
**1.** an inhabitant of Bethany, beloved by christ and raised from the dead by him
**2.** a very poor and wretched person to whom Jesus referred to in Luk 16:20-25
s: Probably of Hebrew origin \[[H499](H499)\]; *Lazarus* (that is, *Elazar*), the name of two Israelites (one imaginary): - Lazarus.

d: **1.** secretly
s: Adverb from [G2990](G2990); *privately:* - privily, secretly.

d:
**1.** a whirlwind, a tempestuous wind
**2.** a violent attack of wind, a squall
  **a.** never a single gust nor a steady blowing wind, however violent, but a storm breaking forth from black thunder clouds in furious gusts, with floods of rain, and throwing everything topsy-turvy
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *whirlwind* (*squall*): - storm, tempest.

d: **1.** to kick, strike with the heel
s: From adverb λάξ lax (*heelwise*); to *recalcitrate:* - kick.

d:
**1.** to utter a voice or emit a sound
**2.** to speak
  **a.** to use the tongue or the faculty of speech
  **b.** to utter articulate sounds
**3.** to talk
**4.** to utter, tell
**5.** to use words in order to declare one’s mind and disclose one’s thoughts
  **a.** to speak
s: A prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb; to *talk*, that is, *utter* words: - preach, say, speak (after), talk, tell, utter. Compare [G3004](G3004).
o: a prolonged form of an otherwise obsolete verb

d:
**1.** speech, i.e a story
**2.** dialect, mode of speech, pronunciation
  **a.** speech which discloses the speaker’s native country
s: From [G2980](G2980); *talk:* - saying, speech.
Of Hebrew origin (\[[H4100](H4100)\] with preposition prefixed); *lama* (that is, *why*): - lama.

d:
**1.** to take
  **a.** to take with the hand, lay hold of, any person or thing in order to use it
    **1.** to take up a thing to be carried
    **2.** to take upon one’s self
  **b.** to take in order to carry away
    **1.** without the notion of violence, i,e to remove, take away
  **c.** to take what is one’s own, to take to one’s self, to make one’s own
    **1.** to claim, procure, for one’s self
  **d.** to associate with one’s self as companion, attendant
    **1.** of that which when taken is not let go, to seize, to lay hold of, apprehend
    **2.** to take by craft (our catch, used of hunters, fisherman, etc.), to circumvent one by fraud
    **3.** to take to one’s self, lay hold upon, take possession of, i.e. to appropriate to one’s self
    **4.** catch at, reach after, strive to obtain
    **5.** to take a thing due, to collect, gather (tribute)
  **e.** to take
    **1.** to admit, receive
    **2.** to receive what is offered
    **3.** not to refuse or reject
    **4.** to receive a person, give him access to one’s self,
**2.** to regard any one’s power, rank, external circumstances, and on that account to do some injustice or neglect something
  **a.** to take, to choose, select
  **b.** to take beginning, to prove anything, to make a trial of, to experience
**3.** to receive (what is given), to gain, get, obtain, to get back
s: A prolonged form of a primary verb, which is used only as an alternate in certain tenses; to *take* (in very many applications, literally and figuratively \[probably objective or active, to *get* *hold* of; whereas [G1209](G1209) is rather subjective or passive, to *have* *offered* to one; while [G138](G138) is more violent, to *seize* or *remove*\]): - accept, + be amazed, assay, attain, bring, X when I call, catch, come on (X unto), + forget, have, hold, obtain, receive (X after), take (away, up).
o: a prolonged form of a primary verb, which is use only as an alternate in certain tenses

d:
Lamech = why thus with thee?: unto bringing low
**1.** the father of Noah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3929](H3929)\]; *Lamech* (that is, *Lemek*), a patriarch: - Lamech.

d:
**1.** a torch
**2.** a lamp, the flame of which is fed with oil
s: From [G2989](G2989); a “lamp” or *flambeau:* - lamp, light, torch.

d:
**1.** shining
  **a.** brilliant
  **b.** clear, transparent
**2.** splendid, magnificent
  **a.** splendid things i.e. luxuries or elegancies in dress or style
s: From the same as [G2985](G2985); *radiant*; by analogy *limpid*; figuratively *magnificent* or *sumptuous* (in appearance): - bright, clear, gay, goodly, gorgeous, white.

d: **1.** brightness, brilliancy
s: From [G2896](G2896); *brilliancy:* - brightness.

d:
**1.** splendidly, magnificently
  **a.** of sumptuous living
s: Adverb from [G2986](G2986); *brilliantly*, that is, (figuratively) *luxuriously:* - sumptuously.

d: **1.** to shine
s: A primary verb; to *beam*, that is, *radiate* brilliancy (literally or figuratively): - give light, shine.

d: **1.** to be hidden, to be hidden from one, secretly, unawares, without knowing
s: A prolonged form of a primary verb, which is used only as an alternate in certain tenses; to *lie* *hid* (literally or figuratively); often used adverbially *unwittingly:* - be hid, be ignorant of, unawares.
o: a prolonged form of a primitive verb, which is used only as an alt. in certain tenses

d: **1.** cut out of stone
s: From a compound of λᾶς las (a *stone*) and the base of [G3584](G3584) (in its original sense of *scraping*); *rock* *quarried:* - hewn in stone.
o: from a compound of las (a stone) and the base of [G3584](G3584) (in its original sense of scraping)

d:
**1.** a people, people group, tribe, nation, all those who are of the same stock and language
**2.** of a great part of the population gathered together anywhere
s: Apparently a primary word; a *people* (in general; thus differing from [G1218](G1218), which denotes one’s *own* populace): - people.

d:
Laodicea = justice of the people
**1.** a city of Phrygia, situated on the river Lycus not far from Colosse. It was destroyed by an earthquake in 66 A.D. and rebuilt by Marcus Aurelius. It was the seat of the Christian church.
s: From a compound of [G2992](G2992) and [G1349](G1349); *Laodicia*, a place in Asia Minor: - Laodicea.

d: **1.** a Laodicean, an inhabitant of Laodicea
s: From [G2993](G2993); a *Laodicean*, that is, inhabitant of Laodicia: - Laodicean.

d:
**1.** the throat
  **a.** of the instrument or organ of speech
s: Of uncertain derivative; the *throat* (“larynx”): - throat.

d:
Lasea = shaggy
**1.** a city in Crete on the coast near Fair Havens
s: Of uncertain origin; *Lasaea*, a place in Crete: - Lasea.

d:
**1.** to crack, crackle, crash
**2.** to burst asunder with a crack, crack open
s: A strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as an alternate in certain tenses; to *crack* open (from a fall): - burst asunder.
o: a strengthened form of a primary verb, which only occurs in this and another prolonged form as alternate in certain tenses

d: **1.** to cut stones, to hew out stones
s: From the same as the first part of [G2991](G2991) and the base of [G5114](G5114); to *quarry:* - hew.
o: from the same as the first part of [G2991](G2991) and the base of [G5114](G5114)

d:
**1.** service rendered for hire
  **a.** any service or ministration: the service of God
**2.** the service and worship of God according to the requirements of the Levitical law
**3.** to perform sacred services
s: From [G3000](G3000); *ministration* of God, that is, *worship:* - (divine) service.

d:
**1.** to serve for hire
**2.** to serve, minister to, either to the Gods or men and used alike of slaves and freemen
  **a.** in the NT, to render religious service or homage, to worship
  **b.** to perform sacred services, to offer gifts, to worship God in the observance of the rites instituted for his worship
    **1.** of priests, to officiate, to discharge the sacred office
