s: From λάτρις latris (a hired *menial*); to *minister* (to God), that is, *render* religious *homage:* - serve, do the service, worship (-per).

d: **1.** any pot herb, vegetables
s: From λαχαίνω lachainō (to *dig*); a *vegetable:* - herb.

d:
Lebbaeus = a man of heart
**1.** one name of Jude, who was one of the twelve apostles
s: Of uncertain origin; *Lebbaeus*, a Christian: - Lebbus.

d: **1.** a legion, a body of soldiers whose number differed at different times, and in the time of Augustus seems to have consisted of 6826 men (i.e. 6100 foot soldiers, and 726 horsemen)
s: Of Latin origin; a “legion”, that is, Roman *regiment* (figuratively): - legion.

d:
**1.** to say, to speak
  **a.** affirm over, maintain
  **b.** to teach
  **c.** to exhort, advise, to command, direct
  **d.** to point out with words, intend, mean, mean to say
  **e.** to call by name, to call, name
  **f.** to speak out, speak of, mention
s: A primary verb; properly to “lay” forth, that is, (figuratively) *relate* (in words \[usually of systematic or set *discourse*; whereas [G2036](G2036) and [G5346](G5346) generally refer to an *individual* expression or speech respectively; while [G4483](G4483) is properly to *break* *silence* merely, and [G2980](G2980) means an *extended* or random harangue\]); by implication to *mean:* - ask, bid, boast, call, describe, give out, name, put forth, say (-ing, on), shew, speak, tell, utter.

d: **1.** a remnant
s: From [G3007](G3007); a *remainder:* - remnant.

d: **1.** smooth, level
s: Apparently a primary word; *smooth*, that is, “level”: - smooth.

d:
**1.** to leave, leave behind, forsake, to be left behind
  **a.** to lag, be inferior
  **b.** to be destitute of, to lack
**2.** to be wanting, to fail
s: A primary verb; to *leave*, that is, (intransitive or passive) to *fail* or *be* *absent:* - be destitute (wanting), lack.

d:
**1.** to serve the state at one’s own cost
  **a.** to assume an office which must be administered at one’s own expense
  **b.** to discharge a public office at one’s own cost
  **c.** to render public service to the state
**2.** to do a service, perform a work
  **a.** of priests and Levites who were busied with the sacred rites in the tabernacle or the temple
  **b.** of Christians serving christ, whether by prayer, or by instructing others concerning the way of salvation, or in some other way
  **c.** of those who aid others with their resources, and relieve their poverty
s: From [G3011](G3011); to be a *public* *servant*, that is, (by analogy) to *perform* religious or charitable *functions* (*worship*, *obey*, *relieve*): - minister.

d:
**1.** a public office which a citizen undertakes to administer at his own expense
**2.** any service
  **a.** of military service
  **b.** of the service of workmen
  **c.** of that done to nature in the cohabitation of man and wife
**3.** biblical usage
  **a.** a service or ministry of the priests relative to the prayers and sacrifices offered to God
  **b.** a gift or benefaction for the relief of the needy
s: From [G3008](G3008); *public* *function* (as priest \[“liturgy”\] or almsgiver): - ministration (-try), service.

d: **1.** relating to the performance of service, employed in ministering
s: From the same as [G3008](G3008); *functional* *publicly* (“liturgic”), that is, *beneficent:* - ministering.

d:
**1.** a public minister, a servant of the state
**2.** a minister, servant
  **a.** so of military labourers
  **b.** of the temple
    **1.** of one busied with holy things
    **2.** of a priest
  **c.** of the servants of a king
s: From a derivative of [G2992](G2992) and [G2041](G2041); a *public* *servant*, that is, a *functionary* in the Temple or Gospel, or (generally) a *worshipper* (of God) or *benefactor* (of man): - minister (-ed).

d:
**1.** a linen cloth, towel
  **a.** of the towel or apron with which servants put on when about to work
s: Of Latin origin; a “linen” cloth, that is, *apron:* - towel.

d: **1.** a scale
s: From λέπω lepō (to *peel*); a *flake:* - scale.

d:
**1.** leprosy
**2.** a most offensive, annoying, dangerous, cutaneous disease, the virus of which generally pervades the whole body, common in Egypt and the East
s: From the same as [G3013](G3013); *scaliness*, that is, “leprosy”: - leprosy.

d:
**1.** scaly, rough
**2.** leprous, affected with leprosy
s: From the same as [G3014](G3014); *scaly*, that is, *leprous* (a *leper*): - leper.

d:
**1.** thin, small
**2.** a small brass coin, equivalent to the eighth part of an as, worth about a 1/5 of a cent
s: Neuter of a derivative of the same as [G3013](G3013); something *scaled* (*light*), that is, a small *coin:* - mite.
o: neuter of a derivative of the same as [G3013](G3013)

d:
Levi = joined
**1.** the third son of the patriarch Jacob by his wife Leah, the founder of the tribe of Israelites which bears his name
**2.** the son of melchi, one of christ’s ancestors
**3.** the son of Simeon, an ancestor of christ
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H3878](H3878)\]; *Levi*, the name of three Israelites: - Levi. Compare [G3018](G3018).

d:
Levi = joined
**1.** the son of alphaeus, a collector of customs
s: A form of [G3017](G3017); *Lewis* (that is, *Levi*), a Christian: - Levi.

d:
**1.** one of the tribe of Levi
**2.** in a narrower sense those were called Levites who, not being of the family of Aaron, for whom alone the priesthood was reserved, served as assistants to the priests. It was their duty to keep the sacred utensils and the temple clean, to provide the sacred loaves, to open and shut the gates of the temple, to sing the sacred hymns in the temple, and to do many other things.
s: From [G3017](G3017); a *Levite*, that is, descendant of Levi: - Levite.

d: **1.** Levitical, pertaining to the Levites
s: From [G3019](G3019); *Levitic*, that is, relating to the Levites: - Levitical.

d: **1.** to whiten, make white
s: From [G3022](G3022); to *whiten:* - make white, whiten.

d:
**1.** light, bright, brilliant
  **a.** brilliant from whiteness, (dazzling) white
    **1.** of the garments of angels, and of those exalted to the splendour of the heavenly state
    **2.** shining or white garments worn on festive or state occasions
    **3.** of white garments as the sign of innocence and purity of the soul
  **b.** dead white
    **1.** of the whitening colour of ripening grain
s: From λύκη lukē (“light”); *white:* - white.

d:
**1.** a lion
**2.** a brave and mighty hero Both christ and Satan are referred to as a lion, indicating great strength,
  **a.** Satan as a roaring lion (1Pe 5:8)
  **b.** and christ as the Lion of the tribe of Judah (Rev 5:5)
s: A primary word; a “lion”: - lion.

d: **1.** forgetfulness
s: From [G2990](G2990); *forgetfulness:* - + forget.

d:
**1.** a tub or trough shaped receptacle, vat, in which grapes are trodden
**2.** the lower vat, dug in the ground, into which the must or new wine flowed from the press
s: Apparently a primary word; a *trough*, that is, wine *vat:* - winepress.

d: **1.** idle talk, nonsense
s: Apparently a primary word; *twaddle*, that is, an *incredible* story: - idle tale.

d: **1.** a robber, plunderer, freebooter, brigand
s: From ληΐ́ζομαι lēizomai (to “plunder”); a *brigand:* - robber, thief.

d: **1.** a receiving
s: From [G2983](G2983); *receipt* (the act): - receiving.

d: **1.** greatly, exceedingly, exceedingly beyond measure
s: Of uncertain affinity; *much* (adverb): - exceeding, great (-ly), sore, very (+ chiefest).

d:
**1.** the frankincense tree
**2.** the perfume, frankincense
s: Of foreign origin \[[H3828](H3828)\]; the *incense* tree, that is, (by implication) *incense* itself: - frankincense.

d:
**1.** the gum exuding from a frankincense tree
**2.** a censer
s: From [G3030](G3030); *frankincense*, that is, (by extension) a *censer* for burning it: - censer.

d:
**1.** one who has been liberated from slavery, a freedman, or the son of a freed man
**2.** Libertine, denotes Jews (according to Philo) who had been made captives of the Romans under Pompey but were afterwards set free; and who although they had fixed their abode in Rome, had built at their own expense a synagogue at Jerusalem which they frequented when in that city, the name Libertines adhered to them to distinguish them from free born Jews who had subsequently taken up their residence at Rome. Evidence seems to have been discovered of the existence of a synagogue of the Libertines at Pompeii.
s: Of Latin origin; a Roman *freedman:* - Libertine.

d:
Libya = afflicted or weeping
**1.** a large region of northern Africa, bordering Egypt. In that portion of it which had Cyrene for its capital and was thence called Libya Cyrenaica.
s: Probably from [G3047](G3047); *Libye*, a region of Africa: - Libya.

d:
**1.** to overwhelm or pelt with stones

**2.** to pelt one with stones, in order either to wound or kill him
s: From [G3037](G3037); to *lapidate:* - stone.

d: **1.** of stone
s: From [G3037](G3037); *stony*, that is, made of *stone:* - of stone.

d:
**1.** to kill by stoning, to stone
**2.** to pelt one with stones
s: From a compound of [G3037](G3037) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *stones*, that is, *lapidate:* - stone, cast stones.

d:
**1.** a stone
  **a.** of small stones
  **b.** of building stones
  **c.** metaph. of christ
s: Apparently a primary word; a *stone* (literally or figuratively): - (mill-, stumbling-) stone.

d:
**1.** spread (paved with stones)
**2.** a mosaic or tessellated pavement
  **a.** of a place near the praetorium or palace of Jerusalem
  **b.** an apartment whose pavement consists of tessellated work
  **c.** of places in the outer courts of temple the word for Pavement is found nowhere else in the NT, but itsHebrew equivalent occurs just once in the OT, and it is evident thatthe holy Sprit would have us link the two passages together. In 2Ki 16:17 we read, King Ahaz cut off the borders of the bases, andremoved the laver from off them; and took down the sea from off thebrazen oxen that were under it and put it upon a pavement ofstones. In Ahaz’s case, his act was the conclusive token of hissurrender to abject apostasy. So here of Pilate coming down to thelevel of the apostate Jews. In the former case it was a Jewish rulerdominated by a Gentile idolater; in the latter, a Gentile idolater,dominated by Jews who rejected their messiah! AWP
s: From [G3037](G3037) and a derivative of [G4766](G4766); *stone* *strewed*, that is, a tessellated *mosaic* on which the Roman tribunal was placed: - Pavement.

d:
**1.** to winnow, cleanse away the chaff from the grain by winnowing
**2.** to scatter
**3.** to crush to pieces, grind to powder
s: From λικμός likmos, the equivalent. of λίκνον liknon (a winnowing *fan* or basket); to *winnow*, that is, (by analogy) to *triturate:* - grind to powder.
o: from likmos, the equivalent of liknon (a winnowing fan or basket)

d: **1.** a harbour, haven
s: Apparently a primary word; a *harbor*: - haven. Compare [G2568](G2568).

d: **1.** a lake
s: Probably from [G3040](G3040) (through the idea of the nearness of shore); a *pond* (large or small): - lake.

s: Probably from [G3007](G3007) (through the idea of *destitution*); a *scarcity* of food: - dearth, famine, hunger.
o: probably from [G3007](G3007) (through the idea of destitution)

d: **1.** linen clothing made from flax
s: Probably a primary word; *flax*, that is, (by implication) “linen”: - linen.

d:
Linus = a net

s: Perhaps from [G3043](G3043); *Linus*, a Christian: - Linus.

d:

**2.** the quarter of the heavens whence the south west wind blows
s: Probably from λείβω leibō (to *pour* a “libation”); the *south* (southwest) wind (as bringing rain), that is, (by extension) the *south* quarter: - southwest.

d:
**1.** a collection
  **a.** of money gathered for the relief of the poor
s: From [G3056](G3056) (in the commercial sense); a *contribution:* - collection, gathering.

d:
**1.** to reckon, count, compute, calculate, count over
  **a.** to take into account, to make an account of
    **1.** metaph. to pass to one’s account, to impute
    **2.** a thing is reckoned as or to be something, i.e. as availing for or equivalent to something, as having the like force and weight
  **b.** to number among, reckon with
  **c.** to reckon or account
**2.** to reckon inward, count up or weigh the reasons, to deliberate
**3.** by reckoning up all the reasons, to gather or infer
  **a.** to consider, take into account, weigh, meditate on
  **b.** to suppose, deem, judge
  **c.** to determine, purpose, decide This word deals with reality. If I logizomai or reckon that my bank book has $25 in it, it has $25 in it. Otherwise I am deceiving myself. This word refers to facts not suppositions.
s: Middle voice from [G3056](G3056); to *take* *an* *inventory*, that is, *estimate* (literally or figuratively): - conclude, (ac-) count (of), + despise, esteem, impute, lay, number, reason, reckon, suppose, think (on).

d:
**1.** pertaining to speech or speaking

  **b.** agreeable to reason, following reason, reasonable, logical
s: From [G3056](G3056); *rational* (“logical”): - reasonable, of the word.

d:
**1.** a brief utterance, a divine oracle (doubtless because oracles were generally brief)
  **a.** in the NT, the words or utterances of God
  **b.** of the contents of the Mosaic law
s: Neuter of [G3052](G3052); an *utterance* (of God): - oracle.

d:
**1.** learned, a man of letters, skilled in literature and the arts, esp. versed in history and the antiquities
**2.** skilled in speech, eloquent

s: From [G3056](G3056); *fluent*, that is, an *orator:* - eloquent.

d:
**1.** a reckoning, computation

**3.** a judgment, decision: such as conscience passes
s: From [G3049](G3049); *computation*, that is, (figuratively) *reasoning* (*conscience*, *conceit*): - imagination, thought.

d:
**1.** to contend about words
**2.** to wrangle about empty and trifling matters
s: From a compound of [G3056](G3056) and [G3164](G3164); to *be* *disputatious* (on trifles): - strive about words.

d:
**1.** to contend about words
**2.** to wrangle about empty and trifling matters
s: From the same as [G3054](G3054); *disputation* about trifles (“logomachy”): - strife of words.

d:
**1.** of speech
  **a.** a word, uttered by a living voice, embodies a conception or idea
  **b.** what someone has said
    **1.** a word
    **2.** the sayings of God
    **3.** decree, mandate or order
    **4.** of the moral precepts given by God
    **5.** Old Testament prophecy given by the prophets
    **6.** what is declared, a thought, declaration, aphorism, a weighty saying, a dictum, a maxim
  **c.** discourse
    **1.** the act of speaking, speech
    **2.** the faculty of speech, skill and practice in speaking
    **3.** a kind or style of speaking
    **4.** a continuous speaking discourse - instruction
  **d.** doctrine, teaching
  **e.** anything reported in speech; a narration, narrative
  **f.** matter under discussion, thing spoken of, affair, a matter in dispute, case, suit at law
  **g.** the thing spoken of or talked about; event, deed
**2.** its use as respect to the MIND alone
  **a.** reason, the mental faculty of thinking, meditating, reasoning, calculating
  **b.** account, i.e. regard, consideration
  **c.** account, i.e. reckoning, score
  **d.** account, i.e. answer or explanation in reference to judgment
  **e.** relation, i.e. with whom as judge we stand in relation
    **1.** reason would
  **f.** reason, cause, ground
**3.** In John, denotes the essential word of God, Jesus christ, the personal wisdom and power in union with God, his minister in creation and government of the universe, the cause of all the world’s life both physical and ethical, which for the procurement of man’s salvation put on human nature in the person of Jesus the messiah, the second person in the Godhead, and shone forth conspicuously from his words and deeds. This word was well suited to John’s purpose inJohn 1.
s: From [G3004](G3004); something *said* (including the *thought*); by implication a *topic* (subject of discourse), also *reasoning* (the mental faculty) or *motive*; by extension a *computation*; specifically (with the article in John) the Divine *Expression* (that is, *Christ*): - account, cause, communication, X concerning, doctrine, fame, X have to do, intent, matter, mouth, preaching, question, reason, + reckon, remove, say (-ing), shew, X speaker, speech, talk, thing, + none of these things move me, tidings, treatise, utterance, word, work.

d:
**1.** the iron point or head of a spear

d:
**1.** pestilence

d:

Properly feminine of Λύδιος

**1.** a wolf

d:

d:
**1.** a female disciple

d:

d:
**1.** declaration of blessedness

d:

d:
**1.** softness

d:
**1.** soft, soft to the touch
**2.** metaph. in a bad sense
  **a.** effeminate
    **1.** of a catamite
    **2.** of a boy kept for homosexual relations with a man
    **3.** of a male who submits his body to unnatural lewdness
    **4.** of a male prostitute
s: Of uncertain affinity; *soft*, that is, *fine* (clothing); figuratively a *catamite:* - effeminate, soft.

d:
Maleleel or Mahalaleel = praise of God
**1.** the fourth in descent from Adam, son of Cainan
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4111](H4111)\]; *Maleleel* (that is, *Mahalalel*), an antediluvian: - Maleleel.

d: **1.** especially, chiefly, most of all, above all
s: Neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb μάλα mala (*very*); (adverb) *most* (*in* *the* *greatest* *degree*) or *particularly:* - chiefly, most of all, (e-) specially.
o: neuter plural of the superlative of an apparently primary adverb mala (very)

d:
**1.** more, to a greater degree, rather
  **a.** much, by far
  **b.** rather, sooner
  **c.** more willingly, more readily, sooner
s: Neuter of the comparative of the same as [G3122](G3122); (adverb) *more* (*in* *a* *greater* *degree*) or *rather:* - + better, X far, (the) more (and more), (so) much (the more), rather.
o: neuter of the comparative of the same as [G3122](G3122)

d:
Malchus = king or kingdom
**1.** was the name of the servant of the high priest whose right ear Peter cut off at the time of christ’s arrest in the garden
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4429](H4429)\]; *Malchus*, an Israelite: - Malchus.

d:
**1.** mother (the name infants use in addressing their mother)
**2.** grandmother
s: Of natural origin \[“mammy”\]; a *grandmother:* - grandmother.

d:
**1.** mammon
**2.** treasure
**3.** riches (where it is personified and opposed to God)
s: Of Chaldee origin (*confidence*, that is, figuratively *wealth*, personified); *mammonas*, that is, *avarice* (deified): - mammon.
o: of Aramaic origin (confidence, i.e. wealth, personified)

d:
manaen = comforter
**1.** one of the teachers and prophets in the church at Antioch
s: Of uncertain origin; *Manaen*, a Christian: - Manaen.

d:
manasseh = forgetting
**1.** the first born son of Joseph
**2.** the son of hezekiah, king of Judah
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4519](H4519)\]; *Manasses* (that is, *Menashsheh*), an Israelite: - Manasses.

d:
**1.** to learn, be appraised
  **a.** to increase one’s knowledge, to be increased in knowledge
  **b.** to hear, be informed
  **c.** to learn by use and practice
    **1.** to be in the habit of, accustomed to
s: Prolonged from a primary verb, another form of which, μαθέω matheō, is used as an alternate in certain tenses; to *learn* (in any way): - learn, understand.
o: prolongation from a primary verb, another form of which, matheo, is used as an alternate in certain tenses

d: **1.** madness, frenzy
s: From [G3105](G3105); *craziness:* - \[+ make\] X mad.

d:
manna = what is it
**1.** the food that nourished the Israelites for forty years in the wilderness
**2.** of the manna was kept in the ark of the covenant
**3.** symbolically, that which is kept in the heavenly temple for the food of angels and the blessed
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4478](H4478)\]; *manna* (that is, *man*), an edible gum: - manna.

d:
**1.** to act as a seer
  **a.** deliver an oracle, prophesy, divine
s: From a derivative of [G3105](G3105) (meaning a *prophet*, as supposed to *rave* through *inspiration*); to *divine*, that is, *utter* *spells* (under pretence of foretelling): - by soothsaying.
o: from a derivative of [G3105](G3105) (meaning a prophet, as supposed to rave through inspiration)

d:
**1.** to extinguish (a flame, fire, light, etc.)
**2.** to render arid, make to waste away, consume away, perish
**3.** to have a miserable end
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *extinguish* (as fire), that is, (figuratively and passively) to *pass* *away:* - fade away.

d: **1.** our Lord cometh or will come
s: Of Chaldee origin (meaning *our* *Lord* *has* *come*); *maranatha*, that is, an exclamation of the approaching *divine* *judgment:* - Maran-atha.
o: of Aramaic origin (meaning our Lord has come)

d:
**1.** a pearl
**2.** a proverb, i.e. a word of great value
s:
From μάργαρος
margaros
(a pearl *oyster*); a *pearl:* - pearl.

d:
Martha = she was rebellious
**1.** was the sister of Lazarus and Mary of Bethany
s: Probably of Chaldee origin (meaning *mistress*); *Martha*, a Christian woman: - Martha.

d:
Mary or Miriam = their rebellion
**1.** Mary the mother of Jesus
**2.** Mary Magdalene, a women from Magdala
**3.** Mary, the sister of Lazarus and Martha
**4.** Mary of Cleophas the mother of James the less
**5.** Mary the mother of John Mark, a sister of Barnabas
**6.** Mary, a Roman Christian who is greeted by Paul in Rom 16:6
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4813](H4813)\]; *Maria* or *Mariam* (that is, *Mirjam*), the name of six Christian females: - Mary.

d:
Mark = a defense
**1.** an evangelist, the author of the Gospel of Mark. Marcus was his Latin surname, his Jewish name was John. He was a cousin of Barnabas and a companion of Paul in some of his missionary journeys
s: Of Latin origin; *Marcus*, a Christian: - Marcus, Mark.

d:
**1.** a stone, a rock
**2.** marble
s: From μαρμαίρω marmairō (to *glisten*); *marble* (as sparkling *white*): - marble.

d:
**1.** to be a witness, to bear witness, i.e. to affirm that one has seen or heard or experienced something, or that he knows it because taught by divine revelation or inspiration
  **a.** to give (not to keep back) testimony
  **b.** to utter honourable testimony, give a good report
  **c.** conjure, implore
s: From [G3144](G3144); to *be* *a* *witness*, that is, *testify* (literally or figuratively): - charge, give \[evidence\], bear record, have (obtain, of) good (honest) report, be well reported of, testify, give (have) testimony, (be, bear, give, obtain) witness.

d:
**1.** a testifying
  **a.** the office committed to the prophets of testifying concerning future events
**2.** what one testifies, testimony, i.e. before a judge
s: From [G3144](G3144); *evidence* given (judicially or generally): - record, report, testimony, witness.

d: **1.** testimony
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G3144](G3144); something *evidential*, that is, (generally) *evidence* given or (specifically) the *Decalogue* (in the sacred Tabernacle): - to be testified, testimony, witness.

d:
**1.** to cite a witness, bring forward a witness, call to witness
  **a.** to affirm be appeal to God, to declare solemnly, protest
**2.** to conjure, beseech as in God’s name, exhort solemnly
s: Middle voice from [G3144](G3144); to *be* *adduced* as *a* *witness*, that is, (figuratively) to *obtest* (in affirmation or exhortation): - take to record, testify.

d:
**1.** a witness
  **a.** in a legal sense
  **b.** an historical sense
    **1.** one who is a spectator of anything, e.g. of a contest
  **c.** in an ethical sense
    **1.** those who after his example have proved the strength and genuineness of their faith in christ by undergoing a violent death
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *witness* (literally \[judicially\] or figuratively \[generally\]); by analogy a “martyr”: - martyr, record, witness.

d: **1.** to chew, consume, eat, devour
s: From a primary word μάσσω massō (to *handle* or *squeeze*); to *chew:* - gnaw.
o: from a primary masso (to handle or squeeze)

d: **1.** to scourge
s: From [G3148](G3148); to *flog* (literally or figuratively): - scourge.

d: **1.** to whip, flog, scourge
s: From [G3149](G3149); to *whip* (literally): - scourge.

d:
**1.** a whip, scourge
**2.** metaph. a scourge, plague
  **a.** a calamity, misfortune, esp. sent by God to discipline or punish
s: Probably from the base of [G3145](G3145) (through the idea of *contact*); a *whip* (literally the Roman *flagellum* for criminals; figuratively a *disease*): - plague, scourging.
o: probably from the base of [G3145](G3145) (through the idea of contact)

d:
**1.** the breasts
**2.** the breasts (nipples) of a man
**3.** breasts of a women
s: From the base of [G3145](G3145); a (properly female) *breast* (as if *kneaded* up): - pap.

d: **1.** vain talking, empty talk
s: From [G3151](G3151); *random* *talk*, that is, *babble:* - vain jangling.

d: **1.** an idle talker, one who utters empty senseless things
s: From [G3152](G3152) and [G3004](G3004); an *idle* (that is, *senseless* or *mischievous*) *talker*, that is, a *wrangler:* - vain talker.

d:
**1.** devoid of force, truth, success, result
**2.** useless, of no purpose
s: From the base of [G3155](G3155); *empty*, that is, (literally) *profitless*, or (specifically) an *idol:* - vain, vanity.

d:
**1.** what is devoid of truth and appropriateness
**2.** perverseness, depravity
**3.** frailty, want of vigour
s: From [G3152](G3152); *inutility*; figuratively *transientness*; morally *depravity:* - vanity.

d: **1.** to make empty, vain, foolish
s: From [G3152](G3152); to *render* (passively *become*) *foolish*, that is, (morally) *wicked* or (specifically) *idolatrous:* - become vain.

d: **1.** in vain, fruitlessly
s: Accusative case of a derivative of the base of [G3145](G3145) (through the idea of tentative *manipulation*, that is, unsuccessful *search*, or else of *punishment*); *folly*, that is, (adverbially) *to* *no* *purpose:* - in vain.
o: accus. of a derivative of the base of [G3145](G3145) (through the idea of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of punishment)

d:
Matthew = gift of Jehovah
**1.** son of alphaeus, one of the 12 disciples
s: A shorter form of [G3161](G3161); *Matthaeus* (that is, *Matthitjah*), an Israelite and Christian: - Matthew.

d:
Matthan = gift
**1.** one of christ’s ancestors
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4977](H4977)\]; *Matthan* (that is, *Mattan*), an Israelite: - Matthan.

d:
Matthat = gift of God
**1.** a son of Levi, in the genealogy of christ
**2.** grandfather of the Mary
s: Probably a shortened form of [G3161](G3161); *Matthat* (that is, *Mattithjah*), the name of two Israelites: - Mathat.

d:
Matthias = gift of God
**1.** the apostle elected to fill the place of the traitor Judas
s: Apparently a shortened form of [G3161](G3161); *Matthias* (that is, *Mattithjah*), an Israelite: - Matthias.

d:
Mattatha = givingness
**1.** an ancestor of christ
s: Probably a shortened form of [G3161](G3161) (compare \[[H4992](H4992)\]); *Mattatha* (that is, *Mattithjah*), an Israelite: - Mattatha.
o: probably a shortened form of [G3161](G3161) cf [G4992](G4992)

d:
Mattathias = gift of Jehovah
**1.** the son of amos, in the genealogy of christ
**2.** Mattathias was the son of Semei in the genealogy of christ
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4993](H4993)\]; *Mattathias* (that is, *Mattithjah*), an Israelite and Christian: - Mattathias.

d:
**1.** a large knife, used for killing animals and cutting up flesh
**2.** a small sword, as distinguished from a large sword
  **a.** curved sword, for a cutting stroke
  **b.** a straight sword, for thrusting
s: Probably feminine of a presumed derivative of [G3163](G3163); a *knife*, that is, *dirk*; figuratively *war*, judicial *punishment:* - sword.

d:
**1.** a fight or combat
  **a.** of those in arms, a battle
  **b.** of persons at variance, disputants etc., strife, contention
  **c.** a quarrel
s: From [G3164](G3164); a *battle*, that is, (figuratively) *controversy:* - fighting, strive, striving.

d:
**1.** to fight
  **a.** of armed combatants, or those who engage in a hand to hand struggle
  **b.** of those who engage in a war of words, to quarrel, wrangle, dispute
  **c.** of those who contend at law for property and privileges
s: Middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to *war*, that is, (figuratively) to *quarrel*, *dispute:* - fight, strive.
o: middle voice of an apparently root word

d: **1.** I, me, my, etc.
s: A shorter (and probably original) form of [G1691](G1691); *me:* - I, me, my.
o: a shorter (and probably originally) from of [G1691](G1691)

d:
**1.** to be grandiloquent
**2.** to boast great things, to bear one’s self loftily in speech or action
s: From a compound of [G3173](G3173) and αὐχέω aucheō (to *boast*; akin to [G837](G837) and [G2744](G2744)); to *talk* *big*, that is, *be* *grandiloquent* (*arrogant*, *egotistic*): - boast great things.
o: from a compound of [G3173](G3173) and aucheo (to boast, akin to [G837](G837) and [G2744](G2744))

d: **1.** magnificent, excellent, splendid, wonderful
s: From [G3173](G3173); *magnificent*, that is, (neuter plural as noun) a conspicuous *favor*, or (subjectively) *perfection:* - great things, wonderful works.

d:
**1.** greatness, magnificence
  **a.** of the majesty of God
  **b.** of the visible splendour of the divine majesty as it appeared in the transfiguration of christ
s: From [G3167](G3167); *superbness*, that is, *glory* or *splendor:* - magnificence, majesty, mighty power.

d:
**1.** befitting a great man, magnificent, splendid
**2.** full of majesty, majestic
s: From [G3173](G3173) and [G4241](G4241); *befitting* *greatness* or *magnificence* (*majestic*): - excellent.

d:
**1.** to make great, magnify
  **a.** metaph. to make conspicuous
**2.** to deem or declare great
  **a.** to esteem highly, to extol, laud, celebrate
**3.** to get glory and praise
s: From [G3173](G3173); to *make* (or *declare*) *great*, that is, *increase* or (figuratively) *extol:* - enlarge, magnify, shew great.

d: **1.** greatly
s: Adverb from [G3173](G3173); *much:* - greatly.

d:
**1.** majesty
  **a.** of the majesty of God
s: From [G3173](G3173); *greatness*, that is, (figuratively) *divinity* (often *God* himself): - majesty.

d:
**1.** great
  **a.** of the external form or sensible appearance of things (or of persons)
    **1.** in particular, of space and its dimensions, as respects
  **b.** mass and weight: great
  **c.** compass and extent: large, spacious
  **d.** measure and height: long
  **e.** stature and age: great, old
  **f.** of number and quantity: numerous, large, abundant
  **g.** of age: the elder
  **h.** used of intensity and its degrees: with great effort, of the affections and emotions of the mind, of natural events powerfully affecting the senses: violent, mighty, strong
**2.** predicated of rank, as belonging to
  **a.** persons, eminent for ability, virtue, authority, power
  **b.** things esteemed highly for their importance: of great moment, of great weight, importance
  **c.** a thing to be highly esteemed for its excellence: excellent
**3.** splendid, prepared on a grand scale, stately
**4.** great things
  **a.** of God’s preeminent blessings
  **b.** of things which overstep the province of a created being, proud (presumptuous) things, full of arrogance, derogatory to the majesty of God
s: Including the prolonged forms, femine μεγάλη megalē, plural μέγάλοι megaloi, etc.; compare also [G3176](G3176), [G3187](G3187)\], *big* (literally or figuratively, in a very wide application): - (+ fear) exceedingly, great (-est), high, large, loud, mighty, + (be) sore (afraid), strong, X to years.
o: \[including the prolonged forms, feminine megale, plural megaloi, etc., cf also [G3176](G3176), [G3187](G3187)\]

d: **1.** greatness
s: From [G3173](G3173); *magnitude* (figuratively): - greatness.

d:
**1.** the grandees, magnates, nobles, chief men
  **a.** of a city or a people
  **b.** of the associates or courtiers of a king
s: Plural from [G3176](G3176); *grandees:* - great men, lords.

d: **1.** greatest, very great
s: Superlative of [G3173](G3173); *greatest* or *very* *great:* - exceeding great.

d: **1.** to translate into the language of one with whom I wish to communicate, to interpret
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G2059](G2059); to *explain* *over*, that is, *translate:* - (by) interpret (-ation).

d:
**1.** intoxication
**2.** drunkenness
s: Apparently a primary word; an *intoxicant*, that is, (by implication) *intoxication:* - drunkenness.

d:
**1.** to transpose, transfer, remove from one place to another
  **a.** of change of situation or place
  **b.** to remove from the office of a steward
  **c.** to depart from life, to die
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G2476](G2476); (second form used at 1Co 13:2) to *transfer*, that is, *carry* *away*, *depose* or (figuratively) *exchange*, *seduce:* - put out, remove, translate, turn away.

d: **1.** cunning arts, deceit, craft, trickery
s: From a compound of [G3326](G3326) and [G3593](G3593) \[compare “method”\]; *traveling* *over*, that is, *travesty*, (*trickery*): - wile, lie in wait.
o: from a compound of [G3326](G3326) and [G3593](G3593) \[cf method\]

d: **1.** a border, frontier
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G3725](G3725); *bounded* *alongside*, that is, *contiguous* (neuter plural as noun, *frontier*): - border.

d:
**1.** to intoxicate, make drunk
**2.** to get drunk, become intoxicated
s: A prolonged (transitive) form of [G3184](G3184); to *intoxicate:* - be drunk (-en).

d: **1.** drunken, intoxicated
s: From [G3184](G3184); *tipsy*, that is, (as noun) a *sot:* - drunkard.

d:
**1.** to be drunken
**2.** metaph. of one who has shed blood or murdered profusely
s: From another form of [G3178](G3178); to *drink* to *intoxication*, that is, *get* *drunk:* - drink well, make (be) drunk (-en).

d: **1.** of greater degree, even more
s: Neuter of [G3187](G3187); (adverbially) in a *greater* degree: - the more.

d: **1.** greater
s: Continued comparative of [G3187](G3187); *still* *larger* (figuratively): - greater.

d: **1.** greater, larger, elder, stronger
s: Irregular comparative of [G3173](G3173); *larger* (literally or figuratively, specifically in age): - elder, greater (-est), more.
Neuter of [G3189](G3189) as noun; *ink:* - ink.

d:
**1.** black
**2.** black ink
s: Apparently a primary word; *black:* - black.

d:
melea = my dear friend: object of care
**1.** the son of Joseph in the genealogy of christ
s: Of uncertain origin; *Meleas*, an Israelite: - Meleas.

d:
**1.** to care for, attend to carefully, practise
**2.** to meditate i.e. to devise, contrive
  **a.** used of the Greeks of the meditative pondering and the practice of orators and rhetoricians
s: From a presumed derivative of [G3199](G3199); to *take* *care* *of*, that is, (by implication) *revolve* in the mind: - imagine, (pre-) meditate.

d: **1.** honey
s: Apparently a primary word; *honey:* - honey.

d: **1.** of bees, made by bees
s: From [G3192](G3192); *relating* *to* *honey*, that is, *bee* (comb): - honeycomb.

d:
melita = honey
**1.** the name of an island in the mediterranean, lying between Africa and Sicily, now called Malta
s: Of uncertain origin; *Melita*, an island in the Mediterranean: - Melita.

d:
**1.** to be about
  **a.** to be on the point of doing or suffering something
  **b.** to intend, have in mind, think to
s: A strengthened form of [G3199](G3199) (through the idea of *expectation*); to *intend*, that is, *be* *about* to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or things, especially events; in the sense of *purpose*, *duty*, *necessity*, *probability*, *possibility*, or *hesitation*): - about, after that, be (almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend, was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall (begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry, which was for, will, would, be yet.
o: a strengthened form of [G3199](G3199) (through the idea of expectation)

d:
**1.** a member, limb: a member of the human body
  **a.** of bodies given up to criminal intercourse, because they are as it were members belonging to the harlot’s body
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *limb* or *part* of the body: - member.

d:
melchi meaning my king, my counsel
**1.** the son of Janna in the genealogy of christ
**2.** Melchi was the son of Addi in the genealogy of christ
s: Of Hebrew origin (\[[H4428](H4428)\] with pronominal suffix, *my* *king*); *Melchi* (that is, *Malki*), the name of two Israelites: - Melchi.
o: of hebrew or [G4428](G4428) with pronominal suf., my king

d:
melchizedek = king of righteousness
**1.** the king of Salem and priest of the most high God, who lived in the days of Abraham
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4442](H4442)\]; *Melchisedek* (that is, *Malkitsedek*), a patriarch: - Melchisedec.

d: **1.** to care about
s: A primary verb; to *be* *of* *interest* to, that is, to *concern* (only third person singular present indicative used impersonally *it* *matters*): - (take) care.

d: **1.** parchment, made first of dressed skins at Pergamos, hence its name
s: Of Latin origin (“membrane”); a (written) sheep *skin:* - parchment.

d: **1.** to blame, find fault
s: Middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to *blame:* - find fault.
o: middle voice of an apparently root word

d: **1.** complaining of one’s lot, querulous, discontented
s: From a presumed derivative of [G3201](G3201) and μοῖρα moira (*fate*; akin to the base of [G3313](G3313)); *blaming* *fate*, that is, *querulous* (*discontented*): - complainer.
o: from a presumed derivative of [G3201](G3201) and moira (fate, akin to the base of [G3313](G3313))

d: **1.** truly, certainly, surely, indeed
s: A primary particle; properly indicative of *affirmation* or *concession* (*in* *fact*); usually followed by a *contrasted* clause with [G1161](G1161) (*this* one, the *former*, etc.: - even, indeed, so, some, truly, verily. Often compounded with other particles in an *intensive* or *asseverative* sense.

d: **1.** nay surely, nay rather
s: From [G3303](G3303) and [G3767](G3767) and [G1065](G1065); *so* *then* *at* *least:* - nay but, yea doubtless (rather, verily).

d: **1.** but yet, nevertheless, howbeit
s: From [G3303](G3303) and [G5104](G5104); *indeed* *though*, that is, *however:* - also, but, howbeit, nevertheless, yet.

d:
**1.** to remain, abide
  **a.** in reference to place
    **1.** to sojourn, tarry
    **2.** not to depart
  **b.** to continue to be present
  **c.** to be held, kept, continually
  **d.** in reference to time
    **1.** to continue to be, not to perish, to last, endure
  **e.** of persons, to survive, live
  **f.** in reference to state or condition
    **1.** to remain as one, not to become another or different
**2.** to wait for, await one
s: A primary verb; to *stay* (in a given place, state, relation or expectancy): - abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain, stand, tarry (for), X thine own.

d:
**1.** to divide
  **a.** to separate into parts, cut into pieces
    **1.** to divide into parties, i.e. be split into factions
  **b.** to distribute
    **1.** a thing among people
    **2.** bestow, impart
s: From [G3313](G3313); to *part*, that is, (literally) to *apportion*, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to *disunite*, *differ:* - deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give part.

d: **1.** care, anxiety
s: From [G3307](G3307) (through the idea of *distraction*); *solicitude:* - care.

d:
**1.** to be anxious
  **a.** to be troubled with cares
**2.** to care for, look out for (a thing)
  **a.** to seek to promote one’s interests
  **b.** caring or providing for
s: From [G3308](G3308); to *be* *anxious* about: - (be, have) care (-ful), take thought.

d:
**1.** a part as distinct from the whole
**2.** an assigned part, a portion, share
s: Feminine of [G3313](G3313); a *portion*, that is, *province*, *share* or (abstractly) *participation:* - part (X -akers).

d:
**1.** a division, partition
  **a.** distribution (of various kinds)
**2.** a separation
  **a.** so far as to cleave asunder or separate
s: From [G3307](G3307); a *separation* or *distribution:* - dividing asunder, gift.

d:
**1.** a divider
  **a.** of an inheritance
s: From [G3307](G3307); an *apportioner* (*administrator*): - divider.

d:
**1.** a part
  **a.** a part due or assigned to one
  **b.** lot, destiny
**2.** one of the constituent parts of a whole
  **a.** in part, partly, in a measure, to some degree, as respects a part, severally, individually
  **b.** any particular, in regard to this, in this respect
s: From an obsolete but more primary form of μείρομαι meiromai (to *get* as a *section* or *allotment*); a *division* or *share* (literally or figuratively, in a wide application): - behalf, coast, course, craft, particular (+ -ly), part (+ -ly), piece, portion, respect, side, some sort (-what).
o: from an obsolete but more primary form of meiromai (to get as a section or allotment)

d:
**1.** as respects to time: noon
**2.** as respects to locality
  **a.** the south
s: From [G3319](G3319) and [G2250](G2250); *midday*; by implication the *south:* - noon, south.

d:
**1.** to act as a mediator between litigating or covenanting parties
  **a.** to accomplish something by interposing between two parties
  **b.** to mediate
**2.** act as a sponsor or surety
  **a.** to pledge one’s self, give surety
s: From [G3316](G3316); to *interpose* (as arbiter), that is, (by implication) to *ratify* (as surety): - confirm.

d:
**1.** one who intervenes between two, either in order to make or restore peace and friendship, or form a compact, or for ratifying a covenant
**2.** a medium of communication, arbitrator
s: From [G3319](G3319); a *go* *between*, that is, (simply) an *internunciator*, or (by implication) a *reconciler* (*intercessor*): - mediator.

d: **1.** midnight
s: Neuter of a compound of [G3319](G3319) and [G3571](G3571); *midnight* (especially as a watch): - midnight.

d:
mesopotamia = between two rivers
**1.** the entire country between the two rivers, the Tigris and the Euphrates
s: From [G3319](G3319) and [G4215](G4215); *Mesopotamia* (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare \[[H763](H763)\]), a region of Asia: - Mesopotamia.

d:
**1.** middle
**2.** the midst
**3.** in the midst of, amongst
s: From [G3326](G3326); *middle* (as adjective or \[neuter\] noun): - among, X before them, between, + forth, mid \[-day, -night\], midst, way.

d: **1.** a partition wall
s: From [G3319](G3319) and [G5109](G5109); a *partition* (figuratively): - middle wall.

d:
**1.** mid-heaven
**2.** the highest point in the heavens, which the sun occupies at noon, where what is done can be seen and heard by all
s: From a presumed compound of [G3319](G3319) and [G3772](G3772); *mid-sky:* - midst of heaven.
o: from a presumed compound of [G3319](G3319) and [G3772](G3772)

d: **1.** to be in the middle, be midway
s: From [G3319](G3319); to *form* the *middle*, that is, (in point of time), to *be* *half* *way* over: - be about the midst.

d:
messias = anointed
**1.** the Greek form of messiah
**2.** a name of christ
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H4899](H4899)\]; the *Messias* (that is, *Mashiach*), or Christ: - Messias.

d:
**1.** full
  **a.** in reference to persons, whose minds are as it were filled with thoughts and emotions, either good or bad
s: Of uncertain derivative; *replete* (literally or figuratively): - full.

d: **1.** to fill, be full
s: From [G3324](G3324); to *replenish*, that is, (by implication) to *intoxicate:* - fill.

d: **1.** with, after, behind
s: A primary preposition (often used adverbially); properly denoting *accompaniment*; “amid” (local or causal); modified variously according to the case (genitive case *association*, or accusative case *succession*) with which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between [G575](G575) or [G1537](G1537) and [G1519](G1519) or [G4314](G4314); less intimate than [G1722](G1722), and less close than [G4862](G4862))*:* - after (-ward),X that he again, against, among, X and, + follow, hence, hereafter, in, of, (up-) on, + our, X and setting, since, (un-) to, + together, when, with (+ -out). Often used in composition, in substantially the same relations of *participation* or *proximity*, and *transfer* or *sequence*.

d: **1.** to pass over from one place to another, to remove, depart
s: From [G3326](G3326) and the base of [G939](G939); to *change* *place:* - depart, go, pass, remove.

d:
**1.** to turn around, to turn about
**2.** to turn one’s self about, or transform one’s self
**3.** to change one’s opinion
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *over*, that is, (middle voice, figuratively) to *turn* *about* in opinion: - change mind.

d:
**1.** to transfer, lead over
**2.** to direct
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G71](G71); to *lead* *over*, that is, *transfer* (*direct*): - turn about.

d: **1.** to impart
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G1325](G1325); to *give* *over*, that is, *share:* - give, impart.

d:
**1.** transfer: from one place to another
**2.** to change
  **a.** of things instituted or established
s: From [G3346](G3346); *transposition*, that is, *transferral* (to heaven), *disestablishment* (of a law): - change, removing, translation.

d:
**1.** to lift up and remove from one place to another, to transfer
**2.** to go away, depart
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G142](G142); to *betake* oneself, that is, *remove* (locally): - depart.

d:
**1.** to call from one place to another, to summon
**2.** to call one’s self
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G2564](G2564); to *call* *elsewhere*, that is, *summon:* - call (for, hither).

d: **1.** to move from a place, to move away
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G2795](G2795); to *stir* to a place *elsewhere*, that is, *remove* (figuratively): - move away.

d:
**1.** to be or to be made a partner
**2.** to partake of, take \[some\] food
**3.** of a thing, to get, find (a whole)
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G2983](G2983); to *participate*; generally to *accept* (and use): - eat, have, be partaker, receive, take.

d: **1.** a taking, participation
s: From [G3335](G3335); *participation:* - taking.

d: **1.** to exchange, change
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G236](G236); to *exchange:* - change.

d:
**1.** it is a care to one afterwards
  **a.** it repents one, to repent one’s self
s: From [G3326](G3326) and the middle of [G3199](G3199); to *care* *afterwards*, that is, *regret:* - repent (self).
o: from [G3326](G3326) and the middle voice of [G3199](G3199)

d:
**1.** to change into another form, to transform, to transfigure
  **a.** christ appearance was changed and was resplendent with divine brightness on the mount of transfiguration
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G3445](G3445); to *transform* (literally or figuratively “metamorphose”): - change, transfigure, transform.

d:
**1.** to change one’s mind, i.e. to repent
**2.** to change one’s mind for better, heartily to amend with abhorrence of one’s past sins
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G3539](G3539); to *think* *differently* or *afterwards*, that is, *reconsider* (morally to *feel* *compunction*): - repent.

d: **1.** a change of mind, as it appears to one who repents, of a purpose he has formed or of something he has done
s: From [G3340](G3340); (subjectively) *compunction* (for guilt, including *reformation*); by implication *reversal* (of \[another’s\] decision): - repentance.

d:
**1.** between
  **a.** meanwhile, in the mean time
**2.** after, afterwards
s: From [G3326](G3326) and a form of [G4862](G4862); *betwixt* (of place or person); (of time) as adjective *intervening*, or (by implication) *adjoining:* - between, mean while, next.

d:
**1.** to send one after another
**2.** like our send after i.e. to send for
**3.** to send after for one’s self, cause to be sent
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G3992](G3992); to *send* from *elsewhere*, that is, (middle voice) to *summon* or *invite:* - call (send) for.

d: **1.** to turn around, turn around
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G4762](G4762); to *turn* *across*, that is, *transmute* or (figuratively) *corrupt:* - pervert, turn.

d: **1.** to change the figure of, to transform
s: From [G3326](G3326) and a derivative of [G4976](G4976); to *transfigure* or *disguise*; figuratively to *apply* (by accommodation): - transfer, transform (self).

d:
**1.** to transpose (two things, one of which is put in place of the other)
  **a.** to transfer
  **b.** to change
  **c.** to transfer one’s self or suffer one’s self to be transferred
    **1.** to go or pass over
    **2.** to fall away or desert from one person or thing to another
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G5087](G5087); to *transfer*, that is, (literally) *transport*, (by implication) *exchange*, (reflexively) *change* *sides*, or (figuratively) *pervert:* - carry over, change, remove, translate, turn.

d: **1.** afterwards, after that
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G1899](G1899); *thereafter:* - afterward.

d:
**1.** to be or become partaker
**2.** to partake
s: From [G3326](G3326) and [G2192](G2192); to *share* or *participate*; by implication *belong* to, *eat* (or *drink*): - be partaker, pertain, take part, use.

d:
**1.** to rise up on high
  **a.** to put a ship \[out to sea\] up upon the deep
  **b.** to raise up fortifications
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to lift up one’s soul, raise his spirits
    **1.** to buoy up with hope
    **2.** to inflate with pride
    **3.** to be elated
    **4.** to take one airs, be puffed up with pride
  **b.** by a metaphor taken from ships that are tossed about on the deep by winds and waves
    **1.** to cause one to waver or fluctuate in the mind
    **2.** to agitate or harass with cares
    **3.** to make anxious
s: From a compound of [G3326](G3326) and a collateral form of [G142](G142) or perhaps rather of [G109](G109) (compare “meteor”); to *raise* *in* *mid-air*, that is, (figuratively) *suspend* (passively *fluctuate* or *be* *anxious*): - be of doubtful mind.
o: from a compound of [G3326](G3326) and a collateral form of [G142](G142) or perhaps rather [G109](G109) (cf meteor)

d: **1.** removal from one abode to another, esp. a forced removal
s: From a derivative of a compound of [G3326](G3326) and [G3624](G3624); a *change* *of* *abode*, that is, (specifically) *expatriation:* - X brought, carried (-ying) away (in-) to.
o: from a derivative of a compound of [G3326](G3326) and [G3624](G3624)

d:
**1.** to transfer settlers
**2.** to cause to remove into another land
s: From the same as [G3350](G3350); to *transfer* as a *settler* or *captive*, that is, *colonize* or *exile:* - carry away, remove into.

d: **1.** a sharing, communion, fellowship
s: From [G3348](G3348); *participation*, that is, *intercourse:* - fellowship.

d:
**1.** sharing in, partaking
**2.** a partner (in a work, office, dignity)
s: From [G3348](G3348); *participant*, that is, (as noun) a *sharer*; by implication an *associate:* - fellow, partaker, partner.

d:
**1.** to measure, to measure out or off
  **a.** any space or distance with a measurer’s reed or rule
  **b.** metaph. to judge according to any rule or standard, to estimate
**2.** to measure out, mete out to, i.e. to give by measure
s: From [G3358](G3358); to *measure* (that is, ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication to *admeasure* (that is, allot by rule); figuratively to *estimate:* - measure, mete.

d: **1.** a measurer, the name of a utensil known as a amphora, which is a species of measure used for liquids and containing somewhat less the nine English gallons or about (40 l)
s: From [G3354](G3354); a *measurer*, that is, (specifically) a certain standard *measure* of capacity for liquids: - firkin.

d:
**1.** to be affected moderately or in due measure
**2.** to preserve moderation in the passions, esp. anger or grief
  **a.** of one who is not unduly disturbed by the errors, faults, sins of others, but bears them gently
s: From a compound of the base of [G3357](G3357) and [G3806](G3806); to *be* *moderate* *in* *passion*, that is, *gentle* (to *treat* *indulgently*): - have compassion.
o: from a compound of the base of [G3357](G3357) and [G3806](G3806)

d:
**1.** in due measure
**2.** moderately, exceedingly
s: Adverb from a derivative of [G3358](G3358); *moderately*, that is, *slightly:* - a little.

d:
**1.** measure, an instrument for measuring
  **a.** a vessel for receiving and determining the quantity of things, whether dry or liquid
  **b.** a graduated staff for measuring, a measuring rod
  **c.** proverbially, the rule or standard of judgment
**2.** determined extent, portion measured off, measure or limit
  **a.** the required measure, the due, fit, measure
s: An apparently primary word; a *measure* (“metre”), literally or figuratively; by implication a limited *portion* (*degree*): - measure.

d: **1.** the space between the eyes, the forehead
s:
From [G3326](G3326) and ὤψ
ōps (the *face*); the *forehead* (as *opposite* the *countenance*): - forehead.

d: **1.** as far as, until
s: From [G3372](G3372); as *far* *as*, that is, *up* *to* a certain point (as preposition of extent \[denoting the *terminus*, whereas [G891](G891) refers especially to the *space* of time or place intervening\] or conjugation): - till, (un-) to, until.

d: **1.** no, not lest
s: A primary particle of qualified *negation* (whereas [G3756](G3756) expresses an absolute denial); (adverbially) *not*, (conjugationally) *lest*; also (as interrogitive implying a *negative* answer \[whereas [G3756](G3756) expects an *affirmative* one\]); *whether*: - any, but, (that), X forbear, + God forbid, + lack, lest, neither, never, no (X wise in), none, nor, \[can-\] not, nothing, that not, un \[-taken\], without. Often used in compounds in substantially the same relations. See also [G3362](G3362), [G3363](G3363), [G3364](G3364), [G3372](G3372), [G3373](G3373), [G3375](G3375), [G3378](G3378).
o: a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas [G3756](G3756) expresses an absolute denial)

d: **1.** if not, unless, whoever ... not
s: That is, [G1437](G1437) and [G3361](G3361); *if* *not*, that is, *unless:* - X before, but, except, if no, (if, + whosoever) not.

d: **1.** lest, that ... not
s: That is, [G2443](G2443) and [G3361](G3361); *in* *order* (or so) *that* *not:* - albeit not, lest, that no (-t, \[-thing\]).

d: **1.** never, certainly not, not at all, by no means
s: That is, [G3756](G3756) and [G3361](G3361); a double negative strengthening the denial; *not* *at* *all*: - any more, at all, by any (no) means, neither, never, no (at all), in no case (wise), nor ever, not (at all, in any wise). Compare [G3378](G3378).

d: **1.** by no means
s: Adverb from a compound of [G3361](G3361) and ἀμός amos (*somebody*); *by* *no* *means:* - not so.
o: from a compound of [G3361](G3361) and amos (somebody)

d: **1.** and not, but not, nor, not
s: From [G3361](G3361) and [G1161](G1161); *but* *not*, *not* *even*; in a continued negation, *nor:* - neither, nor (yet), (no) not (once, so much as).

d: **1.** nobody, no one, nothing
s: The masculine, feminine irregular (second form) and neuter (third form) from [G3361](G3361) and [G1520](G1520); *not* *even* *one* (man, woman, thing): - any (man, thing), no (man), none, not (at all, any man, a whit), nothing, + without delay.

d: **1.** never
s: From [G3366](G3366) and [G4218](G4218); *not* *even* *ever:* - never.

d: **1.** not yet
s: From [G3366](G3366) and [G4452](G4452); *not* *even* *yet:* - not yet.

d:
mede or media = middle land
**1.** a mede, a native or inhabitant of media, a well known region of Asia whose chief city was Ecbatana
s: Of foreign origin (compare \[[H4074](H4074)\]); a *Median*, or inhabitant of Media: - Mede.

d: **1.** no longer, no more, not hereafter
s: From [G3361](G3361) and [G2089](G2089); *no* *further:* - any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more.

d: **1.** length
s: Probably akin to [G3173](G3173); *length* (literally or figuratively): - length.

d:
**1.** to make long, to lengthen
**2.** in the Bible twice of plants, to cause to grow, increase
s: From [G3372](G3372); to *lengthen*, that is, (middle voice) to *enlarge:* - grow up.

d:
**1.** a sheepskin
**2.** an outer robe or mantle since most mantles were made of skins
s: From μῆλον mēlon (a *sheep*); a *sheep* *skin:* - sheepskin.

d: **1.** verily, certainly, truly
s: A stronger form of [G3303](G3303); a particle of affirmation (only with [G2229](G2229)); *assuredly:* - + surely.

d:
**1.** a month
**2.** the time of the new moon, new moon (the first day of each month, when the new moon appeared was a festival among the hebrews)
s: A primary word; a *month:* - month.

d:
**1.** to disclose or make known something secret
  **a.** in a forensic sense, to inform, report
**2.** to declare, tell, make known
**3.** to indicate, intimate
  **a.** of a teacher
s: Probably from the same base as [G3145](G3145) and [G3415](G3415) (that is, μάω maō \[to *strive*\]); to *disclose* (through the idea of mental *effort* and thus calling to *mind*), that is, *report*, *declare*, *intimate:* - shew, tell.
o: probably from the same base as [G3145](G3145) and [G3415](G3415) (i.e. mao, to strive)

d: **1.** not, not ever
s: That is, [G3361](G3361) and [G3756](G3756); as interrogitive and negative *is* *it* *not* *that?* : - neither (followed by no), + never, not. Compare [G3364](G3364).

d: **1.** that ... not, lest, whether perhaps, whether or not, in no way, perhaps
s: From [G3361](G3361) and [G4218](G4218); *not* *ever*; also *if* (or *lest*) *ever* (or *perhaps*): - if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not.

d: **1.** not yet
s: From [G3361](G3361) and [G4452](G4452); *not* *yet:* - not yet.

d: **1.** lest, lest somehow, that perhaps
s: From [G3361](G3361) and [G4458](G4458); *lest* *somehow:* - lest (by any means, by some means, haply, perhaps).

d: **1.** thigh
s: Perhaps a primary word; a *thigh:* - thigh.

d: **1.** and not, neither ... nor, not so
s: From [G3361](G3361) and [G5037](G5037); *not* *too*, that is, (in continued negation) *neither* or *nor*; also, *not* *even:* - neither, (n-) or, so much as.

d:
**1.** a mother
**2.** metaph. the source of something, the motherland
s: Apparently a primary word; a “mother” (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote): - mother.

d: **1.** whether, at all, perchance
s: From [G3361](G3361) and the neuter of [G5100](G5100); *whether* *at* *all*: - not \[the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question\].

d:
**1.** to say nothing of, not to mention
  **a.** much less
  **b.** much more, much rather
s: From [G3385](G3385) and [G1065](G1065); *not* *at* *all* *then*, that is, *not* *to* *say* (*the* *rather* *still*): - how much more.

d:
**1.** let no one
**2.** hath any one
s: From [G3361](G3361) and [G5100](G5100); *whether* *any*: - any \[sometimes unexpressed except by the simple interrogative form of the sentence\].

d: **1.** the womb
s: From [G3384](G3384); the *matrix:* - womb.

d: **1.** matricide, the murderer of a mother
s: From [G3384](G3384) and the base of [G257](G257); a *mother* *thresher*, that is, *matricide:* - murderer of mothers.

d: **1.** a metropolis, a chief city
s: From [G3384](G3384) and [G4172](G4172); a *mother* *city*, that is, “metropolis”: - chiefest city.

d: **1.** only one, someone
s: Irregular feminine of [G1520](G1520); *one* or *first:* - a (certain), + agree, first, one, X other.

d:
**1.** to dye with another colour, to stain
**2.** to defile, pollute, sully, contaminate, soil
  **a.** to defile with sins
s: Perhaps a primary verb; to *sully* or *taint*, that is, *contaminate* (ceremonially or morally): - defile.

d:
**1.** that which defiles, defilement
**2.** metaph., vices the foulness of which contaminates one in his intercourse with the ungodly mass of mankind
s: From [G3392](G3392) (“miasma”); (morally) *foulness* (properly the effect): - pollution.

d: **1.** the act of defiling, defilement, pollution
s: From [G3392](G3392); (morally) *contamination* (properly the act): - uncleanness.

d: **1.** that which has been produced by a mixing, a mixture
s: From [G3396](G3396); a *compound:* - mixture.

d: **1.** to mix, mingle
s: A primary verb; to *mix:* - mingle.

d:
**1.** small, little
  **a.** of size: of stature, of length
  **b.** of space
  **c.** of age: less by birth, younger
  **d.** of time: short, brief, a little while, how little!
  **e.** of quantity: i.e. number, amount
  **f.** of rank or influence When translated a little while, the Greek emphasises theshortness of the time interval, oh how little. This phrase usedoften in the NT of the return of christ.
s: Masculine or neuter singular of [G3398](G3398) (as noun); a *small* space of *time* or *degree:* - a (little) (while).
o: masculine or neuter singular of [G3398](G3398) (as noun)

d:
**1.** small, little
  **a.** of size: hence of stature, of length
  **b.** of space
  **c.** of age: less by birth, younger
  **d.** of time: short, brief, a little while, how little!
  **e.** of quantity: i.e. number, amount
  **f.** of rank or influence
s: Apparently a primary word, including the comparative (second form); *small* (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity): - least, less, little, small.

d:
Miletus = pure white fine wool
**1.** a maritime city, now nearly 10 miles (16 km), from the coast of Caria or Ionia, near the mouth of the Maeander and 35 miles (55 km) from Ephesus. It was the mother of about eighty colonies, the the birth place of Thales, Anaximander, and other famous men.
s: Of uncertain origin; *Miletus*, a city of Asia Minor: - Miletus.

d: **1.** a mile, among the Romans the distance of a thousand paces or eight stadia, about 1.5 km \[somewhat less than our mile\]
s: Of Latin origin; a *thousand* paces, that is, a “mile”: - mile.

d: **1.** to imitate: any one
s: Middle voice from μῖμος mimos (a “mimic”); to *imitate:* - follow.

d: **1.** an imitator
s: From [G3401](G3401); an *imitator:* - follower.

d:
**1.** to remind
  **a.** to be recalled or to return to one’s mind, to remind one’s self of, to remember
  **b.** to be recalled to mind, to be remembered, had in remembrance
  **c.** to remember a thing
  **d.** be mindful of
s: A prolonged form of [G3415](G3415) (from which some of the tenses are borrowed); to *remind*, that is, (middle voice) to *recall* *to* *mind:* - be mindful, remember.
o: a prolonged form of [G3415](G3415) (from which some of the tenses are borrowed)

d:
**1.** to hate, pursue with hatred, detest
**2.** to be hated, detested
s: From a primary word μῖσος misos (*hatred*); to *detest* (especially to *persecute*); by extension to *love* *less:* - hate (-ful).

d: **1.** payment of wages due, recompence
s: From [G3406](G3406); *requital* (good or bad): - recompence of reward.

d: **1.** one who pays wages, a rewarder
s: From [G3409](G3409) and [G591](G591); a *remunerator:* - rewarder.

d: **1.** employed for hire, hired
s: From [G3408](G3408); a *wage* *earner:* - hired servant.

d:
**1.** dues paid for work
  **a.** wages, hire
**2.** reward: used of the fruit naturally resulting from toils and endeavours
  **a.** in both senses, rewards and punishments
  **b.** of the rewards which God bestows, or will bestow, upon good deeds and endeavours
  **c.** of punishments

s: Of uncertain affinity; a *kidney* (plural), that is, (figuratively) the inmost *mind:* - reins.

d:
**1.** one who sweeps and cleans a temple
**2.** one who has charge of a temple, to keep and adorn it, a sacristan
**3.** the worshipper of a deity
  **a.** word appears from coins still extant, it was an honourary title \[temple-keeper or temple-warden\] of certain cities, esp. in Asia Minor, or in which some special worship of some deity or even some deified human ruler had been established; used of Ephesus
s: From a form of [G3485](G3485) and κορέω koreō (to *sweep*); a *temple* *servant*, that is, (by implication) a *votary:* - worshipper.
o: from a form of [G3485](G3485) and koreo (to sweep)

d:
**1.** peculiar to an age, of youth, youthful, younger
  **a.** younger (than now)
  **b.** young, youthful
  **c.** younger (by birth)
  **d.** an attendant, servant, inferiority in rank
s: From the compound of [G3501](G3501); *appertaining* *to* *younger* persons, that is, *juvenile:* - youthful.

d:
**1.** by
  **a.** used in the affirmations of oaths
s: Probably an intensive form of [G3483](G3483); a particle of attestation (accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); *as* *sure* *as:* - I protest by.

d: **1.** to spin
s: From νέω neō of like meaning; to *spin:* - spin.

d: **1.** to be a babe (infant)
s: From [G3516](G3516); to *act* as a *babe*, that is, (figuratively) *innocently:* - be a child.

d:
**1.** an infant, little child
**2.** a minor, not of age
**3.** metaph. childish, untaught, unskilled
s: From an obsolete particle νη ne; implying *negation* and [G2031](G2031); *not* *speaking*, that is, an *infant* (*minor*); figuratively a *simple* *minded* person, an *immature* Christian: - babe, child (+ -ish).
o: from an obsolete particle ne- (implying negation) and [G2031](G2031)

d:
Nereus = lump
**1.** a Christian at Rome saluted by Paul
s: Apparently from a derivative of the base of [G3491](G3491) (meaning *wet*); *Nereus*, a Christian: - Nereus.
o: apparently from a derivative of the base of [G3491](G3491) (meaning wet)

d:
Neri = Jehovah is my lamp
**1.** the grandfather of Zerubbabel
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H5374](H5374)\]; *Neri* (that is, *Nerijah*), an Israelite: - Neri.

d: **1.** a small island
s: Diminutive of [G3520](G3520); an *islet:* - island.

d: **1.** an island
s: Probably from the base of [G3491](G3491); an *island:* - island, isle.

d:
**1.** a fasting, fast
  **a.** a voluntary, as a religious exercise
    **1.** of private fasting
    **2.** the public fast as prescribed by the Mosaic Law and kept yearly on the great day of atonement, the tenth of the month of Tisri (the month Tisri comprises a part of our September and October); the fast accordingly, occurred in the autumn when navigation was usually dangerous on account of storms
  **b.** a fasting caused by want or poverty
s: From [G3522](G3522); *abstinence* (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious); specifically the *fast* of the Day of Atonement: - fast (-ing.)

d: **1.** to abstain as a religious exercise from food and drink: either entirely, if the fast lasted but a single day, or from customary and choice nourishment, if it continued several days
s: From [G3523](G3523); to *abstain* from food (religiously): - fast.

d: **1.** fasting, not having eaten
s: From the negative particle νη nē and [G2068](G2068); *not* *eating*, that is, *abstinent* from food (religiously): - fasting.
o: from the insep. negative particle ne- (not) and [G2068](G2068)

d:
**1.** sober, temperate
  **a.** abstaining from wine, either entirely or at least from its immoderate use
  **b.** of things free from all wine, as vessels, offerings
s: From [G3525](G3525); *sober*, that is, (figuratively) *circumspect:* - sober, vigilant.

d:
**1.** to be sober, to be calm and collected in spirit
**2.** to be temperate, dispassionate, circumspect
s: Of uncertain affinity; to *abstain* from wine (*keep* *sober*), that is, (figuratively) *be* *discreet:* - be sober, watch.

d:
Niger = black
**1.** surname of the prophet Simeon
s: Of Latin origin; *black*; *Niger*, a Christian: - Niger.

d:
Nicanor = conqueror
**1.** one of the seven deacons in the church at Jerusalem
s: Probably from [G3528](G3528); *victorious*; *Nicanor*, a Christian: - Nicanor.

d:
**1.** to conquer
  **a.** to carry off the victory, come off victorious
    **1.** of christ, victorious over all his foes
    **2.** of Christians, that hold fast their faith even unto death against the power of their foes, and temptations and persecutions
    **3.** when one is arraigned or goes to law, to win the case, maintain one’s cause
s: From [G3529](G3529); to *subdue* (literally or figuratively): - conquer, overcome, prevail, get the victory.

d: **1.** victory
s: Apparently a primary word; *conquest* (abstractly), that is, (figuratively) the *means* *of* *success:* - victory.

d:
Nicodemus = conqueror
**1.** a member of the Sanhedrin who took the part of Jesus
s: From [G3534](G3534) and [G1218](G1218); *victorious* among his *people*; *Nicodemus*, an Israelite: - Nicodemus.

d:
Nicolaitans = destruction of people
**1.** a sect mentioned in Rev 2:6, Rev 2:15, who were charged with holding the error of Balaam, casting a stumbling block before the church of God by upholding the liberty of eating things sacrificed to idols as well as committing fornication
s: From [G3532](G3532); a *Nicolaite*, that is, adherent of *Nicolaus:* - Nicolaitane.

d:
Nicolas = victor of the people
**1.** was a proselyte of Antioch and one of the seven deacons of the church at Jerusalem
s: From [G3534](G3534) and [G2004](G2004); *victorious* over the *people*; *Nicolaus*, a heretic: - Nicolaus.

d: Nicopolis meaning city of victory
s: From [G3534](G3534) and [G4172](G4172); *victorious* *city*; *Nicopolis*, a place in Macedonia: - Nicopolis.

d:
**1.** victory
**2.** to utterly vanquish
s: From [G3529](G3529); a *conquest* (concretely), that is, (by implication) *triumph:* - victory.

d:
Nineveh = offspring of ease: offspring abiding
**1.** the capital of the ancient kingdom of Assyria
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H5210](H5210)\]; *Ninevi* (that is, *Nineveh*), the capital of Assyria: - Nineve.

d: **1.** a Ninevite, an inhabitant of Nineveh
s: From [G3535](G3535); a *Ninevite*, that is, inhabitant of Nineveh: - of Nineve, Ninevite.

d: **1.** a vessel for washing the hands and the feet, a basin
s: From [G3538](G3538); a *ewer:* - bason.

d:
**1.** to wash
**2.** to wash one’s self
s: To *cleanse* (especially the hands or the feet or the face); ceremonially to *perform* *ablution*: - wash. Compare [G3068](G3068).
o: to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face)

d:
**1.** to perceive with the mind, to understand, to have understanding
**2.** to think upon, heed, ponder, consider
s: From [G3563](G3563); to *exercise* the *mind* (*observe*), that is, (figuratively) to *comprehend*, *heed:* - consider, perceive, think, understand.

d:
**1.** a mental perception, thought
**2.** an evil purpose
**3.** that which thinks, the mind, thoughts or purposes
s: From [G3539](G3539); a *perception*, that is, *purpose*, or (by implication) the *intellect*, *disposition*, itself: - device, mind, thought.

d:
**1.** illegitimate, bastard
**2.** one born, not in lawful wedlock, but of a concubine or female slave
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *spurious* or *illegitimate* son: - bastard.

d:
**1.** pasturage, fodder, food
  **a.** fig. he shall not want the needful supplies for the true life
**2.** growth, increase
  **a.** of evils spreading like a gangrene
  **b.** of ulcers
  **c.** of a conflagration
s: Feminine from the same as [G3551](G3551); *pasture*, that is, (the act) *feeding* (figuratively *spreading* of a gangrene), or (the food) *pasturage:* - X eat, pasture.

d:
**1.** to hold by custom or usage, own as a custom or usage, to follow a custom or usage
  **a.** it is the custom, it is the received usage
**2.** to deem, think, suppose
s: From [G3551](G3551); properly to *do* by *law* (*usage*), that is, to *accustom* (passively *be* *usual*); by extension to *deem* or *regard:* - suppose, think, be wont.

d:
**1.** pertaining to the law, one learned in the law
**2.** in the NT an interpreter and teacher of the Mosaic law
s: From [G3551](G3551); *according* (or *pertaining*) *to* *law*, that is, *legal* (ceremonially); as noun, an *expert* *in* the (Mosaic) *law:* - about the law, lawyer.

d: **1.** lawfully, agreeable to the law, properly
s: Adverb from a derivative of [G3551](G3551); *legitimately* (specifically agreeably to the rules of the lists): - lawfully.

d:
**1.** anything received and sanctioned by usage or law
**2.** money, (current) coin, legal tender
s: From [G3543](G3543); *what* *is* *reckoned* as of value (after the Latin *numisma*), that is, current *coin:* - money.

d:
**1.** a teacher and interpreter of the law: among the Jews
  **a.** of those who among Christians went about as champions and interpreters of the Mosaic law
s: From [G3551](G3551) and [G1320](G1320); an *expounder* *of* the (Jewish) *law*, that is, a *Rabbi:* - doctor (teacher) of the law.

d: **1.** law giving, legislation
s: From [G3550](G3550); *legislation* (specifically the *institution* *of* the Mosaic *code*): - giving of the law.

d:
**1.** to enact laws
  **a.** laws are enacted or prescribed for one, to be legislated for, furnished with laws
**2.** to sanction by law, enact
s: From [G3550](G3550); to *legislate*, that is, (passively) to *have* (the Mosaic) *enactments* injoined, *be* *sanctioned* (by them): - establish, receive the law.

d: **1.** a lawgiver
s: From [G3551](G3551) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087); a *legislator:* - lawgiver.

d:
**1.** anything established, anything received by usage, a custom, a law, a command
  **a.** of any law whatsoever
    **1.** a law or rule producing a state approved of God
  **b.** by the observance of which is approved of God
    **1.** a precept or injunction
    **2.** the rule of action prescribed by reason
  **c.** of the Mosaic law, and referring, acc. to the context. either to the volume of the law or to its contents
  **d.** the Christian religion: the law demanding faith, the moral instruction given by christ, esp. the precept concerning love
  **e.** the name of the more important part (the Pentateuch), is put for the entire collection of the sacred books of the OT
s: From a primary word νέμω nemō (to *parcel* out, especially *food* or *grazing* to animals); *law* (through the idea of prescriptive *usage*), generally (*regulation*), specifically (of Moses \[including the volume\]; also of the Gospel), or figuratively (a *principle*): - law.
o: from a primary nemo (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to animals)

d:
**1.** to be sick
**2.** metaph. of any ailment of the mind
  **a.** to be taken with such an interest in a thing as amounts to a disease, to have a morbid fondness for
s: From [G3554](G3554); to *be* *sick*, that is, (by implication of a diseased appetite) to *hanker* after (figuratively to *harp* upon): - dote.

d: **1.** disease, sickness
s: From [G3552](G3552); an *ailment:* - disease.

d: **1.** disease, sickness
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *malady* (rarely figurative of moral *disability*): - disease, infirmity, sickness.

d:
**1.** a nest of birds
**2.** a brood of birds
s: From [G3502](G3502); a *brood* (of chickens): - brood.

d: **1.** a brood of birds
s: Diminutive of [G3502](G3502); a *birdling:* - chicken.

d:
**1.** to set apart, separate, divide
**2.** to set apart or separate for one’s self
**3.** to purloin, embezzle, withdraw covertly and appropriate to one’s own use
s: Middle voice from νοσφί nosphi (*apart* or *clandestinely*); to *sequestrate* for oneself, that is, *embezzle:* - keep back, purloin.
o: middle voice from nosphi (apart or clandestinely)

d:
**1.** the south wind
**2.** the south, the southern quarter
s: Of uncertain affinity; the *south* (*southwest*) *wind*; by extension the *southern* *quarter* itself: - south (wind).

d: **1.** admonition, exhortation
s: From [G3563](G3563) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087); calling *attention* to, that is, (by implication) mild *rebuke* or *warning:* - admonition.

d: **1.** to admonish, warn, exhort
s: From the same as [G3559](G3559); to *put* *in* *mind*, that is, (by implication) to *caution* or *reprove* gently: - admonish, warn.

d:
**1.** new moon
  **a.** of the Jewish festival of the new moon
s: Feminine of a compound of [G3501](G3501) and [G3376](G3376) (as noun by implication of [G2250](G2250)); the festival of *new* *moon:* - new moon.
o: from of a compound of [G3501](G3501) and [G3376](G3376) (as noun by implication of [G2250](G2250))

d: **1.** wisely, discreetly, prudently
s: Adverb from a compound of the accusative of [G3563](G3563) and [G2192](G2192); in a *mind* *having* way, that is, *prudently:* - discreetly.
o: from a comparative of the accusative case of [G3563](G3563) and [G2192](G2192)

d:
**1.** the mind, comprising alike the faculties of perceiving and understanding and those of feeling, judging, determining
  **a.** the intellectual faculty, the understanding
  **b.** reason in the narrower sense, as the capacity for spiritual truth, the higher powers of the soul, the faculty of perceiving divine things, of recognising goodness and of hating evil
  **c.** the power of considering and judging soberly, calmly and impartially
**2.** a particular mode of thinking and judging, i.e thoughts, feelings, purposes, desires
s: Probably from the base of [G1097](G1097); the *intellect*, that is, *mind* (divine or human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication *meaning*: - mind, understanding. Compare [G5590](G5590).

d:
Nymphas = bridegroom
**1.** a wealthy and zealous Christian in Laodicea
s: Probably contracted for a compound of [G3565](G3565) and [G1435](G1435); *nymph* *given* (that is, *born*); *Nymphas*, a Christian: - Nymphas.
o: probably contracted for a compound of [G3565](G3565) and [G1435](G1435)

d:
**1.** a betrothed woman, a bride
**2.** a recently married woman, young wife
**3.** a young woman
**4.** a daughter-in-law
s: From a primary but obsolete verb νύπτω nuptō (to *veil* as a bride; compare the Latin *“nupto”*, to *marry*); a young *married* woman (as *veiled*), including a *betrothed* girl; by implication, a *son’s* *wife:* - bride, daughter in law.
o: from a primary but obsolete verb nupto (to veil as a bride, cf Latin nupto, to marry)

d: **1.** a bridegroom
s: From [G3565](G3565); a *bride* *groom* (literally or figuratively): - bridegroom.

d:
**1.** the chamber containing the bridal bed, the bridal chamber
  **a.** of the friends of the bridegroom whose duty it was to provide and care for whatever pertained to the bridal chamber, i.e. whatever was needed for the due celebration of the nuptials
  **b.** the room in which the marriage ceremonies are held
s: From [G3565](G3565); the *bridal* room: - bridechamber.

d: **1.** at this time, the present, now
s: A primary particle of present time; “now” (as adverb of date, a transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective *present* or *immediate*: - henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this (time). See also [G3569](G3569), [G3570](G3570).
o: a primary particle of present time

d: **1.** now, the present
s: From neuter plural of [G3588](G3588) and [G3568](G3568); *the* things *now*, that is, (adverb) *at* *present:* - (but) now.

d: **1.** now, at this very moment
s: A prolonged form of [G3568](G3568) for emphasis; *just* *now:* - now.
o: a prolonged form of [G3568](G3568) for emphasis

d:
**1.** night
**2.** metaph. the time when work ceases
  **a.** the time of death
  **b.** the time for deeds of sin and shame
  **c.** the time of moral stupidity and darkness
  **d.** the time when the weary and also the drunken give themselves up to slumber
s: A primary word; “night” (literally or figuratively): - (mid-) night.

d:
**1.** pierce
**2.** to pierce through, transfix
  **a.** often of severe or even deadly wounds given one
s: Apparently a primary word; to *prick* (“nudge”): - pierce.

d:
**1.** to nod in sleep, to sleep
  **a.** to be overcome or oppressed with sleep
  **b.** to fall asleep, drop off to sleep
**2.** to be negligent, careless
  **a.** of a thing i.e. to linger, delay
