s: From a presumed derivative of [G3506](G3506); to *nod*, that is, (by implication) to *fall* *asleep*; figuratively to *delay:* - slumber.

d: **1.** a night and a day, the space of twenty four hours
s: From [G3571](G3571) and [G2250](G2250); a *day* and *night*, that is, full *day* of twenty four hours: - night and day.

d:
Noah = rest
**1.** the tenth in descent from Adam, second father of the human family
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H5146](H5146)\]; *Noe*, (that is, *Noach*), a patriarch: - Noe.

d: **1.** slow, sluggish, indolent, dull, languid
s: From a derivative of [G3541](G3541); *sluggish*, that is, (literally) *lazy*, or (figuratively) *stupid:* - dull, slothful.

d: **1.** the back
s: Of uncertain affinity; the *back:* - back.

d:
**1.** hospitality, hospitable reception
**2.** a lodging place, lodgings
s: From [G3581](G3581); *hospitality*, that is, (by implication) a *place* *of* *entertainment:* - lodging.

d:
**1.** to receive as a guest, to entertain, hospitably
  **a.** to be received hospitably
  **b.** to stay as a guest, to lodge
  **c.** be lodged
**2.** to surprise or astonish by the strangeness and novelty of a thing
  **a.** to think strange, be shocked
s: From [G3581](G3581); to *be* *a* *host* (passively a *guest*); by implication *be* (*make*, *appear*) *strange:* - entertain, lodge, (think it) strange.

d: **1.** to receive and entertain hospitably, to be hospitable
s: From a compound of [G3581](G3581) and [G1209](G1209); to *be* *hospitable:* - lodge strangers.

d:
**1.** a foreigner, a stranger
  **a.** alien (from a person or a thing)
  **b.** without the knowledge of, without a share in
  **c.** new, unheard of
**2.** one who receives and entertains another hospitably
  **a.** with whom he stays or lodges, a host
s: Apparently a primary word; *foreign* (literally *alien*, or figuratively *novel*); by implication a *guest* or (vice-versa) *entertainer:* - host, strange (-r).

d:
**1.** a sextarius
  **a.** a vessel for measuring liquids, holding about a pint (.5 litre)
**2.** a wooden pitcher or ewer from which water or wine is poured, whether holding a sextarius or not
s: As if from ξέω xeō (which properly means to *smooth*; by implication \[of *friction*\] to *boil* or *heat*); a *vessel* (as *fashioned* or for *cooking*), (or perhaps by corruption from the Latin *sextarius*, the *sixth* of a modius, that is, about a *pint*), that is, (specifically) a *measure* for liquids or solids, (by analogy a *pitcher*): - pot.
o: as if from xeo (properly, to smooth, by implication \[of friction\] to boil or heat)

d:
**1.** to make dry, dry up, wither
**2.** to become dry, to be dry, be withered
  **a.** of plants
  **b.** of the ripening of crops
  **c.** of fluids
  **d.** of the members of the body
**3.** to waste away, pine away, i.e. a withered hand
s: From [G3584](G3584); to *desiccate*; by implication to *shrivel*, to *mature:* - dry up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away).

d:
**1.** dry
  **a.** of members of the body deprived of their natural juices, shrunk, wasted, withered
  **b.** of the land in distinction from the water
s: From the base of [G3582](G3582) (through the idea of *scorching*); *arid*; by implication *shrunken*, *earth* (*as* *opposed* *to* *water*): - dry, land, withered.
o: from the base of [G3582](G3582) (through the idea of scorching)

d: **1.** wooden, made of wood
s: From [G3586](G3586); *wooden:* - of wood.

d:
**1.** wood
  **a.** that which is made of wood
    **1.** as a beam from which any one is suspended, a gibbet, a cross
    **2.** a log or timber with holes in which the feet, hands, neck of prisoners were inserted and fastened with thongs
    **3.** a fetter, or shackle for the feet
    **4.** a cudgel, stick, staff
**2.** a tree
s: From another form of the base of [G3582](G3582); *timber* (as fuel or material); by implication a *stick*, *club* or *tree* or other wooden article or substance: - staff, stocks, tree, wood.
o: from another form of the base of [G3582](G3582)

d:
**1.** to shear, shave
**2.** to get one’s self shaved
s: From a derivative of the same as [G3586](G3586) (meaning a *razor*); to *shave* or “shear” the hair: - shave.
o: from a derivative of the same as [G3586](G3586) (meaning a razor)

d: **1.** this, that, these, etc.
s: The masculine, feminine (second) and neuter (third) forms, in all their inflections; the definite article; *the* (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom): - the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.
o: in all their inflections, the definite article

d: **1.** eighty
s: From [G3590](G3590); *ten* *times* *eight:* - fourscore.

d: **1.** the eighth
s: From [G3638](G3638); the *eighth:* - eighth.

d:
**1.** whatever is prominent, protuberance, bulk, mass
  **a.** hence a burden, weight, encumbrance
s: Probably from the same as [G43](G43); a *mass* (as *bending* or *bulging* by its load), that is, *burden* (*hindrance*): - weight.

d: **1.** this one here, these things, as follows, thus
s: The masculine, feminine (second) and neuter (third) forms. From [G3588](G3588) and [G1161](G1161); the *same*, that is, *this* or *that* one (plural *these* or *those*); often used as personal pronoun: - he, she, such, these, thus.

d: **1.** to travel, journey
s: From [G3598](G3598); to *travel:* - journey.

d:
**1.** to be a guide, lead on one’s way, to guide
**2.** to be a guide or a teacher
  **a.** to give guidance to
s: From [G3595](G3595); to *show* the *way* (literally or figuratively \[*teach*\]): - guide, lead.

d:
**1.** a leader of the way, a guide
**2.** a teacher of the ignorant and inexperienced
s: From [G3598](G3598) and [G2233](G2233); a *conductor* (literally or figuratively \[*teacher*\]): - guide, leader.

d: **1.** to travel, journey
s: From a compound of [G3598](G3598) and [G4198](G4198); to *be* *a* *wayfarer*, that is, *travel:* - go on a journey.

d: **1.** a journey, journeying
s: From the same as [G3596](G3596); *travel:* - journey (-ing).

d:
**1.** properly
  **a.** a way
    **1.** a travelled way, road
  **b.** a travellers way, journey, travelling
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** a course of conduct
  **b.** a way (i.e. manner) of thinking, feeling, deciding
s: Apparently a primary word; a *road*; by implication a *progress* (the route, act or distance); figuratively a *mode* or *means:* - journey, (high-) way.

d: **1.** a tooth
s: Perhaps from the base of [G2068](G2068); a “tooth”: - tooth.

d:
**1.** to cause intense pain
**2.** to be in anguish, be tormented
**3.** to torment or distress one’s self
s: From [G3601](G3601); to *grieve:* - sorrow, torment.

d: **1.** consuming grief, pain, sorrow
s: From [G1416](G1416); *grief* (as *dejecting*): - sorrow.

d: **1.** wailing, lamentation, mourning
s: From a derivative of the base of [G1416](G1416); *moaning*, that is, *lamentation:* - mourning.
o: from a derivative of the base of [G1416](G1416)

d: **1.** which is, that is
s: From the neuter of [G3739](G3739) and the third person singular present indicative of [G1510](G1510); *which* *is:* - called, which is (make), that is (to say).
o: from the neuter of [G3739](G3739) and the third person singular present ind. of [G1510](G1510)

d:
Uzziah = strength of Jehovah
**1.** son of amaziah, king of Judah from B.C. 810 - 758
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H5818](H5818)\]; *Ozias* (that is, *Uzzijah*), an Israelite: - Ozias.

d:
**1.** to give out an odour (either good or bad), to smell, emit a smell
  **a.** of a decaying corpse
s: A primary verb (in a strengthened form); to *scent* (usually an ill “oder”): - stink.
o: a root word (in a strengthened form)

d:
**1.** from which, whence
  **a.** of the place from which
  **b.** of the source from which a thing is known, from which, whereby
  **c.** of the cause from which, for which reason, wherefore, on which account
s: From [G3739](G3739) with the directive enclitic of source; *from* *which* place or source or cause (adverbially or conjugationally): - from thence, (from) whence, where (-by, -fore, -upon).
o: from [G3739](G3739) with the directive enclitic of source

d:
**1.** linen (i.e. fine white linen for women’s clothing)
**2.** linen clothes (sheet or sail)
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *linen* cloth, that is, (especially) a *sail:* - sheet.

d:
**1.** a piece of linen, small linen cloth
**2.** strips of linen cloth for swathing the dead
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G3607](G3607); a linen *bandage:* - linen clothes.

d:
**1.** belonging to a house or family, domestic, intimate
  **a.** belonging to one’s household, related by blood, kindred
  **b.** belonging to the household of God
  **c.** belonging, devoted to, adherents of a thing
s: From [G3624](G3624); *domestic*, that is, (as noun), a *relative*, *adherent:* - (those) of the (his own) house (-hold).

d:
**1.** one who lives in the same house as another, spoken of all who are under the authority of one and the same householder
  **a.** a servant, a domestic
s: From [G3611](G3611); a fellow *resident*, that is, menial *domestic:* - (household) servant.

d: **1.** to dwell in
s: From [G3624](G3624); to *occupy* *a* *house* that is, *reside* (figuratively *inhabit*, *remain*, *inhere*); by implication to *cohabit:* - dwell. See also [G3625](G3625).

d:
**1.** a dwelling place, habitation
**2.** euphemistically a prison
s: From [G3611](G3611); a *tenement*, that is, (specifically) a *jail:* - prison.

d:
**1.** a dwelling place, habitation
  **a.** of the body as a dwelling place for the spirit
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G3611](G3611) (equivalent to [G3612](G3612)); a *residence* (literally or figuratively): - habitation, house.
o: from a presumed derivative of [G3611](G3611) (equivalent to [G3612](G3612))

d:
**1.** a house
  **a.** an inhabited edifice, a dwelling
  **b.** the inmates of a house, the family
  **c.** property, wealth, goods
s: From [G3624](G3624); properly *residence* (abstractly), but usually (concretely) an *abode* (literally or figuratively); by implication a *family* (especially *domestics*): - home, house (-hold).

d:
**1.** one belonging to the house
**2.** one under control of the master of a house, whether a son or a servant
s: From [G3614](G3614); *familiar*, that is, (as noun) *relatives:* - they (them) of (his own) household.

d:
**1.** to be master (or head) of a house
**2.** to rule a household, manage family affairs
s: From [G3617](G3617); to *be* the *head* *of* (that is, *rule*) *a* *family:* - guide the house.

d: **1.** master of the house, householder
s: From [G3624](G3624) and [G1203](G1203); *the* *head* *of* *a* *family:* - goodman (of the house), householder, master of the house.

d:
**1.** to build a house, erect a building
  **a.** to build (up from the foundation)
  **b.** to restore by building, to rebuild, repair
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to found, establish
  **b.** to promote growth in Christian wisdom, affection, grace, virtue, holiness, blessedness
  **c.** to grow in wisdom and piety
s: From the same as [G3619](G3619); to *be* a *house* *builder*, that is, *construct* or (figuratively) *confirm:* - (be in) build (-er, -ing, up), edify, embolden.

d:
**1.** (the act of) building, building up
**2.** metaph. edifying, edification
  **a.** the act of one who promotes another’s growth in Christian wisdom, piety, happiness, holiness
**3.** a building (i.e. the thing built, edifice)
s: Feminine (abstraction) of a compound of [G3624](G3624) and the base of [G1430](G1430); *architecture*, that is, (concretely) a *structure*; figuratively *confirmation:* - building, edify (-ication, -ing).
o: feminine (abstract) of a compound of [G3624](G3624) and the base of [G1430](G1430)

d: **1.** (the act of) building, erection
s: From the same as [G3619](G3619); *confirmation:* - edifying.

d:
**1.** to be a steward
**2.** to manage the affairs of a household
**3.** to manage, dispense, order, regulate
s: From [G3623](G3623); to *manage* (a house, that is, an estate): - be steward.

d:
**1.** the management of a household or of household affairs
  **a.** specifically, the management, oversight, administration, of other’s property
  **b.** the office of a manager or overseer, stewardship
  **c.** administration, dispensation
s: From [G3623](G3623); *administration* (of a household or estate); specifically a (religious) “economy”: - dispensation, stewardship.

d:
**1.** the manager of household or of household affairs
  **a.** esp. a steward, manager, superintendent (whether free-born or as was usually the case, a freed-man or a slave) to whom the head of the house or proprietor has intrusted the management of his affairs, the care of receipts and expenditures, and the duty of dealing out the proper portion to every servant and even to the children not yet of age
  **b.** the manager of a farm or landed estate, an overseer
  **c.** the superintendent of the city’s finances, the treasurer of a city (or of treasurers or quaestors of kings)
**2.** metaph. the apostles and other Christian teachers and bishops and overseers
s: From [G3624](G3624) and the base of [G3551](G3551); a *house* *distributor* (that is, *manager*), or *overseer*, that is, an employee in that capacity; by extension a fiscal *agent* (*treasurer*); figuratively a *preacher* (of the Gospel): - chamberlain, governor, steward.

d:
**1.** a house
  **a.** an inhabited house, home
  **b.** any building whatever
    **1.** of a palace
    **2.** the house of God, the tabernacle
  **c.** any dwelling place
    **1.** of the human body as the abode of demons that possess it
    **2.** of tents, and huts, and later, of the nests, stalls, lairs, of animals
    **3.** the place where one has fixed his residence, one’s settled abode, domicile
**2.** the inmates of a house, all the persons forming one family, a household
  **a.** the family of God, of the Christian Church, of the church of the Old and New Testaments
**3.** stock, family, descendants of one
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *dwelling* (more or less extensive, literally or figuratively); by implication a *family* (more or less related, literally or figuratively): - home, house (-hold), temple.

d:
**1.** the inhabited earth
  **a.** the portion of the earth inhabited by the Greeks, in distinction from the lands of the barbarians
  **b.** the Roman empire, all the subjects of the empire
  **c.** the whole inhabited earth, the world
  **d.** the inhabitants of the earth, men
**2.** the universe, the world
s: Feminine participle present passive of [G3611](G3611) (as noun, by implication of [G1093](G1093)); *land*, that is, the (terrene part of the) *globe*; specifically the Roman *empire:* - earth, world.
o: feminine participle present passive of [G3611](G3611) (as noun, by implication of [G1093](G1093))

d:
**1.** caring for the house, working at home
  **a.** the (watch or) keeper of the house
  **b.** keeping at home and taking care of household affairs
  **c.** a domestic
s: From [G3624](G3624) and οὖρος ouros (a *guard*; be “ware”); a *stayer* *at* *home*, that is, *domestically* *inclined* (a “good housekeeper”): - keeper at home.
o: from [G3624](G3624) and ouros (a guard, be ware)

d: **1.** to pity, have compassion on
s: Also in certain tenses οἰκτερέω oiktereō *oyk-ter-eh’-o*; from οἰκτος oiktos (*pity*); to *exercise* *pity:* - have compassion on.

d:
**1.** compassion, pity, mercy
  **a.** bowels in which compassion resides, a heart of compassion
  **b.** emotions, longings, manifestations of pity
s: From [G3627](G3627); *pity:* - mercy.

d: **1.** merciful
s: From [G3627](G3627); *compassionate:* - merciful, of tender mercy.

d: **1.** a winebibber, given to wine, a wino
s: From [G3631](G3631) and a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095); a *tippler:* - winebibber.
o: from [G3631](G3631) and a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095)

d:
**1.** wine
**2.** metaph. fiery wine of God’s wrath
s: A primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin \[[H3196](H3196)\]); “wine” (literally or figuratively): - wine.
o: a primary word (or perhaps of hebrew origin [H3196](H3196))

d: **1.** drunkenness
s: From [G3631](G3631) and a form of the base of [G5397](G5397); an *overflow* (or surplus) of *wine*, that is, *vinolency* (*drunkenness*): - excess of wine.
o: from [G3631](G3631) and a form of the base of [G5397](G5397)

d: **1.** to suppose, think
s: Middle voice apparently from [G3634](G3634); to *make* *like* (oneself), that is, *imagine* (*be* *of* the *opinion*): - suppose, think.

d: **1.** what sort of, what manner of, such as
s: Probably akin to [G3588](G3588), [G3739](G3739), and [G3745](G3745); *such* or *what* *sort* of (as a correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverb) with the negative not *so:* - so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.

d:
**1.** to feel loath, to be slow
**2.** to delay, hesitate
s: From ὄκνος oknos (*hesitation*); to *be* *slow* (figuratively *loath*): - delay.

d: **1.** sluggish, slothful, backward
s: From [G3635](G3635); *tardy*, that is, *indolent*; (figuratively) *irksome:* - grievous, slothful.

d:
**1.** eight days old
**2.** passing the eighth day
s: From [G3638](G3638) and [G2250](G2250); an *eight* *day* old person or act: - the eighth day.

d: **1.** eight
s: A primary numeral; “eight”: - eight.

d:
**1.** ruin, destroy, death
  **a.** for the destruction of the flesh, said of the external ills and troubles by which the lusts of the flesh are subdued and destroyed
s: From ὄλλυμι ollumi a primary word (to *destroy*; a prolonged form); *ruin*, that is, *death*, *punishment:* - destruction.
o: from a primary ollumi (to destroy, a prolonged form)

d: **1.** of little faith, trusting too little
s: From [G3641](G3641) and [G4102](G4102); *incredulous*, that is, *lacking* *confidence* (in Christ): - of little faith.

d:
**1.** little, small, few
  **a.** of number: multitude, quantity, or size
  **b.** of time: short
  **c.** of degree or intensity: light, slight
s: Of uncertain affinity; *puny* (in extent, degree, number, duration or value); especially neuter (adverbially) *somewhat:* - + almost, brief \[-ly\], few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.

d: **1.** fainthearted
s: From [G3641](G3641) and [G5590](G5590); *little* *spirited*, that is, *faint* *hearted:* - feebleminded.

d: **1.** to care little for, regard lightly, make small account
s: From a compound of [G3641](G3641) and ὤρα ōra (“care”); to *have* *little* *regard* for, that is, to *disesteem:* - despise.
o: from a compound of [G3641](G3641) and ora (care)

d: **1.** a destroyer
s: From [G3645](G3645); a *ruiner*, that is, (specifically) a venomous *serpent:* - destroyer.

d: **1.** to destroy
s: From [G3639](G3639); to *spoil*, that is, *slay:* - destroy.

d:
**1.** a whole burnt offering
  **a.** a victim the whole (and not like other victims only a part) of which was burned
s: From a derivative of a compound of [G3650](G3650) and a derivative of [G2545](G2545); a *wholly* *consumed* sacrifice (“holocaust”): - (whole) burnt offering.
o: from a derivative of a compound of [G3650](G3650) and a derivative of [G2545](G2545)

d:
**1.** of an unimpaired condition of the body, in which all its members are healthy and fit for use
  **a.** good health
s: From [G3648](G3648); *integrity*, that is, physical *wholeness:* - perfect soundness.

d:
**1.** complete in all its parts, in no part wanting or unsound, complete, entire, whole
  **a.** of a body without blemish or defect, whether of a priest or of a victim
  **b.** free from sin, faultless
  **c.** complete in all respects, consummate
s: From [G3650](G3650) and [G2819](G2819); *complete* in every *part*, that is, perfectly *sound* (in body): - entire, whole.

d:
**1.** to howl, wail, lament
  **a.** of a loud cry whether for joy or of grief
s: A reduplicated primary verb; to “howl” or “halloo”, that is, *shriek:* - howl.

d: **1.** all, whole, completely
s: A primary word; “whole” or “all”, that is, *complete* (in extent, amount, time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb: - all, altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.

d: **1.** perfect, complete in all respects
s: From [G3650](G3650) and [G5056](G5056); *complete* to the *end*, that is, *absolutely* *perfect:* - wholly.

d:
Olympas = heavenly
**1.** a Christian at Rome
s: Probably a contraction from Ὀλυμπιόδωρος Ŏlumpiodōros (*Olympian* *bestowed*, that is, *heaven* *descended*); *Olympas*, a Christian: - Olympas.
o: probably a contraction from Olumpiodoros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e. heaven-descended)

d: **1.** an unripe fig which grows during the winter, yet does not come to maturity but falls off in the spring
s: Of uncertain derivative; an *unripe* (because out of season) *fig:* - untimely fig.

d: **1.** wholly, altogether
s: Adverb from [G3650](G3650); *completely*, that is, *altogether*; (by analogy) *everywhere*; (negative) not *by* *any* *means:* - at all, commonly, utterly.

d:
**1.** a shower
  **a.** a violent storm, accompanied by high wind with thunder and lightning
s: Of uncertain affinity; a thunder *storm:* - shower.

d:
**1.** to be in company with
**2.** to associate with
**3.** to stay with
**4.** to converse with, talk about: with one
s: From [G3658](G3658); to *be* *in* *company* with, that is, (by implication) to *converse:* - commune, talk.

d: **1.** companionship, intercourse, communion
s: From [G3658](G3658); *companionship* (“homily”), that is, (by implication) *intercourse:* - communication.

d: **1.** a multitude of men gathered together, a crowd, a throng
s: From the base of [G3674](G3674) and a derivative of the alternate of [G138](G138) (meaning a *crowd*); *association* *together*, that is, a *multitude:* - company.
o: from the base of [G3674](G3674) and a derivative of the alternate of [G138](G138) (meaning a crowd)

d: **1.** an eye
s: From [G3700](G3700); a *sight*, that is, (by implication) the *eye:* - eye.

d:
**1.** to swear
**2.** to affirm, promise, threaten, with an oath
**3.** in swearing to call a person or thing as witness, to invoke, swear by
s: A prolonged form of a primary but obsolete word, ὄμω omō, for which another prolonged form (ὀμόω omoō  *om-o’-o*) is used in certain tenses. To *swear*, that is, *take* (or *declare* *on*) *oath:* - swear.
o: a prolonged form of a primary but obsolete omo, for which another prolonged form (omoo om-o’-o) is used in certain tenses

d: **1.** with one mind, with one accord, with one passion A unique Greek word, used 10 of its 12 New Testament occurrences inthe Book of Acts, helps us understand the uniqueness of the Christiancommunity. Homothumadon is a compound of two words meaning to rushalong and in unison. The image is almost musical; a number ofnotes are sounded which, while different, harmonise in pitch andtone. As the instruments of a great concert under the direction of aconcert master, so the holy spirit blends together the lives ofmembers of christ’s church.
s: Adverb from a compound of the base of [G3674](G3674) and [G2372](G2372); *unanimously:* - with one accord (mind).
o: from a compound of the base of [G3674](G3674) and [G2372](G2372)

d: **1.** to be like
s: From [G3664](G3664); to *resemble:* - agree.

d: **1.** suffering the like with another, of like feelings or affections
s: From [G3664](G3664) and the alternate of [G3958](G3958); *similarly* *affected:* - of (subject to) like passions.

d:
**1.** like, similar, resembling
  **a.** like: i.e. resembling
  **b.** like: i.e. corresponding to a thing
s: From the base of [G3674](G3674); *similar* (in appearance or character): - like, + manner.

d: **1.** likeness
s: From [G3664](G3664); *resemblance:* - like as, similitude.

d:
**1.** to be made like
**2.** to liken, compare
  **a.** illustrate by comparisons
s: From [G3664](G3664); to *assimilate*, that is, *compare*; passively to *become* *similar:* - be (make) like, (in the) liken (-ess), resemble.

d:
**1.** that which has been made after the likeness of something
  **a.** a figure, image, likeness, representation
  **b.** likeness i.e. resemblance, such as amounts almost to equality or identity
s: From [G3666](G3666); a *form*; abstractly *resemblance:* - made like to, likeness, shape, similitude.

d: **1.** likewise, equally, in the same way
s: Adverb from [G3664](G3664); *similarly:* - likewise, so.

d:
**1.** a making like
**2.** likeness: after the likeness of God
s: From [G3666](G3666); *assimilation*, that is, *resemblance:* - similitude.

d:
**1.** to say the same thing as another, i.e. to agree with, assent
**2.** to concede
  **a.** not to refuse, to promise
  **b.** not to deny
    **1.** to confess
    **2.** declare
    **3.** to confess, i.e. to admit or declare one’s self guilty of what one is accused of
**3.** to profess
  **a.** to declare openly, speak out freely
  **b.** to profess one’s self the worshipper of one
**4.** to praise, celebrate
s: From a compound of the base of [G3674](G3674) and [G3056](G3056); to *assent*, that is, *covenant*, *acknowledge:* - con- (pro-) fess, confession is made, give thanks, promise.
o: from a compound of the base of [G3674](G3674) and [G3056](G3056)

d:
**1.** profession
  **a.** subjectively: whom we profess to be ours
  **b.** objectively: profession \[confession\] i.e. what one professes \[confesses\]
s: From the same as [G3670](G3670); *acknowledgment:* - con- (pro-) fession, professed.

d: **1.** by consent of all, confessedly, without controversy
s: Adverb of present passive participle of [G3670](G3670); *confessedly:* - without controversy.

d: **1.** practising the same trade or craft, of the same trade
s: From the base of [G3674](G3674) and [G5078](G5078); a *fellow* *artificer:* - of the same craft.

d: **1.** together: of persons assembled together
s: Genitive case of ὁμός homos (the *same*; akin to [G260](G260)) as adverb; *at* the *same* place or time: - together.
o: genitive case of homos (the same, akin to [G260](G260)) as adv

d: **1.** of one mind, concordant
s: From the base of [G3674](G3674) and [G5424](G5424); *like* *minded*, that is, *harmonious:* - of one mind.

d: **1.** nevertheless, yet
s: Adverb from the base of [G3674](G3674); *at* the *same* time, that is, (conjugationally) *notwithstanding*, *yet* *still:* - and even, nevertheless, though but.

d: **1.** a dream
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *dream:* - dream.

d: **1.** a little ass
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G3688](G3688); a *little* *ass:* - young ass.

d:
**1.** to reproach, upbraid, revile
  **a.** of deserved reproach
  **b.** of undeserved reproach, to revile
  **c.** to upbraid, cast (favours received) in one’s teeth
s: From [G3681](G3681); to *defame*, that is, *rail* *at*, *chide*, *taunt:* - cast in teeth, (suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid.

d:
**1.** a reproach
  **a.** such as christ suffered, for the cause of God, from his enemies
s: From [G3679](G3679); *contumely:* - reproach.

d:
**1.** reproach
**2.** shame
s: Probably akin to the base of [G3686](G3686); *notoriety*, that is, a *taunt* (*disgrace*): - reproach.
o: probably akin to the base of [G3686](G3686)

d:
onesimus = profitable or useful
**1.** a Christian slave of Philemon
s: From [G3685](G3685); *profitable*; *Onesimus*, a Christian: - Onesimus.

d:
onesiphorus = bringing profit
**1.** the name of a certain Christian in 2Ti 1:16-18, 2Ti 4:19
s: From a derivative of [G3685](G3685) and [G5411](G5411); *profit* *bearer*; *Onesiphorus*, a Christian: - Onesiphorus.

d:
**1.** of or for an ass, turned by an ass
  **a.** these beasts were often employed to turn millstones
s: From [G3688](G3688); *belonging* *to* an *ass*, that is, *large* (so as to be turned by an ass): - millstone.

d:
**1.** to be useful, to profit, help
**2.** to receive profit or advantage, be helped \[or have joy\]
s: A prolonged form of an apparent primary verb ὄνομαι onomai; for which another prolonged form ὀνάω onaō is used as an alternate in some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of [G3686](G3686) through the idea of *notoriety*); to *gratify*, that is, (middle voice) to *derive* *pleasure* or *advantage* from: - have joy.
o: a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (onomai, to slur), for which another prolonged form (onao) is used as an alternate in some tenses \[unless indeed it be identical with the base of [G3686](G3686) through the idea of notoriety\]

d:
**1.** name: univ. of proper names
**2.** the name is used for everything which the name covers, everything the thought or feeling of which is aroused in the mind by mentioning, hearing, remembering, the name, i.e. for one’s rank, authority, interests, pleasure, command, excellences, deeds etc.
**3.** persons reckoned up by name
**4.** the cause or reason named: on this account, because he suffers as a Christian, for this reason
s: From a presumed derivative of the base of [G1097](G1097) (compare [G3685](G3685)); a “name” (literally or figuratively), (*authority*, *character*): - called, (+ sur-) name (-d).
o: from a presumed derivative of the base of [G1097](G1097) (cf [G3685](G3685))

d:
**1.** to name
  **a.** to name, to utter, to make mention of the name
  **b.** to name
    **1.** give name to, one
    **2.** be named
  **c.** to bear the name of a person or thing
  **d.** to utter the name of a person or thing
s: From [G3686](G3686); to *name*, that is, *assign* *an* *appellation*; by extension to *utter*, *mention*, *profess:* - call, name.

d: **1.** an ass
s: Apparently a primary word; a *donkey:* - ass.

d:
**1.** truly, in reality, in point of fact, as opp. to what is pretended, fictitious, false, conjectural
**2.** that which is truly etc., that which is indeed
s: Adverb of the oblique cases of [G5607](G5607); *really:* - certainly, clean, indeed, of a truth, verily.

d:
**1.** vinegar
  **a.** the mixture of sour wine or vinegar and water which the Roman soldiers were accustomed to drink
s: From [G3691](G3691); *vinegar*, that is, *sour* wine: - vinegar.

d:
**1.** sharp
**2.** swift, quick
s: Probably akin to the base of [G188](G188) (“acid”); *keen*; by analogy *rapid:* - sharp, swift.
o: probably akin to the base of [G188](G188) \[acid\]

d:
**1.** through which one can see, an opening, an aperture
  **a.** of a window
  **b.** of fissures in the earth
  **c.** of caves in rocks or mountains, holes
s: Probably from [G3700](G3700); a *hole* (as if for light), that is, *cavern*; by analogy a *spring* (of water): - cave, place.

d: **1.** from behind, on the back, behind, after
s: From ὄπις opis (*regard*; from [G3700](G3700)) with enclitic of source; *from* *the* *rear* (as a secure *aspect*), that is, *at* the *back* (adverb and preposition of palce or time): - after, backside, behind.
o: from opis (regard, from [G3700](G3700)) with enclitic of source

d:
**1.** back, behind, after, afterwards
  **a.** of place: things that are behind
  **b.** of time: after
s: From the same as [G3693](G3693) with enclitic of direction; *to* the *back*, that is, *aback* (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun): - after, back (-ward), (+ get) behind, + follow.
o: from the same as [G3693](G3693) with enclitic of direction

d:
**1.** to arm, furnish with arms
**2.** to provide
**3.** to furnish one’s self with a thing (as with arms)
**4.** metaph. take on the same mind
s: From [G3696](G3696); to *equip* (with weapons \[middle voice and figuratively\]): - arm self.

d:
**1.** any tool or implement for preparing a thing
  **a.** arms used in warfare, weapons
**2.** an instrument
s: Probably from the primary word ἕπω hepō(to be *busy* about); an *implement* or *utensil* or *tool* (literally or figuratively, especially offensive for war): - armour, instrument, weapon.
o: probably from a primary hepo (to be busy about)

d: **1.** of what sort or quality, what manner of
s: From [G3739](G3739) and [G4169](G4169); of *what* kind *that*, that is, *how* (*as*) *great* (*excellent*) (specifically as indefinite correlation to antecedent definitely [G5108](G5108) of quality): - what manner (sort) of, such as, whatsoever.

d: **1.** when
s: From [G3739](G3739) and [G4218](G4218); *what* (-ever) *then*, that is, (of time) *as* *soon* *as:* - when.

d: **1.** where, whereas
s: From [G3739](G3739) and [G4225](G4225); *what* (-ever) *where*, that is, *at* *whichever* spot: - in what place, where (-as, -soever), whither (+ soever).

d:
**1.** to look at, behold
**2.** to allow one’s self to be seen, to appear
s: The first a (middle voice) prolonged form of the second (primary) which is used for it in certain tenses; and both as alternates of [G3708](G3708); to *gaze* (that is, with wide open eyes, as at something remarkable; and thus differing from [G991](G991), which denotes simply *voluntary* observation; and from [G1492](G1492), which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual vision; while [G2300](G2300), and still more emphatically its intensive [G2334](G2334), signifies an earnest but more continued *inspection*; and [G4648](G4648) a watching *from* *a* *distance*): - appear, look, see, shew self.
o: a (middle voice) prolonged form of the primary (middle voice) optomai op’-tom-ahee, which is used for it in certain tenses, and both as alternate of [G3708](G3708)

d:
**1.** the act of exhibiting one’s self to view
**2.** a sight, a vision, an appearance presented to one whether asleep or awake
s: From a presumed derivative of [G3700](G3700); *visuality*, that is, (concretely) an *apparition:* - vision.

d: **1.** cooked, broiled
s:
From an obsolete verb akin to ἕψω
hepsō (to “*steep*”); *cooked*, that is, *roasted:* - broiled.
o: from an obsolete verb akin to hepso (to steep)

d:
**1.** the season which succeeds summer, from the rising of Sirius to that of Arcturus, i.e. from late summer, early autumn, our dog days
**2.** ripe fruits (of trees)
s: Apparently from the base of [G3796](G3796) and [G5610](G5610); properly *even* *tide* of the (summer) season (*dog* *days*), that is, (by implication) *ripe* fruit: - fruit.
o: apparently from the base of [G3796](G3796) and [G5610](G5610)

d: **1.** how, that
s: From [G3739](G3739) nad [G4459](G4459); *what* (-ever) *how*, that is, *in* the *manner* *that* (as adverb or conjugation of coincidence, intentional or actual): - because, how, (so) that, to, when.

d:
**1.** that which is seen, spectacle
**2.** a sight divinely granted in an ecstasy or in a sleep, a vision
s: From [G3708](G3708); *something* *gazed* *at*, that is, a *spectacle* (especially supernatural): - sight, vision.

d:
**1.** the act of seeing
  **a.** the sense of sight, the eyes
**2.** appearance, visible form
**3.** a vision
  **a.** an appearance divinely granted in an ecstasy or dream
s: From [G3708](G3708); the act of *gazing*, that is, (external) an *aspect* or (internal) an inspired *appearance:* - sight, vision.

d: **1.** visible, open to view
s: From [G3708](G3708); *gazed* *at*, that is, (by implication) *capable* *of* *being* *seen:* - visible.

d:
**1.** to see with the eyes
**2.** to see with the mind, to perceive, know
**3.** to see, i.e. become acquainted with by experience, to experience
**4.** to see, to look to
  **a.** to take heed, beware
  **b.** to care for, pay heed to
**5.** I was seen, showed myself, appeared
s: Properly to *stare* at (compare [G3700](G3700)), that is, (by implication) to *discern* clearly (physically or mentally); by extension to *attend* to; by Hebraism to *experience*; passively to *appear:* - behold, perceive, see, take heed.

d:
**1.** anger, the natural disposition, temper, character
**2.** movement or agitation of the soul, impulse, desire, any violent emotion, but esp. anger
**3.** anger, wrath, indignation
**4.** anger exhibited in punishment, hence used for punishment itself
  **a.** of punishments inflicted by magistrates
s: From [G3713](G3713); properly *desire* (as a *reaching* forth or *excitement* of the mind), that is, (by analogy) violent *passion* (*ire*, or \[justifiable\] *abhorrence*); by implication *punishment:* - anger, indignation, vengeance, wrath.

d:
**1.** to provoke, to arouse to anger
**2.** to be provoked to anger, be angry, be wroth
s: From [G3709](G3709); to *provoke* or *enrage*, that is, (passively) *become* *exasperated:* - be angry (wroth).

d: **1.** prone to anger, irascible
s: From [G3709](G3709); *irascible:* - soon angry.

d: **1.** fathom, the distance across the breast from the tip of one middle finger to the tip of the other when the arms are outstretched, 5 to 6 feet (2 m)
s: From [G3713](G3713); a *stretch* of the arms, that is, a *fathom:* - fathom.

d:
**1.** to stretch one’s self out in order to touch or to grasp something, to reach after or desire something
**2.** to give one’s self up to the love of money
s: Middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary (compare [G3735](G3735)); to *stretch* oneself, that is, *reach* out after (*long* for): - covet after, desire.
o: middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary \[cf [G3735](G3735)\]

d:
**1.** mountainous, hilly
**2.** the mountain district, hill country
s: From [G3735](G3735); *mountainous*, that is, (feminine by implication of [G5561](G5561)) the *Highlands* (of Judaea): - hill country.

d:
**1.** desire, longing, craving for
**2.** eager desire, lust, appetite
  **a.** used both in a good and a bad sense, as well of natural and lawful and even of proper cravings (of appetite for food), also of corrupt and unlawful desires
s: From [G3713](G3713); *excitement* of the mind, that is, *longing* after: - lust.

d:
**1.** to walk in a straight course
**2.** metaph. to act uprightly
s: From a compound of [G3717](G3717) and [G4228](G4228); to *be* *straight* *footed*, that is, (figuratively) to *go* *directly* forward: - walk uprightly.

d:
**1.** straight, erect
  **a.** upright
  **b.** straight, not crooked
s: Probably from the base of [G3735](G3735); *right* (as *rising*), that is, (perpendicularly) *erect* (figuratively *honest*), or (horizontally) *level* or *direct:* - straight, upright.

d:
**1.** to cut straight, to cut straight ways
  **a.** to proceed on straight paths, hold a straight course, equiv. to doing right
**2.** to make straight and smooth, to handle aright, to teach the truth directly and correctly
s: From a compound of [G3717](G3717) and the base of [G5114](G5114); to *make* a *straight* *cut*, that is, (figuratively) to *dissect* (*expound*) *correctly* (the divine message): - rightly divide.
o: from a compound of [G3717](G3717) and the base of [G5114](G5114)

d: **1.** to rise early in the morning
s: From [G3722](G3722); to *use* the *dawn*, that is, (by implication) to *repair* *betimes:* - come early in the morning.

d: **1.** early
s: From [G3722](G3722); *relating* *to* the *dawn*, that is, *matutinal* (as an epithet of Venus, especially brilliant in the early day): - morning.

d:
**1.** early
**2.** rising at the first dawn or very early in the morning
s: From [G3722](G3722); *in* the *dawn*, that is, up *at* *day* *break:* - early.

d:
**1.** daybreak, dawn
**2.** at early dawn, at daybreak, early in the morning
s: From the same as [G3735](G3735); *dawn* (as *sun* *rise*, *rising* of light); by extension *morn:* - early in the morning.

d: **1.** rightly
s: Adverb from [G3717](G3717); *in* *a* *straight* manner, that is, (figuratively) *correctly* (also morally): - plain, right (-ly).

d:
**1.** to define
  **a.** to mark out the boundaries or limits (of any place or thing) 1b to determine, appoint
    **1.** that which has been determined, acc. to appointment, decree
    **2.** to ordain, determine, appoint
s: From [G3725](G3725); to *mark* out or *bound* (“horizon”), that is, (figuratively) to *appoint*, *decree*, *specify:* - declare, determine, limit, ordain.

d:
**1.** boundaries
  **a.** for a region, district, land, territory
s: Neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary word ὅρος horos (a *bound* or *limit*); a *boundary* line, that is, (by implication) a *frontier* (*region*): - border, coast.
o: from a derivative of an apparently primary horos (a bound or limit)

d:
**1.** to force to take an oath, to administer an oath to
**2.** to adjure (solemnly implore)
s: From [G3727](G3727); to *put* *on* *oath*, that is, *make* *swear*; by analogy to solemnly *enjoin:* - adjure, charge.

d: **1.** that which has been pledged or promised with an oath
s: From ἕρκος herkos (a *fence*; perhaps akin to [G3725](G3725)); a *limit*, that is, (sacred) *restraint* (specifically *oath*): - oath.
o: from herkos (a fence, perhaps akin to [G3725](G3725))

d: **1.** affirmation made on oath, the taking of an oath, an oath
s: From a compound of [G3727](G3727) and a derivative of [G3660](G3660); *asseveration* *on* *oath:* - oath.
o: from a compound of [G3727](G3727) and a derivative of [G3660](G3660)

d:
**1.** to set in rapid motion, stir up, incite, urge on
**2.** to start forward impetuously, to rush
s: From [G3730](G3730); to *start*, *spur* or *urge* on, that is, (reflexively) to *dash* or *plunge:* - run (violently), rush.

d:
**1.** a violent motion, impulse
**2.** a hostile movement, onset, assault
s: Of uncertain affinity; a violent *impulse*, that is, *onset:* - assault.

d:
**1.** a rush, impulse
**2.** that which is impelled or hurried away by impulse
s: From [G3730](G3730); an *attack*, that is, (abstractly) *precipitancy:* - violence.

d: **1.** a bird
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G3733](G3733); a *birdling:* - bird, fowl.

d:
**1.** a bird
**2.** a cock, a hen
s: Probably from a prolonged form of the base of [G3735](G3735); a *bird* (as *rising* in the air), that is, (specifically) a *hen* (or female domestic fowl): - hen.
o: probably from a prolonged form of the base of [G3735](G3735)

d:
**1.** a setting of boundaries, laying down limits
**2.** a definite limit, bounds
s: From a compound of the base of [G3725](G3725) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087); a *limit* *placing*, that is, (concretely) *boundary* *line:* - bound.
o: from a compound of the base of [G3725](G3725) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087)

d: **1.** a mountain
s: Probably a from an obsolete word ὄρω orō (to *rise* or “rear”; perhaps akin to [G142](G142); compare [G3733](G3733)); a *mountain* (as *lifting* itself above the plain): - hill, mount (-ain).
o: probably from an obsolete oro (to rise or rear, perhaps akin to [G142](G142), cf [G3733](G3733))

d: **1.** to dig
s: Apparently a primary verb; to “burrow” in the ground, that is, *dig:* - dig.

d:
**1.** bereft (of a father, of parents)
  **a.** of those bereft of a teacher, guide, guardian
  **b.** orphaned
s: Of uncertain affinity; *bereaved* (“orphan”), that is, *parentless:* - comfortless, fatherless.

d: **1.** to dance
s: Middle voice fromόρχος orchos (a *row* or *ring*); to *dance* (from the *ranklike* or *regular* motion): - dance.
o: middle voice from orchos (a row or ring)

d: **1.** who, which, what, that Wigram’s count is 1309 not 1393.
s: Probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article [G3588](G3588)); the relative (sometimes demonstrative) pronoun, *who*, *which*, *what*, *that*: - one, (an-, the) other, some, that, what, which, who (-m, -se), etc. See also [G3757](G3757).
o: probably a primary word (or perhaps a form of the article [G3588](G3588))

d: **1.** as often as, as often soever as
s: Multiple adverb from [G3739](G3739); *how* (that is, with [G302](G302), *so*) *many* *times* as: - as oft (-en) as.

d: **1.** undefiled by sin, free from wickedness, religiously observing every moral obligation, pure holy, pious
s: Of uncertain affinity; properly *right* (by intrinsic or divine character; thus distinguished from [G1342](G1342), which refers rather to *human* statutes and relations; from [G2413](G2413), which denotes formal *consecration*; and from [G40](G40), which relates to *purity* from defilement), that is, *hallowed* (*pious*, *sacred*, *sure*): - holy, mercy, shalt be.

d: **1.** piety towards God, fidelity in observing the obligations of piety, holiness
s: From [G3741](G3741); *piety:* - holiness.

d: **1.** piously, holily
s: Adverb from [G3741](G3741); *piously:* - holily.

d: **1.** a smell, odour
s: From [G3605](G3605); *fragrance* (literally or figuratively): - odour, savour.

d: **1.** as great as, as far as, how much, how many, whoever
s: By reduplication from [G3739](G3739); *as* (*much*, *great*, *long*, etc.) *as:* - all (that), as (long, many, much) (as), how great (many, much), \[in-\] asmuch as, so many as, that (ever), the more, those things, what (great, -soever), wheresoever, wherewithsoever, which, X while, who (-soever).

d: **1.** whomever
s: From [G3739](G3739) and [G4007](G4007); *who* *especially:* - whomsoever.

d: **1.** a bone
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *bone:* - bone.

d: **1.** whoever, whatever, who
s: From [G3739](G3739) and [G5100](G5100); *which* *some*, that is, *any* *that*; also (definitely) *which* *same*: - X and (they), (such) as, (they) that, in that they, what (-soever), whereas ye, (they) which, who (-soever). Compare [G3754](G3754).

d:
**1.** earthen, clay
  **a.** with the added suggestion of frailty
s: From ὄστρακον ostrakon (“oyster”), (a *tile*, that is, *terra* *cotta*); *earthen* ware, that is, *clayey*; by implication *frail:* - of earth, earthen.
o: from ostrakon \[oyster\] (a tile, i.e. terra cotta)

d: **1.** a sense of smell, smelling
s: From a derivative of [G3605](G3605); *smell* (the sense): - smelling.

d:
**1.** the hip (loin)
  **a.** to gird, gird about, the loins
**2.** a loin, the (two) loins
  **a.** the place where the hebrews thought the generative power (semen) resided
s: Of uncertain affinity; the *loin* (externally), that is, the *hip*; internally (by extension) *procreative* *power:* - loin.

d: **1.** when, whenever, as long as, as soon as
s: From [G3753](G3753) and [G302](G302); *whenever* (implying *hypothesis* or more or less *uncertainty*); also causative (conjugationally) *inasmuch* as: - as long (soon) as, that, + till, when (-soever), while.

d: **1.** when whenever, while, as long as
s:
From [G3739](G3739) and [G5037](G5037); at *which* (thing) *too*, that is, *when:* - after (that), as soon as, that, when, while.
Second form also feminine, third form also neuter and fourth form simply the article [G3588](G3588) followed by [G5037](G5037); so written (in some editions) to distinguish them from [G3752](G3752) and [G5119](G5119).

d: **1.** that, because, since
s: Neuter of [G3748](G3748) as conjugation; demonstrative *that* (sometimes redundant); causatively *because:* - as concerning that, as though, because (that), for (that), how (that), (in) that, though, why.

d: **1.** while, until
s: From the genitive case of [G3748](G3748) (as adverb); during *which* *same* time, that is, *whilst:* - whiles.
o: for the genitive case of [G3748](G3748) (as adverb)

d: **1.** no, not; in direct questions expecting an affirmative answer
s:
Also οὐκ ouk *ook* used before a vowel and οὐχ ouch *ookh* before an aspirate.
A primary word; the absolutely negative (compare [G3361](G3361)) adverb; *no* or *not*: - + long, nay, neither, never, no (X man), none, \[can-\] not, + nothing, + special, un (\[-worthy\]), when, + without, + yet but. See also [G3364](G3364), [G3372](G3372).
o: a primary word, the absolute negative \[cf [G3361](G3361)\] adverb

d: **1.** where
s: Genitive case of [G3739](G3739) as adverb; at *which* place, that is, *where:* - where (-in), whither (\[-soever\]).

d: **1.** ah! ha! an interjection of wonder and amazement
s: A primary exclamation of surprise; “ah”: - ah.

d: **1.** alas, woe
s: A primary excamation of grief; “woe”: - alas, woe.

d: **1.** by no means, in no wise
s: Adverb from (the feminine) of [G3762](G3762); *by* *no* *means:* - not.

d: **1.** but not, neither, nor, not even
s: From [G3756](G3756) and [G1161](G1161); *not* *however*, that is, *neither*, *nor*, *not* *even:* - neither (indeed), never, no (more, nor, not), nor (yet), (also, even, then) not (even, so much as), + nothing, so much as.

d: **1.** no one, nothing
s:
Including the feminine οὐδεμία oudemia
*oo-dem-ee’-ah* and the neuter οὐδέν ouden *oo-den’*
From [G3761](G3761) and [G1520](G1520); *not* *even* *one* (man, woman or thing), that is, *none*, *nobody*, *nothing:* - any (man), aught, man, neither any (thing), never (man), no (man), none (+ of these things), not (any, at all, -thing), nought.

d: **1.** never
s: From [G3761](G3761) and [G4218](G4218); *not* *even* *at* *any* *time*, that is, *never* *at* *all:* - neither at any time, never, nothing at any time.

d: **1.** not yet, not as yet
s: From [G3761](G3761) and [G4452](G4452); *not* *even* *yet:* - as yet not, never before (yet), (not) yet.

d: **1.** no longer, no more, no further
s:
Also (separately) οὐκ ἔτι ouk eti *ook* *et’-ee*
From [G3756](G3756) and [G2089](G2089); *not* *yet*, *no* *longer:* - after that (not), (not) any more, henceforth (hereafter), not, no longer (more), not as yet (now), now no more (not), yet (not).

d: **1.** not therefore
s: From [G3756](G3756) and [G3767](G3767); is it *not* *therefore* that, that is, (affirmatively) *hence* or *so:* - then.

d: **1.** then, therefore, accordingly, consequently, these things being so
s: Apparently a primary word; (adverbially) *certainly*, or (conjugationally) *accordingly:* - and (so, truly), but, now (then), so (likewise then), then, therefore, verily, wherefore.

d: **1.** not yet
s: From [G3756](G3756) and [G4452](G4452); *not* *yet:* - hitherto not, (no . . .) as yet, not yet.

d: **1.** a tail
s: Apparently a primary word; a *tail:* - tail.

d:
**1.** heavenly
  **a.** dwelling in heaven
  **b.** coming from heaven
s: From [G3772](G3772); *celestial*, that is, *belonging* *to* or *coming* *from* the *sky:* - heavenly.

d: **1.** from heaven
s: From [G3772](G3772) and the enclitic of source; *from* the *sky:* - from heaven.
o: from [G3772](G3772) and the enclitic of source

d:
**1.** the vaulted expanse of the sky with all things visible in it
  **a.** the universe, the world
  **b.** the aerial heavens or sky, the region where the clouds and the tempests gather, and where thunder and lightning are produced
  **c.** the sidereal or starry heavens
**2.** the region above the sidereal heavens, the seat of order of things eternal and consummately perfect where God dwells and other heavenly beings
s: Perhaps from the same as [G3735](G3735) (through the idea of *elevation*); the *sky*; by extension *heaven* (as the abode of God); by implication *happiness*, *power*, *eternity*; specifically the *Gospel* (*Christianity*): - air, heaven (\[-ly\]), sky.
o: perhaps from the same as [G3735](G3735) (through the idea of elevation); the sky

d:
Urbane = of the city; polite
**1.** a certain Christian in Rom 16:9
s: Of Latin origin; *Urbanus* (*of* the *city*, “urbane”), a Christian: - Urbanus.

d:
Uriah = light of Jehovah
**1.** the husband of Bathsheba, one of David’s mighty men
s: Of Hebrew origin \[[H223](H223)\]; *Urias* (that is, *Urijah*), a Hittite: - Urias.

d:
**1.** the ear
**2.** metaph. the faculty of perceiving with the mind, the faculty of understanding and knowing
s: Apparently a primary word; the *ear* (physically or mentally): - ear.

d: **1.** what one has, i.e. property, possessions, estate
s: From the feminine of [G5607](G5607); *substance*, that is, *property* (*possessions*): - goods, substance.

d: **1.** neither, and not
s: From [G3756](G3756) and [G5037](G5037); *not* *too*, that is, *neither* or *nor*; by analogy *not* *even:* - neither, none, nor (yet), (no, yet) not, nothing.

d: **1.** this, these, etc.
s: Including the nominative masculine plural (second form), nominative feminine signular (third form), and the nominate feminine plural, (fourth form). From the article [G3588](G3588) and [G846](G846); *the* *he* (*she* or it), that is, *this* or *that* (often with the article repeated): - he (it was that), hereof, it, she, such as, the same, these, they, this (man, same, woman), which, who.

d: **1.** in this manner, thus, so
s:
Or, before a vowel, οὕτως houtōs *hoo’-toce*.
From [G3778](G3778); *in* *this* *way* (referring to what precedes or follows): - after that, after (in) this manner, as, even (so), for all that, like (-wise), no more, on this fashion (-wise), so (in like manner), thus, what.

d: **1.** not, by no means, not at all
s: Intensive of [G3756](G3756); *not* *indeed:* - nay, not.

d:
**1.** one who owes another, a debtor
  **a.** one held by some obligation, bound by some duty
  **b.** one who has not yet made amends to whom he has injured:
    **1.** one who owes God penalty or whom God can demand punishment as something due, i.e. a sinner
s: From [G3784](G3784); an *ower*, that is, a person *indebted*; figuratively a *delinquent*; morally a *transgressor* (against God): - debtor, which owed, sinner.

d:
**1.** that which is owed
**2.** a debt
**3.** metaph. dues: specifically of conjugal duty
s: From [G3784](G3784); *indebtedness*, that is, (concretely) a *sum* owed; figuratively *obligation*, that is, (conjugal) *duty:* - debt, due.

d:
**1.** that which is owed
  **a.** that which is justly or legally due, a debt
**2.** metaph. offence, sin
s: From (the alternate of) [G3784](G3784); *something* *owed*, that is, (figuratively) a *due*.; morally a *fault:* - debt.

d:
**1.** to owe
  **a.** to owe money, be in debt for
    **1.** that which is due, the debt
**2.** metaph. the goodwill due
s: Including its prolonged form (second form) used in certain tenses. Probably from the base of [G3786](G3786) (through the idea of *accruing*); to *owe* (pecuniarily); figuratively to *be* *under* *obligation* (*ought*, *must*, *should*); morally to *fail* in duty: - behove, be bound, (be) debt (-or), (be) due (-ty), be guilty (indebted), (must) need (-s), ought, owe, should. See also [G3785](G3785).
o: or (in certain tenses) its prolonged form opheileo of-i-leh’-o; probably from the base of [G3786](G3786) (through the idea of accruing)

d: **1.** would that, where one wishes that a thing had happened which has not happened or a thing be done which probably will not be done
s: First person singular of a past tense of [G3784](G3784); I *ought* (*wish*), that is, (interjectionally) *oh* *that!*: - would (to God).
o: first person singular of a past tense of [G3784](G3784)

d: **1.** advantage, profit
s: From ὀφέλλω ophellō (to *heap* up, that is, *accumulate* or *benefit*); *gain:* - advantageth, profit.
o: from ophello (to heap up, i.e. accumulate or benefit)

d:
**1.** service performed \[only\] under the master’s eyes
  **a.** for the master’s eye usually stimulates to greater diligence
  **b.** his absence, on the other hand, renders sluggish
s: From [G3788](G3788) and [G1397](G1397); *sight* *labor*, that is, that needs watching (*remissness*): - eye-service.

d:
**1.** the eye
**2.** metaph. the eyes of the mind, the faculty of knowing
s: From [G3700](G3700); the *eye* (literally or figuratively); by implication *vision*; figuratively *envy* (from the jealous side glance): - eye, sight.

d:
**1.** snake, serpent
**2.** with the ancients, the serpent was an emblem of cunning and wisdom. The serpent who deceived Eve was regarded by the Jews as the devil.
s: Probably from [G3700](G3700) (through the idea of *sharpness* of vision); a *snake*, figuratively (as a type of sly cunning) an artful *malicious* person, especially *Satan:* - serpent.
o: probably from [G3700](G3700) (through the idea of sharpness of vision)

d:
**1.** the eyebrow
**2.** any prominence or projection
s: Perhaps from [G3700](G3700) (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of *vision*); the eye “brow” or *forehead*, that is, (figuratively) the *brink* of a precipice: - brow.
o: perhaps from [G3700](G3700) (through the idea of the shading or proximity to the organ of vision)

d:
**1.** to excite a mob against one
**2.** to disturb, roll away
**3.** to trouble, molest
**4.** be in confusion, in an uproar
**5.** to be vexed, molested, troubled: by demons
s: From [G3793](G3793); to *mob*, that is, (by implication) to *harass:* - vex.

d: **1.** to collect a crowd, gather the people together
s: From [G3793](G3793) and [G4160](G4160); to *make* *a* *crowd*, that is, *raise* *a* public *disturbance:* - gather a company.

d:
**1.** a crowd
  **a.** a casual collection of people
    **1.** a multitude of men who have flocked together in some place
    **2.** a throng
  **b.** a multitude
    **1.** the common people, as opposed to the rulers and leading men
    **2.** with contempt: the ignorant multitude, the populace
  **c.** a multitude
    **1.** the multitudes, seems to denote troops of people gathered together without order
s: From a derivative of [G2192](G2192) (meaning a *vehicle*); a *throng* (as *borne* along); by implication the *rabble*; by extension a *class* of people; figuratively a *riot:* - company, multitude, number (of people), people, press.
o: from a derivative of [G2192](G2192) (meaning a vehicle)

d:
**1.** a castle, stronghold, fortress, fastness
**2.** anything on which one relies
  **a.** of the arguments and reasonings by which a disputant endeavours to fortify his opinion and defend it against his opponent
s: From a remote derivative of [G2192](G2192) (meaning to *fortify*, through the idea of *holding* safely); a *castle* (figuratively *argument*): - stronghold.
o: from a remote derivative of [G2192](G2192) (meaning to fortify, through the idea of holding safely)

d: **1.** fish
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of the base of [G3702](G3702); a *relish* to other food (as if cooked *sauce*), that is, (specifically) *fish* (presumably salted and dried as a condiment): - fish.
o: from a presumed derivative of the base of [G3702](G3702)

d:
**1.** after a long time, long after, late
  **a.** late in the day, i.e. at evening
  **b.** the sabbath having just passed, after the sabbath
    **1.** at the early dawn of the first day of the week
s: From the same as [G3694](G3694) (through the idea of *backwardness*); (adverbially) *late* in the day; by extension *after* *the* *close* of the day: - (at) even, in the end.
o: from the same as [G3694](G3694) (through the idea of backwardness)

d:
**1.** late, later
  **a.** of the time of subsidence of the waters of the Nile
  **b.** the latter or vernal rain, which falls chiefly in the months of March and April just before the harvest
s: From [G3796](G3796); *later*, that is, *vernal* (showering): - latter.

d:
**1.** late
**2.** evening
  **a.** either from three to six o’clock p.m.
  **b.** from six o’clock p.m. to the beginning of night
s: From [G3796](G3796); *late*; feminine (as noun) *afternoon* (early eve) or *nightfall* (later eve): - even (-ing, \[-tide\]).

d:
**1.** seeing, sight
**2.** face, countenance
**3.** the outward appearance, look
s: From [G3700](G3700); properly *sight* (the act), that is, (by implication) the *visage*, an external *show:* - appearance, countenance, face.

d:
**1.** a soldier’s pay, allowance
  **a.** that part of the soldier’s support given in place of pay \[i.e. rations\] and the money in which he is paid
**2.** metaph. wages: hire or pay of sin
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of the same as [G3795](G3795); *rations* for a soldier, that is, (by extension) his *stipend* or *pay:* - wages.
o: from a presumed derivative of the same as [G3795](G3795)

l: ὁ ὢν καί ὁ ἦν καί ὁ ἐρχόμενος
p: ho own kahee ho ane kahee ho er-khom'-en-os
x: ho ṑn kaí ho ēn kaí ho erchómenos
d: **1.** He who is, and was, and is coming
s: A phrase combining [G3588](G3588) with the present participle and imperfect of [G1510](G1510) and the present participle of [G2064](G2064) by means of [G2532](G2532); *the* one *being* *and* *the* one that *was* *and* *the* one *coming*, that is, *the* *Eternal*, as a divine epithet of Christ. (Each “and” ([G2532](G2532)) was ommited from the phrase because of limited space.): - which art (is, was), and (which) wast (is, was), and art (is) to come (shalt be).
o: a phrase combining [G3588](G3588) with the present participle and imperfect of [G1510](G1510) and the present participle of [G2064](G2064) by means of [G2532](G2532)

d:
**1.** to ensnare, entrap
  **a.** of birds
**2.** metaph. of the attempt to elicit from one some remark which can be turned into an accusation against him
s: From [G3803](G3803); to *ensnare* (figuratively): - entangle.

d:
**1.** snare, trap, noose
  **a.** of snares in which birds are entangled and caught
    **1.** implies unexpectedly, suddenly, because birds and beasts are caught unawares
  **b.** a snare, i.e. whatever brings peril, loss, destruction
    **1.** of a sudden and unexpected deadly peril
    **2.** of the allurements and seductions of sin
    **3.** the allurements to sin by which the devil holds one bound
    **4.** the snares of love
s: From [G4078](G4078); a *trap* (as *fastened* by a noose or notch); figuratively a *trick* or *stratagem* (*temptation*): - snare

d:
**1.** that which one suffers or has suffered
  **a.** externally, a suffering, misfortune, calamity, evil, affliction
    **1.** of the sufferings of christ
    **2.** also the afflictions which Christians must undergo in behalf of the same cause which christ patiently endured
  **b.** of an inward state, an affliction, passion
**2.** an enduring, undergoing, suffering
s: From a presumed derivative of [G3806](G3806); something *undergone*, that is, *hardship* or *pain*; subjectively an *emotion* or *influence:* - affection, affliction, motion, suffering.

d:
**1.** passible, endued with the capacity of suffering, capable of feeling
**2.** subject to the necessity of suffering, destined to suffer
s: From the same as [G3804](G3804); *liable* (that is, *doomed*) *to* experience *pain:* - suffer.

d:
**1.** whatever befalls one, whether it be sad or joyous
  **a.** spec. a calamity, mishap, evil, affliction
**2.** a feeling which the mind suffers
  **a.** an affliction of the mind, emotion, passion
  **b.** passionate deed
  **c.** used by the Greeks in either a good or bad sense
  **d.** in the NT in a bad sense, depraved passion, vile passions
s: From the alternate of [G3958](G3958); properly *suffering* (“pathos”), that is, (subjectively) a *passion* (especially *concupiscence*): - (inordinate) affection, lust.

d: **1.** a tutor i.e. a guardian and guide of boys. Among the Greeks and the Romans the name was applied to trustworthy slaves who were charged with the duty of supervising the life and morals of boys belonging to the better class. The boys were not allowed so much as to step out of the house without them before arriving at the age of manhood.
s: From [G3816](G3816) and a reduplication form of [G71](G71); a *boy* *leader*, that is, a servant whose office it was to take the children to school; (by implication \[figuratively\] a *tutor* \[“paedagogue”\]): - instructor, schoolmaster.
o: from [G3816](G3816) and a reduplicated form of [G71](G71)

d: **1.** little boy, a lad
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G3816](G3816); a *little* *boy:* - child, lad.

d:
**1.** the whole training and education of children (which relates to the cultivation of mind and morals, and employs for this purpose now commands and admonitions, now reproof and punishment) It also includes the training and care of the body
**2.** whatever in adults also cultivates the soul, esp. by correcting mistakes and curbing passions.
  **a.** instruction which aims at increasing virtue
  **b.** chastisement, chastening, (of the evils with which God visits men for their amendment)
s: From [G3811](G3811); *tutorage*, that is, *education* or *training*; by implication disciplinary *correction:* - chastening, chastisement, instruction, nurture.

d:
**1.** an instructor, preceptor, teacher
**2.** a chastiser
s: From [G3811](G3811); a *trainer*, that is, *teacher* or (by implication) *discipliner:* - which corrected, instructor.

d:
**1.** to train children
  **a.** to be instructed or taught or learn
  **b.** to cause one to learn
**2.** to chastise
  **a.** to chastise or castigate with words, to correct
    **1.** of those who are moulding the character of others by reproof and admonition
  **b.** of God
    **1.** to chasten by the affliction of evils and calamities
  **c.** to chastise with blows, to scourge
    **1.** of a father punishing his son
    **2.** of a judge ordering one to be scourged
s: From [G3816](G3816); to *train* up a child, that is, *educate*, or (by implication) *discipline* (by punishment): - chasten (-ise), instruct, learn, teach.

d: **1.** from childhood, from a child
s: Adverb (of *source*) from [G3813](G3813); *from* *infancy:* - of a child.

d:
**1.** a young child, a little boy, a little girl
  **a.** infants
  **b.** children, little ones
  **c.** an infant
    **1.** of a (male) child just recently born
  **d.** of a more advanced child; of a mature child;
  **e.** metaph. children (like children) in intellect
s: Neuter diminutive of [G3816](G3816); a *childling* (of either sex), that is, (properly) an infant, or (by extension) a half grown *boy* or girl; figuratively an *immature* Christian: - (little, young) child, damsel.

d:
**1.** a young girl, damsel
**2.** a maid-servant, a young female slave
  **a.** a maid servant who has charge of the door
s: Feminine diminutive of [G3816](G3816); a *girl*, that is, (specifically) a *female* *slave* or *servant:* - bondmaid (-woman), damsel, maid (-en).

d:
**1.** to play like a child
**2.** to play, sport, jest
**3.** to give way to hilarity, esp. by joking singing, dancing
s: From [G3816](G3816); to *sport* (as a boy): - play.

d:
**1.** a child, boy or girl
  **a.** infants, children
**2.** servant, slave
  **a.** an attendant, servant, spec. a king’s attendant, minister
s: Perhaps from [G3817](G3817); a *boy* (as often *beaten* with impunity), or (by analogy) a *girl*, and (generally) a *child*; specifically a *slave* or *servant* (especially a *minister* to a king; and by eminence to God): - child, maid (-en), (man) servant, son, young man.

d:
**1.** to strike, smite
**2.** to sting (to strike or wound with a sting)
s: A primary verb; to *hit* (as if by a single blow and less violently than [G5180](G5180)); specifically to *sting* (as a scorpion): - smite, strike.

d:
Phrygia = dry, barren
**1.** in the 4th century after christ, Phrygia was divided into Phrygia Salutaris and Phrygia Pacatiana; Laodicea was a city in the latter
s: Feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation; *Pacatianian*, a section of Phrygia: - Pacatiana.
o: feminine of an adjective of uncertain derivation

d:
**1.** of old, former
**2.** long ago
s: Probably another form for [G3825](G3825) (through the idea of *retrocession*); (adverbially) *formerly*, or (relatively) *sometime* *since*; (elliptically as adjective) *ancient:* - any while, a great while ago, (of) old, in time past.
o: probably another form for [G3825](G3825) (through the idea of retrocession)

d:
**1.** old, ancient
**2.** no longer new, worn by use, the worse for wear, old
s: From [G3819](G3819); *antique*, that is, *not* *recent*, *worn* *out:* - old.

d: **1.** oldness: the old state of life controlled by ’the letter’
s: From [G3820](G3820); *antiquatedness:* - oldness.

d:
**1.** to make ancient or old
  **a.** to become old, to be worn out
  **b.** of things worn out by time and use
**2.** to declare a thing to be old and so about to be abrogated
s: From [G3820](G3820); to *make* (passively *become*) *worn* *out*, or *declare* *obsolete:* - decay, make (wax) old.

d:
**1.** wrestling (a contest between two in which each endeavours to throw the other, and which is decided when the victor is able to hold his opponent down with his hand upon his neck)
  **a.** the term is transferred to the Christian’s struggle with the power of evil
s: From πάλλω pallō (to *vibrate*; another form for [G906](G906)); *wrestling:* - + wrestle.
o: from pallo (to vibrate, another form for [G906](G906))

d:
**1.** new birth, reproduction, renewal, recreation, regeneration
  **a.** hence renovation, regeneration, the production of a new life consecrated to God, a radical change of mind for the better. The word often used to denote the restoration of a thing to its pristine state, its renovation, as a renewal or restoration of life after death
  **b.** the renovation of the earth after the deluge
  **c.** the renewal of the world to take place after its destruction by fire, as the Stoics taught
  **d.** the signal and glorious change of all things (in heaven and earth) for the better, that restoration of the primal and perfect condition of things which existed before the fall of our first parents, which the Jews looked for in connection with the advent of the messiah, and which Christians expected in connection with the visible return of Jesus from heaven.
  **e.** other uses
    **1.** of Cicero’s restoration to rank and fortune on his recall from exile
    **2.** of the restoration of the Jewish nation after exile
    **3.** of the recovery of knowledge by recollection
s: From [G3825](G3825) and [G1078](G1078); (spiritual) *rebirth* (the state or the act), that is, (figuratively) spiritual *renovation*; specifically Messianic *restoration:* - regeneration.

d:
**1.** anew, again
  **a.** renewal or repetition of the action
  **b.** again, anew
**2.** again, i.e. further, moreover
**3.** in turn, on the other hand
s: Probably from the same as [G3823](G3823) (through the idea of *oscillatory* repetition); (adverbially) *anew*, that is, (of place) *back*, (of time) *once* *more*, or (conjugationally) *furthermore* or *on* *the* *other* *hand:* - again.
o: probably from the same as [G3823](G3823) (through the idea of oscillatory repetition)

d:
**1.** with the whole multitude
**2.** all together, one and all
s: Dative case (adverb) of a compound of [G3956](G3956) and [G4128](G4128); *in* *full* *multitude*, that is, *concertedly* or *simultaneously:* - all at once.
o: dative case (adverb) of a compound of [G3956](G3956) and [G4128](G4128)

d: **1.** very great
s: From [G3956](G3956) and [G4183](G4183); *full* *many*, that is, *immense:* - very great.

d:
Pamphylia = of every tribe
**1.** a province in Asia Minor, bounded on the east by Cilicia, on the west by Lycia and Phrygia Minor, on the north by Galatia and Cappadocia, and on the south by the mediterranean Sea
s: From a compound of [G3956](G3956) and [G5443](G5443); *every* *tribal*, that is, *heterogeneous* ([G5561](G5561) being implied); *Pamphylia*, a region of Asia Minor: - Pamphylia.
o: from a compound of [G3956](G3956) and [G4443](G4443), every-tribal, i.e. heterogeneous ([G5561](G5561) being implied)

d: **1.** an inn, a public house for the reception of strangers
s: Neuter of a presumed compound of [G3956](G3956) and a derivative of [G1209](G1209); *all* *receptive*, that is, a public *lodging* place (*caravanserai* or *khan*): - inn.
o: from a presumed compound of [G3956](G3956) and a derivative of [G1209](G1209)

d: **1.** an inn keeper, host
s: From the same as [G3829](G3829); an *innkeeper* (*warden* *of* *a* *caravanserai*): - host.

d:
**1.** a festal gathering of the whole people to celebrate public games or other solemnities
**2.** a public festal assembly
s: From [G3956](G3956) and a derivative of [G58](G58); a *mass* *meeting*, that is, (figuratively) *universal* *companionship:* - general assembly.

d: **1.** with all (his) house, with (his) whole family
s: Adverb from [G3956](G3956) and [G3624](G3624); *with* the *whole* *family:* - with all his house.

d:
**1.** full armour, complete armour
  **a.** includes shield, sword, lance, helmet, greaves, and breastplate
s: From a compound of [G3956](G3956) and [G3696](G3696); *full* *armor* (“panoply”): - all (whole) armour.

d:
**1.** craftiness, cunning
**2.** a specious or false wisdom
**3.** in a good sense, prudence, skill, in undertaking and carrying on affairs
s: From [G3835](G3835); *adroitness*, that is, (in a bad sense) *trickery* or *sophistry:* - (cunning) craftiness, subtilty.

d:
**1.** skilful, clever
  **a.** in a good sense, fit to undertake and accomplish anything, dexterous, wise, sagacious, skilful
  **b.** in a bad sense, crafty, cunning, knavish, treacherous, deceitful
s: From [G3956](G3956) and [G2041](G2041); *all* *working*, that is, *adroit* (*shrewd*): - crafty.

d: **1.** from all sides, from every quarter
s: Adverb (of *source*) from [G3837](G3837); *from* *all* directions: - from every quarter.

d: **1.** everywhere
s: Genitive case (as adverb of *place*) of a presumed derivative of [G3956](G3956); *universally:* - in all places, everywhere.
o: genitive case (as adverb of place) of a presumed derivative of [G3956](G3956)

d:
**1.** all complete, perfect
**2.** completely, perfectly, utterly
s: From [G3956](G3956) and [G5056](G5056); *full* *ended*, that is, *entire* (neuter as noun, *completion*): -  + in \[no\] wise, uttermost.

d: **1.** everywhere, wholly, in all respects, in every way
s: Adverb (of *manner*) from [G3956](G3956); *wholly:* - always.

d: **1.** from all sides, from every quarter
s: Adverb (of *source*) from [G3956](G3956); *from* (that is, *on*) *all* sides: - on every side, round about.

d:
**1.** he who holds sway over all things
**2.** the ruler of all
**3.** almighty: God
s: From [G3956](G3956) and [G2904](G2904); the *all* *ruling*, that is, *God* (as absolute and universal *sovereign*): - Almighty, Omnipotent.

d: **1.** at all times, always, ever
s: From [G3956](G3956) and [G3753](G3753); *every* *when*, that is, *at* *all* times: - always (-s), ever (-more).

d:
**1.** altogether
  **a.** in any and every way, by all means
  **b.** doubtless, surely, certainly
  **c.** in no wise, not at all
s: From [G3956](G3956); *entirely*; specifically *at* *all* *events*, (with negative following) *in* no *event:* - by all means, altogether, at all, needs, no doubt, in \[no\] wise, surely.

d: **1.** from, of at, by, besides, near
s: A primary preposition; properly *near*, that is, (with genitive case) *from* *beside* (literally or figuratively), (with dative case) *at* (or *in*) the *vicinity* of (objectively or subjectively), (with accusative case) to the *proximity* with (local \[especially *beyond* or *opposed* to\] or causal \[*on* *account* of\]). In compounds it retains the same variety of application: - above, against, among, at, before, by, contrary to, X friend, from, + give \[such things as they\], + that \[she\] had, X his, in, more than, nigh unto, (out) of, past, save, side . . . by, in the sight of, than, \[there-\] fore, with. In compounds it retains the same variety of application.

d:
**1.** to go by the side of
**2.** to go past or pass over without touching a thing
**3.** to overstep, neglect, violate, transgress
**4.** so to go past as to turn aside from
  **a.** to depart, leave, be turned from
**5.** one who abandons his trust
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the base of [G939](G939); to *go* *contrary* *to*, that is, *violate* a command: - (by) transgress (-ion).

d:
**1.** to throw before, cast to (as fodder for horses)
**2.** to put one thing by the side of another for the sake of comparison, to compare, liken
**3.** to put one’s self, betake one’s self into a place or to a person
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *alongside*, that is, (reflexively) to *reach* a place, or (figuratively) to *liken:* - arrive, compare.

d:
**1.** a going over
**2.** metaph. a disregarding, violating
  **a.** of the Mosaic law
  **b.** the breach of a definite, promulgated, ratified law
  **c.** to create transgressions, i.e. that sins might take on the character of transgressions, and thereby the consciousness of sin be intensified and the desire for redemption be aroused
s: From [G3845](G3845); *violation:* - breaking, transgression.

d:
**1.** a transgressor
**2.** a lawbreaker
s: From [G3845](G3845); a *violator:* - breaker, transgress (-or).

d:
**1.** to employ force contrary to nature and right
**2.** to compel by employing force
**3.** to constrain one by entreaties
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the middle voice of [G971](G971); to *force* *contrary* to (nature), that is, *compel* (by entreaty): - constrain.
o: from [G3844](G3844) and the middle voice of [G971](G971)

d:
**1.** a placing of one thing by the side of another, juxtaposition, as of ships in battle
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** a comparing, comparison of one thing with another, likeness, similitude
  **b.** an example by which a doctrine or precept is illustrated
  **c.** a narrative, fictitious but agreeable to the laws and usages of human life, by which either the duties of men or the things of God, particularly the nature and history of God’s kingdom are figuratively portrayed
  **d.** a parable: an earthly story with a heavenly meaning
**3.** a pithy and instructive saying, involving some likeness or comparison and having preceptive or admonitory force
  **a.** an aphorism, a maxim
**4.** a proverb
**5.** an act by which one exposes himself or his possessions to danger, a venture, a risk
s: From [G3846](G3846); a *similitude* (“parable”), that is, (symbolically) *fictitious* *narrative* (of common life conveying a moral), *apoth* *gm* or *adage:* - comparison, figure, parable, proverb.

d: **1.** to consult amiss
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the middle of [G1011](G1011); to *misconsult*, that is, *disregard:* - not (to) regard (-ing).
o: from [G3844](G3844) and the middle voice of [G1011](G1011)

d:
**1.** announcement, a proclaiming or giving a message to
**2.** a charge, a command
s: From [G3853](G3853); a *mandate:* - charge, command.

d:
**1.** to transmit a message along from one to another, to declare, announce
**2.** to command, order, charge
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the base of [G32](G32); to *transmit* *a* *message*, that is, (by implication) to *enjoin:* - (give in) charge, (give) command (-ment), declare.

d:
**1.** to be present, to come near, approach
**2.** to come forth, make one’s public appearance
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1096](G1096); to *become* *near*, that is, *approach* (*have* *arrived*); by implication to *appear* publicly: - come, go, be present.

d:
**1.** pass by
  **a.** to lead past, lead by
  **b.** to lead aside, mislead
    **1.** to lead away
  **c.** to lead to
    **1.** to lead forth, bring forward
**2.** to pass by, go past
  **a.** to depart, go away
**3.** metaph. disappear
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G71](G71); to *lead* *near*, that is, (reflexively or intransitively) to *go* *along* or *away:* - depart, pass (away, by, forth).

d:
**1.** to set forth as a public example, make an example of
  **a.** in a bad sense
    **1.** to hold up to infamy
    **2.** to expose to public disgrace
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1165](G1165); to *show* *alongside* (the public), that is, *expose* *to* *infamy:* - make a public example, put to an open shame.

d:
**1.** among the Persians a grand enclosure or preserve, hunting ground, park, shady and well watered, in which wild animals, were kept for the hunt; it was enclosed by walls and furnished with towers for the hunters
**2.** a garden, pleasure ground
  **a.** grove, park
**3.** the part of Hades which was thought by the later Jews to be the abode of the souls of pious until the resurrection: but some understand this to be a heavenly paradise
**4.** the upper regions of the heavens. According to the early church fathers, the paradise in which our first parents dwelt before the fall still exists, neither on the earth or in the heavens, but above and beyond the world
**5.** heaven
s: Of Oriental origin (compare \[[H6508](H6508)\]); a *park*, that is, (specifically) an *Eden* (place of future happiness, “paradise”): - paradise.

d:
**1.** to receive, take up, take upon one’s self
**2.** to admit i.e. not to reject, to accept, receive
  **a.** of a son: to acknowledge as one’s own
