s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1209](G1209); to *accept* *near*, that is, *admit* or (by implication) *delight* in: - receive.

d: **1.** useless occupation, empty business, misemployment
s: From a compound of [G3844](G3844) and [G1304](G1304); *misemployment*, that is, *meddlesomeness:* - perverse disputing.

d:
**1.** to give into the hands (of another)
**2.** to give over into (one’s) power or use
  **a.** to deliver to one something to keep, use, take care of, manage
  **b.** to deliver up one to custody, to be judged, condemned, punished, scourged, tormented, put to death
  **c.** to deliver up treacherously
    **1.** by betrayal to cause one to be taken
    **2.** to deliver one to be taught, moulded
**3.** to commit, to commend
**4.** to deliver verbally
  **a.** commands, rites
  **b.** to deliver by narrating, to report
**5.** to permit allow
  **a.** when the fruit will allow that is when its ripeness permits
  **b.** gives itself up, presents itself
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1325](G1325); to *surrender*, that is, *yield* *up*, *intrust*, *transmit:* - betray, bring forth, cast, commit, deliver (up), give (over, up), hazard, put in prison, recommend.

d: **1.** unexpected, uncommon, incredible, wonderful
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1391](G1391) (in the sense of *seeming*); *contrary* *to* *expectation*, that is, *extraordinary* (“paradox”): - strange.
o: from [G3844](G3844) and [G1391](G1391) (in the sense of seeming)

d:
**1.** giving up, giving over
  **a.** the act of giving up
  **b.** the surrender of cities
**2.** a giving over which is done by word of mouth or in writing, i.e. tradition by instruction, narrative, precept, etc.
  **a.** objectively, that which is delivered, the substance of a teaching
  **b.** of the body of precepts, esp. ritual, which in the opinion of the later Jews were orally delivered by Moses and orally transmitted in unbroken succession to subsequent generations, which precepts, both illustrating and expanding the written law, as they did were to be obeyed with equal reverence
s: From [G3860](G3860); *transmission*, that is, (concretely) a *precept*; specifically the Jewish *traditionary* *law:* - ordinance, tradition.

d:
**1.** to provoke to
  **a.** to provoke to jealously or rivalry
  **b.** to provoke to anger
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2206](G2206); to *stimulate* *alongside*, that is, *excite* *to* *rivalry:* - provoke to emulation (jealousy).

d: **1.** besides the sea, by the sea
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2281](G2281); *along* the *sea*, that is, *maritime* (*lacustrine*): - upon the sea coast.

d:
**1.** to examine things placed beside each other, to compare
**2.** to overlook, neglect
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2334](G2334); to *overlook* or *disregard:* - neglect.

d:
**1.** a deposit, a trust or thing consigned to one’s faithful keeping
  **a.** used of the correct knowledge and pure doctrine of the gospel, to be held firmly and faithfully, and to be conscientiously delivered unto others
s: From [G3908](G3908); a *deposit*, that is, (figuratively) *trust:* - committed unto.

d: **1.** to exhort, admonish
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G134](G134); to *mispraise*, that is, *recommend* or *advise* (a different course): - admonish, exhort.

d:
**1.** to ask along side, beg to have near one
  **a.** to obtain by entreaty
  **b.** to beg from, to ask for, supplicate
**2.** to avert by entreaty or seek to avert, to deprecate
  **a.** to entreat that ... not
  **b.** to refuse, decline
  **c.** to shun, avoid
  **d.** to avert displeasure by entreaty
    **1.** to beg pardon, crave indulgence, to excuse
    **2.** of one excusing himself for not accepting a wedding invitation to a feast
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the middle of [G154](G154); to *beg* *off*, that is, *deprecate*, *decline*, *shun:* - avoid, (make) excuse, intreat, refuse, reject.
o: from [G3844](G3844) and the middle voice of [G154](G154)

d:
**1.** to make to sit down besides
**2.** to set beside, place near
**3.** sit down beside
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2523](G2523); to *sit* *down* *near:* - sit.

d:
**1.** to call to one’s side, call for, summon
**2.** to address, speak to, (call to, call upon), which may be done in the way of exhortation, entreaty, comfort, instruction, etc.
  **a.** to admonish, exhort
  **b.** to beg, entreat, beseech
    **1.** to strive to appease by entreaty
  **c.** to console, to encourage and strengthen by consolation, to comfort
    **1.** to receive consolation, be comforted
  **d.** to encourage, strengthen
  **e.** exhorting and comforting and encouraging
  **f.** to instruct, teach
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2564](G2564); to *call* *near*, that is, *invite*, *invoke* (by *imploration*, *hortation* or *consolation*): - beseech, call for, (be of good) comfort, desire, (give) exhort (-ation), intreat, pray.

d: **1.** to cover over, cover up, hide, conceal
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2572](G2572); to *cover* *alongside*, that is, *veil* (figuratively): - hide.

d:
**1.** a deposit, a trust or thing consigned to one’s faithful keeping
  **a.** used of the correct knowledge and pure doctrine of the gospel, to be held firmly and faithfully, and to be conscientiously delivered unto others
s: From a compound of [G3844](G3844) and [G2698](G2698); something *put* *down* *alongside*, that is, a *deposit* (sacred *trust*): - that (thing) which is committed (un-) to (trust).

d:
**1.** to lie beside, to be near
**2.** to be present, at hand
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2749](G2749); to *lie* *near*, that is, *be* *at* *hand* (figuratively *be* *prompt* or *easy*): - be present.

d:
**1.** a calling near, summons, (esp. for help)
**2.** importation, supplication, entreaty
**3.** exhortation, admonition, encouragement
**4.** consolation, comfort, solace; that which affords comfort or refreshment
  **a.** thus of the messianic salvation (so the Rabbis call the messiah the consoler, the comforter)
**5.** persuasive discourse, stirring address
  **a.** instructive, admonitory, conciliatory, powerful hortatory discourse
s: From [G3870](G3870); *imploration*, *hortation*, *solace:* - comfort, consolation, exhortation, intreaty.

d:
**1.** summoned, called to one’s side, esp. called to one’s aid
  **a.** one who pleads another’s cause before a judge, a pleader, counsel for defense, legal assistant, an advocate
  **b.** one who pleads another’s cause with one, an intercessor
    **1.** of christ in his exaltation at God’s right hand, pleading with God the father for the pardon of our sins
  **c.** in the widest sense, a helper, succourer, aider, assistant
    **1.** of the holy spirit destined to take the place of christ with the apostles (after his ascension to the father), to lead them to a deeper knowledge of the gospel truth, and give them divine strength needed to enable them to undergo trials and persecutions on behalf of the divine kingdom
s: An *intercessor*, *consoler:* - advocate, comforter.

d:
**1.** a hearing amiss
**2.** disobedience
s: From [G3878](G3878); *inattention*, that is, (by implication) *disobedience:* - disobedience.

d:
**1.** to follow after
  **a.** so to follow one as to be always at his side
  **b.** to follow close, accompany
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to be always present, to attend one wherever he goes
  **b.** to follow up a thing in mind so as to attain to the knowledge of it
    **1.** to understand, (cf our follow a matter up, trace its course)
    **2.** to examine thoroughly, investigate
  **c.** to follow faithfully i.e a standard or rule, to conform one’s self to
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G190](G190); to *follow* *near*, that is, (figuratively) *attend* (as a result), *trace* *out*, *conform* to: - attain, follow, fully know, have understanding.

d:
**1.** to hear aside
  **a.** causally or carelessly or amiss
**2.** to be unwilling to hear
  **a.** on hearing to neglect, to pay no heed to
  **b.** to refuse to hear, pay no regard to, disobey
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G191](G191); to *mishear*, that is, (by implication) to *disobey:* - neglect to hear.

d:
**1.** to stoop to a thing in order to look at it
**2.** to look at with head bowed forward
**3.** to look into with the body bent
**4.** to stoop and look into
**5.** metaph. to look carefully into, inspect curiously
  **a.** of one who would become acquainted with something
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2955](G2955); to *bend* *beside*, that is, *lean* *over* (so as to *peer* *within*): - look (into), stoop down.

d:
**1.** to take to, to take with one’s self, to join to one’s self
  **a.** an associate, a companion
  **b.** metaph.
    **1.** to accept or acknowledge one to be such as he professes to be
    **2.** not to reject, not to withhold obedience
**2.** to receive something transmitted
  **a.** an office to be discharged
  **b.** to receive with the mind
    **1.** by oral transmission: of the authors from whom the tradition proceeds
    **2.** by the narrating to others, by instruction of teachers (used of disciples)
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2983](G2983); to *receive* *near*, that is, *associate* *with* oneself (in any familiar or intimate act or relation); by analogy to *assume* an office; figuratively to *learn:* - receive, take (unto, with).

d:
**1.** to sail past, coast along
**2.** work past, weather
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the middle of [G3004](G3004) (in its original sense); (specifically) to *lay* one’s course *near*, that is, *sail* *past:* - pass, sail by.
o: from [G3844](G3844) and the middle voice of [G3004](G3004) (in its original sense)

d: **1.** by the sea, maritime, the sea coast
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G251](G251); *beside* the *salt* (sea), that is, *maritime:* - sea coast.

d: **1.** variation, change
s: From a compound of [G3844](G3844) and [G236](G236); *transmutation* (of phase or orbit), that is, (figuratively) *fickleness:* - variableness.

d:
**1.** to reckon wrong, miscount
**2.** to cheat by false reckoning
  **a.** to deceive by false reasoning
**3.** to deceive, delude, circumvent
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3049](G3049); to *misreckon*, that is, *delude:* - beguile, deceive.

d:
**1.** paralytic
  **a.** suffering from the relaxing of the nerves of one’s side
  **b.** disabled, weak of limb
s: From a derivative of [G3886](G3886); as if *dissolved*, that is, “paralytic”: - that had (sick of) the palsy.

d:
**1.** to loose on one side or from the side
**2.** to loose or part things placed side by side
**3.** to loosen, dissolve
**4.** to weaken, enfeeble
**5.** suffering from the relaxing of the nerves, unstrung, weak of limb
**6.** tottering, weakened, feeble knees
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3089](G3089); to *loosen* *beside*, that is, *relax* (perfect passive participle *paralyzed* or *enfeebled*): - feeble, sick of the (taken with) palsy.

d:
**1.** to remain beside, continue always near
**2.** to survive, remain alive
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3306](G3306); to *stay* *near*, that is, *remain* (literally *tarry*; or figuratively *be* *permanent*, *persevere*): - abide, continue.

d:
**1.** to speak to, address one, whether by way of admonition and incentive, or to calm and console
  **a.** to encourage, console
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the middle of a derivative of [G3454](G3454); to *relate* *near*, that is, (by implication) *encourage*, *console:* - comfort.
o: from [G3844](G3844) and the middle voice of a derivative of [G3454](G3454)

d:
**1.** any address, whether made for the purpose of persuading, or of arousing and stimulating, or of calming and consoling
  **a.** consolation, comfort
s: From [G3888](G3888); *consolation* (properly abstract): - comfort.

d: **1.** persuasive address
s: Neuter of [G3889](G3889); *consolation* (properly concrete): - comfort.

d: **1.** to act contrary to the law, to break the law
s: From a compound of [G3844](G3844) and [G3551](G3551); to *be* *opposed* *to* *law*, that is, to *transgress:* - contrary to law.

d: **1.** breach of law, transgression, wickedness
s: From the same as [G3891](G3891); *transgression:* - iniquity.

d:
**1.** to provoke, exasperate
**2.** to rouse to indignation
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G4087](G4087); to *embitter* *alongside*, that is, (figuratively) to *exasperate:* - provoke.

d: **1.** provocation
s: From [G3893](G3893); *irritation:* - provocation.

d:
**1.** to fall beside a person or thing
**2.** to slip aside
  **a.** to deviate from the right path, turn aside, wander
  **b.** to error
  **c.** to fall away (from the true faith): from worship of Jehovah
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G4098](G4098); to *fall* *aside*, that is, (figuratively) to *apostatize:* - fall away.

d: **1.** to sail by, sail past
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G4126](G4126); to *sail* *near:* - sail by.

d: **1.** near to, almost to
s: Neuter of a compound of [G3844](G3844) and the base of [G4139](G4139) (as adverb); *close* *by*, that is, (figuratively) *almost:* - nigh unto.
o: from a compound of [G3844](G3844) and the base of [G4139](G4139) (as adverb)

d: **1.** similarly, in like manner, in the same way
s: Adverb from the same as [G3897](G3897); *in* *a* *manner* *near* *by*, that is, (figuratively) *similarly:* - likewise.

d: **1.** to proceed at the side, go past, pass by
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G4198](G4198); to *travel* *near:* - go, pass (by).

d:
**1.** to fall beside or near something
**2.** a lapse or deviation from truth and uprightness
  **a.** a sin, misdeed
s: From [G3895](G3895); a *side* *slip* (*lapse* or *deviation*), that is, (unintentional) *error* or (wilful) *transgression:* - fall, fault, offence, sin, trespass.

d:
**1.** to glide by: lest we be carried by, pass by
  **a.** lest the salvation which these things heard show us how to obtain, slip away from us
  **b.** a thing escapes me
  **c.** slips my mind
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the alternate of [G4482](G4482); to *flow* *by*, that is, (figuratively) carelessly *pass* (*miss*): - let slip.

d:
**1.** marked falsely, spurious, counterfeit: as a coin
**2.** marked beside or in the margin
  **a.** so noteworthy words, which the reader of a book marks on the margin
**3.** noted, marked, conspicuous, remarkable
  **a.** of persons in a bad sense, notorious
**4.** marked with a sign: a ship marked with the image or figure of Dioscuri (Castor and Pollux)
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the base of [G4591](G4591); *side* *marked*, that is, *labelled* (with a *badge* \[*figure* *head*\] of a ship): - sign.

d:
**1.** to make one’s self ready, to prepare one’s self
**2.** have prepared one’s self, to be prepared or ready
s: From [G3844](G3844) and a derivative of [G4632](G4632); to *furnish* *aside*, that is, *get* *ready:* - prepare self, be (make) ready.

d:
**1.** a making ready, preparation, equipping
**2.** that which is prepared, equipment
**3.** in the NT in a Jewish sense, the day of preparation
  **a.** the day on which the Jews made necessary preparation to celebrate a sabbath or a feast
s: As if from [G3903](G3903); *readiness:* - preparation.

d:
**1.** to extend beside, to stretch out lengthwise, to extend
**2.** to prolong
s: From [G3844](G3844) and τείνω teinō (to *stretch*); to *extend* *along*, that is, *prolong* (in point of time): - continue.

d:
**1.** to stand beside and watch, to watch assiduously, observe carefully
  **a.** to watch, attend to with the eyes
  **b.** of auguries, to see what he is going to do
  **c.** in a bad sense, to watch insidiously
  **d.** to watch one’s self
  **e.** to observe, keep scrupulously
    **1.** to neglect nothing requisite to the religious observance of
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G5083](G5083); to *inspect* *alongside*, that is, *note* *insidiously* or *scrupulously:* - observe, watch.

d: **1.** observation
s: From [G3906](G3906); *inspection*, that is, *ocular* *evidence:* - observation.

d:
**1.** to place beside or near or set before
  **a.** food, i.e. food placed on a table
  **b.** to set before (one) in teaching
  **c.** to set forth (from one’s self), to explain
**2.** to place down (from one’s self or for one’s self) with any one
  **a.** to deposit
  **b.** to intrust, commit to one’s charge
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G5087](G5087); to *place* *alongside*, that is, *present* (food, truth); by implication to *deposit* (as a trust or for protection): - allege, commend, commit (the keeping of), put forth, set before.

d: **1.** to chance to be by, to happen to be present, to meet by chance
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G5177](G5177); to *chance* *near*, that is, *fall* *in* *with:* - meet with.

d: **1.** for the moment
s: From [G3844](G3844) and a derivative of [G846](G846); *at* the *very* instant, that is, *momentary:* - but for a moment.

d:
**1.** to bear to, bring to, put before
**2.** to lead aside from the right course or path, to carry away
**3.** to carry past, lead past
  **a.** to cause to pass by, to remove
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G5342](G5342) (including its alternate forms); to *bear* *along* or *aside*, that is, *carry* *off* (literally or figuratively); by implication to *avert:* - remove, take away.

d: **1.** to be beside one’s self, out of one’s senses, void of understanding, insane
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G5426](G5426); to *misthink*, that is, *be* *insane* (*silly*): - as a fool.

d: **1.** madness, insanity
s: From [G3912](G3912); *insanity*, that is, *foolhardiness:* - madness.

d: **1.** to winter, pass the winter, with one or at a place
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G5492](G5492); to *winter* *near*, that is, *stay* with over the *rainy* season: - winter.

d: **1.** a passing the winter, wintering
s: From [G3914](G3914); a *wintering* over: - winter in.

d: **1.** immediately, forthwith, instantly
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G5536](G5536) (in its original sense); *at* *the* *thing* itself, that is, *instantly:* - forthwith, immediately, presently, straightway, soon.

d:
**1.** a pard, panther, leopard
**2.** a very fierce Asiatic and African animal, having a tawny skin marked with large black spots
s: Feminine of πάρδος pardos (a *panther*); a *leopard:* - leopard.

d:
**1.** to be by, be at hand, to have arrived, to be present
**2.** to be ready, in store, at command
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1510](G1510) (including its various forms); to *be* *near*, that is, *at* *hand*; neuter present participle (singular) *time* *being*, or (plural) *property:* - come, X have, be here, + lack, (be here) present.

d: **1.** to introduce or bring in secretly or craftily
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1521](G1521); to *lead* *in* *aside*, that is, *introduce* *surreptitiously:* - privily bring in.

d:
**1.** secretly or surreptitiously brought in
**2.** one who has stolen in
s: From [G3919](G3919); *smuggled* *in:* - unawares brought in.

d:
**1.** to enter secretly, slip in stealthily
**2.** to steal in
s: From [G3844](G3844) and a compound of [G1519](G1519) and [G1416](G1416); to *settle* *in* *alongside*, that is, *lodge* *stealthily:* - creep in unawares.
o: from [G3844](G3844) and a compound of [G1519](G1519) and [G1416](G1416)

d:
**1.** to come in secretly or by stealth, or creep or steal in
**2.** to enter in addition, come in besides
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1525](G1525); to *come* *in* *along* *side*, that is, *supervene* *additionally* or *stealthily:* - come in privily, enter.

d:
**1.** to bring in besides
**2.** to contribute besides to something
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1533](G1533); to *bear* *in* *alongside*, that is, *introduce* *simultaneously:* - give.

d:
**1.** except, with the exception of (a thing)
**2.** besides
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1622](G1622); *near* *outside*, that is, *besides:* - except, saving, without.

d:
**1.** an encampment
  **a.** the camp of Israel in the desert
    **1.** used for the city of Jerusalem, inasmuch as that was to the Israelites what formerly the encampment had been in the desert
    **2.** of the sacred congregation or assembly of Israel, as it had been gathered formerly in camps in the wilderness
  **b.** the barracks of the Roman soldiers, which at Jerusalem were in the castle of Antonia
**2.** an army in a line of battle
s: From a compound of [G3844](G3844) and [G1685](G1685); a *throwing* *in* *beside* (*juxtaposition*), that is, (specifically) *battle* *array*, *encampment* or *barracks* (tower Antonia): - army, camp, castle.

d: **1.** to cause trouble in a matter, to trouble, annoy
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G1776](G1776); to *harass* *further*, that is, *annoy:* - trouble.

d:
**1.** one who comes from a foreign country into a city or land to reside there by the side of the natives
**2.** a stranger
**3.** sojourning in a strange place, a foreigner
**4.** in the NT metaph. in reference to heaven as the native country, one who sojourns on earth
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the base of [G1927](G1927); an *alien* *alongside*, that is, a *resident* *foreigner:* - pilgrim, stranger.

d:
**1.** to go past, pass by
  **a.** of persons moving forward
    **1.** to pass by
  **b.** of time
    **1.** an act continuing for a time
  **c.** metaph.
    **1.** to pass away, perish
    **2.** to pass by (pass over), that is, to neglect, omit, (transgress)
    **3.** to be led by, to be carried past, be averted
**2.** to come near, come forward, arrive
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2064](G2064); to *come* *near* or *aside*, that is, to *approach* (*arrive*), *go* *by* (or *away*), (figuratively) *perish* or *neglect*, (causatively) *avert:* - come (forth), go, pass (away, by, over), past, transgress.

d: **1.** passing over, letting pass, neglecting, disregarding
s: From [G2935](G2935); *praetermission*, that is, *toleration:* - remission.

d:
**1.** to reach forth, offer
**2.** to show, afford, supply
**3.** to be the authors of, or to cause one to have
  **a.** to give, bring, cause one something either favourable or unfavourable, to occasion
**4.** to offer, show or present one’s self
**5.** to exhibit or offer on one’s own part
  **a.** to render or afford from one’s own resources or by one’s own power
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2192](G2192); to *hold* *near*, that is, *present*, *afford*, *exhibit*, *furnish* *occasion:* - bring, do, give, keep, minister, offer, shew, + trouble.

d:
**1.** addressing, address
  **a.** exhortation
  **b.** comfort, solace, relief, alleviation, consolation
s: From a compound of [G3844](G3844) and a derivative of [G58](G58) (meaning to *harangue* an assembly); an *address* *alongside*, that is, (specifically) *consolation:* - comfort.
o: from a compound of [G3844](G3844) and a derivative of [G58](G58) (meaning to harangue an assembly)

d: **1.** virginity
s: From [G3933](G3933); *maidenhood:* - virginity.

d:
**1.** a virgin

  **b.** a woman who has never had sexual intercourse with a man
  **c.** one’s marriageable daughter
**2.** a man who has abstained from all uncleanness and whoredom attendant on idolatry, and so has kept his chastity
  **a.** one who has never had intercourse with women
s: Of unknown origin; a *maiden*; by implication an unmarried *daughter:* - virgin.

d:
Parthia = a pledge
**1.** an inhabitant of Parthia, a district of Asia, bounded on the north by Hyrcania, on the east by Ariana, on the south by Carmania Deserta, on the west by media
s: Probably of foreign origin; a *Parthian*, that is, inhabitant of Parthia: - Parthian.

d:
**1.** to let pass
  **a.** to pass by, neglect
  **b.** to disregard, omit
**2.** to relax, loose, let go
**3.** relaxed, unstrung, weakened, exhausted
s: From [G3844](G3844) and ίημι  hiēmi (to *send*); to *let* *by*, that is, *relax:* - hang down.

d:
**1.** to place beside or near
  **a.** to set at hand
    **1.** to present
    **2.** to proffer
    **3.** to provide
    **4.** to place a person or thing at one’s disposal
    **5.** to present a person for another to see and question
    **6.** to present or show
    **7.** to bring to, bring near
    **8.** metaph. i.e to bring into one’s fellowship or intimacy
  **b.** to present (show) by argument, to prove
**2.** to stand beside, stand by or near, to be at hand, be present
  **a.** to stand by
    **1.** to stand beside one, a bystander
  **b.** to appear
  **c.** to be at hand, stand ready
  **d.** to stand by to help, to succour
  **e.** to be present
    **1.** to have come
    **2.** of time
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G2476](G2476); to *stand* *beside*, that is, (transitively) to *exhibit*, *proffer*, (specifically) *recommend*, (figuratively) *substantiate*; or (intransitively) to *be* *at* *hand* (or *ready*), *aid:* - assist, bring before, command, commend, give presently, present, prove, provide, shew, stand (before, by, here, up, with), yield.

d:
Parmenas = abiding
**1.** one of the seven deacons of the church at Jerusalem
s: Probaby by contraction for Παρμενίδης Parmenidēs (a derivative of a compound of [G3844](G3844) and [G3306](G3306)); *constant*; *Parmenas*, a Christian: - Parmenas.
o: probably by contraction for Parmenides (a derivative of a compound of [G3844](G3844) and [G3306](G3306))

d:
**1.** a passing by or passage
**2.** in passing
s: From [G3844](G3844) adn [G3598](G3598); a *by* *road*, that is, (actively) a *route:* - way.

d:
**1.** to dwell beside (one) or in one’s neighbourhood, to live near
**2.** in the NT, to be or dwell in a place as a stranger, to sojourn
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3611](G3611); to *dwell* *near*, that is, *reside* as a *foreigner:* - sojourn in, be a stranger.

d:
**1.** a dwelling near or with one
**2.** a sojourning, dwelling in a strange land
**3.** metaph. the life of a man here on earth is likened to a sojourning
s: From [G3941](G3941); *foreign* *residence:* - sojourning, X as strangers.

d:
**1.** dwelling near, neighbouring
**2.** in the NT, a stranger, a foreigner, one who lives in a place without the right of citizenship
**3.** metaph.
  **a.** without citizenship in God’s kingdom
  **b.** one who lives on earth as a stranger, a sojourner on the earth
  **c.** of Christians whose home is in heaven
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3624](G3624); having a *home* *near*, that is, (as noun) a *by-dweller* (*alien* *resident*): - foreigner, sojourn, stranger.

d:
**1.** a saying out of the usual course or deviating from the usual manner of speaking
  **a.** a current or trite saying, a proverb
**2.** any dark saying which shadows forth some didactic truth
  **a.** esp. a symbolic or figurative saying
  **b.** speech or discourse in which a thing is illustrated by the use of similes and comparisons
  **c.** an allegory
    **1.** extended and elaborate metaphor
s: From a compound of [G3844](G3844) and perhaps a derivative of [G3633](G3633); apparently a state *alongside* *of* *supposition*, that is, (concretely) an *adage*; specifically an enigmatical or fictitious *illustration:* - parable, proverb.
o: from a compound of [G3844](G3844) and perhaps a derivative of [G3633](G3633)

d: **1.** given to wine, drunken
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3631](G3631); staying *near* *wine*, that is, *tippling* (a *toper*): - given to wine.

d: **1.** to go by, pass by
s: From [G3844](G3844) and οίχομαι oichomai (to *depart*); to *escape* *along*, that is, *be* *gone:* - past.

d:
**1.** to be like
**2.** to be not unlike
s: From [G3946](G3946); to *resemble:* - be like unto.

d: **1.** like
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3664](G3664); *alike* *nearly*, that is, *similar:* - like.

d:
**1.** to make sharp, sharpen
  **a.** to stimulate, spur on, urge
  **b.** to irritate, provoke, arouse to anger
    **1.** to scorn, despise
    **2.** provoke, make angry
    **3.** to exasperate, to burn with anger
s: From [G3844](G3844) and a derivative of [G3691](G3691); to *sharpen* *alongside*, that is, (figuratively) to *exasperate:* - easily provoke, stir.

d:
**1.** an inciting, incitement
**2.** irritation
s: From [G3947](G3947) (“paroxysm”); *incitement* (to good), or *dispute* (in anger): - contention, provoke unto.

d: **1.** to rouse to wrath, to provoke, exasperate, anger
s: From [G3844](G3844) and [G3710](G3710); to *anger* *alongside*, that is, *enrage:* - anger, provoke to wrath.

d: **1.** indignation, wrath, exasperation
s: From [G3949](G3949); *rage:* - wrath.

d: **1.** to incite, stir up
s: From [G3844](G3844) and ὀτρύνω  otrunō (to *spur*); to *urge* *along*, that is, *stimulate* (to hostility): - stir up.

d:
**1.** presence
**2.** the coming, arrival, advent
  **a.** the future visible return from heaven of Jesus, to raise the dead, hold the last judgment, and set up formally and gloriously the kingdom of God
s: From the present participle of [G3918](G3918); a *being* *near*, that is, *advent* (often, *return*; specifically of Christ to punish Jerusalem, or finally the wicked); (by implication) physical *aspect:* - coming, presence.

d:
**1.** a side dish, a dish of dainties or choice food suited not so much to satisfy as to gratify the appetite
  **a.** a side accompaniment of the more solid food
**2.** the dish itself in which the delicacies are served up
s: From [G3844](G3844) and the base of [G3795](G3795); a *side* *dish* (the receptacle): - platter.

d:
**1.** freedom in speaking, unreservedness in speech

  **b.** without ambiguity or circumlocution
  **c.** without the use of figures and comparisons
**2.** free and fearless confidence, cheerful courage, boldness, assurance
**3.** the deportment by which one becomes conspicuous or secures publicity
s: From [G3956](G3956) and a derivative of [G4483](G4483); *all* out *spokenness*, that is, *frankness*, *bluntness*, *publicity*; by implication *assurance:* - bold (X -ly, -ness, -ness of speech), confidence, X freely, X openly, X plainly (-ness).

d:
**1.** to use freedom in speaking, be free spoken
  **a.** to speak freely
**2.** to grow confident, have boldness, show assurance, assume a bold bearing
s: Middle voice from [G3954](G3954); to *be* *frank* in utterance, or *confident* in spirit and demeanor: - be (wax) bold, (preach, speak) boldly.

d:
**1.** individually
  **a.** each, every, any, all, the whole, everyone, all things, everything
**2.** collectively
  **a.** some of all types ... the whole world has gone after him Did all the world go afterChrist? then went all Judea, and were baptized of him in Jordan.Was all Judea, or all Jerusalem, baptized in Jordan? Ye are of God,little children, and the whole world lieth in the wicked one. Doesthe whole world there mean everybody? The words world and all areused in some seven or eight senses in Scripture, and it is veryrarely the all means all persons, taken individually. The words aregenerally used to signify that christ has redeemed some of all sorts-- some Jews, some Gentiles, some rich, some poor, and has notrestricted his redemption to either Jew or Gentile ...
s: Including all the forms of declension; apparently a primary word; *all*, *any*, *every*, the *whole:* - all (manner of, means) alway (-s), any (one), X daily, + ever, every (one, way), as many as, + no (-thing), X throughly, whatsoever, whole, whosoever.
o: including all the forms of declension

d:
**1.** the paschal sacrifice (which was accustomed to be offered for the people’s deliverance of old from Egypt)
**2.** the paschal lamb, i.e. the lamb the Israelites were accustomed to slay and eat on the fourteenth day of the month of Nisan (the first month of their year) in memory of the day on which their fathers, preparing to depart from Egypt, were bidden by God to slay and eat a lamb, and to sprinkle their door posts with its blood, that the destroying angel, seeing the blood, might pass over their dwellings; christ crucified is likened to the slain paschal lamb
**3.** the paschal supper
**4.** the paschal feast, the feast of the Passover, extending from the 14th to the 20th day of the month Nisan
s: Of Chaldee origin (compare \[[H6453](H6453)\]); the *Passover* (the meal, the day, the festival or the special sacrifices connected with it): - Easter, Passover.

d:
**1.** to be affected or have been affected, to feel, have a sensible experience, to undergo
  **a.** in a good sense, to be well off, in good case
  **b.** in a bad sense, to suffer sadly, be in a bad plight
    **1.** of a sick person
s: Apparently a primary verb (the third form used only in certain tenses for it); to *experience* a sensation or impression (usually painful): - feel, passion, suffer, vex.

d:

s: Probably of foreign origin; *Patara*, a place in Asia Minor: - Patara.

d:

s: Probably a prolongation from [G3817](G3817); to *knock* (gently or with a weapon or fatally): - smite, strike. Compare [G5180](G5180).

d:
**1.** to tread

  **c.** to tread under foot, trample on, i.e. to treat with insult and contempt: to desecrate the holy city by devastation and outrage
s: From a derivative probably of [G3817](G3817) (meaning a “path”); to *trample* (literally or figuratively): - tread (down, under foot).
o: from a derivative probably of [G3817](G3817) (meaning a path)

d:
**1.** generator or male ancestor
  **a.** either the nearest ancestor: father of the corporeal nature, natural fathers, both parents
  **b.** a more remote ancestor, the founder of a family or tribe, progenitor of a people, forefather: so Abraham is called, Jacob and David
    **1.** fathers i.e. ancestors, forefathers, founders of a nation
  **c.** one advanced in years, a senior
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** the originator and transmitter of anything
    **1.** the authors of a family or society of persons animated by the same spirit as himself
    **2.** one who has infused his own spirit into others, who actuates and governs their minds
  **b.** one who stands in a father’s place and looks after another in a paternal way
  **c.** a title of honour
    **1.** teachers, as those to whom pupils trace back the knowledge and training they have received
    **2.** the members of the Sanhedrin, whose prerogative it was by virtue of the wisdom and experience in which they excelled, to take charge of the interests of others
**3.** God is called the father
  **a.** of the stars, the heavenly luminaries, because he is their creator, upholder, ruler
  **b.** of all rational and intelligent beings, whether angels or men, because he is their creator, preserver, guardian and protector
    **1.** of spiritual beings and of all men
  **c.** of Christians, as those who through christ have been exalted to a specially close and intimate relationship with God, and who no longer dread him as a stern judge of sinners, but revere him as their reconciled and loving father
  **d.** the father of Jesus christ, as one whom God has united to himself in the closest bond of love and intimacy, made acquainted with his purposes, appointed to explain and carry out among men the plan of salvation, and made to share also in his own divine nature
    **1.** by Jesus christ himself
    **2.** by the apostles
s: Apparently a primary word; a “father” (literally or figuratively, near or more remote): - father, parent.

d:

o: from [G3962](G3962) and the same as the latter part of [G3389](G3389)

d:

  **b.** the Israelites which distributed into twelve tribes, descended from the twelve sons of Jacob, these were divided into families which were divided into houses

s: As if feminine of a derivative of [G3962](G3962); paternal *descent*, that is, (concretely) a *group* of families or a whole *race* (*nation*): - family, kindred, lineage.

d:
**1.** patriarch, founder of a tribe, progenitor

  **b.** of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob
s: From [G3965](G3965) and [G757](G757); a *progenitor* (“patriarch”): - patriarch.

d: **1.** paternal, ancestral, handed down by or received from one’s fathers

  **b.** one’s own native place i.e. a city

o: from [G3962](G3962) and a derivative of [G3860](G3860) (in the sense of handing over or down)

**1.** descending from father to son or from ancestors to their posterity as it were by right of inheritance
**2.** received from the fathers
s: From [G3962](G3962); *paternal*, that is, *hereditary:* - of fathers.

d:

**2.** Paulus was a deputy or pro-consul of Cyprus and is said to be a prudent man, in the management of affairs, as a governor
s: Of Latin origin; (*little*; but remotely from a derivative of [G3973](G3973), meaning the same); *Paulus*, the name of a Roman and of an apostle: - Paul, Paulus.

d:

s: A primn. verb (“pause”); to *stop* (transitive or intransitive), that is, *restrain*, *quit*, *desist*, *come* *to* *an* *end:* - cease, leave, refrain.

s: Of uncertain derivative; *Paphus*, a place in Cyprus: - Paphos.

d:
**1.** to make thick, to make fat, fatten
**2.** metaph. to make stupid (to render the soul dull or callous)
s: From a derivative of [G4078](G4078) (meaning *thick*); to *thicken*, that is, (by implication) to *fatten* (figuratively *stupefy* or *render* *callous*): - wax gross.

d: **1.** a fetter, shackle for the feet
s: Ultimately from [G4228](G4228); a *shackle* for the feet: - fetter.

d: **1.** level, plain
s: From a derivative of [G4228](G4228) (meaning the *ground*); *level* (as easy for the *feet*): - plain.
o: from a derivative of [G4228](G4228) (meaning the ground)

d: **1.** to travel on foot (not on horseback or in carriage), or (if opp. to going by sea) by land

d:
**1.** on foot (as opposed to riding)
**2.** by land (as opposed to going by sea)
s: Dative feminine of a derivative of [G4228](G4228) (as adverb); *foot* *wise*, that is, by *walking:* - a- (on) foot.
o: dative case feminine of a derivative of [G4228](G4228) (as adv)

d: **1.** to obey (a ruler or a superior)

d: **1.** persuasive
s: From [G3982](G3982); *persuasive:* - enticing.

d:
**1.** persuade
  **a.** to persuade, i.e. to induce one by words to believe
  **b.** to make friends of, to win one’s favour, gain one’s good will, or to seek to win one, strive to please one
  **c.** to tranquillise
  **d.** to persuade unto i.e. move or induce one to persuasion to do something
**2.** be persuaded
  **a.** to be persuaded, to suffer one’s self to be persuaded; to be induced to believe: to have faith: in a thing
    **1.** to believe
    **2.** to be persuaded of a thing concerning a person
  **b.** to listen to, obey, yield to, comply with
**3.** to trust, have confidence, be confident
s: A primary verb; to *convince* (by argument, true or false); by analogy to *pacify* or *conciliate* (by other fair means); reflexively or passively to *assent* (to evidence or authority), to *rely* (by inward certainty): - agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax) content, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield.

d:
**1.** to hunger, be hungry
  **a.** to suffer want
  **b.** to be needy
**2.** metaph. to crave ardently, to seek with eager desire
s: From the same as [G3993](G3993) (through the idea of pinching *toil*; “pine”); to *famish* (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively to *crave:* - be an hungered.
o: from the same as [G3993](G3993) (through the idea of pinching toil; pine)

d:
**1.** a trial, experience, attempt
**2.** to attempt a thing, to make trial of a thing or of a person
**3.** to have a trial of a thing
**4.** to experience, learn to know by experience
s: From the base of [G4008](G4008) (through the idea of *piercing*); a *test*, that is, *attempt*, *experience:* - assaying, trial.
o: from the base of [G4008](G4008) (through the idea of piercing)

d:
**1.** to try whether a thing can be done
  **a.** to attempt, endeavour
**2.** to try, make trial of, test: for the purpose of ascertaining his quantity, or what he thinks, or how he will behave himself
  **a.** in a good sense
  **b.** in a bad sense, to test one maliciously, craftily to put to the proof his feelings or judgments
  **c.** to try or test one’s faith, virtue, character, by enticement to sin
    **1.** to solicit to sin, to tempt
  **d.** of the temptations of the devil
  **e.** after the OT usage
    **1.** of God: to inflict evils upon one in order to prove his character and the steadfastness of his faith
    **2.** men are said to tempt God by exhibitions of distrust, as though they wished to try whether he is not justly distrusted
    **3.** by impious or wicked conduct to test God’s justice and patience, and to challenge him, as it were to give proof of his perfections.
s: From [G3984](G3984); to *test* (objectively), that is, *endeavor*, *scrutinize*, *entice*, *discipline:* - assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt (-er), try.

d:
**1.** an experiment, attempt, trial, proving

  **b.** the trial of man’s fidelity, integrity, virtue, constancy
    **1.** an enticement to sin, temptation, whether arising from the desires or from the outward circumstances
    **2.** an internal temptation to sin
  **c.** of the temptation by which the devil sought to divert Jesus the messiah from his divine errand
    **1.** of the condition of things, or a mental state, by which we are enticed to sin, or to a lapse from the faith and holiness
    **2.** adversity, affliction, trouble: sent by God and serving to test or prove one’s character, faith, holiness
  **d.** temptation (i.e. trial) of God by men
    **1.** rebellion against God, by which his power and justice are, as it were, put to the proof and challenged to show themselves
s: From [G3985](G3985); a putting to *proof* (by experiment \[of good\], *experience* \[of evil\], solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication *adversity:* - temptation, X try.

d:
**1.** to make a trial of, to attempt
  **a.** taught by trial, experienced
**2.** to test, to make trial of one, put him to proof
  **a.** his mind, sentiments, temper
  **b.** in particular, to attempt to induce one to commit some (esp. carnal) crime
  **c.** tempted to sin
s: From [G3984](G3984); to *test* (subjectively), that is, (reflexively) to *attempt:* - assay.

d:
**1.** persuasion
**2.** treacherous or deceptive persuasion
s: From a presumed derivative of [G3982](G3982); *persuadableness*, that is, *credulity:* - persuasion.

d:
**1.** the sea
**2.** the high sea, the deep (where ships sail)
s: Of uncertain affinity; deep or open *sea*, that is, the *main:* - depth, sea.

d: **1.** to cut off with an axe, to behead
s: From a derivative of [G4141](G4141) (meaning an *axe*); to *chop* off (the head), that is, *truncate:* - behead.
o: from a derivative of [G4141](G4141) (meaning an axe)

d: **1.** fifth
s: From [G4002](G4002); *fifth:* - fifth.

d:

  **a.** to bid a thing to be carried to one
  **b.** to send (thrust or insert) a thing into another
s: Apparently a primary verb; to *dispatch* (from the subjective view or point of *departure*, whereas ἵημι hiēmi \[as a stronger form of εἶμι eimi\] refers rather to the objective point or *terminus* *ad* *quem*, and [G4724](G4724) denotes properly the *orderly* motion involved), especially on a temporary errand; also to *transmit*, *bestow*, or *wield:* - send, thrust in.

d: **1.** poor
s: From a primary “peno” (to *toil* for daily subsistence); *starving*, that is, *indigent*: - poor. Compare [G4434](G4434).
o: from a primary peno (to toil for daily subsistence)

d: **1.** mother-in-law, a wife’s mother
s: Feminine of [G3995](G3995); a *wife’s* *mother:* - mother in law, wife’s mother.

d: **1.** father-in-law, a wife’s father
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *wife’s* *father:* - father in law.

d:
**1.** to mourn
**2.** to mourn for, lament one
s: From [G3997](G3997); to *grieve* (*the* *feeling* *or* *the* *act*): - mourn, (be-) wail.

d: **1.** mourning
s: Strengthened from the alternate of [G3958](G3958); *grief:* - mourning, sorrow.

d: **1.** needy, poor
s: Prolonged from the base of [G3993](G3993); *necessitous:* - poor.

d: **1.** five times
s: Multiplicative adverb from [G4002](G4002); *five* *times:* - five times.

d: **1.** five thousand
s: From [G3999](G3999) and [G5507](G5507); *five* *times* *a* *thousand:* - five thousand.

d: **1.** five hundred
s: From [G4002](G4002) and [G1540](G1540); *five* *hundred:* - five hundred.

d: **1.** five
s: A primary number; “five”: - five.

d: **1.** the fifteenth
s: From [G4002](G4002) and [G2532](G2532) and [G1182](G1182); *five* *and* *tenth:* - fifteenth.

d: **1.** fifty
s: Multiplicative of [G4002](G4002); *fifty:* - fifty.

d:
Pentecost = the fiftieth day
**1.** the second of the three great Jewish feasts, celebrated at Jerusalem yearly, the seventh week after the Passover, in grateful recognition of the completed harvest
s: Feminine of [G4004](G4004); *fiftieth* ([G2250](G2250) being implied) from Passover, that is, the festival of “pentecost”: - Pentecost.

d: **1.** trust, confidence, reliance
s: From the perfect of the alternate of [G3958](G3958); *reliance:* - confidence, trust.
o: from the perfect of the alternate of [G3982](G3982)

d: **1.** however much, very much, altogether, indeed
s: From the base of [G4008](G4008); an enclitic particle significant of *abundance* (*thoroughness*), that is, *emphasis*; *much*, *very* or *ever:* - \[whom-\] soever.

d: **1.** beyond, on the other side
s: Apparently the accusative case of an obsolete derivation of πείρω peirō (to “peirce”); *through* (as adverb or preposition), that is, *across:* - beyond, farther (other) side, over.
o: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of peiro (to pierce)

d:
**1.** extremity, bound, end
  **a.** of a portion of space
    **1.** boundary
    **2.** frontier
    **3.** the ends of the earth
    **4.** the remotest lands
  **b.** of a thing extending through a period of time (termination)
s: From the same as [G4008](G4008); an *extremity:* - end, ut- (ter-) most part.

d:
Pergamos = height or elevation
**1.** a city of mysia Minor, in Asia Minor, the seat of the dynasties of Attalus and Eumenes, famous for its temple of Aesculapius and the invention and manufacture of parchment. The river Selinus flowed through it and the Cetius ran past it. It was the birthplace of the physician Galen, and had a great royal library. It had a Christian church.
s: From [G4444](G4444); *fortified*; *Pergamus*, a place in Asia Minor: - Pergamos.

d:
Perga = earthy
**1.** a town in Pamphylia, on the river Cestius, at a distance of 7 miles (10 km) from its mouth, and famous in antiquity for the worship of Artemis (Diana)
s: Probably from the same as [G4010](G4010); a *tower*; *Perga*, a place in Asia Minor: - Perga.

d: **1.** about, concerning, on account of, because of, around, near
s: From the base of [G4008](G4008); properly *through* (all *over*), that is, *around*; figuratively *with* *respect* to; used in various applications, of place, cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the *subject* or *occasion* or *superlative* point; with the accusative case the *locality*, *circuit*, *matter*, *circumstance* or general *period*): - (there-) about, above, against, at, on behalf of, X and his company, which concern, (as) concerning, for, X how it will go with, (\[there-, where-\]) of, on, over, pertaining (to), for sake, X (e-) state, (as) touching, \[where-\] by (in), with. In compounds it retains substantially the same meaning of circuit (*around*), excess (*beyond*), or completeness (*through*).

d:
**1.** to lead around, to lead about with one’s self
**2.** to go about, walk about
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G71](G71); to *take* *around* (as a companion); reflexively to *walk* *around:* - compass, go (round) about, lead about.

d:
**1.** to take away that which surrounds or envelopes a thing
**2.** metaph. to take away altogether or entirely
  **a.** the guilt of sin, to expiate perfectly
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G138](G138) (including its alternate); to *remove* all *around*, that is, *unveil*, *cast* *off* (anchor); figuratively to *expiate:* - take away (up).

d: **1.** to flash around, shine about
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G797](G797); to *flash* all *around*, that is, *envelop* *in* *light:* - shine round (about).

d:
**1.** to throw around, to put around
  **a.** to surround a city with a bank (palisade)
  **b.** of garments, to clothe one
    **1.** to put a thing on one
    **2.** to clothe one with a thing
  **c.** to put on or clothe one’s self
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G906](G906); to *throw* all *around*, that is, *invest* (with a palisade or with clothing): - array, cast about, clothe (-d me), put on.

d:
**1.** to look around
**2.** to look around about one’s self
**3.** to look round on one (i.e. to look for one’s self at one near by)
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G991](G991); to *look* all *around:* - look (round) about (on).

d:
**1.** a covering thrown around, a wrapper
  **a.** a mantle
  **b.** a veil
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G4016](G4016); something *thrown* *around* one, that is, a *mantle*, *veil:* - covering, vesture.

d: **1.** to bind around, tie over
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G1210](G1210); to *bind* *around* one, that is, *enwrap:* - bind about.

d:
**1.** to bustle about uselessly, to busy one’s self about trifling, needless, useless matters
  **a.** used apparently of a person officiously inquisitive about other’s affairs
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2038](G2038); to *work* all *around*, that is, *bustle* *about* (*meddle*): - be a busybody.

d:
**1.** busy about trifles and neglectful of important matters
  **a.** esp. busy about other folks’ affairs, a busybody
  **b.** of things: impertinent and superfluous
    **1.** of magic arts
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2041](G2041); *working* *all* *around*, that is, *officious* (*meddlesome*, neuter plural *magic*): - busybody, curious arts.

d:
**1.** to go about
  **a.** of strollers
  **b.** of wanderers
  **c.** of navigators (making a circuit)
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2064](G2064) (including its alternate); to *come* all *around*, that is, *stroll*, *vacillate*, *veer:* - fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about.

d:
**1.** to surround, encompass
  **a.** to contain: of the subject-matter, contents, of a writing
  **b.** to take possession of, to seize
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2192](G2192); to *hold* all *around*, that is, *include*, *clasp* (figuratively): - + astonished, contain, after \[this manner\].

d:
**1.** to fasten garments with a girdle or belt
**2.** to gird one’s self
**3.** metaph. with truth as a girdle
  **a.** to equip one’s self with knowledge of the truth
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2224](G2224); to *gird* all *around*, that is, (middle or passive voice) to *fasten* *on* *one’s* *belt* (literally or figuratively): - gird (about, self).

d:
**1.** the act of putting around
**2.** the adornment consisting of the golden ornaments wont to be placed around the head or the body
s: From [G4060](G4060); a *putting* all *around*, that is, *decorating* oneself with: - wearing.

d:
**1.** to place around one
**2.** to stand around
  **a.** to turn one’s self about for the purpose of avoiding something
  **b.** to avoid, shun
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2476](G2476); to *stand* all *around*, that is, (near) to *be* *a* *bystander*, or (aloof) to *keep* *away* from: - avoid, shun, stand by (round about).

d:
**1.** off scouring, refuse
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** the most abject and despicable men
  **b.** the price of expiation or redemption, because the Greeks used to apply the term katharmata to victims sacrificed to make expiation for the people, and even to criminals who were maintained at the public expense, that on the outbreak of a pestilence or other calamity they might be offered as sacrifices to make expiation for the state
s: From a compound of [G4012](G4012) and [G2508](G2508); something *cleaned* off all *around*, that is, *refuse* (figuratively): - filth.

d: **1.** to cover all around, to cover up, cover over
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2572](G2572); to *cover* all *around*, that is, *entirely* (the face, a surface): - blindfold, cover, overlay.

d:
**1.** to lie around
**2.** to be compassed with, have round one
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2749](G2749); to *lie* all *around*, that is, *inclose*, *encircle*, *hamper* (literally or figuratively): - be bound (compassed) with, hang about.

d:
**1.** a helmet
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** the protection of the soul which consists in (the hope of) salvation
s: Feminine of a compound of [G4012](G4012) and [G2776](G2776); *encirclement* *of* the *head*, that is, a *helmet:* - helmet.

d: **1.** having power over a thing
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2904](G2904); *strong* all *around*, that is, a *master* (*manager*): - + come by.

d: **1.** to conceal on all sides or entirely, to hide, seclude
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2928](G2928); to *conceal* all *around*, that is, *entirely:* - hide.

d:
**1.** to encircle, compass about
  **a.** of a city (besieged)
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2944](G2944); to *encircle* all *around*, that is, *blockade* *completely:* - compass round.

d: **1.** to shine around
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G2989](G2989); to *illuminate* all *around*, that is, *invest* *with* *a* *halo:* - shine round about.

d:
**1.** to leave over
**2.** to remain over, to survive
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G3007](G3007); to *leave* all *around*, that is, (passively) *survive:* - remain.

d:
**1.** very sad, exceedingly sorrowful
**2.** overcome with sorrow so much as to cause one’s death
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G3077](G3077); *grieved* all *around*, that is, *intensely* *sad:* - exceeding (very) sorry (-owful).

d: **1.** to wait for
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G3306](G3306); to *stay* *around*, that is, *await:* - wait for.

d: **1.** round about: the neighbouring cities
s: Adverb from [G4012](G4012); all *around*, that is, (as adjective) *circumjacent:* - round about.

d: **1.** to dwell round about, to be one’s neighbour
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G3611](G3611); to *reside* *around*, that is, *be* a *neighbor:* - dwell round about.

d: **1.** dwelling around, a neighbour
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G3624](G3624); *housed* *around*, that is, *neighboring* (elliptically as noun): - neighbour.

d:
**1.** that which is one’s own, belonging to one’s possessions
  **a.** a people selected by God from the other nations for his own possession
s: From the present participle feminine of a compound of [G4012](G4012) and [G1510](G1510); *being* *beyond* usual, that is, *special* (one’s *own*): - peculiar.
o: from the present participle feminine of a compound of [G4012](G4012) and [G1510](G1510)

d:
**1.** an encompassing, compass, circuit
**2.** that which is contained
  **a.** the contents of any writing
s: From [G4023](G4023); a *being* *held* *around*, that is, (concretely) a *passage* (of Scripture, as *circumscribed*): - place.

d:
**1.** to walk
  **a.** to make one’s way, progress; to make due use of opportunities
  **b.** Hebrew for, to live
    **1.** to regulate one’s life
    **2.** to conduct one’s self
    **3.** to pass one’s life
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G3961](G3961); to *tread* all *around*, that is, *walk* at large (especially as proof of ability); figuratively to *live*, *deport* *oneself*, *follow* (as a companion or votary): - go, be occupied with, walk (about).

d:
**1.** to pierce through
**2.** metaph. to torture one’s soul with sorrows
s: From [G4012](G4012) and the base of [G4008](G4008); to *penetrate* *entirely*, that is, *transfix* (figuratively): - pierce through.

d: **1.** so to fall into as to be encompassed
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G4098](G4098); to *fall* into something that is all *around*, that is, *light* *among* or *upon*, *be* *surrounded* *with:* - fall among (into).

d:
**1.** to make to remain over
**2.** to reserve, to leave or keep safe, lay by
**3.** to make to remain for one’s self
**4.** to preserve for one’s self
**5.** to get for one’s self, purchase
s: Middle voice from [G4012](G4012) and [G4160](G4160); to *make* *around* *oneself*, that is, *acquire* (*buy*): - purchase.

d:
**1.** a preserving, a preservation
**2.** possession, one’s own property
**3.** an obtaining
s: From [G4046](G4046); *acquisition* (the act or the thing); by extension *preservation:* - obtain (-ing), peculiar, purchased, possession, saving.

d:
**1.** to break off on all sides, break off all around
**2.** to rend or tear off all around
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G4486](G4486); to *tear* all *around*, that is, *completely* *away:* - rend off.

d:
**1.** to draw around, to draw away, distract
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to be driven about mentally, to be distracted
  **b.** to be over-occupied, too busy, about a thing
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G4685](G4685); to *drag* all *around*, that is, (figuratively) to *distract* (with care): - cumber.

d:
**1.** abundance, superabundantly, superfluously
**2.** superiority, preference, pre-eminence
**3.** gain, profit
**4.** residue, remains: the wickedness remaining over in a Christian from his state prior to conversion used by the Greeks to describe the excess wax in their ears.
s: From [G4052](G4052); *surplusage*, that is, *superabundance:* - abundance (-ant, \[-ly\]), superfluity.

d:
**1.** abundance, in which one delights
  **a.** of that which fills the heart
**2.** that which is left over, residue, remains
s: From [G4052](G4052); a *surplus*, or *superabundance:* - abundance, that was left, over and above.

d:
**1.** to exceed a fixed number of measure, to be left over and above a certain number or measure
  **a.** to be over, to remain
  **b.** to exist or be at hand in abundance
    **1.** to be great (abundant)
    **2.** a thing which comes in abundance, or overflows unto one, something falls to the lot of one in large measure
    **3.** to redound unto, turn out abundantly for, a thing
  **c.** to abound, overflow
    **1.** to be abundantly furnished with, to have in abundance, abound in (a thing), to be in affluence
    **2.** to be pre-eminent, to excel
    **3.** to excel more than, exceed
**2.** to make to abound
  **a.** to furnish one richly so that he has abundance
  **b.** to make abundant or excellent
s: From [G4053](G4053); to *superabound* (in quantity or quality), *be* *in* *excess*, *be* *superfluous*; also (transitively) to *cause* *to* *superabound* or *excel:* - (make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance, (be more) abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase, be left, redound, remain (over and above).

d:
**1.** exceeding some number or measure or rank or need
  **a.** over and above, more than is necessary, superadded
    **1.** exceeding abundantly, supremely
    **2.** something further, more, much more than all, more plainly
  **b.** superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon
    **1.** pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent
s: From [G4012](G4012) (in the sense of *beyond*); *superabundant* (in quantity) or *superior* (in quality); by implication *excessive*; adverb (with [G1537](G1537)) *violently*; neuter (as noun) *preeminence:* - exceeding abundantly above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond measure, more, superfluous, vehement \[-ly\].

d:
**1.** exceeding some number or measure or rank or need
  **a.** over and above, more than is necessary, superadded
    **1.** exceeding abundantly, supremely
    **2.** something further, more, much more than all, more plainly
  **b.** superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon
    **1.** pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent
s: Neuter of [G4055](G4055) (as adverb); in a *more* *superabundant* way: - more abundantly, a great deal, far more.

d:
**1.** exceeding some number or measure or rank or need
  **a.** over and above, more than is necessary, superadded
    **1.** exceeding abundantly, supremely
    **2.** something further, more, much more than all, more plainly
  **b.** superior, extraordinary, surpassing, uncommon
    **1.** pre-eminence, superiority, advantage, more eminent, more remarkable, more excellent
s: Comparative of [G4053](G4053); *more* *superabundant* (in number, degree or character): - more abundant, greater (much) more, overmuch.

d:
**1.** more abundantly
**2.** more in a greater degree
**3.** more earnestly, more exceedingly
**4.** especially, above others
s: Adverb from [G4055](G4055); *more* *superabundantly:* - more abundant (-ly), X the more earnest, (more) exceedingly, more frequent, much more, the rather.

d:
**1.** beyond measure, extraordinary
**2.** greatly, exceedingly
s: Adverb from [G4053](G4053); *superabundantly:* - exceedingly, out of measure, the more.

d: **1.** a dove
s: Of uncertain derivation; a *pigeon:* - dove, pigeon.

d:
**1.** to cut around
**2.** to circumcise
  **a.** cut off one’s prepuce (used of that well known rite by which not only the male children of the Israelites, on the eighth day after birth, but subsequently also proselytes of righteousness were consecrated to Jehovah and introduced into the number of his people)
  **b.** to get one’s self circumcised, present one’s self to be circumcised, receive circumcision
  **c.** since by the rite of circumcision a man was separated from the unclean world and dedicated to God, the word is transferred to denote the extinguishing of lusts and the removal of sins
s: From [G4012](G4012) and the base of [G5114](G5114); to *cut* *around*, that is, (specifically) to *circumcise:* - circumcise.

d:
**1.** to place around, set about
**2.** to put on a garment
**3.** to put or bind a thing around another
**4.** to present, to bestow, confer, a thing upon one
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G5087](G5087); to *place* *around*; by implication to *present:* - bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set about.

d:
**1.** circumcised
  **a.** the act or rite of circumcision, they of the circumcision is a term used of the Jews
    **1.** of Christians gathered from among the Jews
    **2.** the state of circumcision
  **b.** metaph.
    **1.** of Christians separated from the unclean multitude and truly consecrated to God
    **2.** the extinction of passions and the removal of spiritual impurity
s: From [G4059](G4059); *circumcision* (the rite, the condition or the people, literally or figuratively): - X circumcised, circumcision.

d:
**1.** to turn about, to turn
**2.** to transfer or change by turning
  **a.** a person or thing into some state
  **b.** turning one mad
s: From [G4012](G4012) and the base of [G5157](G5157); to *turn* *around*, that is, (mentally) to *craze:* - + make mad.

d: **1.** to run around, run around about
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G5143](G5143) (including its alternate); to *run* *around*, that is, *traverse:* - run through.

d:
**1.** to carry round, to bear about everywhere with one
**2.** to carry here and there
**3.** to be driven
  **a.** in doubt and hesitation to be led away now to this opinion, now to that
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G5342](G5342); to *convey* *around*, that is, *transport* *hither* *and* *thither:* - bear (carry) about.

d:
**1.** to consider or examine on all sides i.e. carefully, thoroughly
**2.** to set one’s self in thought beyond (exalt one’s self in thought above) a person or a thing
**3.** to contemn, to despise
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G5426](G5426); to *think* *beyond*, that is, *depreciate* (*contemn*): - despise.

d:
**1.** lying round about, neighbouring
  **a.** the region round about
  **b.** the region of Jordan
s: From [G4012](G4012) and [G5561](G5561); *around* the *region*, that is, *circumjacent* (as noun, with [G1093](G1093) implied, *vicinity*): - country (round) about, region (that lieth) round about.

d:
**1.** what is wiped off
**2.** dirt rubbed off
**3.** off scouring, scrapings
s: From a compound of [G4012](G4012) and “psao” (to *rub*); something *brushed* all *around*, that is, *off* *scrapings* (figuratively *scum*): - offscouring.
o: from a comparative of [G4012](G4012) and psao (to rub)

d:
**1.** to boast one’s self
**2.** a self display, employing rhetorical embellishments in extolling one’s self excessively
s: Middle voice from πέρπερος perperos (*braggart*; perhaps by reduplication of the base of [G4008](G4008)); to *boast:* - vaunt itself.
o: middle voice from perperos (braggart, perhaps by reduplication of the base of [G4008](G4008))

d:
Persis = a Persian woman
**1.** a Christian woman at Rome
s: A *Persian* woman; *Persis*, a Christian female: - Persis.

d:
**1.** last year
**2.** the year just past
  **a.** for a year past, a year ago
s: Adverb from [G4009](G4009); the *by* *gone*, that is, (as noun) *last* *year:* - + a year ago.

d:
**1.** flying, winged
**2.** flying or winged animals, birds
  **a.** the birds of the heaven, i.e. flying in the heaven (air)
s: Neuter of a derivative of [G4072](G4072); a *flying* animal, that is, *bird:* - bird, fowl.

d: **1.** to fly
s: Including the prolonged form (second form) and contraction (third form) of the middle voice of a primary verb; to *fly:* - fly (-ing).
o: middle voice of a primary verb

d:
**1.** a rock, cliff or ledge
  **a.** a projecting rock, crag, rocky ground
  **b.** a rock, a large stone
  **c.** metaph. a man like a rock, by reason of his firmness and strength of soul
s: Feminine of the same as [G4074](G4074); a (mass of) *rock* (literally or figuratively): - rock.

d:
Peter = a rock or a stone
**1.** one of the twelve disciples of Jesus
s: Apparently a primary word; a (piece of) *rock* (larger than [G3037](G3037)); as a name, *Petrus*, an apostle: - Peter, rock. Compare [G2786](G2786).

d:
**1.** rocky, stony
  **a.** of a ground full of rocks
s: From [G4073](G4073) and [G1491](G1491); *rock* *like*, that is, *rocky:* - stony.

d:
**1.** rue
**2.** a shrubby plant about 2 feet (60 cm) high, of medicinal value
s: From [G4078](G4078); *rue* (from its *thick* or *fleshy* leaves): - rue.

d:
**1.** fountain, spring
**2.** a well fed by a spring
s: Probably from [G4078](G4078) (through the idea of *gushing* plumply); a *fount* (literally or figuratively), that is, *source* or *supply* (of water, blood, enjoyment), (not necessarily the original spring): - fountain, well.
o: probably from [G4078](G4078) (through the idea of gushing plumply)

d:
**1.** to make fast, to fix
**2.** to fasten together, to build by fastening together
s: A prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to *fix* (“peg”), that is, (specifically) to *set* *up* (a tent): - pitch.
o: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses)

d: **1.** a ship’s rudder
s: Neuter of a (presumed) derivative of πηδόν pēdon (the *blade* of an oar; from the same as [G3976](G3976)); a “pedal”, that is, *helm:* - rudder.
o: from a (presumed) derivative of pedon (the blade of an oar, from the same as [G3976](G3976))

d:
**1.** how great, how large
  **a.** in a material reference (denoting geometrical magnitude as distinguished from arithmetical)
  **b.** in an ethical sense: how distinguished
s: A quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of [G4225](G4225); *how* *much* (as indefinite), that is, in size or (figuratively) dignity: - how great (large).
o: a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of [G4225](G4225)

d:
**1.** clay, which potters uses
**2.** mud (wet clay)
s: Perhaps a primary word; *clay:* - clay.

d:
**1.** a wallet
**2.** a leathern sack, in which travellers and shepherds carried their provisions
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *wallet* or leather *pouch* for food: - scrip.

d:
**1.** a cubit
**2.** a measure of length equal to distance from the joint of the elbow to the tip of the middle finger (i.e. about 18 inches, (.5 m) but its precise length varied and is disputed)
s: Of uncertain affinity; the *fore* *arm*, that is, (as a measure) a *cubit:* - cubit.

d:
**1.** to lay hold of
**2.** to take, capture
  **a.** of fishes
**3.** to apprehend
  **a.** of a man, in order to imprison him
s: Probably another form of [G971](G971); to *squeeze*, that is, *seize* (gently by the hand \[*press*\], or officially \[*arrest*\], or in hunting \[*capture*\]): - apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take. Compare [G4085](G4085).

d: **1.** to press, press together
s: Another form for [G4084](G4084); to *pack:* - press down.

d:
**1.** speech adapted to persuade, discourse in which probable arguments are adduced
**2.** in a bad sense, persuasiveness of speech, specious discourse leading others into error
s: From a compound of a derivative of [G3982](G3982) and [G3056](G3056); *persuasive* *language:* - enticing words.
o: from a compound of a derivative of [G3982](G3982) and [G3056](G3056)

d:
**1.** to make bitter
  **a.** to produce a bitter taste in the stomach
**2.** to embitter. exasperate
  **a.** render angry, indignant
  **b.** to be embittered, irritated
  **c.** to visit with bitterness, to grieve (deal bitterly with)
s: From [G4089](G4089); to *embitter* (literally or figuratively): - be (make) bitter.

d:
**1.** bitter gall
  **a.** extreme wickedness
  **b.** a bitter root, and so producing a bitter fruit
  **c.** metaph. bitterness, bitter hatred
s: From [G4089](G4089); *acridity* (especially *poison*), literally or figuratively: - bitterness.

d:
**1.** bitter
**2.** metaph. harsh, virulent
s: Perhaps from [G4078](G4078) (through the idea of *piercing*); *sharp* (*pungent*), that is, *acrid* (literally or figuratively): - bitter.
o: perhaps from [G4078](G4078) (through the idea of piercing)

d:
**1.** bitterly
**2.** metaph. with poignant grief
s: Adverb from [G4089](G4089); *bitterly*, that is, (figuratively) *violently:* - bitterly.

d:
Pilate = armed with a spear
**1.** the sixth Roman procurator of Judah and Samaria who ordered christ to be crucified
s: Of Latin origin; *close* *pressed*, that is, *firm*; *Pilatus*, a Roman: - Pilate.

d:
**1.** to blow, to burn
**2.** to cause to swell, to render timid
**3.** to swell, become swollen
  **a.** of the parts of the body
s: A reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary word, πρέω preō, (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); to *fire*, that is, *burn* (figuratively and passively *become* *inflamed* with fever): - be (X should have) swollen.
o: a reduplicated and prolonged form of a primary preo preh’-o

d:
**1.** a small tablet
**2.** a writing tablet
s: Diminutive of [G4094](G4094); a *tablet* (for writing on): - writing table.

d:
**1.** a board, a tablet
**2.** a dish, plate, platter
s: Apparently a form of [G4109](G4109); a *plate:* - charger, platter.

d:
**1.** to drink
**2.** figuratively, to receive into the soul what serves to refresh strengthen, nourish it unto life eternal
s: The first is a prolonged form of the second, which (together with the third form) occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; to *imbibe* (literally or figuratively): - drink.
o: a prolonged form of pio pee’-o; which (together with another form poo po’-o, occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses

d: **1.** fatness
s: From πίων piōn (*fat*; perhaps akin to the alternate of [G4095](G4095) through the idea of *repletion*); *plumpness*, that is, (by implication) *richness* (*oiliness*): - fatness.
o: from pion (fat, perhaps akin to the alternate of [G4095](G4095) through the idea of repletion)

d:
**1.** to sell
  **a.** of price, one into slavery
  **b.** of the master to whom one is sold as a slave
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** sold under sin, entirely under the control of the love of sinning
  **b.** of one bribed to give himself up wholly to another’s will
s: The first is a reduplicated and prolonged form of the second (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); contracted from περάω peraō (to *traverse*; from the base of [G4008](G4008)); to *traffic* (by *travelling*), that is, *dispose* of as merchandise or into slavery (literally or figuratively): - sell.
o: a reduplicated and prolonged form of prao prah’-o, (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses), contracted from perao (to traverse, from the base of [G4008](G4008))

d:
**1.** to descend from a higher place to a lower
  **a.** to fall (either from or upon)
    **1.** to be thrust down
  **b.** metaph. to fall under judgment, came under condemnation
**2.** to descend from an erect to a prostrate position
  **a.** to fall down
    **1.** to be prostrated, fall prostrate
    **2.** of those overcome by terror or astonishment or grief or under the attack of an evil spirit or of falling dead suddenly
    **3.** the dismemberment of a corpse by decay
    **4.** to prostrate one’s self
    **5.** used of suppliants and persons rendering homage or worship to one
    **6.** to fall out, fall from i.e. shall perish or be lost
    **7.** to fall down, fall into ruin: of buildings, walls etc.
  **b.** to be cast down from a state of prosperity
    **1.** to fall from a state of uprightness
    **2.** to perish, i.e come to an end, disappear, cease
  **c.** of virtues
    **1.** to lose authority, no longer have force
  **d.** of sayings, precepts, etc.
    **1.** to be removed from power by death
    **2.** to fail of participating in, miss a share in
s: The first is a reduplicated and contracted form of the second (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses); probably akin to [G4072](G4072) through the idea of *alighting*; to *fall* (literally of figuratively): - fail, fall (down), light on.
o: a reduplicated and contracted form of peto pet’-o, (which occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses), probably akin to [G4072](G4072) through the idea of alighting

d:
Pisidia = pitchy
**1.** a region in Asia Minor bounded by Pamphylia, and the Pamphylian Sea, Phrygia, and Lycaonia
s: Probably of foreign origin; *Pisidia*, a region of Asia Minor: - Pisidia.

d:
**1.** to think to be true, to be persuaded of, to credit, place confidence in
  **a.** of the thing believed
    **1.** to credit, have confidence
  **b.** in a moral or religious reference
    **1.** used in the NT of the conviction and trust to which a man is impelled by a certain inner and higher prerogative and law of soul
    **2.** to trust in Jesus or God as able to aid either in obtaining or in doing something: saving faith 1bc) mere acknowledgment of some fact or event: intellectual faith
**2.** to entrust a thing to one, i.e. his fidelity
  **a.** to be intrusted with a thing
s: From [G4102](G4102); to *have* *faith* (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or thing), that is, *credit*; by implication to *entrust* (especially one’s spiritual well being to Christ): - believe (-r), commit (to trust), put in trust with.

d:
**1.** pertaining to belief
  **a.** having the power of persuading, skilful in producing belief
  **b.** trusty, faithful, that can be relied on
s: From [G4102](G4102); *trustworthy*, that is, *genuine* (*unadulterated*): - spike-\[nard\].

d:
**1.** conviction of the truth of anything, belief; in the NT of a conviction or belief respecting man’s relationship to God and divine things, generally with the included idea of trust and holy fervour born of faith and joined with it
  **a.** relating to God
    **1.** the conviction that God exists and is the creator and ruler of all things, the provider and bestower of eternal salvation through christ
  **b.** relating to christ
    **1.** a strong and welcome conviction or belief that Jesus is the messiah, through whom we obtain eternal salvation in the kingdom of God
  **c.** the religious beliefs of Christians
  **d.** belief with the predominate idea of trust (or confidence) whether in God or in christ, springing from faith in the same
**2.** fidelity, faithfulness
  **a.** the character of one who can be relied on
s: From [G3982](G3982); *persuasion*, that is, *credence*; moral *conviction* (of *religious* truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially *reliance* upon Christ for salvation; abstractly *constancy* in such profession; by extension the system of religious (Gospel) *truth* itself: - assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity.

d:
**1.** trusty, faithful
  **a.** of persons who show themselves faithful in the transaction of business, the execution of commands, or the discharge of official duties
  **b.** one who kept his plighted faith, worthy of trust
  **c.** that can be relied on
**2.** easily persuaded
  **a.** believing, confiding, trusting
  **b.** in the NT one who trusts in God’s promises
    **1.** one who is convinced that Jesus has been raised from the dead
    **2.** one who has become convinced that Jesus is the messiah and author of salvation
s: From [G3982](G3982); objectively *trustworthy*; subjectively *trustful:* - believe (-ing, -r), faithful (-ly), sure, true.

d:
**1.** to make faithful, render trustworthy
  **a.** to make firm, establish
**2.** to be firmly persuaded of
  **a.** to be assured of
s: From [G4103](G4103); to *assure:* - assure of.

d:
**1.** to cause to stray, to lead astray, lead aside from the right way
  **a.** to go astray, wander, roam about
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** to lead away from the truth, to lead into error, to deceive
  **b.** to be led into error
  **c.** to be led aside from the path of virtue, to go astray, sin
  **d.** to sever or fall away from the truth
    **1.** of heretics
  **e.** to be led away into error and sin
s: From [G4106](G4106); to (properly *cause* to) roam (from safety, truth, or virtue): - go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way.

d:
**1.** a wandering, a straying about
  **a.** one led astray from the right way, roams hither and thither
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** mental straying
    **1.** error, wrong opinion relative to morals or religion
  **b.** error which shows itself in action, a wrong mode of acting
  **c.** error, that which leads into error, deceit or fraud
s: Feminine of [G4108](G4108) (as abstraction); objectively *fraudulence*; subjectively a *straying* from orthodoxy or piety: - deceit, to deceive, delusion, error.

d: **1.** a wanderer: wandering stars
s: From [G4108](G4108); a *rover* (“planet”), that is, (figuratively) an *erratic* teacher: - wandering.

d:
**1.** wandering, roving
**2.** misleading, leading into error
  **a.** a vagabond, tramp, imposter
  **b.** corrupter, deceiver
s: Of uncertain affinity; *roving* (as a *tramp*), that is, (by implication) an *impostor* or *misleader:* - deceiver, seducing.

d: **1.** a flat thing, broad tablet, plane, level surface (as of the sea)
s: From [G4111](G4111); a *moulding* *board*, that is, *flat* surface (“plate”, or *tablet*, literally or figuratively): - table.

d:
**1.** what has been moulded or formed, as from wax
**2.** the thing formed by a potter, earthen vessel
s: From [G4111](G4111); something *moulded:* - thing formed.

d:
**1.** to form, mould (something from clay, wax, etc.)
  **a.** used of a potter
s: A primary verb; to *mould*, that is, *shape* or *fabricate:* - form.

d:
**1.** moulded, formed, as from clay, wax, or stone
**2.** feigned
s: From [G4111](G4111); *moulded*, that is, (by implication) *artificial* or (figuratively) *fictitious* (*false*): - feigned.

d: **1.** a broad way, a street
s: Feminine of [G4116](G4116); a *wide* “plat” or “place”, that is, open *square:* - street.

d:
**1.** breadth
  **a.** suggesting great extent
s: From [G4116](G4116); *width:* - breadth.

d:
**1.** to make broad, enlarge
**2.** be enlarged in heart, i.e. to welcome and embrace you in love
s: From [G4116](G4116); to *widen* (literally or figuratively): - make broad, enlarge.

d: **1.** broad
s: From [G4111](G4111); spread out “flat” (“plot”), that is, *broad:* - wide.

d:
**1.** what is woven, plaited, or twisted together
**2.** a web, plait, braid
  **a.** of a net
  **b.** of a basket, in which the infant Moses was laid
  **c.** of braided hair
s: From [G4120](G4120); a *plait* (of hair): - broidered hair.

d:
**1.** most
**2.** at the very most
s: Irregular superlative of [G4183](G4183); the *largest* *number* or *very* *large:* - very great, most.

d:
**1.** greater in quantity
  **a.** the more part, very many
**2.** greater in quality, superior, more excellent
