s: Comparative of [G4183](G4183); *more* in quantity, number, or quality; also (in plural) the *major* *portion:* - X above, + exceed, more excellent, further, (very) great (-er), long (-er), (very) many, greater (more) part, + yet but.

d: **1.** to plait, braid, weave together
s: A primary word; to *twine* or *braid:* - plait.

d:
**1.** to superabound
  **a.** of things
    **1.** to exist in abundance
    **2.** to increase
    **3.** be augmented
**2.** to make to increase: one in a thing
s: From [G4119](G4119); to *do*, *make* or *be* *more*, that is, *increase* (transitively or intransitively); by extension to *superabound:* - abound, abundant, make to increase, have over.

d:
**1.** to have more, or a greater part or share
  **a.** to be superior, excel, surpass, have an advantage over
**2.** to gain or take advantage of another, to overreach
s: From [G4123](G4123); to *be* *covetous*, that is, (by implication) to *over* *reach:* - get an advantage, defraud, make a gain.

d:
**1.** one eager to have more, esp. what belongs to others
**2.** greedy of gain, covetous
s: From [G4119](G4119) and [G2192](G2192); *holding* (*desiring*) *more*, that is, *eager* *for* *gain* (*avaricious*, hence a *defrauder*): - covetous.

d: **1.** greedy desire to have more, covetousness, avarice
s: From [G4123](G4123); *avarice*, that is, (by implication) *fraudulency*, *extortion:* - covetous (-ness) practices, greediness.

d: **1.** the side of the body
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *rib*, that is, (by extension) *side:* - side.

d: **1.** to sail, navigate, travel by ship
s: The first is another form for the second which is used as an alternate in certain tenses; probably a form of [G4150](G4150) (through the idea of *plunging* through the water); to *pass* in a vessel: - sail. See also [G4130](G4130).
o: another form for pleuo plyoo’-o, which is used as an alternate in certain tenses, probably a form of [G4150](G4150) (through the idea of plunging through the water)

d:
**1.** a blow, stripe, a wound
**2.** a public calamity, heavy affliction, plague,
s: From [G4141](G4141); a *stroke*; by implication a *wound*; figuratively a *calamity:* - plague, stripe, wound (-ed).

d:
**1.** a multitude
  **a.** a great number, of men or things
  **b.** the whole number, the whole multitude, the assemblage
    **1.** the multitude of the people
s: From [G4130](G4130); a *fulness*, that is, a *large* *number*, *throng*, *populace:* - bundle, company, multitude.

d:
**1.** to increase, to multiply
  **a.** to be increased, (be multiplied) multiply
**2.** to be increased, to multiply
s: From another form of [G4128](G4128); to *increase* (transitively or intransitively): - abound, multiply.

d:
**1.** to fill
**2.** to be fulfilled, to be filled
s: A prolonged form of a primary word πλέω pleō (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form of πίμπλημι pimplēmi to “*fill*” (literally or figuratively \[*imbue*, *influence*, *supply*\]); specifically to *fulfil* (time): - accomplish, full (. . . come), furnish.
o: a prolonged form of a primary pleo pleh’-o (which appears only as an alternate in certain tenses and in the reduplicated form pimplemi)

d:
**1.** bruiser, ready for a blow
**2.** a pugnacious, contentious, quarrelsome person
s: From [G4141](G4141); a *smiter*, that is, *pugnacious* (*quarrelsome*): - striker.

d: **1.** a flood, whether of sea or of a river
s: Prolongation from [G4130](G4130); *flood* *tide*, that is, (by analogy) a *freshet:* - flood.

d:
**1.** moreover, besides, but, nevertheless
**2.** besides, except, but
s: From [G4119](G4119); *moreover* (*besides*), that is, *albeit*, *save* *that*, *rather*, *yet:* - but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.

d:
**1.** full, i.e. filled up (as opposed to empty)
  **a.** of hollow vessels
  **b.** of a surface, covered in every part
  **c.** of the soul, thoroughly permeated with
**2.** full, i.e. complete
  **a.** lacking nothing, perfect
s: From [G4130](G4130); *replete*, or *covered* over; by analogy *complete:* - full.

d:
**1.** to bear or bring full, to make full
  **a.** to cause a thing to be shown to the full
    **1.** to fulfil the ministry in every part
  **b.** to carry through to the end, accomplish
    **1.** things that have been accomplished
  **c.** to fill one with any thought, conviction, or inclination
    **1.** to make one certain, to persuade, convince one
    **2.** to be persuaded, persuaded, fully convinced or assured
    **3.** to render inclined or bent on
s: From [G4134](G4134) and [G5409](G5409); to *carry* out *fully* (in evidence), that is, *completely* *assure* (or *convince*), *entirely* *accomplish:* - most surely believe, fully know (persuade), make full proof of.

d: **1.** full assurance, most certain confidence
s: From [G4135](G4135); *entire* *confidence:* - (full) assurance.

d:
**1.** to make full, to fill up, i.e. to fill to the full
  **a.** to cause to abound, to furnish or supply liberally
    **1.** I abound, I am liberally supplied
**2.** to render full, i.e. to complete
  **a.** to fill to the top: so that nothing shall be wanting to full measure, fill to the brim
  **b.** to consummate: a number
    **1.** to make complete in every particular, to render perfect
    **2.** to carry through to the end, to accomplish, carry out, (some undertaking)
  **c.** to carry into effect, bring to realisation, realise
    **1.** of matters of duty: to perform, execute
    **2.** of sayings, promises, prophecies, to bring to pass, ratify, accomplish
    **3.** to fulfil, i.e. to cause God’s will (as made known in the law) to be obeyed as it should be, and God’s promises (given through the prophets) to receive fulfilment
s: From [G4134](G4134); to *make* *replete*, that is, (literally) to *cram* (a net), *level* up (a hollow), or (figuratively) to *furnish* (or *imbue*, *diffuse*, *influence*), *satisfy*, *execute* (an office), *finish* (a period or task), *verify* (or *coincide* with a prediction), etc.: - accomplish, X after, (be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come), fully preach, perfect, supply.

d:
**1.** that which is (has been) filled
  **a.** a ship inasmuch as it is filled (i.e. manned) with sailors, rowers, and soldiers
  **b.** in the NT, the body of believers, as that which is filled with the presence, power, agency, riches of God and of christ
**2.** that which fills or with which a thing is filled
  **a.** of those things which a ship is filled, freight and merchandise, sailors, oarsmen, soldiers
  **b.** completeness or fulness of time
**3.** fulness, abundance
**4.** a fulfilling, keeping
s: From [G4137](G4137); *repletion* or *completion*, that is, (subjectively) what *fills* (as contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what is *filled* (as container, performance, period): - which is put in to fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.

d:
**1.** a neighbour
  **a.** a friend
  **b.** any other person, and where two are concerned, the other (thy fellow man, thy neighbour), according to the Jews, any member of the hebrew nation and commonwealth
  **c.** according to christ, any other man irrespective of nation or religion with whom we live or whom we chance to meet
s: Neuter of a derivative of πέλας pelas (*near*); (adverb) *close* by; as noun, a *neighbor*, that is, *fellow* (as man, countryman, Christian or friend): - near, neighbour.
o: neuter of a derivative of pelas (near)

d:
**1.** repletion, satiety, for the satisfying of the flesh, to satiate the desires of the flesh
  **a.** indulgence of the flesh
s: From a presumed derivative of [G4130](G4130); a *filling* up, that is, (figuratively) *gratification:* - satisfying.

d: **1.** to strike, smite
s: Apparently another form of [G4111](G4111) (through the idea of *flattening* out); to *pound*, that is, (figuratively) to *inflict* with (calamity): - smite. Compare [G5180](G5180).
o: apparently another form of [G4111](G4111) (through the idea of flattening out)

d: **1.** a small vessel, a boat
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G4143](G4143); a *boat:* - boat, little (small) ship.

d: **1.** a ship
s: From [G4126](G4126); a *sailer*, that is, *vessel:* - ship (-ping).

d: **1.** a voyage
s: From [G4126](G4126); a *sail*, that is, *navigation:* - course, sailing, voyage.

d:
**1.** wealthy, abounding in material resources
**2.** metaph. abounding, abundantly supplied
  **a.** abounding (rich) in Christian virtues and eternal possessions
s: From [G4149](G4149); *wealthy*; figuratively *abounding* with: - rich.

d: **1.** abundantly, richly
s: From [G4145](G4145); *copiously:* - abundantly, richly.

d:
**1.** to be rich, to have abundance
  **a.** of outward possessions
**2.** metaph. to be richly supplied
  **a.** is affluent in resources so that he can give blessings of salvation to all
s: From [G4148](G4148); to *be* (or *become*) *wealthy* (literally or figuratively): - be increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.

d:
**1.** to make rich, enrich
  **a.** of spiritual riches
**2.** to be richly furnished
s: From [G4149](G4149); to *make* *wealthy* (figuratively): - en- (make) rich.

d:
**1.** riches, wealth
  **a.** abundance of external possessions
  **b.** fulness, abundance, plenitude
  **c.** a good i.e. that with which one is enriched
s: From the base of [G4130](G4130); *wealth* (as *fulness*), that is, (literally) *money*, *possessions*, or (figuratively) *abundance*, *richness*, (specifically) valuable *bestowment:* - riches.

d:
**1.** to wash: with reference to clothing
  **a.** use figuratively of those who by faith so appropriate the results of christ’s expiation as to be regarded by God as pure and sinless
s: A prolonged form of an obsolete πλύω pluō *ploo’-o* (to “*flow*”); to “*plunge*”, that is, *launder* clothing: - wash. Compare [G3068](G3068), [G3538](G3538).
o: a prolonged form of an obsolete pluo (to flow)

d:
**1.** the third person of the triune God, the holy spirit, coequal, coeternal with the father and the son
  **a.** sometimes referred to in a way which emphasises his personality and character (the \\Holy\\ Spirit)
  **b.** sometimes referred to in a way which emphasises his work and power (the spirit of \\Truth\\)
  **c.** never referred to as a depersonalised force
**2.** the spirit, i.e. the vital principal by which the body is animated
  **a.** the rational spirit, the power by which the human being feels, thinks, decides
  **b.** the soul
**3.** a spirit, i.e. a simple essence, devoid of all or at least all grosser matter, and possessed of the power of knowing, desiring, deciding, and acting
  **a.** a life giving spirit
  **b.** a human soul that has left the body
  **c.** a spirit higher than man but lower than God, i.e. an angel
    **1.** used of demons, or evil spirits, who were conceived as inhabiting the bodies of men
    **2.** the spiritual nature of christ, higher than the highest angels and equal to God, the divine nature of christ
**4.** the disposition or influence which fills and governs the soul of any one
  **a.** the efficient source of any power, affection, emotion, desire, etc.
**5.** a movement of air (a gentle blast)
  **a.** of the wind, hence the wind itself
  **b.** breath of nostrils or mouth
s: From [G4154](G4154); a *current* of air, that is, *breath* (*blast*) or a *breeze*; by analogy or figuratively a *spirit*, that is, (human) the rational *soul*, (by implication) *vital* *principle*, mental *disposition*, etc., or (superhuman) an *angel*, *daemon*, or (divine) God, Christ’s *spirit*, the Holy *spirit*: - ghost, life, spirit (-ual, -ually), mind. Compare [G5590](G5590).

d:
**1.** relating to the human spirit, or rational soul, as part of the man which is akin to God and serves as his instrument or organ
  **a.** that which possesses the nature of the rational soul
**2.** belonging to a spirit, or a being higher than man but inferior to God
**3.** belonging to the divine spirit
  **a.** of God the holy spirit
  **b.** one who is filled with and governed by the spirit of God
**4.** pertaining to the wind or breath; windy, exposed to the wind, blowing
s: From [G4151](G4151); *non-carnal*, that is, (humanly) *ethereal* (as opposed to gross), or (daemoniacally) a *spirit* (concretely), or (divinely) *supernatural*, *regenerate*, *religious*: - spiritual. Compare [G5591](G5591).

d: **1.** spiritually: i.e. by the aid of the holy spirit
s: Adverb from [G4152](G4152); *non-physically*, that is, *divinely*, *figuratively:* - spiritually.

d:
**1.** to breathe, to blow
  **a.** of the wind
s: A primary word; to *breathe* hard, that is, *breeze*: - blow. Compare [G5594](G5594).

d:
**1.** to choke, strangle
  **a.** of thorns crowding out the seed in the field and hindering its growth
**2.** to wring one’s neck, throttle
s: Strengthened from [G4154](G4154); to *wheeze*, that is, (causative by implication) to *throttle* or *strangle* (*drown*): - choke, take by the throat.

d:
**1.** suffocate, strangled
  **a.** what is strangled, i.e. an animal deprived of life without the shedding of blood
  **b.** of cooking: our smothered as a culinary term
s: From [G4155](G4155); *throttled*, that is, (neuter concretely) an animal *choked* to death (not bled): - strangled.

d:
**1.** breath, breath of life
**2.** wind
s: From [G4154](G4154); *respiration*, a *breeze:* - breath, wind.

d:
**1.** reaching to the feet
**2.** a garment reaching to the ankles, coming down to the feet
s: From [G4228](G4228) and another element of uncertain affinity; a *dress* ([G2066](G2066) implied) *reaching* the *ankles:* - garment down to the foot.
o: from [G4228](G4228) and another element of uncertain affinity

d:
**1.** of place: from where, from what condition
**2.** of origin or source: from what author or giver
**3.** of cause: how is that?, how can that be?
s: From the base of [G4213](G4213) with enclitic adverb of origin; *from* *which* (as interrogitive) or *what* (as relative) place, state, source or cause: - whence.
o: from the base of [G4213](G4213) with enclitic adverb of origin

d:
**1.** to make
  **a.** with the names of things made, to produce, construct, form, fashion, etc.
  **b.** to be the authors of, the cause
  **c.** to make ready, to prepare
  **d.** to produce, bear, shoot forth
  **e.** to acquire, to provide a thing for one’s self
  **f.** to make a thing out of something
  **g.** to (make i.e.) render one anything
    **1.** to (make i.e.) constitute or appoint one anything, to appoint or ordain one that
    **2.** to (make i.e.) declare one anything
  **h.** to put one forth, to lead him out
  **i.** to make one do something
    **1.** cause one to
  **j.** to be the authors of a thing (to cause, bring about)
**2.** to do
  **a.** to act rightly, do well
    **1.** to carry out, to execute
  **b.** to do a thing unto one
    **1.** to do to one
  **c.** with designation of time: to pass, spend
  **d.** to celebrate, keep
    **1.** to make ready, and so at the same time to institute, the celebration of the passover
  **e.** to perform: to a promise
s: Apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to *make* or *do* (in a very wide application, more or less direct): - abide, + agree, appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth), cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any delay, (would) do (-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have, hold, X journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, X mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform, provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, X secure, shew, X shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield. Compare [G4238](G4238).
o: apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary

d:
**1.** that which has been made
**2.** a work
  **a.** of the works of God as creator
s: From [G4160](G4160); a *product*, that is, *fabric* (literally or figuratively): - thing that is made, workmanship.

d:
**1.** a making
**2.** a doing or performing
  **a.** in his doing i.e. in the obedience he renders to the law
s: From [G4160](G4160); *action*, that is, *performance* (of the law): - deed.

d:
**1.** a maker, a producer, author
**2.** a doer, performer
  **a.** one who obeys or fulfils the law
**3.** a poet
s: From [G4160](G4160); a *performer*; specifically a “poet”: - doer, poet.

d:
**1.** a various colours, variegated
**2.** of various sorts
s: Of uncertain derivation; *motley*, that is, *various* in character: - divers, manifold.

d:
**1.** to feed, to tend a flock, keep sheep
  **a.** to rule, govern
    **1.** of rulers
    **2.** to furnish pasture for food
    **3.** to nourish
    **4.** to cherish one’s body, to serve the body
    **5.** to supply the requisites for the soul’s need
s: From [G4166](G4166); to *tend* as a shepherd (or figuratively *superviser*): - feed (cattle), rule.

d:
**1.** a herdsman, esp. a shepherd
  **a.** in the parable, he to whose care and control others have committed themselves, and whose precepts they follow
**2.** metaph.
  **a.** the presiding officer, manager, director, of any assembly: so of christ the head of the church
    **1.** of the overseers of the Christian assemblies
    **2.** of kings and princes the tasks of a Near Eastern shepherd were: - to watch for enemies trying to attack the sheep - to defend the sheep from attackers - to heal the wounded and sick sheep - to find and save lost or trapped sheep - to love them, sharing their lives and so earning their trust.
s: Of uncertain affinity; a *shepherd* (literally or figuratively): - shepherd, pastor.

d:
**1.** a flock (esp.) of sheep
  **a.** of christ’s flock i.e. the body of those who follow Jesus as their guide and keeper
s: Contracted from [G4165](G4165); a *flock* (literally or figuratively): - flock, fold.

d:
**1.** a flock (esp.) of sheep
**2.** a group of christ’s disciples
**3.** bodies of Christian (churches) presided over by elders
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G4167](G4167); a *flock*, that is, (figuratively) *group* (of believers): - flock.
o: neuter of a presumed derivative of [G4167](G4167)

d: **1.** of what sort or nature
s: From the base of [G4226](G4226) and [G3634](G3634); individualizing interrogitive (of character) *what* sort of, or (of number) *which* one: - what (manner of), which.

d:
**1.** to war, carry on war
**2.** to fight
s: From [G4171](G4171); to *be* (engaged) in *warfare*, that is, to *battle* (literally or figuratively): - fight, (make) war.

d:
**1.** a war
**2.** a fight, a battle
**3.** a dispute, strife, quarrel
s: From πέλομαι pelomai (to *bustle*); *warfare* (literally or figuratively; a single encounter or a series): - battle, fight, war.

d:
**1.** a city
  **a.** one’s native city, the city in which one lives
  **b.** the heavenly Jerusalem
    **1.** the abode of the blessed in heaven
    **2.** of the visible capital in the heavenly kingdom, to come down to earth after the renovation of the world by fire
  **c.** the inhabitants of a city
s: Probably from the same as [G4171](G4171), or perhaps from [G4183](G4183); a *town* (properly with walls, of greater or less size): - city.
o: probably from the same as [G4171](G4171), or perhaps from [G4183](G4183)

d: **1.** a ruler of a city or citizens
s: From [G4172](G4172) and [G757](G757); a *town* *officer*, that is, *magistrate:* - ruler of the city.

d:
**1.** the administration of civil affairs
**2.** a state or commonwealth
**3.** citizenship, the rights of a citizen
s: From [G4177](G4177) (“polity”); *citizenship*; concretely a *community:* - commonwealth, freedom.

d:
**1.** the administration of civil affairs or of a commonwealth
**2.** the constitution of a commonwealth, form of government and the laws by which it is administered
**3.** a state, commonwealth
  **a.** the commonwealth of citizens
s: From [G4176](G4176); a *community*, that is, (abstractly) *citizenship* (figuratively): - conversation.

d:
**1.** to be a citizen
**2.** to administer civil affairs, manage the state
**3.** to make or create a citizen
  **a.** to be a citizen
  **b.** to behave as a citizen
    **1.** to avail one’s self of or recognise the laws
    **2.** to conduct one’s self as pledged to some law of life
s: Middle voice of a derivative of [G4177](G4177); to *behave* as a citizen (figuratively): - let conversation be, live.
o: middle voice of a derivative of [G4177](G4177)

d:
**1.** a citizen
  **a.** the inhabitant of any city or country
  **b.** the association of another in citizenship
    **1.** a fellow citizen, fellow countryman
s: From [G4172](G4172); a *townsman:* - citizen.

d: **1.** often, frequently
s: Multiplicative adverb from [G4183](G4183); *many* *times*, that is, *frequently:* - oft (-en, -en-times, -times).

d: **1.** manifold, much, more
s: From [G4183](G4183) and probably a derivative of [G4120](G4120); *manifold*, that is, (neuter as noun) *very* *much* *more:* - manifold more.
o: from [G4183](G4183) and probably a derivative of [G4120](G4120)

d: **1.** much speaking
s: From a compound of [G4183](G4183) and [G3056](G3056); *loquacity*, that is, *prolixity:* - much speaking.

d: **1.** by many portions, by many times and in many ways
s: Adverb from a compound of [G4183](G4183) and [G3313](G3313); *in* *many* *portions*, that is, *variously* as to time and agency (*piecemeal*): - at sundry times.

d:
**1.** much variegated, marked with a great variety of colours
    **1.** of cloth or a painting
**2.** much varied, manifold
s: From [G4183](G4183) and [G4164](G4164); *much* *variegated*, that is, *multifarious:* - manifold.

d: **1.** many, much, large
s: Including the forms from the alternate “pollos”; (singular) *much* (in any respect) or (plural) *many*; neuter (singular) as adverb *largely*; neuter (plural) as adverb or noun *often*, *mostly*, *largely*: - abundant, + altogether, common, + far (passed, spent), (+ be of a) great (age, deal, -ly, while), long, many, much, oft (-en \[-times\]), plenteous, sore, straitly. Compare [G4118](G4118), [G4119](G4119).
o: including the forms from the alternate pollos

d: **1.** full of pity, very kind
s: From [G4183](G4183) and [G4698](G4698) (figuratively), *extremely* *compassionate:* - very pitiful.

d:
**1.** precious
  **a.** requiring very great outlay, very costly
  **b.** excellent, of surpassing value
s: From [G4183](G4183) and [G5056](G5056); *extremely* *expensive:* - costly, very precious, of great price.

d: **1.** very valuable, of great price
s: From [G4183](G4183) and [G5092](G5092); *extremely* *valuable:* - very costly, of great price.

d: **1.** in many manners
s: Adverb from a compound of [G4183](G4183) and [G5158](G5158); *in* *many* *ways*, that is, *variously* as to method or form: - in divers manners.

d: **1.** drink
s: From the alternate of [G4095](G4095); a *beverage:* - drink.

d:
**1.** depravity, iniquity, wickedness
**2.** malice
**3.** evil purposes and desires
s: From [G4190](G4190); *depravity*, that is, (specifically) *malice*; plural (concretely) *plots*, *sins:* - iniquity, wickedness.

d:
**1.** full of labours, annoyances, hardships
  **a.** pressed and harassed by labours
  **b.** bringing toils, annoyances, perils; of a time full of peril to Christian faith and steadfastness; causing pain and trouble
**2.** bad, of a bad nature or condition
  **a.** in a physical sense: diseased or blind
  **b.** in an ethical sense: evil wicked, bad the word is used in the nominative case in Mat 6:13. This usuallydenotes a title in the Greek. Hence christ is saying, deliver usfrom The Evil, and is probably referring to Satan.
s: From a derivative of [G4192](G4192); *hurtful*, that is, *evil* (properly in effect or influence, and thus differing from [G2556](G2556), which refers rather to *essential* character, as well as from [G4550](G4550), which indicates *degeneracy* from original virtue); figuratively *calamitous*; also (passively) *ill*, that is, *diseased*; but especially (morally) *culpable*, that is, *derelict*, *vicious*, *facinorous*; neuter (singular) *mischief*, *malice*, or (plural) *guilt*; masculine (singular) the *devil*, or (plural) *sinners*: - bad, evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked (-ness). See also [G4191](G4191).

d: **1.** more evil
s: Comparative of [G4190](G4190); *more* *evil:* - more wicked.

d:
**1.** great trouble, intense desire
**2.** pain
s: From the base of [G3993](G3993); *toil*, that is, (by implication) *anguish:* - pain.

d: **1.** belonging to Pontus, born in Pontus
s: From [G4195](G4195); a *Pontican*, that is, native of Pontus: - born in Pontus.

d:
Pontius \[Pilate\] = of the sea
**1.** the sixth Roman procurator of Judah who crucified christ
s: Of Latin origin; apparently *bridged*; *Pontius*, a Roman: - Pontius.

d:
Pontus = the sea
**1.** a region of eastern Asia Minor, bounded by the Euxine Sea, Armenia, Cappadocia, Galatia, Paphlagonia
s: A *sea*; *Pontus*, a region of Asia Minor: - Pontus.

d:
Publius = popular
**1.** the chief magistrate of the island of melita
s: Of Latin origin; apparently “popular”; *Poplius* (that is, *Publius*), a Roman: - Publius.

d:
**1.** a journey
**2.** a going, that is: purpose, pursuit, undertaking
s: From [G4198](G4198); *travel* (by land); figuratively (plural) *proceedings*, that is, *career:* - journey \[-ing\], ways.

d:
**1.** to lead over, carry over, transfer
  **a.** to pursue the journey on which one has entered, to continue on one’s journey
  **b.** to depart from life
  **c.** to follow one, that is: become his adherent
    **1.** to lead or order one’s life
s: Middle voice from a derivative of the same as [G3984](G3984); to *traverse*, that is, *travel* (literally or figuratively; especially to *remove* \[figuratively *die*\], *live*, etc.): - depart, go (away, forth, one’s way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk.
o: middle voice from a derivative of the same as [G3984](G3984)

d: **1.** to destroy, overthrow
s: Prolonged version of πέρθω porthō (to *sack*); to *ravage* (figuratively): - destroy, waste.

d:
**1.** acquisition, gain
**2.** source of gain
s: From a derivative of πόρος poros (a *way*, that is, *means*); *furnishing* (*procuring*), that is, (by implication) *money* *getting* (*acquisition*): - gain.
o: from a derivative of poros (a way, i.e. means)

d:
Porcius \[Festus\] = swinish
**1.** the successor of Felix as procurator of Judea
s: Of Latin origin; apparently *swinish*; *Porcius*, a Roman: - Porcius.

d:
**1.** illicit sexual intercourse
  **a.** adultery, fornication, homosexuality, lesbianism, intercourse with animals etc.
  **b.** sexual intercourse with close relatives; Lev_18
  **c.** sexual intercourse with a divorced man or woman; Mar 10:11,
**2.** metaph. the worship of idols
  **a.** of the defilement of idolatry, as incurred by eating the sacrifices offered to idols
s: From [G4203](G4203); *harlotry* (including *adultery* and *incest*); figuratively *idolatry:* - fornication.

d:
**1.** to prostitute one’s body to the lust of another
**2.** to give one’s self to unlawful sexual intercourse
  **a.** to commit fornication
**3.** metaph. to be given to idolatry, to worship idols
  **a.** to permit one’s self to be drawn away by another into idolatry
s: From [G4204](G4204); to *act* the *harlot*, that is, (literally) *indulge* unlawful *lust* (of either sex), or (figuratively) *practise* *idolatry:* - commit (fornication).

d:
**1.** a woman who sells her body for sexual uses
  **a.** a prostitute, a harlot, one who yields herself to defilement for the sake of gain
  **b.** any woman indulging in unlawful sexual intercourse, whether for gain or for lust
**2.** metaph. an idolatress
  **a.** of Babylon i.e. Rome, the chief seat of idolatry
s: Feminine of [G4205](G4205); a *strumpet*; figuratively an *idolater:* - harlot, whore.

d:
**1.** a man who prostitutes his body to another’s lust for hire
**2.** a male prostitute
**3.** a man who indulges in unlawful sexual intercourse, a fornicator
s: From πέρνημι pernēmi (to *sell*; akin to the base of [G4097](G4097)); a (male) *prostitute* (as *venal*), that is, (by analogy) a *debauchee* (*libertine*): - fornicator, whoremonger.
o: from pernemi (to sell, akin to the base of [G4097](G4097))

d: **1.** far, at a distance, a great way off
s: Adverb from [G4253](G4253); *forwards*, that is, *at* *a* *distance*: - far, a great way off. See also [G4207](G4207).

d: **1.** from afar, afar off
s: From [G4206](G4206) with adverbial enclitic of source; *from* *far*, or (by implication) *at* *a* *distance*, that is, *distantly:* - afar off.
o: from [G4206](G4206) with adverbial enclitic of source

d: **1.** further
s: Adverb comparative of [G4206](G4206); *farther*, that is, *a* *greater* *distance:* - further.

d:
**1.** the purple fish, a species of shell fish or mussel
**2.** a fabric coloured with purple dye, a garment made from purple cloth
s: Of Latin origin; the “purple” mussel, that is, (by implication) the *red* *blue* color itself, and finally, a garment dyed with it: - purple.

d: **1.** purple, dyed in purple, made of purple fabric
s: From [G4209](G4209); *purpureal*, that is, *bluish* *red:* - purple.

d: **1.** a female seller of purple or of fabric dyed in purple
s: Feminine of a compound of [G4209](G4209) and [G4453](G4453); a *female* *trader* *in* *purple* cloth: - seller of purple.

d: **1.** how often
s: Multiplicative from [G4214](G4214); *how* *many* *times:* - how oft (-en).

d: **1.** a drinking, drink
s: From the alternate of [G4095](G4095); a *drinking* (the act), that is, (concretely) a *draught:* - drink.

d:
**1.** how great
**2.** how much
**3.** how many
s: From an obsolete “pos” (*who*, *what*) and [G3739](G3739); interrogitive pronoun (of amount) *how* *much* (*large*, *long* or \[plural\] *many*): - how great (long, many), what.
o: from an absolute pos (who, what) and [G3739](G3739)

d:
**1.** a stream, a river
**2.** a torrent
**3.** floods
s: Probably from a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095) (compare [G4224](G4224)); a *current*, *brook* or *freshet* (as *drinkable*), that is, *running* *water:* - flood, river, stream, water.
o: probably from a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095) (cf [G4224](G4224))

d: **1.** carried away by a stream (i.e. overwhelmed, drowned in the waters)
s: From [G4215](G4215) and a derivative of [G5409](G5409); *river* *borne*, that is, *overwhelmed* *by* *a* *stream:* - carried away of the flood.

d:
**1.** from what country, nation or tribe
**2.** of what sort or quality (what manner of)
  **a.** of persons
  **b.** of things
s: Apparently from [G4219](G4219) and the base of [G4226](G4226); interrogitive *whatever*, that is, of *what* *possible* sort: - what (manner of).
o: apparently from [G4219](G4219) and the base of [G4226](G4226)

d: **1.** once i.e. formerly, aforetime, at some time
s: From the base of [G4225](G4225) and [G5037](G5037); indefinite adverb, at *some* *time*, *ever:* - afore- (any, some-) time (-s), at length (the last), (+ n-) ever, in the old time, in time past, once, when.

d: **1.** when?, at what time?
s: From the base of [G4226](G4226) and [G5037](G5037); interrogitive adverb, at *what* *time:* - + how long, when.

d: **1.** which of two
s: Neuter of a comparative of the base of [G4226](G4226); interrogitive as adverb, *which* (of two), that is, *is* *it* this or that: - whether.
o: neuter of a comparative of the base of [G4226](G4226)

d:
**1.** a cup, a drinking vessel
**2.** metaph. one’s lot or experience, whether joyous or adverse, divine appointments, whether favourable or unfavourable, are likened to a cup which God presents one to drink: so of prosperity and adversity
s: Neuter of a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095); a *drinking* *vessel*; by extension the contents thereof, that is, a *cupful* (*draught*); figuratively a *lot* or *fate:* - cup.
o: of a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095)

d:
**1.** to give to drink, to furnish drink
**2.** to water, irrigate (plants, fields etc.)
**3.** metaph. to imbue, saturate one’s mind
s: From a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095); to *furnish* *drink*, *irrigate:* - give (make) to drink, feed, water.
o: from a derivative of the alternate of [G4095](G4095)

d:
Puteoli = sulphurous springs
**1.** a city of Campania, in Italy, situated on the Bay of Naples
s: Of Latin origin; *little* *wells*, that is, *mineral* *springs*; *Potioli* (that is, *Puteoli*), a place in Italy: - Puteoli.

d: **1.** a drinking, carousing
s: From the alternate of [G4095](G4095); a *drinking* *bout* or *carousal:* - banqueting.

d: **1.** where?, in what place?
s: Genitive case of πός pos, an indefinite pronoun  (*some*) otherwise obsolete (compare [G4214](G4214)); as adverb of place, *somewhere*, that is, *nearly:* - about, a certain place.
o: genitive case of an indefinite pronoun pos (some) otherwise obsolete (cf [G4214](G4214))

d:
**1.** somewhere
**2.** nearly
**3.** with numerals: somewhere about, about
s: Genitive case of πός pos, an interrogitive pronoun, (*what*) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as [G4225](G4225) used with the rising slide of inquiry); as adverb of place; *at* (by implication *to*) *what* locality: - where, whither.
o: genitive case of an interrogative pronoun pos (what) otherwise obsolete (perhaps the same as [G4225](G4225) used with the rising slide of enquiry)

d:
Pudens = modest
**1.** a Christian friend of Timothy at Rome, and may have been one of the seventy disciples
s: Of Latin origin; *modest*; *Pudes* (that is, *Pudens*), a Christian: - Pudens.

d:
**1.** a foot, both of men or beast
  **a.** often in the orient, one put his foot on vanquished
  **b.** of disciples listening to their teacher’s instruction are said to be at his feet
s: A primary word; a “foot” (figuratively or literally): - foot (-stool).

d:
**1.** that which has been done, a deed, an accomplished fact
**2.** what is done or being accomplished
  **a.** spec. business, a commercial transaction
**3.** a matter, question, affair
  **a.** spec. in a forensic sense, a matter at law, case, suit
**4.** that which is or exists, a thing
s: From [G4238](G4238); a *deed*; by implication an *affair*; by extension an *object* (material): - business, matter, thing, work.

d:
**1.** prosecution of any affair
  **a.** business, occupation
s: From [G4231](G4231); a *transaction*, that is, *negotiation:* - affair.

d:
**1.** to be occupied in anything
**2.** to carry on a business
**3.** to carry on the business of a banker or a trader
s: From [G4229](G4229); to *busy* *oneself* with, that is, to *trade:* - occupy.

d:
**1.** head-quarters in a Roman camp, the tent of the commander-in-chief
**2.** the palace in which the governor or procurator of a province resided, to which use the Romans were accustomed to appropriate the palaces already existing, and formerly dwelt in by kings or princes; at Jerusalem it was a magnificent palace which herod the great had built for himself, and which the Roman procurators seemed to have occupied whenever they came from Caesarea to Jerusalem to transact public business
**3.** the camp of the Praetorian soldiers established by Tiberius
s: Of Latin origin; the *praetorium* or governor’s *court* *room* (sometimes including the whole *edifice* and *camp*): - (common, judgment) hall (of judgment), palace, praetorium.

d:
**1.** one who does anything, a doer
**2.** one who does the work of inflicting punishment or taking vengeance
  **a.** the avenger of murder
  **b.** the exactor of a monetary fine
  **c.** an officer of justice of the lower order whose business it is to inflict punishment
s: From a derivative of [G4238](G4238); a *practiser*, that is, (specifically) an official *collector:* - officer.

d:
**1.** a doing, a mode of acting, a deal, a transaction
  **a.** the doings of the apostles
  **b.** in a bad sense, wicked deed, crime, wicked doings (our practices i.e. trickery)
**2.** a thing to be done, business
s: From [G4238](G4238); *practice*, that is, (concretely) an *act*; by extension a *function:* - deed, office, work.

d: **1.** gentle, mild, meek
s: A form of [G4239](G4239), used in certain parts; *gentle*, that is, *humble:* - meek.
o: a form of [G4239](G4239), used in certain parts

d: **1.** gentleness, mildness, meekness
s: From [G4235](G4235); *gentleness*; by implication *humility:* - meekness.

d:
**1.** a plot of ground, a garden bed
**2.** Hebrew idiom i.e. they reclined in ranks or divisions, so that several ranks formed, as it were separate plots
s: Perhaps from πράσον prason (a *leek*, and so an *onion* *patch*); a garden *plot*, that is, (by implication of regular *beds*) a *row* (repeated in plural by Hebraism to indicate an arrangement): - in ranks.
o: perhaps from prason (a leek, and so an onion-patch)

d:
**1.** to exercise, practise, to be busy with, carry on
  **a.** to undertake, to do
**2.** to accomplish, perform
  **a.** to commit, perpetrate
**3.** to manage public affairs, transact public business
  **a.** to exact tribute, revenue, debts
**4.** to act
s: A primary verb; to “practise”, that is, *perform* *repeatedly* or *habitually* (thus differing from [G4160](G4160), which properly refers to a *single* act); by implication to *execute*, *accomplish*, etc.; specifically to *collect* (dues), *fare* (personally): - commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require, use arts.

d: **1.** mildness of disposition, gentleness of spirit, meekness. Meekness toward God is that disposition of spirit in which we accept his dealings with us as good, and therefore without disputing or resisting. In the OT, the meek are those wholly relying on God rather than their own strength to defend them against injustice. Thus, meekness toward evil people means knowing God is permitting the injuries they inflict, that he is using them to purify his elect, and that he will deliver his elect in his time. (Isa 41:17, Luk 18:1-14)
s: Apparently a primary word; *mild*, that is, (by implication) *humble:* - meek. See also [G4235](G4235).

d: **1.** mildness of disposition, gentleness of spirit, meekness
s: From [G4239](G4239); *mildness*, that is, (by implication) *humility:* - meekness.

d:
**1.** to stand out, to be conspicuous, to be eminent
**2.** to be becoming, seemly, fit
s: Apparently a primary verb; to *tower* up (*be* *conspicuous*), that is, (by implication) to *be* *suitable* or *proper* (third person singular present indicative, often used impersonally, it is *fit* or *right*): - become, comely.

d:
**1.** age, dignity, right of the first born
**2.** the business normally intrusted to elders, spec. the office of an ambassador, an embassy
s: From [G4243](G4243); *seniority* (*eldership*), that is, (by implication) an *embassy* (concretely *ambassadors*): - ambassage, message.

d:
**1.** to be older, prior by birth or in age
**2.** to be an ambassador, act as an ambassador
s: From the base of [G4245](G4245); to be a *senior*, that is, (by implication) *act* *as* *a* *representative* (figuratively *preacher*): - be an ambassador.

d:
**1.** body of elders, presbytery, senate, council
  **a.** of the Jewish elders
  **b.** of the elders of any body (assembly) of Christians
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of [G4245](G4245); the *order* *of* *elders*, that is, (specifically) Israelite *Sanhedrim* or Christian “presbytery”: - (estate of) elder (-s), presbytery.

d:
**1.** elder, of age,
  **a.** the elder of two people
  **b.** advanced in life, an elder, a senior
    **1.** forefathers
**2.** a term of rank or office
  **a.** among the Jews
    **1.** members of the great council or Sanhedrin (because in early times the rulers of the people, judges, etc., were selected from elderly men)
    **2.** of those who in separate cities managed public affairs and administered justice
  **b.** among the Christians, those who presided over the assemblies (or churches) The NT uses the term bishop, elders, and presbyters interchangeably
  **c.** the twenty four members of the heavenly Sanhedrin or court seated on thrones around the throne of God
s: Comparative of πρέσβυς presbus (*elderly*); *older*; as noun, a *senior*; specifically an Israelite *Sanhedrist* (also figuratively, member of the celestial council) or Christian “presbyter”: - elder (-est), old.

d:
**1.** an old man, an aged man
**2.** ambassador
s: From the same as [G4245](G4245); an *old* *man:* - aged (man), old man.

d: **1.** an aged woman
s: Feminine of [G4246](G4246); an *old* *woman:* - aged woman.

d: **1.** headlong
s: From [G4253](G4253); *leaning* (*falling*) *forward* (“prone”), that is, *head* *foremost:* - headlong.

d: **1.** to saw, to cut in two with a saw
s: A strengthened form of a primary word πρίω priō, (to *saw*); to *saw* in two: - saw asunder.
o: a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw)

d: **1.** before, formerly
s: Adverb from [G4253](G4253); *prior*, *sooner:* - before (that), ere.

d:
Priscilla = ancient
**1.** a Christian woman, the wife of Aquila
s: Of Latin origin; feminine of *Priscus*, *ancient*; *Priska*, a Christian woman: - Prisca. See also [G4252](G4252).

d:
Priscilla = ancient
**1.** a Christian woman, the wife of Aquila
s: Diminutive of [G4251](G4251); *Priscilla* (that is, *little* *Prisca*), a Christian woman: - Priscilla.

d: **1.** before
s: A primary preposition; “fore”, that is, *in* *front* *of*, *prior* (figuratively *superior*) *to*. In compounds it retains the same significations: - above, ago, before, or ever. In compounds it retains the same significations.

d:
**1.** to lead forward, lead forth
  **a.** one from a place in which he has lain hidden from view, as from a prison
  **b.** in a forensic sense, to bring one forth to trial
**2.** to go before
  **a.** preceding, prior in time, previous
  **b.** to proceed, go forward
    **1.** in a bad sense, to go further than is right. or proper
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G71](G71); to *lead* *forward* (magisterially); intransitively to *precede* (in place or time \[participle *previous*\]): - bring (forth, out), go before.

d:
**1.** to bring forward, bring forth from one’s stores
**2.** to bring forth for one’s self, to choose for one’s self before another, to prefer
**3.** to purpose
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G138](G138); to *choose* for oneself *before* another thing (*prefer*), that is, (by implication) to *propose* (*intend*): - purpose.

d: **1.** to bring a charge against previously (i.e. in what has previously been said)
s: From [G4253](G4253) and a derivative of [G156](G156); to *accuse* *already*, that is, *previously* *charge:* - prove before.

d:
**1.** to hear before
  **a.** the hoped for salvation before its realisation
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G191](G191); to *hear* *already*, that is, *anticipate:* - hear before.

d:
**1.** to sin before
  **a.** of those who before receiving baptism had been guilty of the vices especially common among the Gentiles
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G264](G264); to *sin* *previously* (to conversion): - sin already, heretofore sin.

d: **1.** fore-court, porch
s: Neuter of a presumed compound of [G4253](G4253) and [G833](G833); a *fore-court*, that is, *vestibule* (*alley* *way*): - porch.
o: from a presumed compound of [G4253](G4253) and [G833](G833)

d: **1.** to go forwards, go on
s: From [G4253](G4253) and the base of [G939](G939); to *walk* *forward*, that is, *advance* (literally or in years): - + be of a great age, go farther (on), be well stricken.

d:
**1.** to throw forward
  **a.** of trees, to shoot forth, put out leaves
  **b.** to germinate
  **c.** to push forward, thrust forward, put forward
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G906](G906); to *throw* *forward*, that is, *push* *to* *the* *front*, *germinate:* - put forward, shoot forth.

d:
**1.** pertaining to sheep
**2.** the sheep gate
s: From [G4263](G4263); *relating* *to* *sheep*, that is, (a *gate*) through which they were led into Jerusalem: - sheep (market).

d:
**1.** any four footed, tame animal accustomed to graze, small cattle (opp. to large cattle, horses, etc.), most commonly a sheep or a goat
  **a.** a sheep, and so always in the NT
s: Properly the neuter of a presumed derivative of [G4260](G4260); *something* *that* *walks* *forward* (a *quadruped*), that is, (specifically) a *sheep* (literally or figuratively): - sheep (\[-fold\]).
o: probably from a presumed. derivative of [G4260](G4260)

d:
**1.** to cause to go forward, to lean forward, to bring forward, drag forward
**2.** metaph. to incite, instigate, urge, forward, set on
  **a.** to induce by persuasion
s: From [G4253](G4253) and a reduplicated form of [G971](G971); to *force* *forward*, that is, *bring* *to* *the* *front*, *instigate:* - draw, before instruct.
o: from [G4253](G4253) and a reduplicated form of [G971](G971)

d:
**1.** to foresee
**2.** to provide
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G991](G991); to *look* out *beforehand*, that is, *furnish* *in* *advance:* - provide.

d:
**1.** to arise or come before, happen before
  **a.** of sins committed previously
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1096](G1096); to *be* *already*, that is, *have* *previously* *transpired:* - be past.

d:
**1.** to have knowledge before hand
**2.** to foreknow
  **a.** of those whom God elected to salvation
**3.** to predestinate
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1097](G1097); to *know* *beforehand*, that is, *foresee:* - foreknow (ordain), know (before).

d:
**1.** foreknowledge
**2.** forethought, pre-arrangement
s: From [G4267](G4267); *forethought:* - foreknowledge.

d:
**1.** born before, older
  **a.** of ancestors
  **b.** of a mother
  **c.** of grandparents
  **d.** of great-grand parents (if they are still alive)
s: From [G4266](G4266); an *ancestor*, (*grand-*) *parent:* - forefather, parent.

d:
**1.** to write before (of time)
  **a.** of old set forth or designated before hand (in the scriptures of the OT)
**2.** to depict or portray openly
  **a.** to write before the eyes of all who can read
  **b.** to depict, portray, paint, before the eyes
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1125](G1125); to *write* *previously*; figuratively to *announce*, *prescribe:* - before ordain, evidently set forth, write (afore, aforetime).

d: **1.** openly evident, known to all, manifest
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1212](G1212); *plain* *before* all men, that is, *obvious:* - evident, manifest (open) beforehand.

d:
**1.** to give before, give first
**2.** to betray
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1325](G1325); to *give* *before* the other party has given: - first give.

d: **1.** a betrayer, traitor
s: From [G4272](G4272) (in the sense of *giving* *forward* into another’s \[the enemy’s\] hands); a *surrender:* - betrayer, traitor.
o: from [G4272](G4272) (in the sense of giving forward into another’s \[the enemy’s\] hands)

d:
**1.** a forerunner
  **a.** esp. one who is sent before to take observations or act as a spy, a scout, a light armed soldier
  **b.** one who comes in advance to a place where the rest are to follow
s: From the alternate of [G4390](G4390); a *runner* *ahead*, that is, *scout* (figuratively *precursor*): - forerunner.

d: **1.** to foresee
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1492](G1492); *foresee:* - foresee, saw before.

d: **1.** to hope before
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1679](G1679); to *hope* *in* *advance* of other confirmation: - first trust.

d:
**1.** to say before
  **a.** to say in what precedes, to say above
  **b.** to say before i.e. heretofore, formerly
  **c.** to say beforehand i.e. before the event: prophecies
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2036](G2036); to *say* *already*, to *predict*: - forewarn, say (speak, tell) before. Compare [G4280](G4280).

d: **1.** to make a beginning before
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G1728](G1728); to *commence* *already:* - begin (before).

d:
**1.** to announce before
**2.** to promise before
s: Middle voice from [G4253](G4253) and [G1861](G1861); to *promise* *of* *old:* - promise before.

d:
**1.** to say before
  **a.** to say in what precedes, to say above
  **b.** to say before i.e. heretofore, formerly
  **c.** to say beforehand i.e. before the event: prophecies
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2046](G2046); used as alternate of [G4277](G4277); to *say* *already*, *predict:* - foretell, say (speak, tell) before.
o: from [G4253](G4253) and [G2046](G2046), used as alternate of [G4277](G4277)

d:
**1.** to go forward, go on
**2.** to go before
  **a.** to go before, precede
  **b.** to go before, in the advance of another
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2064](G2064) (including its alternate); to *go* *onward*, *precede* (in place or time): - go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.

d: **1.** to prepare before, to make ready beforehand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2090](G2090); to *fit* up *in* *advance* (literally or figuratively): - ordain before, prepare afore.

d: **1.** to announce or promise glad tidings beforehand
s: Middle voice from [G4253](G4253) and [G2097](G2097); to *announce* glad news *in* *advance:* - preach before the gospel.

d:
**1.** to have before or in advance of another, to have pre-eminence over another, to excel, surpass
**2.** to surpass in excellencies which can be passed to one’s credit
s: Middle voice from [G4253](G4253) and [G2192](G2192); to *hold* oneself *before* others, that is, (figuratively) to *excel:* - be better.

d: **1.** to go before and show the way, to go before and lead, to go before as a leader
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2233](G2233); to *lead* *the* *way* for others, that is, *show* *deference:* - prefer.

d:
**1.** a setting forth of a thing, placing of it in view, the shewbread
  **a.** twelve loaves of wheaten bread, corresponding to the number of the tribes of Israel, which loaves were offered to God every Sabbath, and separated into two rows, lay for seven days upon a table placed in the sanctuary or front portion of the tabernacle, and afterwards of the temple
**2.** a purpose
s: From [G4388](G4388); a *setting* *forth*, that is, (figuratively) *proposal* (*intention*); specifically the *show* bread (in the Temple) as *exposed* before God: - purpose, shew \[-bread\].

d: **1.** set beforehand, appointed or determined beforehand, prearranged
s: From [G4253](G4253) and a derivative of [G5087](G5087); *fixed* *beforehand*, that is, (feminine with [G2250](G2250) implied) a *designated* day: - time appointed.

d:
**1.** zeal, spirit, eagerness
**2.** inclination, readiness of mind
s: From [G4289](G4289); *predisposition*, that is, *alacrity:* - forwardness of mind, readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.

d: **1.** ready, willing
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2372](G2372); *forward* in *spirit*, that is, *predisposed*; neuter (as noun) *alacrity:* - ready, willing.

d: **1.** willingly, with alacrity
s: Adverb from [G4289](G4289); *with* *alacrity:* - willingly.

d:
**1.** to set or place before
  **a.** to set over
  **b.** to be over, to superintend, preside over
  **c.** to be a protector or guardian
    **1.** to give aid
  **d.** to care for, give attention to
    **1.** profess honest occupations
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2476](G2476); to *stand* *before*, that is, (in rank) to *preside*, or (by implication) to *practise:* - maintain, be over, rule.

d:
**1.** to call forth
**2.** to call forth to one’s self
  **a.** esp. to challenge to a combat or contest with one
**3.** to provoke, to irritate
s: Middle voice from [G4253](G4253) and [G2564](G2564); to *call* *forth* *to* *oneself* (*challenge*), that is, (by implication) to *irritate:* - provoke.

d:
**1.** to announce beforehand (that a thing will be)
  **a.** of prophecies
**2.** to preannounce in the sense of to promise
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2605](G2605); to *announce* *beforehand*, that is, *predict*, *promise:* - foretell, have notice (shew) before.

d: **1.** to prepare beforehand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2675](G2675); to *prepare* *in* *advance:* - make up beforehand.

d:
**1.** to lie or be placed before (a person or a thing) or in front of
**2.** to set before
  **a.** to be placed before the eyes, to lie in sight
    **1.** to stand forth
  **b.** to be appointed, destined
  **c.** to be there, be present, be at hand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2749](G2749); to *lie* *before* the view, that is, (figuratively) to *be* *present* (to the mind), to *stand* *forth* (as an example or reward): - be first, set before (forth).

d:
**1.** to announce or proclaim be herald beforehand
**2.** to announce beforehand (of the herald himself)
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2784](G2784); to *herald* (that is, *proclaim*) *in* *advance:* - before (first) preach.

d: **1.** progress, advancement
s: From [G4298](G4298); *progress*, that is, *advancement* (subjectively or objectively): - furtherance, profit.

d:
**1.** to beat forward
  **a.** to lengthen out by hammering (as a smith forges metals)
  **b.** metaph. to promote, forward, further
**2.** to go forward, advance, proceed
  **a.** of time: the night is far spent
  **b.** metaph. to increase, make progress
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2875](G2875); to *drive* *forward* (as if by beating), that is, (figuratively and intransitively) to *advance* (in amount, to *grow*; in time, to *be* *well* *along*): - increase, proceed, profit, be far spent, wax.

d:
**1.** an opinion formed before the facts are known
**2.** a prejudgment, a prejudice
s: From a compound of [G4253](G4253) and [G2919](G2919); a *prejudgment* (*prejudice*), that is, *prepossession:* - prefer one before another.

d: **1.** to sanction, ratify, or establish beforehand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2964](G2964); to *ratify* *previously:* - confirm before.

d:
**1.** to take before
**2.** to anticipate, to forestall
**3.** to take one by forestalling (him i.e. before he can flee or conceal his crime)
  **a.** surprise, detect
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G2983](G2983); to *take* *in* *advance*, that is, (literally) *eat* *before* others have an opportunity; (figuratively) to *anticipate*, *surprise:* - come aforehand, overtake, take before.

d: **1.** to say beforehand, to predict
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3004](G3004); to *say* *beforehand*, that is, *predict*, *forewarn:* - foretell, tell before.

d:
**1.** antetestor
**2.** to testify beforehand
  **a.** to make known, predict
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3143](G3143); to *be* *a* *witness* *in* *advance*, that is, *predict:* - testify beforehand.

d: **1.** to meditate beforehand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3191](G3191); to *premeditate:* - meditate before.

d: **1.** to be anxious beforehand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3309](G3309); to *care* (anxiously) *in* *advance:* - take thought beforehand.

d:
**1.** to perceive before, foresee
**2.** to provide, think of beforehand
  **a.** to provide for one
  **b.** to take thought for, care for a thing
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3539](G3539); to *consider* *in* *advance*, that is, *look* out for *beforehand* (active voice by way of *maintenance* for others; middle voice by way of *circumspection* for oneself): - provide (for).

d:
**1.** forethought, providential care
**2.** to make provision for a thing
s: From [G4306](G4306); *forethought*, that is, provident *care* or *supply:* - providence, provision.

d:
**1.** to see before (whether as respects place or time)
**2.** to keep before one’s eye’s
**3.** metaph. to be mindful of one always
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3708](G3708); to *behold* *in* *advance*, that is, (active voice) to *notice* (another) *previously*, or (middle voice) to *keep* *in* (one’s own) *view:* - foresee, see before.

d:
**1.** to predetermine, decide beforehand
**2.** in the NT of God decreeing from eternity
**3.** to foreordain, appoint beforehand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3724](G3724); to *limit* *in* *advance*, that is, (figuratively) *predetermine:* - determine before, ordain, predestinate.

d: **1.** to suffer before
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3958](G3958); to *undergo* hardship *previously:* - suffer before.

d:
**1.** to send before
**2.** to send forward, bring on the way, accompany or escort
**3.** to set one forward, fit him out with the requisites for a journey
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G3992](G3992); to *send* *forward*, that is, *escort* or *aid* in travel: - accompany, bring (forward) on journey (way), conduct forth.

d:
**1.** to fall forwards, headlong, sloping, precipitously
**2.** precipitate, rash, reckless
s: From a compound of [G4253](G4253) and [G4098](G4098); *falling* *forward*, that is, *headlong* (figuratively *precipitate*): - heady, rash \[-ly\].

d:
**1.** to send before, to make to precede
**2.** to go before one
  **a.** of a leader
  **b.** of a messenger or a herald
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G4198](G4198); to *precede* (as guide or herald): - go before.

d:
**1.** to the advantage of
**2.** at, near, by
**3.** to, towards, with, with regard to
s: A strengthened form of [G4253](G4253); a preposition of direction; *forward* *to*, that is, *toward* (with the genitive case *the* *side* of, that is, *pertaining* *to*; with the dative case *by* *the* *side* *of*, that is, *near* *to*; usually with the accusative case the place, time, occasion, or respect, which is the *destination* of the relation, that is, *whither* or *for* which it is predicated): - about, according to, against, among, at, because of, before, between, (\[where-\]) by, for, X at thy house, in, for intent, nigh unto, of, which pertain to, that, to (the end that), + together, to (\[you\]) -ward, unto, with (-in). In compounds it denotes essentially the same applications, namely, motion towards, accession to, or nearness at.

d: **1.** the day before the sabbath
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G4521](G4521); a *fore* *sabbath*, that is, the *sabbath* *eve*: - day before the sabbath. Compare [G3904](G3904).

d:
**1.** to speak to, to address, accost, salute
**2.** esp. to address or accost by some name, call by name
**3.** to give a name in public, to style
s: From [G4314](G4314) and a derivative of [G58](G58) (meaning to *harangue*); to *address*, that is, salute by *name:* - call.
o: from [G4314](G4314) and a derivative of [G58](G58) (mean to harangue)

d:
**1.** to lead, to bring
  **a.** to open a way of access, for one to God
    **1.** to render one acceptable to God
  **b.** in a forensic sense, to summon (to trial or punishment)
**2.** to draw near to, approach
  **a.** the land which a sailor is approaching seeming to approach him
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G71](G71); to *lead* *towards*, that is, (transitively) to *conduct* *near* (*summon*, *present*), or (intransitively) to *approach:* - bring, draw near,

d:
**1.** the act of bringing to, a moving to
**2.** access, approach
  **a.** to God, i.e. that relationship with God whereby we are acceptable to him and have assurance that he is favourably disposed towards him
s: From [G4317](G4317) (compare [G72](G72)); *admission:* - access.

d:
**1.** to ask for in addition
**2.** to approach one with supplications
**3.** to ask alms
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G154](G154); to *ask* *repeatedly* (*importune*), that is, *solicit:* - beg.

d:
**1.** to go up further
**2.** go up higher
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G305](G305); to *ascend* *farther*, that is, *be* *promoted* (*take* *an* *upper* (*more* *honorable*) *seat*): - go up.

d: **1.** to expend besides (i.e. upon physicians)
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G355](G355); to *expend* *further:* - spend.

d: **1.** to fill up by adding to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G378](G378); to *fill* *up* *further*, that is, *furnish* *fully:* - supply.

d:
**1.** to lay upon in addition to
**2.** to lay upon one’s self in addition
  **a.** to undertake besides
  **b.** to put one’s self upon another by going to him,
  **c.** to commit or betake one’s self to another for the purpose of consulting him
  **d.** to consult, to take one into counsel
  **e.** to add from one’s store
**3.** to communicate, impart
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G394](G394); to *lay* *up* *in* *addition*, that is, (middle voice and figuratively) to *impart* or (by implication) to *consult:* - in conference add, confer.

d: **1.** to add threats, threaten further
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G546](G546); to *menace* *additionally:* - threaten further.

d: **1.** to spend besides
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G1159](G1159); to *expend* *additionally:* - spend more.

d: **1.** to want besides, need in addition
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G1189](G1189); to *require* *additionally*, that is, *want* *further:* - need.

d:
**1.** to receive to one’s self, to admit, to give access to one’s self
  **a.** to admit one, receive one into intercourse and companionship
  **b.** to receive one (coming from some place)
  **c.** to accept (not to reject) a thing offered
**2.** to expect: the fulfilment of promises
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G1209](G1209); to *admit* (to intercourse, hospitality, credence or (figuratively) endurance); by implication to *await* (with confidence or patience): - accept, allow, look (wait) for, take.

d:
**1.** to expect (whether in thought, in hope, or in fear)
**2.** to look for, wait for
s: From [G4314](G4314) and δοκεύω dokeuō (to *watch*); to *anticipate* (in thought, hope or fear); by implication to *await:* - (be in) expect (-ation), look (for), when looked, tarry, wait for.

d: **1.** expectation (whether good or evil)
s: From [G4328](G4328); *apprehension* (of evil); by implication *infliction* anticipated: - expectation, looking after.

d: **1.** to permit one to approach or arrive
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G1439](G1439); to *permit* *further* progress: - suffer.

d: **1.** to approach unto
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G1448](G1448); to *approach* *near:* - come nigh.

d:
**1.** to sit near
**2.** to attend assiduously
**3.** to be in attendance upon, not to quit one’s side
s: From a compound of [G4314](G4314) and the base of [G1476](G1476); to *sit* *near*, that is, *attend* as a servant: - wait at.
o: from a compound of [G4314](G4314) and the base of [G1476](G1476)

d:
**1.** to work besides
**2.** by working or trading to make or gain besides
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2038](G2038); to *work* *additionally*, that is, (by implication) *acquire* *besides:* - gain.

d:
**1.** to come to, approach
**2.** draw near to
**3.** to assent to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2064](G2064) (including its alternate); to *approach*, that is, (literally) *come* *near*, *visit*, or (figuratively) *worship*, *assent* *to:* - (as soon as he) come (unto), come thereunto, consent, draw near, go (near, to, unto).

d:
**1.** prayer addressed to God
**2.** a place set apart or suited for the offering of prayer
  **a.** a synagogue
  **b.** a place in the open air where the Jews were wont to pray, outside the cities, where they had no synagogue
    **1.** such places were situated upon the bank of a stream or the shore of a sea, where there was a supply of water for washing the hands before prayer
s: From [G4336](G4336); *prayer* (*worship*); by implication an *oratory* (*chapel*): - X pray earnestly, prayer.

d: **1.** to offer prayers, to pray
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2172](G2172); to *pray* *to* God, that is, *supplicate*, *worship:* - pray (X earnestly, for), make prayer.

d:
**1.** to bring to, bring near
  **a.** to bring a ship to land, and simply to touch at, put in
**2.** to turn the mind to, attend to be attentive
  **a.** to a person or a thing: of caring for, providing for
**3.** to attend to one’s self, i.e. to give heed to one’s self
  **a.** give attention to, take heed
**4.** to apply one’s self to, attach one’s self to, hold or cleave to a person or a thing
  **a.** to be given or addicted to
  **b.** to devote thought and effort to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2192](G2192); (figuratively) to *hold* the mind ([G3563](G3563) implied) *towards*, that is, *pay* *attention* *to*, *be* *cautious* *about*, *apply* *oneself* *to*, *adhere* *to:* - (give) attend (-ance, -ance at, -ance to, unto), beware, be given to, give (take) heed (to, unto) have regard.

d: **1.** to fasten with nails to, nail to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and a derivative of [G2247](G2247); to *peg* *to*, that is, *spike* fast: - nail to.

d:
**1.** a newcomer
  **a.** a stranger, alien
**2.** a proselyte
  **a.** one who has come over from a Gentile religion to Judaism
s: From the alternate of [G4334](G4334); an *arriver* from a foreign region, that is, (specifically) an *acceder* (*convert*) to Judaism (“proselyte”): - proselyte.

d:
**1.** for a season
**2.** enduring only for a while
**3.** temporary
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2540](G2540); *for* the *occasion* only, that is, *temporary:* - dur- \[eth\] for awhile, endure for a time, for a season, temporal.

d:
**1.** to call to
**2.** to call to one’s self
**3.** to bid to come to one’s self
**4.** metaph.
  **a.** God is said to call to himself the Gentiles, aliens as they are from him, by inviting them, through the preaching of the gospel unto fellowship with himself in the messiah’s kingdom
  **b.** christ and the holy Sprit are said to call to themselves those preachers of the gospel to whom they have decided to intrust a service having reference to the extension of the gospel
s: Middle voice from [G4314](G4314) and [G2564](G2564); to *call* *toward* *oneself*, that is, *summon*, *invite:* - call (for, to, unto).

d:
**1.** to adhere to one, be his adherent, to be devoted or constant to one
**2.** to be steadfastly attentive unto, to give unremitting care to a thing
**3.** to continue all the time in a place
**4.** to persevere and not to faint
**5.** to show one’s self courageous for
**6.** to be in constant readiness for one, wait on constantly
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2594](G2594); to *be* *earnest* *towards*, that is, (to a thing) to *persevere*, *be* *constantly* diligent, or (in a place) to *attend* assiduously all the exercises, or (to a person) to *adhere* closely *to* (as a servitor): - attend (give self) continually (upon), continue (in, instant in, with), wait on (continually).

d: **1.** perseverance
s: From [G4342](G4342); *persistency:* - perseverance.

d: **1.** a pillow, cushion
s: Neuter of a presumed compound of [G4314](G4314) and [G2776](G2776); something *for* the *head*, that is, a *cushion:* - pillow.
o: neuter of a presumed compound of [G4314](G4314) and [G2776](G2776)

d: **1.** to add or assign by lot, to allot
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2820](G2820); to *give* a common *lot* *to*, that is, (figuratively) to *associate* *with:* - consort with.

d:
**1.** an inclination or proclivity of mind
**2.** a joining the party of one
**3.** partiality
s: From a compound of [G4314](G4314) and [G2827](G2827); a *leaning* *towards*, that is, (figuratively) *proclivity* (*favoritism*): - partiality.

d:
**1.** to glue upon, glue to
**2.** to join one’s self to closely, cleave to, stick to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2853](G2853); to *glue* *to*, that is, (figuratively) to *adhere:* - cleave, join (self).

d:
**1.** a stumbling block
  **a.** an obstacle in the way which if one strikes his foot against he stumbles or falls
  **b.** that over which a soul stumbles i.e. by which is caused to sin
s: From [G4350](G4350); a *stub*, that is, (figuratively) *occasion* *of* *apostasy:* - offence, stumbling (-block,\[-stone\]).

d:
**1.** an occasion of stumbling
**2.** to do something which causes others to stumble
  **a.** i.e. leads them into error or sin
s: From [G4350](G4350); a *stumbling*, that is, (figuratively and concretely) *occasion* *of* *sin:* - offence.

d:
**1.** to strike against
  **a.** of those who strike against a stone or other obstacle in the path, to stumble
  **b.** to strike one’s foot against a stone
    **1.** i.e. to meet with some harm;
  **c.** to rush upon, beat against
  **d.** to be made to stumble by a thing
    **1.** i.e. metaph. to be induced to sin
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2875](G2875); to *strike* *at*, that is, *surge* *against* (as water); specifically to *stub* *on*, that is, *trip* *up* (literally or figuratively): - beat upon, dash, stumble (at).

d: **1.** to roll to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2947](G2947); to *roll* *towards*, that is, *block* *against:* - roll (to).

d:
**1.** to kiss the hand to (towards) one, in token of reverence
**2.** among the Orientals, esp. the Persians, to fall upon the knees and touch the ground with the forehead as an expression of profound reverence
**3.** in the NT by kneeling or prostration to do homage (to one) or make obeisance, whether in order to express respect or to make supplication
  **a.** used of homage shown to men and beings of superior rank
    **1.** to the Jewish high priests
    **2.** to God
    **3.** to christ
    **4.** to heavenly beings
    **5.** to demons
s: From [G4314](G4314) and probably a derivative of [G2965](G2965) (meaning to *kiss*, like a dog *licking* his master’s hand); to *fawn* or *crouch* *to*, that is, (literally or figuratively) *prostrate* oneself in homage (*do* *reverence* to, *adore*): - worship.
o: from [G4314](G4314) and a probable derivative of [G2965](G2965) (meaning to kiss, like a dog licking his master’s hand)

d: **1.** a worshipper
s: From [G4352](G4352); an *adorer:* - worshipper.

d: **1.** to speak to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2980](G2980); to *talk* *to*, that is, *converse* *with:* - speak to (with).

d:
**1.** to take to, take in addition, to take to one’s self
  **a.** to take as one’s companion
  **b.** to take by the hand in order to lead aside
  **c.** to take or receive into one’s home, with the collateral idea of kindness
  **d.** to receive, i.e. grant one access to one’s heart
    **1.** to take into friendship and intercourse
  **e.** to take to one’s self, to take: i.e. food
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G2983](G2983); to *take* *to* oneself, that is, *use* (food), *lead* (aside), *admit* (to friendship or hospitality): - receive, take (unto).

d: **1.** a receiving: into the kingdom of God
s: From [G4355](G4355); *admission:* - receiving.

d:
**1.** to remain with, to continue with one
**2.** to hold fast to: the grace of God received in the Gospel
**3.** to remain still, tarry, stay
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G3306](G3306); to *stay* *further*, that is, *remain* in a place, with a person; figuratively to *adhere* to, *persevere* in: - abide still, be with, cleave unto, continue in (with).

d:
**1.** to bring a ship to moorings
**2.** to take one’s station near the shore
**3.** to moor, come to anchor
s: From [G4314](G4314) and a derivative of the same as [G3730](G3730) (meaning to *tie* (*anchor*) or *lull*); to *moor* *to*, that is, (by implication) *land* *at:* - draw to the shore.
o: from [G4314](G4314) and a derivative of the same as [G3730](G3730) (meaning to tie \[anchor\] or lull)

d: **1.** to owe beside
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G3784](G3784); to *be* *indebted* *additionally:* - over besides.

d:
**1.** to be wroth or displeased with
**2.** to loathe
**3.** to spew out
**4.** to be disgusted with
s: From [G4314](G4314) and a form of ὀχθέω ochtheō (to *be* *vexed* with something irksome); to *feel* *indignant* *at:* - be grieved with.
o: from [G4314](G4314) and a form of ochtheo (to be vexed with something irksome)

d: **1.** very hungry
s: From [G4314](G4314) and the same as [G3983](G3983); *hungering* *further*, that is, *intensely* *hungry:* - very hungry.

d: **1.** to fasten
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G4078](G4078); to *fasten* *to*, that is, (specifically) to *impale* (on a cross): - crucify.

d:
**1.** to fall forwards, fall down, prostrate one’s self before, in homage or supplication: at one’s feet
**2.** to rush upon, beat against
  **a.** of winds beating upon a house
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G4098](G4098); to *fall* *towards*, that is, (gently) *prostrate* oneself (in supplication or homage), or (violently) to *rush* upon (in storm): - beat upon, fall (down) at (before).

d:
**1.** to take or claim a thing to one’s self
**2.** to conform one’s self to a thing, or rather to affect to one’s self
  **a.** to pretend
s: Middle voice from [G4314](G4314) and [G4160](G4160); to *do* *forward* *for* *oneself*, that is, *pretend* (as if about to do a thing): - make as though.

d: **1.** to draw near, approach
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G4198](G4198); to *journey* *towards*, that is, *approach* (not the same as [G4313](G4313)): - go before.

d: **1.** to break against, break by dashing against
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G4486](G4486); to *tear* *towards*, that is, *burst* *upon* (as a tempest or flood): - beat vehemently against (upon).

d:
**1.** to assign or ascribe to, join to
**2.** to enjoin, order, prescribe, command
  **a.** to appoint, to define
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G5021](G5021); to *arrange* *towards*, that is, (figuratively) *enjoin:* - bid, command.

d:
**1.** a woman set over others
**2.** a female guardian, protectress, patroness, caring for the affairs of others and aiding them with her resources
s: Feminine of a derivative of [G4291](G4291); a *patroness*, that is, *assistant:* - succourer.

d:
**1.** to put to
**2.** to add
  **a.** i.e. to join to, gather with any company, the number of one’s followers or companions
    **1.** he was gathered to his fathers i.e. died
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G5087](G5087); to *place* *additionally*, that is, *lay* *beside*, *annex*, *repeat:* - add, again, give more, increase, lay unto, proceed further, speak to any more.

d: **1.** to run to
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G5143](G5143) (including its alternate); to *run* *towards*, that is, *hasten* to meet or join: - run (thither to, to).

d:
**1.** anything eaten with bread
  **a.** spoken of fish boiled or broiled
s: Neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of [G4314](G4314) and [G5315](G5315); something *eaten* *in* *addition* to bread, that is, a *relish* (specifically *fish*; compare [G3795](G3795)): - meat.
o: from a presumed derivative of a compound of [G4314](G4314) and [G5315](G5315)

d:
**1.** lately slaughtered, freshly killed
**2.** recently made, new
s: From [G4253](G4253) and a derivative of [G4969](G4969); *previously* (*recently*) *slain* (*fresh*), that is, (figuratively) *lately* *made:* - new.

d: **1.** lately
s: Adverb from [G4372](G4372); *recently:* - lately.

d:
**1.** to bring to, lead to
  **a.** one to a person who can heal him or is ready to show him some kindness, one to a person who is to judge him
  **b.** to bring a present or a thing, to reach or hand a thing to one
  **c.** to put to
**2.** to be borne towards one, to attack, assail
  **a.** to behave one’s self towards one, deal with one
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G5342](G5342) (including its alternate); to *bear* *towards*, that is, *lead* *to*, *tender* (especially to God), *treat:* - bring (to, unto), deal with, do, offer (unto, up), present unto, put to.

d: **1.** acceptable, pleasing
s: From a presumed compound of [G4314](G4314) and [G5368](G5368); *friendly* *towards*, that is, *acceptable:* - lovely.
o: from a presumed compound of [G4314](G4314) and [G5368](G5368)

d:
**1.** the act of offering, a bringing to
**2.** that which is offered, a gift, a present. In the NT a sacrifice, whether bloody or not: offering for sin, expiatory offering
s: From [G4374](G4374); *presentation*; concretely an *oblation* (bloodless) or *sacrifice:* - offering (up).

d:
**1.** to call to, to address by calling
**2.** to call to one’s self, summon
s: From [G4314](G4314) and [G5455](G5455); to *sound* *towards*, that is, *address*, *exclaim*, *summon:* - call unto, speak (un-) to.

d: **1.** a pouring or sprinkling upon, affusion
s: From a compound of [G4314](G4314) and χέω cheō (to *pour*); a *shedding* *forth*, that is, *affusion:* - sprinkling.
o: from a comparative of [G4314](G4314) and cheo (to pour)

d: **1.** to touch
s: From [G4314](G4314) and ψαύω psauō (to *touch*); to *impinge*, that is, *lay* *a* *finger* *on* (in order to relieve): - touch.

d:
**1.** to respect the person (i.e. the external condition of man)
**2.** to have respect of persons, discriminate
s: From [G4381](G4381); to *favor* *an* *individual*, that is, *show* *partiality:* - have respect to persons.

d:
**1.** an acceptor of persons
**2.** one who discriminates
s: From [G4383](G4383) and [G2983](G2983); an *accepter* of *a* *face* (*individual*), that is, (specifically) one *exhibiting* *partiality:* - respecter of persons.

d:
**1.** respect of persons
**2.** partiality
  **a.** the fault of one who when called on to give judgment has respect of the outward circumstances of man and not to their intrinsic merits, and so prefers, as the more worthy, one who is rich, high born, or powerful, to another who does not have these qualities
s: From [G4381](G4381); *partiality*, that is, *favoritism:* - respect of persons.

d:
**1.** the face
  **a.** the front of the human head
  **b.** countenance, look
    **1.** the face so far forth as it is the organ of sight, and by it various movements and changes) the index of the inward thoughts and feelings
  **c.** the appearance one presents by his wealth or property, his rank or low condition
    **1.** outward circumstances, external condition
    **2.** used in expressions which denote to regard the person in one’s judgment and treatment of men
**2.** the outward appearance of inanimate things
s: From [G4314](G4314) and ὤψ ōps (the *visage*; from [G3700](G3700)); the *front* (as being *towards* *view*), that is, the *countenance*, *aspect*, *appearance*, *surface*; by implication *presence*, *person:* - (outward) appearance, X before, countenance, face, fashion, (men’s) person, presence.

d:
**1.** to place before
**2.** to appoint before, define beforehand
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G5021](G5021); to *pre-arrange*, that is, *prescribe:* - before appoint.

d:
**1.** to stretch forth, stretch out
  **a.** when they had stretched one out on the thongs i.e. to receive the blows of the thongs (by tying him up to a beam or a pillar)
s: From [G4253](G4253) and τείνω teinō (to *stretch*); to *protend*, that is, *tie* *prostrate* (for scourging): - bind.

d:
**1.** before, prior
  **a.** of time, former
s: Neuter of [G4387](G4387) as adverb (with or without the article); *previously:* - before, (at the) first, former.
o: neuter of [G4387](G4387) as adverb (with or without the art.)

d:
**1.** before, prior
  **a.** of time, previous, former
s: Comparative of [G4253](G4253); *prior* or *previous:* - former.

d:
**1.** to place before, to set forth
  **a.** to set forth to be looked at, expose to view
  **b.** to expose to public view
    **1.** of the bodies of the dead
    **2.** to let lie in state
**2.** to set before one’s self, propose to one’s self
  **a.** to purpose, determine
s: Middle voice from [G4253](G4253) and [G5087](G5087); to *place* *before*, that is, (for oneself) to *exhibit*; (to oneself) to *propose* (*determine*): - purpose, set forth.

d: **1.** to urge forwards, exhort, encourage
s: Middle voice from [G4253](G4253) and the base of [G5157](G5157); to *turn* *forward* for oneself, that is, *encourage:* - exhort.
o: middle voice from [G4253](G4253) and the base of [G5157](G5157)

d: **1.** to run before, to outrun
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G5143](G5143) (including its alternate); to *run* *forward*, that is, *outstrip*, *precede:* - outrun, run before.

d: **1.** to be before, exist previously
s: From [G4253](G4253) and [G5225](G5225); to *exist* *before*, that is, (adverbially) to *be* or *do* something *previously:* - + be before (-time).

d:
**1.** a pretext (alleged reason, pretended cause)
**2.** show
  **a.** under colour as though they would do something
  **b.** in pretence, ostensibly
